translations.translation: Sto Onoma tou Allakh, tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), tou Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnou).
Oles oi eukharisties (kai oi doxasies kai oi epainoi) anekoun ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon (tes anthropotetas, ton tzinn kai olon oson uparkhoun).
Ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), ton Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhno).
Ton Kuriarkho tes Emeras tes Kriseos.
Esena mono latreuoume kai apo Esena mono zetame boetheia kai uposterixe.
Kathodegese mas ston ortho dromo.
Ton dromo ekeinon pou tous kharises ten Eunoia Sou, kai okhi ekeinon pou periepesan sten orge Sou, oute ekeinon pou parastratesan.

A, L, M (Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an -Koranio- pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio).
S' auto to Biblio (to Kor'an) den uparkhei kamia amphibolia. Kai apotelei kathodegese gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou).
Oi opoioi pisteuoun sto aorato kai teloun tis proseukhes (stis ores tous kai me to sosto tropo) kai apo o,ti tous parekhoume, xodeuoun (se o,ti orise o Allakh apo eleemosune kai philanthropia klp.).
Kai oi opoioi pisteuoun se o,ti staltheke se sena (o, Mokhammant) (del. to Kor'an) kai se o,ti staltheke prin apo sena (apo Theia Biblia) kai pisteuoun me bebaioteta ste Mellousa Zoe.
Ekeinoi briskontai se kathodegese apo ton Kurio tous kai ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.
Oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste (apo alazoneia kai turannia), eite tous proeidopoieis, eite okhi (o, Mokhammant), einai to idio gi' autous, de tha pistepsoun.

O Allakh ekhei sphragisei tis kardies tous kai ten akoe tous, kai sta matia tous uparkhei kalumma (logo tes alazoneias kai tes turannias tous), kai tha ekhoun (kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) ena terastio marturio.
Kai anamesa stous anthropous uparkhoun ekeinoi (oi upokrites) pou lene: <<Pisteuoume ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera>>, eno sten pragmatikoteta den pisteuoun.
Nomizoun oti exapatoun ton Allakh kai tous pistous, eno sten pragmatikoteta exapatoun mono tous eautous tous, kai den to antilambanontai!
Stis kardies tous uparkhei astheneia (tes amphibolias kai tes upokrisias). Kai etsi, o Allakh auxanei ten astheneia tous, kai tha ekhoun epoduno marturio gia o,ti psemata elegan.
Kai otan legetai se autous: <<Me skorpizete to kako (ten apistia kai tis amarties) ste ge.>> Apantoun: <<St' aletheia, emeis eimaste autoi pou kanoun to kalo.>>
Ma, st' aletheia, autoi einai ekeinoi pou skorpizoun to kako, alla den to antilambanontai.

Kai otan legetai se autous: <<Pistepste, opos pistepsan oi anthropoi (oi suntrophoi tou Mokhammant).>> Apantoun: <<Thelete na pistepsoume opos pistepsan oi anoetoi;>> Ma, st' aletheia, autoi einai oi anoetoi, alla den to gnorizoun.

Kai otan sunantoun tous pistous, lene: <<Pisteuoume (ki emeis).>> Ma otan pane stous diabolous (apistous egetes) tous, kai miloun metaxu tous, lene: <<St' aletheia, eimaste mazi sas. Apla koroideuoume (tous Mousoulmanous).>>

O Allakh tous koroideuei (antapodidontas ten koroidia tous, kanontas tous na ekhoun tous kanones kai ta dikaiomata ton Mousoulmanon kata ten egkosmia zoe, alla ste Mellousa Zoe tha tous timoresei gia ten apistia tous) kai tous aphenei (anaballontas ten timoria tous, oste) na aphethoun perissotero sten plane kai sten turannia tous, kai etsi paramenoun se sugkhuse.
Autoi einai pou ekhoun antallaxei ten kathodegese me ten plane, etsi, oute e sunallage tous etan kerdismene, oute autoi etan kathodegemenoi.
Autoi moiazoun me auton pou anapse mia photia (gia phos). Epeita, otan (e photia) photise ta panta guro tou, o Allakh pere to phos tous kai tous aphese sta skotadia. (Etsi) den mporoun na doun.
Kophoi, bouboi kai tuphloi (apo to na akoun, na lene e na blepoun ten aletheia) kai etsi den tha epistrepsoun (ston isio dromo).

E san mia kataigida apo ton ourano, kata ten opoia uparkhoun skotadia, brontes kai astrapes. Khonoun ta dakhtula tous sta autia tous apo ton phobo tou thanatou apo tous keraunous. Ma, o Allakh panta perikuklonei tous apistous (del. den tha xephugoun apo Auton).

Paraligo e astrape na arpaxei ten orase tous, opote astraphtei gi' autous, perpatoun sto phos tes, kai otan stamataei kai tous kaluptei to skotadi, stekontai akinetoi. Kai an ethele o Allakh, tha epairne ten akoe kai ten orase tous. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Ikanos gia ta panta.
O, anthropoi! Latrepste ton Kurio sas, pou demiourgese esas kai osous etan prin apo sas, mepos kai (kanontas auto) phulakhtheite (apo ten timoria tou Allakh).

O Opoios ekane te ge os stromeno khali gia sas (oste na dieukolunei te zoe sas pano tes) kai ton ourano teleia kataskeue (os stege gia sas). Kai esteile kato nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano, me to opoio (nero) ebgale (apo te ge) karpous os agatha gia sas. Etsi loipon, men apodidete etairous ston Allakh (ste latreia), eno gnorizete (oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos).

Kai an eseis (o, anthropoi) amphiballete skhetika me auto (to Kor'an) pou steilame ston doulo Mas, tote pherte mia Soura (Kephalaio) paromoia me auto (to Kor'an), kai kaleste tous martures sas (uposteriktes kai boethous) ektos apo ton Allakh, an eiste eilikrineis.

Ma an den to kanete, kai pote den tha mporesete na to kanete, tote na phulakhtheite (meso tes upakoes pros ton Allakh) apo to Pur (tes Kolaseos), tou opoiou to kausimo einai anthropoi kai petres (ta eidola pou latreuan oi apistoi), kai einai proetoimasmeno gia tous apistous.

Kai anaggeile ta eukharista nea s' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, oti gi' autous tha uparkhoun kepoi (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Kathe phora pou tha tous parekhetai enas karpos apo ekei, tha lene: <<Autos (o karpos) einai pou mas eikhe dothei sto parelthon (kata ten egkosmia zoe).>> Tha tous dinetai idios (karpos me ton karpo tes egkosmias zoes, idios ste morphe kai sto onoma, ma diaphoretikos ste geuse), kai tha ekhoun ekei agnes suzugous, kai tha katoikesoun ekei gia panta.

St' aletheia, o Allakh den ntrepetai na dosei to paradeigma (akome ki) enos kounoupiou e otidepote allo pano apo auto. Oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun, gnorizoun oti aute einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio tous, ma oso gia tous apistous, lene: <<Ti skopo eikhe o Allakh me auto to paradeigma;>> Me auto paraplana pollous, kai pollous kathodegei me auto. Ma den paraplana, para mono tous anupakouous.

Autoi pou athetoun te desmeuse pou tous anethese o Allakh (to na men Tou apodidoun kanenan etairo ste latreia kai na akolouthesoun te threskeia Tou), aphou ekhei epibebaiothei (aute e desmeuse meso tes apostoles ton apostolon kai ton biblion), kai koboun o,ti o Allakh dietaxe na enothei (opos tous desmous suggeneias klp.), kai skorpizoun to kako ste ge, autoi einai oi khamenoi.

Pos arneiste ton Allakh, aphou eno esastan nekroi (prin gennetheite), Autos einai pou sas edose zoe; Epeita, tha sas aphairesei te zoe kai epeita tha sas epanapherei ste zoe (kata ten Emera tes Kriseos), kai epeita, se Auton tha epistrepsete.
Einai Autos pou eplase gia sas o,ti brisketai ste ge. Epeita, prokhorese ste demiourgia tou ouranou kai ton demiourgese se epta ouranous (stromata). Kai einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Kurios sou eipe stous aggelous: <<St' aletheia, tha kano pano ste ge anthropous pou e kathe genia tha diadekhetai e mia ten alle.>> Eipan (rotesan gia na mathoun te sophia piso apo auto): <<Tha baleis pano tes kapoion pou tha skorpizei to kako ekei kai tha khunei to aima, eno emeis Se doxazoume eugnomonontas Esena kai Se epainoume;>> (O Allakh) eipe: <<St' aletheia, gnorizo auto pou den gnorizete.>>

Kai didaxe ston Adam ta onomata olon ton pragmaton. Epeita, ta edeixe stous aggelous kai eipe: <<Peite Mou ta onomata tous, an auto pou eipate iskhuei (oti eiste pio timemenoi kai kaluteroi apo auton).>>
Eipan (oi aggeloi): <<Doxa se Esena! Den ekhoume gnose, para mono o,ti mas didaxes. St' aletheia, Esu eisai o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

Eipe (o Allakh): <<O, Adam, enemerose tous gia ta onomata tous.>> Kai otan tous eipe ta onomata tous, (o Allakh) eipe: <<Den sas eipa oti gnorizo ola ta aorata ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai gnorizo ti phaneronete kai ti kratate mesa sas;>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan eipame stous aggelous, <<Peste se Soutzount stase (del. me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos) enopion tou Adam (os sebasmo kai time pros auton).>> Kai etsi, epesan oloi se Soutzount stase, ektos apo ton Implis (-ton Satana- pou etan apo ta tzinn), arnetheke kai egine alazonas, kai etsi egine enas apo tous apistous.

Kai eipame: <<O, Adam, katoikese esu kai e suzugos sou ston Paradeiso kai phate ap' opou thelete ap' auton eleuthera me eukharistese kai apolause. Alla men plesiasete auto to dentro, oste na men eiste anamesa stous adikous.>>

Alla, o Satanas tous ekane na pesoun sten amartia logo tou (dentrou, aphou tous psithurise na phane apo auto) kai etsi tous ebgale apo ten eudaimonia pou zousan (ston Paradeiso). Kai eipame: <<Katebeite (oloi sas ste Ge) os ekhthroi metaxu sas, kai tha ekhete pano ste Ge topo katoikias kai tha epopheletheite apo ta agatha tes gia kapoio diastema.>>

Epeita, o Adam elabe apo ton Kurio tou logia (pou tha prepei na pei, oste na ton sugkhoresei). Kai etsi, apodekhteke te metameleia tou. St' aletheia, Autos einai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Eipame: <<Katebeite ap' auto to meros (ton Paradeiso), oloi sas. Kai otan e kathodegese elthei s' esas apo Mena (meso ton apostolon Mou), opoioi akolouthesoun ten kathodegese Mou, den tha uparxei phobos gi' autous (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Kai opoioi arnethoun ten piste kai diapseusoun ta Edaphia (kai ta Semeia) Mas, autoi tha einai oi katoikoi tou Puros. Tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.>>

O, paidia tou Israel (Iakobou), thumetheite ten eunoia Mou pou parakhoresa s' esas, kai tereiste te desmeuse pou sas anethesa (to na tereite tis entoles Mou), oste na ekpleroso ten uposkhese Mou pros esas (eisagontas sas ston Paradeiso), kai na phobaste mono Emena.

Kai pistepste s' auto pou ekho steilei (to Kor'an), to opoio epibebaionei auto pou ekhete (apo ten prototupe Tora kai to prototupo In-tzel -euaggelio- tou Iesou prin te diastreblose tous, pou epibebaiosan oti kaneis den axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh, kai ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant), kai men eiste oi protoi pou to arnountai. Kai men antallassete ta Edaphia Mou (alloionontas Ta) me kapoio mikro timema (apo exousia e khremata), kai apo Emena (kai ten orge Mou) na phulakhtheite (meso tes tereses ton entolon Mou).

Kai men mperdeuete ten aletheia (pou esteila stous Aggeliaphorous Mou) me to pseudos (pou epinoesate) kai men krubete ten aletheia (pou anaphertheke stis Graphes sas gia ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant) eno (te) gnorizete.

Kai (na eiserkheste sto Islam kai) na teleite tis proseukhes (stis kathorismenes ores tous kai me to sosto tropo) kai na dinete te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai na upoklineste (kai na upotakhteite ston Allakh) mazi m' ekeinous pou upoklinontai (tous Mousoulmanous pou upotassontai s' Auton).

Diatazete ten arete (kai ten piste) stous anthropous, eno eseis oi idioi xekhnate na ten diataxete ston eauto sas, eno apaggellete to Biblio (ten Tora pou sas diatazei na akoloutheite te threskeia tou Allakh kai tous Aggeliaphorous Tou); Ma den sullogizeste;

Kai na anazetate te boetheia (tou Allakh) meso tes upomones kai tes proseukhes (pou sas phernei pio konta ston Allakh), kai st' aletheia aute (e proseukhe) einai baria, ektos gia tous alethinous tapeinous pistous (pou upotassontai ston Allakh)..
Oi opoioi einai bebaioi oti tha sunantesoun ton Kurio tous, kai oti se Auton tha epistrepsoun.
O, paidia tou Israel (Iakobou)! Thumetheite ten eunoia Mou pou parakhoresa s' esas kai oti sas protimesa (me Theia apokalupse kai basileia) apo olous tous anthropous (tou kairou sas, sto parelthon).

Kai na phulakhtheite (meso tes tereses ton entolon Mou) apo mia Emera (tes Kriseos) kata ten opoia kamia psukhe den tha ophelesei kamia alle, oute kamia diamesolabese tha ginei apodekte ek merous tes, oute kanena antallagma tha parthei apo auten (oste na men timorethei), oute tha boethethoun.

Kai (thumetheite) otan sas sosame apo tous opadous tou Pharao, pou sas ekanan na geuteite ena tromero marturio: esphaxan tous gious sas kai aphesan (tis kores kai) tis gunaikes sas na zesoun (os doules), kai se auto (del. oti sas sosame apo autous) uperkhe mia megale dokimasia apo ton Kurio sas (an tha esastan eugnomones meta apo auto).

Kai (thumetheite) otan skhisame to nero gia sas (aphou diataxame ton Mouse na to khtupesei me to rabdi tou, kai etsi skhisteke to nero se duo) kai etsi sas sosame kai pnixame ton lao tou Pharao, eno eseis koitousate (autous na pnigontai).

Kai (thumetheite) otan orisame gia ton Mouse saranta nukhtes (gia na Mas epikalestei me aphosiose pano sto oros, kai sto telos tous na tou milesoume kai na tou apokalupsoume ten Tora os kathodegese kai phos), alla kata ten apousia tou perate to moskhari (gia latreia), kai esastan adikoi.
Epeita, meta ap' auto (kai te metameleia sas), sas sugkhoresame mepos kai ginete eugnomones.
Kai (thumetheite) otan dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora) os kriterio (tou kalou kai tou kakou) isos kai na kathodegetheite ortha.

Kai (thumetheite) otan o Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<O, lae mou! St' aletheia, ekhete adikesei tous eautous sas pairnontas to moskhari (gia latreia). Strapheite, loipon, me metameleia ston Demiourgo sas kai skototheite (oi athooi na skotosoun tous adikous anamesa sas), auto einai kalutero gia sas enopion tou Demiourgou sas (apo to na mpeite sto Pur gia panta).>> Ste sunekheia, (o Allakh) dekhteke te metameleia sas. St' aletheia, einai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Kai (thumetheite) otan eipate: <<O, Mouse! Den tha pistepsoume s' esena mekhri na doume ton Allakh phanera.>> Kai tote sas khtupese e photia (apo ton ourano) eno koitazate (o enas ton allon).
Epeita, sas anastesame meta ton thanato sas, mepos kai ginete eugnomones.

Kai (thumetheite te khare Mas otan khathekate ste ge, kai etsi) sas skiasame me sunnepha (apo te zeste tou eliou) kai sas steilame kato to manna (gluko poto san to meli) kai As-Saloa (poulakia pou moiazoun me ta ortukia) (legontas): <<Phate apo ta kala agatha pou pareikhame se sas.>> (Ma eginan agnomones) kai den Mas eblapsan (se tipote meso tes parakoes kai tes agnomosunes tous), ma tous eautous tous adikesan.

Kai (thumetheite) otan eipame: <<Mpeite s' auten ten pole (Ierousalem) kai phate ap' auten eleuthera me eukharistese ap' opou thelete, kai peraste ten pule tes upoklinomenoi (del. me tapeinoteta pros ton Allakh) kai peite: <<Sugkhorese mas.>> Kai tha sas sugkhoresoume tis amarties sas kai tha auxesoume (ten amoibe) gi' autous pou kanoun kales praxeis.
Ma oi adikoi (ap' autous) allaxan ton Logo pou eipotheke s' autous me allon, ki etsi steilame pano stous adikous mia timoria apo ton ourano, logo tes anupakoes tous.

Kai (thumetheite) otan (khathekate ste ge kai esastan dipsasmenoi, kai) o Mouses Mas epikalesteke gia na parekhoume nero ston lao tou, kai eipame: <<Khtupa ton brakho me to rabdi sou.>> Epeita, aneblusan apo auton dodeka peges (gia tis dodeka phules). Kathe phule gnorize to diko tes meros gia nero. (Kai eipame:) <<Phate kai pieite apo ta agatha tou Allakh kai me skorpizete to kako ste ge.>>

Kai (thumetheite) otan (esastan agnomones kai barethekate to kalo phageto, kai) eipate: <<O, Mouse! Den antekhoume ena eidos phagetou. Epikalesou, loipon, ton Kurio sou gia mas, gia na bgalei gia mas apo o,ti phutronei ste ge: ta botana tes, ta xulaggoura tes, ta sitaria tes, tis phakes tes kai ta kremmudia tes.>> Eipe (o Mouses): <<Tha antallazate auto pou einai kalutero gia auto pou einai katotero;! Katebeite (apo auten ten eremo) pros opoiadepote pole kai tha breite auto pou zetesate!>> Kai etsi kaluphthekan me tapeinose kai dustukhia, kai gurisan piso me ten orge tou Allakh. Auto giati arniontousan ta Edaphia (kai ta semeia) tou Allakh kai skotonan tous Prophetes adika. Auto egine giati parakousan kai parabiasan ta oria (diaprattontas amarties kai egklemata).

St' aletheia! Autoi pou pisteuoun (oi Mousoulmanoi) kai oi Ebraioi, oi Khristianoi kai oi Mandaioi (oi opoioi: Ebraioi, Khristianoi, kai Mandaioi zousan prin ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant, kai diateresan tis authentikes didaskalies tes threskeias tous), opoioi (ap' autous) pisteuan ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera kai ekanan enaretes praxeis tha laboun ten amoibe tous apo ton Kurio tous, kai gi' autous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

Kai (thumetheite) otan perame apo sas mia desmeuse kai upsosame apo pano sas to oros (os proeidopoiese an paramelesete te desmeuse sas, kai eipame): <<Tereite dunata auto pou sas dosame (ten Tora), kai thumetheite auto pou brisketai ekei mesa tou mepos kai (meso autou) phulakhtheite (apo ten timoria tou Allakh).>>
Epeita, meta apo auto, straphekate makria (apo tis entoles Mas, kai parakousate xana). An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh gia sas, tha esastan sigoura anamesa stous khamenous.

Kai pragmati, gnorizate autous anamesa sas (mathate gia ten amartia ton progonon sas) pou parabiazan (ten entole Mas, to na men psareuoun) to Sabbato. Eipame s' autous: <<Na eiste pithekoi, periphronemenoi kai aporriphthentes.>>

Etsi, ten kaname (aute ten timoria e auto to khorio) os paradeigma gia te dike tous genia (e gia ta guro khoria) kai gia tis epomenes genies kai mia upenthumise gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten orge tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).

Kai (thumetheite) otan (kapoios apo tous progonous sas skototheke kai den exeran poios to ekane) o Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<St' aletheia, o Allakh sas diatazei na sphagiasete mia agelada.>> Eipan: <<Mas koroideueis;>> Eipe: <<Anazeto kataphugio ston Allakh apo to na eimai apo tous adaeis (pou koroideuoun tous anthropous).>>

Eipan: <<Epikalesou ton Kurio sou gia mas, na mas dieukrinisei poia (agelada) einai!>> Eipe (o Mouses), <<Leei (o Allakh): <<Einai mia agelada, oute polu gerasmene, oute polu mikre, alla meses elikias.>> Kante, loipon, auto pou diatakhtekate.>>

Eipan: <<Epikalesou ton Kurio sou gia mas, na mas dieukrinisei to khroma tes.>> Eipe (o Mouses): <<Leei (o Allakh): <<Einai mia kitrine agelada, me entono khroma, pou eukharistei autous pou (ten) koitoun.>>.>>

Eipan: <<Epikalesou ton Kurio sou gia mas, na mas dieukrinisei (me perissoteres perigraphes) poia einai! St' aletheia, gia mas oles oi agelades moiazoun. Kai me to thelema tou Allakh, tha kathodegethoume (ste sugkekrimene agelada).>>

(O Mouses) eipe: <<Leei (o Allakh): <<Einai mia agelada pou den khresimopoietheke prin oute sto na orgonei to khoma, oute sto na potizei ta khoraphia, apallagmene apo opoiodepote elattoma, kai den ekhei kanena semadi allou khromatos (para to kitrino).>> Eipan: <<Tora epheres ten aletheia.>> Etsi ten esphaxan, an kai paraligo na men to ekanan.

Kai (thumetheite) otan skotosate enan andra kai pesate metaxu sas se diamakhe skhetika me to egklema (o kathenas apo sas apekrouse ten kategoria kategorontas ton allon). Ma, o Allakh phanerose auto pou krubate.

Etsi, eipame: <<Khtupeste ton (nekro) me ena kommati tes (ageladas) (oste na anastethei kai na sas pei poios ton skotose).>> Etsi o Allakh phernei ste zoe tous nekrous (kata ten Emera tes Anastases), kai sas deikhnei ta semeia (thaumata) Tou, mepos kai sullogisteite.

Epeita, meta apo auto, oi kardies sas sklerunan, kai eginan san petres ki akoma pio skleres. Kai pragmati, uparkhoun petres apo tis opoies pegazoun potamia (aphou malakosan), kai uparkhoun alles pou ragizoun kai etsi kulaei nero (pege) ap' autes, kai uparkhoun alles pou pephtoun apo phobo pros ton Allakh. Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanete.

Elpizete (o, pistoi) na pistepsoun sto kalesma sas, par' oti mia omada tous (apo tous rabinous) akougan ton Logo tou Allakh (ten Tora), ki epeita, aphou ton eikhan katanoesei, ton alloiosan en gnosei tous;

Kai otan (oi Ebraioi) sunantoun autous pou pisteuoun (Mousoulmanous), lene (mono me te glossa tous), <<Pisteuoume (ston Aggeliaphoro sas, tou opoiou oi perigraphes einai grammenes sten Tora).>> Ma, otan einai monoi metaxu tous (allelokategorountai gia autes tis omologies kai), lene: <<Lete s' autous (tous Mousoulmanous) ti apokalupse s' esas o Allakh (gia ten perigraphe tou Mokhammant sten Tora), oste na to paroun os epikheirema enantion sas enopion tou Kuriou sas; Ma, den sullogizeste;>>
Ma den gnorizoun (oi Ebraioi) oti o Allakh gnorizei o,ti apokruptoun kai o,ti phaneronoun;

Kai uparkhoun anamesa tous agrammatoi (aploi anthropoi), pou den gnorizoun apo to Biblio (ten Tora), para mono ten apaggelia tou (khoris na katanooun te semasia tou, kai den ekhoun para mono psemata pou akousan apo tous logious tous) kai, pragmati, autoi mono nomizoun (oti auta ta psemata pou akousan apo tous logious tous, einai e aletheia apo ten authentike Tora).

Alimono (katastrophe kai epoduno marturio) s' autous pou graphoun to biblio me ta dika tous kheria kai epeita lene: <<Auto einai apo ton Allakh (iskhurizomenoi oti einai e authentike Tora).>>, gia na laboun os antallagma gi' auto penikhro timema! Alimono s' autous gia o,ti egrapsan ta kheria tous kai alimono s' autous gia o,ti kerdizoun ap' auto.

Kai lene: <<Den tha mas aggixei to Pur, para gia liges metremenes meres.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Ekhete parei kamia uposkhese apo ton Allakh; Giati o Allakh pote den tha athetesei ten uposkhese Tou. E lete gia ton Allakh auto pou den gnorizete;>>
Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou eipate), alla st' aletheia, opoios diaprattei to kako kai e amartia tou ton ekhei perikuklosei - autoi tha einai oi katoikoi tou Puros, tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.
Ma, autoi pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes kales praxeis, autoi tha einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.

Kai (thumetheite) otan perame te desmeuse apo ta paidia tou Israel (Iakobou) (diatazontas tous): <<Me latreuete kanenan ektos apo ton Allakh. Kai stous goneis sas na phereste kallista, kai (epises) stous suggeneis, sta orphana kai stous endeeis. Kai na lete kala logia stous anthropous kai na teleite ten proseukhe kai na dinete te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune).>> Epeita, straphekate makria (apo tis entoles tou Allakh) arnoumenoi (na ekplerosete te desmeuse sas), ektos apo ligous apo sas.

Kai (thumetheite) otan perame te desmeuse apo sas (legontas): <<Me khunete o enas to aima tou allou kai men ekdiokete o enas ton allon apo ta spitia sas.>> Epeita (to) anagnorisate, kai (se auto) eiste martures.

Kai oriste, epeita apo auto, eseis skotonete o enas ton allon kai ekdiokete e mia omada apo sas ten alle apo ta spitia tes, zetontas te boetheia (apo tous ekhthrous tes alles) enantion tes (gia na ten ekdiokete) adika kai me parabiase (ton dikaiomaton tous). Omos, an erkhontai s' esas os aikhmalotoi tous exagorazete, paroti e ekdioxe tous ex arkhes etan apagoreumene gia sas. Pisteuete, loipon, se ena meros tou Bibliou (Tora) kai arneiste allo meros; E antamoibe auton apo sas pou ekanan etsi, den tha einai para e atimose kata ten egkosmia zoe, kai ten Emera tes Kriseos tha staloun sten austerotere timoria. Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanete.
Einai ekeinoi pou exagorasan ten egkosmia zoe me te Mellousa zoe, etsi e timoria den tha elaphrunthei gi' autous, oute tha boethethoun.

Kai st' aletheia, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora) kai ste sunekheia steilame meta ap' auton aggeliaphorous. Kai dosame ston Iesou, ton uio tes Marias, sapheis apodeixeis (thaumata) kai ton uposterixame me agio pneuma (ton aggelo Gabriel). Ma, opote erkhotan s' esas kapoios aggeliaphoros me kati pou den epithumousate, ginosastan alazones, kai etsi, kapoious (apo tous prophetes) tous diapseusate kai kapoious allous tous skotosate;!

Kai elegan (ston Mokhammant): <<Oi kardies mas einai tuligmenes (kai ta logia sou den pernane ekei).>> Okhi (den einai etsi opos iskhuristekan), alla, st' aletheia, o Allakh tous katarasteke (kai sphragise tis kardies tous) logo tes apistias tous, etsi ligo einai auto pou pisteuoun.

Kai otan elthe s' autous (tous Ebraious) ena Biblio (to Kor'an) apo ton Allakh pou epibebaionei auto pou etan mazi tous (apo ten prototupe Tora), eno proegoumenos eikhan epikalestei (ton Allakh gia ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant) gia nike enanti ton apiston (nomizontas oti o prophetes pou perimenan tha erkhotan apo tous Ebraious), kai otan elthe s' autous autos pou ton anagnorisan, ton arnethekan (aphou eidan oti den erthe apo tous idious)! Etsi, as einai e katara tou Allakh stous apistous.

Poso athlio einai auto gia to opoio poulesan ton eauto tous (del. ten piste tous) - to na arnountai adika kai apo phthono auto (to Kor'an) pou esteile o Allakh, epeide o Allakh enapothese te khare Tou pano se ekeinon (ton Mokhammant) pou ethele apo tous doulous Tou. Etsi, axizan na pesei pano tous orge meta apo orge. Kai gia tous apistous uparkhei mia tapeinotike timoria.

Kai otan eipotheke s' autous, <<Pistepste s' auto (to Kor'an) pou o Allakh esteile.>> Eipan: <<Pisteuoume (mono) s' ekeino (ten Tora) pou staltheke s' emas.>> Kai arnountai o,ti elthe meta ap' auto, parolo pou einai e aletheia pou epibebaionei auto pou etan mazi tous. Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Tote, giati skotonate tous prophetes tou Allakh sto parelthon, an eiste pragmati pistoi;>>
Kai pragmati, o Mouses elthe s' esas me sapheis apodeixeis. Epeita, kai kata ten apousia tou, perate to moskhari (gia latreia) kai esastan adikoi.

Kai (thumetheite) otan perame apo sas mia desmeuse (to na pistepsete se o,ti staltheke ston Mouse) kai upsosame apo pano sas to oros (os proeidopoiese an paramelesete te desmeuse sas. Kai eipame): <<Tereite dunata auto pou sas dosame (ten Tora), kai akouste.>> Eipan: <<Akoume (me ta autia mas) kai parakoume (meso ton praxeon mas).>> Kai oi kardies tous potistekan me te latreia tou moskhariou logo tes apistias tous. Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Ti athlio einai auto pou sas diatazei e piste sas, an eiste pragmati pistoi;>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<An (aletheuei auto pou iskhurizeste, oti) e Mellousa Zoe (o Paradeisos) einai apokleistika gia sas apo ton Allakh kai okhi gia tous allous anthropous, tote eukhetheite ton thanato (oste na pate kateutheian ekei), an eiste eilikrineis.>>

Ma, pote den tha to eukhethoun, logo ton oson dieprattan ta kheria tous (apo amarties kai apistia, kai epeide gnorizoun kala oti pseudontai ston iskhurismo tous). Kai o Allakh gnorizei kala tous adikous.

Kai st' aletheia, tha tous breis tous pio aplestous apo tous anthropous gia te zoe, kai akoma perissotero apo tous eidololatres. Kathenas ap' autous tha epithumouse na zesei gia khilia khronia, ma, akoma kai an tou dinotan makrobioteta, auto den tha ton apomakrune oute sto elakhisto apo ten (eperkhomene) timoria. Kai o Allakh blepei kala ola osa kanoun.

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous Ebraious pou elegan oti o Tzimpril -Gabriel- einai o ekhthros tous) oti opoios einai ekhthros tou Tzimpril, (as mathei oti o Tzimpril) einai autos pou to ephere (to Kor'an) kato sten kardia sou, me ten adeia tou Allakh, to opoio (Kor'an) epibebaionei auta pou uperkhan prin apo auto (apo Theia Biblia) kai apotelei kathodegese kai kharmosune eidese gia tous pistous.
Opoios einai ekhthros tou Allakh, ton aggelon Tou, ton Aggeliaphoron Tou, tou Tzimpril (Gabriel) kai tou Mikal (Mikhael) - tote, pragmati, o Allakh einai ekhthros ton apiston.
Kai pragmati, sou steilame xekathara semeia (apodeixeis kai edaphia), kai den tha ta arnountai, para mono osoi parekklinan apo te threskeia tou Allakh.
Opote kanoun mia sumphonia (e analambanoun mia desmeuse), mia omada apo autous ten athetei; Pragmati, oi perissoteroi ex' auton den pisteuoun.

Kai otan erthe s' autous enas Aggeliaphoros (o Mokhammant) apo ton Allakh epibebaionontas auto pou etan mazi tous (apo tis perigraphes tou sten Tora), mia omada (Ebraion logion) apo autous stous opoious eikhe dothei to Biblio (e gnose gia ten Tora, enantiothekan ston Mokhammant oti den anapheretai mesa sten Tora, alla otan eidan oti ontos e Tora sumphonei me to Kor'an stis perigraphes tou), petaxan to Biblio tou Allakh (ten Tora) piso apo tis plates tous san na men exeran (ti perieikhe apo tis perigraphes tou Mokhammant).

Kai (otan aphesan ten Tora) akolouthesan (anti autes) auta pou eikhan apaggeilei oi daimones (apo mageia) kata te basileia tou Solomonta (kai eipan pseudos, aphou pethane, oti e basileia tou basisteke ste mageia). Den etan o Solomontas pou apistese (del. den khresimopoiouse te mageia), ma oi daimones apistesan, didaskontas stous anthropous te mageia kai o,ti staltheke kato (apo mageia) stous duo aggelous, ton Kharout kai ton Marout, ste Babulona (os dokimasia gia tous anthropous). Ma, den didaxan (oi duo aggeloi te mageia) se kanenan, ektos na tou elegan (proeidopoiontas ton): <<St' aletheia, eimaste mono gia dokimasia (gia tous anthropous), etsi, men apisteseis (mathainontas te mageia apo mas).>> Kai (omos, opoioi arnethekan te sumboule tous, arkhisan na) mathainoun ap' autous auto me to opoio prokaloun khorismo metaxu enos andra kai tes suzugou tou. Kai den mporoun na blapsoun kanenan meso autou, para me ten adeia tou Allakh (del. an ethele o Allakh tha tous empodize, alla tous aphese os dokimasia). Kai st' aletheia, mathainoun auto pou tous blaptei kai den tous ophelei. Omos, (oi Ebraioi) gnorizan oti opoios ten exagoraze (te mageia me antallagma to Biblio tou Allakh) den tha lambane ste Mellousa Zoe kanena meridio. Kai ti athlio einai auto gia to opoio poulesan ton eauto tous, an exeran!
Kai an eikhan pistepsei kai eikhan phulakhthei (apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou), tote e amoibe apo ton Allakh tha etan (makran) kalutere, an exeran!

O, seis pou pisteuete, men peite (ston Prophete): <<Ra'ena>>, ma peite <<Oundourna>> (oi duo lexeis ekhoun ten idia semasia, del. 'prosexe mas'. Oi Ebraioi omos khresimopoiousan ten prote lexe me alloiose sten prophora apeuthunomenoi ston Prophete, oste na semainei mia prosbole), kai akouste (ton). Kai gia tous apistous uparkhei epoduno marturio.

Oute autoi pou arnethekan ten piste anamesa ston lao tou Bibliou (ton proegoumenon theion biblion, Ebraioi kai Khristianoi), oute oi eidololatres epithumoun na sas stalei kanena kalo apo ton Kurio sas. Ma, o Allakh epilegei gia to eleos Tou opoious thelei, kai o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales eunoias.

Den katargoume kapoion kanona apo ena Edaphio, oute kanoume ena Edaphio na xekhastei, khoris na to antikatastesoume me kapoio kalutero apo auto e paromoio me auto. Den emathes oti o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos;
Den emathes oti ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges; Kai pragmati, den ekhete peran tou Allakh, kanenan kedemona oute uposterikte.

E, mepos, thelete (o, pistoi) na zetesete apo ton Aggeliaphoro sas (kati me mono skopo ten enantiose kai to peisma), opos zetetheke sto parelthon apo ton Mouse (otan oi Ebraioi zetesan na tous deixei ton Allakh); Kai opoios antallassei ten piste me ten apistia, pragmati, ekhei parastratesei apo ton isio dromo.

Polloi apo ton lao tou Bibliou (ton proegoumenon theion biblion, Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) tha ethelan na sas epanapheroun, aphou ekhete pistepsei, piso sten apistia, apo phthono mesa tous, aphou e aletheia ekhei ginei phanere s' autous. Etsi, as sugkhoreite kai as parablepete, eos otou na erthei e entole tou Allakh. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Ikanos gia ta panta.

Kai na teleite ten proseukhe (stis kathorismenes ores tous) kai na dinete te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), kai o,ti kalo kanete kata ten egkosmia zoe sas (gia na sas ophelesei kata te Mellousa zoe sas)- tha to breite (del. ten antamoibe tou) me ton Allakh. St' aletheia, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

Kai (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi) eipan: <<Kaneis den tha eiselthei ston Paradeiso, para kapoios pou einai Ebraios (etsi iskhuristekan oi Ebraioi) e Khristianos (etsi iskhuristekan oi Khristianoi)!>> Autes einai oi (pseutikes) epithumies tous. Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Parousiaste tis apodeixeis sas, an eiste aletheia eilikrineis.>>

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou eipan), alla st' aletheia, opoios upotassei to prosopo tou ston Allakh kai einai kalos (ste latreia akolouthontas tous tropous pou edeixe o Prophetes), tha labei ten amoibe tou apo ton Kurio tou, kai gia tetoious anthropous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

Oi Ebraioi eipan: <<Oi Khristianoi den basizontai se tipota (den ekhoun alethine threskeia).>> kai oi Khristianoi eipan: <<Oi Ebraioi den basizontai se tipota (den ekhoun alethine threskeia).>>, an kai apaggelloun (kai oi duo) to Biblio (ta proegoumena theia biblia pou epibebaionoun ten upokhreose na pisteuoun s' olous tous prophetes). Etsi elegan, paromoia logia, kai autoi pou den ekhoun gnose (oi eidololatres, otan diepseusan olous tous prophetes kai ta theia biblia). Ma, o Allakh tha krinei metaxu tous ten Emera tes Anastases skhetika m' auto sto opoio diaphonousan.

Kai poios einai pio adikos ap' auton pou apetrepse na anapherthei to Onoma tou Allakh sta tzamia Tou (del. apagorepse opoiodepote eidos latreias mesa tous) kai espeude pros ten katastrophe tous; Tetoioi den tha eiselthoun s' auta, para mono phobismenoi. Gi' autous sten egkosmia zoe uparkhei atimose, kai tha laboun ste Mellousa Zoe ena tromero marturio.

Ston Allakh anekei e anatole kai e duse: Pros opoia kateuthunse kai na strapheite, ekei einai to Prosopo tou Allakh (del. otan sas dietaxe na strapheite kata tis proseukhes sas pros te Makka anti ten Ierousalem, na xerete oti oles oi kateuthunseis anekoun ston Allakh. Epises, to idio otan einai duskolo na breite ten kateuthunse tes Makkas). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gia olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>

Kai eipan (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi): <<O Allakh apektese enan uio.>> Doxa s' Auton (einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti lene)! Okhi (den iskhuei aute e blasphemia pou eipan), alla, st' aletheia, s' Auton anekoun ola osa briskontai stous ouranous kai ste ge kai ola einai upotagmena me upakoe s' Auton.
(O Allakh) einai o Protourgos ton ouranon kai tes ges. Otan apophasisei kati, aplos leei s' auto: 'Genetheto!' kai etsi ginetai.

Kai autoi pou den ekhoun gnose (apo Ebraious, Khristianous kai eidololatres) eipan (ston Mokhammant): <<Giati den mas mila o Allakh (apeutheias khoris kanenan diamesolabete), oute erkhetai s' emas kapoio semadi (thauma);>> Etsi, elegan paromoia logia kai ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous. Oi kardies tous einai paromoies. Pragmati, phanerosame ta semadia s' autous pou pisteuoun me bebaioteta.

St' aletheia, se steilame (o, Mokhammant) me ten aletheia, os phorea kharmosunon eideseon kai proeidopoiete, kai den tha rotetheis gia tous katoikous tou Puros tes Kolaseos (pou den pistepsan s' esena).

Kai pote den prokeitai oi Ebraioi, oute oi Khristianoi, na einai eukharistemenoi (me otidepote) apo sena mekhri na akoloutheseis te threskeia tous. Pes: <<St' aletheia, e kathodegese tou Allakh (to Islam) einai e (mone alethine) kathodegese.>> An etan na akoloutheseis tis epithumies tous meta ap' auto pou ephtase s' esena apo gnose, den tha eikhes enopion tou Allakh kanenan prostate e uposterikte.

Autoi (mia omada apo tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous) stous opoious dosame to Biblio, kai to apaggelloun me ten prepousa apaggelia tou (akolouthontas o,ti ekhoun apo ta authentika didagmata tou, kai den to alloionoun), einai ekeinoi pou pisteuoun s' auton (ton Mokhammant aphou briskoun sto Biblio tous tis perigraphes tou). Opoioi, omos, ton arnountai einai oi khamenoi.
O, paidia tou Israel (Iakobou)! Thumetheite ten eunoia Mou pou parakhoresa s' esas kai oti sas protimesa (me theia apokalupse kai basileia) ap' olous tous anthropous (tou kairou sas, sto parelthon).

Kai na phulakhtheite (meso tes tereses ton entolon Mou) apo mia Emera (tes Kriseos) kata ten opoia kamia psukhe den tha ophelesei kamia alle, oute kanena antallagma tha ginei dekto apo auten (oste na men timorethei), oute kamia diamesolabese tha ten ophelesei, oute tha boethethoun.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Kurios tou Impraem (Abraam) ton dokimase me entoles, tis opoies ekplerose. (O Allakh tou) eipe: <<St' aletheia, tha se kano Imam (egete kai kalo paradeigma) gia tous anthropous. Eipe (o Impraem, zetontas): <<(O, Allakh, kane egetes) kai apo tous apogonous mou!>> (O Allakh) eipe: <<E uposkhese Mou (kai auto pou sou parakhoresa apo egesia ste threskeia) den perilambanei tous adikous (apo tous apogonous sou).>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan kaname ton Oiko (ten Ka'mpa ste Makka) kataphugio sto opoio oi anthropoi epistrephoun sukhna (logo tes agapes tous pros auto) ki enan asphale topo. Kai parte (o, anthropoi) to Makam tou Impraem (Abraam) (ten petra sten opoia o Impraem statheke otan ekhtize ten Ka'mpa) os topo proseukhes. Kai diataxame ton Impraem kai ton Ismael na exagnisoun ton Oiko Mou (apo ta eidola kai ta akatharta) gia ekeinous pou peripherontai, e paramenoun ekei (gia kapoio khroniko diastema aphieronontas ton eauto tous ste latreia, kanontas I'tikaph), e upoklinontai kai pephtoun se Soutzount stase (me to metopo me tis palames sto edaphos) (proseukhomenoi).

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Impraem (Abraam) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Kane auten ten pole (te Makka) asphale kai parakhorese stous anthropous tes apo tous karpous, s' osous pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera.>> (O Allakh) eipe: <<Oso gia auton pou arneitai ten piste, tha ton apheso na apolausei gia ligo, ki epeita tha ton exanagkaso sto marturio tou Puros, kai kheiroteros pragmati einai autos o proorismos.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Impraem (Abraam) kai o Ismael sekonan ta themelia tou Oikou, (legontas): <<Kurie mas! Dexou apo mas (tis kales mas praxeis, sumperilambanomenes tes oikodomeses autou tou Oikou). St' aletheia, Esu eisai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Kurie mas! Kai kane mas Mousoulmanous (upotagmenous) s' Esena, kai apo tous apogonous mas ena ethnos Mousoulmaniko (upotagmeno) s' Esena, kai deixe mas tis teletes tes latreias mas (pros Esena, pos prepei na einai) kai dexou te metameleia mas. St' aletheia, eisai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Kurie mas! Kai steile anamesa tous (del. stous apogonous mas) enan aggeliaphoro ap' autous, o opoios tha apaggeilei s' autous ta Edaphia Sou, kai tha tous didaxei to Biblio (to Kor'an) kai ten Al-Khikma (te Sounna -paradose- tou Prophete Mokhammant), kai tha tous exagnisei. St' aletheia, eisai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

Kai poios apostrephetai te threskeia tou Impraem (Abraam) (del. ton Islamiko Monotheismo), ektos ap' auton pou upotima ton eauto tou (me ten anoesia tou, agnoontas ti ton ophelei kai ti ton blaptei); St' aletheia, Emeis ton epilexame (ton Abraam) s' auton ton kosmo (se upsele these, os Prophete), kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha brisketai anamesa stous dikaious.
(Kai auto epeide) otan o Kurios tou tou eipe: <<Upotaxou (gine Mousoulmanos)!>>, eipe (khoris distagmo): <<Ekho upotakhtei (os Mousoulmanos) ston Kurio olon ton Kosmon.>>

Kai o Impraem (Abraam) dietaxe auto (ten upotage ston Allakh, to Islam) tous gious tou, epises to idio ekane ki o Giakoump (Iakobos -Israel-) (legontas): <<O, gioi mou, st' aletheia o Allakh epelexe gia sas ten (alethine) threskeia, ki etsi men pethanete, para mono os Mousoulmanoi.>>

E, mepos, esastan (o, Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) parontes otan o thanatos erthe ston Giakoump (Iakobo -Israel-); Otan eipe stous gious tou: <<Poion tha latreuete meta ton thanato mou;>> Eipan: <<Tha latreuoume ton Theo sou kai ton Theo ton pateron sou: tou Impraem (Abraam), tou Ismael kai tou Isaak, ton Enan (Alethino) Theo, kai s' Auton eimaste Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste boulese Tou).>>
Auto etan ena ethnos pou ekhei perasei. Tha ekhei (tis sunepeies gia) o,ti ekane kai eseis tha ekhete (tis sunepeies gia) o,ti kanate. Kai den tha rotetheite gia o,ti ekanan.

Kai (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi) eipan (stous Mousoulmanous): <<Ginete Ebraioi e Khristianoi, oste na kathodegetheite.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou eipate), alla st' aletheia, (akolouthoume) te threskeia tou Impraem (Abraam), o opoios etan Khaneiphan (apekline ap' ola ta mataia dogmata, akolouthontas ten alethine piste), kai den etan apo tous polutheistes.>>

Peite (o, Mousoulmanoi): <<Pisteuoume ston Allakh kai se o,ti staltheke s' emas, kai se o,ti staltheke ston Impraem (Abraam), ton Ismael, ton Isaak, ton Giakoump (Iakobo) kai stous Al-Asmpat (tous prophetes apo tous apogonous tou Iakobou), kai se o,ti dotheke ston Mouse kai ston Iesou, kai se o,ti dotheke stous Prophetes apo ton Kurio tous. Kamia diakrise den kanoume anamesa se kanenan ap' autous (del. pisteuoume se olous tous), kai eimaste s' Auton Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi).>>

An, loipon, pistepsoun (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi) sta idia pou pisteuete ki eseis (del. se olous tous Aggeliaphorous kai se ola ta Biblia tou Allakh), tote kathodegethekan (sten Aletheia)* ma, an strephontai makria, tote briskontai se megale diaphonia. Etsi, o Allakh tha se prostateuei (o, Mokhammant) ap' autous. Kai Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

(Kai na eiste statheroi) ste threskeia tou Allakh (sten opoia sas eplase). Kai poia threskeia mporei na einai kalutere apo te threskeia tou Allakh; (Kai peite:) <<St' aletheia, emeis latreuoume mono Auton.>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous): <<Diaphoneite me emas skhetika me ton Allakh (iskhurizomenoi oti eiste pio axioi gia te threskeia tou Allakh apo emas, logo tou oti e threskeia sas proegetheke tes dikes mas) eno (o Allakh) einai o Kurios mas kai o Kurios sas; Gia mas einai oi praxeis mas, kai gia sas einai oi praxeis sas (kai o kathenas tha antameiphthei e tha timorethei gia tis praxeis tou). Kai eimaste pistoi s' Auton (den Tou apodidoume kanenan etairo ste latreia).>>

E, mepos, (o, Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) lete oti o Impraem (Abraam), o Ismael, o Isaak, o Giakoump (Iakobos) kai oi Al-Asmpat (oi prophetes apo tous apogonous tou Iakobou) etan Ebraioi e Khristianoi; Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Eseis gnorizete kalutera e o Allakh;>> Kai poios einai pio adikos ap' auton pou krubei mia marturia pou ekhei apo ton Allakh (sten Tora kai sto In-tzel -to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou-, oti ekeinoi oi Prophetes etan Mousoulmanoi); Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanete.
Auto etan ena ethnos pou ekhei perasei. Tha ekhei (tis sunepeies gia) o,ti ekane kai eseis tha ekhete (tis sunepeies gia) o,ti kanate (apo kalo e kako). Kai den tha rotetheite gia o,ti ekanan.

Oi anoetoi anamesa stous anthropous tha poun: <<Ti tous ekane na straphoun makria apo ten Kimpla tous (kateuthunse tes proseukhes pros ten Ierousalem), pros ten opoia strephontan (kai tora strephontai pros te Makka);>> Pes, <<Ston Allakh anekei e Anatole kai e Duse. Kathodegei opoion thelei ston isio dromo.>>

Epises, sas kaname enan lao metriopathe kai dikaio, gia na eiste martures stous anthropous (oti oi Prophetes tous tous metedosan to Theio Menuma) kai na einai o Apostolos (Mokhammant) marturas s' esas (oti sas metedose to Theio Menuma). Kai den orisame ten Kimpla (kateuthunse tes proseukhes) opou strephosoun (o, Mokhammant), para gia na xeroume (-auto pou ede xeroume-, del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakrinoume me aute ten allage tes Kimplas) poios tha akolouthouse ton Aggeliaphoro kai poios tha gurize ten plate tou (sten piste) (kai s' auto basizetai e amoibe kai e timoria). Kai st' aletheia, etan megalo thema (stis psukhes), alla okhi gi' autous pou kathodegese o Allakh. Kai pote o Allakh den tha ekane ten piste sas akarpe (del. den tha khasete tis amoibes ton proegoumenon proseukhon sas pou etan pros ten proegoumene Kimpla). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai gia olous tous anthropous Poluepieikes kai Polueusplakhnos.

Blepoume ten epanalambanomene strophe tou prosopou sou (o, Mokhammant) pros ton ourano (anamenontas apokalupse skhetika me ten Kimpla -kateuthunse tes proseukhes- kai epithumontas na ginei pros te Makka anti pros ten Ierousalem), kai etsi, tha se strepsoume pros mia Kimpla pou se eukharistei. Etsi, strepse to prosopo sou pros to Al-Mastzint Al-Kharam (ton Iero Oiko ste Makka), kai opou ki an eiste (o, pistoi) strepste ta prosopa sas pros auto (kata ten proseukhe). St' aletheia, autoi (oi Khristianoi kai oi Ebraioi) stous opoious ekhei dothei to Biblio, gnorizoun kala oti auto (e strophe sou pros te Makka) einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio tous (e opoia anapheretai sta biblia tous). Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanoun.

Akoma kai an ephernes s' autous (Khristianous kai Ebraious) stous opoious ekhei dothei to Biblio kathe semadi (kai apodeixe oti e strophe sou pros te Makka kata ten proseukhe einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou), den tha akolouthousan ten Kimpla (kateuthunse tes proseukhes) sou (apo alazoneia kai iskhurognomosune). Oute esu tha akoloutheseis ten Kimpla tous. Oute kanenas ap' autous akolouthei ten Kimpla tou allou. Kai ean etan na akolouthouses tis epithumies tous meta apo o,ti ekhei elthei se esena apo gnose, pragmati, tha esoun enas apo tous adikous.

Autoi stous opoious dosame to Biblio (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi) ton gnorizoun (ton Mokhammant, apo tis perigraphes tou sta biblia tous) opos gnorizoun tous gious tous. Ma, st' aletheia, mia omada ap' autous apokruptoun ten aletheia, eno (te) gnorizoun.
(Auto pou staltheke se esena, o, Mokhammant, einai) e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, men eisai, loipon, anamesa se ekeinous pou amphiballoun (gia auten).

Gia kathe ena (ethnos) uparkhei kapoia kateuthunse (Kimpla) sten opoia strephetai (kata ten proseukhe tou). Sunagonizeste, loipon, (o, pistoi metaxu sas) sto na kanete enaretes praxeis. Opou ki an eiste, o Allakh tha sas pherei olous mazi (kata ten Emera tes Kriseos gia krise). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Etsi, apo opou ki an bgaineis (gia proseukhe, o, Mokhammant) strepse to prosopo sou pros to Al-Mastzint Al-Kharam (ton Iero Oiko ste Makka), kai pragmati, aute einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou. Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanete.

Etsi, apo opou ki an bgaineis (gia proseukhe, o, Mokhammant) strepse to prosopo sou pros to Al-Mastzint Al-Kharam (ton Iero Oiko ste Makka). Kai opou ki an eiste (o, pistoi), strepste ta prosopa sas pros auto, oste oi anthropoi na men ekhoun kanena epikheirema enantia sas, ektos apo tous adikous anamesa tous. Etsi na men tous phobaste, ma Emena na phobaste. Kai (pragmati, e Makka ekhei oristei gia sas os Kimpla -kateuthunse tes proseukhes-) oste na olokleroso te khare Mou se esas (me mia diaphoretike Kimpla apo ta alla ethne), kai oste na kathodegetheite (pros ten kalutere Kimpla).

Epises, (sas dosame kai alle mia eunoia, oti) steilame anamesa sas enan Aggeliaphoro apo esas tous idious, pou sas apaggellei ta Edaphia Mas, sas exagnizei, sas didaskei to Biblio kai te Sounna (paradose tou Prophete) kai sas didaskei auta pou den gnorizate.
Etsi, na exumneite Emena, ki Ego tha sas epaino. Kai na eiste eugnomones s' Emena, kai na men eiste agnomones.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na anazetate te boetheia (tou Allakh) meso tes upomones kai tes proseukhes (pou sas phernei pio konta ston Allakh). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai me tous upomonetikous (uposterizontas kai boethontas tous).
Kai me lete gi' autous pou skotonontai ston dromo tou Allakh: <<Einai nekroi.>> Okhi (den einai)! Alla st' aletheia, einai zontanoi, ma den (to) antilambaneste.
Kai pragmati, tha sas dokimasoume me kapoio phobo, peina kai meiose ploutou, zoon kai karpon, kai anaggeile ta eukharista nea (o, Mokhammant) stous upomonetikous.
Oi opoioi, otan plettontai me sumphora lene: <<St' aletheia! Ston Allakh anekoume kai s' Auton tha epistrepsoume.>>
Autoi tha laboun epainese kai eleos apo ton Kurio tous, kai pragmati, autoi einai oi orthos kathodegemenoi.

St' aletheia, e As-Sapha kai e Al-Maroua (oi duo mikroi lophoi ste Makka) einai apo ta sumbola (tes threskeias) tou Allakh. Etsi, opoios telei to Khatz (to megalo proskunema) ston Iero Oiko e telei ten 'Oumra (to mikro proskunema), den uparkhei amartia s' auton me to na perpata (telontas Sa'i) anamesa tous (stous duo lophous). Kai opoios ethelontika prattei to kalo, tote st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Eugnomon kai Pantognostes.

St' aletheia, autoi (oi Khristianoi kai oi Ebraioi logioi) pou apokruptoun auta pou steilame apo tis xekathares apodeixeis kai ten kathodegese (skhetika me ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant kai tis perigraphes tou), aphou ta kaname saphe gia tous anthropous sto Biblio (ten prototupe Tora kai to prototupo In-tzel -Euaggelio- pou dotheke ston Iesou), ekeinous tous katarietai o Allakh kai tous katariountai ekeinoi pou katariountai (apo tous aggelous kai tous pistous pou epikalountai ton Allakh gia na tous dioxei apo to eleos Tou).

Ektos ap' autous (tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious logious) pou straphekan me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) kai diorthosan (tis praxeis tous), kai phanerosan (ten aletheia pou apekruptan). Gi' autous, tha dekhto te metameleia tous. Kai st' aletheia, eimai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
St' aletheia, autoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai pethainoun paramenontas sten apistia tous, tha pesei pano tous e katara tou Allakh, ton aggelon kai olon ton anthropon.
Tha parameinoun s' auten (ten katara kai sto Pur) gia panta. To marturio den tha elaphrunthei gi' autous, oute tha tous dothei anabole (ten Emera tes Kriseos oste na dikaiologethoun).

Kai pragmati, o (Alethinos) Theos sas (o, anthropoi) einai Enas Theos. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

St' aletheia, ste demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges, ste diadokhike enallage tes nukhtas me ten emera, sta ploia pou pleoun stis thalasses metapherontas auta pou opheloun tous anthropous, sto nero (tes brokhes) pou o Allakh stelnei kato apo ton ourano kanontas me auto te ge na xanazontaneuei meta ton thanato tes, se o,ti skorpise (o Allakh) se aute (te ge) apo kathe eidous kinoumeno plasma, stis allages ton kateuthunseon ton anemon kai sta upotagmena sunnepha anamesa ston ourano kai te ge, uparkhoun semeia (kai xekathares apodeixeis) gia tous anthropous pou to antilambanontai.

Kai, anamesa stous anthropous einai ekeinoi pou pairnoun allous (theous, eidola, agious klp.) ektos tou Allakh os isaxious kai paromoious me ton Allakh. Tous agapoun opos agapoun ton Allakh (del. tous exisonoun me ton Allakh ste latreia, ten upakoe kai ten agape, dinontas tous tetoia agape pou den tairiazei para mono ston Allakh). Kai st' aletheia, autoi pou pisteuoun agapoun ton Allakh perissotero (apo oso agapoun oi polutheistes ton Allakh kai ta eidola tous). Kai an mono, autoi pou adikesan (ton eauto tous meso tou polutheismou) mporousan na doun, (auto pou tha xeroun) otan tha doun to marturio, oti ole e duname anekei ston Allakh kai oti o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria, (tote den tha latreuan pote allous ektos tou Allakh).

Otan (tha doun to marturio), autoi (oi epikephaleis) pou akolouthethekan, tha aparnethoun ekeinous pou tous akolouthousan, kai (oloi tous) tha doun to marturio, kai tha apokopoun ola ta mesa soterias tous.

Kai autoi pou akolouthesan tha poun: <<Makari na eikhame akoma mia eukairia epistrophes (sten egkosmia zoe) oste na tous aparnethoume opos mas aparnountai tora autoi.>> Etsi, o Allakh tha tous deixei tis praxeis tous os tupseis pano tous. Kai pote den tha bgoun apo to Pur.

O, anthropoi, phate apo o,ti uparkhei ste ge (pou einai) epitrepto kai kalo (den einai akatharto), kai men akoloutheite ta bemata tou Satana. St' aletheia, autos einai gia sas enas prophanes ekhthros.
St' aletheia, sas diatazei mono to kako kai ten aiskhre amartia kai to na lete gia ton Allakh auto pou den gnorizete.

Kai otan eipothei s' autous (tous apistous): <<Akoloutheste o,ti esteile o Allakh.>> Apantoun: <<Okhi! Alla tha akolouthesoume auto pou brekame tous pateres mas na akolouthoun.>> Akome ki an oi pateres tous den antilambanontan tipota, oute etan kathodegemenoi;

To paradeigma ekeinon ton apiston (me ekeinon pou tous kalei sten kathodegese) einai san auto ekeinou (tou boskou) pou phonazei s' auta (ta booeide e probata) pou den akoun para mono to kalesma kai tis phones (khoris na katalabainoun tis ennoies ton lexeon tou). Kophoi, bouboi kai tuphloi (apo to na akoun, na lene e na blepoun ten aletheia), ki etsi den antilambanontai tipote.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phate apo ta kala agatha pou sas parekhoume, kai na eiste eugnomones ston Allakh, an, pragmati, Auton latreuete (khoris na Tou apodidete etairous ste latreia).

St' aletheia, sas apagorepse (na katanalonete) mono ta nekra (zoa kai poulia pou den sphagiastekan sumphona me ton Islamiko tropo), to aima, te sarka tou khoirou kai opoiodepote zoo pou otan sphakhteke anaphertheke to onoma allou ektos tou Allakh. An omos kapoios anagkasteke (na katanalosei kati ap' auta ta proanapheromena) khoris na to katanalosei apo epithumia, oute na uperbei (to orio tes anagkaiotetas), den uparkhei amartia s' auton. St' aletheia o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

St' aletheia, autoi pou apokruptoun o,ti esteile o Allakh apo to Biblio (kai ten aletheia kai tis perigraphes tou Mokhammant) kai to antallazoun gia mikro timema - autoi den katanalonoun sten koilia tous para monon to Pur. Kai o Allakh den tha tous milesei ten Emera tes Anastases, oute tha tous exagnisei. Kai tha laboun ena epoduno marturio.
Einai ekeinoi pou antallaxan ten kathodegese me ten plane kai te sugkhorese me ten timoria. Poso tolmeroi einai autoi gia (na kanoun tis kakes praxeis pou tha tous othesoun se aute) te Photia!

Auto (to marturio to axizan) giati o Allakh esteile kato to Biblio (ta Theia Biblia) me ten aletheia (kai etsi eprepe na phanerosoun ten aletheia anti na ten apokrupsoun). Kai pragmati, autoi pou diaphonoun gia to Biblio (pisteuontas se kapoia mere tou kai arnoumenoi alla) briskontai se akraia diaphonia kai antithese makria apo ten aletheia.

Eusebeia den einai na strephete to prosopo sas (kata ten proseukhe) pros Anatolas e pros Dusmas, alla e (alethine) eusebeia einai ekeinou pou pisteuei ston Allakh, sten Eskhate Emera, stous Aggelous, sta (Theia) Biblia kai stous prophetes, kai dinei apo ten periousia tou, para ten agape tou (gia ten periousia tou), stous suggeneis, sta orphana, stous aporous, stous odoiporous, stous epaites kai gia ten apeleutherose ton sklabon kai ton aikhmaloton, kai telei tis proseukhes kai dinei te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), kai ekeinon pou otan kanoun mia sumphonia ten ekpleronoun, kai ekeinon pou einai upomonetikoi se periodo phtokheias, astheneias kai se kairo polemou (kata te diarkeia ton makhon). Autoi einai oi eilikrineis (sten piste tous) kai autoi einai oi eusebeis (pou phullasontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).

O, seis pou pisteuete! O Al-Kisas (o nomos tes isotetas metaxu tou egklematos kai tes poines -ophthalmon anti ophthalmou, odonta anti odontos-) ekhei oristei gia sas se upotheseis phonou ek protheseos: o eleutheros anti tou eleutherou, o doulos anti tou doulou, kai e gunaika anti tes gunaikas (del. prepei na skotosoun ton sugkekrimeno dolophono kai okhi kapoion allon. Opos sten pro-Islamike epokhe otan enas antras skotonotan, e phule tou elege, 'Enas antras apo emas isodunamei me treis apo esas, kai enas doulos apo emas isodunamei me enan eugene apo esas kai mia gunaika apo emas isodunamei me enan antra apo esas.'). Ma an o dolophonos sugkhorethei apo ton adelpho tou (del. apo ton epikephales tes oikogeneias tou phoneuthentos, -kai anaphertheke edo os adelphos os upenthumise oti einai adelphia sto Islam kai okhi ekhthroi-), me antallagma phoro aimatos, tote as to zetesei (o epikephales tes oikogeneias) me ton kalutero tropo (khoris na blapsei ton dolophono), kai (o dolophonos) tha prepei na ton plerosei me ton kalutero tropo (khoris anabole e meiose). Aute einai anakouphise kai eleos apo ton Kurio sas. Etsi, meta ap' auto opoios parabainei ta oria (delade skotosei ton dolophono aphou eispraxei to phoro aimatos), tha ekhei ena odunero marturio.

Kai uparkhei gia sas sto Al-Kisas (ton nomo tes isotetas metaxu tou egklematos kai tes poines -ophthalmon anti ophthalmou, odonta anti odontos-), zoe (del. soteria gia tis zoes sas apo opoion thelei na sas epitethei), o, anthropoi pou antilambaneste, mepos kai phulakhtheite (apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).

Oristeke gia sas otan o thanatos plesiazei kapoion apo sas, ki ekhei aphesei periousia, na kanei ste diatheke tou ena klerodotema gia tous goneis kai tous kontinous suggeneis sumphona me ton kalo kai dikaio tropo (kai mekhri to ena trito tes periousias tou) - ena kathekon gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Opoios loipon, to tropopoiesei (to klerodotema) aphou to ekhei akousei, st' aletheia, e amartia autes (tes tropopoieses) einai mono s' autous pou to tropopoiesan (kai okhi ston klerodote). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ma an kapoios phobatai merolepsia khoris prothese e adikia me prothese ek merous tou klerodote, kai (ton nouthetesei prin pethanei na diorthosei te diatheke, e an ekhei ede pethanei) tous sumbibasei (tous endiapheromenous, me to na tropopoiesei te diatheke me dikaio tropo), den uparkhei amartia s' auton. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! E nesteia ekhei epiblethei s' esas opos eikhe epiblethei s' ekeinous (ta proegoumena ethne) pou etan prin apo sas. Mepos etsi phulakhtheite (apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).

(E upokhreotike nesteia einai gia) katametremenes meres (delade olo ton mena tou Ramantan -Ramazaniou-). Etsi, opoios apo esas einai asthenes e taxideuei, tote (mporei na men nestepsei, alla) ton idio arithmo (emeron pou ekhase tha prepei na ton anaplerosei) me alles meres. Kai gi' autous pou mporoun na nestepsoun alla me megale duskolia (opos oi elikiomenoi kai oi monima arrostoi, mporoun na men nestepsoun alla) as taIsoun enan phtokho (gia kathe mera pou ekhasan). Kai opoios ekane kalo ethelontika (opos me to na taIsei ethelontika parapano apo enan phtokho), einai kalutero g' auton. Ma to na nesteuete einai kalutero gia sas, an to gnorizate.

O menas tou Ramantan (Ramazaniou) einai autos kata ton opoion apokaluphtheke to Kor'an, to opoio apotelei mia kathodegese gia tous anthropous kai periekhei sapheis apodeixeis kathodegeses kai kriteriou (metaxu tes aletheias kai tes planes). Etsi, opoios apo esas einai katoikos kata ton mena (kai den taxideuei), as ton nestepsei. Kai opoios einai asthenes e taxideuei, tote (mporei na men nestepsei, alla) ton idio arithmo (emeron pou ekhase tha prepei na ton anaplerosei) me alles meres. O Allakh thelei gia sas kathe eukolia kai den thelei na sas balei se duskolies. Kai na oloklerosete ton idio arithmo (emeron tes nesteias), kai na doxasete ton Allakh (legontas tis phraseis tou 'Takmpeir' kata ten teleutaia nukhta tou Ramantan kai kata tis emeres tes eortes Al-Phitr) gi' auto sto opoio sas kathodegese. Kai isos na ginete eugnomones.

Kai otan oi douloi Mou se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) skhetika me Emena, pragmati Eimai konta, antapokrinomai sten epiklese tou proseukhete otan Me kalei (khoris kanenan diamesolabete). Etsi loipon, as Me upakoun kai na pisteuoun se Emena, isos etsi na kathodegethoun.

Epitrepetai gia sas te nukhta (ton emeron) tes nesteias na plesiazete tis suzugous sas (gia sexoualike epaphe). Oi opoies einai ena kalumma gia sas (kai prophulaxe apo tis apagoreumenes skheseis), kai eseis eiste to diko tous kalumma. O Allakh gnorizei oti exapatousate ton eauto sas (pephtontas s' auto pou sas apagorepse) (epeide sten arkhe kata ton mena Ramazaniou, an koimotan kaneis kai xupnouse prin ten auge, etan apagoreumeno to na phaei e na ekhei sexoualike epaphe me te suzugo tou, ma kapoioi to ekanan eite kata lathos eite okhi), etsi apodekhteke te metameleia sas kai sas sugkhorese. Tora, loipon, mporeite na ekhete (sexoualike) epaphe mazi tous (kata tis nukhtes tou Ramazaniou) kai na epizetate auto pou o Allakh orise gia sas (apo paidia). Kai na trote kai na pinete mekhri na phanei s' esas to leuko nema (phos) tes auges apo to mauro nema (skotadi tes nukhtas). Epeita na olokleronete te nesteia mekhri na pesei e nukhta (e duse tou eliou). Kai oso eiste se katastase I'tikaph (aphieronontas ton eauto sas ste latreia gia kapoio khroniko diastema) sta tzamia (kai bgeite apo ta tzamia pegainontas spitia sas gia kapoia anagke, meta apo ten opoia tha epistrepsete xana sta tzamia), men tis plesiazete (tis suzugous sas sexoualika, epeide auto akuronei ten katastase I'tikaph). Auta einai ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh (pou diakhorizoun tis epitreptes apo tis apagoreumenes praxeis), etsi na men ta plesiazete (oste na men pesete stis apagoreumenes praxeis). Etsi o Allakh dieukrinizei ta Edaphia (kai ta semeia) Tou stous anthropous, mepos kai phulakhthoun (apo ten timoria Tou meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Kai men phate metaxu sas adika o enas ten periousia tou allou oute na prosphugete gi' auten stous dikastes (me pseutikes apodeixeis) gia na phate ena meros tes periousias ton allon anthropon, amartola kai me epignose.

Se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia ta nea pheggaria (oson aphora ten stadiake allage tes emphanises tous). Pes: <<Einai metretes khronou gia tous anthropous (gia na xeroun to khrono ton praxeon latreias tous) kai gia to proskunema.>> Eusebeia den einai to na mpainete sta spitia apo ten piso pleura tous (opos iskhurizosastan prin to Islam, oti enas proskunetes tha prepei na mpei sto spiti tou apo ten piso pleura), alla eusebeia, einai to na phulakhthei kaneis (apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou). Na mpainete sta spitia (sas) apo tis portes tous. Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), mepos kai epitukhete.

Kai na polemate ston dromo tou Allakh ekeinous pou sas polemoun, alla men xepernate ta oria sas (del. na me skotonete amakhous polites, gunaikes, paidia, dentra, zoa klp.), giati o Allakh den agapaei tous parabates.

Kai skotoste ekeinous (tous apistous pou sas polemoun) opou tous sunantate kai exoriste tous ap' opou sas ekhoun exorisei (apo te Makka), kai e Al-Phitna (e eidololatria kai e apotrope enos Mousoulmanou apo te threskeia tou meso diogmou) einai kheirotere (gi' auton) apo to na skotothei (ap' autous). Kai men tous polemate ston Iero Oiko (ste Makka) ektos ki an sas polemesoun autoi ekei. Ma an sas polemesoun, tote skotoste tous. Tetoia einai e timoria gia tous apistous.
Ma an pausoun (ten apistia tous kai to na sas polemoun), tote st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Kai polemeste tous mekhri na men uparkhei pia (ap' autous kamia) Phitna (del. na stamatesoun na sas apotrepoun apo to Islam meso diogmon, kai na stamatesoun ten apistia kai ten eidololatria tous) kai na uperiskhusei e threskeia tou Allakh. Ma an pausoun (ten apistia tous kai to na sas polemoun), tote (na men tous polemate, giati) den uparkhei epithese para mono pros tous adikous.

O Ieros menas (kata ton opoio polemate tous apistous) einai antapodose gia (ten epithese tous enantion sas kata) ton Iero mena (etsi, den uparkhei amartia se sas na tous polemate s' auton), kai gia ola ta Iera uparkhei o nomos tou Kisas (antapodose) (del. opoios epitithetai s' esas se iero topo e khrono, apanteste ten epithese tou kai den mporei na zetaei kataphugio logo tou ierou topou e khronou). Etsi, opoios sas epitethei, tote epitetheite tou me ton idio tropo me ton opoio sas epitetheke. Kai na phulakhteite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou) kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh einai me tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Kai na xodeuete ston dromo tou Allakh, kai me rikhnete ton eauto sas sten katastrophe. Kai na kanete to kalo (kai na teleite te latreia sas) me ton kalutero tropo. Pragmati, o Allakh agapa autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Kai na telesete olokleromena to Khatz (megalo proskunema) kai ten 'Oumra (mikro proskunema) gia khare tou Allakh. Ma an apotrapeite (apo enan ekhthro e mia astheneia apo to na phtasete ston Iero Oiko, aphou eiselthete sten katastase Ikhram -phorontas ta roukha tou proskunematos-), tote thusiaste auto pou mporeite apo ta zoa thusias (mia probatina e kathe ephta atoma na thusiasoun mazi mia agelada e mia kamela gia na bgeite apo ten katastase Ikhram). Kai men xurizete ta kephalia sas mekhri to zoo thusias na phtasei ston topo sphages tou (ston Iero Oiko ten emera tes thusias, alla an eikhate apotrapei apo to na phtasete ston Iero Oiko, tote thusiaste opou apotrapekate). Kai opoios apo sas einai asthenes e ekhei kati pou ton blaptei sto kephali tou (opos pseires klp., kai prepei logo autou na to xurisei eno brisketai akoma se katastase Ikhram), e exileose tou einai na prospherei nesteia (gia treis emeres) e eleemosune (taIzontas exi aporous) e thusia (enos probatou gia tous aporous sto Iero Tzami). Kai otan eiste asphaleis, opoios telesei ten 'Oumra (kata tous menes tou Khatz kai parameinei sto Iero Tzami) kai apolausei (auta pou etan apagoreumena kata ten katastase Ikhram tes 'Oumras, aphou ekhei bgei apo auten ten katastase), mekhri to (na xana mpei sten katastase Ikhram tou) Khatz (ekeines tes khronias), tha prepei na thusiasei auto pou mporei apo ta zoa thusias (mia probatina e mazi me alla exi atoma na thusiasoun mia agelada e mia kamela). Kai opoios den mporei (na thusiasei ena zoo), tote nesteia trion emeron kata to Khatz kai epta otan ekhete epistrepsei. Autes einai, loipon, deka olokleres (meres). Auto einai gi' osous oi oikogeneies tous den einai apo tous katoikous tes periokhes tou Ierou Tzamiou (del. Makka). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou) kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria.

To Khatz (proskunema) einai kata tous gnostous menes (Saoual, Dou-al-Ki'nta kai oi protes deka emeres tou Dou-al-Khitza). Etsi, opoios desmeuei ton eauto tou na kanei to proskunema kata autous tous menes (eiserkhomenos sten katastase Ikhram -phorontas ta roukha tou Khatz-), den prepei na ekhei sexoualike epaphe (oute erotika paikhnidia), oute na diaprattei amarties, oute na diaplektizetai kata te diarkeia tou Khatz. Kai o,ti kalo kanete, o Allakh to gnorizei. Kai na pairnete ephodia, st' aletheia, to kalutero ephodio einai e eusebeia. Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Mou (meso tes tereses ton entolon Mou), o, anthropoi pou ekhete mualo (gia na sullogisteite).

Den uparkhei amartia s' esas sto na epizetate gennaiodoria apo ton Kurio sas (meso ton emporikon sunallagon kata to Khatz). Ma otan anakhoreite apo to 'Araphat (to meros opou oi proskunetes stekontai ten enate emera tou mena Dou-al-Khitza), na mnemoneuete ton Allakh sto Al-Mas'ar Al-Kharam (ten periokhe tes Al-Mouzntaliphas). Kai mnemoneuete Ton, opos sas kathodegese (stis teletourgies tou proskunematos tou Oikou Tou), giati st' aletheia, prin ap' auto esastan anamesa stous parastratemenous.

Epeita, anakhoreste apo kei ap' opou oi anthropoi (pou akolouthousan ten paradose tou Impraem -Abraam-) anakhorousan (kai men kanete san autous pou prin to Islam den stekontousan sto 'Araphat), kai zeteste sugkhorese apo ton Allakh. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Kai otan oloklerosete ta teletourgika sas, na mnemoneuete ton Allakh, opos mnemoneuete tous pateres sas (kaukhiomenoi gi' autous), e me polu megalutere mnemoneuse. Kai anamesa stous anthropous einai autos pou leei: <<Kurie mas, dose mas (tis khares Sou) s' auton ton kosmo.>>, kai ste Mellousa Zoe den tha labei meridio (aphou den noiazetai para mono gia ten egkosmia zoe).

Kai anamesa tous (stous anthropous) einai autos pou leei: <<Kurie mas, dose mas s' auton ton kosmo (auto pou einai) kalo (ten eudaimonia, ten kathodegese, tis enaretes praxeis, klp.) kai ste Mellousa Zoe (auto pou einai) kalo (ton Paradeiso) kai prostatepse mas apo to marturio tou Puros.>>
Ekeinoi tha laboun meridio (apo terastia amoibe) gia o,ti ekanan (apo kales praxeis), kai o Allakh einai Gregoros ston upologismo (ton praxeon ton doulon Tou, kai sto na tous antameibei gi' autes).

Kai na mnemoneuete ton Allakh se (sugkekrimenes) katametremenes emeres (ten 11e, te 12e kai te 13e tou mena Dou-al-Khitza, kata tis opoies oi proskunetes menoun sten periokhe Mena kata to Khatz). Opoios omos epispeudei (ten anakhorese tou) meta te deutere mera (del. prin te duse tes 12es emeras aphou erixe tis Tzamarat -petres-) - den uparkhei amartia s' auton. Kai opoios kathusterei (mekhri ten trite emera) - den uparkhei amartia s' auton. (Auta einai) gi' auton pou phobatai ton Allakh (telontas to Khatz opos orise o Allakh). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou) kai na gnorizete oti se Auton tha sugkentrotheite.

Kai apo tous anthropous uparkhei ekeinos (o upokrites), tou opoiou o logos sou aresei (o, Mokhammant), sten egkosmia zoe, kai iskhurizetai oti o Allakh einai marturas gi' auta pou ekhei sten kardia tou (apo piste, kalosune kai agape gia to Islam), eno st' aletheia einai o megaluteros ekhthros.
Kai otan pheugei (apo sena, o, Mokhammant) speudei na diadosei to kako ste ge kai na katastrepsei tis kalliergeies kai ta booeide. Ma o Allakh den agapa ten katastrophe.

Kai otan legetai s' auton: <<Na phobasai ton Allakh (apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).>> E uperephaneia (alazoneia tou) ton odegei se (perissoteres) amarties. Arkei gi' auton to Pur tes Kolaseos, kai poso athlios einai autos o topos diamones.
Kai apo tous anthropous einai autos pou poula (aphieronei) ton eauto tou (sten upakoe pros ton Allakh), epizetontas ten eukharistese tou Allakh. Kai o Allakh einai Poluepieikes stous doulous (Tou).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Eiselthete sto Islam pleros (terontas olous tous nomous tou). Kai men akoloutheite ta bemata tou Satana. St' aletheia, autos einai gia esas enas prophanes ekhthros.
Kai an apoklinete (apo ton dromo tes aletheias) aphou sas ekhoun elthei oi sapheis apodeixeis, tote na xerete oti o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), Khakeim (Pansophos).

Perimenoun (oi apistoi, meta ap' oles autes tis apodeixeis) mono to na tous elthei o Allakh pano apo sorous nephon (me tropo pou tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia kai sten Teleioteta Tou, kata ten Emera tes Kriseos gia na tous dikasei), kai (na elthoun epises) oi aggeloi (pou tha tous periballoun apo kathe pleura), kai na ginei e Krise (tou Allakh skhetika m' autous); Kai ston Allakh epistrephoun (ola) ta themata.

Rota (o, Mokhammant) ta paidia tou Israel (Iakobou) poses sapheis apodeixeis tous dosame. Kai opoios antallassei ten eunoia tou Allakh (me ten apistia), aphou tou ekhei elthei (e eunoia) - tote, st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria Tou.

Oraiopoiemene einai gia tous apistous e zoe autou tou kosmou, kai khleuazoun autous pou pisteuoun. Ma autoi pou phullasontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou) tha einai pano ap' autous (tous apistous) ten Emera tes Anastases (opou tha briskontai psela ston Paradeiso, eno oi apistoi tha briskontai sta katotera semeia tes Photias). Kai o Allakh parekhei ephodia se opoion thelei khoris orio.

Oi anthropoi etan ena ethnos (pou pisteuan ston Allakh kai akolouthousan ten idia threskeia, tou Adam, to Islam, alla epeita oi daimones tous paraplanesan, kai diakhoristekan se diaphores threskeies), kai etsi, o Allakh esteile tous Prophetes os phoreis eukhariston eideseon kai proeidopoietes, kai m' autous esteile to Biblio (ta Theika Biblia) me ten aletheia, gia na krinei metaxu ton anthropon se o,ti ekhoun diaphonesei. Kai den diaphonesan skhetika me auto (to Biblio -ten Tora- kai o,ti periekhei apo ten aletheia) para mono ekeinoi (oi Ebraioi) stous opoious dotheke (e gnose gia ten Tora), apo adikia kai phthono metaxu tous, aphou erthan s' autous emphaneis apodeixeis (oti einai e aletheia apo ton Allakh pou den mporoun na diaphonoun s' aute). Epeita, o Allakh me te thelese Tou kathodegese tous pistous (tous Mousoulmanous), sten aletheia gia ten opoia diaphonousan (ta proegoumena ethne, Ebraioi kai Khristianoi). Kai o Allakh kathodegei opoion thelei ston isio dromo.

E nomizete (o, pistoi) oti tha eiselthete ston Paradeiso khoris na elthoun s' esas tetoies (dokimasies) pou elthan s' autous (tous pistous) pou etan prin apo sas; Khtupethekan apo te phtokheia kai tis astheneies kai klonisthekan se semeio pou o aggeliaphoros kai autoi pou pisteuan mazi tou eipan: <<Pote (tha erthei) e nike apo ton Allakh;>> St' aletheia, e nike apo ton Allakh einai konta.

Se rotoun (o, Mokhammant), ti prepei na xodeuoun (se eleemosune apo ta diaphora eide ploutou tous, kai se poious na dosoun). Pes: <<Otidepote xodeuete apo kalo, na to dosete stous goneis, stous suggeneis, sta orphana, stous endeeis kai ston odoiporo. Kai o,ti kanete apo kalo - st' aletheia, o Allakh to gnorizei pleros.>>

Ekhei diatakhthei s' esas to na polemesete, eno auto einai kati dusaresto gia sas. Ma isos na apekhthaneste kati eno auto einai kalo gia sas* kai isos na agapate kati eno auto einai kako gia sas. Kai o Allakh gnorizei, eno eseis den gnorizete.

Se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) skhetika me to na polemate kata tous ierous menes (De-al-Ki'nta, De-al-Khitza, Moukharram kai Ratzamp). Pes: <<O polemos ekeino to diastema einai mia terastia (parabiase), ma einai megalutere (parabiase) enopion tou Allakh, (auta pou kanoun oi apistoi, opos) e apotrope (ton anthropon) apo ton dromo tou Allakh (to Islam), e apistia s' Auton, (e apotrope ton piston apo ten prosbase sto) Iero Tzami (ste Makka) kai o exorismos ton katoikon tou (Ierou Tzamiou) apo auto. Kai e Al-Phitna (e apistia tous) einai kheirotere apo ton phono.>> Kai (oi apistoi) tha sunekhisoun na sas polemoun (o, Mousoulmanoi) mekhri na sas strepsoun makria apo te threskeia sas an mporoun. Kai opoios apo sas apostatesei apo te threskeia tou kai pethanei os apistos - gi' autous, oi (kales) praxeis tous tha katargethoun s' auton ton kosmo kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai autoi einai oi katoikoi tou Puros, tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.

St' aletheia, autoi pou pistepsan kai autoi pou metanasteusan kai polemesan ston dromo tou Allakh - autoi epizetoun to eleos tou Allakh. Kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia to Al-Khamr (ta alkooloukha pota, -epises einai opoiadepote ousia pou zalizei to mualo-) kai ton tzogo. Pes: <<Uparkhei kai sta duo megale amartia, kai (kapoia) ophele gia tous anthropous, ma e amartia tous einai megalutere apo to ophelos tous.>> Kai se rotoun ti (poso) prepei na xodepsoun (gia eleemosune klp.). Pes: <<To perisseuma sas.>> Etsi o Allakh sas dieukrinizei ta Edaphia (kai tous nomous tes Sarias) oste na sullogizeste.

(Na sullogizeste auta pou einai ophelema gia sas) s' auton ton kosmo kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Kai se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia ta orphana (pou einai upo ten kedemonia tous kai diakheirizontai ta ploute tous, an mporoun na anameignuoun ta khremata tous me ta dika tous ste diatrophe, te stegase klp., eno prin, diakhorizan to phageto ton orphanon apo to diko tous, phoboumenoi ten proeidopoiese tou Allakh na men adikesei kaneis enan orphano). Pes: <<To na beltiosete gi' autous (ta ploute tous kai na ta prostateusete) einai to kalutero. Kai an anameignuete mazi tous (ta khremata sas me ta dika tous, ste diatrophe, te stegase klp., khoris auto na tous blaptei e na tous adikei) -einai adelphia sas. Kai o Allakh gnorizei poios (ekhei kake prothese na) khalasei (ta ploute ton orphanon meso tes anameixes) kai poios (ekhei kale prothese na ta) beltiosei. Kai an o Allakh ethele, tha sas ebaze se duskolies. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

Kai men pantreueste polutheIstries gunaikes mekhri na pistepsoun. Kai mia piste doula einai kalutere apo mia polutheIstria (eleuthere), akoma ki an (e teleutaia) sas aresei. Kai men pantreuete (tis pistes gunaikes) me polutheistes andres mekhri na pistepsoun. Kai enas pistos doulos einai kaluteros apo enan polutheiste (eleuthero), akoma ki an (o teleutaios) sas aresei. Autoi (sas) kaloun sto Pur, ma o Allakh (sas) kalei ston Paradeiso kai ste sugkhorese, me ten adeia Tou. Kai diasaphenizei stous anthropous ta Edaphia Tou, mepos kai ta laboun upopse.

Kai se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia ten emmeno ruse. Pes, <<Einai blabere (gia ton andra an ekhei sexoualike epaphe me te gunaika tou kata ten emmeno ruse tes), opote apophugete te sexoualike epaphe me tis gunaikes sas kata ten emmeno ruse. Kai men ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous mekhri na stamatesei e emmenos ruse tous kai na kanoun Gousl (Igtisal - pleres ntous). Kai otan to kanoun, tote mporeite na ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous, apo ekei opou sas dietaxe o Allakh (delade mono apo ton kolpo). St' aletheia, o Allakh agapa ekeinous pou strephontai sukhna me metameleia (pros Auton), kathos agapa tous katharous (pou apekhoun apo tis akatharsies kai plenontai sukhna kanontas Gousl e Ountou' -nipse- gia tis proseukhes tous).

Oi gunaikes sas einai gia sas enas topos kalliergeias (del. apo autes apoktate paidia), plesiaste tes, loipon, me opoion tropo thelete (del. mproumuta e anaskela, alla panta apo to meros tes gonimopoieses, ton kolpo). Kai na kanete kales praxeis pou tha sas ophelesoun (kata te Mellousa Zoe). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou), kai na gnorizete oti tha Ton sunantesete. Kai anaggeile (o, Mokhammant) ta eukharista nea stous pistous.

Kai men kanete tous orkous sas sto Onoma tou Allakh na einai dikaiologia gia na men kanete to kalo, na men energeite eusebos kai na men sumphilionete tous anthropous (del. an kapoios ekane orko na men milaei me ton adelpho tou, den prepei na to epharmosei, antitheta, tha prepei na kanei to kalo kai epeita na exileothei). Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

O Allakh de tha sas katadikasei gia tous orkous pou eipate khoris na eikhate skopo ton orko, ma tha sas katadikasei gi' auto pou skopeuan oi kardies sas (apo skopimous orkous an tous athetesete). Kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

Gi' autous pou orkizontai na men ekhoun sexoualike epaphe me tis suzugous tous (apo thumo pros autes), uparkhei periodos anamones tessaron menon, an (prin teleiosei) epistrepsoun (kai ekhoun sexoualike epaphe), tote (as exileothoun gia ton orko tous kai) o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos) [An den epistrepsoun kai perasei e periodos anamones, tote ekeines mporoun na kataphugoun ston dikaste gia diazugio].
