Ma an skopeuoun to diazugio (sunekhizontas na egkataleipoun te sexoualike epaphe me tis suzugous tous, aphou teleiose e periodos anamones) - st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Oi diazeugmenes gunaikes paramenoun sten anamone gia treis periodous (kata tis opoies den mporoun na pantreutoun kapoion allon), kai den epitrepetai s' autes na krupsoun auto pou o Allakh demiourgese stis metres tous (apo paidia), an pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera. Kai oi suzugoi tous ekhoun to dikaioma na tis paroun piso (ston eggamo bio) kata auto (to khroniko diastema), an skopeuoun sumphiliose (kai diorthose kai kalosune kai okhi gia na tis blapsoun). Kai gi' autes uparkhoun dikaiomata (apenanti stous suzugous tous), opos ta kathekonta pou uparkhoun s' autes (pros autous), sumphona me ton dikaio tropo. Kai oi andres (oi suzugoi) ekhoun ena bathmo (euthunes) pano s' autes. Kai o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

To diazugio (sto opoio o suzugos mporei na parei xana te suzugo tou ston eggamo bio kata ten periodo anamones -'Einta-) mporei na dothei (mono) duo phores: epeita eite diaterei kaneis (te suzugo) me kalo tropo (kale suntrophikoteta kai kalo eggamo bio), eite (ten) aphenei me kalosune (meso tes trites phoras diazugiou, meta ten opoia den mporei na ten parei piso ektos me allous kanones). Kai den epitrepetai s' esas (tous andres meta to diazugio) na parete piso tipota ap' ose (proika) tous eikhate dosei, ektos kai an (e suzugos misei ton suzugo tes logo kapoion somatikon idiaiteroteton tou, e megales sexoualikes aneparkeias tou, e kakou kharaktera tou klp. kai zetaei diazugio) kai oi duo pleures (o andras kai e suzugos tou) phobountai oti de tha mporesoun (exaitias autou tou misous) na teresoun ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh (ta suzugika dikaiomata kai kathekonta). An loipon (eseis, oi krites pou tethekate apo tis duo pleures) phobaste oti de tha mporesoun na teresoun ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, tote de tha uparkhei amartia se kanenan ap' tous duo, an aute epistrepsei ten proika (e meros tes ston suzugo tes) gia na parei diazugio (Khoul'). Auta einai ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, gi' auto men ta parabiazete. Kai opoioi parabiazoun ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, autoi einai oi adikoi.

Kai an tes ekhei dosei diazugio (gia trite phora), tote den epitrepetai s' auton na ten pantreutei xana mekhri (aute) na pantreutei allo suzugo. Kai an (o teleutaios suzugos) tes dosei diazugio (e pethanei), den uparkhei amartia pano tous (ste gunaika kai ston proen suzugo) sto na epistrepsoun o enas ston allon (me kainourgio sumbolaio gamou kai kainourgia proika), an pisteuoun oti mporoun na teresoun ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh. Auta einai ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, ta opoia diasaphenizei stous anthropous pou gnorizoun.

Kai otan khorisete tis gunaikes (sas) kai ekhoun (skhedon) ekplerosei ten orismene periodo (anamones) tous, eite na tis diateresete (ston eggamo bio) me kalo tropo (kale suntrophikoteta kai kalo eggamo bio), eite na tis aphesete (na ekplerosoun ten orismene periodo anamones) me kalo tropo (me kalosune kai dinontas tous ta dikaiomata tous). Kai men tis kratesete (ston eggamo bio), me skopo na tis blapsete kai na parabiasete (ta dikaiomata tous), kai opoios to kanei auto, st' aletheia adikei ton eauto tou (kai axizei ten timoria). Kai men pairnete ta Edaphia tou Allakh os asteio (parabiazontas tis entoles Tou). Kai thumetheite tis khares tou Allakh se sas kai o,ti sas esteile apo to Biblio (Kor'an) kai te Sophia (Sounna -paradose- tou Prophete). Sas diatazei auto, kai phulakhteite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Kai otan khorisete (gia prote e deutere phora) tis gunaikes sas kai ekhoun ekplerosei (ede) ten orismene periodo (anamones -'Einta-) tous (khoris na tis ekhete epistrepsei ston eggamo bio, kai thelete na tis xana pantreuteite), men tis apotrepete (o, kedemones ton gunaikon, opos o pateras e o adelphos tous) apo to na (xana) pantreutoun tous suzugous tous (me kainourgio sumbolaio gamou) an sumphonoun metaxu tous me ten kalosune (kai ton dikaio tropo). Auto (pou sas dietaxa) to lambanoun upopse osoi apo sas pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera. (Kai to na epistrepsoun xana stous suzugous tous) auto einai kalutero gia sas kai pio agno, kai o Allakh gnorizei ki eseis de gnorizete.

Oi meteres tha thelasoun ta paidia tous gia duo oloklera khronia, gia osous theloun na oloklerosoun ten prepousa periodo thelasmou. Kai o pateras tou paidiou upokhreoutai na kalupsei tis dapanes tou phagetou kai tou roukhismou tes (diazeugmenes meteras), sumphona me to eulogo. Kaneis de barunetai peran ton dunatoteton tou. Kamia metera den prepei na blaphthei meso tou paidiou tes, oute o pateras meso tou paidiou tou (del. den prepei oi goneis na khresimopoioun to paidi os meso gia na blapsei o enas ton allon). Kai (an pethanei o pateras, tote) ston kleronomo (tou) uparkhei to idio (kathekon, apo phageto kai roukhismo pros te metera tou paidiou). Kai an kai oi duo epithumoun ton apogalaktismo (prin na oloklerothoun ta duo khronia thelasmou) me amoibaia sunainese kai sunennoese, den uparkhei amartia se kanenan apo tous duo. Kai an thelete to paidi sas na thelastei apo kapoia tropho (ektos tes meteras), den uparkhei amartia s' esas ephoson (tes) dinete ten plerome, me dikaio tropo (khoris meiose oute anabole). Kai phulakhteite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou), kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh blepei o,ti kanete.

Kai autoi apo sas pou pethainoun aphenontas piso suzugous -autes paramenoun se periodo anamones gia tesseris menes kai deka emeres, (khoris na pantreutoun, oute na stolistoun). Kai otan ekhoun ekplerosei ten orismene periodo (anamones) tous, tote den uparkhei amartia s' esas (o, suggeneis tous) gia o,ti kanoun me ton eauto tous me apodekton tropo (opos an theloun na pantreutoun kapoion allon). Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Den uparkhei amartia s' esas (o, andres) gi' auto pou upainisseste gia mia (emmese) protase arrabona stis gunaikes (kata ten orismene periodo anamones tous, opos stis kheres, kai s' autes pou einai diazeugmenes gia trite phora apo tous proen suzugous tous. Opos to na tes pei: <<Pote teleionei e periodos anamones sou;>> klp.) e gi' auto pou kratate mesa sas (oti ekhete ten prothese na tis pantreuteite, otan ekplerothei e periodos anamones tous). O Allakh gnorizei oti tha tis anapherete (eite mesa sas, eite me tis glosses sas, gi' auto sas epetrepse na to upainikhtheite, khoris omos na to peite phonakhta). Ma men tous uposkhetheite mustika, gamo (kata ten periodo anamones tous), ektos na peite katallela logia (del. na upainikhtheite mono). Kai men apophasisete na sunapsete gamelio sumbolaio mekhri e orismene periodos anamones na phtasei sto telos tes. Kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh gnorizei o,ti uparkhei mesa sas, etsi na Ton phobaste. Kai na gnorizete oti o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

Den uparkhei amartia s' esas (sto na men dinete ten proika) stis gunaikes pou tis khorizete khoris na tis ekhete (akoma) aggixei (sexoualika), oute ekhete (akoma) orisei gi' autes mia (sugkekrimene) proika. Alla doste tous ena khrematiko poso, (os apozemiose, gia na aisthanontai kalutera) - o plousios dinei sumphona me te dunatoteta tou kai o phtokhos dinei sumphona me te dunatoteta tou - ena eulogo poso sumphona m' auto pou einai apodekto, ena kathekon s' autous pou prattoun to kalo.

An omos tis khorisete protou na tis aggixete (sexoualika), alla tous ekhete orisei mia (sugkekrimene) proika, tote (doste tous) to miso apo auto pou kathorisate gia proika, ektos kai an apodekhtoun (oi gunaikes) na aphesoun (auto to miso), e an autos (o suzugos), sto kheri tou opoiou einai o desmos tou gamou, dekhtei na dosei (ste gunaika) ten plere proika. Kai to na aphesete (o enas ston allon, kapoia apo ta dikaiomata sas) einai plesiestero sten eusebeia. Kai men xekhnate te gennaiodoria (ten anokhe kai ten eugeneia) metaxu sas. St' aletheia, o Allakh blepei o,ti kanete.
Tereite austera tis (pente upokhreotikes kathemerines) proseukhes, kai (eidika) te mesaia proseukhe (Al-'Asr). Kai statheite (stis proseukhes sas) enopion tou Allakh upakouoi kai tapeinoi.

Kai an phobaste (apo enan ekhthro se periodo polemou, kai den mporeite na telesete ten proseukhe opos prepei) tote (teleste ten opos mporeite) eite perpatontas eite kabalontas (kai eite pros ten Kimpla, eite okhi). Kai otan eiste asphaleis, tote (telesete tis proseukhes sas opos prepei kai) mnemoneuste ton Allakh, kathos sas ekhei didaxei auto pou de gnorizate prin.

Kai ekeinoi anamesa sas pou pethainoun aphenontas piso (tis) suzugous (tous) - gia tis suzugous tous uparkhei os klerodotema mia desmeuse (apo ton Allakh s' esas): ta pros to zen (phageto, roukhismo, diamone klp.) gia ena etos kai khoris na tous kanei kaneis (apo ten oikogeneia tou thanonta) na phugoun (apo ta spitia ton suzugon tous). An omos phugoun (oi suzugoi apo epiloge tous, prin teleiosei to etos), den uparkhei amartia se sas (oute se autes) gia o,ti kanoun ston eauto tous apo epitrepta pragmata. Kai o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai gia tis diazeugmenes gunaikes uparkhei pronoia (gia khremata kai roukhismo klp.) sumphona m' auto pou einai apodekto - ena kathekon s' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).
Etsi o Allakh sas dieukrinizei ta Edaphia Tou, mepos kai sullogisteite.

Ma den emathes (o, Mokhammant) gi' ekeinous (apo ta paidia tou Israel -Iakobou-) pou bgekan apo ta spitia tous se khiliades, phoboumenoi to thanato (apo ten epidemia); Kai etsi, o Allakh tous eipe: <<Pethanete.>> Kai epeita tous ephere xana ste zoe (gia na tous deixei oti e apophase olon ton thematon brisketai mono sta Kheria Tou, kai oti autoi den mporoun na pheroun ston eauto tous kati kalo oute na apotrepsoun apo ton eauto tous kati kako). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Autos pou dinei polles khares (kai eunoies kai gennaiodoria) stous anthropous, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi den deikhnoun eugnomosune.
Kai polemeste ston dromo tou Allakh (ekeinous pou polemoun enantion tes threskeias Tou) kai na xerete oti o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Poios tha daneisei ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas apo ta khremata tou gia khare tou Allakh se kathe kalo dromo), oste (o Allakh) na tou to pollaplasiasei polu (del. ten amoibe tou); Kai einai o Allakh pou parakratei kai khoregei me aphthonia (gi' auto, xodepste se kathe kalo dromo kai men phobaste te meiose ton khrematon). Kai s' Auton tha epistrepsete.

Ma den emathes (o, Mokhammant) gia tous arkhegous ton paidion tou Israel, meta apo ten epokhe tou Mouse, otan eipan se enan prophete anamesa tous (ton Samouel): <<Diorise gia mas enan basilia, oste na polemesoume ston dromo tou Allakh.>>; Eipe: <<Isos an orizotan s' esas na polemesete, (pithanotata) den tha polemousate;>> Eipan: <<Kai giati na men polemesoume ston dromo tou Allakh, eno diokhthekame apo ta spitia mas kai (aikhmalotistekan) ta paidia mas;>> Alla otan oristeke s' autous na polemesoun, apostraphekan (athetontas ten uposkhese tous), ektos apo ligous ap' autous. Kai o Allakh gnorizei kala tous adikous.

Kai o Prophetes tous (o Samouel) tous eipe: <<Pragmati, o Allakh diorise s' esas ton Talout (Saoul) os basilia pano sas.>> Eipan (oi arkhegoi ton paidion tou Israel): <<Pos mporei na ekhei te basileia s' emas, eno eimaste pio axioi gia te basileia ap' auton (aphou e basileia etan apokleistika gia mia phule, kai o Talout den proerkhotan apo ekeine te phule, kai oute enas apo te phule tou etan prophetes), kai den tou ekhei dothei megalos ploutos (oste na idrusei te basileia tou);>> Eipe: <<Pragmati, o Allakh ton epelexe (gia na einai basilias) pano sas, kai ton auxese me eureia gnose kai duname sto soma. Kai o Allakh dinei s' opoion thelei basileia. Kai o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gia olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Kai o Prophetes tous (o Samouel) tous eipe: <<Pragmati, to semadi tes basileias tou einai oti tha erthei s' esas to kibotio (tes diathekes, to opoio kapoioi ekhthroi eikhan parei apo ta paidia tou Israel), ekhontas mesa tou eremia (kai diabebaiose) apo ton Kurio sas kai alla pragmata pou eikhe aphesei e oikogeneia tou Mouse kai e oikogeneia tou Aaron (opos e rabdos tou Mouse kai kapoia spasmena kommatia apo tis plakes tou Mouse), kai to opoio tha to metapheroun oi aggeloi. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena (xekatharo) semadi gia sas, an eiste pragmati pistoi.>>

Kai otan o Talout (Saoul) bgeke mazi me tous stratiotes (gia ton polemo), eipe: <<Pragmati, o Allakh tha sas dokimasei me ena potami. Etsi, opoios pinei ap' auto den einai ap' emena (apo tous akolouthous mou oute einai katallelos gia na me sunodeusei), kai opoios den to geutei einai ontos ap' emena, ektos ap' ekeinon pou (anagkazetai kai) pairnei mia khouphta (nero) me to kheri tou (gi' auton den uparkhei kati to mempto).>> Alla epian ap' auto, ektos apo ligous ap' autous. Kai otan to dieskhise (to potami) mazi m' ekeinous pou pisteuan (oi opoioi etan ligoi, kapoioi ap' autous, aphou eidan poso megalo strato ekhei o ekhthros tous), eipan: <<Den ekhoume kamia duname semera enantia tou Tzalout (Goliath) kai ton stratioton tou.>> Alla ekeinoi pou gnorizan me bebaioteta oti tha sunantousan ton Allakh (kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) eipan: <<Poses phores mia mikre omada (piston) eikhe upernikesei mia megale (paniskhure) omada (apiston) me ten adeia tou Allakh;>> Kai o Allakh einai me tous upomonetikous.

Kai otan emphanistekan (ephtasan se orato meros) ston Tzalout (Goliath) kai tous stratiotes tou, eipan (epikaloumenoi ton Allakh): <<Kurie mas, rixe se mas upomone, kai statheropoiese ta podia mas, kai dose mas nike epi tou laou pou den pisteuei.>>

Etsi, tous nikesan me ten adeia tou Allakh, kai o Ntaount (Dabid) skotose ton Tzalout (Goliath). Kai o Allakh tou edose (ston Dabid) te basileia [meta to thanato tou Talout (Saoul)] kai te sophia (del. ton ekane prophete meta to thanato tou Samouel) kai ton didaxe o,ti (gnoseis) ethele (o Allakh na ton didaxei). Kai an o Allakh de stamatouse (to kako kai tis adikies) mias omadas anthropon meso mias alles (del. meso polemou), e ge tha eikhe katastraphei (kai tha etan gemate me anatarakhes)! Alla o Allakh dinei megales khares kai gennaiodoria se olous.
Auta einai ta Edaphia tou Allakh pou apaggelloume s' esena (o, Mokhammant) me ten aletheia. Kai pragmati, eisai enas apo tous Aggeliaphorous (tou Allakh).

Kai ap' autous tous Aggeliaphorous protimesame kapoious pano apo tous allous: se kapoious ap' autous milese o Allakh (amesa, opos ston Mouse kai ston Mokhammant), allous tous auxese se bathmous (times, opos ton Mokhammant), kai ston Iesou, ton gio tes Marias, dosame sapheis apodeixeis kai ton uposterixame me to agio pneuma (ton aggelo Gabriel). An ethele o Allakh, autoi (apo tis epomenes genies) pou erthan meta ap' autous (tous aggeliaphorous) den tha polemousan metaxu tous, meta pou tous eikhan erthei oi sapheis apodeixeis, alla diepheran metaxu tous, kai etsi, merikoi ap' autous pisteuan kai alloi arnethekan ten piste. An ethele o Allakh, den tha polemousan metaxu tous, alla o Allakh kanei o,ti thelei.

O, eseis pou pisteuete, xodepste (sto dromo tou Allakh) ap' auto pou sas parekhoume, protou erthei mia Emera sten opoia den tha uparxei kamia exagora (gia tous apistous, oste na men timorethoun) oute kamia philia, oute kamia diamesolabese (tha tous ophelesei). Kai pragmati, oi apistoi einai oi adikoi.

Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos - o Al-Khai (o Aionia Zontanos), o Al-Kaioum (Uposteriktes kai Sunteretes olon). Den Ton kataballei kamia nusta, oute enas upnos. S' Auton anekoun o,ti einai stous ouranous kai o,ti einai ste Ge. Poios mporei na mesolabesei (gia logariasmo kapoiou allou) enopion Tou, ektos me ten adeia Tou; Gnorizei o,ti etan prin ap' autous (ta demiourgemata Tou) kai ti tha ginei meta ap' autous, eno den katekhoun tipota apo te gnose Tou, para mono o,ti thelei. To Koursei (upopodio) Tou ekteinetai pano ap' tous ouranous kai te Ge, kai den Ton epibarunei e phulaxe kai e sunterese tous, kai Autos einai o Al-'Alei (Upsistos), o Al-'Adeim (Megas).

Den uparkhei katanagkasmos (se kanenan gia na mpei) ste threskeia (to Islam). Pragmati, e aletheia (kai e kathodegese) xekhorise phanera apo ten plane (kai ten apistia). Opoios aporriptei ta At-Tagkout (o,tidepote latreuetai ektos tou Allakh, opos ta eidola, tous pseutikous theous, tous kakous turannous klp.) kai pisteuei mono ston Allakh, ekhei piasei ten iskhurotere aitia (tes soterias kata ten Emera tes Anastases), pou den kobetai pote* Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

O Allakh einai o Kedemonas (kai o Prostates) ton piston, tous bgazei apo to skotadi pros to phos, eno oi kedemones ton apiston einai At-Tagout (ta eidola, oi diaboloi, kai oi arkhegoi tes planes), tous bgazoun apo to phos pros to skotadi. Autoi einai oi katoikoi tou Puros, opou tha katoikesoun ekei gia panta.

Eides (o, Mokhammant) ekeinon pou (etan polu alazonas kai tolmeros pou) diaphonouse suzetontas me ton Impraem (Abraam) gia ton Kurio tou (ton Allakh), [aplos] epeide o Allakh tou eikhe dosei basileia (egine alazonas rotontas ton Impraem poios einai o Kurios tou); Otan o Impraem eipe: <<O Kurios mou (Allakh) einai Autos pou dinei zoe kai ten aphairei.>> Eipe (ekeinos o basilias): <<Kai ego dino zoe (otan diatazo ten ektelese kapoiou, kai epeita ton sugkhoreso) kai ten aphairo (an den ton sugkhoreso).>> O Impraem eipe: <<O Allakh phernei ton elio apo ta anatolika, opote phere ton loipon, apo ta dutika.>> Etsi, o apistos emeine anaudos (kai to epikheirema tou katarriphtheke). Kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous.

E (eides, o, Mokhammant, kapoion) san auton pou perase apo mia komopole pou eikhe pesei pano apo tis steges tes (del. gkremistekan ola kai pethanan oi katoikoi tes), kai eipe: <<Pos o Allakh phernei xana ste zoe auten (ten komopole) meta ton thanato tes;>> Etsi, o Allakh ton ekane na pethanei gia ekato khronia, kai epeita ton anestese. Eipe (o Allakh): <<Poso kairo emeines (nekros);>> Eipe (o andras): <<Emeina mia mera e meros mias emeras.>> Eipe (o Allakh): <<Okhi, st' aletheia, emeines ekato khronia. Koita to phageto sou kai to poto sou, den ekhoun allaxei (me to khrono). Kai koita ton (nekro) gaidaro sou (pos tha ton anastesoume tora). Kai tha se kanoume ena semadi gia tous anthropous. Kai koita ta (skorpismena) osta (tou gaidarou sou) - pos tha ta enosoume kai epeita tha ta ntusoume me sarka.>> Kai otan egine saphes s' auton, eipe: <<Ksero oti o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Impraem (Abraam) eipe: <<O, Kurie mou, deixe mou (oste na do me ta matia) pos anasteneis tous nekrous.>> Eipe (o Allakh): <<Ma den to pisteues; (del. 'aphou ede to pisteueis auto')>> Eipe: <<Pisteuo, alla (rotao, pos to kaneis) oste e kardia mou na ikanopoiethei (blepontas me ta matia auto pou ede pisteuo me ten kardia). Eipe (o Allakh): <<Pare tessera poulia kai pherta konta sou (kai sphagiase ta) kai kopsta (se kommatia), ste sunekheia, bale se kathe lopho ena kommati ap' auta* kai epeita kalese ta - tha erthoun s' esena speudontas. Kai na xereis oti o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

To paradeigma ekeinon pou xodeuoun apo ten periousia tous ston dromo tou Allakh einai san enan sporo (sitou) pou megalonei ephta stakhua, se kathe stakhu uparkhoun ekato sporoi. Kai o Allakh pollaplasiazei (ten amoibe) gi' opoion thelei. Kai o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gia olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ekeinoi pou xodeuoun apo ten periousia tous ston dromo tou Allakh kai epeita den kanoun auto pou xodepsan na akoloutheitai oute apo to na kaukhiountai (s' auton pou tou edosan eleemosune), oute apo kako (me to na ton blaptoun me logia e me praxeis skhetika me ten eleemosune tous), tha laboun ten amoibe tous apo ton Kurio tous, kai gi' autous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

Ta kala logia kai e sugkhorese einai kalutera apo mia eleemosune pou akoloutheitai apo kako (me to na kaukhietai kaneis s' auton pou tou edose eleemosune). Kai o Allakh einai Ganei (Plousios, Apallagmenos apo oles tis anagkes), kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete, men kathistate mataies tis eleemosunes sas meso tou na kaukhieste (s' ekeinon pou tou dosate eleemosune) e tou kakou (me to na ton blaptete me logia e me praxeis skhetika me ten eleemosune), opos autos pou xodeuei apo ten periousia tou (se eleemosune) mono kai mono gia epideixe mprosta stous anthropous eno den pisteuei ston Allakh kai ten Eskhate Emera. To paradeigma tou einai san ekeino enos leiou brakhou pano ston opoio uparkhei lige skone kai epeita epese pano tou dunate brokhe kai ton aphese gumno, den ekhei tipote pano tou. Etsi, den tha mporesoun na paroun tipote (amoibe kata ten Eskhate Emera ) gia o,ti ekanan (del. gia o,ti xodepsan se eleemosune). Kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous apistous.

Kai to paradeigma ekeinon pou xodeuoun apo ten periousia tous anazetontas ten eukharistese tou Allakh kai pisteuontas oi idioi stathera (sten uposkhese tou Allakh gia amoibe), einai san ekeino to paradeigma enos kepou se pselo edaphos, ston opoio epese dunate brokhe - etsi apodidei tous karpous tou se diplasio. Kai (akome) an den pephtei pano tou dunate brokhe, e asthenes brokhe tou arkei. St' aletheia, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

Tha ethele kapoios apo sas (pou dinei eleemosune gia epideixe) na ekhei enan kepo me phoinikes kai ampelia, mesa ston opoio reoun potamia, kai na ekhei mesa tou kathe loges karpous, kai epeita na gerasei eno ekhei adunama mikra paidia, kai epeita (o kepos) na khtupethei apo enan anemostrobilo pou periekhei photia kai na kaei; (del. o,ti xodepse gia epideixe kaeke, kai etsi den tha labei kamia amoibe, para ten anagke tou gi' auten kata ten Eskhate Emera). Etsi, o Allakh sas dieukrinizei ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia Tou) oste na sullogizeste.

O, seis pou pisteuete! Ksodepste apo ta kala agatha pou kerdisate kai ap' auta (ta phuta) pou bgalame gia sas apo te ge, kai men epilexete skopimos auto pou den einai kalo apo auto, xodeuontas (to se eleemosune), eno (an sas dinotan), den tha to pairnate ektos na to parablepate (apo anagke). Kai na xerete oti o Allakh einai Ganei (Plousios, Apallagmenos apo oles tis anagkes) kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

O Satanas (diabolos) sas phobizei me phtokheia (an xodeuete se eleemosune) kai sas diatazei (na diapraxete) tis aiskhres amarties, eno o Allakh sas uposkhetai sugkhorese ap' Auton kai gennaiodoria. Kai o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gi' olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

(O Allakh) dinei te sophia (te gnose gia te threskeia kai ten orthoteta sta logia kai stis praxeis) s' opoion thelei (o Allakh). Kai s' opoion ekhei dothei e sophia, tou ekhei dothei aphthono kalo. Kai den to lambanoun upopse para mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun mualo (gia na to sullogistoun).

Kai o,ti eleemosune xodeuete (gia khare tou Allakh) e o,ti tama kanete (p.kh. to na dinete khremata se eleemosune) - pragmati, o Allakh to gnorizei. Kai gia tous adikous den tha uparkhoun uposteriktes.

Ean phaneronete tis eleemosunes, einai (oi eleemosunes) to kalutero pragma (ephoson einai gia khare tou Allakh), kai an tis apokruptete kai tis dinete (krupha) stous phtokhous, einai kalutero gi' esas (apo to na tis phaneronete), kai (o Allakh) tha sbesei gia sas apo tis amarties sas. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Den einai dikia sou euthune (o, Mokhammant) e kathodegese tous (del. men anagkaseis kanenan na eiselthei sto Islam, aphou to kathekon sou einai mono na metadoseis to menuma me saphe tropo), alla o Allakh kathodegei opoion thelei. Kai o,ti kalo (khremata) xodeuete (o, pistoi, to ophelos tou kai e amoibe tou) einai gia ton eauto sas, kai men xodeuete para mono anazetontas te khare tou Allakh. Kai o,ti xodeuete apo kalo - tha apoplerothei pleros gia sas (kata ten Mellousa Zoe), kai den tha adiketheite.

(E eleemosune) einai gia tous phtokhous, pou tous empodise e apaskholese tous sto Tzikhant sto dromo tou Allakh apo to na taxidepsoun ste ge (anazetontas mesa epibioses apo emporio e douleia). Autos pou den gnorizei ten katastase tous, nomizei oti einai plousioi (del. den ekhoun anagke eleemosunes) logo tes apokhes tous apo to na zetesoun (eleemosune). Tha tous anagnoriseis apo ta semadia tous (sto soma kai ta roukha tous pou deikhnoun ten anagke tous), den zetoun apo tous anthropous epimona. Kai o,ti kalo xodeuete, pragmati o Allakh to gnorizei kala.

Autoi pou xodeuoun apo ten periousia tous (gia khare tou Allakh) mera kai nukhta, krupha kai phanera, tha laboun ten amoibe tous apo ton Kurio tous, kai gi' autous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

Autoi pou trone (sullegoun) ten Ar-Rempa (tous tokous) den tha sekothoun (apo tous taphous tous ten Emera tes Anastases), para opos sekonetai ena atomo pou khtupietai me ten trela apo to Satana. Auto epeide eipan: <<(Ta kerde apo) to emporio einai (epitrepta) san (ta kerde apo) ten Ar-Rempa (lepse tokon).>>, eno o Allakh epitrepei to emporio kai apagoreuei ten Ar-Rempa (logo tes adikias tou na parei kaneis ta khremata ton anthropon adika kai khoris na dosei kati se antallagma). Etsi, opoios elabe mia nouthesia apo ton Kurio tou kai stamatesei (na sullegei tokous), mporei na kratesei o,ti eikhe parei (sto parelthon)* kai e upothese tou einai gia ton Allakh (gia na te dikasei)* ma opoios epistrephei (ste lepse tokon), autoi einai oi katoikoi tou Puros -tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.

O Allakh katastrephei (ta kerde apo) ten Ar-Rempa (lepse tokon, aphairontas tous kathe eulogia kai meionontas ta) kai pollaplasiazei (tis amoibes gia) tis eleemosunes (kai eulogei ta khremata auton pou dinoun eleemosunes). Kai o Allakh den agapa kathe amartolo apisto (pou epimenei sten apistia kai ten amartia tou kathistontas epitrepta auta pou apagorepse o Allakh).

Pragmati, autoi pou pisteuoun, kanoun enaretes praxeis, teloun tis proseukhes kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), tha laboun ten amoibe tous apo ton Kurio tous, kai gi' autous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), kai na paraitetheite ap' o,ti apomenei (khrostoumeno s' esas) apo ten Ar-Rempa (lepse tokon), an eiste pragmatika pistoi.

Alla an den to kanete, tote na eiste bebaioi oti tha labete polemo apo ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, ma an metanoesete, na parete mono to sunolo ton kephalaion sas (apo tous opheiletes khoris ton toko). Oute na adikesete (tous opheiletes me to na parete toko), oute na adiketheite (apo tous opheiletes me to na men sas dosoun to pleres sunolo ton kephalaion sas).

Kai an (o opheiletes) antimetopizei duskolies (kai den mporei na plerosei), tote doste tou khrono mekhri na eukolunthei (gia na apoplerosei), ma an to aphesete (kapoio meros tou daneiou e oloklero) os eleemosune (ston opheilete), auto einai kalutero gia sas, an to gnorizate.

Kai na phulakhtheite (ektelontas tis entoles tou Allakh) apo ten Emera kata ten opoia tha epistrepsete ston Allakh. Epeita kathe atomo tha labei pleros (eite amoibe, eite timoria) analoga me o,ti ekane, kai den tha adikethoun.

O, eseis pou pisteuete, otan kanete mia sunallage metaxu sas me daneio (e agorapolesia me khreos) gia orismeno khroniko diastema, grapste to. Kai as (to) grapsei enas grapheas metaxu sas me dikaiosune. Den prepei kapoios grapheas na arnethei na grapsei, opos ton ekhei didaxei o Allakh (te graphe). As grapsei (o grapheas), kai as upagoreusei o opheiletes (ston graphea ti khrostaei, oste na einai mia anagnorise ap' auton), kai as phobatai (o opheiletes) ton Allakh, ton Kurio tou, kai na men meiosei tipota ap' auto (pou opheilei kata ten upagoreuse tou). Alla an o opheiletes einai khameles noemosunes (den mporei na gnorizei to sosto apo to lathos s' auta pou upagoreuei), e einai adunamos (mikros e trelos), e einai anikanos na upagoreusei (epeide einai boubos klp.), as upagoreusei tote o kedemonas tou me dikaiosune. Kai parte duo (dikaious) martures apo tous andres sas. Kai an den uparkhoun duo andres (diathesimoi), tote (parte) enan andra kai duo gunaikes ap' ekeinous pou dekheste os martures (del. gnorizete oti einai dikaioi), (kai o logos gia na kalesete duo gunaikes einai) oste an mia ap' autes xekhasei, e alle na tes upenthumisei. Kai oi martures den prepei na arnountai (na marturesoun) otan kalountai. Kai men baretheite na to grapsete (to daneio e to khreos), eite einai mikro eite megalo, gia ton kathorismeno khrono tou. Auto (to na katagrapsete to daneio e to khreos) einai pio dikaio enopion tou Allakh kai kathieronei ten marturia pio ortha (upenthumizontas stous martures an xekhasoun e an diaphonesoun metaxu tous) kai einai plesiestero sto na men ekhete amphibolies. Ektos ean prokeitai gia amese sunallage pou pragmatopoieite epi topou metaxu sas (me paron proion kai amese plerome), tote den uparkhei kati to mempto se sas an den ten grapsete. Kai parte martures opote kanete mia sunallage (eite einai mikre e megale, kai eite einai me amese plerome kai paradose e me anabole). Kai den prepei na blaptetai kanenas grapheas oute kanenas marturas (apo tis duo pleures tes sunallages), kai an to kanete (del. tous blaptete), tote ekhete anupakoe mesa sas (pros ten entole tou Allakh). Kai na phulakhteite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou). Kai o Allakh sas didaskei (o,ti einai kala gia sas s' auton ton kosmo kai ste Mellousa Zoe). Kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Kai ean eiste se taxidi kai den mporeite na breite kapoion graphea, tote tha prepei (o daneistes) na parei sten katokhe tou mia egguese. Kai an empisteueste o enas ton allon (kai den pere o daneistes mia egguese), tha prepei o opheiletes na apoplerosei ten opheile tou (ton sumphonemeno khrono), kai as phulakhthei apo ten timoria tou Allakh, ton Kurio tou (kai na men aparnethei to daneio e to khreos tou). Kai (an omos to aparnethei, tote) men apokruptete (o, martures) te marturia, giati opoios ten apokruptei, pragmati, e kardia tou einai amartole. Kai o Allakh einai gia o,ti kanete Pantognostes.

Ston Allakh anekei o,ti brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge. Eite phaneronete o,ti brisketai mesa sas, eite to krubete, o Allakh tha sas kalesei na logodotesete gi' auto, kai ste sunekheia, tha sugkhoresei opoion thelei kai tha timoresei opoion thelei. Kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

O Aggeliaphoros pistepse se o,ti tou ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio tou, kai (to idio kai) oi pistoi. Oloi pistepsan ston Allakh, stous aggelous Tou, sta Biblia Tou kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou. (Lene:) <<Kamia diakrise den kanoume anamesa se kanenan apo tous Aggeliaphorous Tou (del. pisteuoume s' olous tous).>> - kai lene: <<Akousame, kai upakousame. (Anazetoume) te sugkhorese Sou, Kurie mas, kai s' Esena brisketai o telikos proorismos (ton panton).>>

O Allakh den epiballei se kamia psukhe, para osa antekhei. (Kathe psukhe) tha labei (amoibe gia) o,ti kalo ekane, kai tha phortothei me (timoria gia) o,ti kako diepraxe. (Kai o Aggeliaphoros kai oi pistoi eipan:) <<Kurie mas, men mas timoreis an xekhasame (na kanoume kati pou mas dietaxes) e sphallame kata lathos. Kurie mas, men enapotheteis se mas baros (duskoles upokhreoseis pou den tha tis antekhame) opos to enapotheses (os timoria) s' autous prin apo mas (logo tes adikias tous). Kurie mas, men epiballeis se mas kati peran ton dunatoteton mas. Kai dose mas khare (men mas timoreis logo ton amartion mas), sugkhorese mas kai deixe eleos s' emas. Esu eisai o Kedemonas mas, dose mas loipon nike uper ton apiston anthropon.

A, L, M (Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den apoteloun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh prokalei opoiondepote amphiballei gia to Kor'an na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio).
Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos - o Al-Khai (o Aionia Zontanos), o Al-Kaioum (Uposteriktes kai Sunteretes olon).

(Autos einai pou) sou esteile (o, Mokhammant) to Biblio (to Kor'an) me ten aletheia, epibebaionontas o,ti (Theia Biblia) erthan prin ap' auto. Kai esteile ten Tora kai to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou),

(ta esteile) apo prin (to Kor'an), os kathodegese gia tous anthropous. Kai esteile to kriterio (pou diakrinei metaxu tes aletheias kai tes planes). St' aletheia, autoi pou arnethekan ta Edaphia tou Allakh, tha ekhoun epoduno marturio. Kai o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Ikanos gia antapodose.
Pragmati, den uparkhei tipota ste ge, oute ston ourano pou na einai krupho apo ton Allakh.

Autos einai pou sas diamorphonei (arseniko e thuliko, omorphos e okhi) stis metres, opos thelei. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Autos einai pou sou esteile (o, Mokhammant), to Biblio (to Kor'an). Sto opoio uparkhoun Edaphia me xekathares oristikes semasies (sto mualo olon ton anthropon), ta opoia einai ta themelia tou Bibliou (kai apoteloun to megalutero meros tou) - kai uparkhoun kai alla (Edaphia) pou mporoun na ermeneutoun (sto mualo pollon anthropon) me parapano apo mia semasia (kai etsi den ermeneuontai para mono upo to phos ton allon Edaphion pou apoteloun ta themelia tou Bibliou). Oso gi' ekeinous stis kardies ton opoion uparkhei apoklise apo ten aletheia, (aphenoun ta Edaphia pou apoteloun ta themelia tou Bibliou, kai) akolouthoun mono auta (ta Edaphia) pou mporoun na ermeneutoun me parapano apo mia semasia (khoris na ta ermeneusoun upo to phos ton allon Edaphion), anazetontas na egeiroun paranoeseis kai plane anamesa stous anthropous kai anazetontas na ta ermeneusoun (pera apo ten alethine semasia tous kai sumphona me tis paraplanemenes apopseis tous). Kai kaneis den xerei ten (alethine) ermeneia tous, para monon o Allakh. Kai autoi pou einai statheroi ste gnose, lene: <<Pisteuoume s' auto (oloklero to Kor'an). Olo to (Kor'an) einai apo ton Kurio mas.>> Kai den to lambanoun upopse, para mono autoi pou ekhoun mualo (gia na to sullogistoun).

(Kai autoi pou einai statheroi ste gnose, lene:) <<Kurie mas! Men kaneis tis kardies mas na apoklinoun apo ten aletheia, aphou mas kathodegeses. Kai parakhorese se mas eleos apo Esena. St' aletheia, Esu eisai o Al-Ouakhamp (Autos pou kharizei me gennaiodoria khoris kanena antallagma).
Kurie mas! St' aletheia, tha sugkentroseis tous anthropous ten Emera gia ten opoia den uparkhei kamia amphibolia. Pragmati, o Allakh den athetei ten uposkhese Tou.>>
Pragmati, autoi pou arnethekan ten piste - oute ta ploute tous, oute ta paidia tous tha apotrepsoun tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh s' autous. Kai autoi tha einai to kausimo tou Pur tes Kolaseos.

(E upothese auton ton apiston einai) opos e upothese tou laou tou Pharao kai ekeinon pou etan prin ap' autous. Diepseusan ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) Mas, kai etsi, o Allakh tous timorese gia tis amarties tous. Kai o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria.
Pes (o, Mokhammant) stous apistous: <<Tha ettetheite kai tha sugkentrotheite pros ten Kolase, kai ti athlio krebati einai auto (pou ekhei etoimastei gia sas).>>

Uperkhe gia sas ena semadi (kai nouthesia kai mathema) se duo omades (duo stratous) pou sunantethekan (ste makhe tou Mpantr). Mia omada polemouse ston dromo tou Allakh, kai e alle etan apiste. (Oi pistoi) eidan autous (tous apistous) me ta matia tous duo phores ton arithmo tous. Kai o Allakh uposterizei me te nike Tou opoion thelei. Pragmati, s' auto einai ena mathema gia osous ekhoun orase (kai katanoese).

Oraiopoiemene gia tous anthropous einai e agape gia tis epithumies: gia tis gunaikes, gia (na apoktoun) ta paidia, gia tous sorous khrusaphiou kai asemiou, gia ta markarismena omorpha aloga, gia ta booeide kai gia ten kalliergesime ge. Aute einai e apolause tes egkosmias zoes. Ma ston Allakh brisketai e exairetike epistrophe (pros ton Paradeiso gia tous eusebeis).

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Na sas enemeroso gia kati kalutero ap' autes (tis egkosmies epithumies); Gi' osous phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou kai tes apokhes apo tis apagoreuseis Tou) tha uparkhoun me ton Kurio tous kepoi (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai (tha ekhoun ekei) agnes suzugous kai (tha laboun) ten euarestese apo ton Allakh.>> Kai o Allakh blepei tous doulous Tou (gnorizontas o,ti kanoun kai o,ti kratoun mesa tous).
Ekeinoi (oi eusebeis) pou lene: <<Kurie mas, ekhoume pistepsei, opote sugkhorese gia mas tis amarties mas kai prostatepse mas apo to marturio tou Puros.>>

(Oi opoioi) einai oi upomonetikoi, oi eilikrineis (sten piste, ta logia kai tis praxeis), oi upakouoi, ekeinoi pou xodeuoun (ston dromo tou Allakh) kai ekeinoi pou zetoun sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) kata tis teleutaies ores tes nukhtas.

O Allakh martura (meso ton Edaphion kai ton semadion Tou sto sumpan) oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, kai (marturoun to idio) oi aggeloi kai ekeinoi pou ekhoun gnose. Kathieronei te dikaiosune (sta panta). Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

St' aletheia, e mone alethine kai apodekte threskeia gia ton Allakh einai to Islam. Kai autoi (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi) stous opoious dotheke to Biblio [e prototupe Tora pou dotheke ston Mouse, kai to In-tzel pou dotheke ston Iesou] den diaphonesan (ste threskeia tous kai eginan omades kai aireseis) para mono aphou tous elthe e gnose (gia ten aletheia) - apo zeleia metaxu tous. Kai opoios arneitai ta Edaphia tou Allakh, tote st' aletheia o Allakh einai Gregoros sto na (ton) kalesei gia logodotese.

An, loipon, diaphonesoun suzetontas mazi sou (o, Mokhammant, gia ten aletheia pou elthe se sena) pes: <<Ekho upotakhthei ston Allakh (me to Islam) kai (to idio ekanan) osoi me akolouthesan.>> Kai pes s' autous (Ebraious kai Khristianous) stous opoious dotheke to Biblio [e prototupe Tora pou dotheke ston Mouse, kai to In-tzel pou dotheke ston Iesou] kai s' autous pou einai analphabetoi (Arabes eidololatres): <<Tha upotakhtheite (ki eseis ston Allakh me to Islam);>> An upotakhthoun, kathodegethekan (ston isio dromo), ma an straphoun makria, to kathekon sou einai mono na metadoseis to menuma. Kai o Allakh blepei tous doulous Tou.

Pragmati, s' autous pou arnountai ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) tou Allakh kai skotonoun tous prophetes adika kai skotonoun ekeinous apo tous anthropous pou diatazoun te dikaiosune - na tous anaggeileis oti tous perimenei ena odunero marturio.
Ekeinoi einai autoi ton opoion oi praxeis ekhoun katastei mataies sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai gi' autous den tha uparxoun uposteriktes (gia na apotrepsoun ten timoria ap' autous).

Den eides (o, Mokhammant), ekeinous stous opoious dotheke ena meros tou Bibliou (del. e gnose gia ten Tora kai ti periekhei apo apodeixeis gia to erkhomo sou); Proskalountai sto Biblio tou Allakh (ten Tora) gia na krinei metaxu tous* epeita (aphou eidan oti den sumphonei me tis idiotropies tous) mia omada ap' autous apomakrunetai arnoumene.

Aute (e apomakrunse tous apo ten aletheia etan) epeide eipan: <<Den tha mas aggixei to Pur (kata ten Eskhate Emera), para gia liges metremenes meres (kai epeita tha mpoume ston Paradeiso).>> Kai etsi tous paraplanesan ste threskeia tous, auta pou epinoesan apo psemata.

Pos (tha einai e katastase tous) otan tha tous sugkentrosoume gia (apologismo kata) ten Emera gia ten opoia den uparkhei kamia amphibolia, kai kathe atomo tha labei (ten amoibe e ten timoria gia) o,ti ekane; Kai den tha adikethoun.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, Allakh, Idioktete olou tou Basileiou, dineis basileio s' opoion theleis kai aphaireis basileio ap' opoion theleis. Dineis duname (kai time) s' opoion theleis kai tapeinoneis opoion theleis. Sto Kheri Sou brisketai olo to kalo. St' aletheia, eisai gia ta panta Ikanos.

(Kai apo ta semadia tes Dunames Sou einai oti) eisageis te nukhta sten emera, kai eisageis ten emera ste nukhta (del. auxaneis kai meioneis tis ores tous kata to kheimona kai to kalokairi), bgazeis ton zontano apo ton nekro (opos to phuto pou bgainei apo to sporo, kai o pistos gios pou erkhetai apo enan apisto patera), kai bgazeis ton nekro apo ton zontano (opos to augo pou bgainei apo ten kota, kai o apistos gios pou erkhetai apo enan pisto patera), kai parakhoreis agatha s' opoion theleis khoris logariasmo (aperiorista).>>

Den prepei oi pistoi na paroun tous apistous os summakhous (uposteriktes kai kedemones) anti ton piston. Kai opoios to kanei auto, den ekhei kamia sundese me ton Allakh, ektos ean (eiste adunamoi, upo ten kuriarkhia tous kai phoboumenoi na sas skotosoun, tote den uparkhei kati to mempto to na to kanete) gia na apophugete to kako tous mono me te glossa sas (eno e kardia sas gemate me ten piste). Kai o Allakh sas proeidopoiei gia ton Eauto Tou (kai ten timoria Tou), kai ston Allakh brisketai o telikos proorismos.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Eite krubete o,ti brisketai sta stethe sas, eite to phaneronete, o Allakh to gnorizei. Kai gnorizei o,ti brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge.>> Kai pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Ten Emera pou kathe psukhe tha brei o,ti ekhei kanei apo kalo na einai paron (kai ten perimenei e amoibe tou), kai gia o,ti ekhei kanei apo kako, tha epithumouse na uparxei megale apostase metaxu autes (tes psukhes) kai tou kakou (pou diepraxe). Kai o Allakh sas proeidopoiei gia ton Eauto Tou (kai ten timoria Tou), kai o Allakh einai Poluepieikes stous doulous (Tou).

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<An agapate ton Allakh, akoloutheiste me. Etsi, o Allakh tha sas agapesei kai tha sugkhoresei tis amarties sas. Kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro.>> Alla an apomakrunthoun - tote pragmati, o Allakh den agapa tous apistous.

Pragmati, o Allakh epelexe ton Adam (kanontas tous aggelous na ton timesoun), ton Noe (kanontas ton ton proto Aggeliaphoro aphou oi anthropoi tote latreuan eidola), ten oikogeneia tou Impraem (Abraam) (kanontas na elthoun apo tous apogonous tou oloi oi prophetes meta ap' auton, opos o Ismael, o Isaak, o Iakob, o Iesous, o Mokhammant) kai ten oikogeneia tou 'Imran (apo ten opoia elthan e Maria kai o Iesous) pano ap' ole ten anthropoteta (tes epokhes tous).
Apogonoi, o enas proerkhetai apo ton allon. Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

(Anaphere, o, Mokhammant), otan e suzugos tou 'Imran (e Khanna, e kore tou Phakoud, pou etan steira kai epikalesteke ton Allakh gi' auto, emathe oti emeine egkuos) eipe: <<Kurie mou, st' aletheia ekana tama, auto (to moro) pou einai ste metra mou, na einai aphieromeno s' Esena kai apallagmeno (apo ta panta oste na uperetesei mono ton Oiko Sou, kai na Se latreuei), apodexou (to), loipon, apo mena. St' aletheia, Esu eisai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>

Ma otan ten gennese, eipe: <<Kurie mou, gennesa theluko (kai den einai arseniko opos ethela gia na uperetesei ton Oiko Sou).>> - Alla o Allakh xerei kalutera gia to ti gennese (kai tha upsosei auto to theluko se upsele these) -. (Kai sunekhise e suzugos tou 'Imran legontas:) <<Kai to arseniko den einai san to theluko (to arseniko einai pio dunato gia ten uperesia tou Oikou Sou). Kai ten onomasa Mariam (Maria -e metera tou Iesou-), kai anazeto kataphugio gi' auten kai gia tous apogonous tes s' Esena, apo ton katarameno Satana.>>

Etsi, o Kurios tes (Marias) ten apodekhteke me kale apodokhe kai ten ekane na megalosei me kalon tropo kai ten ethese upo te phrontida tou Zakharia (epeide o pateras tes pethane prin gennethei). Kathe phora pou o Zakharias empaine sten kamara opou aute proseukhotan, ebriske ekei agatha. Eipe: <<O, Maria, apo pou ta ekheis auta (ta agatha);>> Eipe (e Maria): <<Einai apo ton Allakh, st'aletheia o Allakh parekhei ephodia s' opoion thelei khoris metrese (aperiorista).>>
Tote, o Zakharias epikalesteke ton Kurio tou, legontas: <<Kurie mou, dose mou apo Sena enan enareto apogono. Pragmati, Esu eisai Autos pou akouei tis epikleseis (ton proseukheton).>>

Etsi, oi aggeloi ton kalesan (ton Zakharia) eno stekotan sten proseukhe sten kamara opou proseukhotan, (legontas): <<Pragmati, o Allakh sou anaggellei ta eukharista nea gia (enan gio), ton Giakhia (ton Ioanne ton Baptiste), o opoios tha epibebaiosei mia lexe apo ton Allakh (del. tha epibebaiosei ten apostole tou Iesou, o opoios -Iesous- demiourgetheke me ten lexe kai ten entole tou Allakh <<Genetheto>>, kai etsi autos egine), kai tha einai (o Ioannes) entimos (anamesa ston lao tou), kai tha apekhei (apo tis epithumies, sumperilambanomenon ton gunaikon, aphieronontas ton eauto tou ste latreia tou Allakh), kai tha einai prophetes, metaxu ton enareton.>>

Eipe (o Zakharias kharoumenos kai ekplektos): <<Kurie mou! Pos tha ekho enan gio eno ekho phtasei se megale elikia kai e gunaika mou einai steira; (e erotese edo den semainei oti amphisbetei alla rotaei gia to pos tha to kanei)>> Eipe: <<Etsi o Allakh kanei o,ti thelei (otan apophasisei kati, aplos leei: <<Genetheto>>, kai etsi ginetai).>>

Eipe: <<Kurie mou! Kane ena semadi gia mena (gia na xero otan sullabei e gunaika mou kai na kharo).>> Eipe: <<To semadi sou einai oti den tha mporeis na mileseis stous anthropous gia treis meres para mono me kheironomies. Kai mnemoneuse polu ton Kurio sou kai na (Ton) doxazeis sto telos tes emeras kai sten arkhe tes.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan oi aggeloi eipan: <<O, Maria! O Allakh se epelexe (logo tes sukhnes latreias sou pros Auton kai tou kalou kharaktera sou), kai se exagnise (apo opoiondepote kako kharaktera), kai se epelexe (upsonontas esena pano) apo oles tis gunaikes tou kosmou (tes epokhes sou).

O, Maria! Na eisai aphosiomene sten upakoe pros ton Kurio sou (me upotage kai eulabeia) kai pese se Soutzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomene) kai na upoklinesai m' ekeinous pou upoklinontai.>>

Auto einai ena meros apo tis eideseis ton aoraton, pou apokaluptoume s' esena (o, Mokhammant). Den esoun mazi tous, otan erikhnan klero me tis xulines penes tous gia to poios tha analabei te phrontida tes Marias* oute esoun mazi tous otan diaphonousan (gia to poios dikaioutai perissotero na phrontisei te Maria, epeide o pateras tes pethane prin gennethei).

(Kai anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan oi aggeloi eipan: <<O, Maria! O Allakh sou anaggellei ta eukharista nea (gia enan gio pou tha demiourgethei khoris kanenan patera, alla) me enan logo ap' Auton (<<Genetheto>> - kai etsi o Iesous egine me ten entole tou Allakh), to onoma tou tha einai o Messias, 'Iesa (Iesous), o uios tes Marias, timemenos s' auton ton kosmo kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai tha einai enas apo ekeinous pou einai polu konta ston Allakh.

Kai tha milesei stous anthropous apo to likno (gia na se uperaspistei otan tha se kategoresoun oti to paidi einai proion moikheias) kai (tha milesei) otan tha einai orimos (otan xekinesei e apostole tou), kai tha einai apo tous enaretous.>>

(E Maria) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Pos tha apokteso ena paidi aphou kaneis andras de me ekhei aggixei;>> (O aggelos) eipe: <<(Men ekplesesai) etsi o Allakh demiourgei o,ti thelei. Otan apophasisei kati, aplos leei: <<Genetheto>>, kai etsi ginetai.>>
Kai (o Allakh) tha ton didaxei (ton Iesou) te graphe, te sophia (ten orthoteta sta logia kai stis praxeis tou), ten Tora kai to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou).

Kai (o Allakh tha steilei ton Iesou os) Aggeliaphoro gia ta paidia tou Israel (kai tha tous pei o Iesous): <<Eltha s' esas me semadia apo ton Kurio sas (ta opoia epibebaionoun ten apostole mou), opos oti skhediazo gia sas apo pelo te morphe enos pouliou kai phuso s' auto, kai ginetai pouli me ten adeia tou Allakh. Kai therapeuo ton ek genetes tuphlo kai ton lepro, kai pherno ton nekro ste zoe me ten adeia tou Allakh. Kai sas plerophoro gia to ti trote kai to ti apothekeuete sta spitia sas. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun semadia gia sas, an eiste pistoi.

Kai (eltha s' esas) epibebaionontas o,ti apokaluphtheke prin apo mena apo ten Tora (ten prototupe Tora pou dotheke ston Mouse), kai gia na kano epitrepto gia sas meros ekeinou pou sas etan apagoreumeno, ki eltha s' esas me semadia apo ton Kurio sas. Etsi, na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou) kai na me upakoute.
St' aletheia, o Allakh einai o Kurios mou kai o Kurios sas. Etsi, na latreuete Auton (khoris na Tou apodidete kanenan etairo ste latreia), autos einai o isios dromos.>>

Ma otan o Iesous antilephteke ten apistia apo merous tous (ton paidion tou Israel, kai oti theloun na ton skotosoun), eipe: <<Poioi tha einai oi uposteriktes mou sto dromo tou Allakh;>> Oi stenoi (tou) mathetes eipan: <<Eimaste oi uposteriktes (tes threskeias) tou Allakh. Pisteuoume ston Allakh kai na martureseis oti eimaste Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Theia Boulese).

Kurie mas! Pisteuoume se o,ti esteiles (to In-tzel -to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou-), kai akolouthoume ton Apostolo (Iesou), gi' auto grapse mas anamesa stous martures (pou marturoun ten aletheia kai oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Esu).>>

Kai (ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste anamesa sta paidia tou Israel sunomotesan kai) skhediasan krupha (na skotosoun ton Iesou), kai etsi, o Allakh skhediase ki Autos (enantion tous, antapodidontas to skhedio tous, aphenontas tous sten plane tous, kai sozontas ton Iesou, bazontas ten omoioteta tou Iesou s' allon anthropo, kai etsi, staurosan ton allon nomizontas oti etan o Iesous). Kai o Allakh einai o Kaluteros ton skhediaston (del. to skhedio Tou einai to pio iskhuro, kai apo dikaiosune kai os antapodose, eno to skhedio ton ekhthron Tou einai apo kakia gia na blaptoun tous enaretous). (To skhedio tou Allakh semainei oti anaballei ten timoria gia tous ekhthrous Tou, oste e timoria na pesei xaphnika s' autous apo ekei pou den ten perimenan).

(Epises kai apo to skhedio tou Allakh enantion tous einai oti) otan o Allakh eipe: <<O, Iesou, pragmati tha se paro (zontano) kai tha se anupsoso pros Emena (me to soma kai te psukhe sou) kai tha se exagniso (apomakruno) ap' autous pou arnethekan ten piste (s' esena os Aggeliaphoro). Kai tha kano autous pou se akolouthoun (sten alethine threskeia, sumperilambanomenes tes pistes ston Mokhammant) anoterous (me to iskhuro epikheirema kai te doxa) ap' autous pou arnethekan ten piste mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, kai epeita s' Emena tha brisketai e epistrophe olon sas, kai tha dikazo metaxu sas s' auta gia ta opoia diaphonousate.

Oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste (s' esena, o, Iesou, os Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh), tha tous timoreso me ena epoduno marturio sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai den tha ekhoun uposteriktes (gia na tous prostatepsoun apo to marturio).
Kai oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun (s' esena, o, Iesou, os Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh) kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, (o Allakh) tha tous dosei pleros ten amoibe tous. Kai o Allakh den agapa tous adikous.>>

Auto pou sou apaggelloume (o, Mokhammant, skhetika me ton Iesou kai ten oikogeneia, tous ekhthrous, kai tous uposteriktes tou) einai apo ta xekathara semadia (kai epikheiremata pou epibebaionoun ten apostole sou, aphou den tha ta exeres para mono me Theia Apokalupse) kai te sophe upenthumise (del. to Kor'an pou diakhorizei meso tes sophias tou, metaxu tes aletheias kai tes planes).

St' aletheia, to paradeigma (tes demiourgias) tou Iesou enopion tou Allakh einai opos ekeino tou Adam. Ton demiourgese apo khoma (khoris patera oute metera), epeita tou eipe: <<Genetheto.>>, kai etsi autos egine.
(Auto pou staltheke s' esena, o, Mokhammant, skhetika me ton Iesou, einai) e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, men eisai, loipon, anamesa s' ekeinous pou amphiballoun (gi' auten).

Etsi, opoios diaphonei suzetontas mazi sou (o, Mokhammant, apo ten omada ton Khristianon tou Natzran pou elthan na se episkephtoun) skhetika m' auton (ton Iesou), meta ap' auto pou ekhei elthei s' esena apo gnose - pes: <<Elate, as kalesoume tous gious mas kai tous gious sas, tis gunaikes mas kai tis gunaikes sas, tous eautous mas kai tous eautous sas, ste sunekheia, na epikalestoume (ton Allakh) gia na pesei e katara tou Allakh stous pseutes (anamesa mas).>>

St' aletheia, auto (pou sou apokalupsa, o, Mokhammant, skhetika me ton Iesou) einai e alethine aphegese. Kai den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh. Kai pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
Kai an apomakrunthoun (ap' auto pou ekhei elthei s' esena apo ten aletheia skhetika me ton Iesou), st' aletheia, o Allakh gnorizei pleros gi' autous pou skorpizoun to kako.

Pes: <<O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi)! Elate na sumphonesoume se enan dikaio logo anamesa mas: na me latreuoume para mono ton Allakh, na men apodidoume etairous s' Ekeinon (ste latreia) ki na me laboume kanenan anamesa mas os Kurio (opos lambanete anthropous os agious upakouontas kai latreuontas tous), ektos apo ton Allakh.>> An omos straphoun makria, tote na peis: <<Na eiste martures, oti emeis eimaste Mousoulmanoi (upotassomaste ste Theia Boulese).>>

O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi), giati diaphoneite gia ton Impraem (Abraam) (iskhurizomenoi oti etan Ebraios e Khristianos) eno e Tora kai to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou) den apokaluphthekan para meta ap' auton; Ma den sullogizeste;

Na eseis - diaphonesate gi' auto gia to opoio ekhete (kapoia) gnose (skhetika me te threskeia sas), giati, loipon, diaphoneite (kai milate) gi' auto (skhetika me te threskeia tou Abraam) gia to opoio den ekhete kamia gnose; Kai o Allakh gnorizei, eno eseis den gnorizete.

O Impraem (Abraam) den etan Ebraios, oute Khristianos. Ma etan Khaneiphan (apekline apo ola ta mataia dogmata, akolouthontas ten alethine piste), kai etan Mousoulmanos (upotagmenos ste Boulese tou Allakh). Kai den etan apo tous eidololatres.

Pragmati, oi pio axioi anthropoi na poun oti anekoun ston Impraem (Abraam) einai ekeinoi pou ton akolouthesan, opos epises kai autos o Prophetes (o Mokhammant) ki ekeinoi pou ekhoun pistepsei (oi Mousoulmanoi). Kai o Allakh einai o Kedemonas (kai o Prostates) ton piston.

Mia omada apo tous anthropous tou Bibliou (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi) eukhetai na sas paraplanesoun (apo ten aletheia sten opoia sas kathodegese o Allakh). Alla den paraplanoun para mono ton eauto tous, kai den to antilambanontai.

O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi), giati arneiste ta Edaphia tou Allakh (pou stalthekan s' esas kai periekhoun apodeixeis gia ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant), eno eiste martures (oti aute einai e aletheia pou anaphertheke sta Biblia sas);

O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi), giati mperdeuete ten aletheia (pou staltheke s' esas apo ton Kurio sas) me to pseudos (pou epinoesate) kai apokruptete ten aletheia eno (te) gnorizete;

Kai mia omada apo tous anthropous tou Bibliou (apo tous rabinous) eipe (o enas ston allon): <<Pistepste s' auto pou apokaluphtheke s' autous pou pisteuoun (Mousoulmanous) sten arkhe tes emeras kai aporripste to sto telos tes (emeras), isos etsi (na eiselthei e amphibolia sten kardia tous kai) na epistrepsoun (sten eidololatria egkataleipontas to Islam).

(Kai sunekhisan legontas), kai men pisteuete kanenan ektos ap' opoion akolouthei te threskeia sas.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, e (alethine) kathodegese einai e kathodegese tou Allakh, (kai okhi aute e diapseuse pou kanete kai e iskhurognomosune sas). (Phoboumenoi) to na dothei se kapoion (eunoia kai gennaiodoria), opos auta pou ekhoun dothei s' esas e to na thetoun (oi Mousoulmanoi) epikheiremata enantion sas enopion tou Kuriou sas (an anagnorizete auto pou apokaluphtheke s' autous).>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, ole e gennaiodoria brisketai sto Kheri tou Allakh - ten parakhorei s' opoion thelei.>> Kai pragmati, o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gia olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Epilegei gia to eleos Tou opoion thelei. Kai o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales gennaiodorias.

Kai anamesa sto lao tou Bibliou (apo tous Ebraious) einai autos pou, an tou empisteuteis ena megalo poso ploutou, tha to epistrepsei s' esena. Kai anamesa tous einai autos pou, ean tou empisteuteis ena denario, den tha sou to epistrepsei ektos na parameineis sunekhos pano tou apaitontas to. Auto epeide lene: <<Den uparkhei kamia amartia s' emas skhetika me tous analphabetous (Arabes, aphou o Allakh mas epetrepse na katapioume ta khremata opoion den akolouthoun te threskeia mas).>> Kai lene gia ton Allakh psemata (apodidontas s' Auton logia pou den ta eipe), eno gnorizoun (oti pseudontai).

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou iskhuristekan), alla st' aletheia, opoios ekpleronei te desmeuse tou (pros ton Allakh pisteuontas s' Auton kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou, kai pros tous anthropous epistrephontas s' autous o,ti tou ekhoun empisteuthei) kai phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou) - tote pragmati, o Allakh agapa tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Pragmati, autoi pou antallassoun te desmeuse pou tous anethese o Allakh (sta Biblia Tou) kai tous orkous tous (na teroun aute te desmeuse) me ena mikro timema, den tha ekhoun kanena meridio (apo amoibe) ste Mellousa Zoe, kai o Allakh ten Emera tes Anastases den tha tous milesei (me kati pou na tous eukharistei), oute tha tous koitaxei (me eleos), oute tha tous exagnisei (apo tis amarties kai ten apistia tous), kai tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

Kai pragmati, anamesa tous (ton Ebraion) brisketai mia omada pou diastreblonoun to Biblio (ten Tora) me tis glosses tous (apaggellontas logia pou den einai apo ten Tora), oste na nomizete oti einai apo to Biblio, ma den einai apo to Biblio. Kai lene: <<Auto einai apo ton Allakh.>> Ma den einai apo ton Allakh. Kai lene gia ton Allakh psemata eno gnorizoun (oti lene psemata).

Den einai dunaton gia kanenan anthropo (prophete) ston opoio o Allakh ekhei dosei to Biblio kai te gnose ton nomon (tes threskeias), kai ton ekhei kanei prophete, epeita na leei stous anthropous: <<Ginete latreis gia mena anti gia ton Allakh.>> Antithetos (tha pei): <<Na eiste sophoi logioi (pou didaskoun te threskeia stous allous anthropous), logo tou oti didaskete to Biblio, kai o,ti meletate (apo to Biblio).>>
Oute tha sas dietaze (kanenas prophetes) na parete tous aggelous kai tous prophetes os kurious (theous). Tha sas dietaze ten apistia aphou ginate Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Boulese tou Allakh);

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant), otan o Allakh pere te desmeuse apo (olous) tous Prophetes (legontas): <<Gia o,ti sas edosa apo to Biblio kai te sophia (katanoese ton nomon tes threskeias) kai epeita elthei s' esas enas Aggeliaphoros pou tha epibebaiosei o,ti einai mazi sas (apo to Biblio), tote tha prepei na pistepsete s' auton kai na ton uposterixete.>> Eipe (epises o Allakh): <<To anagnorizete kai analambanete skhetika m' auto ten iskhure desmeuse Mou (pou anethesa se sas);>> Eipan: <<To anagnorizoume.>> Eipe (o Allakh): <<Tote martureste (ston eauto sas kai sta ethne sas), kai Ego epises eimai mazi sas apo tous martures (s' esas kai sta ethne sas).>>

Opoios meta ap' auto (te desmeuse pou anethese o Allakh stous prophetes) apomakrunthei (apo to kalesma tou Islam aphou ekhei elthei o Prophetes Mokhammant), tote ekeinoi einai oi anupakouoi (pou apomakrunontai apo te threskeia tou Allakh).

Epizetoun (ekeinoi oi anupakouoi), mia alle threskeia ektos tes threskeias tou Allakh (to Islam), eno s' Auton ekhei upotakhthei o,ti brisketai ston ourano kai ste ge, eite prothuma, eite aprothuma; Kai s' Auton tha epistrepsoun oloi.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pisteuoume ston Allakh kai se o,ti staltheke s' emas (apo Theia apokalupse), kai se o,ti staltheke ston Impraem (Abraam), ston Ismael, ston Isaak, ston Iakobo kai stous Al-Asmpat (tous prophetes apo tous apogonous tou Iakobou), kai se o,ti dotheke ston Mouse, ston Iesou kai stous Prophetes apo ton Kurio tous. Kamia diakrise den kanoume se kanenan ap' autous (del. pisteuoume s' olous tous) kai s' Auton (ston Allakh) eimaste Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Boulese Tou).>>
Kai opoios epizeta, ektos tou Islam, alle threskeia, pote touto den tha ginei apodekto ap' auton (ston Allakh), kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha einai anamesa stous ettemenous.

Pos tha kathodegouse o Allakh mia omada anthropon pou aperripsan ten piste aphou eikhan pistepsei, eikhan marturesei oti o Aggeliaphoros erthe me ten aletheia kai eikhan elthei s' autous oi xekathares apodeixeis; Kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous.
Ekeinoi tha ekhoun os antamoibe oti pano tous tha pesei e katara tou Allakh, ton aggelon kai olon ton anthropon.
Tha parameinoun s' auten (ten Kolase) gia panta. To marturio den tha elaphrunthei gi' autous, oute tha tous dothei anabole (ten Emera tes Kriseos oste na dikaiologethoun).

Ektos ap' ekeinous pou straphekan me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) meta ap' auto (ten apistia kai ten adikia tous) kai diorthosan (tis praxeis tous kanontas kales praxeis). Tote pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

St' aletheia, autoi pou aperripsan ten piste aphou eikhan pistepsei, ki epeita auxanane ten apistia tous (mekhri te stigme tou thanatou tous), pote e metameleia tous (kata te stigme tou thanatou tous) den tha ginei apodekte. Kai autoi einai oi parastratemenoi.

St' aletheia, autoi pou aperripsan ten piste, kai pethanan os apistoi, den tha ginei apodekto apo kanenan ap' autous oute to poso khrusou pou mporei na gemisei te ge, akoma ki an to prosephere gia antallagma oste na men timorethei. Gi' autous uparkhei ena epoduno marturio kai den tha ekhoun uposteriktes (pou na apotrepsoun ten timoria ap' autous).

Pote den tha epitukhete ten eusebeia (del. te these tes kai ten antamoibe tes pou einai o Paradeisos) mekhri na xodepsete (se eleemosune kai sto dromo tou Allakh) ap' auto pou agapate (apo ta ploute sas). Kai o,ti xodeuete (eite ligo eite polu) - pragmati, o Allakh to gnorizei.

Ola ta trophima etan epitrepta gia ta paidia tou Israel ektos apo o,ti apagorepse o Israel (Iakob) gia ton eauto tou (opos gala kai kreas kamelas logo tes iskhialgias pou eikhe) prin stalei e Tora. Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pherte ten Tora kai apaggeilte ten, an eiste eilikrineis.>> [ston iskhurismo sas oti o Abraam den etroge kreas kamelas kai oti panta etan apagoreumeno, kai katakrinete ton Prophete Mokhammant oti troei kreas kamelas eno leei oti akolouthei te threskeia tou Abraam. Pherte, loipon, ten Tora gia na deite oti pseudeste kai oti aute e apagoreuse etan apo ton Iakob gia ton eauto tou, polu kairo meta apo ton Abraam, kai gia na deite oti apagoreutekan gia sas sten Tora kala trophima logo tes adikias sas].
Opoios epinoesei psemata enantion tou Allakh meta ap' auto (aphou emphanisteke e aletheia) - ekeinoi einai oi adikoi.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O Allakh eipe ten aletheia. Akoloutheste loipon te threskeia tou Impraem (Abraam, o opoios etan) Khaneiphan (apekline apo ola ta mataia dogmata, akolouthontas ten alethine piste), kai den etan apo tous polutheistes.>>
Pragmati, o protos Oikos (latreias tou Allakh) pou ktisteke gia tous anthropous etan o Ieros Oikos sten Mpakka (del. Makka e Mekka), eulogemenos kai os kathodegese gia olon ton kosmo.

S' auton (ton Iero Oiko) uparkhoun emphane semadia, (opos) to Makam tou Impraem (Abraam) (ten petra sten opoia statheke o Abraam otan ekhtize ten Ka'mpa). Opoios mpainei s' auton (ton Oiko) tha einai asphales. Kai pros ton Allakh opheiletai na teloun oi anthropoi Khatz (proskunema) ston Iero Oiko (ste Makka), gi' opoion ekhei te dunatoteta na to telesei. Kai opoios arneitai ten piste (arneitai ten upokhreose tou Khatz), tote pragmati, o Allakh den ekhei anagke kanena apo ta plasmata Tou.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi), giati aporriptete ta semadia (kai ta Edaphia) tou Allakh (sten Tora kai to In-tzel pou epibebaionoun ten apostole mou); Kai o Allakh einai marturas se ola osa kanete.>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi), giati apotrepete apo to threskeia tou Allakh opoion pisteuei (s' Auton) - thelontas na kanete aute (te threskeia tou Allakh kai opoion pisteuei) na parekklinei (apo ten aletheia), eno eiste martures (oti einai e aletheia); Kai o Allakh den agnoei o,ti kanete.>>
O, eseis pou pisteuete, ean upakousete se mia omada ap' autous stous opoious dotheke to Biblio (Ebraious kai Khristianous), tha sas gurisoun piso os apistous meta ten piste sas.

Kai pos tha arnetheite ten piste eno apaggellontai s' esas ta Edaphia tou Allakh kai anamesa sas brisketai o Aggeliaphoros Tou; Kai opoios katapheugei ston Allakh (kai proskollatai ste threskeia Tou kai Ton upakouei), ekhei kathodegethei ston isio dromo.
O, eseis pou pisteuete, na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou) opos Tou prepei, kai men pethanete para mono os Mousoulmanoi.

Kai kratetheite oloi mazi gera sto skhoini tou Allakh (to Biblio Tou kai te Sounna -paradose- tou Prophete) kai men diairetheite. Kai na thumetheite ten eunoia tou Allakh s' esas otan esastan ekhthroi (metaxu sas, prin to Islam) kai sumphiliose tis kardies sas, kai etsi, ginate aderphia me te khare Tou. Kai esastan (apistoi) sto kheilos enos lakkou apo te Photia (tes Kolaseos) kai sas esose ap' auto (me to Islam). Etsi o Allakh sas dieukrinizei ta Edaphia Tou, mepos kai kathodegetheite.
Kai as uparkhei apo esas mia omada pou kalei (tous allous) sto kalo, diatazei kathe kale praxe kai apagoreuei kathe apagoreumene praxe, kai autoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

Men eiste san ekeinous pou diairethekan (se omades kai aireseis) kai diaphonesan metaxu tous (ste threskeia tous) aphou tous eikhan elthei oi sapheis apodeixeis. Kai ekeinoi tha ekhoun ena epoduno marturio.

(Auto to epoduno marturio tha to ekhoun), ten Emera opou kapoia prosopa tha ginoun photeina, eno alla prosopa tha skoteiniasoun. Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion ta prosopa tha skoteiniasoun, (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Arnethekate ten piste aphou esastan pistoi; Geuteite to marturio gia o,ti arnethekate apo ten piste.>>
Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion ta prosopa tha einai photeina, tha einai sto eleos tou Allakh (kai ton Paradeiso Tou), tha parameinoun ekei gia panta.

Auta einai ta Edaphia tou Allakh, ta apaggelloume s' esena (o, Mokhammant) me ten aletheia. Kai o Allakh den thelei adikia gia (kanenan s') auton ton kosmo (kai den timorei para osous axizoun logo ton amartion tous).
Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste ge, kai ston Allakh tha epistrepsoun oles oi upotheseis.

Eiste to kalutero ethnos pou anadeikhtheke gia ten anthropoteta (sten piste kai stis praxeis sas, kai oi pio ophelimoi gia tous anthropous): diatazete to kalo kai apagoreuete to kako, kai pisteuete ston Allakh. Kai an oi anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) eikhan pistepsei, tha etan kalutera gi' autous. Merikoi ap' autous einai pistoi, alla oi perissoteroi einai anupakouoi (ston Allakh).
Den mporoun na sas blapsoun ektos apo enokhlese (me ta logia tous). Kai an sas polemesoun, tha sas gurisoun tis plates (tous ettemenoi), kai epeita den tha boethethoun.

Kai kaluphthekan me tapeinose opou ki an briskontan, ektos (an prostateuontan) apo mia diatheke apo ton Allakh e mia suntheke apo tous anthropous. Kai epestrepsan me ten orge tou Allakh kai kaluphthekan me dustukhia. Auto epeide arniontousan ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) tou Allakh kai skotonan tous Prophetes adika. Auto egine giati parakousan kai parabiasan ta oria (diaprattontas amarties kai egklemata).

Ostoso, den einai (oloi) idioi: uparkhei apo ton lao tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) mia omada stathere (ste threskeia tou Allakh prin ton erkhomo tou Prophete Mokhammant, kai otan erthe pistepsan s' auton), apaggelloun ta Edaphia tou Allakh (to Kor'an) tis ores tes nukhtas (kata tis proseukhes tous) kai pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomenoi).
Pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, kai diatazoun to kalo kai apagoreuoun to kako, kai speudoun na kanoun kales praxeis. Ekeinoi einai apo tous enaretous.
Kai o,ti kanoun apo kalo, den tha khasoun ten amoibe tou. Kai o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste, oute ta ploute tous, oute ta paidia tous tha apotrepsoun tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh gi' autous. Ekeinoi einai oi katoikoi tes Photias, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta.

To paradeigma oson (khrematon) xodeuoun (se philanthropia) s' aute ten egkosmia zoe (gia ten opoia perimenoun amoibe), einai san ekeino enos anemou pou periekhei pageto kai khtupa te sodeia enos laou pou adikese ton eauto tou (meso amartion), kai etsi ten katestrepse (kai etsi einai e apistia tous, katastrephei tis kales tous praxeis). Kai o Allakh den tous adikese, alla autoi adikoun ton eauto tous.

O, eseis pou pisteuete, men pairnete gia stenous philous, allous ektos ap' autous anamesa sas (pistous) (me to na tous lete ta mustika sas kai ta prosopika sas). Den pheidontai prospatheion gia na khalane ten katastase sas, kai epithumoun gia sas o,ti (sas blaptei kai) sas duskoleuei. To misos ekhei emphanistei apo ta stomata tous, alla auto pou kruboun ta stethe tous einai akome megalutero. Sas dieukrinisame ta Edaphia, an antilambaneste.

Na eseis eiste (o, pistoi), pou tous agapate (kai agapate to kalo tous) eno autoi den sas agapoun (oute agapoun to kalo sas), parolo pou pisteuete se ola ta (Theia) Biblia. Otan sas sunantoun, lene: <<Pisteuoume.>>, alla otan einai monoi, dagkonoun ta dakhtula tous apo orge pros esas (kai logo tes enotetas sas). Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<As pethanete sten orge sas.>> Pragmati, o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti uparkhei sta stethe.

An sas sumbei kati kalo, auto tous stenakhorei, kai an sas khtupesei kati kako, khairontai gi' auto. Alla an kanete upomone kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou), ta skhedia tous den tha sas blapsoun se tipota. Pragmati, o Allakh periballei ola osa kanoun.

Kai (thumesou, o, Mokhammant) otan bgekes noris to proi (apo to spiti sou ste Mantina) aphenontas ten oikogeneia sou gia na baleis tous pistous stis theseis makhes (tous, gia na polemesete tous eidololatres kata te makhe tou Oukhount). Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Otan duo omades apo sas (oi Mpanou Salima kai oi Mpanou Kharitha kata te makhe tou Oukhount) konteuan na khasoun to tharros tous (kai na men polemesoun kai na epistrepsoun aphou eidan ton upokrite, ton Ampnt Allakh mpin Oumpai na epistrephei mazi me pollous apo tous suntrophous tou), tote o Allakh etan o uposteriktes tous (pou tous uposterixe kai etsi den ephugan meta ap' auton). Kai ton Allakh as empisteuontai oi pistoi.

Kai pragmati, o Allakh sas uposterixe kharizontas sas ten nike ste (makhe tou) Mpantr eno esastan adunamoi (kai ligoi kai me liga opla). Na phulakhtheite loipon apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), isos etsi na eiste eugnomones (gia tis khares Tou s' esas).

Kai (thumesou, o, Mokhammant) otan eipes stous pistous (kata te makhe tou Mpantr aphou akousan oti erkhontai kai alloi uposteriktes ton eidololatron): <<Den tha sas arkei na sas uposterixei o Kurios sas stelnontas kato treis khiliades aggelous;>>

<<Sigoura (tha sas arkei, kai) an kanete upomone (ste makhe -tou Mpantr-) kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), kai (oi ekhthroi sas) erthoun me orme s' esas, tote o Kurios sas tha sas uposterixei me pente khiliades aggelous pou ekhoun semadia (diakrises).>>

O Allakh den ephtiaxe aute (ten uposterixe me tous aggelous kata te makhe tou Mpantr) para os kharmosuna nea gia sas kai gia na kathesukhasoun oi kardies sas m' aute. Kai pragmati, e nike den proerkhetai para mono apo ton Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), ton Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

(Aute e nike pou sas kharise o Allakh kata te makhe tou Mpantr, etan) gia na apokopsei ena meros ton apiston (me to na skotothoun) e na tous tapeinosei (tous upoloipous pou den skotothekan ste makhe), oste na epistrepsoun entelos apogoeteumenoi (me ten etta kai ten tapeinose tous).

Den einai dike sou e apophase (o, Mokhammant, skhetika me tous apistous pou se polemesan ste makhe tou Oukhount kai ekanes epikleseis enantion tous meta apo o,ti ekanan ste makhe). (Alla e apophase einai tou Allakh kai mono) an tha dekhtei te metameleia tous (an tha eiselthoun sto Islam) e tha tous timoresei (an parameinoun sten apistia tous). Pragmati, einai adikoi (pou axizoun ten timoria).

Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste ge. Sugkhorei opoion thelei kai timorei opoion thelei, kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete, men katabrokhthizete ten Ar-Rempa (tokogluphia), (oute) diple kai (oute) pollaplasiasmene. Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou), isos kai na petukhete.
Kai na phulakhteite apo te Photia (meso tes upakoes ton entolon tou Allakh), e opoia (Photia) einai proetoimasmene gia tous apistous.
Kai na upakoute ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro, mepos kai na eleetheite.

Kai speusate pros te sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas kai pros enan Paradeiso pou einai toso platus oso oi ouranoi kai e ge, proetoimasmenos gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Oi opoioi (eusebeis) einai autoi pou xodeuoun (sto dromo tou Allakh) sten euemeria kai stis antixootetes, katapiezoun ten orge kai sugkhoroun tous anthropous* st' aletheia, o Allakh agapa autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Kai oi opoioi (eusebeis) an diapraxoun aiskhre amartia e adikesoun ton eauto tous (meso amartion), mnemoneuoun ton Allakh kai zetoun sugkhorese gia tis amarties tous - kai poios mporei na sugkhoresei tis amarties ektos apo ton Allakh; Kai (oi opoioi eusebeis) den epimenoun se o,ti (amartia) ekanan, eno gnorizoun.

E amoibe auton (ton eusebon) einai e sugkhorese apo ton Kurio tous kai kepoi (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Tha katoikesoun ekei mesa (ston Paradeiso) gia panta, kai pragmati, exairetike einai e amoibe auton pou prattoun (tis enaretes praxeis).

(Otan oi Mousoulmanoi ekhasan kata te makhe tou Oukhount, epeide oi toxotes nomizan oti nikesan kai katebekan apo to bouno gia na paroun ta laphura parakouontas ten entole tou prophete, o Allakh eipe gia na paregoresei tous Mousoulmanous:) Pragmati, eikhan perasei prin apo sas Sounnan (oi nomoi tou Allakh stous apistous ton proegoumenon ethnon, opou edine anabole sten timoria tous kai epeita tous arpaze me ten timoria Tou apo ekei pou den to perimenan). Perpateste loipon ste ge kai koitaxte pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou diepseudan.
Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia xekathare delose gia ten anthropoteta, kai kathodegese kai nouthesia gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).
Kai men apodunamoneste (o, pistoi) kai men lupaste (epeide khasate kata te makhe tou Oukhount), eno eiste oi anoteroi, an eiste pragmatika pistoi.

Ean sumboun s' esas pleges (kai thanatos ten Emera tou Oukhount), pragmati ekhoun sumbei kai stous allous (stous apistous) paromoies pleges (kai thanatos). Kai enallassoume ekeines tis meres (me nike kai etta) anamesa stous anthropous. Kai gia na xerei o Allakh (-auto pou ede xerei-, del. na emphanistei s' esas kai na diakhorisei o Allakh me aute ten etta) ekeinous pou pisteuoun, kai gia na parei martures (pou skotothekan) apo esas (gia na tous timesei me aute te these ston Paradeiso), kai o Allakh den agapaei tous adikous.
Kai gia na dokimasei o Allakh ekeinous pou pisteuoun (kai na tous exagnesei apo tis amarties tous) kai na katastrepsei tous apistous.

E mepos nomizete oti tha eiselthete ston Paradeiso khoris o Allakh na xerei (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei s' esas kai na dei o Allakh) autous apo esas pou agonistekan (ston dromo Tou) kai autous pou paremeinan upomonetikoi;

Kai pragmati, eukhosastan ton thanato (del. na sunantesete tous apistous kai na ginete martures sto dromo tou Allakh) prin na ton sunantesete (del. tis aities tou), kai (idou eseis) ton ekhete dei eno koitousate.

O Mokhammant den einai para enas Aggeliaphoros, kai (polloi) Aggeliaphoroi ekhoun stalthei kai pethanei prin ap' auton. An omos pethanei e skotothei (opos diadotheke pseudos apo tous ekhthrous tou kata te makhe tou Oukhount), tha strapheite piso (os apistoi); Kai ekeinos pou tha straphei piso de tha blapsei se tipota ton Allakh* kai o Allakh tha antameipsei tous eugnomones.

Kamia psukhe den pethainei para mono me ten adeia tou Allakh, se mia prodiagegrammene stigme. Opoios anazeta (meso ton praxeon tou) ten antamoibe autou tou kosmou, tha tou dosoume apo aute (osa tou ekhoume proorisei kai den tha parei antamoibe kata te Mellousa Zoe), kai opoios anazeta (meso ton praxeon tou) ten antamoibe tes Mellousas Zoes, tha tou te dosoume. Kai tha antameipsoume tous eugnomones.

Kai posoi prophetes, pou o kathenas tous eikhe polles omades (apo tous opadous tou) pou polemesan mazi tou, oi opoioi den deiliasan (apo to Tzikhant) exaitias autou pou tous sunebe ston dromo tou Allakh (apo phono kai pleges) oute apodunamothekan (apo to polemo me ton ekhthro) oute upotakhthekan (ston ekhthro tous), kai o Allakh agapa tous upomonetikous.

Ta logia tous den etan para oti eipan: <<Kurie mas, sugkhorese gia mas tis amarties mas kai ten uperbase mas stis upotheseis mas, kai statheropoiese ta podia mas (otan sunantame tous ekhthrous) kai dose mas nike enantia stous apistous anthropous.>>
Etsi, o Allakh tous edose ten antamoibe autou tou kosmou kai ten kalutere antamoibe tes Mellousas Zoes, kai o Allakh agapa autous pou prattoun to kalo.
O, eseis pou pisteuete, ean upakousete autous pou arnethekan ten piste, tha sas gurisoun piso (os apistous aphou eiste pistoi) kai etsi tha epistrepsete os khamenoi.
(Okhi, den tha sas uposterizoun an tous upakoute) alla pragmati, o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes sas (enantion ton ekhthron sas), kai einai o Kaluteros ton uposterikton.

Tha rixoume tromo stis kardies ton apiston (pou sas polemoun) gia o,ti apedidan ston Allakh apo etairous ste latreia, gia tous opoious (pseutikous etairous) den esteile (o Allakh stous apistous) kamia apodeixe (oute exousia). Kai e katoikia tous tha einai e Photia kai poso athlia einai e katoikia ton adikon.
