Pragmati, o Allakh ekplerose ten uposkhese Tou pros esas otan tous skotonate me ten adeia Tou (kata te makhe tou Oukhount), mekhri pou khasate to tharros sas kai diaphonesate metaxu sas gia ten entole (tou Prophete, oti tha prepei na meinoun oi toxotes stis theseis tous sto bouno o,ti ki an ginei) kai parakousate (ten entole gia na parete ta laphura nomizontas oti o polemos teleiose me te nike sas) aphou sas edeixe (o Allakh) auto pou sas arese (apo nike). Anamesa sas uparkhoun kapoioi pou anazetoun auton ton kosmo kai kapoioi pou anazetoun te Mellousa Zoe. Epeita sas apestrepse ap' autous (me etta) gia na sas dokimasei. Kai pragmati, sas sugkhorese (o Allakh), kai o Allakh ekhei polles khares stous pistous.

(Thumetheite, o pistoi) otan drapeteusate (apo tous ekhthrous sas kata te makhe tou Oukhount) kai den koitousate aristera kai dexia se kanenan, eno o Aggeliaphoros (stekotan stathera metaxu ton apiston kai esas kai) sas kalouse apo piso sas (legontas: <<Elate s' emena, o, douloi tou Allakh.>>). Etsi, (o Allakh) sas antameipse me thlipse (gia o,ti khasate apo nike kai laphura), e opoia akolouthetheke apo alle thlipse (otan oi apistoi diedosan pseudos metaxu sas oti o Prophetes skototheke), (kai o Allakh sas ekane aute te deutere thlipse) oste na (xekhasete ten prote kai na) me stenakhorieste gia osa khasate (apo nike kai laphura) e gia osa sas sunebesan (apo pleges kai thanato), (del. otan mathate oti o Prophetes den skototheke, kharekate kai etsi egine e prote thlipse polu asemante). Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete einai Pantognostes.

Epeita, meta apo te thlipse, esteile s' esas asphaleia (kai eremia): (e opoia etan) upnos pou kalupse mia omada apo esas (pou pisteuan me bebaioteta sten uposkhese tou Allakh, kai etsi oi kardies tous kathesukhastekan kai koimethekan). Eno alle omada (upokriton anamesa sas) anesukhouse mono gia ton eauto tous (adiaphorontas gia to ti sunebe ston Prophete kai tous suntrophous tou, kai phoboumenoi oti oi apistoi tha xanakanoun eisbole enantion tous ste Mantina). Nomizan gia ton Allakh kati allo ektos apo ten aletheia (del. nomizan oti o Allakh den tha uposterize ton Prophete Tou kai oti aute e makhe einai to telos tou Islam), (opos) e skepse (ton anthropon) tes agnoias (ten pro-Islamike epokhe). Lene: <<Eikhame epiloge gia to thema (to na bgoume gia te makhe e okhi); (Kai an eikhame den tha bgainame!).>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, oles oi upotheseis anekoun mono ston Allakh.>> Kruboun mesa tous auto pou den sou apokaluptoun. Lene: <<An eikhame epiloge gia to thema, kaneis mas den tha eikhe skotothei edo.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Akoma ki an esastan sta spitia sas, osoi anamesa sas etan prokathorismeno gi' autous na skotothoun, tha eikhan bgei sta mere phonou tous.>> Kai (o Allakh den orise auto pou egine ste makhe tou Oukhount para) gia na dokimasei auto pou brisketai sta stethe sas (apo protheseis kai skopous) kai na diakhorisei auto pou ekhete stis kardies sas (apo piste e upokrisia). Kai o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti uparkhei sta stethe (ton doulon Tou).

Osoi apo esas trapekan se phuge ten emera pou sunantethekan oi duo stratoi (sto Oukhount), etan o Satanas pou tous ekane na glistresoun s' aute ten amartia, logo kapoion amartion tous, alla o Allakh tous sugkhorese. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete, men ginete san ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste kai eipan gia tous suggeneis tous pou taxidepsan ste ge (gia kapoia douleia) e summeteikhan se kapoia makhe (kai pethanan e skotothekan): <<An eikhan meinei mazi mas, den tha eikhan pethanei e skotothei!>> O Allakh ekane auta (ta logia pou eipan) na einai thlipse stis kardies tous. Kai o Allakh einai Autos pou dinei zoe kai ten aphairei, kai o Allakh blepei o,ti kanete.
Ean skototheite ston dromo tou Allakh e pethanete, tote e sugkhorese kai to eleos apo ton Allakh einai makran kalutera apo osa mazeuoun (apo egkosmio plouto).
Ean pethanete e skototheite, tote tha sugkentrotheite ston Allakh.

Kai me to Eleos tou Allakh (o, Mokhammant) egines epieikes apenanti tous. Kai an esoun austeros sto logo kai sklerokardos, tha epheugan apo guro sou* etsi, sugkhorese tous, kai zeta (apo ton Allakh) sugkhorese gi' autous. Kai zeta te gnome tous gia tis upotheseis. Etsi, otan pairneis mia apophase, enapothese ten empistosune sou ston Allakh. St' aletheia o Allakh agapa autous pou enapothetoun ten empistosune tous s' Auton.

Ean sas uposterizei o Allakh, kaneis den mporei na sas nikesei. Kai an sas egkataleipsei, poios meta ap' Auton, tha mporouse na sas uposterixei; Kai ston Allakh as enapothetoun oi pistoi ten empistosune tous.

Kanenas prophetes den mporei na prodosei sta laphura (me to na parei ap' auta prin na ekhei oristei to meridio kathenos sto strato e na parei parapano apo to meridio tou), kai opoios prodidei sta laphura, tha pherei auto pou pere ten Emera tes Kriseos, kai epeita, kathe psukhe tha labei (ten amoibe e ten timoria) gia o,ti ekane. Kai den tha adikethoun.

Einai autos pou anazeta ten eukharistese tou Allakh, san ekeinon pou epistrephei me ten orge tou Allakh; E katoikia tou opoiou (tou teleutaiou) tha einai e Kolase, kai ti tromeros proorismos einai autos;
Einai se diaphoretikes taxeis enopion tou Allakh, kai o Allakh blepei ola osa kanoun.

Pragmati, o Allakh enapothese te khare Tou stous pistous otan esteile anamesa tous enan Aggeliaphoro apo tous idious, o opoios (Aggeliaphoros) tous apaggellei ta Edaphia Tou, tous exagnizei kai tous didaskei to Biblio kai te Sophia (Sounna -ten paradose tou Prophete-), an kai prin, autoi etan se phanere plane.

Ma otan sas eplexe mia katastrophe (o pistoi, otan ettethekate ste makhe tou Oukhount), parolo pou eikhate khtupesei (tous ekhthrous sas kata te makhe tou Mpantr) to diplasio, eipate: <<Pos egine auto (eno eimaste pistoi kai anamesa mas brisketai o Aggeliaphoros);>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Auto einai apo ton eauto sas (otan parakousan oi toxotes ten entole tou Prophete aphenontas tis theseis tous ste makhe gia na paroun ta laphura).>> Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Auto pou sas sunebe ten emera (tes makhes tou Oukhount) opou sunantethekan oi duo stratoi, etan me ten adeia tou Allakh, gia na xerei (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakhorisei) tous (pragmatikous) pistous.

Kai gia na xerei (o Allakh -auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakhorisei) tous upokrites. Eipotheke s' autous: <<Elate na polemesete sto dromo tou Allakh e toulakhiston boetheste mas auxanontas ton arithmo mas.>> Eipan: <<An xeroume oti tha uparxei makhe, sigoura tha sas akolouthesoume (alla den nomizoume oti tha uparxei).>> Ekeine ten emera autoi etan pio konta sten apistia para ten piste, lene me to stoma tous auto pou den uparkhei sten kardia tous. Kai o Allakh gnorizei kalutera o,ti kruboun (sta stethe tous).

Einai ekeinoi pou eipan gia ta aderphia tous (pou skotothekan kata te makhe tou Oukhount) eno oi idioi kathontan (kai den pegan ste makhe): <<An mas eikhan upakousei, den tha eikhan skotothei.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Apotrepste, loipon, ton thanato apo ton eauto sas, an eiste eilikrineis!>>
Me nomizete oti autoi pou skotothekan sto dromo tou Allakh einai nekroi. Okhi (den einai nekroi), alla einai zontanoi me ton Kurio tous apolambanoun o,ti tous parekhetai.

Kharoumenoi me o,ti tous ekhei kharisei o Allakh apo te gennaiodoria Tou kai anamenoun kharmosuna nea gia osous den tous akolouthesan akoma meta ap' autous (oste na laboun kai autoi ten idia gennaiodoria apo ton Allakh). Pragmati, gi' autous den uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Khairontai me te khare kai te gennaiodoria apo ton Allakh, kai oti o Allakh den aphenei ten antamoibe ton piston na khathei.

Ekeinoi pou antapokrithekan sten entole tou Allakh kai tou Aggeliaphorou (sto na bgoun gia te makhe tes Khamra' Al-Asant) aphou eikhan sunebe pleges (kata te makhe tou Oukhount): Gi' osous ap' autous epraxan to kalo kai phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou) tha uparkhei mia terastia antamoibe.

Ekeinoi stous opoious oi anthropoi (merikoi apo tous polutheistes) eipan: <<Oi anthropoi (oi Kourais upo ten egesia tou Ampou Souphian) mazeutekan (se megala plethe) enantion sas, gi' auto na tous phobaste.>> (Alla auto) tous auxese ten piste kai eipan: <<Mas arkei o Allakh, kai einai o Kaluteros Diakheiristes (olon ton upotheseon).>>

Kai etsi, epestrepsan (apo te makhe tes Khamra' Al-Asant) me te khare kai te gennaiodoria apo ton Allakh, khoris na tous aggixei kanena kako. Epidioxan ten eukharistese tou Allakh kai o Allakh katekhei megale gennaiodoria.
Den einai para mono o Satanas pou (prospathei na) sas tromaxei meso ton boethon tou. Etsi, men tous phobaste, alla Emena mono na phobaste, an eiste pragmati pistoi.

Kai na me se stenakhoroun ekeinoi pou speudoun sten apistia. Pragmati, den tha blapsoun ton Allakh se tipote. O Allakh thelei na men orisei kanena meridio (eudaimonias) gi' autous ste Mellousa Zoe, kai tha ekhoun tromero marturio.
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou antallaxan ten piste me ten apistia den tha blapsoun ton Allakh se tipote kai tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

Kai men nomizoun oi apistoi oti epeide tous dinoume anabole (aphenontas tous na zesoun para ten apistia tous) oti einai kati kalo gi' autous, pragmati, tous dinoume anabole oste na auxethoun stis amarties, kai tha ekhoun ena tapeinotiko marturio.

Pote den tha aphene o Allakh (esas) tous pistous s' auto pou eiste (oti anamesa sas uparkhoun upokrites) para mono mekhri na diakhorisei (meso dokimasion) metaxu tou kakou kai tou kalou. Kai pote den tha sas apokalupte ta aorata (gia na diakrinete metaxu tou pistou kai tou upokrite), alla o Allakh epilegei apo tous Aggeliaphorous Tou opoion thelei (oste na tou apokaluptei kapoia apo ta aorata). Pistepste loipon, ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou. Kai an pisteuete kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), tha ekhete terastia amoibe.

Kai men nomizoun osoi einai tsigkounedes me auta pou tous parakhorese o Allakh apo te gennaiodoria Tou (oi opoioi den pleronoun te Zaka -etesia upokhreotike eleemosune-) oti auto einai kalutero gi' autous. Okhi, einai kheirotero gi' autous! Auto pou apo aplestia kratesan (gia na men plerosoun te Zaka), tha dethei sto laimo tous san ena kolaro ten Emera tes Anastases. Ston Allakh tha epistrepsei o,ti einai stous ouranous kai te ge. St' aletheia, o Allakh gia osa kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Pragmati, o Allakh akouse ta logia ekeinon (ton Ebraion) pou eipan: <<O Allakh einai phtokhos eno emeis eimaste plousioi!>> [Auta ta eipan aphou akousan ta logia tou Allakh: <<Poios tha daneisei ston Allakh ena kalo daneio -xodeuontas gia khare tou Allakh se eleemosune-, oste -o Allakh- na tou to pollaplasiasei polu -del. ten amoibe->> Sourat Al-Mpakara edaphio 245]. Tha katagrapsoume auta pou eipan kai epises oti skotonan tous Prophetes adika (del. oi progonoi tous skotonan tous Prophetes, alla kai autoi dekhontai auto kai einai ston idio dromo ton progonon tous), kai tha poume: <<Geuteite to marturio tes kauses tes Photias.>>
Auto (to marturio) einai gia o,ti diepraxan ta kheria sas, kai o Allakh den adikei tous doulous (Tou).

Einai ekeinoi (oi Ebraioi) pou eipan: <<Pragmati, o Allakh mas dietaxe na men pistepsoume se kanenan Aggeliaphoro mekhri na mas pherei mia thusia ten opoia tha katabrokhthisei e photia (apo ton ourano).>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, erthan s' esas Aggeliaphoroi prin apo emena, me sapheis apodeixeis, akome kai me auta pou eipate (del. thusies)* giati tote tous skotosate, an eiste eilikrineis;>>

Epeita, an se diapseudoun (o, Mokhammant), pragmati, eikhan diapseusei kai allous Aggeliaphorous prin apo esena, oi opoioi (Aggeliaphoroi) eikhan erthei me xekathares apodeixeis, ta Theia Biblia kai to Biblio pou photizei (to dromo tes Aletheias).

Kathe psukhe tha geutei to thanato, kai mono ten Emera tes Anastases tha labete pleros tis amoibes e tis timories sas. Kai opoios apomakrunthei apo to Pur kai eisakhthei ston Paradeiso, st' aletheia, petukhe. Pragmati, e egkosmia zoe den einai para mono e eukharistese tes mataiodoxias.

Pragmati, tha dokimasteite ston plouto sas kai ston eauto sas, kai tha akousete apo ekeinous (Ebraious kai Khristianous) stous opoious dotheke to Biblio (e Tora kai to In-tzel -prototupo Euaggelio- tou Iesou) prin apo esas, kai apo tous eidololatres, polla blabera logia. Alla an deixete upomone kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), auto einai apo ta themata pou khreiazontai stathere apophasistikoteta.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Allakh pere te desmeuse ap' autous (Ebraious kai Khristianous) stous opoious dotheke to Biblio (e Tora kai to In-tzel -prototupo Euaggelio- tou Iesou), oti: <<Na to katastesete saphes (to Biblio tou Allakh) stous anthropous kai na men to apokrupsete.>> Alla ekeinoi to erixan piso apo ten plate tous kai to antallaxan me mikro timema. Poso athlio einai auto (to timema) pou peran se antallagma (gia to Biblio tou Allakh)!

Me nomizeis (o, Mokhammant) oti ekeinoi pou khairontai gia o,ti ekanan (apo amarties) kai agapoun na tous epainoun (oi anthropoi) gia o,ti den ekhoun kanei (apo kales praxeis), tha sothoun apo to marturio. Kai gi' autous tha uparkhei ena odunero marturio.
Ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
Pragmati, ste demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges kai sten diadokhe tes nukhtas kai tes emeras, uparkhoun Semadia gi' autous pou ekhoun mualo (na ta sullogistoun).

Autoi pou mnemoneuoun ton Allakh orthioi, kathismenoi e xaplomenoi plagia kai stokhazontai gia te demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges, (legontas): <<Kurie mas, den ta demiourgeses auta askopa* Upsistos eisai (kai Anoteros apo to na ta ekheis demiourgesei askopa)* prostatepse mas, loipon, apo to marturio tou Puros.
Kurie mas, opoion eisageis ste photia, pragmati, ton tapeinoses, kai gia tous adikous den tha uparxoun uposteriktes (pou na tous prostatepsoun apo te Photia ten Emera tes Kriseos).

Kurie mas, pragmati, akousame enan pou kalei pros ten piste (ton Mokhammant), legontas: <<Pistepste ston Kurio sas.>>, kai etsi pistepsame. Kurie mas, sugkhorese gia mas tis amarties mas, exileose gia mas tis kakes mas praxeis kai kane mas otan pethanoume na eimaste metaxu ton dikaion.

Kurie mas, dose mas o,ti mas uposkhethekes meso ton apestalmenon Sou kai me mas tapeinoseis ten Emera tes Anastases (me to na mas eisageis ste Photia), pragmati, (eisai Gennaiodoros kai) pote den atheteis ten uposkhese Sou.>>

Etsi, o Kurios tous antapokritheke s' autous legontas: <<Pote den kathisto mataio to (kalo) ergo kanenos apo esas (del. ten antamoibe tou), eite einai andras, eite gunaika, eseis proerkheste o enas apo ton allon (del. den uparkhei diakrise sten amoibe logo phulou). Oso gi' ekeinous pou metanasteusan (apo te Makka pros te Mantina), ekdiokhthekan apo ta spitia tous, upepheran gia khare Mou, kai polemesan kai skotothekan, sigoura tha exileoso tis amarties tous kai tha tous eisago se kepous kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Mia amoibe apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei ten kalutere amoibe.>>
Na me se xegelasei (o, Mokhammant) e euemeria ton apiston ste ge (apo taxidia, emporio kai ploute, aphou ola auta tha phugoun kai tha parameinoun mono oi kakes tous praxeis).
Einai mia suntome apolause, kai epeita, e Kolase tha einai e katoikia tous. Ti athlio krebati einai auto (pou ekhei etoimastei gi' autous).

Alla, autoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Kuriou tous (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), tha ekhoun kepous kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. Mia amoibe apo ton Allakh. Kai auto pou ekhei o Allakh (apo amoibe) einai kalutero gia tous eusebeis (apo o,ti ekhoun oi apistoi apo egkosmies apolauseis).

Uparkhoun anamesa stous anthropous tou Bibliou (Ebraious kai Khristianous) ekeinoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai se o,ti ekhei stalthei s' esas kai se o,ti ekhei stalthei s' autous. Tapeinonontai enopion tou Allakh, kai den antallazoun ta Edaphia tou Allakh me ena mikro timema. Ekeinoi tha ekhoun ten antamoibe tous me ton Kurio tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros ston upologismo (ton praxeon ton doulon Tou, kai sto na tous antameipsei).

O, eseis pou pisteuete, kante upomone, upomeinete perissotero apo tous ekhthrous sas, parameinete sto Tzikhant (enantia ston ekhthro sas) kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon tou Allakh), mepos kai na petukhete.

O, anthropoi! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Kuriou sas (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), o Opoios sas eplase apo ena atomo (ton Adam), kai ap' auton (ton Adam) eplase te suzugo tou (ten Eua), kai ap' autous tous duo eplase pollous andres kai gunaikes. Etsi, phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh, sto Onoma (khare) tou Opoiou zetate o enas (kati) apo ton allo (legontas gia khare tou Allakh na kaneis auto) kai men diakoptete tous suggenikous desmous. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Parateretes pano sas.

Kai na dosete sta orphana tis periousies tous (otan phtasoun ten ephebeia) kai men antikathistate ta (dika sas) kaka me ta (dika tous) kala. Kai men katabrokhthizete tis periousies tous prosthetontas tes stis dikes sas. Pragmati, aute einai terastia amartia.

Kai an phobaste oti den tha mporesete na antimetopisete dikaia ta orphana koritsia (pou einai upo ten kedemonia sas, kai thelete na tis pantreuteite khoris na tous dosete olokleres tis proikes tous kai ta dikaiomata tous, opos kanate prin to Islam), tote (apheste tes kai) pantreuteite alles gunaikes tes epiloges sas, duo e treis, e tesseris* alla an phobaste oti den tha mporesete na (tis) antimetopisete dikaia, tote (pantreuteite) mono mia e autes pou katekhei to dexi sas kheri (del. tis sklabes). Aute (e entole) proseggizei perissotero to na sas apotrepsei apo to na adikesete.
Kai doste stis gunaikes (pou pantreueste) ten proika tous prothuma, ena kathekon s' esas. Alla an sas aphesoun prothuma kapoio meros tes (proikas), parte to, epitrepto kai kalo (gia esas).

Kai me dinete s' osous den diakheirizontai kala ta khremata (del. s' autous pou einai upo ten kedemonia sas apo ta mikra orphana paidia, tous trelous e autous pou spatalane khoris logike e kai sta mikra paidia sas) ten periousia sas (oute ten periousia tous pou ten phulate san na etan dikia sas gia na men katastraphei), ten opoia o Allakh katestese meso suntereses gia sas (del. gia te zoe ton anthropon). Alla na parekhete s' ekeinous ap' auten kai na tous ntunete kai na tous lete kala eugenika logia (opos oti tha tous dosete tis periousies tous molis megalosoun e na mporesoun na tis diakheirizontai sosta).

Kai na dokimazete ta orphana (pou konteuoun na phtasoun sten ephebeia, me to na tous dosete ena mikro poso apo ten periousia tous, gia na xerete ten ikanoteta tous na diathetoun sosta ta khremata tous) mekhri na phtasoun sten elikia tou gamou. Epeita, an antilephtheite s' auta orthe krise, doste tous ten periousia tous. Kai men epidiokete na ten katanalonete me spatale kai gregora, phoboumenoi pos tha megalosoun (kai tha ten paroun). Kai opoios (apo tous kedemones) einai plousios, as apophugei na parei (apo ta lephta tou orphanou), ma an einai phtokhos, as troei (parei) sumphona me auto pou einai dikaio kai logiko (pou kaluptei tis anagkes tou). Epeita, otan tous dosete ten periousia tous, pherte martures gi' auto. Kai eparkei o Allakh os Marturas kai gia na tous kalesei se apologismo.>>

Uparkhei gia tous andres ena meridio apo osa aphesan oi goneis kai oi kontinoi suggeneis (tous, apo kleronomia), kai uparkhei gia tis gunaikes ena meridio apo osa aphesan oi goneis kai oi kontinoi suggeneis (tous, apo kleronomia), eite (e kleronomia) einai mikre, eite megale: ena upokhreotiko meridio (kai okhi opos etan prin to Islam, opou oute oi gunaikes oute ta paidia kleronomousan).
An erthan kata te dianome (tes kleronomias kai) alloi suggeneis (pou den dikaiountai meridio sten kleronomia), orphana e aporoi, doste tous kati apo aute (ten kleronomia) kai peite tous kala logia.

Kai as phobountai ekeinoi (oi kedemones ton orphanon) pou an tha pethainan aphenontas adunamous apogonous, tha phobontousan (kai tha anesukhousan) gi' autous (na khathoun e na adikethoun), as phulakhthoun, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou skhetika me ta orphana upo ten kedemonia tous, kai na men tous adikoun oste o Allakh na steilei meta to thanato tous ekeinon pou tha prosekhe ta paidia tous opos ekeinoi prosekhan ta alla orphana) kai as (tous) lene sosta (kai kala) logia.
Ekeinoi pou katanalonoun adika ten periousia ton orphanon, st' aletheia, katanalonoun mono mia photia stis koilies tous, kai tha eisakhthoun sto Pur tes kolaseos gia na kaoun mesa.

O Allakh sas diatazei skhetika me ten kleronomia ton paidion sas: gia to arseniko (ena meridio pou einai) iso me to meridio duo thelukon. An uparkhoun mono kores, duo e perissoteres, pairnoun ta duo trita apo o,ti aphese (o thanontas apo periousia), alla an einai mono mia (kore), pairnei te mise. Oso gia tous goneis tou, o kathenas tous dikaioutai to ena ekto apo o,ti aphese (apo periousia) ean aphese apogonous, alla an den aphese apogonous kai oi goneis tou einai oi monoi kleronomoi, e metera tou pairnei to ena trito (kai o pateras tou to upoloipo), alla an ekhei aderphia (andres e gunaikes), e metera tou pairnei to ena ekto (kai o pateras tou to upoloipo, kai den pairnoun kati ta aderphia tou), kai (aute e dianome tes kleronomias ginetai) meta ten ektelese tes diathekes pou ten eikhe kanei (o thanontas, kai ephoson e diatheke tou den uperbainei to ena trito tes periousias tou) kai meta apo ten exophlese tou khreous (tou, an eikhe). Oi goneis sas kai ta paidia sas, den xerete poios ap' autous tha sas ophelesei perissotero. (Aute e dianome einai) ena kathekon (s' esas) apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

To meridio sas apo o,ti aphesan oi gunaikes sas (apo kleronomia) einai to miso, an den ekhoun paidi, alla an ekhoun paidi, to meridio sas einai to ena tetarto apo o,ti aphesan, meta ten ektelese tes diathekes pou ten eikhan kanei (oi thanouses, kai ephoson e diatheke tous den uperbainei to ena trito tes periousias tous) kai meta apo ten exophlese tou khreous (tous, an eikhan). Kai to meridio tous (ton gunaikon sas apo ten kleronomia pou aphesate) einai to ena tetarto an den ekhete paidi, alla an ekhete paidi, to meridio tous einai to ena ogdoo apo o,ti aphesate, meta ten ektelese tes diathekes pou ten eikhate kanei (prin pethanete) kai meta apo ten exophlese tou khreous (sas, an eikhate). Kai an enas andras e mia gunaika den ekhei oute patera oute paidi (gio e kore) kai aphenei kleronomia, eno ekhei enan eterothale adelpho (apo te pleura tes manas) e mia eterothale adelphe (apo te pleura tes manas), tote gia ton kathena tous einai to ena ekto. An omos (oi eterothaleis adelphia apo te pleura tes manas) einai perissoteroi apo auto (apo enan e mia), tote moirazontai to ena trito, meta ten ektelese tes diathekes pou ten eikhe kanei (prin pethanei) kai meta apo ten exophlese tou khreous (tou e tes, an eikhe), (kai upo ten proupothese oti e diatheke tou e tes einai) khoris na prokalei blabe (stous kleronomous, opos an e diatheke einai parapano apo to ena trito tes periousias tou e tes). (Auta einai) mia diatage apo ton Allakh, kai o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

Auta einai ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, kai opoios upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, (o Allakh) tha ton eisagei se kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Kai tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai aute einai e megalutere epitukhia.

Kai opoios parakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, kai parabiazei ta oria pou tethekan ap' Auton, (o Allakh) tha ton eisagei sto Pur, opou tha katoikesei ekei mesa gia panta, kai tha labei ena tapeinotiko marturio.

Oses apo tis gunaikes sas diaprattoun moikheia, kaleste tesseris martures enantion tous apo anamesa sas (dikaious Mousoulmanous). Ean marturesoun (enantion tous), perioriste tes sta spitia tous (apo mia upopte exodo) mekhri na tous elthei o thanatos e o Allakh na orisei gi' autes (allo) dromo.

Kai ekeinoi oi duo (o andras kai e gunaika) apo esas pou te diaprattoun (te moikheia), blapste tous (me to na tous epiplexete klp.). An, omos, straphekan me metamelia (pros ton Allakh) kai prattoun dikaia, apheste tous esukhous (kai men tous blapsete). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Allakh dekhetai mono te metameleia ekeinon pou diaprattoun to kako apo agnoia kai meta strephontai me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) suntoma. Gi' autous o Allakh dekhetai te metameleia tous, kai o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

E metameleia den ginetai dekte apo ekeinous pou diaprattoun to kako (ole tous te zoe) kai otan o thanatos erthei se enan ap' autous, tote leei: <<Tora strephomai me metameleia (pros ton Allakh).>>, oute apo ekeinous pou pethainoun os apistoi, gi' autous ekhoume proetoimasei epoduno marturio.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Apagoreuetai na pairnete tis gunaikes (tis suzugous ton pateron kai ton suggenon sas) os kleronomia (na tis apotrepsete apo to na pantreutoun allon andra, e na tis kanete na pantreutoun allon andra) para te thelese tous. Kai na men kratate autes (tis suzugous sas pou thelete na khorisete, sto gamo empodizontas tous na pantreutoun allous) gia na parete meros tes proikas pou tous ekhete dosei, ektos ki an diapraxoun phanere aiskhre praxe (moikheia) (s' auten ten periptose epitrepetai na parete piso ten proika). Kai na zeite mazi tous me ton kalutero tropo. An tis miseite, isos na miseite kati, pou o Allakh na pherei meso autou polla kala (pou den ta perimenete).

An thelesete na khorisete te suzugo kai na pantreuteite mia alle, kai tes eikhate dosei mia terastia proika, men parete piso oute to elakhisto ap' auten (ten proika). Tha ten pairnate me adikia kai phanere amartia;
Kai pos mporeite na ten parete piso (ten proika), eno ekhete erthei se stene skhese o enas me ton allo, kai ekeines (oi suzugoi) ekhoun parei apo sas mia dunate desmeuse (sumbolaio);

Men pantreueste tis gunaikes pou pantreutekan oi pateres sas, ektos ap' auto pou sunebe sto parelthon: einai pragmati aiskhre kai apekhthes praxe (pou o Allakh apekhthanetai auton pou ten kanei) kai einai enas kakos dromos (gi' osous ton peran).

Apagoreuetai gia sas na pantreuteite: tis meteres sas, tis kores sas, tis aderphes sas, tis theies sas apo te pleura tou patera sas, tis theies sas apo te pleura tes meteras sas, tis kores tou aderphou sas, tis kores tes aderphes sas, tis (gunaikes pou theorountai san tis) meteres sas pou sas thelazan, tis aderphes sas apo to thelasmo, tis petheres sas, tis thetes kores sas pou einai (e okhi) upo ten kedemonia sas kai einai (oi kores) apo tis gunaikes sas pou ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous, - ostoso, ean den ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous (del. me tis gunaikes sas pou einai oi meteres tous kai tis khorisate), tote den uparkhei amartia s' esas (na tis pantreuteite) - kai tis gunaikes ton gion sas pou einai apo ten osphu sas (del. tous biologikous gious), kai (epises apagoreuetai) na pantreuteite duo aderphes mazi, ektos apo auto pou sunebe sto parelthon. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Epises (apagoreuetai na pantreuteite) tis pantremenes gunaikes, ektos ap' ekeines pou katekhoun ta dexia sas kheria (tis aikhmalotes ston topo makhes kata te diarkeia tou polemou). Auta sas diatazei o Allakh. Epitrepetai, omos, gia sas (na pantreuteite) opoiadepote alle ektos ekeinon (ton proanapheromenon gunaikon), ephoson o skopos sas einai na (tis) pantreuteite dinontas apo ta ploute sas ten proika, kai okhi na diapraxete moikheia. Kai opoies pantreuteite ap' autes kai ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous (meta apo to gamou), einai upokhreotiko na tous dosete ten proika tous. Den uparkhei amartia s' esas gia osa sumphoneite (eite na prosauxanete eite na meionete ten proika) meta ton kathorismo tes opheilomenes proikas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai opoios ap' esas den ekhei ten poluteleia na pantreutei eleutheres pistes gunaikes, mporei na pantreutei apo tis pistes doules pou ekhete sten katokhe sas. O Allakh xerei kalutera gia ten piste sas. Eseis (oi andres kai oi gunaikes) eiste o enas apo ton allo (del. eiste isoi ste threskeia kai sten anthropoteta, gi' auto men ntrepeste na pantreuteite tis pistes doules). Pantreuteite tous me ten adeia ton kurion tous kai doste tous ten proika tous dikaia (khoris meiose e kathusterese) - me ten proupothese oti einai agnes kai den diaprattoun moikheia, oute ekhoun philous krupha gia porneia. An pantreutoun, kai epeita diapraxoun moikheia, tote e timoria tous einai e mise tes timorias ton eleutheron gunaikon. Auto einai gi' opoion apo sas phobatai na pesei se moikheia, kai to na kanete upomone einai kalutero gia sas. Kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Allakh thelei (me te thespise auton ton diataxeon) na kanei saphes s' esas (tous nomous tes threskeias Tou, kai ti sas ophelei s' aute te zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe), kai na sas kathodegesei stous tropous ekeinon (ton propheton) pou proegethekan ap' esas (oste na tous akoloutheite), kai na dekhtei te metameleia sas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
O Allakh thelei na dekhtei te metameleia sas (o, pistoi), eno ekeinoi pou akolouthoun tous pothous (tous), epithumoun na parekklinete polu (apo ton isio dromo).
O Allakh thelei na elaphrunei gia sas (tis duskolies, gi' auto den sas diatazei peran ton dunatoteton sas). Pragmati, o anthropos demiourgetheke adunamos.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men katatrote ten periousia sas anamesa sas (o enas tou allou) adika, ektos an einai apo emporio metaxu sas (me dikaio tropo kai) me amoibaia sunainese. Kai me skotonete tous eautous sas (del. me skotonete o enas ton allon, oute na autoktoneite, oute na rixete ton eauto sas sten katastrophe). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Polueusplakhnos gia sas.
Opoios ta kanei auta apo parabase kai adikia (kai me prothese), tha ton eisagoume sten Kolase gia na kaei mesa. Kai auto einai eukolo gia ton Allakh.
Ean apopheugete tis megales amarties pou sas apagoreuontai, tha exileosoume gia sas tis (mikres) amarties, kai tha sas eisagoume se mia eugene eisodo (tou Paradeisou).

Kai men epithumeite auta ta opoia o Allakh ekhei parakhoresei se merikous ap' esas enanti allon. Gia tous andres uparkhei amoibe e timoria gia o,ti ekanan, kai (omoios) gia tis gunaikes uparkhei amoibe e timoria gia o,ti ekanan. Kai zeteste apo ton Allakh te khare kai te gennaiodoria Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Kai gia kathe enan ekhoume orisei kleronomous gia o,ti aphesan oi goneis kai oi suggeneis (tou). Epises, s' autous stous opoious ekhete dosei uposkhese (summakhias kai uposterixes), doste tous to meridio tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai sta panta Marturas.

Oi andres einai oi kedemones (oi prostates kai oi sunteretes) ton gunaikon, logo oson ekhei kharisei o Allakh s' autous (apo ikanotetes gia sunterese kai prostasia) pano ap' autes, kai logo oson xodeuoun ekeinoi (gia na tis uposterizoun) apo tis periousies tous. Etsi, oi enaretes gunaikes einai upakoues (ston Allakh kai stous suzugous tous), kai phulassoun kata ten apousia ton suzugon tous (ten agnoteta tous kai ten periousia ton andron tous), meso tes prostasias tou Allakh (pou tis ekane enaretes gunaikes). Oso gi' ekeines tis gunaikes pou ek merous tous blepete askheme sumperiphora me alazoneia, na tis nouthetesete (prota), (deuteron) na tous gurisete ten plate sas sto krebati (del. na men ekhete sexoualike epaphe mazi tous), (kai telos) na tis khtupesete (polu elaphros, an epimenoun peismatika sten askheme sumperiphora tous, kai exanagkasteite na to kanete). Ma an sas upakousoun, na men tis adikesete m' opoiondepote tropo. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Alei (Upsistos) kai Kampeir (Megas).

An phobaste (o, suggeneis ton duo suzugon) dikhonoia metaxu tous (pou mporei na odegesei se diazugio), steilte enan (dikaio) krite apo ten oikogeneia tou, ki enan (dikaio) krite apo ten oikogeneia tes: an kai oi duo tous (krites) epithumoun diorthose (kai sumphiliose, kai dialexan to sosto kai kalo tropo gi' auto), o Allakh tha tous sumphiliosei (tous duo suzugous). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Kai na latreuete ton Allakh kai men Tou apodidete etairous (ste latreia). Phertheite kallista stous goneis, stous suggeneis, sta orphana, stous aporous, stous geitones pou sundeeste me suggeneia kai stous geitones pou den einai suggeneis sas, stous philous pou einai dipla sas (tis suzugous sas kai tous suntrophous sas sto taxidi), stous odoiporous kai s' osous katekhete sto dexi sas kheri (sklabous). Pragmati, o Allakh den agapa ekeinon pou einai uperephanos me alazoneia kai mataiodoxos.

(Kai o Allakh den agapa) ekeinous pou einai tsigkounedes kai diatazoun ten tsigkounia stous anthropous kai apokruptoun o,ti tous ekhei kharisei o Allakh apo te gennaiodoria Tou (apo agatha kai gnose). Pragmati, ekhoume etoimasei gia tous apistous ena tapeinotiko marturio.

Kai (auto to marturio tha einai epises kai gia) ekeinous pou xodeuoun apo ta ploute tous gia na epideiknuontai stous anthropous, eno den pisteuoun ston Allakh oute sten Eskhate Emera. Opoios pairnei ton Satana os suntropho, pragmati, ekhei parei ton pio athlio suntropho!
Ti tha tous eblapte an pisteuan ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, kai xodeuan apo o,ti tous ekhei paraskhei o Allakh; Pragmati, o Allakh einai Pantognostes gi' ola ta themata tous.
Pragmati, o Allakh den adikei kanenan, oute sto baros enos atomou (moriou). Kai an einai mia kale praxe, tha ten pollaplasiasei kai o Idios tha dosei mia megale antamoibe.

Pos loipon (tha einai e katastase ton anthropon kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) otan tha pheroume apo kathe ethnos enan martura (ton Prophete pou staltheke s' auto to ethnos), kai pheroume esena (o, Mokhammant) os martura enantion auton (del. tou laou sou) (oti tous metepheres to Theio Menuma)!

Ekeine ten Emera (tes Kriseos), tha eukhontan ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai parakousan ton Aggeliaphoro (na ginoun skone kai) na ginoun mia ontoteta me te ge. Kai den tha mporesoun na krupsoun apo ton Allakh kanenan logo (aphou o Allakh tha kanei ta mere tou somatos tous na marturesoun gi' o,ti ekanan).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men plesiazete (teleite) ten proseukhe eno eiste methusmenoi, mekhri (na exaphanistei to methusi sas kai) na xerete ti lete! [Aute etan e prote entole tou Allakh skhetika me to alkool, to opoio apagoreuteke stadiaka]. Oute (na teleite ten proseukhe eno eiste) se katastase Tzanampa (megales akatharsias p.kh. meta apo sexoualike epaphe), (oute na mpeite sta tzamia otan eiste se katastase Tzanampa) para mono otan pernate (khoris na meinete mesa), mekhri na kanete Gousl (pleres ntous). Kai otan eiste arrostoi (pou den mporeite na khresimopoiesete to nero), e taxideuete, e kapoios ap' esas ekhei anakouphistei, e ekhete sexoualike epaphe me tis gunaikes (sas), kai den briskete nero, tote pegainete pros kathare skone (e ammo e khoma, gia na ektelesete Tagiammoum khtupontas ten me tis duo palames mia phora) kai skoupiste (me tis palames sas) ta prosopa kai ta kheria sas (me ten palame tou aristerou pano sto dexi kheri mekhri ton karpo kai to antistropho). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aphoou (Autos pou dinei aphese gia ta panta) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Den ekheis dei (o, Mokhammant) ekeinous stous opoious dotheke ena meros tou Bibliou (del. apo te gnose gia ten Tora), kai antalassoun (ten kathodegese) me ten paraplanese kai eukhontai na parastratesete apo ton (isio) dromo;
Alla o Allakh gnorizei kalutera (apo sas) tous ekhthrous sas (kai sas enemeronei gi' autous kai ten ekhthroteta tous). Arkei o Allakh os Prostates kai arkei o Allakh os Uposteriktes.

Anamesa stous Ebraious, uparkhoun ekeinoi pou diastreblonoun tis lexeis (pou apokalupse o Allakh kai tis allazoun) apo tis theseis tous (kai tis sostes ennoies tous, kai ta ermeneuoun m' alles ennoies pou den apokalupse o Allakh). Kai lene (otan tous diatazei o Prophetes Mokhammant me kati): <<Akousame (ta logia sou) kai parakousame (ten entole sou).>> Kai (lene epises ston Prophete kanontas epiklese enantion tou): <<Akou (mas), eithe na men akous.>> Kai otan lene (ston Prophete): <<Ra'ena (dose mas prosokhe)>>, striboun tis glosses tous (kai alloionoun ten prophora tes, oste na semainei mia prosbole) kai me skopo ten prosbole tes threskeias! Kai an eikhan pei: <<Akousame kai upakousame>>, kai: <<Akou (mas)>> kai: <<Dose mas prosokhe>> (anti ten prosbole pou eipan), tha etan kalutera gi' autous kai pio ortha. Alla o Allakh tous katarasteke gia ten apistia tous, etsi, den pisteuoun para mono ligo.

O, eseis (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) pou sas dotheke to Biblio! Pistepste s' auto (to Kor'an) pou steilame (ston Mokhammant), to opoio epibebaionei ta dika sas Biblia (ten authentike Tora pou staltheke ston Mouse kai to authentiko In-tzel pou staltheke ston Iesou, ta opoia epibebaionoun ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant, kai gi' auto prepei na eiste oi protoi pou na pistepsete s' auton) - protou exaleipsoume ta prosopa gurizontas ta pros ten plate tous, e na tous katariomaste opos katarastekame tous parabates tou Sabbatou. Pragmati, e entole tou Allakh ginetai oposdepote.

St' aletheia, o Allakh de sugkhorei to na Tou apodidontai etairoi (ste latreia)* alla sugkhorei otidepote allo ektos ap' auto gi' opoion thelei* kai opoios apodidei etairous ston Allakh (ste latreia) ekhei pragmati mekhaneutei mia terastia amartia.

Den ekheis dei (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous) pou epainoun ton eauto tous (kai tis praxeis tous, kai iskhurizontai oti einai apallagmenoi apo tis amarties, oti einai oi gioi tou Allakh kai oi agapetoi Tou kai oti kaneis den tha eiselthei ston Paradeiso para mono autoi); (Den iskhuei auto pou iskhuristekan), ma o Allakh exagnizei opoion thelei (apo tis amarties kai epainei opoion thelei kai tis praxeis tou, aphou o Allakh xerei ten pragmatikoteta olon ton praxeon). Kai den tha adikethoun oute sto megethos enos nematos tou koukoutsiou enos khourma.
Koita pos mekhaneuontai psemata gia ton Allakh! Auto apo mono tou arkei os kataphoro amartema.

Den ekheis dei (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous Ebraious) stous opoious dotheke ena meros tou Bibliou (del. apo te gnose gia ten Tora), pou pisteuoun se eidola kai pseutikous theous, kai lene stous apistous oti einai (del. oi apistoi) pio kathodegemenoi apo tous pistous;
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou tous katarasteke o Allakh, kai opoion katarastei o Allakh, de tha breis pote gi 'auton kanenan uposterikte.
E ekhoun meridio sto basileio (kai sten kuriarkhia); Akoma ki an eikhan, de tha edinan stous anthropous oute oso einai o kokkos pou brisketai pano sto koukoutsi enos khourma.

E mepos (ekeinoi oi Ebraioi) phthonoun tous anthropous (ton Mokhammant kai tous opadous tou) gia o,ti tous ekhei dosei o Allakh (apo apostole, kathodegese kai duname) apo te gennaiodoria Tou; St' aletheia, eikhame dosei (prin) stous apogonous tou Impraem (Abraam) to Biblio kai te sophia kai tous parakhoresame ena megalo basileio.

Merikoi ap' autous (apo ton lao tou Bibliou) pistepsan s' auto (pou esteile o Allakh ston Abraam kai stous Prophetes apo tous apogonous tou), eno alloi to arnethekan kai apetrepsan tous anthropous ap' auto. Arkei e Kolase gia na (tous) kapsei.

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, tha tous eisagoume ste Photia gia na kaoun mesa tes* opote kaigontai ta dermata tous, tha ta antikatastesoume m' alla dermata gia na geutoun to marturio. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis, tha tous eisagoume se kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, kai tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. Tha ekhoun ekei mesa agnes suzugous kai tha tous eisagoume se mia drosere anazoogonetike skiase.

St' aletheia, o Allakh sas diatazei na epistrepsete ta katapisteumata stous dikaioukhous tous* kai otan krinete metaxu ton anthropon na krinete me dikaiosune. Pragmati, polu exairetiko einai auto pou sas diatazei o Allakh! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

O, seis pou pisteuete! Upakouste ton Allakh, kai upakouste ton Aggeliaphoro kai ekeinous anamesa sas pou ekhoun ten egesia. Ean diaphoneite gi' otidepote, parapempste to ston Allakh (sto Biblio Tou) kai ston Aggeliaphoro (ste Sounna -paradose- tou), ean pragmati pisteuete ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera. Auto einai kalutero (gia ten egkosmia zoe sas apo to na diaphoneite metaxu sas) kai pio omorpho se katalexe (kai antamoibe).

Den ekheis dei (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou iskhurizontai oti pisteuoun se o,ti staltheke s' esena (to Kor'an) kai se o,ti staltheke prin apo sena (apo Theia Biblia), eno anazetoun tous paraplanetikous nomous na krinoun metaxu tous (stis diaphores tous), parolo pou eikhan diatakhthei na tous aporripsoun; O Satanas thelei na tous parastratesei polu makria.
Otan tous eipothei: <<Elate s' auto pou esteile o Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro (oste na krinei metaxu sas).>>, blepeis (o, Prophete) tous upokrites na apomakrunontai polu apo sena.

Pos tha einai, loipon, (e katastase ton upokriton) otan tous pesei mia sumphora exaitias oson diepraxan ta kheria tous (apo amarties), kai epeita erthoun s' esena (o, Prophete) orkizomenoi sto Onoma tou Allakh oti: <<Den eikhame allo skopo (otan pegame s' allon gia na krinei metaxu mas) para mono to kalo kai te sumphiliose!>>; [Alla einai pseutes s' auto pou iskhurizontai].

Einai ekeinoi pou o Allakh gnorizei ti uparkhei sten kardia tous (apo upokrisia kai kake prothese). Gi' auto men tous epiplexeis e timoreseis (gia o,ti ekhoun sten kardia tous), nouthetese tous kai pes tous euglotta logia pou tha epereasoun ton eauto tous.

Den steilame kanenan Aggeliaphoro para mono gia na ton upakousoun me ten adeia tou Allakh. Kai an otan adikousan ton eauto tous (me tis amarties tous) erkhontousan s' esena (o, Mokhammant) kai zetousan sugkhorese apo ton Allakh, kai zetouse o Aggeliaphoros (apo ton Allakh) sugkhorese gi' autous, tha ebriskan ton Allakh Taouamp (Auton pou apodekhetai te metameleia) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhno).

Okhi! (Orkizomai) ma ton Kurio sou (o, Mokhammant)! Den tha pistepsoun pragmatika, mekhri na erthoun s' esena gia na krineis s' oles tis diaphonies metaxu tous, kai meta na men broun mesa tous kamia dusareskeia gi' o,ti ekrines kai na to apodekhtoun me apolute upotage.

An tous eikhame prostaxei: <<Skotoste ton eauto sas.>>, e <<Bgeite apo ta spitia sas.>>, de tha to ekanan para mono ligoi ap' autous (gi' auto as doxazoun ton Allakh pou den tous dietaxe kati peran ton dunatoteton tous). Alla an eikhan kanei auto pou diatakhthekan (apo kales praxeis), tha etan kalutero gi' autous kai pio stathero (gia ten piste tous),
Kai tha tous diname ap' Emas mia megale antamoibe,
Kai tha tous kathodegousame ston isio dromo.

Opoios upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro, tha einai mazi m' autous stous opoious o Allakh parakhorese ten eunoia Tou, apo tous Prophetes, tous eusebeis (pou pistepsan apoluta tous Prophetes), tous martures kai tous enaretous. Kai poso exairetoi suntrophoi einai autoi (ston Paradeiso)!
Aute e gennaiodoria (kai e khare) einai apo ton Allakh, kai arkei o Allakh os Pantognostes (ton panton).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na prophulakhtheite (apo tous ekhthrous sas) kai bgeite (gia na tous polemesete) se omades, e mia meta apo ten alle e bgeite oloi mazi (sumphona m' auto pou sas sumpherei).

Uparkhoun merikoi anamesa sas pou kathusteroun (apo to na bgoun ste makhe exaitias tes deilias tous). An sas brei mia sumphora, tote (o kathenas tous) leei: <<O Allakh me eulogese pou den emoun paron mazi tous!>>

Alla an sas erthei apo ton Allakh kapoia gennaiodoria (nike kai laphura), tote leei -san na men (etan enas apo sas oute) uperkhe pote kale skhese anamesa s' esas kai auton-: <<Makari na emoun mazi tous, gia na eikha ena megalo kerdos.>>

As polemesoun ston dromo tou Allakh, ekeinoi pou antalassoun te zoe autou tou kosmou me te Mellousa Zoe. Kai opoios polemesei sto dromo tou Allakh, kai epeita eite skotothei eite nikesei, tha tou dosoume megale antamoibe.

Kai pos na men polemate sto dromo tou Allakh, kai gia (na uposterizete) tous adunamous (tous katapiesmenous) anamesa stous andres, tis gunaikes kai ta paidia; Oi opoioi (adunamoi) lene: <<Kurie mas! Sose mas ap' auten ten pole, tes opoias oi katoikoi einai adikoi* kai anadeixe gia mas apo Sena kapoion kedemona kai anadeixe gia mas apo Sena kapoion uposterikte!>>

Oi pistoi polemoun sto dromo tou Allakh, eno oi apistoi polemoun sto dromo ton pseutikon theon (tous). Polemeste, loipon, tous summakhous tou Satana. Pragmati, to skhedio tou Satana einai panta adunamo.

Den ekheis dei (o, Prophete) ekeinous (apo tous suntrophous sou pou zetesan na polemesoun sto dromo tou Allakh, alla) stous opoious eipotheke: <<Krateste piso ta kheria sas (apo to na polemesete tous ekhthrous sas) [auto etan prin na diataxei o Allakh to Tzikhant], teleste ten proseukhe kai doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune)>>; Alla otan o polemos diatakhtheke s' autous, idou ena meros auton phobountai tous anthropous opos phobountai ton Allakh e akome perissotero. Lene: <<Kurie mas! Giati epebales se mas polemo; Makari na mas doseis mia anabole gia suntomo diastema (oste na apolausoume gia perissotero khrono ta egkosmia agatha);>> Pes: <<Suntome einai e apolause autou tou kosmou, eno e Mellousa Zoe einai (polu) kalutere gi' auton pou phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, de tha antimetopisteite adika, oute sto megethos enos nematos tou koukoutsiou enos khourma.>>

Opou ki an eiste, o thanatos tha sas phtasei, akoma ki an eiste se aporthetous purgous (makria apo to polemo).>> An tous sumbei kati kalo, lene: <<Auto einai apo ton Allakh.>>, alla an tous sumbei kati kako, lene (s' esena, o, Mokhammant): <<Auto einai exaitias sou.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Ola einai apo ton Allakh.>> Ti sumbainei m' autous tous anthropous pou duskola katalabainoun ta logia (sou);

O,ti kalo sou sumbainei (o, anthrope) einai apo ton Allakh, alla o,ti kako sou sumbainei einai apo ton eauto sou (exaitias ton amartion sou). Pragmati, se steilame (o, Mokhammant) os Aggeliaphoro sten anthropoteta, kai arkei o Allakh os Marturas.

Opoios upakousei ton Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant) ekhei, pragmati, upakousei ton Allakh. Opoios omos apomakrunetai, (men stenakhoriesai gi' auton), pragmati, den se steilame (o, Prophete) os paraterete apo pano tous (gia na katagrapsei tis praxeis tous, Emeis tis katagraphoume kai tha tous pheroume se apologismo gi' autes).

Lene (oi upokrites s' esena mono me tis glosses tous): <<Upakoume (ten entole sou)!>>, alla molis pheugoun ap' esena, mia omada ap' autous sunomotei krupha enantia s' auta pou les! O Allakh katagraphei o,ti sunomotoun, gi' auto apomakrunsou ap' autous kai enapothese ten epistosune sou (gi' oles tis upotheseis sou) ston Allakh. Kai arkei o Allakh os Diakheiristes (olon ton upotheseon).
Ma den sullogizontai to Kor'an; An etan ap' allon ektos apo ton Allakh, tha ebriskan sigoura mesa tou polles antiphaseis.

Opote phtanei s' autous (tous upokrites) kapoia eidese gia (to oti oi Mousoulmanoi einai se) asphaleia (kai khara) e phobo (kai thlipse), amesos te diadidoun. Kai an (eikhan kanei upomone kai) ten parepempan ston Aggeliaphoro kai s' ekeinous pou ekhoun gnose, tote ekeinoi (oi anthropoi tes gnoses) pou mporoun na to psaxoun (apo tis peges tou an einai aletheia e pseudos) tha mathainan ten pragmatikoteta tes! An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh s' esas (o, Mousoulmanoi), tha akolouthousate (opos autoi oi upokrites) ton Satana, ektos apo ligous.

Polemese, loipon, (o, Prophete) sto dromo tou Allakh, den ekheis euthune para mono gia ton eauto sou (kai den tha rotetheis gia tous allous). Kai parotrune tous pistous (na polemesoun). Isos o Allakh na apothesei te duname ton apiston (meso tou na tous polemesete), kai o Allakh ekhei megalutere duname kai austerotere timoria.
Opoios mesolabei se enan kalo skopo, tha ekhei meridio sten antamoibe tou, alla opoios mesolabei se enan kako skopo, tha ekhei meridio sten amartia tou. Kai o Allakh einai Marturas ton panton.
Otan khairetetheite me kapoio khairetismo, apanteste me enan kalutero khairetismo e me ton idio. Pragmati, o Allakh katagraphei ta panta (kai tha kalesei tous anthropous se apologismo gi' auta).

Allakh: den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Pragmati, tha sas sugkentrosei olous ten emera tes Anastases, gia ten opoia den uparkhei kamia amphibolia. Poios einai pio eilikrines ston logo apo ton Allakh;

Ti sumbainei m' esas (o, pistoi) pou khoristekate se duo omades oson aphora tous upokrites (mia omada leei na tous polemesete gia ten apistia tous, eno e alle leei na men tous polemesete gia ten piste tous), eno o Allakh tous epestrepse (sten apistia kai ten plane) exaitias oson diepraxan; Thelete na kathodegesete autous pou o Allakh tous ekane na parastratesoun; Opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, de tha breis gi' auton kanena dromo (gia ten kathodegese).

Eukhontai na arnetheite ten piste opos autoi arnethekan ten piste, oste na ginete oloi isoi. Epomenos, men parete ap' autous summakhous mekhri na metanasteusoun sto dromo tou Allakh (kai na khoristoun apo tous polutheistes, os apodeixe tes pistes tous). An omos arnethoun (na metanasteusoun deikhnontas ten apistia tous), parte tous kai skotoste tous opou tous breite, kai men parete ap' autous oute summakhous oute uposteriktes, [Bl. Edaphio 97 apo to idio kephalaio, gia perissoteres leptomereies].

Ektos ap' ekeinous pou phtanoun se enan lao me ton opoio ekhete suntheke (eirenes) e ekeinous pou erkhontai s' esas niothontas dusphoria na sas polemesoun e na polemesoun ton lao tous. An ethele o Allakh, tha tous eikhe dosei te dunatoteta na sas polemesoun (gi' auto doxaste ton Allakh gia tis khares Tou, kai men tous blaptete). Epomenos, ean apophugoun na sas polemesoun kai sas prospheroun eirene, tote o Allakh den kanei gia sas kanena dromo (e adeia na polemesete) enantion tous.

Tha breite allous (mia alle omada upokriton) pou theloun na einai asphaleis ap' esas (kai etsi sas deikhnoun ten piste tous) kai theloun na einai asphaleis apo ton lao tous (kai etsi latreuoun ta eidola mazi tous). Opote kalountai sten apistia (kai ston polutheismo apo ton lao tous), pephtoun s' aute polu sklera. Epomenos, ean den apophugoun na sas polemesoun, den sas prospheroun eirene kai den sugkratesoun ta kheria tous (ap' esas), tote parte tous kai skotoste tous opou ki an tous breite. (Ekeinoi me tetoies perigraphes) einai ekeinoi enantion ton opoion sas dosame xekathare exousia.

Kai den einai gia kanenan pisto na skotosei enan allon pisto para mono kata lathos. Kai opoios skotosei enan pisto kata lathos, tha prepei na apeleutherosei enan pisto doulo kai na dothei mia apozemiose (phoro aimatos, -Ntigia-) sten oikogeneia tou (nekrou), ektos ki an ten aphesoun (oi suggeneis tou nekrou) os eleemosune (s' auton pou ton skotose kai katopin ton sugkhoresoun). An omos o nekros pou etan pistos aneke s' enan (apisto) lao pou einai ekhthros sas (kai brisketai se polemo mazi sas), tote tha prepei na ginei apeleutherose enos pistou doulou (kai de tha prepei na plerosei autos pou skotose phoro aimatos). Kai an (o nekros eite etan Mousoulmanous eite me kai) aneke s' enan lao (me Mousoulmano) me ton opoio ekhete suntheke (opos me tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous pou zoun se mia Mousoulmanike khora), prepei na dothei apozemiose (phoros aimatos) sten oikogeneia tou, kai na ginei apeleutherose enos pistou doulou. An, omos, (autos pou skotose) de briskei (enan doulo gia na ton apeleutherosei e khremata gia na agorasei enan doulo kai meta na ton apeleutherosei), tote tha prepei na nestepsei gia duo sunekhomenous menes oste na dekhtei o Allakh te metameleia tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai opoios skotosei enan pisto skopimos, e timoria tou tha einai e Kolase, opou tha meinei ekei gia panta* kai o Allakh tha orgistei m' auton kai tha ton katarastei, kai (o Allakh) ekhei proetoimasei ena tromero marturio gi' auton.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan pegainete na polemesete sto dromo tou Allakh, bebaiotheite (poion polemate, gia na men skotosete enan pisto pou krubei ten piste tou apo ton apisto lao tou pou sas polemaei). Kai men lete s' auton pou sas deikhnei oti einai Mousoulmanos (kai den sas polemaei mazi me ton apisto lao tou): <<Den eisai pistos (alla deikhneis oti eisai pistos gia na prostateuseis ton eauto sou).>>, anazetate m' auto (na parete ta khremata tou os laphura, kai) ta kerde tes egkosmias zoes, eno o Allakh ekhei aphthona kerde. Esastan prin kai eseis etsi (san auton, krubate ten piste sas apo ton lao sas), alla o Allakh sas eulogese (dinontas sas duname). Epomenos, bebaiotheite, pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Den einai isoi ekeinoi oi pistoi pou menoun piso (den polemoun sto dromo tou Allakh) - ektos ap' autous pou ekhoun dikaiologies (arrostia klp.) - kai ekeinoi pou polemoun sto dromo tou Allakh me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous. O Allakh xekhorise se upselotero bathmo autous pou polemoun me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous ap' ekeinous pou menoun piso. Gia olous (del. gi' autous pou polemoun sto dromo tou Allakh, kai gi' autous pou menoun piso gia kapoia anagke) o Allakh ekhei uposkhethei ton Paradeiso. Kai o Allakh xekhorise autous pou polemoun dinontas tous megalutere antamoibe ap' ekeinous pou menoun piso,

(E opoia antamoibe einai ta) upsela epipeda (to ena pano apo to allo) pou tha dosei Autos, kai sugkhorese kai eleos, kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou tous aphairoun oi aggeloi tis zoes tous eno adikoun ton eauto tous [menontas ste Makka anamesa stous apistous, parolo pou einai Mousoulmanoi kai eno o Allakh eikhe epiballei ekeine ten epokhe s' olous tous Mousoulmanous na metanasteusoun pros ton Prophete ste Mantina kai na egkataleipsoun tous apistous ste Makka. Kai otan bgekan oi eidololatres tes Makkas gia na polemesoun tous Mousoulmanous kata te makhe tou Mpantr, tous peran mazi tous gia na polemesoun tous Mousoulmanous. Opoioi skotothekan ap' autous, oi aggeloi pou tous aphairesan te zoe, tous] eipan: <<Se poia katastase esastan (me poia omada esastan, me tous pistous e me tous apistous);>> Ekeinoi apantesan: <<Emastan adunamoi ste ge (ste Makka, kai oi eidololatres mas apetrepsan apo ten piste kai apo to na akolouthesoume ton Prophete)!>> (Oi aggeloi tous) eipan: <<Den etan e ge tou Allakh arketa eurukhore gia na metanasteusete ekei (pros te Mantina);>> Gia tetoious anthropous, e katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, kai ti athlios proorismos einai autos!
Ektos apo tous adunamous antres, gunaikes kai paidia pou den eikhan mesa (e duname gia na apothesoun ten adikia apo ton eauto tous) oute kathodegethekan se enan tropo (diaphuges).
Ekeinoi einai pou isos o Allakh na tous sugkhoresei, kai pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aphoou (Autos pou dinei aphese gia ta panta) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Opoios metanasteusei sto dromo tou Allakh (apo to meros ton apiston pros to meros ton piston) tha brei ste ge polla kataphugia kai aphthones prometheies. Opoios bgei apo to spiti tou metanasteuontas sto dromo tou Allakh kai pros ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, alla ton prolabe o thanatos (prin phtasei ston proorismo tou), tha labei ten antamoibe tou apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Otan taxideuete ste ge, den uparkhei amartia s' esas na suntomeusete ten proseukhe (pou apoteleitai apo tesseris Rak'a -monades proseukhes- se duo Rak'a), ean phobaste oti oi apistoi mporei na sas blapsoun. Pragmati, oi apistoi einai enas phaneros ekhthros gia sas.

Otan eisai (o, Prophete) mazi me tous (pistous ste makhe) kai tous odegeis sten proseukhe, (as khoriseis to strato se duo omades, kai etsi,) as stathei mia omada ap' autous mazi sou (sten proseukhe), koubalontas ta opla tous (eno e alle omada na sas prostateusei). Otan teleiosoun (osoi einai ste prote omada) mia Rak'a (monada proseukhes, me ton Imame, tha ekhoun etsi teleiosei ten proseukhe tous kai), as pegainoun apo piso sas (pros te meria ton ekhthron), kai as erthei e alle omada pou den telese akome ten proseukhe, kai as telesoun mazi sou ten proseukhe (telontas mazi sou ten teleutaia Rak'a, kai epeita na sunekhisoun monoi tous ten proseukhe tous gia alle mia Rak'a), kai as prosekhoun koubalontas ta opla tous. Eukhontai oi apistoi na paramelesete ta opla kai ta uparkhonta sas, oste na exapolusoun mia aiphnidiastike epithese enantion sas. Alla den uparkhei amartia s' esas, ean aphesete ta opla sas (kai den ta koubalesete) otan kati sas blaptei apo brokhe e eiste arrostoi. Alla as prosekhete! Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei etoimasei gia tous apistous ena tapeinotiko marturio.

Otan teleiosete ten proseukhe, exumneiste ton Allakh (s' oles sas tis katastaseis), eite eiste orthioi, eite kathismenoi, eite xaplomenoi plagia. Alla otan eiste pali asphaleis, na teleite tis proseukhes (olokleromenes stis kathorismenes ores tous kai me ton olokleromeno tropo). Pragmati, e proseukhe epiballetai stous pistous se kathorismenes ores.

Men apodunamoneste sto na polemesete ton ekhthro. Ean ponate (apo pleges kai thanatous), pragmati, kai autoi ponane (apo pleges kai thanatous) opos eseis ponate. Elpizete apo ton Allakh auto pou den elpizoun (del. antamoibe kai uposterixe). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Pragmati, sou steilame (o, Prophete) to Biblio (to Kor'an) me ten aletheia, gia na krineis metaxu ton anthropon, sumphona me osa sou ekhei didaxei o Allakh. Men eisai loipon sunegoros ekeinon pou exapatoun (ton eauto tous, oi opoioi einai apo ton lao tou Tou'ma mpin Oumpairik), [O Tou'ma mpin Oumpairik eklepse mia aspida kai ten ekrupse sto spiti enos Ebraiou, kai otan emathan oi anthropoi gia ten klope, orkisteke o Tou'ma oti den etan autos pou ten eklepse, kai ste sunekheia, kategorese ton Ebraio. Etsi o laos tou Tou'ma zetese apo ton Prophete na uperaspistei ton Tou'ma kai na ton athoosei).
Kai zeta sugkhorese apo ton Allakh, st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Men uperaspisteis ekeinous pou exapatoun ton eauto tous (me tis amarties). Pragmati, o Allakh den sumpathei kanenan pou einai apateonas kai amartolos.

Krubontai (kai ntrepontai) apo tous anthropous, kai den krubontai (oute ntrepontai) apo ton Allakh, eno (o Allakh) tous blepei otan skhediasan krupha to bradu tetoia logia (del. na orkistoun oti o Tou'ma den eklepse kai na kategoresoun ton Ebraio me logia) pou den dekhetai (o Allakh). Pragmati, o Allakh periballei (me te Gnose Tou) ola osa kanoun.

Na eseis (pou noiazeste na uperaspisteite ekeinous pou ekanan ena egklema) eiste autoi pou tous uperaspistekate sten egkosmia zoe, poios loipon tha tous uperaspistei enopion tou Allakh kata ten Emera tes Anastases e poios tha einai o diakheiristes ton upotheseon tous (enopion tou Allakh);
Opoios kanei kati kako e adikei ton eauto tou (meso amartion) kai epeita zeta sugkhorese apo ton Allakh, tha brei ton Allakh Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Kai opoios kanei mia amartia, ten kanei mono eis baros tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
Opoios ekane mia amartia kata lathos e diepraxe mia amartia eskemmena kai epeita kategorei kapoion athoo gi' auten, pragmati, pherei ena baru psema kai mia phanere amartia.

An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh s' esena (o, Prophete), mia omada ap' autous (pou exapatoun ton eauto tous) tha eikhe apophasisei na se paraplanesei (me to na se mperdepsoun me lathos plerophories uposterizontas auton pou eklepse, oste na krineis lathos), kai den paraplanoun para mono ton eauto tous, oute mporoun na se blapsoun sto elakhisto. Pragmati, o Allakh sou esteile to Biblio kai te Sophia (Sounna) kai sou didaxe auto pou den exeres. Pragmati, e khare tou Allakh s' esena einai terastia.

Den uparkhei kalo se polles apo tis prosopikes sunomilies tous (del. ton anthropon), ektos apo kapoion pou parotrunei ten philanthropia, ten kalosune e te sumphiliose metaxu ton anthropon. Opoios to kanei auto, epizetontas ten eukharistese tou Allakh, tha tou dosoume megale antamoibe.

Kai opoios antitithetai ston Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant) aphou tou ekhei ginei phanere e kathodegese (kai o orthos dromos), kai akolouthei allon dromo ap' auton ton piston, tha ton egkataleipsoume sto dromo pou dialexe, kai tha ton eisagoume sten Kolase gia na kaei mesa tes - ti athlios proorismos einai autos!

Pragmati, o Allakh de sugkhorei to na Tou apodidontai etairoi (ste latreia)* alla sugkhorei otidepote allo ektos ap' auto gia opoion thelei. Opoios apodidei etairous ston Allakh (ste latreia) ekhei parastratesei polu makria.

Pragmati, auta pou (oi eidololatres) epikalountai ektos ap' Auton (ton Allakh), den einai para mono theluka (eidola me gunaikeia onomata, opos Al-Lat kai Al-'Ouzza, ta opoia oute mporoun na tous pheroun kati kalo, oute na apotrepsoun ap' autous kapoio kako). Kai den epikalountai, sten pragmatikoteta, para mono enan epanastatemeno Satana (epeide autos einai pou tous dietaxe na latreuoun ta eidola).
O Allakh ton katarasteke. Kai (o Satanas) eipe (orkizomenos): <<Tha piaso mia orismene omada apo tous doulous Sou.

Kai tha tous paraplaneso, tha tous diegeiro (pseutikes kai paraplanetikes) epithumies (pou tha tous odegoun makria apo ten upakoe pros Esena), tha tous diataxo na kopsoun (kai na skhisoun) ta autia ton booeidon kai tha tous diataxo na allaxoun te demiourgia tou Allakh (na allaxoun te threskeia tou Allakh kai tis morphes kai tis emphaniseis ton demiourgematon Tou).>> Opoios pairnei ton Satana os kedemona anti tou Allakh, pragmati, ekhei upostei mia phanere apoleia.
(O Satanas) tous uposkhetai (pseudos) kai tous diegeirei (pseutikes kai paraplanetikes) epithumies. Alla den tous uposkhetai o Satanas para mono autapates.
Gi' ekeinous (pou akolouthoun ta bemata tou Satana) e katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, kai den tha broun kamia diaphuge ap' auten.

Alla ekeinoi pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis, tha tous eisagoume se kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Tha katoikesoun ekei mesa (ston Paradeiso) gia panta. E uposkhese tou Allakh einai panta alethine. Poios einai pio eilikrines sto logo tou apo ton Allakh;

Den einai (e soteria kai to kerdos sumphona) oute me tous pothous sas oute me tous pothous tou laou tou Bibliou (del. ton Ebraion kai ton Khristianon). Opoios kanei to kako tha timorethei gi' auto kai den tha brei ektos tou Allakh oute kedemona oute uposterikte gi' auton.

Opoios kanei enaretes praxeis, eite einai andras, eite gunaika, eno einai pistos, einai ekeinoi pou tha eiselthoun ston Paradeiso kai den tha adikethoun (sten amoibe tous) oute oso o kokkos pou brisketai pano sto koukoutsi enos khourma.

Kai poios einai se kalutere threskeia ap' auton pou upotassei to prosopo tou (del. ton eauto tou) ston Allakh, kanontas tis kales praxeis, kai akolouthei te threskeia tou Impraem (Abraam) apoklinontas apo ola ta mataia dogmata, kai teinontas pros ten alethine piste; Kai o Allakh pere ton Impraem os epilegmeno!
Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge. Pragmati, o Allakh perikleiei ta panta (me te Gnose, te Duname kai te Diakheirise Tou).

Se rotoun (o, Prophete) skhetika me tis gunaikes (oson aphora ta dikaiomata kai ta kathekonta tous). Pes: <<O Allakh tha diasaphenisei gia sas skhetika m' autes. Kai (tha diasaphenisei) auta pou apaggellontai apo to Biblio s' esas skhetika me tis orphanes gunaikes (upo ten kedemonia sas) pou den tous dinete auta pou oristekan (apo ton Allakh) gi' autes (apo ta dikaiomata tous sten proika kai kleronomia klp.) ostoso epithumeite na tis pantreuteite (dinontas tous ligotera apo te sunethismene proika, e den epithumeite na tis pantreuteite, ostoso tis empodizete apo to na pantreutoun allon apo ten aplestia sas gia ta khremata tous). Kathos (tha diasaphenisei gia sas) kai skhetika me ta mikra paidia (oti tha prepei na tous dinete ta dikaiomata tous kai na men tous adikeite), kai oti prepei na sumperiphereste sta orphana me dikaiosune. O,ti kalo ki an kanete, o Allakh to gnorizei.>>.

Kai an mia gunaika phobatai alazonike sumperiphora e apostrophe ap' to suzugo tes (logo tou oti den einai omorphe e einai se megale elikia kai o andras tes thelei na te khorisei kai na pantreutei alle, tote) den uparkhei amartia se kanenan apo tous duo, an sumphiliothoun (me to na aphesei e suzugos kapoia apo ta dikaiomata tes ston andra tes oste na men te khorisei, opos to na men meinei mazi tes ton idio arithmo emeron opos menei me ten alle suzugo)* e sumphiliose einai kalutere (apo to diazugio). Pragmati, oi (anthropines) psukhes demiourgethekan mesa sten tsigkounia (kamia psukhe den thelei na aphesei tipote apo ta dikaiomata tes). An prattete to kalo (se ola ta themata sas) kai phulasseste apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Kai de tha mporesete na eiste dikaioi metaxu ton suzugon akoma ki an to prospathesete (m' ole sas te duname), epomenos men klinete uperbolika uper mias ex' auton (prospherontas tes perissotero khrono kai pronoia), aphenontas ten alle na kremetai (ontas oute diazeugmene, oute pantremene). Kai an diorthonete (tis praxeis sas, oste na eiste dikaioi anamesa stis suzugous sas), kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou skhetika me tis suzugous sas), pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Panteleemon).

Ma an khorisoun (me diazugio), o Allakh tha paraskhei aphthonia s' olous tous apo ten Eunoia Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Oasi' (Uper-Eparkes gia tis anagkes ton plasmaton Tou) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge. Ekhoume diataxei autous (Ebraious kai Khristianous) pou tous dotheke to Biblio prin ap' esas, kathos kai (diatazoume) esas: <<Na phulasseste apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).>> Alla an arnetheite ten piste, (na xerete oti) pragmati, o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge, anekoun ston Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Ganei (Plousios, Apallagmenos apo oles tis anagkes) kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).
Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge. Arkei o Allakh os Diakheiristes (olon ton upotheseon tes demiourgias Tou).
An thelei, mporei na sas exaphanisei entelos, o, anthropoi, kai na pherei allous (pou tha Ton upakoun kai de tha Ton parakousoun pote). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Ikanos na to kanei auto.

Opoios epidiokei ten antamoibe tes egkosmias zoes, (as mathei oti) pragmati, o Allakh ekhei ten antamoibe kai tes egkosmias zoes kai tes Mellousas Zoes. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta Panta).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na uposterizete te dikaiosune, dinontas marturia gia khare tou Allakh, akoma ki an einai enantion sas e enantion ton goneon sas e ton suggenon sas. Eite autos (pou skhetizetai me te marturia sas) einai plousios e phtokhos (as men sas epereazei to poso plousios e phtokhos einai ste marturia sas), st' aletheia, o Allakh dieuthetei kalutera apo sas ta themata tous (kai gnorizei kalutera apo sas to kalo tous). Men, loipon, akoloutheite tous pothous (tes kardias sas), oste na men apophugete te dikaiosune. Ean diastreblosete (te marturia sas) e arnetheite (na te dosete), st' aletheia, o Allakh gnorizei pleros o,ti kanete.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Pistepste ston Allakh, ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, sto Biblio pou esteile ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai sta Biblia pou esteile prin. Kai opoios arneite ten piste ston Allakh, stous aggelous Tou, sta Biblia Tou, stous Aggeliaphorous Tou kai sten Eskhate Emera, pragmati, ekhei parastratesei polu makria.

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pistepsan kai epeita arnethekan ten piste, kai epeita xanapistepsan kai epeita arnethekan xana ten piste, kai ste sunekheia auxesan ten apistia tous, o Allakh de tha tous sugkhoresei pote, oute tha tous kathodegesei ston isio dromo.
Aneggeile stous upokrites (pou deikhnoun oti einai pistoi eno kruboun mesa tous ten apistia), oti gi' autous tha uparkhei odunero marturio,
Oi opoioi pairnoun tous apistous os uposteriktes kai summakhous anti ton piston. Anazetoun te duname meso auton; Pragmati, ole e duname anekei ston Allakh.

(O, pistoi) pragmati, (o Allakh) sas ekhei steilei sto Biblio (to Kor'an) oti: opote akoute ta Edaphia tou Allakh na aporriptontai e na geloiopoiountai, men katheste mazi m' autous (pou ta geloiopoioun), mekhri autoi na allaxoun te suzetese, diaphoretika tha eiste san autous. Pragmati, o Allakh tha sugkentrosei olous tous upokrites kai tous apistous mazi sten Kolase.

Ekeinoi (oi upokrites) pou perimenoun kai parakolouthoun esas (gia na doun ti tha sas sumbei apo kalo e kako), ean o Allakh sas dosei te nike, lene (s' esas oste na paroun apo ta laphura): <<Den emastan mazi sas (uposterizontas sas);>> Alla an oi apistoi ekhoun meridio nikes (kai laphuron), lene (s' autous): <<Den sas boethesame kai den sas prostatepsame apo tous pistous (me to na tous apotharrunoume apo to na sas polemesoun);>> Alla o Allakh tha krinei metaxu sas ten Emera tes Anastases, kai o Allakh (ekeine ten Emera) de tha kanei gia tous apistous kanena tropo e epikheirema enantion ton piston.

Oi upokrites (nomizoun oti) xegeloun ton Allakh (deikhnontas ten piste kai krubontas ten apistia tous mesa tous), alla einai Autos pou tous xegelaei (antapodidontas ten praxe tous, dinontas tous tous kanones kai ta dikaiomata ton Mousoulmanon kata ten egkosmia zoe, kai ste Mellousa tha tous dosei phos mazi me tous Mousoulmanous, alla xaphnika tha sbesei to phos ton upokriton kai tha tous timoresei gia ten apistia kai ten upokrisia tous). Opote sekonontai gia proseukhe, sekonontai nokhelika, epideiknuontai stous anthropous, kai den mnemoneuoun ton Allakh para ligo,

Amphitalanteuomenoi, oute einai m' autous (tous pistous), oute einai m' ekeinous (tous apistous). Opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, de tha breis pote gi' auton kanenan tropo (gia na ton kathodegeseis).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men pairnete tous apistous os uposteriktes kai summakhous anti ton piston. Thelete na thesete enopion tou Allakh mia xekathare apodeixe enantion sas;
Pragmati, oi upokrites tha briskontai sto bathutero epipedo tou Puros, kai den tha briskeis gi' autous kanenan uposterikte.

Ektos ap' ekeinous pou straphekan me metameleia (pros ton Allakh), diorthosan (ton eauto tous kai tis praxeis tous), kratesan dunata te desmeuse pou anethese o Allakh (sto Biblio Tou stous doulous Tou, to na Ton upakoun) kai aphosiothekan ste threskeia pros ton Allakh. Ekeinoi tha einai me tous pistous (kai sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe) kai o Allakh tha dosei stous pistous mia megale antamoibe.
Giati na sas timoresei o Allakh, ean eiste eugnomones kai pisteuete; Pragmati, o Allakh einai Sakir (Eugnomon) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ston Allakh den aresei na eipothei to kako phonakhta (o Allakh misei kati tetoio kai proeidopoiei opoion to kanei), ektos an kapoios ekhei adikethei (tote s' auton epitrepetai na paraponietai demosia gia ton katapieste tou, na kanei epikleseis ston Allakh enantion tou katapieste e na apantesei ston katapieste s' auta pou tou eipe klp., alla to na deixei upomone einai kalutera apo to na pei auta demosia). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ean phaneronete kati kalo (eite logia eite praxe) e den to phaneronete, e sugkhoresete kapoio kako, pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aphoou (Autos pou dinei aphese gia ta panta) kai Kanteir (Ikanos sta panta).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou, kai theloun na kanoun diakrise (sten piste) metaxu tou Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoron Tou (del. to na pistepsoun ston Allakh, alla kai na arnountai kapoious apo tous Aggeliaphorous Tou, kati pou semainei oti arnountai kai ton Allakh pou tous esteile), kai lene: <<Emeis pisteuoume se merikous (Aggeliaphorous) kai arnoumaste merikous.>>, thelontas na paroun enan dromo sto endiameso (metaxu tes pistes kai tes apistias, nomizontas oti auto tha tous sosei),

Ekeinoi einai oi apistoi pragmatika (epeide opoios arneitai enan Aggeliaphoro, ekhei arnethei etsi ten piste ston Allakh kai s' olous tous allous Aggeliaphorous). Pragmati, ekhoume etoimasei gia tous apistous ena tapeinotiko marturio.

Alla osoi pisteuoun ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou kai den kanoun kamia diakrise se kanenan ap' autous (del. pisteuoun s' olous tous), tha tous dosei (o Allakh) tis antamoibes tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Sou zetaei o laos tou Bibliou (oi Ebraioi) na katebaseis epano tous (os thauma) ena Biblio apo ton ourano (grammeno, opos ephere o Mouses tis petrines plakes apo ton Allakh). (Men ekplessesai, o, Prophete, aphou oi progonoi tous) eikhan zetesei apo ton Mouse kati megalutero ap' auto, otan eipan: <<Deixe mas ton Allakh phanera!>> Etsi, tous khtupese e photia (apo ton ourano) logo tes adikias tous. Epeita (tous anestese o Allakh apo to eleos kai te gennaiodoria Tou, alla ekeinoi anti na einai eugnomones) peran to moskhari gia latreia parolo pou eikhan labei xekathara semadia (pou tous dietazan na latreuoun mono ton Allakh). Alla sugkhoresame auto (meta apo te metameleia tous) kai dosame ston Mouse mia megale apodeixe (pou epibebaionei ten apostole tou, kai ena epikheirema enantia tou laou tou).

Kai upsosame apo pano tous to oros (os proeidopoiese) logo tes desmeuses tous (pou elaban apo ton Allakh gia na ten teroun). Kai tous eipame: <<Peraste ten pule (tes poles tes Ierousalem) upoklinomenoi (del. me tapeinoteta pros ton Allakh, alla den to ekanan).>> Kai tous eipame (epises): <<Men parabiasete to Sabbato (psareuontas s' aute ten emera, alla to parabiasan).>> Kai perame ap' autous mia dunate desmeuse (alla ten athetesan).

Kai (tous Katarastekame) logo tou oti athetesan te desmeuse tous, arnethekan ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) tou Allakh, skotosan tous prophetes adika, kai logo tou logou tous: <<Oi kardies mas einai tuligmenes (del. den katalabainoume o,ti lene oi Prophetes).>> Antitheta (den einai opos iskhuristekan), o Allakh tis sphragise (tis kardies tous) logo tes apistias tous, etsi den pisteuoun, ektos apo ligous.
Kai (tous Katarastekame) gia ten apistia tous kai logo oti eipan enantion tes Marias mia terastia sukophantia (oti diepraxe paranome sunousia).

Kai (tous Katarastekame) epeide eipan (kaukhoumenoi): <<Skotosame ton Iesou Khristo, ton uio tes Marias, ton Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh.>>, ma den ton skotosan, oute ton staurosan. Alla etsi phaneke s' autous [del. e omoioteta tou prosopou tou Iesou, topothetetheke s' allon andra kai etsi ton skotosan nomizontas oti etan o Iesous]. Kai st' aletheia, autoi (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi) pou diepheran s' auto, amphiballoun gi' auto (to thema). Den ekhoun gnose gi' auto, para mono eikasies akolouthoun. Kai st' aletheia den ton skotosan.
Alla, o Allakh ton anebase (zontano) pros Auton (del. ston ourano). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai de tha uparkhei kanenas (Ebraios e Khristianos) apo ton lao tou Bibliou, pou den tha pistepsei s' auton (ton Iesou) prin to thanato tou (del. prin to thanato tou Iesou meta ten kathodo tou apo ton ourano sto telos tou khronou kai aphou tha kubernesei me dikaiosune). Kai ten Emera tes Kriseos autos (o Iesous) tha einai marturas s' autous (kai stis praxeis tous).
Gia tis kakes adikes praxeis ton Ebraion, apagorepsame gi' autous kapoies kales trophes, pou etan epitreptes gi' autous. Kai gia to oti empodisan pollous apo to dromo tou Allakh.

Kai gia to oti epairnan Rimpa (tokogluphia) an kai tous apagoreuotan na ten pairnoun, kai gia to oti katetrogan adika ten periousia ton anthropon. Kai ekhoume etoimasei gia tous apistous anamesa tous ena epoduno marturio.

Ma autoi anamesa tous pou ekhoun stathera themelia gnoses, kai oi pistoi, pisteuoun se o,ti staltheke s' esena (o, Mokhammant) kai se o,ti staltheke prin apo sena. Oi opoioi teloun ten proseukhe, kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, s' autous tha dosoume megale antamoibe.

Pragmati, Emeis apokalupsame s' esena (o, Mokhammant) opos apokalupsame sto Noe, kai stous Prophetes meta ap' auton* kai (epises) apokalupsame ston Impraem (Abraam), ston Ismael, ston Isaak, ston Iakobo, stous Al-Asmpat (tous prophetes apo tous apogonous tou Iakobou), ston Iesou, ston Iob, ston Iona, ston Aaron kai ston Solomonta* kai dosame sto Dabid to Zampour (to Theio Biblio).

Kai (steilame epises kai) kapoious Aggeliaphorous, gia tous opoious se ekhoume plerophoresei, kai kapoious allous Aggeliaphorous, gia tous opoious de se ekhoume plerophoresei! Kai pragmati, o Allakh milese ston Mouse (apeutheias khoris diamesolabete kai me tropo pou tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou).

(Autous tous) Aggeliaphorous (tous steilame) os phoreis kalon eideseon, kathos kai proeidopoietes, etsi oste e anthropoteta na men ekhei kamia dikaiologia apenanti ston Allakh aphotou (o Allakh esteile) tous Aggeliaphorous. Kai o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
Alla o Allakh martura gia o,ti sou esteile, to opoio esteile me te gnose Tou, kai oi aggeloi to marturoun. Kai arkei o Allakh os Marturas.
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnountai ten piste (s' esena, o, Prophete) kai empodizoun tous allous apo ton dromo tou Allakh (to Islam), ekhoun parastratesei polu makria.

Ekeinoi pou arnountai ten piste kai adikoun (ton eauto tous sunekhizontas peismatika sten apistia), o Allakh de tha tous sugkhoresei pote, oute tha tous kathodegesei se kapoio dromo (pou tha tous sosei),
Ektos apo ton dromo tes Kolases, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta. Kai auto einai polu eukolo gia ton Allakh.

O, anthropoi! Pragmati erthe s' esas o Aggeliaphoros me ten aletheia apo ton Kurio sas, gi' auto pistepste epeide einai to kalutero gia sas. Alla an arneiste ten piste, (na xerete oti) pragmati ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste Ge. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

O, lae tou Bibliou! Men uperballete ste threskeia sas, kai me lete gia ton Allakh tipote allo, para mono ten aletheia.
