St' aletheia, o Messias, o Iesous, o gios tes Mariam (Marias), den einai para enas Apostolos tou Allakh, kai mia lexe ap' Auton (del. demiourgetheke me ten entole tou Allakh <<Gennetheto!>> -kai etsi egine.) ten opoia (lexe) esteile (me ton aggelo Gabrel) pros te Mariam, ki ena pneuma pou demiourgese (o Allakh, kai o Allakh dietaxe ton Gabriel na emphusesei to pneuma tou Iesou ste metra tes Mariam). Pistepste loipon ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou kai men lete <<triada>>, stamateste, kalutera gia sas. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Enas Theos. Doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros apo to na ekhei enan uio. S' Auton anekei o,ti brisketai stous ouranous kai o,ti brisketai ste Ge. Kai arkei o Allakh gia na dieuthetei oles tis upotheseis.

Pote o Messias de tha aperripte apo uperopsia e alazoneia na einai doulos tou Allakh, oute oi aggeloi pou einai konta (ston Allakh). Kai opoios aporriptei te latreia Tou apo uperopsia kai einai alazonas, tote Autos tha tous sugkentrosei olous mazi pros Auton.

Oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha tous dosei pleros tis antamoibes tous, kai apo te khare Tou tha tous tis auxesei. Ma oso gi' ekeinous pou aporriptoun apo uperopsia (te latreia Tou) kai einai alazones, tha tous timoresei me epoduno marturio, kai de tha broun gia tous eautous tous ektos tou Allakh kanenan kedemona e uposterikte.
O, anthropoi! St' aletheia, elthe s' esas mia apodeixe (o Prophetes Mokhammant) apo ton Kurio sas. Kai steilame kato s' esas ena phanero Phos (to Kor'an).
Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai kratoun gera auto (to Kor'an), Autos tha tous eisagei sto eleos kai te khare Tou kai tha tous kathodegesei ston isio dromo pros Auton.

Sas rotoun (o, Prophete), pes: <<O Allakh tha diasaphenisei gia sas skhetika me ten kleronomia autounou pou pethane kai den ekhei oute patera oute paidi (gio e kore). An pethanei enas kai den ekhei paidi, alla ekhei mia adelphe (e eterothale adelphe apo ten pleura tou patera tou), aute tha parei to miso tes kleronomias pou aphese. Omoios, autos (o adelphos e eterothales adelphos apo ten pleura tou patera tes) tha ten kleronomesei, an (pethanei aute e adelphe kai) den ekhei paidi. An, omos, uparkhoun duo adelphes (tou apothanontos e duo eterothaleis adelphes apo ten pleura tou patera tou), tha moirastoun ta duo trita tes kleronomias pou aphese. Ean uparkhoun kai arsenika kai theluka adelphia, tote to meridio enos arsenikou einai iso me auto ton duo thelukon.>> O Allakh diasaphenizei gia sas, oste na men parastratesete. Kai o Allakh einai Pantognostes ton panton.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Ekpleroste tis diathekes (sas pros ton Allakh kai pros tous anthropous). Epitrepontai s' esas ola ta zoa pou boskoun, ektos apo o,ti apaggelletai s' esas (oti apagoreuetai na ta phate), kathos kai (oti apagoreuetai) to kunegi eno briskeste se katastase Ikhram (gia proskunema). O Allakh orizei o,ti thelei (epitrepei o,ti thelei kai apagoreuei o,ti thelei, sumphona me te sophia Tou, kai kaneis den mporei na deixei antirrese s' auto).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men parabiazete tis teletourgies tou Allakh (ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh kai ta semadia tes threskeias Tou), oute (na polemate kata) tous ierous menes (De-El-Ki'nta, De-El-Khitza, Moukharram kai Ratzamp), oute (na parete kati apo) tis thusies (pou prospherontai gia na thusiazontai ston Iero Oiko e na tis empodisete na phtasoun ston Iero Oiko), oute (na parete kati apo) ta zoa pou ekhoun perideraia (apo malli klp. os semadi oti proorizontai gia thusia), oute (na epitetheite se) autous (tous proskunetes) pou pegainoun ston Iero Oiko anazetontas te gennaiodoria tou Kuriou tous (del. kerdos apo to emporio) kai ten eukharistese (Tou). Otan bgeite apo ten katastase Ikhram (kai teleiosete to proskunema sas), mporeite na kunegesete. Ostoso, men aphesete to misos gia kapoious pou sas apetrepsan apo to Iero Tzami, na sas odegesei se parabase (tes dikaiosunes kai ton orion pou tethekan apo ton Allakh skhetika m' autous). Kai sunergasteite (o, pistoi) sten arete (kai se o,ti sas dietaxe o Allakh) kai sto na prophulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (apekhontas apo o,ti sas apagoreuse o Allakh)* kai me sunergasteite sten amartia kai sten parabase. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou). St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria Tou.

Apagoreumena (phageta) gia sas einai: ta pethamena zoa, (pou den ekhoun sphagiastei), to aima, e sarka ton khoiron, ta zoa kata te sphage ton opoion ekhei mnemoneuthei allo onoma ektos tou Onomatos tou Allakh, kai auta pou skotothekan me straggalismo (e me pnigmo klp.) e me biaio khtupema, e me ragdaia ptose, e me khtupema keraton apo allo zoo - kai auto pou ekhei (en merei) phagothei apo agrio zoo - ektos apo o,ti (apo ta proanapheromena) prolabete na to sphagiasete (prin to thanato tou apo tis proanapheromenes aities) - (epises apagoreuetai) kai auto pou sphagiasteke pano stis An-Nousoump (tis petres guro apo ten Ka'mpa, tis opoies latreuan oi eidololatres kai thusiazan zoa gi' autes kai ta sphagiazan pano s' autes). Epises kai (apagoreumeno einai) na epizetesete na mathete ti oristeke gia sas sto mellon me ten klerose me bele [mia praktike pou ekanan oi eidololatres gia na paroun mia mellontike apophase, gia taxidi e gamo klp., kai etsi egraphan se ena belos 'kane' kai sto allo 'men kaneis' kai trabagan ena ap' auta gia na mathoun ten tukhe tous kai ti prepei na kanoun]. Ola auta (ta proanapheromena) apoteloun anupakoe pros ton Allakh. Semera, apelpistekan oi apistoi apo to na sas apomakrunoun apo te threskeia sas (aphou sas edosa nike pano tous), etsi men tous phobaste, alla Emena mono na phobaste. Semera oloklerosa te threskeia sas gia sas, oloklerosa ten Eunoia Mou s' esas, kai ekho dialexei gia sas to Islam os threskeia sas. Alla an kapoios exanagkazetai apo entone peina (na phaei apo auta ta proanapheromena), khoris na skopeuei na amartesei, tote (as mathei oti) o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Se rotoun (o, Prophete) ti epitrepetai s' autous (apo phageto). Pes: <<Epitrepontai gia sas ola ta kala (phageta), kai o,ti therama pianetai apo ta arpaktika pou ekpaideuete (del. ta zoa e ta poulia pou ekhoun kunodontes e nukhia, san ta skulia, tis leopardaleis kai ta gerakia, ta opoia stelnete gia na kunegesoun gia sas). Ta ekpaideuete (pos na kunegesoun) apo o,ti gnose sas parakhorese o Allakh (kai etsi trekhoun e stamatoun opos tous diatazete). Phate apo o,ti pianoun gia sas (kai men phate ap' auta pou epiasan gia ton eauto tous e ephagan ap' auta). Kai na anapherete to Onoma tou Allakh otan ta stelnete (na kunegesoun gia sas). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).>> Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros ston upologismo (ton praxeon ton doulon Tou, kai sto na tous antameibei e na tous timorei gi' autes).

Semera ola ta kala (phageta) einai epitrepta gia sas, kai sas epitrepetai na phate apo to phageto (del. tis thusies) ton anthropon tou Bibliou (Ebraion kai Khristianon), kai to phageto (del. oi thusies) sas einai epitrepto gi' autous. Kai (epitrepetai gia sas na pantreuteite) tis agnes pistes (Mousoulmanes) kai tis agnes (Ebraies kai Khristianes) apo tous anthropous pou tous dotheke to Biblio prin apo sas (ten Tora tou Mouse kai to In-tzel tou Iesou), an tous dinete ten proika tous kai an eiste agnoi kai den diaprattete moikheia, oute ekhete eromenes. Opoios arneitai ten piste, pragmati, oles oi kales praxeis tou tha einai mataies, kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha brisketai anamesa stous khamenous.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan sekoneste gia ten proseukhe, plunte ta prosopa sas kai ta kheria sas mekhri tous agkones, peraste ta (bregmena) kheria sas pano sta kephalia sas kai (plunte) ta podia sas mekhri tous astragalous. An eiste Tzounoump (se katastase megales akatharsias apo sexoualike epaphe), tote plutheite (kanontas Gousl -pleres ntous-). An omos eiste arrostoi, e taxideuete, e kapoios apo sas erkhetai apo te phusike tou anagke (aphodeuse) e ekhete sexoualike epaphe me tis gunaikes sas kai den briskete nero, tote pegainete pros kathare skone (e ammo e khoma, gia na ektelesete Tagiammoum khtupontas ten me tis duo palames sas mia phora) kai skoupiste (me tis palames sas) ta prosopa kai ta kheria sas (me ten palame tou aristerou kheriou pano sto dexi kheri mekhri ton karpo kai to antistropho). O Allakh den thelei na sas balei se duskolies, alla thelei na sas exagnisei kai na oloklerosei te khare Tou s' esas, mepos kai ginete eugnomones.

Thumetheite ten eunoia tou Allakh s' esas kai te desmeuse Tou pou anethese s' esas otan eipate (ston Prophete): <<Akoume kai upakoume.>> Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Pantognostes gia o,ti brisketai sta stethe (ton anthropon).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na eiste statheroi sten ektelese ton dikaiomaton tou Allakh s' esas (me to na Ton latreuete khoris na Tou apodidete kanenan etairo) kai na eiste martures me dikaiosune. Kai na men sas odegei to misos gia kapoious na egkataleipsete te dikaiosune. Na eiste dikaioi. Auto einai to plesiestero sten eusebeia. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia osa kanete Pantognostes.
O Allakh ekhei uposkhethei s' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis, oti tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai megale antamoibe.
Alla ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas, tha einai oi katoikoi tou Puros tes Kolaseos.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Thumetheite ten eunoia tou Allakh s' esas otan kapoioi apophasisan na tentosoun ta kheria tous enantion sas, alla o Allakh kratese ta kheria tous makria apo sas. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai ston Allakh as basizontai oi pistoi.

O Allakh pere te desmeuse apo ta paidia tou Israel kai orise dodeka arkhegous ap' autous. O Allakh eipe: <<Eimai mazi sas (kai tha sas uposterizo enantia ston ekhthro sas, an diatereite te desmeuse pou sas anethesa). Kai ean teleite ten proseukhe, dinete te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), pisteuete stous Aggeliaphorous Mou kai tous uposterizete, kai dinete ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas gia khare tou Allakh se kathe kalo dromo), sigoura tha sugkhoreso gia sas tis amarties sas kai tha sas eisago se kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Alla opoios apo sas arneitai ten piste meta ap' aute (te desmeuse), pragmati, ekhei parastratesei apo ton isio dromo.>>

Alla logo tes parabiases tes desmeuse tous apo ten pleura tous, tous katarastekame kai skleruname tis kardies tous (kai etsi kamia nouthesia de tha tous ophelesei). Diastreblonoun tis lexeis (tes Toras) apo tis sostes theseis (ennoies) tous kai xekhasan (paramelesan) mere ap' auta pou eikhan diatakhthei. Kai exakoloutheis na briskeis (kai na anakalupteis, o, Prophete) prodosia apo ten pleura tous ektos apo ligous ap' autous (pou ekplerosan te desmeuse tous pros ton Allakh). Sugkhorese tous, loipon, (gia ten kakometakheirise pou ekanan apenanti sou) kai parablepse ta lathe tous, pragmati, o Allakh agapa autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Kai ap' autous pou eipan: <<Emeis eimaste Nasara [Khristianoi] (del. akolouthoi kai uposteriktes tou Iesou).>>, Emeis perame desmeuse ap' autous (to na akolouthoun ta authentika didagmata tou Iesou), ma autoi xekhasan (paramelesan) ena meros ap' o,ti eikhan diatakhthei (kai diastreblosan te threskeia tous, opos ekanan oi Ebraioi prin ap' autous). Etsi, rixame anamesa tous ekhthra kai misos mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases* kai tote o Allakh tha tous enemerosei gi' o,ti ekanan (kai tha tous timoresei gi' auta).

O, lae tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi)! Tora erthe s' esas o Aggeliaphoros Mas (o Mokhammant), phaneronei s' esas polla ap' osa krubate (apo tous koinous Ebraious kai Khristianous) apo to Biblio (ten Tora kai to In-tzel, kai o,ti diastreblosate kai prosthesate s' auta), kai aphenei polla (pou den uparkhei ophelos na ta phanerosei). Pragmati, ekhei erthei s' esas apo ton Allakh ena phos (o Prophetes Mokhammant) kai ena xekatharo Biblio (to Kor'an).

Me to opoio (Kor'an) o Allakh kathodegei autous pou akolouthoun o,ti Ton eukharistei, stous dromous tes asphaleias (apo ten timoria Tou), kai tous bgazei me te boulese Tou apo to skotadi (odegontas tous) sto phos kai tous kathodegei ston isio dromo.

Pragmati, ekhoun apostatesei autoi pou lene: <<O Allakh einai o Messias (Iesous Khristos), o uios tes Mariam (Marias).>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Poios, loipon, tha eikhe ten paramikre duname apenanti ston Allakh, an Ekeinos ethele na katastrepsei ton Messia, ton uio tes Mariam (Marias), kai te metera tou, kai olous osous briskontai ste Ge;>> Kai ston Allakh anekei e Kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai olon oson briskontai anamesa tous. Demiourgei o,ti thelei, kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi lene: <<Eimaste oi gioi tou Allakh kai oi agapemenoi Tou.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Tote giati sas timorei gia tis amarties sas; St' aletheia, eiste mono anthropoi, ap' osous demiourgese* sugkhorei opoion thelei kai timorei opoion thelei.>> Kai ston Allakh anekei e Kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges, kai olon oson briskontai anamesa tous. Kai s' Auton brisketai o telikos proorismos (ton panton).

O, laoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi)! Pragmati, erthe s' esas o Aggeliaphoros Mas, gia na sas diasaphenisei (ten aletheia kai ten kathodegese), meta apo ena khroniko diastema kata to opoio den stalthekan Aggeliaphoroi (to opoio einai to diastema anamesa ston Iesou kai ton Mokhammant), oste na men peite: <<Den mas erthe kanenas Aggeliaphoros kharmosunon eideseon oute kanenas proeidopoietes.>> Tora, sas erthe enas Aggeliaphoros kharmosunon eideseon kai proeidopoietes. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Kai (anephere, o, Prophete) otan o Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<O, lae mou! Thumetheite ten eunoia tou Allakh s' esas otan diorise Prophetes anamesa sas (gia na sas kathodegesoun ston isio dromo), sas ekane basiliades (gia na kuriarkheite ola ta themata sas, aphou esastan prin douloi gia ton Pharao) kai sas edose autes (tis khares) pou den eikhe dosei se kanenan allon ston kosmo (tes epokhes sas).

O, lae mou! Mpeite (kai polemeste tous apistous) sten iere pole pou ekhei orisei o Allakh gia sas (oso eiste pistoi), kai men gurisete piso (khoris na tous polemesete) giati allios tha epistrepsete os ettemenoi (kai sten egkosmia kai ste Mellousa Zoe).>>
Eipan: <<O, Mouse! Mesa sten (pole) uparkhei enas polu iskhuros laos, kai de tha mpoume s' aute mekhri na bgoun ap' aute, kai mono otan bgoun ap' aute, tote tha mpoume.>>

Duo antres (apo tous suntrophous tou Mouse) ap' ekeinous pou phobountan ton Allakh kai o Allakh eikhe eunoesei kai tous duo (me ten upakoe pros Auton), eipan: <<Mpeite s' autous apo ten pule, kai otan tha mpeite ap' aute, sigoura tha eiste oi niketes (aphou ekteleite ten entole tou Allakh, akolouthontas tis aities tes nikes). Kai ston Allakh enapotheste ten empistosune sas an eiste pistoi.>>
Eipan: <<O, Mouse! De tha mpoume pote s' aute (ten pole) oso autoi einai mesa tes. Pegaine esu kai o Kurios sou kai polemeste, emeis tha kathisoume edo!>>
Eipe (o Mouses): <<Kurie mou! Den ekho kamia exousia ektos s' emena kai ston adelpho mou, opote khorise mas ap' autous tous anupakouous anthropous.>>

(O Allakh) eipe: <<Aute e pole tha einai apagoreumene gi' autous gia saranta khronia, kata ta opoia tha periplanontai ste ge (sten eremo). Gi' auto, me stenakhoriesai (o, Mouse) gia tous anupakouous anthropous.>>

Aphegesou (o, Mokhammant) s' autous (tous Ebraious) me ten aletheia ten istoria ton duo gion tou Adam (tou Kampel -Kain- kai tou Khampel -Abel-), otan kai oi duo prospheran mia thusia (apo kathenan tous). Alla (e prosphora) egine dekte apo ton enan (ton Khampel) kai den egine dekte apo ton allon (ton Kampel). Eipe (o Kampel): <<Tha se skotoso.>> Eipe (o Khampel): <<O Allakh dekhetai mono ap' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).
Ean aploseis to kheri sou pros emena gia na me skotoseis, den tha aploso to kheri mou pros esena gia na se skotoso! Pragmati, phobamai ton Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.

(Sunekhise o Khampel legontas gia na ton phobisei) thelo na koubaleseis ten amartia (sou) enantion mou (tou phonou mou) mazi m' oles tis proegoumenes amarties sou, kai etsi tha eisai enas apo tous katoikous tes Photias. Aute einai e timoria ton adikon!>>
Alla o idios tou o eautos (Kampel) ton parotrune kai tou ekane na phanei dikaios o phonos tou adelphou tou. Etsi, ton skotose kai egine enas apo tous khamenous!

Epeita, o Allakh esteile ena koraki na skapsei to edaphos (gia na thapsei allo nekro koraki) gia na tou deixei (ston Kampel) pos na thapsei to ptoma tou adelphou tou. Eipe (o Kampel): <<Alimono mou! Den kataphera oute na gino san auto to koraki gia na thapso to ptoma tou adelphou mou;>> Kai etsi egine enas ap' autous pou epesan se tupseis.

Ex' aitias autou, diataxame ta paidia tou Israel, pos an kapoios skotosei kapoion okhi os antapodose gia kapoio phono pou diepraxe e gia na exaplosei to kako ste ge, tha etan san na eikhe skotosei ole ten anthropoteta, kai an kapoios sosei mia zoe, tha etan san na esoze te zoe oles tes anthropotetas. Pragmati, erthan s' autous oi Aggeliaphoroi Mas me xekathares apodeixeis, kai epeita ap' auto polloi ap' autous akoma amartanoun uperbolika ste ge.

E poine gi' ekeinous pou diexagoun polemo (kai ekhthroteta) enantion tou Allakh kai tou Aggeliaphorou Tou, kai skorpizoun to kako (opos oi summories sta bouna pou eisbaloun sta emporika karabania, lesteuontas kai skotonontas klp.) ste ge, einai oti prepei na ektelestoun, e na staurothoun, e na akroteriastoun ta kheria kai ta podia tous se antithetes pleures (del. to dexi tou kheri mekhri ton karpo, kai to aristero tou podi mekhri to astragalo, kai an epistrepsei sta egklemata tou, tote to aristero tou kheri mekhri ton karpo, kai to dexi tou podi mekhri to astragalo) e na exoristoun apo te ge aute. Auto einai atimose gi' autous sten egkosmia zoe kai gi' autous ste Mellousa Zoe tha uparxei megalo marturio.
Ektos ap' ekeinous pou metaniosan prin na tous piasete. Na xerete oti o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), anazeteste ta mesa pou sas phernoun pio konta Tou (meso ton praxeon latreias pros Auton) kai na agonizeste ston dromo Tou (enantia stous apistous), mepos kai petukhete.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, akoma ki an katekhoun o,ti brisketai ste Ge kai alla tosa, gia na lutrothoun apo ten timoria tes Emeras tes Anastases, de tha ginotan dekto ap' autous, kai gi' autous tha uparkhei ena odunero marturio.
Tha epithumoun na bgoun apo te Photia, alla de tha bgoun pote ap' auten, kai gi' autous tha uparkhei ena aionio marturio.

Kai oso gia ton klephte, andra e gunaika, kopse to (dexi) kheri tou/tes (apo ton karpo), os poine gi' auto pou diepraxan* mia poine os paradeigma apo ton Allakh. Kai o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Alla opoios strephetai me alethine metameleia pros ton Allakh meta apo ten adikia tou (te lesteia pou ekane) kai diorthosei (tis praxeis tou), o Allakh tha dekhtei te metameleia tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos). [Omos, e metameleia tou den katargei ten poine tou, an autos ekhei ede phtasei sta kheria tou kubernete].
Den emathes (o, Prophete) oti ston Allakh anekei oloklere e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges; Timorei opoion thelei kai sugkhorei opoion thelei, kai o Allakh einai sta panta Ikanos.

O, Aggeliaphore! Me stenakhoriesai logo ekeinon pou speudoun sten apistia, oi opoioi einai apo ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou lene mono me ta stomata tous: <<Pisteuoume.>>, eno oi kardies tous den pisteuoun, kai apo ekeinous tous Ebraious (pou ethelan na krineis skhetika me ten Ebraia pou diepraxe moikheia), oi opoioi akoun polu to psema (apo tous rabinous oti e krise tes Toras gia te moikheia einai to mastigoma, eno ste pragmatikoteta, e krise tes Toras einai o lithobolismos) kai akoun tous allous (Ebraious tes Khaimper kai tes Phantak) pou den erthan s' esena. Diastreblonoun tis lexeis (sten Tora) apo tis sostes theseis tous, kai lene (s' autous pou erthan s' esena): <<An sas dothei auto (pou epithumeite, apo ten krise tou Mokhammant, del. to mastigoma) tote apodekhteite to, alla an den sas dothei (kai sas eipe o Mokhammant oti e krise sten Tora einai o lithobolismos), tote prosexte (kai men dekhteite ten krise tou).>> Opoion thelei o Allakh na paraplanethei, de tha mporeis na apotrepseis tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh gi' auton. Ekeinoi einai pou o Allakh den ethele na exagnisei tis kardies tous. Tha ekhoun sten egkosmia zoe atimose, kai tha laboun ste Mellousa Zoe ena megalo marturio.

Akoun polu ta psemata kai katanalonoun polu ta apagoreumena kerde (opos ten tokogluphia klp.). An erthoun s' esena (o, Prophete), (ekheis ten epiloge) e na krineis metaxu tous, e na apomakruntheis ap' autous. Ean apomakruntheis ap' autous, den mporoun na se blapsoun se tipote. Alla an krineis, tote krine metaxu tous me dikaiosune. Pragmati, o Allakh agapa tous dikaious.

Kai pos na anazetoun ten krise sou (aphou den pisteuoun s' esena -elpizontas oti e krise sou tha tairiaze me tis epithumies tous- kai) aphou ekhoun ten Tora (pou iskhurizontai oti pisteuoun s' aute) pou periekhei ten krise tou Allakh, kai epeita na apomakrunontai (apo ten krise sou) meta ap' auto (otan blepoun oti e krise sou den tairiazei me tis epithumies tous); Tetoioi anthropoi den einai pistoi (aphou arnountai ten krise tes Toras kai ten krise sou)!

St' aletheia, steilame ten Tora (ston Mouse), pou perieikhe kathodegese kai phos, me ten opoia ekrinan metaxu ton Ebraion, oi prophetes pou upotakhthekan ste Boulese tou Allakh (kai stis entoles Tou sten Tora, kai den ekrinan me kati allo ektos me aute). Epises kai oi eusebeis logioi kai oi rabinoi (ekrinan) me o,ti tous empisteuteke (kai tous dotheke apo tous prophetes) apo to Biblio tou Allakh, kai etan martures s' auto. Etsi, (o, eusebeis logioi) me phobaste tous anthropous (sto na krinete metaxu tous me to Biblio Mou), alla Emena na phobaste. Kai men exagorasete ta Edaphia Mou (egkataleipontas ten krise m' auta e krubontas kapoia ap' auta gia khare kapoion anthropon) gia mia exeutelistike time. Kai opoioi den krinoun sumphona m' o,ti esteile o Allakh, pragmati, tetoioi einai oi apistoi.

Kai orisame gi' autous mesa tes (Toras) oti: <<Zoe anti zoes, ophthalmon anti ophthalmou, mute anti mutes, auti anti autiou, odonta anti odontos kai pleges, ises me ises. Ma an kapoios sugkhoresei aphenontas ta antipoina, tha einai gi' auton mia exileose (gia kapoies amarties tou). Kai opoioi den krinoun m' o,ti esteile o Allakh, pragmati, tetoioi einai oi adikoi.

Kai sta bemata tous, steilame ton Iesou, uio tes Marias, pou epibebaiose ten Tora pou staltheke prin ap' auton, kai tou dosame to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou), sto opoio uperkhe kathodegese kai phos, kai to opoio epibebaiose ten Tora pou staltheke prin ap' auto, kai apotelouse kathodegese kai nouthesia gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou).

As krinei o laos tou In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou) [mporei kai na semainei: (kai dosame ston Iesou to In-tzel) oste na krinei o laos tou In-tzel] sumphona me o,ti apokalupse o Allakh mesa tou. Kai opoioi den krinoun m' o,ti apokalupse o Allakh, tetoioi einai oi anupakouoi.

Kai steilame s' esena (o, Mokhammant) to Biblio (to Kor'an) me ten Aletheia, to opoio epibebaionei ta Biblia pou stalthekan prin ap' auto kai steketai os kriterio s' auta (martura tis aletheies pou akoma uparkhoun mesa tous, kai diapseudei oti pseudos uparkhei mesa tous). Krine, loipon, (o, Prophete) anamesa tous (olous tous opadous ton allon threskeion pou erkhontai s' esena gia na krineis metaxu tous) m' auto (to Kor'an) pou esteile o Allakh kai men akoloutheis tous mataious pothous tous, apoklinontas apo ten aletheia pou erthe s' esena. Ston kathena (lao) orisame kanones kai ena xekatharo dromo (gia na kathodegeitai). An ethele o Allakh, tha sas ekane ena ethnos, alla (den to ekane) gia na sas dokimasei se o,ti sas ekhei dosei. Na sunagonizeste, loipon, stis kales praxeis. E epistrophe olon sas einai ston Allakh, kai tote tha sas enemerosei gia o,ti diaphonousate.

Krine, loipon, (o, Mokhammant) anamesa tous m' auto pou esteile o Allakh kai men akoloutheis tous mataious pothous tous. Kai prosexe ap' autous na me se strepsoun makria apo kapoia ap' auta pou esteile o Allakh s' esena. An omos apomakrunthoun (ap' auta pou ekrines), tote na xereis oti auto egine epeide o Allakh thelei na tous timoresei (del. na tous apomakrunei apo ten kathodegese) gia kapoies apo tis amarties tous. Kai st' aletheia, polu anthropoi einai anupakouoi.

Epizetoun, loipon, ten krise (ton nomon) tes Al-Tzakhilia (tes agnoias kai tes adikias sten pro-Islamike epokhe, arnoumenoi tous nomous tou Allakh pou basizontai se dikaiosune, gnose kai kathodegese); Kai gia enan lao pou ekhei bathia piste, poios einai kaluteros sten krise apo ton Allakh; [Kaneis, aphou pisteuoun oti e krise tou Allakh einai e Aletheia, eno oi anthropoi tes planes epizetoun adikous nomous pou sumbadizoun me tous pothous tous].

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men parete tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous os kedemones, einai kedemones o enas tou allou. Opoios ap' esas tous pairnei os kedemones, einai pragmati enas ap' autous. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei ton adiko lao.

Blepeis (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou ekhoun astheneia sten kardia tous na speudoun (me storge) pros autous (tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous gia na tous paroun os kedemones), kai lene (ston eauto tous): <<(Speudoume pros autous me storge epeide) Phobomaste (an nikesoun tous Mousoulmanous, tote) na mas khtupesei mia sumphora (ap' autous).>> Isos, o Allakh pherei te nike (gia ton Prophete Tou kai tous pistous) e kapoia alle apophase ap' Auton, kai tote tha metaniosoun (oi upokrites) gia o,ti ekrupsan (apo upokrisia) ston eauto tous.

Oi pistoi lene: <<Autoi (oi upokrites) einai ekeinoi pou orkistekan me to Onoma tou Allakh me polu zelo sten orkomosia tous oti einai mazi sas (o, pistoi, sten piste kai ten uposterixe);>> Oi (kales) praxeis tous eginan mataies, kai etsi autoi eginan khamenoi.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Opoios ap' esas apostatesei apo te threskeia tou, o Allakh tha pherei allous anthropous pou tha tous agapesei kai autoi tha Ton agapesoun. Tha einai eleemones apenanti stous pistous, alla dunatoi apenanti stous apistous. Tha agonizontai sto dromo tou Allakh kai de tha phobountai kamia epikrise apo kanenan epikrite. Aute einai e eunoia tou Allakh pou parakhorei s' opoion thelei (o Allakh). Kai o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkoun gi' olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Oi kedemones (kai oi uposteriktes) sas den einai para mono o Allakh, o Aggeliaphoros Tou, kai oi pistoi pou teloun ten proseukhe kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai einai upotagmenoi (ston Allakh).

Opoios pairnei ton Allakh, ton Aggeliaphoro Tou kai tous pistous os kedemones (kai uposteriktes, as xerei oti) pragmati, e omada tou Allakh einai oi niketes (aphou o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes tous).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men pairnete os kedemones (kai uposteriktes) oute ekeinous pou peran te threskeia sas os kati asteio kai paikhnidi, ap' autous (tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous) stous opoious dotheke to Biblio prin ap' esas, oute tous apistous. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) an eiste pragmati pistoi.
Kai otan kaleite gia proseukhe (meso tou Adan -to kalesma gia proseukhe-), to pairnoun os kati asteio kai paikhnidi. Auto epeide einai enas laos pou den sullogizetai.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi)! Mas kategoreite mono epeide pisteuoume ston Allakh kai s' o,ti staltheke s' emas kai s' o,ti staltheke apo prin, kai oti oi perissoteroi ap' esas einai anupakouoi;>> [Auto pou mas kategoreite einai axiepaino gi' emas, okhi katakriteo].

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous pistous): <<Na sas enemeroso gi' ekeinous pou tha ekhoun kheirotere timoria apo ton Allakh (ap' autous tous anupakouous); Einai ekeinoi (oi progonoi tous) pou tous katarasteke o Allakh kai upestesan ten orge Tou, kai apo tous opoious metetrepse kapoious se pithekous kai khoirous, kai oi opoioi latreuan allous ektos tou Allakh. Ekeinoi tha ekhoun te kheirotere these (kata te Mellousa Zoe) kai einai ekeinoi pou parastratesan apo ton isio dromo (sten egkosmia zoe).>>

Otan (oi upokrites anamesa tous) erkhontai s' esas (o, pistoi) lene (mono me tis glosses tous): <<Pisteuoume.>>, alla st' aletheia, mpekan (s' esas) me ten apistia (stis kardies tous) kai bgekan (ap' esas) me ten apistia (stis kardies tous). O Allakh gnorizei kalutera o,ti kruboun.

Blepeis (o, Prophete) pollous ap' autous na speudoun sten amartia kai ten parabase kai na katanalonoun apagoreumena kerde (apo tokogluphia kai dorodokia klp.). Pragmati, polu athlio einai auto pou kanoun!

Giati oi rabinoi kai oi logioi tous den tous apagoreuoun na lene logia amartias (apo psemata kai pseudorkia klp.) kai na katanalonoun apagoreumena kerde (apo tokogluphia kai dorodokia klp.); Pragmati, polu athlio einai auto pou kanoun (oi rabinoi tous pou den tous apagoreuoun to kako)!

Kai oi Ebraioi eipan: <<To Kheri tou Allakh einai sphikhto (del. kratese apo mas tis khares kai te gennaiodoria Tou).>> As sphikhtoun ta kheria tous (apo to na prattoun to kalo) kai kataramenoi na einai gi' auto pou eipan. St' aletheia, ta duo Kheria Tou einai aplomena (me to kalo kai te gennaiodoria) kai dinei opos thelei. Kai auto pou sou ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio sou, tha auxesei pollous ap' autous (logo tes zelias kai tou phthonou tous) se parabase kai apistia! Ekhoume rixei metaxu tous (ton aireseon tous) ekhthroteta kai misos mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases. Opote anaboun photia gia polemo, o Allakh te sbenei (skorpizontas te sugkentrose tous kai aphairontas te duname tous). Diadidoun to kako ste ge, kai o Allakh den agapaei ekeinous pou diadidoun to kako.

Kai an oi laoi tou Bibliou (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi) eikhan pistepsei (ston Allakh kai ston Prophete Mokhammant) kai eikhan phulakhthei apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apopheugontas tis apagoreuseis Tou), tha tous eikhame pragmati exileosei apo tis amarties tous kai tha tous eikhame eisagei stous kepous tes eudaimonias (ston Paradeiso).

Kai an eikhan energesei sumphona me ten Tora, to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou) kai auto (to Kor'an) pou ekhei (tora) stalei s' ekeinous apo ton Kurio tous, tha eikhan sigoura labei pronoia apo pano tous (del. brokhe) kai apo kato apo ta podia tous (del. karpous). Anamesa tous brisketai mia metriopathes omada (e opoia den ekhei uperballei sten piste tes ston Iesou iskhurizomene oti einai o Idios o Allakh, oute arnetheke ten piste ston Iesou iskhurizomene oti einai proion moikheias, opos iskhuristekan oi Ebraioi, kai otan erthe o Prophetes Mokhammant, pistepse s' auton, opos o Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai oi suntrophoi tou kai alloi), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous kanoun to kako.

O, Aggeliaphore (Mokhammant)! Metadose auto (to menuma) pou staltheke s' esena apo ton Kurio sou. Ki an den to kaneis (del. an ekrupses kati apo to menuma kai den to metedoses), tote de metedoses to Menuma Tou. St' aletheia, o Allakh tha se prostatepsei apo tous anthropous (apo tous ekhthrous sou). St' aletheia, o Allakh den kathodegei tous apistous (pou arnethekan to Menuma Tou).

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, anthropoi tou Bibliou (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi)! Den briskeste se tipota (ap' auta pou iskhurizeste oti akoloutheite, apo o,ti sas ephere o Mouses kai o Iesous) eos otou na energesete sumphona me ten (authentike) Tora kai to (prototupo) In-tzel (pou stalthekan ston Mouse kai ston Iesou, ta opoia Biblia sas diatazoun na akoloutheite ton Mokhammant) kai m' auto (to Kor'an) pou sas ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio sas.>> Kai auto pou sou ekhei stalei (o, Mokhammant) apo ton Kurio sou, tha auxesei pollous ap' autous (logo tes zelias kai tou phthonou tous) se parabase kai apistia! Gi' auto men lupasai gia ton apisto lao.

St' aletheia! Autoi pou pisteuoun (oi Mousoulmanoi), oi Ebraioi, oi Mandaioi kai oi Khristianoi (oi opoioi -Ebraioi, Khristianoi, kai Mandaioi- zousan prin ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant, kai diateresan tis authentikes didaskalies tes threskeias tous), opoioi (ap' autous) pisteuan ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera kai ekanan enaretes praxeis, de tha uparkhei phobos gi' autous (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).

St' aletheia, perame te desmeuse apo ta paidia tou Israel (to na upakououn ton Allakh kai tous Aggeliaphorous Tou, alla autoi athetesan te desmeuse), kai steilame Aggeliaphorous s' autous (gia na tous kathodegesoun). Opote erkhotan s' ekeinous enas Aggeliaphoros me kati pou oi idioi den epithumousan, diepseusan mia omada (apo tous Aggeliaphorous), kai skotosan ten alle omada.

Nomizan oti den tha uparxei timoria (gia o,ti kakes praxeis ekanan), etsi (sunekhisan stous pothous tous, kai) eginan tuphloi kai kophoi (apo to na blepoun e na akoun ten aletheia). Epeita (o Allakh tous esteile sumphores, kai etsi straphekan me metameleia pros ton Allakh, kai etsi) o Allakh tous sugkhorese, alla kai pali polloi ap' autous eginan tuphloi kai kophoi (apo to na blepoun e na akoun ten aletheia). Kai o Allakh blepei ola osa kanoun.

Pragmati, apostatesan ekeinoi pou lene: <<O Allakh einai o Messias (o Khristos), o uios tes Marias.>> O Khristos eipe: <<O, paidia tou Israel! Latrepste ton Allakh, ton Kurio mou kai ton Kurio sas.>> Pragmati, opoios apodidei etairous ston Allakh ste latreia, o Allakh tha tou apagoreusei ton Paradeiso kai to Pur tha einai e katoikia tou. Kai gia tous adikous de tha uparxoun uposteriktes.

Pragmati, apostatesan ekeinoi pou lene: <<O Allakh einai enas ek ton trion (Agia Triada: o pateras einai theos, o gios einai theos kai to agio pneuma einai theos).>> Ma den uparkhei allos theos (pou axizei na latreuetai), para monon Enas Theos. Kai an den papsoun ap' auta pou lene, pragmati, ena epoduno marturio tha epelthei stous apistous anamesa tous.
Ma de tha strephontousan me metameleia pros ton Allakh kai na Tou zetesoun sugkhorese; Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Messias (Iesous), o uios tes Marias, den etan tipote parapano apo enas Aggeliaphoros* prin ap' auton perasan polloi Aggeliaphoroi. E metera tou (e Maria), etan eilikrines pou pistepse me bebaioteta. Kai oi duo tous etrogan phageto (del. etan anthropoi kai okhi theoi, eno o Allakh den troei). Koitaxe pos kaname ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia Mas) saphe gi' autous* ki omos, koitaxte pos apomakrunontai (apo ten aletheia)!

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Latreuete ektos tou Allakh, auto pou den mporei oute na apotrepsei apo sas kapoio kako, oute na sas pherei kapoio ophelos; Kai o Allakh einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes)!>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, lae tou Bibliou (Khristianoi)! Men uperballete ste threskeia sas pera apo ten Aletheia, oute na akoloutheite tous mataious pothous enos laou (ton progonon sas kai ton Ebraion) pou paraplanetheke apo prin kai paraplanese pollous anthropous kai parastratese apo ton isio dromo.>>
Ekeinoi anamesa sta paidia tou Israel pou apostatesan, tous katarasteke e glossa tou Dauid kai tou Iesou, uiou tes Marias. Auto etan logo tes anupakoes tous kai tes epimones tous sten parabase.
Den apagoreuan o enas ston allon ten apagoreumene praxe pou diepraxe (o allos). Pragmati, athlio einai auto pou ekanan!

Blepeis (o, Prophete) pollous ap' autous (pou apostatesan apo ta paidia tou Israel) na pairnoun tous apistous os summakhous. Athlio etan pragmati auto pou tous ekanan oi eautoi tous, oti prokalesan ten orge tou Allakh kai tha meinoun sto marturio gia panta.

Kai an (ekeinoi pou apostatesan apo ta paidia tou Israel) pisteuan ston Allakh kai ston Prophete kai s' auto pou staltheke s' auton, den tha tous epairnan (tous apistous) os summakhous, alla polloi ap' autous einai anupakouoi.

Pragmati, (o, Prophete) tha breis oti oi pio ekhthrikoi apo tous anthropous pros tous pistous einai oi Ebraioi kai oi polutheistes. Kai tha breis oti oi pio kontinoi sten storge pros tous pistous einai autoi pou lene: <<Eimaste Khristianoi.>> Auto giati ap' autous uparkhoun iereis kai monakhoi, kai den einai alazones.

Kai otan autoi (oi Khristianoi, opos o basilias tes Abusenias -An-Natzasi- o Askhama mpin Ampgkar kai oi suntrophoi tou) akoun o,ti apokaluphtheke ston Aggeliaphoro (ton Mokhammant), blepeis ta matia tous na dakruzoun gia o,ti anagnorisan apo ten aletheia. Lene: <<Kurie mas! Pisteuoume* gi' auto kategrapse mas anamesa stous martures.

Kai giati na men pistepsoume ston Allakh kai se o,ti erthe se mas apo ten aletheia; St' aletheia, eukhomaste o Kurios mas na mas eisagei (ston Paradeiso ten Emera tes Kriseos) mazi me tous enaretous.>>

Etsi, o Allakh tous antameipse gi' auta pou eipan, me kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai aute einai e antamoibe oson prattoun to kalo.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas, tha einai oi katoikoi tou Puros tes Kolaseos.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men apagoreuete ta kala pragmata pou o Allakh sas ekhei epitrepsei kai men parabiazete (ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh), pragmati, o Allakh den agapa tous parabates.
Kai phate apo osa sas parekhei o Allakh, ephoson einai epitrepta kai kala, kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), Auton ston Opoio pisteuete.

O Allakh de tha sas timoresei gia osa einai akousia stous orkous sas, alla tha sas timoresei gia tous skopimous orkous sas (pou den tous ekplerosate)* ton opoion e exileose einai to taisma deka endeon, apo to meso phageto pou taIzete tis dikes sas oikogeneies* e to ntusimo tous* e e apeleutherose enos doulou (e aikhmalotou). Alla opoios den briskei (ta mesa na ektelesei kati ap' auta), tote as nestepsei gia treis meres. Aute einai e exileose ton orkon sas otan orkizeste (kai den tous ekpleronete). Diaphulaxte tous orkous sas (apo to na orkizeste pseudos kai apo to na orkizeste sukhna sto Onoma tou Allakh). Etsi o Allakh sas dieukrinizei ta Edaphia Tou, mepos kai ginete eugnomones.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! St' aletheia, to Al-Khamr (o,ti methaei), ta tukhera paikhnidia, oi Al-Ansamp (oi petres pou briskontan konta sten Ka'mpa, tis opoies oi eidololatres theorousan ieres, kai stis opoies thusiazan zoa) kai oi Al-Azlam (e praktike tou trabegmatos anamesa se tria bele, pou ten ekanan oi eidololatres epizetontas na mathoun ten tukhe tous oste na paroun mia mellontike apophase, gia kapoio taxidi e gamo klp. kai etsi egraphan se ena belos 'kane' kai sto allo 'men kaneis' kai trabagan ena ap' auta), einai apekhtheis amarties apo to ergo tou Satana. Etsi na apekhete ap' autes, mepos kai epitukhete.

St' aletheia, o Satanas thelei mono na speirei ten ekhthroteta kai to misos metaxu sas me to Al-Khamr (o,ti methaei) kai ta tukhera paikhnidia, kai na sas empodisei apo te mnemoneuse tou Allakh ki apo ten proseukhe! Tha apekhete loipon (ap' auta);

Upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant), kai prosexte (men parabiazete tis entoles tou Allakh). An omos apomakruntheite (apo o,ti sas ekhei diataxei o Allakh), tote na gnorizete oti to kathekon tou Aggeliaphorou Mas einai mono na metadosei (to Menuma) me xekatharo tropo.

Den uparkhei amartia s' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis gia o,ti katanalonan (apo Al-Khamr -o,ti methaei- prin ten apagoreuse tou), ephoson phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (apekhontas apo o,ti apagoreuse), pisteuoun (s' Auton) kai kanoun kales praxeis, kai epeita phulassontai (perissotero) apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai pisteuoun (s' Auton), kai epeita phulassontai (perissotero) apo ten timoria Tou kai prattoun to kalo (sto semeio pou na Ton latreuoun me tose eulabeia san na Ton eblepan mprosta tous). Pragmati, o Allakh agapa autous pou kanoun to kalo (kai Ton latreuoun me tose eulabeia san na Ton eblepan mprosta tous).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Pragmati, o Allakh tha sas dokimasei me kati apo theramata pou ta phtanoun ta kheria sas kai ta dorata sas (eno eiste se katastase Ikhram telontas proskunema), gia na xerei o Allakh (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakhorisei) autous pou Ton phobountai aorata (kai apekhoun apo to na kunegesoun eno teloun proskunema). Opoios meta ap' auto parabiazei (kai kunegaei eno brisketai se katastase Ikhram), tha ekhei odunero marturio (epeide parabiase ten entole tou Allakh).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Me skotonete theramata eno briskeste se katastase Ikhram (gia proskunema). Opoios apo sas ta skotosei eskemmena, tha prepei os poine na prospherei to isodunamo autounou pou skotose apo ta booeide. Tha krinoun duo dikaioi apo sas auto (pou prepei na prospherei), kai tha prospherthei sten Al-Ka'mpa (stous phtokhous ston Iero Oiko). E os exileose na taIsei aporous (me ten idia axia tou zoou pou skotose, gia kathe aporo miso Sa' phageto -enamise kilo peripou-) e e antistoikhe nesteia m' auto (mia mera gia kathe miso Sa' phageto), oste na geutei te sunepeia tes praxes tou. O Allakh sugkhorese o,ti egine prin, alla opoios to xana kanei, o Allakh tha ton ekdikethei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos kai Aniketos) kai Ikanos gia antapodose.

Epitrepetai gia sas o,ti psareuete apo te thalassa (kai ta potamia) kai o,ti psaria briskete nekra ste thalassa (e sta potamia). Mia prometheia gia sas (an eiste katoikoi) kai gi' autous pou taxideuoun. Omos, apagoreuetai gia sas to kunegi ste steria oso eiste se katastase Ikhram (gia proskunema). Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), ston Opoion tha sugkentrotheite.

O Allakh ekane ten Ka'mpa, ton Iero Oiko, os topo sterixes (gia te threskeia ton anthropon ston opoio kanoun praxeis latreias, opos proseukhes kai proskunema klp.) kai asphaleias gia tous anthropous (ston opoio aisthanontai asphaleis apo to na tous epitithetai kaneis). Epises (ekane) kai tous Ierous Menes (De-el-Ki'nta, De-el-Khitza, Moukharram kai Ratzamp, os asphaleia gia tous anthropous, epeide autous tous menes apagoreuontan oi makhes). Epises (ekane) kai ta zoa thusias (pou prospherontai gia thusia ston Iero Oiko), kai ta zoa pou ekhoun perideraia (apo malli klp. os semadi oti proorizontai gia thusia) (os asphaleia gia tous idioktetes tous aphou kaneis den mporei na epitithetai s' autous). Auto gia na mathete oti o Allakh gnorizei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge, kai oti o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes [kai na mathete oti auta ta proanapheromena, periekhoun to kalo gia sas kai apotrepoun to kako apo sas prin sumbei].

Na xerete (o, anthropoi) oti o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria (gia osous Ton parakoun) kai oti o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos) [gia osous strephontai me alethine metameleia pros Auton].
To kathekon tou Aggeliaphorou einai mono na metadosei (to Menuma xekathara). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei o,ti phaneronete kai o,ti apokruptete mesa sas.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Den einai isaxia to kako kai to kalo, akoma ki an sou aresei (o, anthrope) e aphthonia tou kakou (kai o arithmos ton opadon tou).>> Etsi, phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), o, anthropoi pou ekhete mualo, mepos kai epitukhete.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Me rotate gia pragmata pou, an sas phaneronontousan, mono duskolia tha sas prokalousan [opos ekeinos pou rotese ton Prophete gia to poios einai o pateras tou. Kai o allos pou ton rotese otan epibletheke to proskunema, an einai gia mia phora ste zoe e prepei na teleitai kathe khrono]. Ean rotesete gi' auta kathos apokaluptetai to Kor'an (kai ta anapherei), tha sas phanerothoun. O Allakh ta aphese (kai den ta anephere os eleos gia sas, gi' auto me rotate gia kati pou den to anephere o Allakh gia na men epiblethei e na apagoreutei se sas logo tes eroteses sas). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).
Uperkhan anthropoi prin apo sas pou rotesan (tous prophetes tous) gia paromoia pragmata, epeita (otan epiblethekan s' autous, ta arnethekan kai den ta ekanan, kai etsi) eginan apistoi logo auton!

[O Allakh sas epetrepse ta booeide kai den apagorepse auta pou apagoreuoun oi eidololatres ston eauto tous kai ta prospheroun sta eidola tous]. Pragmati, o Allakh den orise oute ten Mpakhira (ten kamela pou tes koboun to auti otan gennesei sugkekrimeno arithmo paidion kai ten prospheroun meta sta eidola), oute te Sa'impa (ten kamela pou otan phtasei se mia orismene elikia, ten prospheroun sta eidola), oute ten Oasila (ten kamela pou gennese theluko meta apo theluko), oute ton Kham (e arsenike kamela, pou ekhei polla paidia). Alla oi apistoi epinooun pseude gia ton Allakh, kai oi perissoteroi ap' autous den ekhoun logike.

Kai otan eipothei s' autous (pou epinoesan pseude gia ton Allakh): <<Elate s' auto pou esteile o Allakh (to Kor'an) kai ston Aggeliaphoro (ste Sounna tou, oste na mathete ti einai epitrepto kai ti einai apagoreumeno).>> Lene: <<Mas arkei auto pou brekame tous progonous mas na akolouthoun (apo pepoitheseis, logia kai praxeis).>> Akome ki an oi progonoi tous de gnorizan tipota oute kathodegethekan (sten aletheia);

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Diorthoste ton eauto sas (desmeuontas ton sten upakoe pros ton Allakh). Den tha sas blapsei (me ten plane tou) ekeinos pou parastratese ephoson eiste kathodegemenoi. Ston Allakh tha einai e epistrophe olon sas, kai tha sas enemerosei gi' o,ti kanate.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan o thanatos plesiazei kapoion apo sas, as kalesei otan kanei te diatheke tou, duo dikaious martures apo sas (Mousoulmanous), e duo apo tous allous (me mousoulmanous) ean taxideuete kai sas khtupaei o thanatos. Kai an ekhete kapoia amphibolia (gia te marturia ton duo marturon), krateste tous meta ten proseukhe gia na orkistoun ston Allakh (legontas): <<Den tha antallaxoume te marturia mas me kanena timema, akome kai uper enos stenou suggene, oute tha krupsoume te marturia pou ekhei diataxei o Allakh, (kai an kanoume kati tetoio) tote eimaste anamesa stous amartolous.>>

Ean brethei oti (oi duo martures) ekhoun amartesei (legontas psemata ste marturia tous), as tous antikatastesoun duo alloi apo tous stenous suggeneis (tou apothanonta), kai as orkistoun ston Allakh (legontas) oti: <<E marturia mas einai pio dikaia apo te marturia tous, kai den uperbainoume ten aletheia ste marturia mas, (kai an kanoume kati tetoio) tote eimaste anamesa stous adikous.>>

Auto (pou proanaphertheke) einai pio pithano sto na dosoun (oi protoi duo martures) te marturia me ten aletheia (logo tou phobou tous apo ton Allakh, oti mporei na orkistoun meta ten proseukhe). E sto na phobountai oti aphou orkistekan tha aporriphthoun oi orkoi (tous apo tous suggeneis tou apothanonta kai tha apokaluphthei to pseudos tous). Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai akouste. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous anupakouous.

(Thumetheite, o, anthropoi kai phulakhtheite apo) ten Emera kata ten opoia o Allakh tha sugkentrosei tous Aggeliaphorous kai tha tous pei: <<Poia etan e apantese pou labate (apo ta ethne sas otan tous kalesate ste threskeia sas);>> Autoi tha poun: <<Den ekhoume gnose (para ekeine pou ten xereis kalutera apo mas, kai ole e gnose anekei s' Esena kai tipote den einai krupho ap' Esena), pragmati, Esu eisai o Pantognostes olon ton aoraton (kai ton kruphon).>>

(Anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Allakh tha pei (ten Emera tes Kriseos): <<O, Iesou, gie tes Marias! Anaphere te khare Mou s' esena kai ste metera sou, otan se uposterixa me to agio pneuma (ton aggelo Gabriel), kai otan mileses stous anthropous apo to likno (uperaspizomenos te metera sou, otan ten kategoresan oi Ebraioi oti eisai proion moikheias) kai (argotera) otan egines enelikos (kai xekineses ten apostole sou, proskalontas tous ste threskeia tou Allakh). Kai otan sou ematha te graphe, te sophia (ten katanoese tes threskeias kai ten orthoteta ton logon kai ton praxeon), ten Tora kai to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou). Kai otan ephtiaxes apo pelo te morphe enos pouliou, me ten adeia Mou, kai epeita phusexes s' aute kai etsi egine -me ten adeia Mou- ena pouli. Kai otan giatrepses tous ek genetes tuphlous kathos kai tous leprous -me ten adeia Mou-. Kai otan anesteses tous nekrous -me ten adeia Mou-. Kai otan empodisa ta paidia tou Israel apo sena (otan apophasisan na se skotosoun) aphou erthes s' autous me xekathares apodeixeis. Omos, oi apistoi anamesa tous eipan: <<Auta den einai para phanere mageia.>>.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan apokalupsa stous (dodeka) mathetes (tou Iesou, gia na ton uposterixo meso auton): <<Pistepste s' Emena kai ston Aggeliaphoro Mou.>> Eipan: <<Pisteuoume. Kai gine Marturas (o, Allakh) pos eimaste Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Boulese Sou).>>

(Kai anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan oi mathetes (tou Iesou) eipan: <<O, Iesou, uie tes Marias! Mporei o Kurios sou (an Ton epikalesteis) na mas steilei ena trapezi (me phageto) apo ton ourano;>> Eipe: <<Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (aphenontas auto pou zetesate, mepos kai ekhei dokimasia gia sas) an eiste pragmatika pistoi.>>

Eipan (oi mathetes): <<Theloume na phame ap' auto kai na kathesukhastoun oi kardies mas (kai na einai sigoures gia ten teleioteta tes Dunames tou Allakh kai gia to oti eisai o Aggeliaphoros Tou) kai na mathoume (me bebaioteta) oti mas eipes ten aletheia (gia o,ti epheres apo ton Kurio sou) kai na eimaste martures s' auto (to trapezi oti einai thauma apo ton Allakh).>>

Eipe o Iesous, o gios tes Marias: <<O, Allakh, Kurie mas! Katebase se mas ena trapezi (me phageto) apo ton ourano, to opoio tha einai giorte gia mas, gia osous zoun semera kai gi' ekeinous pou tha erthoun meta apo mas, kai tha einai ena semadi apo Sena (pou epibebaionei ten apostole mou). Kai steile mas agatha, pragmati Esu eisai o Kaluteros ap' autous pou parekhoun agatha.>>

O Allakh eipe: <<Pragmati, tha to katebaso se sas, alla opoios apo sas arnethei ten piste meta ap' auto, sigoura tha ton timoreso me ena marturio pou de tha timoreso m' auto kanenan allon ston kosmo (apo to poso dunato tha einai).>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Allakh tha pei (ten Emera tes Kriseos): <<O, Iesou, uie tes Marias! Esu eipes stous anthropous: <<Parte emena kai te metera mou os duo theous, ektos apo ton Allakh.>>;>> Tha pei (o Iesous): <<Doxa Soi! Den mou epitrepetai na po kati gia to opoio den ekho dikaioma na po. An eikha pei kati tetoio, Esu sigoura tha to gnorizes. Gnorizeis ti brisketai ston eauto mou, eno ego de gnorizo ti brisketai ston Eauto Sou. Pragmati, Esu eisai o Pantognostes ton aoraton.

Den tous eipa para mono auto pou Esu me dietaxes na po, oti: <<Na latreuete ton Allakh, ton Kurio mou kai ton Kurio sas.>> Kai emoun marturas s' autous oso ezesa anamesa tous, ma otan Esu me peres pano, Esu esoun o Parateretes s' autous. Pragmati, Esu eisai o Marturas sta panta.
An tous timoreseis, einai oi douloi Sou. Ki an tous sugkhoreseis, Esu eisai pragmati o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

O Allakh tha pei: <<Aute einai e Emera kata ten opoia oi eilikrineis tha epophelethoun apo ten eilikrineia tous. Tha ekhoun kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. O Allakh einai Eukharistemenos m' autous kai autoi einai eukharistemenoi m' Auton. Aute einai e upertate epitukhia.>>
Ston Allakh anekei ole e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai olon oson briskontai mesa tous. Pragmati, Autos einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Olos o epainos kai e doxa anekoun ston Allakh, o Opoios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge, kai eplase to skotadi kai to phos. Ostoso, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste exisonoun allous me ton Kurio tous (apodidontas etairous s' Auton ste latreia).

Einai Autos pou sas demiourgese apo pelo (del. ton patera sas, ton Adam), epeita orise ena sugkekrimeno khrono (gia te zoe sas sten egkosmia zoe) kai orise ena sugkekrimeno khrono (gia ten anastase sas ten Emera tes Anastases) pou den to xerei para monon Autos. Epeita eseis amphiballete (sten Ikanoteta Tou na sas anastesei apo to thanato)!
Einai o Allakh (pou mono Autos axizei na latreuetai) stous ouranous kai ste Ge. Gnorizei o,ti krubete mesa sas kai o,ti phaneronete, kai gnorizei o,ti kanete (apo kales e kakes praxeis).
Kai den tous erkhetai (stous eidololatres) kanena semadi apo ta semadia tou Kuriou tous, para na apomakrunthoun ap' auto.

Pragmati, diepseusan ten aletheia (to Kor'an) otan tous erthe, alla tha tous erthoun ta nea gi' auto (to marturio) pou sunethizan na khleuazoun (otan doun to marturio ten Emera tes Kriseos kai tha xeroun oti to Kor'an einai e aletheia).

Den eidan (autoi oi apistoi) posa ethne katastrepsame prin ap' autous; Tous eikhame dosei duname ste ge, (tetoia duname) pou den sas dosame. Tous eikhame steilei aphthone brokhe apo ton ourano kai kaname na kuloun potamia apo kato tous (kato apo ta spitia tous). Ostoso, tous katastrepsame gia tis amarties tous kai kaname meta ap' autous na emphanistoun alla ethne.
Kai akoma ki an eikhame steilei s' esena (o, Mokhammant) ena Biblio grammeno se khartia kai to aggizane me ta kheria tous, tha elegan oi apistoi: <<Auto den einai para phanere mageia.>>

Kai eipan (oi apistoi): <<An mono eikhe stalei enas aggelos s' auton (ton Mokhammant, kai mas milouse sten alethine morphe tou kai epibebaione oti o Mokhammant einai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh, tote tha pisteuame)!>> An ontos stelname enan aggelo (m' auto ton tropo pou ethelan), to thema tha eikhe apophasistei (del. tha tous eikhame katastrepsei an den pisteuan) kai tote den tha tous eikhe dothei kamia anabole (gia na strephontousan me metameleia). [Opos egine me ta proegoumena ethne pou zetesan megala semadia apo tous prophetes tous, alla otan tous erthan, ta arnethekan kai den pistepsan, kai etsi epese pano tous e timoria tou Allakh amesos khoris kamia anabole].

Kai an kaname auton (ton apestalmeno s' autous) na etan enas aggelos, tha ton kaname ontos anthropo (me te morphe enos anthropou gia na mporoun na ton blepoun kai na ton akoun), kai etsi, tha tous eikhame mperdepsei (an einai ontos enas aggelos e enas anthropos) s' auto pou ede ekhoun mperdepsei ton eauto tous (skhetika me ton Prophete Mokhammant an einai apestalmenos e okhi epeide einai anthropos).
Kai pragmati (polloi) Aggeliaphoroi prin apo sena khleuastekan, ma ekeinoi pou tous khleuasan perikuklothekan ap' auto to idio (to marturio) pou to khleuazan.
Pes (o, Prophete, s' autous pou diapseudoun kai khleuazoun): <<Taxidepste ste ge, kai epeita koitaxte pos etan to telos ekeinon pou diepseudan (apo ta proegoumena ethne).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Se poion anekoun ola osa einai stous ouranous kai ste Ge;>> Pes: <<Ston Allakh.>> Ekhei orisei na einai Eleemon (pros tous doulous Tou kai na me tous stelnei amesos ten timoria, dinontas tous khrono gia na straphoun me metameleia). Pragmati, tha sas sugkentrosei ten Emera tes Anastases gia ten opoia den uparkhei amphibolia. Omos, ekeinoi pou ekhasan ton eauto tous (kai ton katestrepsan me ten apistia tous), den pisteuoun!
S' Auton anekoun o,ti anapauetai (e metakineitai) te nukhta kai ten emera, kai Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Einai dunaton na paro os kedemona (uposterikte kai prostate) allon ektos tou Allakh, eno Autos einai o Demiourgos ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai Autos einai pou taIzei kai den taIzetai;>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, diatakhtheka na eimai o protos pou na upotakhthei (ste Boulese tou Allakh), kai men eisai (o, Mokhammant) apo tous polutheistes.>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, phobamai, ten timoria mias tromeres Emeras, an parakouo ton Kurio mou.>>
Ap' opoion apomakrunetai (to marturio) ekeine ten Emera, pragmati, (o Allakh) ton ekhei eleesei, kai aute einai e phanere epitukhia.
(O, anthrope) ean o Allakh se plettei me kati pou se blaptei, den uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na to aphairesei para mono Autos. Kai an sou kharisei kati kalo, pragmati, einai sta panta Ikanos.

Kai Autos einai o Al-Kakhir (o Pantodunamos pou upotassei ta panta) (kai einai) pano apo tous doulous Tou, kai Autos einai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos), o Al-Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres pou se diapseudoun): <<Poios einai autos pou uparkhei kai ekhei te megalutere marturia (gia ten eilikrineia mou);>> Pes: <<O Allakh einai o Marturas anamesa s' emena kai s' esas. Auto to Kor'an mou apokaluphtheke gia na proeidopoieso m' auto esas kai ekeinous stous opoious tha phtasei. St' aletheia, eseis marturate oti uparkhoun kai alloi theoi ektos apo ton Allakh (tous opoious latreuete)!>> Pes: <<Ego omos den marturo (auta pou marturate).>> Pes: <<Pragmati, Autos einai mono Enas Theos (pou axizei na latreuetai kai den ekhei kanenan etairo), kai arnoumai ola osa apodidete s' Auton ste latreia.>>

Ekeinoi stous opoious dosame to Biblio (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi) ton gnorizoun (ton Mokhammant, apo tis perigraphes tou sta biblia tous) opos gnorizoun tous gious tous. Ekeinoi einai pou ekhasan ton eauto tous (eisagontas ton ste Photia, epeide arnethekan ten piste ston Mokhammant) kai den pisteuoun.

Kai poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia) e diapseudei ta Edaphia Tou; Pragmati, oi adikoi den tha petukhoun pote (an den straphoun pros ton Allakh me metameleia).

Ten Emera pou tha tous sugkentrosoume olous mazi, kai epeita tha poume s' ekeinous pou apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia: <<Pou einai oi etairoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou iskhuristekate (oti einai etairoi tou Allakh ste latreia);>>
Epeita den etan e apantese tous para mono oti eipan (pseudos): <<(Orkizomaste) ma ton Allakh, ton Kurio mas! Den apodidame ston Allakh etairous ste latreia.>>
Koita (o, Mokhammant) pos eipan psemata ston eauto tous! Kai exaphanisteke ap' autous o,ti epinoesan.

Kai anamesa tous (stous eidololatres) uparkhoun ekeinoi pou se akoun (o, Aggeliaphore, otan apaggeleis to Kor'an), alla ekhoume balei kalummata pano stis kardies tous gia na men to katalabainoun (logo tes iskhurognomosunes tous kai tes arneses tous gia ten kathodegese) kai (ekhoume kanei) kophose sta autia tous (gia na men ekhoun ten euergetike akoe). Akoma ki an eblepan kathe semadi, pali den tha pisteuan s' auto. Sto semeio pou otan erkhontai s' esena kai diaphonoun mazi sou (uposterizontas ten plane tous), lene oi apistoi: <<Auto den einai para muthoi ton arkhaion.>>

Kai apagoreuoun (tous anthropous) ap' auto (apo to na akolouthesoun ton Prophete Mokhammant), eno kai oi idioi apomakrunontai ap' auton. Pragmati, den katastrephoun para mono tous eautous tous, kai den to antilambanontai!

Kai an eblepes (o, Prophete) otan tha stathoun enopion tou Puros tes Kolaseos kai tha poun: <<Makari na epistrephame piso (sten egkosmia zoe) kai na me diapseudame ta Edaphia tou Kuriou mas, kai na eimastan apo tous pistous!>>

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou iskhuristekan oti an epestrephan sten egkosmia zoe tha pisteuan), alla emphanisteke s' autous aute (e apistia) pou ekrupsan prin (otan eipan: <<Den apodidame ston Allakh etairous ste latreia.>>). Akoma ki an epestrephan (sten egkosmia zoe), pragmati, tha epestrephan s' aute (ten apistia) pou tous eikhe apagoreutei, kai pragmati, einai pseutes.
Kai eipan (autoi oi eidololatres sten egkosmia zoe): <<Den uparkhei (alle zoe) para e egkosmia zoe mas, kai de tha anastethoume!>>

Kai an eblepes (o, Prophete, ekeinous pou diepseudan ten anastase kai ten Emera tes Kriseos) otan tha stekontai enopion tou Kuriou tous, (tha eblepes se poia athlia katastase tha briskontai). Tha pei (o Allakh): <<Aute (e anastase) den einai e aletheia;>> Tha poun: <<(Orkizomaste) ma ton Kurio mas! Ontos einai (e aletheia).>> Tha pei (o Allakh): <<Geuteite, loipon, to marturio gia o,ti arnethekate (apo ten aletheia).>>

Pragmati, ekhasan ekeinoi pou diepseudan te sunantese me ton Allakh (ten Emera tes Kriseos). Kai otan tous erthei xaphnika e Ora, tha poun: <<Alimono se mas gia o,ti paramelesame skhetika m' aute (ten Ora)!>> Tha koubalesoun tis amarties tous stis plates tous. Ti athlies einai autes oi amarties pou diepraxan!

Pragmati, e zoe autou tou kosmou den einai para paikhnidi kai diaskedase, eno e Mellousa Zoe einai polu kalutere gi' osous phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Ma den sullogizeste;
Pragmati, gnorizoume oti auta pou lene (oi apistoi apo to lao sou) se thliboun (o, Prophete). St' aletheia, den se diapseudoun* alla oi adikoi arnountai apo alazoneia ta Edaphia tou Allakh.

Pragmati, uperkhan kai Aggeliaphoroi prin apo sena (o, Prophete) pou tous diepseudan (oi laoi tous), alla edeixan upomone gia osa tous diepseudan kai se o,ti tous eblaptan (oi laoi tous) mekhri pou tous erthe e uposterixe Mas. Kaneis den mporei na allaxei ta Logia tou Allakh (kai tis apophaseis Tou gia te nike ton Aggeliaphoron Tou). Pragmati, sou erthan (o, Prophete) kapoies apo tis eideseis ton Apestalmenon.

Ean e apostrophe tous (apo o,ti tous epheres apo ten aletheia kai e diapseuse tous) einai duskole s' esena (kai se thlibei logo tes megales epithumias sou na pistepsoun), tote an mporeis na epizeteseis ena tounel ste Ge e mia skala ston ourano gia na tous phereis ena semadi (kai apodeixe pera ap' auta pou sou dosame, tote kane to, alla den tha tous ophelesei se tipote, giati den einai ste duname sou na kathodegeseis autous pou o Allakh den thelei na kathodegesei). An o Allakh ethele, tha tous sugkentrone olous sten kathodegese. Men eisai loipon ap' autous pou den xeroun (oti an ethele o Allakh tha tous sugkentrone sten kathodegese. Gi' auto den prepei e apostrophe tous apo sena, na einai duskole s' esena)!

Pragmati, tha antapokrinontai (sto kalesma sou) mono ekeinoi pou akoun (kai katanooun, eno oi apistoi einai san tous nekrous pou pethanan oi kardies tous, gi' auto de tha antapokrinontai). Kai oso gia tous nekrous, o Allakh tha tous anastesei kai epeita tha epistraphoun s' Auton.

Eipan (oi eidololatres): <<An mono tou eikhe stalei ena semadi apo ton Kurio tou!>> Pes: <<Pragmati, o Allakh einai Ikanos na steilei ena semadi.>> Alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den gnorizoun (oti o Allakh stelnei ta semadia sumphona me te Sophia Tou kai okhi sumphona me o,ti zetoun, kai oti an steilei auto pou zetesan kai epeita den pistepsoun, tha pesei pano tous e timoria tou Allakh khoris kamia anabole, opos egine se proegoumena ethne).

Den uparkhei kanena kinoumeno (zontano) plasma, oute ena pouli pou na petaei me ta duo phtera tou, para na einai ethne san esas. Den aphesame tipote khoris na to ekhoume katagrapsei (sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud). Epeita, ston Kurio tous tha sugkentrothoun.

Ekeinoi pou diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas, einai kophoi kai bouboi kai briskontai se bathia skotadia. Opoion thelei o Allakh ton kanei na parastratesei kai opoion thelei (o Allakh) ton kanei na einai ston isio dromo.

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres): <<Peite mou, ean sas erkhotan e timoria tou Allakh e sas erkhotan e Ora (tes Kriseos), tha epikalousastan kanenan allon ektos apo ton Allakh (gia na sas sosei); An eiste eilikrineis (oti oi pseutikoi theoi sas mporoun na sas ophelesoun e na sas prostatepsoun apo to kako).>>

Okhi (den tha epikalousastan tous pseutikous theous sas), alla mono Auton tha epikalousastan! Kai tote, an ethele tha sas esoze ap' auto gia to opoio Ton epikalousastan, kai tha xekhnousate o,ti apodidate s' Auton apo etairous ste latreia!

Pragmati, eikhame steilei Aggeliaphorous se ethne prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant, alla tous diepseusan), kai etsi tous timoresame me phtokheia kai astheneies, mepos kai epikalestoun (ton Allakh) me tapeinophrosune kai upotage.

Kai an otan tous erthe mia sumphora apo Mas, (Mas) eikhan epikalestei me tapeinophrosune kai upotage (tha tous eikhame sosei), alla oi kardies tous sklerunan, kai o Satanas oraiopoiese sta matia tous auta pou dieprattan (apo apistia kai amarties).

(Kai den elaban nouthesia apo te phtokheia kai tis astheneies pou tous steilame os upenthumise). Kai otan paramelesan auta pou diatakhthekan (apo tis entoles tou Allakh), tous anoixame tis portes ton panton (tes euemerias kai tes ugeias, anti tes phtokheias kai tes astheneias), ospou otan kharekan me uperephaneia gia o,ti elaban, tous arpaxame xaphnika me ten timoria, kai etsi eginan apelpismenoi (gia otidepote kalo).

Etsi, exolothreuteke oloskheros ekeinos o laos pou diepraxe adikia. (Kai nikesan oi Aggeliaphoroi tou Allakh) kai oles oi eukharisties (kai oi doxasies kai oi epainoi) anekoun ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon (tes anthropotetas, ton tzinn kai olon oson uparkhoun).

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres): <<Peite mou, ean o Allakh aphairouse ten akoe kai ten orase sas kai sphragize tis kardies sas, poios theos ektos apo ton Allakh tha mporouse na sas ta pherei piso;>> Koita pos aposaphenizoume ta semadia (kai dinoume polla diaphoretika epikheiremata), kai epeita autoi apostrephontai!
Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres): <<Peite mou, ean sas erthei e timoria tou Allakh xaphnika e phanera (pou na ten blepete), tha katastraphei kanenas allos ektos apo ton adiko lao;>>

Den stelnoume tous Aggeliaphorous para mono os phoreis kharmosunon eideseon kai os proeidopoietes. Opoioi pisteuoun kai diorthonoun tis praxeis tous, de tha uparxei phobos gi' autous (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Oso gi' ekeinous pou diepseudan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, tha tous katabalei to marturio logo tes anupakoes tous.

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres): <<Den sas leo oti ekho ta thesaurophulakia tou Allakh, oute xero ta aorata, oute sas leo oti eimai enas aggelos. Pragmati, akoloutho mono o,ti mou apokaluptetai.>> Pes: <<Einai isos o tuphlos (o apistos pou den blepei ten aletheia) m' auton (ton pisto) pou blepei (ten aletheia kai pisteuei s' aute); Ma den skephteste;>>

Proeidopoiese tous, loipon, (o, Mokhammant) m' auto (to Kor'an) osous phobountai oti tha sugkentrothoun enopion tou Kuriou tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos) -de tha ekhoun kanenan prostate e mesolabete ektos apo Auton-, isos kai na phulakhthoun apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Kai men apomakruneis (ap' esena, o, Prophete) autous (tous phtokhous Mousoulmanous) pou epikalountai ton Kurio tous proi kai bradu epizetontas ten eukharistese Tou [del. men tous apomakruneis gia na phereis pio konta sou tous arkhegous ton eidololatron pou thes na tous kaleseis sto Islam]. Den eisai upologos gia tis praxeis tous (auton ton phtokhon), oute autoi einai upologoi gia tis praxeis sou. Etsi, men tous apomakruneis gia na men eisai apo tous adikous.

Epises dokimasame merikous ap' autous m' allous (dinontas tous perissotera mesa bioporismou), gia na poun (oi plousioi apistoi): <<Autoi (oi phtokhoi Mousoulmanoi) einai autoi pou o Allakh tous eunoese (me ten kathodegese) anamesa mas; (An e piste etan kati kalo, tote tha emastan pio axioi gi' aute!)>> Den gnorizei kalutera o Allakh tous eugnomones (kai tous kathodegei sten piste); [Sigoura tous gnorizei kalutera!]

Otan erthoun s' esena (o, Prophete) ekeinoi pou pisteuoun sta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, pes: <<Eirene se sas. O Kurios sas ekhei orisei na einai Eleemon, etsi opoios anamesa sas diapraxei amartia apo agnoia kai epeita meta ap' aute straphei me metameleia (ston Allakh) kai diorthosei (tis praxeis tou), tote o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>
Etsi diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia, kai gia na phanei o dromos ton kakon.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Mou ekhei apagoreutei (apo ton Allakh) na latreuo ekeinous pou epikaleiste ektos tou Allakh.>> Pes: <<Den akoloutho tis mataies epithumies sas. Pragmati, an to ekana, tha eikha paraplanethei kai de tha emoun apo tous kathodegemenous.>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Stekomai se xekathares apodeixeis apo ton Kurio mou, alla eseis to diapseusate (auto pou mou apokaluphtheke apo ton Allakh). Den ekho auto (to marturio) pou zetate anupomona. E apophase anekei mono ston Allakh. Leei ten aletheia kai einai o Kaluteros apo tous krites (pou diakhorizoun ten aletheia apo to psema, kai diakhorizoun auton pou ekhei dikio ap' auton pou ekhei adiko).>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<An eikha auto (to marturio) pou zetate anupomona, (tha sas to estelna, kai etsi) to thema tha eikhe ede krithei metaxu emena kai esas. Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei kalutera tous adikous (kai pose anabole tha tous dosei kai pote tha tous steilei ten timoria Tou).>>

Autos einai pou ekhei ta kleidia tou aoratou, kaneis den ta xerei ektos ap' Auton. Kserei o,ti uparkhei ste steria kai ste thalassa. Kanena phullo den pephtei khoris na to xerei. Den uparkhei oute enas kokkos sto skotadi tes Ges, oute tipota ugro e xero, para na einai grammeno se ena xekatharo Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).

Einai Autos pou pairnei tis psukhes sas te nukhta (prosorina) [o mikros thanatos -Al-Maouta As-Sougra-] kai gnorizei o,ti kanete ten emera, epeita sas anastainei ten emera (aphou ekhei parei tis psukhes sas te nukhta, oste na sekotheite gia tis praxeis sas), mekhri na ekplerothei enas orismenos khronos (zoes sas). Epeita, pros Auton tha einai e epistrophe sas kai epeita tha sas enemerosei gia o,ti kanate.

Autos einai o Al-Kakhir (o Pantodunamos pou upotassei ta panta) (kai einai) pano apo tous doulous Tou. Stelnei s' esas aggelous grapheis (pou katagraphoun tis praxeis sas) mekhris otou erthei o thanatos se enan apo sas, kai tote oi aggeloi Mas tou aphairoun ten psukhe kai pote den ameloun o,ti diatakhthekan.

Epeita (oloi ekeinoi ton opoion oi psukhes aphairethekan) tha epistrepsoun ston Allakh, ton Alethino Kurio tous. Pragmati, e krise anekei mono s' Auton, kai Autos einai o Takhuteros ap' autous pou upologizoun (sto na katametresei tis praxeis sas kai epeita eite na sas timoresei, eite na sas antameipsei gi' autes).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Poios sas sozei apo to skotadi (kai tis katastrophes) tes sterias kai tes thalassas; Ton epikaleiste me tapeinophrosune kai (Ton epikaleiste kai) krupha (legontas): <<Ean mono na mas sosei (o Allakh) ap' aute (ten katastrophe), sigoura tha eimaste anamesa stous eugnomones.>>.>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<O Allakh einai Autos pou sas sozei ap' aute (ten katastrophe) kai apo kathe duskolia, alla epeita (aphou sas esose) na eseis apodidete s' Auton etairous ste latreia!>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Einai Ikanos na steilei se sas timoria apo pano sas e kato apo ta podia sas, e na sas khorisei se (antimakhomenes) omades, kai etsi, na kanei merikous apo sas na geutoun te duname ton allon (kai na polemesei o enas ton allon).>> Koita pos dinoume diaphora semadia (kai epikheiremata), isos kai na katanoesoun!

St' aletheia, diepseuse o laos sou (o, Prophete) auto (to Kor'an) an kai einai e aletheia! Pes: <<Den eimai phulakas (e parateretes) pano sas (alla e euthune mou einai mono na sas metadoso to Theio Menuma).
Kathe eidese ekhei kathorismeno khrono (kai katalexe opou tha phanei an einai aletheia e psema), kai suntoma tha mathete (ton proorismo sas otan tha anastetheite ten Emera tes Anastases).

Opote blepeis ekeinous pou khleuazoun ta Edaphia Mas, apomakrunsou ap' autous mekhri autoi na allaxoun te suzetese. An o Satanas se ekane na xekhasteis (kai etsi kathises mazi tous), tote molis to thumetheis, (phuge kai) men kathiseis me ton adiko lao.

Autoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) den einai upologoi gia tis praxeis ekeinon (ton adikon), alla (to kathekon tous einai) na tous upenthumizoun (kai na tous apagoreuoun na khleuazoun ta Edaphia tou Allakh) isos kai na phulakhthoun apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).

Ase (o, Prophete) autous pou pairnoun te threskeia tous (del. te threskeia tou Allakh kai ten upakoe tous pros Auton) os paikhnidi kai diaskedase, kai tous xegelase e egkosmia zoe. Kai nouthetese (tous anthropous) m' auto (to Kor'an), oste na men paradothei mia psukhe (sto marturio) logo autou pou diepraxe apo amarties. De tha ekhei (e psukhe) kanenan uposterikte e diamesolabete ektos tou Allakh. Akoma ki an (mia katadikasmene psukhe) prosphere kathe morphes lutra (oste na men timorethei), den tha ginontousan dekta. Tetoioi einai ekeinoi pou tha paradothoun (sto marturio) gia o,ti diepraxan apo amarties. Tha ekhoun na pioun brasto ugro kai tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio gia o,ti arnethekan apo ten piste.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres rotontas tous): <<Einai dunaton, na epikaloumaste ektos apo ton Allakh auta (ta eidola), pou den mporoun oute na mas ophelesoun oute na mas blapsoun kai na epistrepsoume etsi sten apistia, aphou mas ekhei kathodegesei o Allakh;>> San ekeinon pou oi diaboloi ton paraplanesan ste ge aphenontas ton sastismeno, an kai ekhei suntrophous pou ton kaloun sten kathodegese (legontas): <<Ela se mas.>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<E kathodegese tou Allakh einai e (alethine) kathodegese, kai ekhoume diatakhthei na upotakhthoume ston Kurio olon ton kosmon,
(Epises ekhoume diatakhthei:) kai to na teleite ten proseukhe kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).>> Pragmati, pros Auton tha sugkentrotheite.>>

Einai Autos pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge me ten aletheia. Ten Emera (tes Anastases) tha pei: <<Gennetheto>>, kai etsi tha ginei. O Logos tou einai e aletheia. Ole e kuriarkhia anekei s' Auton ten Emera kata ten opoia tha phusekhtei to Keras (Salpigga). Einai o Pantognostes ton aoraton kai ton oraton, kai einai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos) kai o Al-Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).
Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Impraem (Abraam) eipe ston patera tou, Azar: <<Pairneis ta eidola gia theous; Blepo oti esu kai o laos sou briskeste se xekathare plane (makria apo ten aletheia).>>

Etsi, deixame ston Impraem (Abraam) to basileio ton ouranon kai tes Ges (gia na dei oti to basileio ton panton anekei mono ston Allakh kai oti mono o Allakh einai Autos pou axizei na latreuetai), kai gia na einai (o Abraam) enas apo tous bathutata pistous.

Otan e nukhta ton skepase (ton Abraam), eide ena asteri kai eipe: <<Auto einai o kurios mou.>> Alla otan ephuge eipe: <<Den agapo autous pou pheugoun (aphou o Alethinos Theos sigoura einai panta paron kai den pheugei)!>>

Kai otan eide to pheggari na emphanizetai, eipe: <<Auto einai o kurios mou.>> Otan omos (to pheggari) ephuge, eipe: <<Ean den me kathodegesei o Kurios mou, tha bretho sigoura anamesa stous parastratemenous.>>

Otan eide ton elio na anatellei, eipe: <<Autos einai o kurios mou, einai megaluteros (ap' ola ta proegoumena).>> Otan omos (o elios) eduse, eipe: <<O, lae mou! Arnoumai o,ti apodidete apo etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.

Pragmati, strepho to prosopo mou pros Auton pou eplase tous ouranous kai te Ge, kai apoklino apo ten plane teinontas pros ten alethine threskeia kai den eimai ap' autous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.>>

O laos tou, omos, diaphonese mazi tou. Eipe (o Abraam): <<Diaphoneite mazi mou gia ton Allakh, eno Autos me kathodegese; Den phobamai apo tous etairous pou apodidete ston Allakh ste latreia (me tous opoious prospatheite na me ekphobisete oti tha me blapsoun). (Tipota den mporei na mou sumbei) para mono an o Kurios mou thelei kati (na mou sumbei). O Kurios mou perikleiei ta panta me te gnose Tou. Den tha labete nouthesia loipon;

Kai pos na phobamai ap' auta pou apodidete ston Allakh ste latreia, eno eseis den phobaste oti apodidete etairous ston Allakh ste latreia, gia tous opoious den ekhei steilei (o Allakh) kamia apodeixe (oti axizoun te latreia); Poio apo ta duo mere, loipon, ekhei perissotero dikaioma na aisthanetai asphaleia, an pragmatika gnorizete;>>
Autoi pou pisteuoun kai den anamignuoun ten piste tous me ten adikia (praxeis eidololatrias), einai autoi pou ekhoun ten asphaleia, kai autoi einai oi kathodegemenoi.

Ki ekeino etan to epikheirema pou dosame ston Impraem (Abraam) enanti tou laou tou. Emeis exupsonoume se upseles theseis autous pou theloume. Pragmati, o Kurios sou einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Kai kharisame s' auton (ston Abraam), (ton gio tou) ton Isaak kai (ton eggono tou) ton Iakob, kai tous kathodegesame kai tous duo. Kai prin ap' auton kathodegesame ton Noe, kai apo tous apogonous tou, ton Dabid, ton Solomonta, ton Iob, ton Ioseph, ton Mouse kai ton Aaron. Etsi, ameiboume autous pou prattoun to kalo.
Kai (kathodegesame epises kai) ton Zakharia, ton Ioanne, ton Iesou kai ton Elia. Kai oloi tous etan apo tous enaretous.
Kai (kathodegesame epises kai) ton Ismael, ton Elisaio, ton Iona kai ton Lot, ki olous autous tous epilexame pano apo olous tous anthropous (tes epokhes tous).
Kai (kathodegesame epises kai) merikous apo tous pateres tous, tous apogonous tous kai tous adelphous tous, tous ekhoume epilexei kai tous ekhoume kathodegesei ston isio dromo.

Aute einai e kathodegese tou Allakh me ten opoia kathodegei opoion thelei (o Allakh) apo tous doulous Tou. An, omos, apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, tha ginontan mataia ola osa ekanan (apo kales praxeis).

Ekeinoi (oi prophetes) einai autoi pou tous dosame to Biblio kai te sophia (ten katanoese tes threskeias) kai tous kaname prophetes. Alla ean autoi (oi eidololatres apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant) arnountai na pistepsoun s' auta (del, to Biblio, te sophia kai ten apostole sou os Prophete), pragmati, ta ekhoume empisteutei s' allous pou den ta arnountai (del. stous suntrophous sou apo tous Al-Moukhatzirein -oi metanastes apo te Makka- kai tous Al-Ansar -oi katoikoi tes Mantinas- kai tous pistous Mousoulmanous mekhri ten Emera tes Kriseos).

Ekeinoi (oi prophetes) einai autoi pou tous kathodegese o Allakh. Etsi, akolouthese (o, Prophete) ten kathodegese tous. Pes (o, Prophete, ston lao sou): <<Den sas zetao kamia antamoibe gi' auto (to Kor'an pou metadido s' esas). Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) den einai para mia upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gia olous tous kosmous.>>

Kai (oi eidololatres tes Makkas kai merikoi Ebraioi) den ektimesan to megaleio tou Allakh opos Tou armozei, otan eipan (gia na diapseusoun ten apostole tou Mokhammant): <<O Allakh den esteile tipota (Biblio) se kanenan anthropo.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Poios, loipon, esteile to Biblio (ten Tora) pou ephere o Mouses (ston lao tou) os phos kai kathodegese gia tous anthropous; To opoio Biblio (ten Tora) to kanete (o, Ebraioi) se xekhorista phulla, apokaluptontas merika ap' auta kai krubontas polla ap' auta! Kai mathate (o, Arabes, ap' auto to Kor'an) auta pou oute eseis oute oi progonoi sas ta xerate!>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O Allakh (einai Autos pou esteile ten Tora).>> Epeita aphese tous na diaskedasoun sten plane tous.
