Kai auto (to Kor'an) einai ena Biblio pou to steilame, (to opoio einai) eulogemeno, kai epikuronei (ta Biblia) pou elthan prin ap' auto. (To opoio steilame) gia na proeidopoieseis te metera ton komopoleon (te Makka) kai autes pou einai guro tes. Autoi pou pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, pisteuoun s' auto (to Kor'an) kai teroun tis proseukhes tous (stis kathorismenes ores tous).

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh (iskhurizomenos oti o Allakh den esteile kanena Biblio se kanenan anthropo) e leei: <<Mou erthe e apokalupse.>>, eno tipota den tou eikhe apokaluphthei, e ap' ekeinon pou leei: <<Mporo na steilo paromoio m' auto (to Kor'an) pou esteile o Allakh.>> Kai an eblepes (o, Mokhammant) otan oi adikoi briskontai stis odunes tou thanatou (pou kaluptoun kai to mualo tous) [tha eblepes se poia athlia katastase briskontai] eno oi aggeloi aplonoun ta kheria tous (khtupontas tous kai legontas): <<Bgalte tis psukhes sas! Semera tha labete to tapeinotiko marturio, logo oson legate apo psemata enantion tou Allakh kai epeide arnethekate alazonika ta Edaphia Tou.>>

(Kai tha eipothei s' autous tous adikous ten Emera tes Kriseos:)<<Pragmati, erthate (Semera) s' Emas o kathenas sas monos tou, opos sas demiourgesame ten prote phora (ton kathenan sas mono tou, gumno kai xupoleto). Kai aphesate piso apo tis plates sas (sten egkosmia zoe) ola osa sas eikhame kharisei. De blepoume mazi sas tous mesolabetes (pseutikous theous) sas pou iskhuristekate oti etan etairoi tou Allakh ste latreia sas. Pragmati, kopekan oloi oi desmoi metaxu sas kai sas egkateleipsan auta pou iskhurizosastan (oti einai oi diamesolabetes metaxu tou Allakh kai esas, kai oti einai oi etairoi tou Allakh ste latreia).>>

Pragmati, o Allakh einai Autos pou anoigei tous sporous (gia na phutrosoun ta phuta) kai (anoigei) ta koukoutsia (gia na phutrosoun ta dentra). Bgazei ton zontano apo ton nekro, kai bgazei ton nekro apo ton zontano. Autos einai o Allakh! Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo ten aletheia);

Einai Autos pou khorizei to xemeroma (apo to skotadi tes nukhtas), kai ekane te nukhta gia anapause, kai ekane ton elio kai te selene na trekhoun (stis trokhies tous) me enan teleio kai prokathorismeno upologismo. Tetoia einai e metrese (kai e krise) tou Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamou, Aniketou), tou Al-'Aleim (Pantognoste).

Einai Autos pou eplase ta asteria gia sas gia na kathodegeste (sto dromo kai sta taxidia sas) meso auton, sta skotadia tes sterias kai tes thalassas. Pragmati, diasaphenesame ta semadia (kai tis apodeixeis pou deikhnoun te Duname Mas) gi' ekeinous pou gnorizoun (kai tha analogistoun ta semadia Mas).

Einai Autos pou sas demiourgese apo mia kai mono psukhe (tou Adam), kai ekane gia sas enan topo diamones (stis metres ton meteron sas) kai ena meros apothekeuses (opou tha phulasseste sten osphu ton pateron sas). Pragmati, diasaphenesame ta semadia (kai tis apodeixeis pou deikhnoun te Duname Mas) gi' ekeinous pou katanooun.

Einai Autos pou stelnei nero apo ton ourano, kai m' auto kaname na phutrosoun phuta apo kathe eidos. Etsi, kaname na phutrosoun prasina (phuta kai dentra), kai kaname na phutrosoun ap' auta sitera, to ena pano sto allo (opos to ruzi, to kalampoki kai to sitari klp.). Kai (kaname na phutrosoun) apo ta spathe ton phoinikon, tsampia khourmadon pou kremontai khamela kai konta (sta kheria sas), kai (kaname na phutrosoun) kepoi me ampelia, kai (kaname na phutrosoun) elies kai rodies, paromoies (ste demiourgia) alla diaphoretikes (ste geuse). Koitaxte tous karpous tous otan karpophoroun kai orimazoun. Pragmati, uparkhoun semadia s' auta gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun.

(Oi eidololatres) ethesan ta tzinn os etairous tou Allakh ste latreia, parolo pou Autos einai pou ta demiourgese (kai kaneis allos). Epises epinoesan pseudos khoris gnose oti (o Allakh) ekhei gious (opos iskhuristekan oi Ebraioi oti o Ouzaier einai o gios tou Allakh, kai oi Khristianoi oti o Iesous einai o gios tou Allakh) kai kores (opos iskhuristekan oi eidololatres oti oi aggeloi einai thelukoi kai einai oi kores tou Allakh). Doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti perigraphoun.
(O Allakh) einai o Protourgos ton ouranon kai tes Ges. Pos, loipon na ekhei uio, an kai den ekhei suzugo; Demiourgese ta panta kai einai sta panta Pantognostes.

Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas, den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Einai o Demiourgos ton panton, gi' auto latrepste Ton. Pragmati, Autos einai o Diakheiristes ton panton.
Kamia orase den mporei na Ton phtasei, eno Ekeinos perikleiei oles tis oraseis. Kai Autos einai o Al-Lateiph (o Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou), o Al-Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Pragmati, sas erthan semadia (kai apodeixeis) apo ton Kurio sas. Etsi, opoios ta blepei (kai pisteuei s' auta), tha einai gia to ophelos tou, alla opoios kanei ta straba matia (kai ta arneitai), tha einai eis baros tou. Kai den eimai parateretes pano sas (gia na katagrapso tis praxeis sas, alla eimai enas Aggeliaphoros pou sas metaphero to Menuma tou Kuriou olon ton kosmon, kai Autos einai pou tha sas pherei gia logodotese).>>

Etsi, diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia (tou Kor'an), kai tha poun (oi eidololatres): <<Ta emathes (auta ta Edaphia apo tis graphes ton Ebraion kai ton Khristianon kai den einai apokalupse pou apokaluphtheke s' esena)!>> Kai epises (diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia) gia na diasaphenisoume aute (ten aletheia) gi' ekeinous pou xeroun.

Akolouthese, loipon, (o Prophete) o,ti sou apokaluphtheke apo ton Kurio sou. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Kai apomakrunsou ap' ekeinous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.
An ethele o Allakh, de tha eikhan apodosei etairous s' Auton ste latreia. Omos, den se orisame paraterete pano tous, oute eisai o kedemonas tous.

Kai me prosbalete (o, pistoi) ekeinous tous opoious epikalountai (oi apistoi) ektos tou Allakh, oste na men prosbaloun ki autoi ton Allakh adika kai apo agnoia. Etsi, kaname na phanei oraio gia kathe ethnos to ergo tou (eite etan kalo, eite etan kako, os antamoibe e poine gia ton dromo pou epelexe)* epeita pros ton Kurio tous tha einai e epistrophe tous, kai tote tha tous enemerosei gia ola osa ekanan.

Orkistekan (oi eidololatres) me to Onoma tou Allakh me polu zelo ston orko tous, oti an tous erkhotan ena semadi (ap' auta pou proteinan ston Prophete), sigoura tha pisteuan s' auto (to semadi). Pes (o, Prophete): <<(Den ekho ta semadia, alla) mono o Allakh pou ekhei ta semadia (kai ta stelnei opote thelei).>> Pos na xerete (o, pistoi), oti akoma ki an tous erkhotan (stous eidololatres, to semadi opos proteinan), pali de tha pisteuan! (Alla tha emenan sten apistia tous, epeide autoi den theloun ten kathodegese)!

Kai strephoume tis kardies kai ta matia tous makria (apo ten aletheia kai ten kathodegese) opos arnethekan na pistepsoun s' auto (to Kor'an) ten prote phora, kai tous aphenoume sten plane (kai ten apistia) tous, sastismenous.

Akoma ki an (tous stelname ta semadia opos proteinan, kai) tous stelname tous aggelous, kai tous milousan oi nekroi (kai tous epibebaionan oti eisai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh), kai mazeuame mprosta tous ta panta (pou proteinan), de tha pisteuan, ektos an to ethele o Allakh, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den to gnorizoun (kai gi' auto de strephontai ston Allakh gia na tous kathodegesei).

Etsi (opos se dokimasame, o, Prophete, me ten ekhthroteta auton ton eidololatron,) eikhame kanei gia kathe prophete ekhthrous apo tous diabolous ton anthropon kai ton tzinn, oi opoioi psithurizoun o enas ston allo logia planes pou ta oraiopoioun gia na paraplanesoun (o enas ton allon). An ethele o Allakh, de tha to ekanan, gi' auto aphese tous kai o,ti epinooun apo psemata,

Kai (ekeinoi oi diaboloi psithurizoun o enas ston allon ten plane) oste oi kardies ekeinon pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe na klinoun pros aute (ten plane), na te dekhtoun (kai na ten agapoun) kai gia na diaprattoun o,ti (amarties) tha diaprattoun.

(Pes, o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Einai dunaton na anazeteso allon krite ektos apo ton Allakh, otan Autos einai pou sas esteile to Biblio (to Kor'an) pou exegeitai leptomeros (kai periekhei ten krise sto thema metaxu mas);>> Ekeinoi (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi) stous opoious dosame to Biblio (ten Tora kai to In-tzel -to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou-) xeroun (apo tis apodeixeis stis graphes tous) oti (auto to Kor'an) ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio sou me ten aletheia. Etsi, men eisai pote anamesa s' autous pou amphiballoun (se otidepote apokaluphtheke s' esena).

O Logos (to Kor'an) tou Kuriou sou brisketai sten apolute eilikrineia (se logia kai eideseis) kai sten apolute dikaiosune (se kanones kai kriseis). Kaneis den mporei na allaxei ta Logia Tou, kai Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).

An upakoues tous perissoterous anthropous ste ge, tha se paraplanousan makria apo to dromo (threskeia) tou Allakh. Den akolouthoun para mono tis eikasies (nomizontas oti oi pseutikoi theoi tous, tous phernoun pio konta ston Allakh)* kai (s' auta pou iskhurizontai), pragmati, mono pseudontai.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou gnorizei kalutera poios parastratei apo to dromo Tou, kai gnorizei kalutera tous kathodegemenous.
Phate (o, pistoi) opoiodepote (epitrepto zoo) anaphertheke to Onoma tou Allakh kata to sphage tou, an ontos pisteuete sta Edaphia Tou.

Ti sas empodizei (o, pistoi) apo to na phate opoiodepote (epitrepto zoo) anaphertheke to Onoma tou Allakh kata te sphage tou, aphou (o Allakh) sas ekhei diasaphenisei ti einai apagoreumeno s' esas, ektos an anagkasteite (na to phate) apo anagke; Pragmati, polloi (eidololatres) paraplanoun (tous opadous tous apo ten aletheia) me tis paraplanetikes apopseis tous, khoris kamia gnose (epitrepontas s' autous o,ti apagoreuse o Allakh, opos ta nekra zoa klp., kai apagoreuontas s' autous o,ti epitrepse o Allakh, opos auta pou apagoreuoun oi eidololatres kai tous kaloun Mpakhira, Sa'impa, Oasila, Kham klp.). Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei kalutera tous parabates.
(O, anthropoi) apophugete te diapraxe amartias, eite phanera eite krupha. Pragmati, osoi diaprattoun amarties tha timorethoun gia o,ti ekanan.

Kai me phate (o, pistoi) opoiodepote (epitrepto zoo) den anaphertheke to Onoma tou Allakh kata te sphage tou, giati pragmati, aute einai anupakoe. St' aletheia, oi diaboloi psithurizoun stous opadous tous oste na diaphonesoun mazi sas (kai na sas poun: <<Pos den trote ta nekra zoa pou skotose o Allakh, eno trote auta pou sphazete eseis;>>). Kai an tous upakoute (-thetontas os epitrepta ta nekra zoa kai o,ti apagoreuse o Allakh-), tote tha eiste kai eseis eidololatres.

Einai autos pou etan pethamenos (sten apistia, ten agnoia kai tis amarties) kai epeita tou dosame zoe (ton kathodegesame sto Islam kai ste gnose) kai tou dosame phos (tes kathodegeses) me to opoio perpata anamesa stous anthropous, idios m' auton pou brisketai sta skotadia (tes apistias) apo ta opoia de tha bgei pote; Antistoikha, phanekan oraia stous apistous o,ti ekanan (apo kaka erga).

Kai paromoios, topothetesame se kathe pole, tous arkhegous ton kakon tes, gia na sunomotoun mesa tes (kalontas tous allous sten plane), alla st' aletheia, de sunomotoun para mono enantion tou eautou tous (kai e sunomosia tous tha einai eis baros tous), kai den to antilambanontai.

Otan tous erkhetai (stous eidololatres) ena semadi (kai apodeixe), lene: <<De tha pistepsoume pote mekhri na mas dothei to idio m' auto pou dotheke stous Aggeliaphorous tou Allakh (apo apokalupse kai thaumata).>> O Allakh xerei kalutera pou na topothetesei to Menuma Tou. Tha pesei pano s' autous pou dieprattan to kako (kai ten apistia) mia atimose apo ton Allakh kai tha ekhoun odunero marturio gia o,ti sunomotousan.

Opoion thelei o Allakh na ton kathodegesei, anoigei to stethos tou pros to Islam, kai opoion thelei (o Allakh) na ton parastratesei, kanei to stethos tou steno kai sphigmeno dunata, san na anebainei ston ourano. Etsi o Allakh stelnei ten timoria s' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun.
Auto (to Islam) einai o isios dromos tou Kuriou sou (o, Prophete). Ekhoume diasaphenisei ta Edaphia gia tous anthropous pou tha ta laboun upopse.

Oi opoioi (oi anthropoi pou tha ta laboun upopse) tha ekhoun ton Ntar Es-Salam (ton Paradeiso -ton oiko tes asphaleias kai tes eirenes) apo ton Kurio tous. Kai Autos tha einai o Uposteriktes kai o Prostates tous gia o,ti ekanan (apo kales praxeis sten egkosmia zoe).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ten Emera pou (o Allakh) tha tous sugkentrosei olous (tous anthropous kai ta tzinn, kai tha pei sta tzinn): <<O, Tzinn! Pragmati, ekhete paraplanesei pollous anthropous!>> Kai tote tha poun oi opadoi tous (ton tzinn) apo tous anthropous: <<Kurie mas! St' aletheia, apolausame o enas ton allon (ta tzinn apolausan ten upakoe kai te latreia mas pros autous, kai emeis apolausame tis epithumies mas), alla tora phtasame sto kathorismeno khrono pou mas orises (ten Emera tes Kriseos).>> Tha pei (o Allakh): <<E Photia einai e katoikia sas, opou tha meinete ekei gia panta, ektos apo o,ti thelei o Allakh (del. ektos apo opoion thelei o Allakh na bgei apo te Photia apo tous anupakouous pistous).>> Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Kai etsi, kanoume tous adikous na einai o enas kedemonas tou allou gia o,ti dieprattan apo amarties.

(Tha tous poume ten Emera tes Kriseos): <<O, tzinn kai anthropoi! Den erthan s' esas Aggeliaphoroi apo anamesa sas, oi opoioi sas apeggeilan ta Edaphia Mou kai sas proeidopoiesan gia te sunantese autes tes Emeras sas;>> Tha poun: <<Marturoume enantion tou eautou mas.>> Tous paraplanese e egkosmia zoe (me tis apolauseis kai ta stolidia tes), kai tha marturesoun enantion tou eautou tous, oti etan (kata ten egkosmia zoe) apistoi, (alla den tha tous ophelesei oute e marturia tous, oute to na pistepsoun ekeine ten Emera)!

Aute (e apostole ton Aggeliaphoron etan) epeide o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) pote de tha katestrephe poleis gia tis adikies tous, ephoson oi katoikoi tous de gnorizan (ten aletheia kai den tous ephtase to Menuma tou Allakh).
Gi' olous tha uparkhoun epipeda (kai bathmoi) sumphona me o,ti ekanan. Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) den agnoei o,ti kanoun.

O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) einai o Al-Ganei (o Plousios, o Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), pou ekhei megalo eleos. An thelei, mporei na sas katastrepsei kai na pherei meta apo sas opoious thelei, opos sas demiourgese apo tous apogonous allon anthropon.
(O, apistoi) pragmati, e uposkhese pou labate (gia ten anastase, ten apologia kai ten timoria) tha pragmatopoiethei oposdepote, kai den mporeite na xephugete (apo ton Allakh).

Pes (o, Prophete, proeidopoiontas tous eidololatres): <<O, lae mou! Sunekhiste na prattete opos eiste (me ton idio tropo sten apistia kai ten plane). Pragmati, kai ego tha pratto (o,ti me dietaxe o Kurios mou). Sigoura tha mathete poios tha ekhei ten kalutere katoikia (ton Paradeiso) ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, oi adikoi de tha petukhoun pote.>>

Kai (oi eidololatres kainotomesan kai) orisan gia ton Allakh ena meridio apo osa demiourgese apo tis kalliergeies kai ta booeide, kai etsi eipan: <<Auto einai gia ton Allakh.>>, -opos iskhurizontai-, (kai eipan): <<Kai auto einai gia tous etairous mas (ta eidola pou latreuan).>> Omos, o,ti orisan gia tous etairous tous (ta eidola), den to aphenan sto meridio tou Allakh (an epephte ekei logo aera klp.), eno o,ti orisan gia ton Allakh, to aphenan sto meridio ton etairon tous (ta eidola, an epephte ekei logo aera klp.) [del. an khanotan e katastrephotan kati apo to meridio ton eidolon, to epairnan apo to meridio tou Allakh kai to ebazan sto meridio ton eidolon, kai okhi to antistropho. Kai an epephte kati apo to meridio tou Allakh sto meridio ton eidolon, to aphenan ekei, alla an sunebaine to antistropho, to epairnan xana sto meridio ton eidolon]. Ti athlio einai auto pou krinoun!

Epises, oi etairoi (oi diaboloi) tous (ton eidololatron) ekanan na phanei kalo sta matia ton eidololatron e dolophonia ton paidion tous (apo phobo gia te phtokheia e ten atimose), gia na tous katastrepsoun (me to na diapraxoun auto to egklema pou apagorepse o Allakh) kai na tous mperdepsoun ste threskeia tous (kai na men xeroun ti epitrepetai kai ti apagoreuetai). An ethele o Allakh, de tha to ekanan, gi' auto aphese tous loipon kai o,ti psemata epinooun.

Kai eipan: <<Auta ta booeide kai e sugkomide einai apagoreumena, den ta trone ektos ap' ekeinous pou theloume emeis (apo tous uperetes ton eidolon).>> -opos iskhurizontai-. Kai apagorepsan epises kapoia booeide apo to na ta kabalaei kaneis (e na ta phortonei, kai ta apokalousan Mpakhira, Oasila, Sa'impa kai Kham). Kai kapoia booeide pou kata te sphage tous den anapheroun to Onoma tou Allakh (alla anapheroun ta onomata ton eidolon tous). Ola auta ta apedidan pseudos s' Auton (ton Allakh, oti o Allakh pou ta orise). Tha tous timoresei (o Allakh) gia o,ti epinoesan apo psemata.

Kai eipan: <<O,ti uparkhei stis metres auton ton booeidon (an gennethei zontano) epitrepetai apokleistika gia tous andres anamesa mas (gia phageto) kai einai apagoreumeno gia tis suzugous mas.>> Kai omos, an gennethei nekro, tote oloi tha ekhoun meridio s' auto. Tha tous timoresei (o Allakh) gia o,ti eipan pseudos. Pragmati, (o Allakh) einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Pragmati, ekhasan (kai katastraphekan) ekeinoi pou skotosan ta paidia tous apo anoesia kai khoris gnose, kai apagorepsan auta (ta booeide) pou tous parekhei o Allakh (ta opoia ta apokaloun Mpakhira, Oasila, Sa'impa kai Kham), kai ta apedidan auta pseudos ston Allakh (oti o Allakh pou ta orise). Pragmati, ekhoun parastratesei kai den einai kathodegemenoi.

Einai Autos pou demiourgese peribolia, anarrikhomena (se xula kai pergkoles, opos ta ampelia klp.) kai me anarrikhomena (opos ta dentra pou stekontai ston kormo tous). Kai (demiourgese) tis khourmadies kai tis kalliergeies diaphoretikon karpon, kai (demiourgese) tis elies kai tis rodies, paromoies (ste demiourgia) alla diaphoretikes (ste geuse). Phate apo tous karpous tous otan karpophoroun kai doste (stous phtokhous) te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) pou opheiletai apo tous karpous, ten emera tes sugkomides. Kai me spatalate (eite otan trote, eite otan dinete se eleemosune ap' autous). Pragmati, (o Allakh) den agapa tous spatalous.

Kai (einai Autos pou demiourgese) apo ta booeide merika pou mporoun na phortothoun (opos oi megales kameles klp.) kai merika okhi (opos ta katsikia klp.). Phate apo o,ti sas parekhei o Allakh kai men akoloutheite ta bemata tou Satana (me to na epitrepete o,ti apagorepse o Allakh, opos ta nekra zoa klp., kai me to na apagoreuete o,ti epetrepse o Allakh apo booeide, opos kanoun oi eidololatres pou apagoreuoun auta pou ta apokaloun Mpakhira, Sa'impa kai Kham). Pragmati autos (o Satanas) einai gia sas enas prophanes ekhthros.

(Demiourgese gia sas) okto eide (booeidon): apo ta probata duo (1,2) (arseniko kai theluko), kai apo ta katsikia duo (3,4) (arseniko kai theluko). Pes (o, Aggeliaphore, stous eidololatres pou apagoreuoun kapoia booeide kai ta apokaloun Mpakhira, Oasila, Sa'impa kai Kham): <<Ekhei apagoreusei (o Allakh) ta duo arsenika e ta duo theluka (apo ta probata kai ta katsikia logo oti einai arsenika e theluka); E (ekhei apagoreusei o Allakh) auta pou periekhoun oi metres ton duo thelukon (apo mikra, eite arsenika, eite theluka);>> [Ean apantoun kataphatika se kati ap' auta, pes tous: <<Tote giati mia phora na apagorepsete to theluko, eno ten alle na apagorepsete to arseniko;>>] (Kai pes tous:) <<Enemeroste me me gnose ean eiste eilikrineis!>>

Kai apo tis kameles duo (5,6) (arseniko kai theluko) kai apo tis agelades duo (7,8) (arseniko kai theluko). Pes (o, Aggeliaphore): <<Ekhei apagoreusei (o Allakh) ta duo arsenika e ta duo theluka (apo tis kameles kai tis agelades); E (ekhei apagoreusei o Allakh) auta pou periekhoun oi metres ton duo thelukon (apo mikra, eite arsenika, eite theluka); E esastan paron otan o Allakh dietaxe esas (tous eidololatres) auto;>> Poios einai, loipon, pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh gia na paraplanesei tous anthropous khoris gnose; Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei ton adiko lao.

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres): <<De brisko mesa s' auto pou mou apokaluphtheke kati (apo auta pou apagoreuete apo ta booeide, to na einai) apagoreumeno gi' auton pou tha to etroge ektos ki an prokeitai gia nekro zoo, gia aima pou khutheke (pou bgainei ten ora tes sphages enos zoou), gia sarka khoirou giati einai akatharto, e gia zoa pou otan sphakhtekan anaphertheke to onoma allou ektos tou Allakh. An omos kapoios anagkasteke (na katanalosei kati ap' auta ta proanapheromena) khoris na to katanalosei apo epithumia, oute na uperbainei (to orio tes anagkaiotetas), tote st' aletheia, o Kurios sou einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Stous Ebraious apagorepsame (os poine) opoiodepote zoo den ekhei anoikhta dakhtula (opos oi kameles, oi strouthokameloi, oi papies kai oi khenes klp.), kai apo tis agelades kai ta probata, apagorepsame to lipos tous ektos apo o,ti proskollatai sten plate e sta entera tous, e o,ti kollaei sta kokkala tous. Tous kaname aute ten poine (kai ten apagoreuse) gia ten parabase (kai ten adikia) tous. Pragmati, Eimaste Eilikrineis (se o,ti leme e krinoume).
Ean omos se diapseudoun (o, Prophete), tote pes (tous): <<O Kurios sas ekhei aperanto eleos, alla e timoria Tou den apokrouetai apo tous kakous anthropous.>>

Ekeinoi pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia tha poun: <<An ethele o Allakh, oute emeis, oute oi progonoi mas de tha eikhame apodosei etairous ston Allakh ste latreia, oute tha eikhame apagoreusei tipote (ston eauto mas apo ta booeide pou ta ethese o Allakh epitrepta).>> Omoios, diepseudan (tous Aggeliaphorous) ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous mekhri pou geutekan ten timoria Mas. Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ekhete kapoia gnose (kai apodeixe) pou mporeite na mas parousiasete (oti o Allakh dekhteke apo sas to na Tou apodidete etairous ste latreia kai na apagoreuete auta ta booeide pou ta epetrepse); Pragmati, den akoloutheite para mono eikasies, kai pragmati, auta pou lete den einai para psemata!
Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Allakh ekhei to apoluto epikheirema (eno eseis ekhete mataio epikheirema). An ethele (o Allakh), tha sas kathodegouse olous.>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres pou apagoreuoun auta ta booeide pou epetrepse o Allakh): <<Pherte tous martures sas pou marturoun oti o Allakh ekhei apagoreusei auta.>> Ean marturoun, men martureis mazi tous, oute na akoloutheis tis mataies epithumies ekeinon pou diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas, kai pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe kai exisonoun allous me ton Kurio tous (apodidontas etairous s' Auton ste latreia).

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Elate na sas apaggeilo auta pou o Kurios sas apagoreuse gia sas (kai sas diatazei ta exes): na men Tou apodidete etairous ste latreia, (na men parakoute tous goneis sas, alla) -na sumperiphereste me ton kalutero tropo stous goneis sas-, na me skotonete ta paidia sas apo to phobo tes phtokheias, -Emeis pou parekhoume gia sas kai gi' autous-, na men plesiazete tis aiskhres praxeis, eite phaneres eite kruphes, na me skotonete ten psukhe pou o Allakh apagorepse (opoiadepote psukhe), ektos gia dikaious logous (an to dikaio to apaitei - opos ten psukhe enos dolophonou). Auta sas diatazei o Allakh, mepos kai sullogisteite.

Kai na men plesiazete ten periousia ton orphanon para mono me kalo tropo (kai gia na ten beltiosete) mekhri ten enelikiose tou. Na metrate kai na zugizete me (plere) dikaiosune. Kanenan den epibarunoume me parapano ap' o,ti antekhei. Otan milate, na milate dikaia, akoma ki an aphora kapoion suggene sas. Kai na ekplerosete te desmeuse sas pros ton Allakh. Auta sas diatazei (o Allakh), mepos kai ta labete upopse.

Kai oti autos einai o isios dromos Mou, etsi, akoloutheste ton. Kai men akoloutheite allous dromous pou tha sas odegesoun makria apo ton dromo Tou. Auta sas diatazei, mepos kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).>>

Epeita, (anaphere, o, Mokhammant, oti) dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora) os oloklerose (tes khares Mas) s' ekeinon pou epratte to kalo, kai os leptomere exegese gia kathe pragma kai os kathodegese kai eleos. Mepos kai pistepsoun oti tha sunantesoun ton Kurio tous.
Auto (to Kor'an) einai ena eulogemeno Biblio pou ekhoume steilei, gi' auto akoloutheste to kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), isos kai na eleetheite.

(Kai steilame auto to Kor'an) gia na men peite (o, eidololatres) pleon: <<Ta Biblia stalthekan mono se duo omades (stous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous) prin apo mas (eno s' emas den esteile o Allakh kanena Biblio), kai emeis den xerame na ta diabasoume (epeide etan se alles glosses).>>

E na peite: <<An mono mas eikhe stalei ena Biblio, tha emastan pio kathodegemenoi ap' autous (tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous).>> Pragmati, erthe se sas apo ton Kurio sas mia xekathare apodeixe (to Kor'an), kai kathodegese kai eleos. Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou diepseuse ta Edaphia tou Allakh kai apomakruntheke ap' auta; Pragmati, tha timoresoume ekeinous pou apomakrunontai apo ta Edaphia Mas me to kheirotero marturio, gia ten apomakrunse tous.

Perimenoun (o, Mokhammant, autoi oi apistoi) na tous erthoun oi aggeloi (pou tha tous aphairesoun te zoe tous) e na erthei o Kurios sou (gia na krinei metaxu tous kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) e na erthoun merika apo ta semadia tou Kuriou sou (pou tha anakoinosoun ten Emera tes Kriseos); Pragmati, ten Emera pou tha erthoun merika apo ta semadia tou Kuriou sou, kamia psukhe de tha ten ophelesei to na pistepsei (ekeine ten stigme) an den eikhe ede pistepsei apo prin, oute (tha ten ophelesei to na kanei ekeine te stigme kales praxeis) an den eikhe ede kanei kales praxeis eno etan piste. Pes (tous): <<Perimenete tote (kati ap' auta)! Perimenoume ki emeis!>>

St' aletheia, ekeinoi (oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi kai ekeinoi pou kainotomoun ste threskeia) pou diairesan te threskeia tous (del. te threskeia tou Abraam, -to Islam-) kai diaspastekan se aireseis (Ioudaismo kai Khristianismo klp.), esu (o, Prophete) den ekheis kamia skhese mazi tous (e me ten plane tous, kai e euthune sou einai mono na tous proeidopoieseis). E upothese tous anekei mono ston Allakh, epeita tha tous enemerosei gia o,ti ekanan.

Opoios erkhetai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) ekhontas kanei mia kale praxe, tha antameiphthei me dekaplasia amoibe, kai opoios erkhetai ekhontas kanei mia kake praxe, tha timorethei mono gi' aute (khoris na pollaplasiastei), kai de tha adikethoun.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, o Kurios mou me kathodegese se ena isio monopati, mia orthe threskeia, te threskeia tou Abraam, o opoios (o Abraam) etan Khaneiphan (apekline apo ola ta mataia dogmata, akolouthontas kai teinontas pros ten alethine piste), kai den etan ap' ekeinous pou apedidan etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, e proseukhe mou, oi thusies mou, e zoe mou kai o thanatos mou einai gia ton Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Den ekhei kanenan etairo. Kai m' auto diatakhtheka kai eimai o protos (apo auto to ethnos) Mousoulmanos (upotagmenos ste boulese tou Allakh).>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Einai dunaton na epidioko allon pera apo ton Allakh os Kurio, eno Autos einai o Kurios ton panton;>> Kamia psukhe den diaprattei kamia amartia para na einai eis baros tes (kai tha labei ten timoria gi' aute). Kamia amartole psukhe den tha epomistei ten amartia kapoias alles. Epeita ston Kurio sas tha einai e epistrophe sas, kai tote tha sas enemerosei gia o,ti diaphonousate metaxu sas.

Einai Autos pou sas ekane genies -e mia meta apo ten alle- ste ge, kai ekhei anadeixei kapoious apo esas pano apo kapoious allous se epipeda (bioporismou kai demiourgias), oste na sas dokimasei meso auton pou sas ekhei parakhoresei. St' aletheia, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) einai Gregoros sten timoria, kai epises einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

A, L, M, S (Aliph, Lam, Meim, Sant, tessera xekhorista arabika grammata pou den apoteloun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun kapoia semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh prokalei opoiondepote amphiballei gia to Kor'an na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio).

Auto (to Kor'an) einai ena Biblio pou staltheke se sena (o, Prophete), opote as men ekheis amphibolia sto stethos sou gi' auto (oute agonia sten kardia sou apo te diadose tou). (Staltheke se sena) gia na proeidopoieseis m' auto kai os upenthumise stous pistous.
Akoloutheste (o, anthropoi) auto pou sas ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio sas kai men akoloutheite ektos Autou kedemones (pou tha sas paraplanesoun). Ligo einai auto pou to lambanete upopse!
Poses poleis katastrepsame (logo tes apistias tous) kai tous erthe e timoria Mas te nukhta e eno xekourazontan to mesemeri (del. xaphnika ten ora pou den ten perimenan).
Kai otan tous erthe e timoria Mas, tote e krauge tous den etan para oti (anagnorisan ten amartia tous kai) eipan: <<Pragmati, emastan adikoi!>>

Pragmati, tha rotesoume (ten Emera tes Kriseos) ekeinous (tous laous) stous opoious stalthekan oi Aggeliaphoroi (gia to ti apantesan stous Aggeliaphorous tous), kai pragmati, tha rotesoume kai tous idious tous Aggeliaphorous (gia to ti tous apantesan oi laoi tous).
Pragmati, tha tous enemerosoume me gnose (gia o,ti ekanan kata ten egkosmia zoe), kai pote den apousiazame.
To zugisma (ton praxeon) ekeine ten Emera tha einai me ten aletheia (kai te dikaiosune). Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai baria, autoi tha einai oi epitukhemenoi.
Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai elaphria, autoi tha einai pou ekhasan ton eauto tous gia o,ti arnethekan adika apo ta Edaphia Mas.
Pragmati, sas egkathidrusame ste Ge kai phtiaxame gia sas ekei eide bioporismou. Ligo einai auto pou deikhnete apo eugnomosune (pros ton Allakh).

Pragmati, sas demiourgesame, epeita sas diamorphosame, kai epeita eipame stous aggelous: <<Peste se Soutzount stase (del. me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos) enopion tou Adam (os sebasmo kai time pros auton).>> Kai etsi, epesan oloi se Soutzount stase, ektos apo ton Implis (-ton Satana- pou etan apo ta tzinn, o opoios arnetheke kai) den etan ap' autous pou epesan se Soutzount stase.

Eipe (o Allakh ston Implis -Satana-): <<Ti se empodise na peseis se Soutzount stase otan se dietaxa;>> Eipe: <<Eimai kaluteros ap' auton. Me demiourgeses apo photia eno auton ton demiourgeses apo pelo.>>

Eipe (o Allakh ston Implis -Satana-): <<Kateba, loipon, ap' auton (ton topo ton aggelon)! Den einai epitrepto gia sena na deixeis alazoneia mesa tou (autou tou epipedou). Bges exo, eisai enas apo tous atimasmenous.>>
Eipe (o Implis -Satanas-): <<Dose mou mia anabole mekhri ten Emera pou tha anastethoun (oi anthropoi).>>
Eipe (o Allakh): <<Eisai enas ap' autous pou tha laboun anabole.>>

Eipe (o Implis -Satanas-): <<Epeide me ekanes na parastrateso (dioti den upakousa ten entole Sou), tha kathomai na tous perimeno (tous anthropous) ston isio dromo Sou (gia na tous apotrepo ap' auton).

Epeita, tha ertho s' autous apo mprosta tous kai apo piso tous, kai apo ta dexia tous kai apo ta aristera tous (gia na tous apotrepso apo ten aletheia kai na psithurizo stis kardies tous amphibolies gia te Mellousa Zoe, kai na doun ten plane os aletheia kai to antistropho), kai de tha breis (o, Allakh) tous perissoterous ap' autous eugnomones.>>

Eipe (o Allakh): <<Bges ap' auton (ton topo ton kontinon aggelon), misetos kai diogmenos (apo to eleos tou Allakh)! Oso gia opoious tha se akolouthesoun ap' autous (tous anthropous), pragmati, tha gemiso ten Kolase me sas olous mazi (m' esena kai osous tha se upakoun).>>
(Kai eipe epises o Allakh:) <<O, Adam! Katoikese esu kai e suzugos sou ston Paradeiso kai phate ap' opou thelete. Alla men plesiasete auto to dentro, oste na men eiste anamesa stous adikous.>>

Etsi, o Satanas tous psithurise gia na kanei (os sunepeia), na phanerothoun s' autous o,ti etan kalummeno apo to na to doun, apo ta apokrupha semeia tous. Eipe (o Satanas): <<O Kurios sas de sas apagorepse auto to dentro para mono gia na men ginete duo aggeloi e na eiste apo tous athanatous!>>
Kai tous orkisteke (o Satanas): <<Pragmati, eimai enas ap' autous pou sas dinoun eilikrine sumboule.>>

Etsi, (o Satanas) tous katebase (apo to epipedo tes upakoues sto epipedo tes parakoes) me paraplanese (deikhnontas tous oti thelei to kalo tous eno krubei ten kake prothese tou). Kai otan dokimasan apo to dentro, tote ta apokrupha semeia tous eginan phanera s' autous (aphou aphairetheke to kalumma -e to phos- pou ta ekrube) kai arkhisan na kalupsoun ta apokrupha semeia tous me ta phulla tou Paradeisou. Kai o Kurios tous tous phonaxe (legontas): <<De sas apagorepsa auto to dentro kai sas eipa oti o Satanas einai phaneros ekhthros s' esas;>>
Eipan: <<Kurie mas! Adikesame ton eauto mas! An den mas sugkhoreseis kai den mas eleeseis, sigoura tha eimaste apo tous khamenous!>>
Eipe (o Allakh): <<Katebeite (oloi sas ste Ge), os ekhthroi metaxu sas, kai tha ekhete ste Ge topo katoikias kai agatha gia kapoio diastema.>>
Eipe (o Allakh): <<Ekei (ste Ge) tha zesete kai ekei tha pethanete kai apo mesa tes tha anastetheite.>>

O, paidia tou Adam! St' aletheia, sas diathesame roukhismo gia na krupsei ta apokrupha semeia sas kai roukhismo gia stolismo, alla to na parete os enduma ten eusebeia (kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles tou Allakh) einai to kalutero. Auto einai ena apo ta semadia tou Allakh (pou apodeiknuoun tis khares Tou stous doulous Tou), mepos kai ta laboun upopse. [Omos o Satanas paraplanese tous eidololatres kai tous ekane na kanoun periphora guro apo ten Ka'mpa entelos gumnoi, anti na kaluptoun to soma tous me o,ti tous pareikhe o Allakh apo roukhismo].

O, paidia tou Adam! Men aphesete ton Satana na sas paraplanesei (kai na sas kanei na aphesete to roukhismo sas e ten eusebeia sas) opos ekane tous goneis sas na ekdiokhthoun apo ton Paradeiso, bgazontas (o Satanas) ta roukha tous gia na kanei na phanerothoun s' autous ta apokrupha semeia tous. Autos kai oi apogonoi tou sas blepoun apo ekei pou den mporeite na tous deite. Pragmati, kaname tous diabolous na einai kedemones auton pou den pisteuoun.

Otan (oi eidololatres) diaprattoun mia epaiskhunte praxe (opos ten eidololatria kai to na kanoun periphora guro apo ten Ka'mpa entelos gumnoi), lene: <<Brekame tous progonous mas na ten kanoun, kai o Allakh mas dietaxe na ten kanoume.>> Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, o Allakh den diatassei pote epaiskhuntes praxeis. Lete (pseudos) gia ton Allakh auta pou den gnorizete;>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O Kurios mou ekhei diataxei te dikaiosune, na aphosiosete te latreia sas pros Auton opou ki an proseukhetheite (eidika sta tzamia) kai na Ton epikalesteite aphosionontas ten upakoe sas pros Auton. Opos sas demiourgese (apo ten anuparxia) ten prote phora, etsi tha epistrepsete ste zoe (otan tha anastetheite).>>

(O Allakh diakhorise tous anthropous se duo omades:) mia omada pou kathodegese (dieukolunontas gi' auten ola ta mesa tes kathodegeses kai apomakrune ap' auten o,ti empodizei ten kathodegese), kai mia alle omada pou axize na parastratethei, (epeide) ekhoun parei tous diabolous os kedemones ektos tou Allakh, nomizontas oti einai kathodegemenoi (ston isio dromo)!

O, paidia tou Adam! Ntutheite kala (del. ta kathara kai oraia roukha sas pou kaluptoun auta pou prepei na kaluphthoun apo to soma sas) opou ki an proseukhetheite (kai otan teleite periphora guro apo ten Ka'mpa). Kai trote kai pinete, alla me spatalate, giati (o Allakh) den agapa tous spatalous.

Pes (o Mokhammant, stous eidololatres pou peripherontai gumnoi guro apo ten Ka'mpa, kai apagoreuoun ta kala agatha pou ta epetrepse o Allakh): <<Poios apagorepse (se sas) ta kala endumata pou parekhei o Allakh stous doulous Tou os stolidia, kai ta kala agatha;>> Pes: <<Auta einai gia tous pistous sten egkosmia zoe (akoma ki an ta moirastoun mazi tous oi apistoi), alla tha einai apokleistika gi' autous (tous pistous) ten Emera tes Anastases (aphou o Paradeisos tha einai apagoreumenos stous apistous).>> Etsi diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia me leptomereia gi' ekeinous pou gnorizoun (kai katanooun).

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, o Kurios mou apagorepse mono tis aiskhres praxeis, eite phaneres eite kruphes, tis amarties kai tis adikes katapieseis, to na apodidete ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, gia tous opoious (pseutikous etairous) den ekhei stalei (apo ton Allakh) kamia apodeixe (oti axizoun te latreia), kai to na lete gia ton Allakh auta pou den gnorizete.>>
Gia kathe ethnos oristeke enas kathorismenos khronos. Etsi, otan elthei o kathorismenos khronos tous, den mporoun na ton kathusteresoun oute mia ora (e deuterolepto), oute na ton epispeusoun.

O, paidia tou Adam! Otan sas erthoun Aggeliaphoroi apo anamesa sas, pou sas apaggelloun ta Edaphia Mou, (upakouste tous). Etsi, opoioi phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai diorthonoun tis praxeis tous, de tha uparxei phobos gi' autous (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Osoi omos diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas kai ta arnethekan me alazoneia, tha einai oi katoikoi tes Photias, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta.

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia e apodidontas ston Allakh logia pou den ta eipe) e diapseudei ta Edaphia Tou; S' ekeinous tha tous erthei to meridio tous (del. e moira tous apo kalo e kako sten egkosmia zoe) opos graphteke sto Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud). Mekhris otan tous erthoun oi aggeloi Mas gia na tous aphairesoun te zoe tous, kai na (tous) poun: <<Pou einai ekeinoi pou tous epikalousastan ektos apo ton Allakh;>> Tha poun: <<Mas egkateleipsan!>> Etsi, marturesan enantion tou eautou tous oti etan apistoi.

Eipe (o Allakh): <<Mpeite ste photia mazi me ta proegoumena ethne prin apo sas apo ta Tzinn kai tous anthropous.>> Kathe phora pou mpainei ena ethnos katarietai to proegoumeno. Mekhri pou na sugkentrothoun oloi mesa, oi teleutaioi ap' autous (oi opadoi) tha poun (ston Allakh) gia tous protous ap' autous (del. gia tous arkhegous tous): <<Kurie mas! Ekeinoi mas parastratesan, dose tous loipon diplo marturio apo te Photia>>. Tha pei (o Allakh): <<Gia olous sas uparkhei diplo marturio, alla den to gnorizete.>>

Oi protoi (oi arkhegoi) ap' autous tha poun stous teleutaious (stous opadous) ap' autous: <<Den uperekhete loipon apo mas (gia na elaphrunthei to marturio gia sas), geuteite loipon (opos kai emeis) to marturio gia o,ti diapraxate.>>

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou diepseudan ta Edaphia Mas kai ta arnethekan me alazoneia, de tha tous anoixoun oi pules tou ouranou (oute gia tis kales praxeis tous kata ten egkosmia zoe -logo tes apistias tous-, oute gia tis psukhes tous otan pethainoun), oute tha mpoun ston Paradeiso mekhri na perasei mia kamela apo ten trupa tes belonas (del. pote). Etsi timoroume tous kakous.
Tha ekhoun ten Kolase os krebati kai apo pano tous tha ekhoun skepasmata (apo te Photia, del. tha tous periballei e Photia apo oles tis pleures). Etsi timoroume tous adikous.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis (oso mporoun) -den epibarunoume kamia psukhe perissotero apo oso antekhei- tha einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta.

Tha aphairesoume apo tis kardies tous opoiadepote kakia, kai tha reoun apo kato tous potamia. Tha poun: <<Olos o epainos (kai e doxa) anekei ston Allakh pou mas kathodegese s' auto, giati den tha eikhame pote kathodegethei s' auto an den mas eikhe kathodegesei o Allakh. Pragmati, oi Aggeliaphoroi tou Kuriou mas erthan me ten aletheia.>> Tha tous phonaxei (kapoios): <<Autos einai o Paradeisos pou tha kleronomesete gia o,ti kanate (apo kales praxeis).>>

Oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou tha phonaxoun tous katoikous tes Kolases: <<Pragmati, brekame auto pou mas uposkhetheke o Kurios mas na einai alethino. Brekate ki eseis auto pou sas uposkhetheke o Kurios sas na einai alethino;>> Tha poun: <<Nai.>> Tote phonaxe kapoios anamesa tous: <<Eithe e katara tou Allakh na pesei pano stous adikous.>>

Oi opoioi (adikoi) einai ekeinoi pou empodizoun (tous anthropous) apo ton dromo (threskeia) tou Allakh, kai theloun na ginei (autos o dromos) strabos (oste na men ton akolouthesei kaneis), kai den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe.>>

Tha uparkhei ena pselo phragma anamesa tous (stous katoikous tou Paradeisou kai tes Kolases, to opoio phragma legetai Al-A'raph), kai pano sto Al-A'raph tha uparkhoun andres (pou oi kales praxeis tous einai ises me tis kakes praxeis tous) oi opoioi tha anagnorizoun kathe omada apo ta semadia tous (ta lampera prosopa ton katoikon tou Paradeisou, kai ta skoteina prosopa ton katoikon tes Kolases). Tha phonaxoun tous katoikous tou Paradeisou legontas: <<Eirene se sas.>> (Ekeinoi oi andres) den tha ekhoun mpei akoma s' auton (ton Paradeiso), alla tha elpizoun (na mpoun).
Kai otan ta matia tous strephontai pros tous katoikous tes Photias, tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Me mas kaneis mazi me tous adikous anthropous.>>

Autoi pou briskontai pano sto Al-A'raph tha phonaxoun kapoious antres (apo tous katoikous tes Kolases) tous opoious tha anagnorisoun apo ta semadia tous (ta skoteina prosopa tous), legontas: <<Den sas ophelesan oute o,ti mazepsate (apo ploute kai andres), oute e alazoneia sas gia ten aletheia!>>

(O Allakh tha pei stous apistous): <<Einai autoi pou orkistekate oti o Allakh de tha tous dosei pote eleos;>> (Epeita tha pei s' ekeinous pou briskontai pano sto Al-A'raph): <<Mpeite ston Paradeiso. Gia sas den tha uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh), oute tha lupetheite (gia otidepote paramelesate apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).>>

Oi katoikoi tes Photias tha phonaxoun tous katoikous tou Paradeisou: <<Rixte pano mas nero e apo o,ti sas parekhei o Allakh (apo agatha).>> Tha poun: <<O Allakh ekhei apagoreusei kai ta duo stous apistous.>>

Oi opoioi (oi apistoi) einai ekeinoi pou peran te threskeia tous os diaskedase kai paikhnidi, kai tous exapatese e egkosmia zoe (me tis apolauseis kai ta stolidia tes). Semera tha tous agnoesoume (aphenontas tous na upopheroun sto marturio) opos agnoesan te sunantese autes tes Emera tous, kai epeide arnethekan ta Edaphia Mas.
Pragmati, tous pherame ena Biblio (to Kor'an) pou to ekhoume exegesei leptomeros me gnose, to opoio periekhei kathodegese kai eleos gia tous pistous.

Perimenoun mono na ekplerothei (auto to marturio pou tous uposkhetheke o Allakh); Ten Emera pou tha ekplerothei, osoi to agnoesan prin tha poun: <<Pragmati, oi Aggeliaphoroi tou Kuriou mas erthan me ten aletheia. Uparkhoun diamesolabetes pou mporoun na mesolabesoun gia logariasmo mas; E mporoume na epistrepsoume (sten egkosmia zoe) gia na kanoume kati diaphoretiko ap' auto pou kaname;>> St' aletheia, tha ekhoun khasei ton eauto tous kai tha tous ekhoun egkataleipsei o,ti eikhan epinoesei (apo pseutikous theous).

O Kurios sas einai o Allakh, o Opoios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge se exi emeres kai meta anebeke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei sten Megaloprepeia Tou). Kanei te nukhta na kaluptei ten emera (-kai ten emera na kaluptei te nukhta-) kai na ten katadiokei gregora (e mia ten alle khoris kathusterese kai se monime diadokhe). Kai o elios, e selene kai ta asteria, ola upotagmena sten entole Tou. S' Auton anekei e demiourgia kai e entole. Eulogemenos einai o Allakh, o Kurios olon ton kosmon.
Epikalesteite ton Kurio sas me tapeinophrosune kai krupha. Pragmati, den agapa tous parabates (pou epikalountai allous ektos Autou).

Kai men skorpizete to kako (me tis amarties) ste ge meta ten anamorphose tes (meso tes apostoles ton Aggeliaphoron), kai epikalesteite Ton me phobo (gia ten timoria Tou) kai me elpida (gia ten antamoibe Tou). St' aletheia, to eleos tou Allakh einai konta s' autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Einai Autos pou stelnei tous anemous, os kharmosuna nea prin to eleos Tou (te brokhe). Mekhri pou (oi anemoi) na koubalesoun phortomena brokhe sunnepha, tote ta kateuthunoume se mia nekre ge, kai katebazoume pano tes to nero, kanontas m' auto na bgei kathe eidos karpon. Etsi anastainoume tous pethamenous, mepos kai labete upopse (te duname tou Allakh gia ten anastase).

E kale ge paragei te blastese tes me te Thelese tou Kuriou tes, alla ekeine pou einai kake paragei mono phtokhe kai ligoste blastese. Etsi dinoume diaphoretika semadia gi' ekeinous pou deikhnoun eugnomosune (pros tis khares Mas kai Mas upakoun).

Pragmati, steilame ton Noe ston lao tou. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. St' aletheia, phobamai gia sas to marturio mias tromeres Emeras!>>
Oi arkhegoi tou laou tou eipan: <<Blepoume oti briskesai se xekathare paraplanese.>>
Eipe (o Noe): <<O, lae mou! Den eimai paraplanemenos, alla eimai enas Aggeliaphoros apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Sas metadido ta menumata tou Kuriou mou kai sas dino eilikrineis sumboules, kai gnorizo apo ton Allakh auta pou den gnorizete.

Eiste ekplektoi oti sas erthe mia upenthumise apo ton Kurio sas meso enos anthropou apo sas, gia na sas proeidopoiesei kai gia na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai mepos na eleetheite;>>

Ekeinoi omos ton diepseudan, kai etsi, ton sosame kai autous pou etan mazi tou sten Kiboto, kai pnixame ekeinous pou diepseudan ta semadia Mas. Pragmati, etan tuphloi anthropoi (apo to na doun ten aletheia).

Kai ste phule 'Ant steilame ton adelpho tous, Khount. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Ma de tha phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou);
Oi apistoi arkhegoi tou laou tou eipan: <<Pragmati, se blepoume se anoesia kai nomizoume oti eisai enas apo tous pseutes.>>
Eipe (o Khount): <<O, lae mou! Den eimai anoetos, alla eimai enas Aggeliaphoros apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Sas metadido ta menumata tou Kuriou mou kai sas dino eilikrineis sumboules, kai eimai axiopistos (se o,ti metadido se sas apo ta menumata tou Allakh, oute prostheto, oute krubo kati apo auta).

Eiste ekplektoi oti sas erthe mia upenthumise apo ton Kurio sas meso enos anthropou apo sas, gia na sas proeidopoiesei; Thumetheite otan (o Allakh) sas ekane diadokhous meta to lao tou Noe kai auxese ta somata sas se duname kai ogko. Thumetheite tis khares tou Allakh, mepos kai epitukhete.>>

Eipan: <<Erthes se mas na mas diatazeis na latreuoume mono ton Allakh kai na egkataleipsoume o,ti latreuan oi progonoi mas; Phere mas, loipon, auto (to marturio) pou mas uposkhethekes, an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>

Eipe (o Khount): <<Pragmati, tora axizete na pesei pano sas e timoria kai e orge apo ton Kurio sas (oi opoies oposdepote tha pesoun se sas). Diaphoneite mazi mou skhetika me apla onomata (ton eidolon) pou ekhete epinoesei eseis kai oi progonoi sas, kai gia ta opoia (onomata) o Allakh den ekhei steilei kamia apodeixe (oute exousia oti tha prepei na latreuontai mazi me ton Allakh); Perimenete, loipon (ten timoria). Perimeno ki ego mazi sas.>>
Etsi, sosame me to eleos Mas auton kai osous etan mazi tou, kai exontosame ekeinous pou diepseusan ta semadia Mas, kai den etan pistoi.

Kai ste phule Thamount steilame ton adelpho tous, Salikh. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Pragmati, erthe se sas mia xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio sas: aute einai mia kamela pou sas esteile o Allakh os semadi gia sas. Apheste ten loipon na boskesei ste ge tou Allakh kai men ten aggixete me kako, diaphoretika tha pesei se sas ena odunero marturio.

Thumetheite otan (o Allakh) sas ekane diadokhous meta te phule 'Ant kai sas egkatestese ste ge. Khtizate palatia (kai megala spitia) stous kampous tes kai skalizate spitia sta bouna. Thumetheite loipon tis khares tou Allakh kai me skorpizete to kako ste ge.>>

Oi arkhegoi tou laou tou pou edeixan alazoneia, eipan stous pistous pou tous theorousan adunamous: <<Kserete pragmatika oti o Salikh ekhei stalei apo ton Kurio tou;>> Eipan: <<Pragmati, pisteuoume s' auto me to opoio ekhei stalei.>>
Ekeinoi pou edeixan alazoneia eipan: <<Pragmati, emeis s' auto pou pisteuete eseis, den pisteuoume!>>

Etsi, skotosan ten kamela, edeixan alazoneia enantia sten entole tou Kuriou tous kai eipan: <<O, Salikh! Phere mas auto (to marturio) pou mas uposkhethekes, an eisai ontos enas apo tous Apestalmenous.>>
Etsi, tous epiase o dunatos seismos kai epesan nekroi sta prosopa kai ta gonata tous ston oiko (kai te ge) tous.

Tote (o Salikh) apostrapheke ap' autous kai eipe (os epiplexe): <<O, lae mou! Pragmati, sas metedosa to menuma tou Kuriou mou kai sas edose eilikrineis sumboules, alla eseis den agapate ekeinous pou dinoun sumboules.>>
Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant, gia) ton Lot, otan eipe ston lao tou: <<Diaprattete mia tetoia epaiskhunte praxe (ten anomalia) pou kaneis apo olo ton kosmo den ten ekhei diapraxei pote prin apo sas;
Eseis (oi andres) ekhete sexoualike epaphe me tous allous andres kai potho (gi' autous), anti gia tis gunaikes. Den eiste para parabates.>>
E apantese tou laou tou den etan para oti eipan: <<Dioxte tous apo ten pole sas, giati einai anthropoi pou apekhoun (apo ten anomalia kai theloun na diaterountai agnoi)!>>
Etsi, sosame auton (ton Lot) kai ten oikogeneia tou (diatazontas ton na phugoun to bradu apo ten pole) ektos apo te gunaika tou, e opoia etan ap' ekeinous pou emeinan piso (kai katastraphekan).
Kai rixame pano tous brokhe (apo skleres pelines petres). Koita (o, Mokhammant) pos etan to telos ton kakon!

Kai ste phule Madiam steilame ton adelpho tous, Sou'aimp. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Pragmati, erthe se sas mia xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio sas. Na metrate kai na zugizete me (plere) dikaiosune, men adikeite tous anthropous sta pragmata tous (kai ta dikaiomata tous) kai me skorpizete to kako ste ge meta ten anamorphose tes (meso tes apostoles ton Aggeliaphoron). Auto einai to kalutero gia sas, ean eiste pistoi.

Men perimenete se kathe monopati, apeilontas (tous anthropous gia na parete na khremata tous) kai apotrepontas apo to dromo (threskeia) tou Allakh osous pisteuoun s' Auton, kai epidiokontas na ginei strabos (autos o dromos oste na men ton akolouthesei kaneis). Anapherete (te khare tou Allakh se sas) otan esastan ligoi, kai (o Allakh) sas auxese se arithmo. Koitaxte pos etan to telos auton pou skorpizan to kako.

Ean uparkhei mia omada apo sas pou pisteuei s' auto me to opoio ekho stalei, eno alle omada den pisteuei, tote perimenete mekhri na krinei o Allakh anamesa mas, kai Autos einai o Kaluteros apo tous krites.>>

Oi arkhegoi tou laou tou pou edeixan alazoneia, eipan: <<O, Sou'aimp! Pragmati, tha dioxoume esena kai osous pisteuoun mazi sou apo ten pole mas, ektos an epistrepsete ste threskeia mas.>> Eipe: <<Akoma ki an ten apekhthanomaste;

Tha eikhame epinoesei etsi psemata enantion tou Allakh ean epistrephame ste threskeia sas, aphou o Allakh mas esose ap' auten. Den mas epitrepetai na epistrepsoume s' auten, an den to thelei o Kurios mas, o Allakh! O Kurios mas perikleiei ta panta me te gnose Tou. Empisteuomaste ton Allakh. Kurie mas! Krine loipon anamesa se mas kai ton lao mas me aletheia, giati Esu eisai o Kaluteros apo tous krites.>>
Oi arkhegoi tou laou tou pou arnethekan ten piste, eipan: <<(O, lae mas!) Ean akolouthesete ton Sou'aimp, sigoura tha eiste khamenoi.>>
Etsi, tous epiase o dunatos seismos (kai e megale krauge) kai epesan nekroi sta prosopa kai ta gonata tous ston oiko (kai te ge) tous!
Ekeinoi pou diepseudan ton Sou'aimp eginan san na men eikhan katoikesei ekei pote. St' aletheia, ekeinoi pou diepseudan ton Sou'aimp etan oi khamenoi.

Etsi, (o Sou'aimp) apomakruntheke ap' autous kai eipe (os epiplexe): <<O, lae mou! Pragmati, sas metedosa ta menumata tou Kuriou mou kai sas edosa eilikrineis sumboules. Pos loipon na stenakhoriemai gia enan apisto lao;>>

Pragmati, de steilame kanenan prophete se kamia komopole, para na ekhoume plexei (ekeinous pou ton diepseusan apo) tous katoikous tes me phtokheia kai astheneies, mepos kai epikalestoun (ton Allakh) me tapeinophrosune kai upotage (kai na egkataleipsoun ten apistia kai ten alazoneia tous).

Epeita allaxame ten kake katastase (kai tis antixootetes) se kale katastase (kai euemeria), ospou auxethekan (se arithmo kai ploute), kai eipan: <<Kai oi progonoi mas upestesan kakoukhies kai eikhan periodo euemerias (gi' auto o,ti mas sunebe apo kalo kai kako, einai kati aplo).>> [Pragmati, o,ti tous sunebe etan gia na to laboun upopse]. Etsi, tous steilame xaphnika ten timoria khoris na to antilephthoun.

Kai an oi katoikoi ton komopoleon eikhan pistepsei kai eikhan phulakhthei apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), tha eikhame anoixei gi' autous portes eulogias apo ton ourano kai te Ge. Alla ekeinoi diepseusan (tous Aggeliaphorous), kai etsi, tous timoresame gia osa ekanan.
Aisthanontai asphaleis oi katoikoi ton komopoleon apo to na pesei e timoria Mas s' autous te nukhta eno koimountai;
E mepos aisthanontai asphaleis oi katoikoi ton komopoleon apo to na pesei e timoria Mas s' autous ten emera, eno diaskedazoun (kai einai apaskholemenoi me te zoe tous);

Aisthanontai asphaleis apo to skhedio tou Allakh; Pragmati, den aisthanontai asphaleis apo to skhedio tou Allakh para mono oi khamenoi anthropoi! [Eno oi pistoi panta phobountai apo ton Allakh kai phulassontai apo ten timoria terontas tis entoles Tou, kai deikhnoun eugnomosune stis khares Tou].

Den egine saphes s' ekeinous pou katoikoun ste ge (komopole), meta ton proegoumeno lao tes (pou katastrapheke logo ton amartion tou), oti an thelame, tha tous timorousame gia tis amarties tous kai tha sphragizame tis kardies tous kai etsi, den tha akougan;

Autes oi (proanapheromenes) komopoleis, pou gia merikes apo tis istories ton opoion (gia ten apistia tous kai ten timoria tous) se enemeronoume (o, Mokhammant, gia na einai mia nouthesia gia tous anthropous). Pragmati, tous erthan oi Aggeliaphoroi tous me sapheis apodeixeis, alla de ginotan na pistepsoun s' autes (tis apodeixeis) pou eikhan ede diapseusei prin (tis doun). Etsi o Allakh sphragizei tis kardies ton apiston.

De brekame tous perissoterous ap' autous aphosiomenous ste desmeuse (pou tous anethese o Allakh, to na men Tou apodidoun etairous ste latreia kai na akolouthoun te threskeia Tou). Alla brekame tous perissoterous tous, anupakouous.

Epeita steilame meta ap' autous, ton Mouse me ta Semadia Mas ston Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou, alla autoi adikos ta arnethekan. Koita, loipon, (o, Mokhammant) pos etan to telos ekeinon pou skorpizan to kako!
O Mouses eipe: <<O, Pharao! Pragmati, eimai enas Aggeliaphoros apo ton Kurio ton kosmon.

Eimai axios (kai upokhreomenos kai prothumos) na men po tipota gia ton Allakh ektos apo ten aletheia. Ertha se sas me xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio sas, opote aphese ta paidia tou Israel na phugoun mazi mou.>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<An ekheis pherei ena semadi, tote parousiase to an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>
Etsi, petaxe (o Mouses) to rabdi tou kai etsi egine ena megalo phidi, (orato se olous).
Kai (ebale to kheri tou sto anoigma tou endumatos tou sto stethos tou, kai epeita) trabexe to kheri tou, kai etsi bgeke (to kheri tou) lampero leuko mprosta stous theates.
Oi arkhegoi apo ton lao tou Pharao eipan (epanalambanontas ta logia tou Pharao kai suzetontas metaxu tous): <<Autos einai pragmati enas magos me kale gnose!
O opoios epidiokei na sas dioxei apo te ge sas. Poia einai e apopse sas loipon;>>
Eipan (oi arkhegoi ston Pharao): <<Kathusterese ton kai ton aderpho tou kai steile stis poleis ekeinous pou tha mazepsoun (gia sena tous magous).
Tha sou pheroun kathe mago pou ekhei kale gnose.>>
Oi magoi erthan ston Pharao kai eipan: <<Tha ekhoume antamoibe an nikesoume;>>
Eipe: <<Nai, kai sigoura tha eiste ap' autous pou einai konta mou (se pseles theseis).>>
Eipan (oi magoi): <<O, Mouse! (Dialexe) eite na rixeis esu protos, eite na rixoume emeis!>>

Eipe: <<Rixte eseis.>> Etsi, otan erixan (ta skhoinia kai ta kontaria tous), magepsan ta matia ton anthropon, tous tromaxan kai epheran mia megale mageia (kanontas ta skhoinia na phainontai san phidia).
Empneusame ston Mouse: <<Peta to rabdi sou.>>, kai etsi (egine megalo phidi pou) katapie ola ta psemata pou edeixan.
Etsi kuriarkhese e aletheia kai phaneke oti o,ti ekanan etan mataio.
Ettethekan ekei (opou sugkentrothekan) kai epestrepsan tapeinomenoi.
Oi magoi epesan se Soutzount stase (del. me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos).
Eipan (oi magoi): <<Pisteuoume ston Kurio olon ton kosmon,
ton Kurio tou Mouse kai tou Aaron.>>

O Pharao eipe: <<Pistepsate s' auton prin sas doso ten adeia; Auto einai pragmati ena skhedio pou epinoesate (mazi me ton Mouse) sten pole gia na dioxete ap' aute tous katoikous tes, alla suntoma tha mathete (ti tha pathete apo ten timoria mou).
Tha sas kopso ta kheria kai ta podia apo tis antithetes pleures kai meta tha sas stauroso olous mazi.>>
Eipan: <<Pragmati, ston Kurio mas tha epistrepsoume.

Kai de mas kategoreis para mono epeide pistepsame sta semadia tou Kuriou mas otan mas erthan! [O, Allakh] Kurie mas! Rixe pano mas upomone (mekhri na mas kaluptei) kai kane mas na pethanoume os Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste boulese Sou).>>

Oi arkhegoi apo ton lao tou Pharao eipan: <<Tha apheseis ton Mouse kai ton lao tou na skorpizoun to kako ste ge kai na egkataleipsei (o Mouses) esena kai tous theous sou (kai na kalei pros te latreia tou Allakh);>> Eipe (o Pharao): <<Tha skotosoume tous gious tous (ton paidion tou Israel) kai tha aphesoume tis gunaikes tous zontanes (gia na mas uperetesoun), kai pragmati, ekhoume te duname pano tous gia na tous upotaxoume.>>

O Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<Zeteste te boetheia apo ton Allakh kai mono kai kante upomone. Pragmati, e ge anekei ston Allakh (kai okhi ston Pharao), kai te dinei se opoion thelei (o Allakh) apo tous doulous Tou. Kai e epitukhia sto telos einai gi' ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).>>

Eipan (oi anthropoi apo ta paidia tou Israel): <<Ede upopherame kako (apo ton Pharao) prin ertheis se mas kai tora aphou erthes se mas.>> Eipe: <<Eithe o Kurios sas na katastrepsei ton ekhthro sas kai na sas dosei duname ste ge (del. kanontas kapoious apo sas basiliades aphou esastan douloi, -kati pou egine argotera otan mpekan sten Ierousalem kai ekanan to basileio tous-), kai etsi na dei pos tha praxete (del. an tha eiste eugnomones e tha ginete alazones).>>
Pragmati, timoresame ton lao tou Pharao me peina kai elleipse karpon, isos na laboun nouthesia.

Otan tous erthe (ston lao tou Pharao) kati kalo (apo agatha kai bioporismo), eipan: <<Auto einai gia mas (epeide to axizoume).>>, alla otan tous eplexe kati kako (apo xerasia, astheneies kai elleipse karpon), eginan apaisiodoxoi aisthanomenoi oti o Mouses kai osoi einai mazi tou tous epheran kake tukhe. Pragmati, auto pou tous sunebe ekhei oristei apo ton Allakh (kai den ekhei skhese me ton Mouse para mono tis epikleseis pou ekane enantion tous), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den exeran (gi' auto to apedosan s' allous ektos tou Allakh).
Eipan (oi anthropoi apo ton lao tou Pharao ston Mouse): <<Opoiodepote semadi ki an mas phereis gia na mas magepseis, den prokeitai na pistepsoume se sena.>>

Etsi, steilame s' autous plemmura (pou katestrepse tis kalliergeies tous), akrides (pou ephagan tis sodeies tous), pseires (pou tous eblapsan ta mallia tous), batrakhous (pou gemisan ta skeue kai ta krebatia tous) kai aima (pou gemise ta pegadia kai ta potamia tous) - os saphe kai diaphora semadia (pou diadekhetai to ena to allo), alla epemeinan sten alazoneia kai etan enas kakos laos.

Otan epese e timoria pano tous, eipan: <<O, Mouse! Epikalesou ton Kurio sou gia mas, kharis oson parakhorese se sena (apo apokalupse kai threskeia). Ean aphaireseis auten ten timoria apo mas, sigoura tha pistepsoume se sena kai tha aphesoume ta paidia tou Israel na pane mazi sou.>>
Alla otan aphairesame ten timoria ap' autous mekhri ena prokathorismeno khrono pou tha ton phtasoun (del. tes katastrophes tous apo pnigmo), athetesan ten uposkhese tous.
Etsi, perame ekdikese ap' autous kai tous pnixame sto nero giati diepseudan ta Semadia Mas kai etan adiaphoroi gi' auta.

Kai dosame ston lao pou katapiezotan, ta anatolika tes ges kai ta dutika tes pou eikhame eulogesei mesa tes. Ekplerotheke o kalos logos tou Kuriou sou gia ta paidia tou Israel exaitias oson upemeinan me upomone, kai katastrepsame o,ti ephtiakhne o Pharao kai o laos tou (apo spitia kai khoraphia) kai o,ti kataskeuazan (apo palatia).

Kaname ta paidia tou Israel na perasoun to nero (aphou diataxame ton Mouse na to khtupesei me to rabdi tou kai etsi skhisteke se duo), meta perasan apo enan lao pou latreue ta eidola tou. Eipan: <<O, Mouse! Kane gia mas enan theo (del. eidolo), opos autoi ekhoun theous (eidola).>> Eipe (o Mouses): <<Pragmati, eiste enas laos pou agnoei (te Megaloprepeia tou Allakh).
Pragmati, oso gi' autous (pou latreuoun ta eidola) tha katastraphei o,ti kanoun (apo eidololatreia) kai o,ti kanoun einai mataio.>>

Eipe (o Mouses epises): <<Pos na anazeto gia sas allo theo ektos apo ton Allakh, otan Autos einai pou sas eunoese pano ap' olous tous anthropous (tes epokhes sas, katastrephontas ton ekhthro sas kai sozontas sas ap' auton);>>

Kai (thumetheite, o, paidia tou Israel) otan sas sosame apo ton lao tou Pharao, pou sas ekanan na geuteite ena tromero marturio: esphaxan tous gious sas kai aphesan (tis kores kai) tis gunaikes sas na zesoun (os doules). Kai s' auto (oti sas sosame) uperkhe mia megale dokimasia apo ton Kurio sas (an tha esastan eugnomones meta ap' auto e okhi)!

Kai orisame gia ton Mouse trianta nukhtes, kai prosthesame s' autes alles deka (gia na Mas epikalestei me aphosiose pano sto oros, kai sto telos tous na tou milesoume kai na tou apokalupsoume ten Tora), etsi egine o khronos pou oristeke apo ton Kurio tou (gia na tou milesei sto telos tou) saranta nukhtes. O Mouses (prin phugei gia tis saranta nukhtes) eipe ston adelpho tou ton Aaron: <<Pare te these mou anamesa ston lao mou otan apousiazo, diorthose (tous diatazontas tous na latreuoun ton Allakh) kai men akoloutheseis to dromo ekeinon pou skorpizoun to kako (del. men apheneis kanenan na diapraxei amarties khoris na ton stamateseis).>>

Otan o Mouses erthe sten ora kai ton topo pou orisame kai o Kurios tou milese mazi tou, eipe (o Mouses): <<Kurie mou! Deixe mou (ton Eauto Sou), gia na Se koitaxo.>> O Allakh eipe: <<Den mporeis na Me deis [sten egkosmia zoe]. Alla koita to bouno, an tha antexei na meinei stathero ste these tou, tote mono tha Me deis.>> Otan o Kurios tou emphanisteke gia to bouno [me tropo pou tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou], to isopedose kai o Mouses epese anaisthetos. [Sumphona me ena Khantith: emphanisteke mono oso einai to megethos tou enos tritou apo to mikro dakhtulo]. Otan (o Mouses) sunelthe, eipe: <<Doxa Soi! Strephomai me metameleia pros Esena kai eimai o protos apo tous pistous.>>

Eipe (o Allakh): <<O, Mouse! Se epelexa pano apo tous allous anthropous (tes epokhes sou) dinontas sou ta menumata Mou kai milontas sou. Gi' auto pare osa sou ekho dosei kai na eisai enas apo tous eugnomones.>>

Katagrapsame gi' auton stis plakes ola ta pragmata (pou khreiazontai ta paidia tou Israel ste threskeia kai ste zoe tous) os nouthesia (gi' opoion tha te labei upopse) kai exegese olon (ton kanonon). (Kai eipame ston Mouse): <<Terese tous dunata kai dietaxe tous anthropous tou laou sou na teroun to kalutero mesa tous (del. o,ti tous prostaxe o Allakh kai na apekhoun apo o,ti tous apagoreuse). Tha sas deixo ton oiko ton anupakouon.>>

Tha apomakruno apo ta semadia Mou (kai apo to na katanooun ta Edaphia Mou) ekeinous pou einai alazonikoi ste ge khoris kanena dikaioma. Akoma ki an doun kathe semadi, pali de tha pistepsoun s' auto, kai an doun ton dromo tes kathodegeses, de tha ton akolouthesoun, alla an doun ton dromo tes paraplaneses, tha ton akolouthesoun os ton dromo tous. Auto epeide diepseudan ta semadia Mas kai etan adiaphoroi gi' auta.

Ekeinoi pou diepseudan ta semadia Mas kai te sunantese ste Mellousa Zoe, oi (kales) praxeis tous ekhoun katastei mataies. Tha laboun kati allo para mono (ten timoria) gi' auta pou ekanan (apo apistia kai amarties);

En apousia tou (Mouse, aphou ephuge gia tis saranta nukhtes), oi anthropoi tou laou tou Mouse peran gia latreia ena agalma enos moskhariou phtiagmeno apo ta kosmemata tous, to opoio (agalma) etan ena soma pou (den eikhe psukhe, kai) eikhe enan khamelo ekho. Den eblepan oti den mporouse oute na tous milesei, oute na tous kathodegesei se kapoio kalo dromo; Ostoso, to peran gia latreia kai etan adikoi.
Otan metaniosan kai katalaban oti eikhan parastratesei, eipan: <<An o Kurios mas de mas eleesei kai de mas sugkhoresei, sigoura tha eimaste anamesa stous khamenous.>>

Otan o Mouses epestrepse ston lao tou, thumomenos kai thlimmenos (ap' auto pou ekanan), eipe: <<Ti kako einai auto pou kanate en apousia mou! Den mporousate na perimenete (ten epistrophe mou pou einai sumphona me) auto pou orise o Kurios sas;>> Petaxe (o Mouses) tis plakes kai epiase ton adelpho tou (ton Aaron) apo to kephali, sernontas ton pros ton eauto tou. (O Aaron) eipe: <<O, gie tes meteras mou! Ekeinoi me theorousan adunamo kai kontepsan na me skotosoun. Men kaneis loipon tous ekhthrous na khairontai m' auto pou mou kaneis, oute na me theoreis anamesa stous adikous anthropous (pou latrepsan to moskhari).>>
Eipe (o Mouses): <<Kurie mou! Sugkhorese emena kai ton adelpho mou, kai eisegage mas sto eleos Sou. Pragmati, Esu eisai o pio Eleemon apo tous eleemones.>>
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou peran to moskhari gia latreia, tha upostoun orge apo ton Kurio tous kai tapeinose sten egkosmia zoe, kai etsi timoroume autous pou epinooun psemata (enantion tou Allakh).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou diepraxan kakes praxeis, kai epeita -meta ap' autes- straphekan me metameleia pros ton Allakh kai pistepsan (s' Auton), pragmati, o Kurios sou -meta ap' autes- einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Otan e orge tou Mouse eremese, sekose tis plakes, oi opoies perieikhan kathodegese kai eleos gia osous phobountai ton Kurio tous.

O Mouses epelexe ebdomenta andres apo ton lao tou gia ten ora kai topo pou orisame (gia na epikalestoun ton Allakh na sugkhoresei ton lao tous pou latrepse to moskhari). Otan (erthan ston topo, zetesan apo ton Mouse na doun ton Allakh, kai etsi) tous epiase o dunatos seismos, eipe (o Mouses epikalontas ton Allakh): <<Kurie mou! An etan to thelema Sou, tha tous eikhes katastrepsei apo prin (otan o laos latrepse to moskhari), opos kai emena. Tha mas katastrepseis gi' auto pou ekanan oi anoetoi anamesa mas! [erotese kateunasmou, del. men mas katastrepseis]. Auto den einai para mia dokimasia apo Sena (pros tous doulous Sou, gia na phanei poios tha dialexei ten aletheia kai poios tha dialexei ten plane), me ten opoia (dokimasia) kaneis opoion theleis na parastratesei kai kathodegeis opoion theleis. Esu eisai o Kedemonas mas, gi' auto sugkhorese mas kai eleese mas, giati eisai o Kaluteros ap' autous pou sugkhoroun.

Orise gia mas to kalo s' aute te zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, ekhoume straphei me metameleia pros Esena.>> Eipe (o Allakh): <<Oso gia ten timoria Mou, te stelno se opoion thelo, alla to eleos Mou perikleiei ta panta. Tha to oriso gi' ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Mou (terontas tis entoles Mou) kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai oi opoioi pisteuoun sta Semadia (kai sta Edaphia) Mas.>>

Autoi pou akolouthoun ton Aggeliaphoro, ton Prophete (Mokhammant), pou den mporei oute na diabasei, oute na grapsei, tou opoiou to onoma briskoun grammeno stis Graphes tous sten Tora kai sto In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou). O opoios (o Mokhammant) tous diatazei to kalo, kai tous apagoreuei to kako* kai tous epitrepei ta kala (eite pragmata, eite phageta klp.), kai tous apagoreuei ta akatharta (opos to khoirino klp.), kai tous apeleutheronei apo to phortio tous kai tis alusides pou etan pano tous (del. oles tis baries entoles pou tous eikhe anathesei o Allakh paliotera). Etsi, autoi pou pisteuoun s' auton (ton Mokhammant), ton timoun, ton uposterizoun kai akolouthoun to phos (to Kor'an) pou staltheke m' auton, autoi einai pragmati oi epitukhemenoi.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, anthropoi! St' aletheia, eimai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh pou staltheke se olous sas, -ston Opoion (ton Allakh) anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, kai einai Autos pou dinei te zoe kai ten aphairei. Pistepste loipon ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, ton Prophete pou den mporei oute na diabasei, oute na grapsei (ton Mokhammant), o opoios (Prophetes) pisteuei ston Allakh kai sta Logia Tou, kai akoloutheste ton isos na kathodegetheite.
Metaxu tou laou tou Mouse uparkhei mia omada pou kathodegei tous allous me ten aletheia kai kathieronei te dikaiosune m' auten.

Tous khorisame (ta paidia tou Israel) se dodeka phules kai ethne. Kai empneusame ton Mouse otan o laos tou (khatheke ste ge kai etan dipsasmenos, kai) tou zetese nero: <<Khtupa to brakho me to rabdi sou.>> Kai etsi, aneblusan ap' auton dodeka peges (gia tis dodeka phules), kathe phule gnorize to diko tes meros gia nero. Tous skiasame me sunnepha (apo te zeste tou eliou) kai tous steilame to manna (gluko poto san to meli) kai As-Saloa (poulakia pou moiazoun me ta ortukia) (legontas): <<Phate apo ta kala agatha pou parekhoume se sas.>> (Ma eginan agnomones) kai den Mas eblapsan (se tipote meso tes parakoes kai tes agnomosunes tous), ma mono tous eautous tous adikesan.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan tous eipotheke (sta paidia tou Israel): <<Katoikeste s' auten ten pole (Ierousalem) kai phate ap' auten ap' opou thelete, kai peite: <<Sugkhorese mas!>>, kai peraste ten pule tes upoklinomenoi (del. me tapeinoteta pros ton Allakh), kai etsi tha sas sugkhoresoume tis amarties sas kai tha auxesoume (ten amoibe) gi' autous pou prattoun kales praxeis.>>
Ma oi adikoi ap' autous allaxan ton Logo pou eipotheke s' autous me allon, ki etsi steilame pano tous mia timoria apo ton ourano, logo tes adikias tous.

Rota tous (o, Prophete) gia ten komopole pou etan sten akte tes thalassas (e tou potamiou), otan parabiasan to Sabbato (psareuontas, para ten apagoreuse tou psarematos to Sabbato). Ta psaria erkhontousan s' autous sten epiphaneia tou nerou to Sabbato, alla stis alles meres ektos tou Sabbatou, den erkhontousan. Etsi tous dokimasame logo tes anupakoes tous.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan mia omada ap' autous (ta paidia tou Israel) eipe (se mia alle omada pou nouthetese ekeinous pou psareuan to Sabbato na stamatesoun ekeine ten apagoreumene praxe): <<Giati noutheteite anthropous pou o Allakh tha tous katastrepsei e tha tous timoresei me ena odunero marturio;>> Eipan (ekeinoi pou nouthetoun): <<Gia na dikaiologethoume enopion tou Kuriou sas (oti teresame ten entole Tou to na diatazoume to kalo kai na apagoreuoume to kako), kai isos (ekeinoi pou psareuoun) na phulakhthoun apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).>>
Otan (ekeinoi pou psareuan to Sabbato) agnoesan te nouthesia pou tous dotheke, sosame autous pou apagoreuan to kako kai timoresame tous adikous me mia baria timoria gia ten anupakoe tous.
Otan (ekeinoi pou psareuan to Sabbato) parabiasan epimona auto pou tous apagoreuteke na kanoun, tous eipame: <<Na eiste pithekoi, periphronemenoi kai aporriphthentes.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Kurios sou delose xekathara oti tha tous stelnei mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, ekeinous pou tha tous talaiporesoun me tromere timoria. Pragmati, o Kurios sou einai Gregoros sten timoria, kai einai epises Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Tous diaskorpisame ste ge se omades - kapoioi ap' autous einai enaretoi, eno kapoioi alloi den einai. Tous dokimasame kai me ten euemeria kai me tis antixootetes, isos kai na epistrepsoun (sten upakoe pros ton Allakh).

Ste sunekheia (meta ap' ekeine te genia pou eikhe kapoious enaretous kai kapoious kakous), tous diadekhthekan alles genies apo kakous anthropous pou kleronomesan to Biblio (del. te gnose gi' auto, alla den to epharmosan kai parabiasan tis entoles tou), oi opoioi epairnan opoiodepote kerdos ap' auton ton kosmo (eite epitrepto, eite apagoreumeno, opos tis dorodokies klp. gia na allaxoun kai na diastreblosoun ten krise kai ta Logia tou Allakh sten Tora), kai eipan: <<Tha sugkhorethoume.>> Kai an ena paromoio kerdos tous xanaerkhotan, to epairnan. Ma den anelaban te desmeuse pou einai grammene sten Tora oti de tha lene gia ton Allakh para mono ten aletheia; Kai eikhan diabasei o,ti perieikhe mesa tou. Pragmati, e Mellousa Zoe einai kalutere gi' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Ma den sullogizeste;
Oso gi' ekeinous pou aphosionontai sto Biblio kai teloun ten proseukhe, pragmati, de tha aphesoume ten antamoibe ekeinon pou kanoun orthes praxeis, na khathei.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan upsosame apo pano tous to oros (Sina) (os proeidopoiese otan arnethekan na dekhtoun auto pou uparkhei sten Tora), san na etan (to oros) ena skoteino sunnepho, kai katalaban oti tha epephte pano tous. (Kai eipame): <<Tereite dunata auto (to Biblio -ten Tora-) pou sas dosame, kai thumetheite auto pou brisketai mesa tou (apo didaskalies kai kanones) mepos kai (meso autou) phulakhtheite (apo ten timoria tou Allakh).>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Kurios sou ebgale apo ten osphu ton paidion tou Adam tous apogonous tous [del. apo ten osphu tou Adam ta paidia tou kai outo kathexes] kai tous ekane na marturesoun os apodeixe enantion tou eautou tous, (rotontas tous gi' auto pou ekhei ede balei sten emphute phuse tous): <<Den eimai o Kurios sas;>> Eipan: <<Nai, pragmati, Esu eisai, kai marturoume gi' auto.>> (To kaname auto) gia na men peite ten Emera tes Anastases: <<St' aletheia, den to xerame auto!>>

E na peite: <<St' aletheia, oi goneis mas -prin apo mas- einai ekeinoi pou apedidan (protoi) etairous ston Allakh ste latreia, eno emeis emastan oi apogonoi -meta ap' autous- (kai apla tous akolouthesame apo agnoia). Tha mas katastrepseis, loipon, gia o,ti ekanan ekeinoi pou katestesan tis kales praxeis tous mataies (meso tes apistias tous);>>
Etsi diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia, kai isos na epistrepsoun (apo ten eidololatria kai ten apistia, pros te latreia tou Allakh).

Kai apaggeile tous (o, Prophete, sta paidia tou Israel) ten eidese ekeinou tou andra ston opoio dosame ta semadia Mas, alla ta aphese kai etsi ton akolouthese o Satanas (kai ton kurieuse) kai etsi egine (ekeinos o andras) enas apo tous paraplanemenous pou katastraphekan.

An thelame, tha ton upsoname m' auta (ta semadia), alla autos proskolletheke ste ge (kai stis apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes) kai akolouthese tis epithumies tou. To paradeigma tou einai san auto enos skulou: an ton diokhneis, bgazei te glossa tou, kai an ton apheseis, exakolouthei na bgazei te glossa tou. Auto einai to paradeigma ekeinon ton anthropon pou diapseudoun ta semadia Mas (eite tous kaleis sto Islam, eite tous apheneis, einai to idio gi' autous). Gi' auto, aphegesou tis istories, mepos kai na ta analogistoun!
Poso athlio einai to paradeigma ekeinon ton anthropon pou diepseudan ta semadia Mas, kai adikesan tous eautous tous.
Opoion kathodegei o Allakh, einai o pragmatika kathodegemenos. Kai opoion ton kanei na parastratesei, autoi einai oi khamenoi.

Pragmati, ekhoume demiourgesei gia ten Kolase polla tzinn kai anthropous (pou xerame oti tha diaprattoun tis praxeis pou tha tous eisagoun ste Photia). Ekhoun kardies me tis opoies den katalabainoun, matia me ta opoia de blepoun kai autia me ta opoia den akoun. Ekeinoi einai san ta booeide, einai st' aletheia akome pio parastratemenoi. Ekeinoi einai autoi pou adiaphoroun (gia ten piste ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera).

Kai ston Allakh anekoun ta pio Omorpha Onomata, etsi, epikalesteite Ton m' Auta kai apheste autous pou parekklinoun apo ten aletheia skhetika me ta Onomata Tou (apokalontas tous pseutikous theous tous m' Auta ta Onomata e diastreblonontas tis ennoies tous e paromoiazontas m' Auta ta Onomata allous me ton Allakh ). Tha laboun ten timoria gi' auta pou ekanan.
Kai metaxu auton pou demiourgesame uparkhei mia omada pou kathodegei allous me ten aletheia kai kathieronei te dikaiosune m' auten.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou diapseudoun ta Semadia Mas, tha tous sernoume stadiaka (dinontas tous agatha oste na ginoun pio alazonikoi kai na sunekhisoun sten plane tous kai epeita na tous pheroume) pros ten timoria Mas apo kei pou de gnorizoun.

Kai dino anabole sten timoria tous (mekhri na nomizoun oti de tha timorethoun kai na sunekhisoun sten apistia tous, kai epeita xaphnika tha tous steilo mia austere timoria). St' aletheia, to skhedio Mou einai polu iskhuro.
Ma den ekhoun analogistei; O suntrophos tous (o Prophetes Mokhammant) den einai paraphron, alla einai mono enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia!

Ma de blepoun (ta Semadia Mas) sto basileio ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai se o,ti demiourgese o Allakh (oste na ta laboun upopse); Kai (de blepoun) oti isos e ora (tou thanatou) tous ekhei plesiasei (kai etsi na pethanoun os apistoi kai na katalexoun sto Pur); (An den pisteuoun s' auto to Kor'an, tote) se poion allo logo meta ap' auto tha pistepsoun;
Opoion o Allakh ton kanei na parastratesei, den uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na ton kathodegesei. Tha tous aphesei sten plane (kai ten apistia) tous, sastismenous (kai de tha kathodegethoun se tipote)!

(O, Mokhammant) se rotoun (oi apistoi) gia ten Ora (tes Eskhates Emeras, khleuazontas): <<Pote tha erthei;>> Pes: <<E gnose gi' auten einai mono me ton Kurio mou. Kaneis allos den mporei na ten phanerosei kata ton prokathorismeno khrono tes ektos ap' Auton. (E gnose gi' auten) einai baria kai megale gia osous briskontai stous ouranous kai te Ge (kai einai krummene ap' autous) kai de tha sas erthei para mono xaphnika.>> Se rotoun san na esoun prothumos na ten xereis (kai den exeran oti de rotas gi' auten logo tes teleias gnoses sou gia ton Kurio sou)! Pes: <<E gnose gi' auten einai mono me ton Allakh, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Den ekho kamia duname na phero ophelos gia ton eauto mou, oute na apotrepso kako apo ton eauto mou, para mono o,ti thelei o Allakh. An gnoriza ta aorata, tha exasphaliza gia ton eauto mou aphthona kala, kai kanena kako de tha me aggize. Pragmati, den eimai para mono enas proeidopoietes, kai enas Aggeliaphoros kharmosunon eideseon gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.>>

Einai Autos pou sas eplase apo ena (kai mono) atomo (ton Adam), kai ap' auton (ton Adam) eplase te suzugo tou (ten Eua), gia na brei eirene kai anapause s' auten. Otan (kapoios apo sas) eikhe sexoualike epaphe m' auten (te gunaika tou), kai aute sunelabe kai eikhe eukole egkumosune, kai etsi ten perase (me eukolia), kai otan e koilia tes egine pio baria (kai etan etoime na gennesei), tote kalesan (o andras kai e gunaika tou) ton Allakh, ton Kurio tous: <<An mas doseis ena ugies paidi, sigoura tha eimaste apo tous eugnomones.>>
