Otan omos tous edose ena ugies paidi, apedosan s' Auton etairous s' auto pou tous eikhe kharisei. Anoteros einai o Allakh apo o,ti Tou apodidoun apo etairous.
Apodidoun (ston Allakh) etairous, pou den mporoun na demiourgesoun tipota, kai oi idioi einai demiourgemata;
Kai oute mporoun (ta eidola) na tous uposterixoun, oute (ekeina ta eidola) mporoun na uposterixoun tous eautous tous!

Kai an kalesete (o, anthropoi) auta (ta eidola) pros ten kathodegese, de tha sas akolouthesoun. Eite tous kalesete, eite parameinete siopeloi, einai to idio (epeide den akoun, pos loipon na kathodegesoun auta ta eidola tous allous an ki oi idioi den mporoun na kathodegethoun;).

(O, eidololatres) pragmati, auta (ta eidola) pou tous epikaleiste ektos tou Allakh einai douloi san ki esas (aphou einai phtiagmena apo petra kai xula pou demiourgese o Allakh). Kaleste tous, loipon, an mporoun na sas apantesoun, an eiste eilikrineis!

Ekhoun podia me ta opoia perpatoun; E ekhoun kheria me ta opoia khtupoun; E ekhoun matia me ta opoia blepoun; E ekhoun autia me ta opoia akoun; Pes (o, Prophete): <<Kaleste tous etairous (ta eidola) sas, kai epeita sunomoteste enantion mou kai me mou dosete anabole!
O Kedemonas (o Uposteriktes kai o Prostates) mou einai o Allakh, o Opoios esteile to Biblio, kai einai Autos pou uposterizei (kai prostateuei) tous enaretous.
Alla ekeina (ta eidola) pou ta epikaleiste ektos Autou, den mporoun oute na sas uposterixoun, oute na uposterixoun ton eauto tous!>>

An (o, Mokhammant) tous kaleseis (auta ta eidola) pros ten kathodegese, den akoun (aphou einai apla agalmata se anthropine morphe). Kai tous blepeis na se koitazoun (san na eikhan matia), alla de blepoun.

Dexou (apo ta ethe kai tis praxeis ton anthropon) auta pou einai eukola (gi' autous kai men tous epibaruneis me o,ti einai pera ton dunatoteton tous), na diatazeis to kalo, kai na strephesai makria apo tous anoetous (del. opoios se eblapse men ton blapseis kai opoios se adikese men ton adikeseis, alla na eisai dikaios mazi tou).
An sou erthe psithuros apo ton Satana, anazeta kataphugio ston Allakh. Pragmati, Autos einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ekeinoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), otan tous erkhetai enas psithuros apo ton Satana, thumountai (ton Allakh kai ten antamoibe Tou gia tous upakouous kai ten timoria Tou gia tous anupakouous), kai etsi amesos blepoun (ten aletheia kai energoun sumphona m' aute).

Oso gia (tous apistous kai tous kakous, pou einai) ta adelphia tous (ton Satanadon), (oi Satanades) tous auxanoun sunekheia sten plane (me amarties, e mia meta apo ten alle), kai epeita de stamatoun pote.

(O, Aggeliaphore! An tous pherneis ena semadi, se diapseudoun kai apostrephontai ap' auto) kai an den tous pherneis ena semadi, lene: <<Giati den epheures ena semadi;>> Pes: <<Akoloutho mono auto pou mou apokaluptetai apo ton Kurio mou. Auto (to Kor'an) einai semadia (kai apodeixeis) apo ton Kurio sas, kai mia kathodegese kai eleos gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.>>
(O, pistoi) otan apaggelletai to Kor'an, akouste to me prosokhe kai me milate, mepos kai eleetheite.

Kai na mnemoneueis ton Kurio sou mesa sou me tapeinose kai phobo, kai na epikaleisai me metria phone sten arkhe tes emeras kai sto telos tes, kai men eisai apo tous ameleis (pou parameloun te mnemoneuse tou Allakh).

Pragmati, autoi (oi aggeloi) pou einai konta ston Kurio sou den ginontai pote alazones gia te latreia Tou. Ton doxazoun, kai gi' Auton pephtoun se Soutzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos).

Se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia ta laphura (tes makhes tou Mpantr, pos moirazontai;). Pes: <<E krise gia ta laphura anekei ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro (del. o Aggeliaphoros tha ta moirasei sumphona me ten entole tou Allakh). Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (upakouontas tis entoles Tou), diorthoste ten katastase metaxu sas kai upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, an eiste pragmati pistoi.>>

St' aletheia, oi alethinoi pistoi einai ekeinoi pou otan anapheretai to Onoma tou Allakh, oi kardies tous aisthanontai phobo, kai otan apaggellontai ta Edaphia Tou s' autous, auta tous auxanoun se piste. Kai ston Kurio tous basizontai.
Oi opoioi teloun ten proseukhe kai apo o,ti tous parekhoume, xodeuoun (se o,ti orise o Allakh apo eleemosune kai philanthropia klp.).
Ekeinoi einai oi alethinoi pistoi. Tha ekhoun upseles theseis apo ton Kurio tous, kai sugkhorese kai gennaiodore pronoia.

Opos se ekane o Kurios sou na bgeis apo to spiti sou me ten aletheia (apo te Mantina mazi me triakosious deka andres gia na kanete ekstrateia enantion tou emporikou karabaniou ton apiston ekhthron, pou eikhan parei tis periousies sas ste Makka. To karabani erkhotan apo ten palaia Suria pros te Makka, alla otan emathan oi apistoi ste Makka gia ten ekstrateia sas, esteilan strato khilion andron gia na sosoun to karabani), eno se mia omada apo tous pistous den arese (to na polemesoun, epeide den etan etoimoi kai bgekan mono gia to karabani, kai epeide oi apistoi etan triplasioi se arithmo ap' autous).
Suzetousan (ekeinoi ap' aute ten omada piston) mazi sou gia ten aletheia, aphou eikhe ginei xekathare (oti tha ginei e makhe). San na pegainan pros to thanato, eno koitousan.

Kai (thumetheite, o, pistoi pou suzetesate me ton Prophete), otan o Allakh sas uposkhetheke oti tha kerdisete mia apo tis duo omades (del. eite to emporiko karabani, eite ton apisto strato pou erthe gia na sosei to karabani), kai thelate na kerdisate ten aople omada (del. to karabani). Alla o Allakh ethele na phanerosei (kai na upsosei) ten aletheia me ton Logo Tou (del. ten entole Tou gia te makhe) kai na exontosei tous apistous.
Gia na phanerosei ten aletheia kai na akurosei ten plane. Akoma kai an oi kakoi to misoun auto.

(Thumetheite, o, pistoi, kata te makhe tou Mpantr) otan zetesate boetheia apo ton Kurio sas kai etsi antapokritheke stis epikleseis sas (legontas): <<Tha sas eniskhuso me khilious aggelous, pou tha akolouthoun o enas ton allon.>>

Kai den to ekane o Allakh auto (oti sas esteile khilious aggelous) para mono os kharmosuna nea (gia sas, o, pistoi, oti tha nikesete ton ekhthro sas) kai gia na kathesukhastoun m' auto oi kardies sas. Pragmati, e nike den erkhetai para mono apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

(Kai thumetheite, o, pistoi) otan (o Allakh) ekane ton upno na sas kalupsei os asphaleia ap' Auton (meta apo to phobo sas apo ton ekhthro sas), kai esteile pano sas nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano gia na sas exagnisei m' auto (gia ten proseukhe sas), kai na apomakrunei apo sas tous psithurous tou Satana (pou sas psuthirise oti den ekhete nero gia na exagnisteite gia ten proseukhe), kai na dunamosei tis kardies sas kai na statheropoiesei m' auto ta podia sas (kanontas me to nero te ge na ginei sumpages, giati etan apo malake ammo).

(Kai anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Kurios sou enepneuse stous aggelous: <<Eimai mazi sas, gi' auto statheropoieste tous pistous. Tha rixo tromo stis kardies ton apiston. Khtupeste, loipon (o, pistoi), to laimo tous kai khtupeste ta akra tous (gia na men sas polemesoun).>>

Auto epeide antitakhthekan (me ekhthroteta) ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou. Kai opoios antitithetai ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, tote st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria Tou.
Aute (e proanapheromene timoria) einai gia sas (o, apistoi), gi' auto geuteite ten (sten egkosmia zoe), kai gia tous apistous (ste Mellousa Zoe) tha uparkhei to marturio tes Photias.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan antimetopizete tous apistous ste makhe kai briskontai konta sas, men tous gurizete ten plate (alla meinete statheroi ste makhe enantion tous, kai o Allakh tha sas uposterixei).

Opoios tous gurisei ten plate ekeine ten emera -ektos ki an parekklinei (apo mia pleura sten alle os strategike) gia na polemesei e thelei na entakhthei s' alle omada (piston sto Mousoulmaniko strato)- tha gurisei me ten orge tou Allakh kai e katoikia tou (ste Mellousa Zoe) tha einai e Kolase, kai ti tromeros proorismos einai autos!

(O, pistoi) den tous skotosate (tous apistous kata te makhe tou Mpantr me te duname sas), alla etan o Allakh pou tous skotose (otan sas uposterixe s' auto). Kai den erixes (o, Prophete) otan erixes, alla etan o Allakh pou erixe (otan ekane auto pou erixes na tous phtasei). Kai (o Allakh ekane auta stous apistous) gia na kharisei stous pistous megale eunoia ap' Auton (nike, uposterixe kai amoibe). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Auto (to proanapheromeno gia te nike sas, einai apo ton Allakh), kai pragmati, o Allakh apodunamonei ten ploke ton apiston.

(O, apistoi) ean zetousate na pesei e timoria tou Allakh stous adikous, idou erthe se sas auto pou zetousate. An stamatesete (ten apistia sas kai to na polemesete tous Mousoulmanous), tha einai kalutera gia sas. Alla an epistrepsete, tha epistrepsoume ki emeis (stelnontas ten timoria Mas se sas), kai de tha sas ophelesei se tipota e omada sas (kai oi uposteriktes kai ta opla sas), oso megale ki an einai! Pragmati, o Allakh einai me tous pistous (me ten uposterixe Tou).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Upakoute ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou kai men apomakruneste ap' auton (ton Prophete), eno akoute (ta Edaphia tou Allakh na apaggelontai se sas).

Kai men eiste san ekeinous (tous eidololatres kai tous upokrites) pou (otan ta Edaphia tou Allakh apaggelontai) lene: <<Akoume (me ta autia mas).>>, eno sten pragmatikoteta den akoun (del. den analogizontai auta pou akoun).
Ta kheirotera kinoumena plasmata enopion tou Allakh einai ta kopha (pou ekleisan ta autia tous apo to na akousoun ten aletheia) kai ta alala (pou de lene ten aletheia), ta opoia den sullogizontai.

An o Allakh exere oti uparkhei kalo mesa tous (s' ekeinous pou diapseudoun ta Edaphia tou Allakh), tha tous eikhe kanei na akousoun (kai na katalaboun ta semadia kai tis apodeixeis Tou)! Akoma ki an tous eikhe kanei na akousoun, tha eikhan apomakrunthei kai apostraphei.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Antapokrineste ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro otan sas kalei s' auto (ton isio dromo) pou sas dinei zoe. Kai na xerete oti o Allakh mporei na diakhorisei metaxu enos anthropou kai tes kardias tou (del. na ton empodisei apo to na akolouthesei ten aletheia otan thelei na ten akolouthesei, aphou ten eikhe aporripsei prin, gi' auto speuste sto na upakoute ten entole tou Allakh kai men ten parakoute, oste na men sas empodisei apo to na ten upakoute otan thelete meta), kai (na xerete) oti s' Auton tha sugkentrotheite oloi.

Phulakhtheite apo mia dokimasia pou de tha pesei mono stous adikous anamesa sas (alla tha pesei kai stous enaretous an etan se these na katakrinoun kai na allaxoun ten adikia, alla den to ekanan) kai na xerete oti o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria.

Kai thumetheite otan esastan ligoi (ste Makka) kai adunamoi (kai katapiesmenoi) ste ge, phoboumenoi oti oi anthropoi (oi ekhthroi sas) tha sas arpaxoun gregora. Etsi, sas edose kataphugio (ste Mantina), sas eniskhuse me ten uposterixe Tou kai sas pareikhe ta kala agatha, mepos kai ginete eugnomones.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men prodosete ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro, oute na prodosete ta katapisteumata sas en gnosei sas.

Na xerete oti ta ploute sas kai ta paidia sas einai mono mia dokimasia (an tha upakoute ton Allakh kai tha eiste eugnomones pros Auton e tha sas strephoun auta makrua apo te latreia Tou). Kai (na xerete) oti o Allakh ekhei mia megale antamoibe.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! An phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou), (o Allakh) tha kanei gia sas mia diakrise metaxu tes aletheias kai tes planes, tha sbesei gia sas tis amarties sas kai tha sas sugkhoresei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales gennaiodorias.

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan oi apistoi sunomotesan enantion sou (ste Makka), gia na se phulakisoun, na se skotosoun e na se dioxoun (apo te Makka). Skhediazoun, alla kai o Allakh epises skhediazei (enantion tous, antapodidontas to skhedio tous), kai o Allakh einai o Kaluteros ap' autous pou skhediazoun (del. to skhedio Tou einai to pio iskhuro, kai einai apo dikaiosune kai os antapodose, eno to skhedio ton ekhthron Tou einai apo kakia gia na blaptoun tous enaretous).
Otan apaggellontai ta Edaphia Mas s' autous (tous eidololatres), lene: <<Akousame (to Kor'an). An thelame, tha mporousame na poume kati paromoio m' auto. Auto den einai para muthoi ton arkhaion.>>

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan (oi eidololatres) eipan: <<O, Allakh! An aute (pou ephere o Mokhammant) einai e aletheia apo Sena, tote rixe pano mas petres apo ton ourano e steile se mas mia odunere timoria.>>
De tha tous timorouse o Allakh eno esu (o, Mokhammant) eisai anamesa tous, kai de tha tous timorouse o Allakh eno zetoun sugkhorese (oi Mousoulmanoi pou briskontai anamesa tous ste Makka).

Giati na men tous timoresei o Allakh (autous tous apistous) aphou empodizoun (tous anthropous) apo to Iero Tzami, parolo pou den einai oi kedemones tou (Ierou Tzamiou gia na poun poios na mpei kai poios okhi); Oi kedemones tou (Ierou Tzamiou) einai mono ekeinoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous (tous eidololatres) den to gnorizoun.
E proseukhe tous (ton eidololatron) ston Iero Oiko den etan para sphurigma kai palamakia. Geuteite loipon ten timoria (me thanatose kai aikhmalosia kata te makhe tou Mpantr) gia ten apistia sas.

Oi apistoi xodeuoun ta ploute tous gia na apotrepsoun (tous anthropous) apo ton dromo tou Allakh. Tha ta xodeuoun, kai epeita to apotelesma tous tha einai lupe s' autous, kai epeita tha ettethoun. Kai (kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) oi apistoi tha sugkentrothoun pros ten Kolase.

(Tha odegethoun oi apistoi pros ten Kolase) gia na khorisei o Allakh tous kakous (apistous) apo tous kalous (pistous) kai na kanei tous kakous ton enan pano ston allo, kai na tous sussoreusei olous kai meta na tous rixei sten Kolase. Pragmati, autoi einai oi khamenoi.

Pes (o, Prophete) stous apistous, an papsoun (ten apistia tous), tote o,ti ekanan sto parelthon tha sugkhorethei. Alla an epistrepsoun (sten apistia), tote ta paradeigmata ekeinon (pou timorethekan aphou sunekhisan ten apistia tous) prin ap' autous ekhoun ede proegethei (os proeidopoiese).

(O, pistoi) polemeste tous (tous apistous ekhthrous sas) mekhri na men uparkhei pia (ap' autous) eidololatria (kai na stamatesoun na sas apotrepoun apo to Islam meso diogmon) kai na einai ole e threskeia (kai e upakoe kai e latreia) pros ton Allakh kai mono. Ma an pausoun (ten apistia tous kai to na sas polemoun), pragmati, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanoun.
Alla an apomakrunthoun (ap' auta pou diatakhthekan), tote na xerete oti o Allakh einai o Kedemonas (kai o Uposteriktes) sas. Pragmati, einai o Kaluteros Kedemonas kai o Kaluteros Uposteriktes.

Na xerete oti o,ti laphura apoktesete, (ta tessera pempta moirazontai stous pistous sto strato, eno) to ena pempto: anekei ston Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro (del. xodeuetai sta demosia sumpheronta ton Mousoulmanon), tous stenous suggeneis (tou Prophete, apo ta paidia tou Khasim kai ta paidia tou Al-Mouttalimp, epeide apagoreuotan s' autous na paroun opoiadepote eleemosune), ta orphana, tous aporous kai tous odoiporous - ean pisteuete pragmatika ston Allakh kai se o,ti steilame (apo Semadia kai uposterixe) ston doulo Mas ten emera tou diakhorismou (metaxu tes aletheias kai tes planes) - ten emera pou oi duo stratoi sunantethekan (ste makhe tou Mpantr). Kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

(Thumetheite, o, Mousoulmanoi) otan esastan sten kontine pleura tes koiladas (tou Mpantr pros te Mantina), eno ekeinoi (oi eidololatres) etan sten makrine pleura tes koiladas (tou Mpantr pou einai pros te meria tes Makkas), kai to karabani etan se khamelotero semeio apo sas (konta sten akte tes eruthras thalassas) [Kai kathe omada den exere pou brisketai e alle, mekhri pou esteilan kai oi Mousoulmanoi kai oi eidololatres kapoious na tous pheroun nero apo to pegadi tou Mpantr]. Ean eikhate sumphonesei (eseis oi Mousoulmanoi me tous eidololatres) na sunantetheite, tha erkhotan o kathenas sas se diaphoretike ora! Alla (sas sugkentrose ekei) gia na oloklerosei o Allakh auto pou oposdepote tha ginotan, gia na pethanei opoios tha pethaine aphou ekhei dei mia xekathare apodeixe, kai na zesei opoios tha zouse aphou ekhei dei mia xekathare apodeixe! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete, ten khare tou Allakh se sena kai stous pistous) otan o Allakh se ekane na deis ekeinous (tous eidololatres) sto oneiro sou os ligous (kai etsi plerophoreses tous pistous gi' auto to oneiro os kharmosuna nea gia nike ste makhe tou Mpantr). An se eikhe kanei na tous deis os pollous, eseis (oi pistoi) tha eikhate khasei to tharros kai tha diaphonousate metaxu sas gia to thema. Alla o Allakh sas esose (ap' auto). Pragmati, Autos einai o Pantognostes oson uparkhoun stis kardies.

Kai (thumetheite, o, Mousoulmanoi) otan sunantethekate (ste makhe tou Mpantr), (kai o Allakh) ekane ekeinous (tous eidololatres) na phainontai ligoi sta matia sas, kai sas ekane (o, Mousoulmanoi) na phaineste ligoi sta matia tous, gia na oloklerosei o Allakh auto pou oposdepote tha ginotan. Kai ston Allakh tha epistrepsoun ola ta themata.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan sunantate mia omada (apiston ste makhe), meinete statheroi kai mnemoneuste ton Allakh polu, mepos kai epitukhete.

Kai upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou kai men diaphoneite metaxu sas, gia na men ginete adunamoi (kai na khasete to tharros sas) kai na khathei e duname sas. Kai na eiste upomonetikoi, pragmati, o Allakh einai me tous upomonetikous.

Kai men eiste san ekeinous (tous eidololatres) pou bgekan apo ta spitia tous (ste Makka gia te makhe tou Mpantr) alazonika kai gia epideixe, kai apotrepoun (tous anthropous) apo to dromo tou Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh perikleiei me te Gnose Tou ola osa kanoun (kai tipote den einai krupho ap' Auton).

Kai (thumetheite, o, Mousoulmanoi) otan o Satanas oraiopoiese sta matia tous (ton eidololatron) tis praxeis tous, (kai erthe me strato apo diabolous pou emphanistekan se anthropine morphe kai ekeinos emphanisteke ste morphe enos andra pou legotan Souraka mpin Malik) kai eipe (stous eidololatres): <<Kaneis den mporei na sas nikesei semera, kai ego eimai o uposteriktes sas.>> Otan omos sunantethekan oi duo stratoi, (kai o Satanas eide ton Tzimprel kai tous aggelous mazi tou ste pleura ton Mousoulmanon) gurise piso kai eipe (stous eidololatres): <<Den ekho kamia skhese mazi sas, pragmati, blepo auto pou de blepete. Phobamai apo ton Allakh (na me katastrepsei), giati o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria (kai kaneis den mporei na antexei ten timoria Tou)!>>

Kai (thumetheite, o, Mousoulmanoi) otan oi upokrites kai ekeinoi pou eikhan arrostia stis kardies tous (ekeinoi pou dekhtekan to Islam, alla eikhan amphibolia stis kardies tous kai emeinan me tous eidololatres ste Makka anti na metanasteusoun ste Mantina, kai etsi bgekan mazi me tous eidololatres ten emera tou Mpantr) eipan: <<E threskeia auton (ton Mousoulmanon) tous ekhei exapatesei (kai tous ekane na bgoun gia te makhe parolo pou einai ligoi kai me liga opla kai ephodia)!>> Alla opoios empisteuetai ton Allakh, pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
An eblepes (o, Prophete) otan oi aggeloi aphairoun tis psukhes ton apiston, khtupontas ta prosopa tous kai tis plates tous (kai legontas): <<Geuteite to marturio tes kauses tes Photias!
Auto (to marturio) einai gia o,ti diepraxan ta kheria sas, kai o Allakh den adikei tous doulous (Tou).>> [An eblepes auto, o, Prophete, tha eblepes poso tromero einai].

Opos egine prin me tous anthropous apo ton lao tou Pharao kai ekeinous pou etan prin ap' autous - aperripsan ta Semadia tou Allakh, etsi o Allakh tous timorese gia tis amarties tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai Austeros sten timoria Tou.

Aute (e austere timoria) egine epeide o Allakh de tha allaze pote mia eunoia pou ekhei kharisei se enan lao, mekhri na allaxoun (oi anthropoi ap' ekeino ton lao) ten katastase tous (apo ten piste kai ten eugnomosune pros tis khares tou Allakh, sten apistia kai ten agnomosune). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Opos egine prin me tous anthropous apo ton lao tou Pharao kai ekeinous pou etan prin ap' autous - diepseusan ta Semadia tou Kuriou tous, kai etsi, tous katastrepsame gia tis amarties tous kai pnixame ton lao tou Pharao, kai oloi tous etan adikoi!
Ta kheirotera kinoumena plasmata enopion tou Allakh einai oi apistoi, oi opoioi den pisteuoun (kai epimenoun sten apistia tous akoma ki an eblepan kathe semadi).
Einai ekeinoi me tous opoious ekanes (o, Prophete) suntheke, alla epeita athetoun te suntheke tous kathe phora kai de phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).

An tous sunanteseis ste makhe (ekeinous pou athetesan tis sunthekes mazi sou), timorese tous me tropo pou tha skorpisei ekeinous (tous allous ekhthrous) pou einai piso tous, isos kai na to laboun upopse (kai na men athetoun tis sunthekes tous mazi sou, oute na se polemoun, oute na uposterizoun tous allous ekhthrous enantion sou).

An omos (ekheis logous na) phobasai ten prodosia apo kapoio lao (pou ekheis suntheke mazi tou), enemerose tous gia ten katargese tes sunthekes, oste na eiste kai oi duo pleures ises (ste gnose gia ten akurose). Pragmati, o Allakh den agapa tous prodotes.
Na men nomizoun oi apistoi oti xephugan (kai sothekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh), pragmati, den mporoun na xephugoun (apo ton Allakh).

Proetoimaste (o, pistoi) enantion tous (ekhthrous sas) o,ti mporeite apo duname (opla) kai aloga, gia na ekphobisete (m' auta) tous ekhthrous tou Allakh kai tous ekhthrous sas, kai allous ektos auton, tous opoious de gnorizete, alla o Allakh tous gnorizei. O,ti xodepsete sto dromo tou Allakh, tha sas epistraphei pleros (kai tha sas apozemiosei o Allakh gi' auto sten egkosmia zoe, kai tha sas antameibei gi' auto ste Mellousa Zoe) kai de tha adiketheite.
Kai an teinoun pros ten eirene, tote kline kai esu pros auten, kai empisteusou ton Allakh. Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Alla an skopeuoun (me te suntheke eirenes) na se exapatesoun (kai na proetoimastoun gia na se polemesoun), tote o Allakh einai Eparkes na se prostatepsei (apo ten ploke tous kai ten exapatese tous). Einai Autos pou se uposterixe kai me ten uposterixe Tou kai me tous pistous.

Kai enose (o Allakh) tis kardies tous (ton piston pou se uposterixan -ton katoikon tes Mantinas apo te phule Al-Aous kai te phule Al-Khatzratz- parolo pou etan khorismenes logo ton pollon polemon metaxu tous). Akoma ki an eikhes xodepsei o,ti uparkhei ste ge, de tha mporouses na enoseis tis kardies tous, alla o Allakh tis enose. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
O, Prophete! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Eparkes na prostatepsei esena kai osous pistous se akolouthoun.

O, Prophete! Parotrune tous pistous na polemesoun. Ean uparkhoun eikosi apo sas statheroi (ste makhe), tha nikesoun diakosious (del. den prepei na drapeteusete akoma kai an oi apistoi einai dekaplasioi tou arithmou sas, kai an tha eiste statheroi apenanti tous, tote tha tous nikesete me ten adeia kai ten uposterixe tou Allakh). Kai an uparkhoun ekato apo sas (statheroi), tha nikesoun khilious apo tous apistous. Auto epeide ekeinoi (oi apistoi) einai enas laos pou den katanoei (oti o Allakh uposterizei tous pistous).

Tora o Allakh ekhei elaphrunei ten euthune sas, giati exere oti uparkhei kapoia adunamia mesa sas (del. aisthaneste duskolia to na polemesei o kathenas sas deka apo tous apistous). Etsi, an uparkhoun ekato apo sas statheroi (ste makhe), tha nikesoun diakosious (del. den prepei na drapeteusete akoma kai an oi apistoi einai diplasioi tou arithmou sas, kai an tha eiste statheroi apenanti tous, tote tha tous nikesete me ten adeia kai ten uposterixe tou Allakh). Kai an uparkhoun khilioi apo sas (statheroi), tha nikesoun duo khiliades, me ten adeia tou Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai me tous upomonetikous.

[O, pistoi, pou proteinate ston Prophete na parei lutra apo tous apistous ekhthrous pou aikhmalotisate ste makhe tou Mpantr, parolo pou esastan ligoi se arithmo], den armozei se kanenan prophete (na speusei) na aikhmalotisei (tous apistous me skopo na parei lutra kai ta kerde tes egkosmias zoes) mekhri na skotosei pollous (apo tous ekhthrous tou oste na stamatesei to kako tous) ste ge. Epithumeite ta kerde autou tou kosmou, alla o Allakh epithumei (gia sas) te Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

(O, pistoi pou perate lutra apo tous apistous aikhmalotous!) An den etan proegoumenos grammeno apo ton Allakh (sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud oti epitrepetai gia sas na parete lutra), sigoura tha eikhe pesei se sas mia megale timoria (gia o,ti perate apo lutra, prin na erthei mia apokalupse apo ton Allakh pou na sas epitrepei auto).

Phate loipon apo o,ti laphura kerdisate ston polemo, epitrepta kai kala. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, Prophete! Pes stous aikhmalotous pou (aikhmalotisate kata te makhe tou Mpantr kai) briskontai upo ten kratese sas: <<An o Allakh gnorizei kati kalo stis kardies sas, tha sas dosei kati kalutero ap' auto pou ekhei parthei (os lutra) apo sas kai tha sas sugkhoresei, giati o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>> [Aute e uposkhese tou Allakh ekplerotheke ston Al-'Ampas, ton theio tou Prophete, kai s' allous pou aspastekan to Islam].

Alla an skopeuoun (o, Prophete) na se prodosoun (legontas kati antitheto m' auto pou uparkhei stis kardies tous), ekhoun ede prodosei ton Allakh prin (me ten apistia tous), kai etsi sas edose duname pano tous (kata te makhe tou Mpantr). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Ekeinoi (oi Al-Moukhatzirein, -oi metanastes-) pou pisteuoun, metanasteusan (apo te Makka pros te Mantina) kai agonistekan me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous sto dromo tou Allakh, kai ekeinoi (oi Al-Ansar, -oi katoikoi tes Mantinas-) pou pareikhan (stous metanastes) kataphugio kai (tous) uposterixan - einai oi uposteriktes o enas tou allou. Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun alla de metanasteusan, den ekhete kamia upokhreose (o, pistoi) na tous uposterixete mekhri na metanasteusoun. Alla an (tous adikoun oi apistoi kai) zetesoun ten uposterixe sas (enantion tous) logo tou oti ekhete ten idia threskeia, einai upokhreose sas na (tous) uposterixete (enantion ton apiston), ektos an etan enantion enos laou pou ekhete mazi tou suntheke. Pragmati, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, einai oi uposteriktes o enas tou allou (kai den prepei na tous uposterixoun oi pistoi). An (o, pistoi) den to kanete auto (to na eiste uposteriktes o enas tou allou kai na men uposterixete tous apistous), tha uparxei (megale) dokimasia (kai apistia kai tha anameikhthei e aletheia me ten plane) ste ge kai (tha uparxei) megalo kako (kai amarties kai apotrope ton anthropon apo to dromo tou Allakh).

Pragmati, ekeinoi (oi Al-Moukhatzirein, -oi metanastes-) pou pisteuoun, metanasteusan (apo te Makka pros te Mantina) kai agonistekan sto dromo tou Allakh, kathos kai ekeinoi (oi Al-Ansar, -oi katoikoi tes Mantinas-) pou (tous) edosan kataphugio kai (tous) uposterixan - autoi einai oi alethinoi pistoi. Tha laboun sugkhorese kai gennaiodore pronoia (ston Paradeiso).

Ki osoi pistepsan meta, metanasteusan kai agonistekan (sto dromo tou Allakh) mazi sas - einai apo sas (pistoi). Oi ex aimatos suggeneis dikaiountai perissotero na kleronomoun o enas apo ton allon, sumphona me to Biblio tou Allakh (apo to na kleronomoun oi Mousoulmanoi apo tous Al-Moukhatzirein kai tous Al-Ansar o enas apo ton allon, opos kanate prin, me base ten Mousoulmanike adelphosune). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Aute einai mia delose apo ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, gia ten katargese ton sunthekon pros ekeinous tous eidololatres (sten Arabike Khersoneso) me tous opoious eikhate sunapsei (o, Mousoulmanoi) sunthekes (alla ekeinoi tis athetesan e uposterixan allous enantion sas).

Metakinetheite eleuthera loipon ste ge (o, eidololatres tes Arabikes Khersonesou, pou athetesate tis sunthekes sas me tous Mousoulmanous) gia tesseris menes, alla na xerete oti den mporeite na xephugete apo ton Allakh kai oti o Allakh tha tapeinosei tous apistous.

Mia delose apo ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou pros tous anthropous ten emera tou megaluterou proskunematos (del. tou Khatz), oti o Allakh katargei tis sunthekes me tous eidololatres (tes Arabikes Khersonesou, pou athetesan tis sunthekes tous me tous Mousoulmanous) epises kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou (tis katargei). Ean strapheite (o, eidololatres) me metameleia pros ton Allakh (kai stamatesete ten eidololatria sas), einai kalutero gia sas, alla an apomakruntheite, tote na xerete oti den mporeite na xephugete apo ton Allakh. Kai aneggeile (o, Prophete) stous apistous oti tha ekhoun odunero marturio.

Omos, exairountai (ap' aute te delose tes katargeses ton sunthekon) ekeinoi oi eidololatres me tous opoios eikhate sunapsei (o, Mousoulmanoi) sunthekes kai epeita de meiosan tipota apo ta dikaiomata sas (stis sunthekes), oute uposterixan kanenan enantion sas - epomenos ekpleroste te suntheke sas mazi tous mekhri to telos tou kathorismenou khronou tes. Pragmati, o Allakh agapa autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Otan omos, teleiosoun oi (tesseris) ieroi menes, skotoste ekeinous (pou athetesan tis sunthekes tous mazi sas apo) tous eidololatres (tes Arabikes khersonesou) opou tous breite (del. eite mesa sto Iero Tzami, eite exo ap' auto), aikhmalotiste tous, poliorkeste tous (kai empodiste tous na mpoun ste Makka) kai perimenete tous se kathe dromo. An omos straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh, teloun ten proseukhe kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), tote apheste tous eleutherous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

(O, Prophete) an kapoios apo tous eidololatres (pou polemate) sou zetesei prostasia, prostatepse ton, oste na akousei ta Logia tou Allakh, kai meta sunodepse ton mekhri na phtasei sto asphales meros tou. Auto giati einai enas laos pou de gnorizei (tis aletheies tou Islam).

Pos mporei na ekhoun oi eidololatres suntheke me ton Allakh kai me ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, ektos ap' ekeinous me tous opoious sunapsate suntheke sto Iero Tzami (ste sumphiliose tes Al-Khountaimpigia); Ean einai statheroi ste desmeuse tous pros esas (o, Mousoulmanoi), na eiste ki eseis statheroi ste desmeuse sas pros autous. Pragmati, o Allakh agapa autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Pos (mporei na ekhoun suntheke me ton Allakh) - ten ora pou an sas nikesoun, de tha sebontai oute desmous suggeneias, oute suntheke mazi sas; [Alla tha sas kanoun na geuteite ena megalo marturio]. Sas lene me ta stomata tous, auta pou na sas kanoun ikanopoiemenous, eno oi kardies tous arnountai, kai oi perissoteroi ap' autous einai anupakouoi.
Antallassan to na akolouthesoun ta Semadia tou Allakh me ena mikro timema, kai etsi, (arnethekan ten piste kai) empodisan (tous anthropous) apo to dromo Tou. Pragmati, athlio einai auto pou ekanan!
De sebontai oute desmous suggeneias, oute suntheke me kanenan pisto (kai an mporousan, tha ton skotonan). Pragmati, ekeinoi einai oi parabates!

An, omos, straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh, teloun ten proseukhe kai dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune), tote einai adelphoi sas ste threskeia. Etsi, diasaphenisoume ta Edaphia gi' ekeinous pou gnorizoun (kai tha ta analogistoun).

Alla an (ekeinoi oi eidololatres) parabiasoun tous orkous tous, aphou eikhan sunapsei te suntheke (eirenes mazi sas, oti de tha sas polemesoun, oute tha uposterixoun kanenan enantion sas), kai ubrisoun ten threskeia sas, tote polemeste tous egetes tes apistias, giati st' aletheia, de sebontai tous orkous tous, mepos etsi (otan tha tous polemesete) na stamatesoun (ten apistia tous).

Ma de tha polemesete ekeinous tous anthropous pou ekhoun parabiasei tous orkous tous, kai skopeuan na exorisoun ton Aggeliaphoro (apo te Makka), kai etan ekeinoi pou sas epitethekan protoi; Tous phobaste; Pragmati, ton Allakh pou prepei na phobaste, an eiste alethina pistoi!
Polemeste tous, o Allakh tha tous timoresei me ta kheria sas, tha tous atimasei, tha sas kanei na tous nikesete kai tha kanei tis kardies ton piston na einai ikanopoiemenes.
Kai tha kanei to thumo ton kardion tous (ton piston) na phugei. O Allakh dekhetai te metameleia ap' autous pou thelei (o Allakh), kai o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Nomizete (o, pistoi) oti tha aphetheite khoris na dokimasteite kai khoris na xerei (na dei) o Allakh (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei s' esas kai na diakhorisei o Allakh) ekeinous apo sas pou agonizontai (sto dromo Tou) kai den pairnoun os kedemones kai uposteriktes allous ektos tou Allakh, tou Aggeliaphorou Tou kai ton piston; Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Den armozei stous eidololatres na uperetoun (kai na phrontizoun) ta Tzamia tou Allakh, eno oi idioi marturoun ten apistia tous enantion ton eauton tous. Ekeinoi einai autoi pou oi praxeis tous einai mataies kai ste Photia tha parameinoun gia panta.

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou mporoun na uperetoun (kai na phrontizoun) ta Tzamia tou Allakh einai mono autoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai ten Eskhate Emera, teloun ten proseukhe, dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai de phobountai para mono ton Allakh. Ekeinoi isos na einai apo tous pragmatika kathodegemenous.

Theoreite (ekeinon pou phrontizei gia) ten parokhe posimou nerou stous proskunetes kai ten uperetese (kai te phrontida) tou Ierou Tzamiou (ste Makka) iso m' auton pou pisteuei ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, kai agonizetai sto dromo tou Allakh; St' aletheia, den einai isoi enopion tou Allakh. Kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous.
Ekeinoi pou pisteuoun, metanasteusan kai agonistekan sto dromo tou Allakh me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous ekhoun upselotere these enopion tou Allakh, kai ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.
O Kurios tous tous anaggellei eukharista nea oti tha laboun eleos ap' Auton, ten euarestese Tou, kai kepous (ston Paradeiso) opou tha ekhoun ekei mesa aionia eudaimonia.
Opou tha meinoun ekei mesa (ston Paradeiso) gia panta. Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei spoudaia amoibe (ton Paradeiso).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men pairnete tous goneis kai tous adelphous sas os uposteriktes kai agapetous (me to na tous peite ta mustika ton Mousoulmanon kai na epilexete na meinete mazi tous ste Makka apo to na metanasteusete pros te Mantina), an protimoun ten apistia apo ten piste. Opoioi apo sas tous pairnoun os uposteriktes kai agapetous, tote ekeinoi einai oi adikoi.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous Mousoulmanous pou menoun ste Makka kai de metanasteusan pros te Mantina): <<Ean oi goneis sas, ta paidia sas, ta adelphia sas, oi suzugoi sas, e phule sas, o ploutos pou apoktesate, to emporio pou phobaste na parakmasei kai ta spitia pou sas eukharistoun - [an ola auta] einai pio agapeta se sas apo ton Allakh, ton Aggeliaphoro Tou kai to na agonizeste sto dromo Tou (kai na metanasteusete pros te Mantina), tote perimenete mekhri o Allakh na steilei to diatagma Tou (ten timoria Tou se sas). Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous anupakouous.>>

O Allakh sas edose (o, pistoi) nike se polles makhes (parolo pou esastan ligoi kai adunamoi). Kai (sas edose nike) ten emera (tes makhes) tes Khounain, otan sas arese pou esastan polloi [kai eipate: <<De tha nikethoume semera logo tou megalou arithmou mas!>>], alla de sas ophelese se tipote (o megalos arithmos sas)! Kai [otan sas aiphnidiasan oi toxotes apo tous ekhthrous sas rikhnontas xaphnika se sas bele sten koilada tes Khounain,] etsi e ge, para ten aperantosune tes, egine stene gia sas, kai epeita trapekate se phuge ettemenoi [ektos apo ton Prophete kai ekeinous pou etan mazi tou, emeinan statheroi ste makhe, kai o Prophetes prokhorontas pros tous apistous pere petradakia kai ta erixe pros ekeinous kai phonaxe: <<Ma ton Kurio tou Mokhammant! Ettethekan (oi apistoi).>>].

Epeita, o Allakh esteile ten eremia Tou ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai stous pistous (kai tous ekane na einai statheroi xana ste makhe), kai esteile stratiotes (aggelous) pou den tous eidate, kai timorese tous apistous (me phono kai aikhmalosia). Tetoia (timoria) einai e timoria gia tous apistous.

Epeita, meta ap' aute (ten timoria), o Allakh dekhetai te metameleia apo opoion thelei (o Allakh, ap' ekeinous pou egkateleipsan ten apistia kai aspastekan to Islam). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! St' aletheia, oi eidololatres einai akathartoi, gi' auto men tous aphesete na plesiasoun to Iero Tzami meta ap' aute te khronia [ten enate khronia meta apo te metanasteuse]. An phobaste te phtokheia (o, pistoi, logo tou oti de tha erthoun xana oi eidololatres gia proskunema me ta emporika karabania tous), o Allakh tha sas parekhei apo te gennaiodoria Tou, an thelei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Polemeste ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ston Allakh kai ten Eskhate Emera, oute apagoreuoun auta pou apagoreuse o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou, oute akolouthoun ten alethine threskeia, apo tous anthropous tou Bibliou mekhri na plerosoun me ta kheria tous ton phoro (Tzizua), eno einai desmeumenoi kai upotagmenoi (stous genikous kanones tou Islam kai sto na dosoun ton phoro).

Oi Ebraioi eipan: <<O 'Ouzair (Esdras) einai o gios tou Allakh.>>, kai oi Khristianoi eipan: <<O Messias einai o gios tou Allakh.>> Auta einai ta logia pou eipan me ta stomata tous (khoris na ekhoun kamia apodeixe). Moiazoun me ta logia ton apiston apo prin [pou eipan: <<Oi aggeloi einai oi kores tou Allakh.>> -Upsistos einai o Allakh kai Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun-]. Eithe o Allakh na tous katastrepsei. Pos parekklinoun apo ten aletheia;

(Oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi) peran tous rabinous tous kai tous monakhous tous os kurious ektos tou Allakh (akolouthontas o,ti epetrepsan oi rabinoi kai oi papades, kai apekhontas apo o,ti apagoreusan, kai paramelontas tis entoles tou Allakh). (Epises oi Khristianoi peran) kai ton Messia, ton gio tes Marias (os theo). Parolo pou de diatakhthekan para mono na latreuoun mono Enan Theo (ton Allakh). Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Doxa s' Auton, einai Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun apo etairous ste latreia.

Theloun na sbesoun to phos tou Allakh (to Islam) me ta stomata tous (me ta psemata tous kai me to na diapseusoun ten aletheia pou ephere o Mokhammant apo ton Kurio tou), alla o Allakh de tha epitrepsei para mono na oloklerosei to phos (te threskeia) Tou (kai na ten exupsosei pano apo oles tis alles threskeies), akoma ki an oi apistoi misoun auto.

Einai Autos pou esteile ton Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) me ten kathodegese (to Kor'an) kai te threskeia tes aletheias (to Islam) gia na ten exupsosei pano apo oles tis alles threskeies, akoma ki an oi eidololatres misoun auto.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Pragmati, uparkhoun polloi apo tous rabinous kai tous monakhous pou katanalonoun adika ta ploute ton anthropon kai empodizoun tous anthropous apo to dromo tou Allakh. Oso gi' ekeinous pou sussoreuoun to khruso kai to asemi kai den xodeuoun ap' auta sto dromo tou Allakh (del. de dinoun te Zaka -etesia upokhreotike eleemosune-), anaggeile tous (o, Prophete) oti tha ekhoun odunero marturio (ten Emera tes Kriseos).

Ten Emera, opou auta (pou sussoreusan ekeinoi) tha puraktothoun ste Photia tes Kolaseos kai m' auta tha kauteriastoun ta metopa tous, ta pleura tous kai oi plates tous! (Kai tha tous eipothei): <<Auta einai pou sussoreusate gia ton eauto sas (khoris na dinete ap' auta te Zaka -etesia upokhreotike eleemosune-). Geuteite tora auta pou sussoreusate!>>

Pragmati, o arithmos ton menon (tes khronias) sumphona me ten krise tou Allakh einai dodeka menes, grammeno sto Biblio tou Allakh (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud) ten emera pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge. Ek ton opoion, oi tesseris einai ieroi (Dou-el-Kinta, Dou-el-Khitza, Moukharram kai Ratzamp, opou apagoreuetai na ginei makhe). Auto (to proanapheromeno) einai e orthe threskeia, gi' auto men adikeite tous eautous sas s' autous tous menes (me to na parabiasete ten ieroteta tous). Kai polemeste tous eidololatres olous mazi, opos sas polemoun oloi mazi. Kai na xerete oti o Allakh einai m' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Pragmati, e metaphora tes ierotetas enos ierou mena s' allon mena (pou den einai ieros, opos ekanan oi apistoi oste na mporesoun na polemesoun se enan iero mena) einai mia auxese sten apistia (tous). (O Satanas) paraplanei m' auten (ten praxe) tous apistous. Mia khronia (oi apistoi) metapheroun ten ieroteta tou (enos ierou mena, s' allon mena pou den einai ieros), kai ten alle khronia teroun ten ieroteta tou, prokeimenou na ekplerosoun ton arithmo ton menon pou katestese o Allakh os ierous (tesseris menes kathe khrono), kai etsi metapheroun ten ieroteta ton menon pou o Allakh ekhei katastesei os ierous! Oraiopoiethekan sta matia tous (apo to Satana) oi kakes tous praxeis. Kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous apistous anthropous (pou epimenoun sten apistia tous).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Ti sumbainei me sas, pou otan sas eipothei: <<Bgeite gia na agonisteite sto dromo tou Allakh.>>, kathustereite kai proskollate sta spitia sas; Eiste perissotero ikanopoiemenoi me ten egkosmia zoe protimontas ten apo te Mellousa Zoe; Pragmati, oi apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes einai polu ligoteres se sugkrise me tis apolauseis tes Mellousas Zoes.

Ean de bgeite (o, pistoi, gia na agonizeste sto dromo tou Allakh), (o Allakh) tha sas timoresei me mia odunere timoria kai tha sas antikatastesei me enan allon (upakouo) lao, kai de tha Ton blapsete sto elakhisto (me to na parakoute ten entole Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Ean (o, pistoi) den ton uposterizete (ton Prophete, me to na agonizeste sto dromo tou Allakh), pragmati o Allakh ton ekhei ede uposterixei, otan oi apistoi (ethelan na ton skotosoun kai) ton anagkasan na phugei (apo te Makka pros te Mantina). Kai etan enas apo tous duo (pou bgekan, -o Prophetes kai o suntrophos tou, o Ampou Mpakr-), oi opoioi etan ste spelia (Thaour, gia na kruphtoun apo tous eidololatres pou tous kunegousan sto dromo pros te Mantina). Otan eipe (o Prophetes) ston suntropho tou (pou phobetheke gia ton Prophete apo to na ton piasoun oi apistoi): <<Me lupasai. Pragmati, o Allakh einai mazi mas.>> Etsi, o Allakh esteile ten eremia Tou pano tou, ton sterixe me stratiotes (tous aggelous) pou den tous eidate kai ekane ton logo ton apiston na einai o katoteros, eno ton Logo tou Allakh na einai o Anoteros. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Bgeite (o, pistoi, gia na agonisteite sto dromo tou Allakh), eite eiste elaphrioi (ugieis, neoi kai plousioi), eite eiste barioi (adunamoi, gerontes kai phtokhoi), kai agonisteite me ta ploute sas kai tous eautous sas sto dromo tou Allakh. Auto einai kalutero gia sas, an to xerate.

(Oso gi' ekeinous tous upokrites pou sou zetesan, o, Prophete, ten adeia gia na me bgoun gia te Makhe tes Tampouk), an etan (na bgoun gia) eukola laphura kai ena suntomo taxidi, tha se akolouthousan! Alla e apostase gi' autous etan makria kai me kakoukhies (kai etsi tempeliasan na bgoun gia te makhe). Tha orkistoun ston Allakh: <<An mporousame, sigoura tha eikhame bgei mazi sas.>> Katastrephoun tous eautous tous (me tous pseutikous orkous tous), kai o Allakh xerei oti einai pseutes!

O Allakh se sugkhorese (o, Prophete). Giati tous edoses ten adeia (na me bgoun gia te makhe tes Tampouk) prin na phanoun se sena poioi eipan ten aletheia (ste dikaiologia tous), kai na matheis poioi etan pseutes;

Osoi pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera de tha sou zetousan ten adeia na men agonistoun sto dromo tou Allakh me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous (alla tha espeudan na bgoun opote tous kaleis s' auto). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei kala ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Ekeinoi pou tha sou zetousan ten adeia (na men bgoun gia na agonistoun sto dromo tou Allakh) einai mono autoi pou den pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera kai ton opoion oi kardies ekhoun amphiballei (ste threskeia), kai etsi, autoi menoun stis amphibolies tous me sugkhuse.

An ethelan pragmatika na bgoun (gia na agonistoun sto dromo tou Allakh), tha eikhan kanei tis aparaitetes proetoimasies gi' auto. Alla o Allakh misouse to na bgoun (mazi sou ste makhe), kai etsi tous ekane na aisthanontai baria to na bgoun. Kai tous eipotheke: <<Meinete piso m' autous pou tha meinoun piso (apo tous arrostous, tous adunamous, tis gunaikes kai ta paidia.).>>

Ean (oi upokrites) eikhan bgei mazi sas (o, pistoi), de tha sas auxanan para mono se ataxia, kai tha espeudan anamesa sas spernontas dikhonoia metaxu sas. Kai uparkhoun merikoi anamesa sas pou tous akoun (kai akoun ta psemata tous, ta dekhontai kai ta diadidoun). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei kala tous adikous.

Ede eikhan anazetesei (oi upokrites) na speiroun dikhonoia (metaxu ton piston) apo prin (te makhe tes Tampouk, opos ekane o Ampnt Allakh mpin Oumpai kata te makhe tes Oukhount, otan ephuge me tous suntrophous tou), kai eikhan epinoesei sunomosies enantion sou (o, Prophete) mekhri pou erthe e aletheia (e nike) kai epikratese e entole (e threskeia) tou Allakh, parolo pou to misousan auto.

Kai ap' autous (tous upokrites) uparkhei ekeinos (o Tzant mpin Kais) pou eipe (pseudos, ston Prophete): <<Dose mou adeia na me bgo (gia te makhe tes Tampouk) gia na me me kaneis na peso sten amartia (tes moikheias an pao makria apo te gunaika mou se toso makrino taxidi, epeide ekho adunamia pros tis gunaikes).>> Pragmati, autoi ekhoun ede pesei sten amartia (tes upokrisias), kai pragmati, e kolase tha periballei tous apistous.

An sou sumbei (o, Prophete) kati kalo (apo nike klp.), tous stenakhorei, alla an sou sumbei mia sumphora, lene: <<Ekhoume parei tis prophulaxeis mas apo prin (otan de bgekame gia te makhe me tous pistous, pou kapoioi skotothekan kai alloi epesan se aikhmalosia)!>>, kai strephontai (pros tis oikogeneies tous) kharoumenoi (gia ten asphaleia tous kai gia o,ti epathan oi pistoi).
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Tipota de tha mas sumbei para mono auto pou o Allakh ekhei orisei gia mas. Autos einai o Kedemonas (kai o Prostates) mas.>> Kai mono ton Allakh as empisteutoun oi pistoi.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous upokrites): <<Perimenete na mas sumbei kati allo, ektos ena apo ta duo kala (nike e na eimaste martures); Alla emeis perimenoume na sas plexei o Allakh me mia timoria ap' Auton e me ta kheria mas. Perimenete loipon, ki emeis perimenoume mazi sas.>>
Pes (o, Prophete, stous upokrites): <<Eite xodeuete ethelemena, eite athela sas, de tha ginei apodekto apo sas, giati eiste anupakouoi anthropoi.>>

Den empodise, to na ginoun apodekta ap' autous (tous upokrites) auta pou xodepsan, para mono oti den pisteuan ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, den erkhontai sten proseukhe para nokhelika kai den xodeuoun para aprothuma.

Gi' auto as me se entuposiazoun ta ploute tous kai ta paidia tous (ton upokriton). O Allakh thelei mono na tous timoresei meso auton sten egkosmia zoe (kanontas tous na trekhoun ole te zoe tous me kourase piso ap' auta) kai (mekhri) na bgoun oi psukhes tous apo ta somata tous, eno einai apistoi.
Orkizontai ston Allakh (oi upokrites) oti einai apo sas, alla den einai apo sas, alla einai enas laos pou phobatai.
An mporousan (oi upokrites) na broun ena kataphugio, e spelies, e ena tounel (gia na kruphtoun), tha pegainan pros auto me orme.

Uparkhoun kapoioi ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou se katakrinoun (o, Mokhammant) skhetika me to moirasma tes eleemosunes. An tous dothei kati (auto pou theloun) ap' aute, einai ikanopoiemenoi, alla an den tous dothei kati (auto pou theloun) ap' aute, exorgizontai.

An etan (ekeinoi oi upokrites pou se katekrinan) ikanopoiemenoi me o,ti tous edose (del. orise) o Allakh (gi' autous) kai (o,ti tous edose) o Aggeliaphoros Tou kai na elegan: <<Mas eparkei o Allakh na mas parekhei. O Allakh tha mas dosei apo te gennaiodoria Tou, kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou (tha mas dosei apo o,ti tou edose o Allakh). Pragmati, mono ston Allakh strephomaste me elpida.>> [tha etan kalutero gi' autous].

St' aletheia, e eleemosune (e Zaka -e etesia upokhreotike eleemosune-) einai mono gia: tous phtokhous, tous endeeis, ekeinous pou (tous stelnei o kubernetes gia na) te sullexoun (te Zaka), tous me-Mousoulmanous pou oi kardies ton opoion klinoun pros to Islam, ten apeleutherose ton sklabon e ton aikhmaloton, osous ekhoun khree, ten uposterixe (ekeinon pou agonizontai) sto dromo tou Allakh kai ton odoiporo (ton taxidiote pou einai apokommenos apo ola). Ena kathekon pou epibletheke apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Uparkhoun kapoioi ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou blaptoun me ta logia tous ton Prophete kai (otan kapoios tous leei na prosexoun, oste na me phtasoun ta logia tous ston Prophete, tote) lene: <<Autos (o Prophetes) akouei opoion tou milaei kai ton pisteuei (etsi, an tou phtasoun ta logia mas, tha poume oti den ta eipame kai tha mas pistepsei)!>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Nai, akouei (o Prophetes) o,ti einai kalutero gia sas (kai okhi o,ti einai kako), pisteuei ston Allakh, pisteuei tous pistous (kai okhi tous upokrites) kai einai eleos gia osous pisteuoun apo sas.>> Pragmati, ekeinoi pou blaptoun ton Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh, tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

Orkizontai (oi upokrites) sto Onoma tou Allakh enopion sas (o, Mousoulmanoi) gia na sas eukharistesoun (oti den eipan kati pou blaptei ton Prophete), alla o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou einai oi pio axioi na tous eukharistesoun (me ten piste kai tis kales praxeis), an etan alethina pistoi.
Den emathan (oi upokrites) oti opoios antitithetai ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, tha eisakhthei ste Photia tes Kolaseos, opou tha meinei ekei gia panta; Aute einai e megale atimose.

Oi upokrites phobountai apo to na apokaluphthei (ston Prophete) ena kephalaio skhetika m' autous, to opoio tha enemerosei (tous pistous) gi' auta pou uparkhoun stis kardies tous (ton upokriton). Pes (o, Prophete): <<Sunekhiste (o, upokrites) sten koroidia sas! Pragmati, o Allakh tha phanerosei auta pou phobaste na phanerothoun.>>

An tous roteseis (o, Prophete, gi' auta pou eipan gia sena kai tous suntrophous sou), lene: <<Apla milousame khoris sobaroteta kai paizame.>> Pes: <<Ma, ton Allakh kai ta Edaphia Tou kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, khleuazate;>>

Me dikaiologeste, st' aletheia, apostatesate aphou eikhate pistepsei. An sugkhoresoume kapoious apo sas (pou strephontai me metameleia pros ton Allakh), tha timoresoume allous (pou epimenoun sten upokrisia tous) epeide einai kakoi.

Oi upokrites, andres kai gunaikes, einai o enas apo ton allon (del. oloi einai idioi). Diatassoun to kako kai apagoreuoun to kalo, kai sphiggoun ta kheria tous (apo to na xodeuoun sto dromo tou Allakh). Paramelesan ten upakoe pros ton Allakh, etsi tous paramelese o Allakh (apo ten kathodegese kai to eleos Tou). Pragmati, oi upokrites einai oi anupakouoi.

O Allakh ekhei uposkhethei stous upokrites, andres kai gunaikes, kai stous apistous te Photia tes Kolaseos, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta. Eparkei aute (e Photia) gi' autous (os timoria). O Allakh tous katarasteke, kai gi' autous tha uparkhei ena aionio marturio.

(O, upokrites), (eiste sten apistia kai to khleuasmo) san ekeinous (apo ta proegoumena ethne) pou etan prin apo sas, oi opoioi etan pio iskhuroi apo sas kai eikhan perissotera ploute kai paidia (apo sas). Apolausan to meridio tous (apo tis apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes). Epises kai eseis apolausate to meridio sas, opos ekeinoi pou etan prin apo sas, apolausan to meridio tous. Kai ekhete epidothei se psemata (enantion tou Allakh kai tou Aggeliaphorou Tou, kai diapseusate ton Aggeliaphoro kai khleuasate tous pistous) opos kai ekeinoi (ekanan prin, me tous Aggeliaphorous kai tous pistous). Tetoioi einai ekeinoi ton opoion oi praxeis ekhoun ginei mataies sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Kai ekeinoi einai oi khamenoi.

Den tous ephtase (stous upokrites) e eidese ekeinon pou etan prin ap' autous: tou laou tou Noe, tou 'Ant, tou Thamount, tou laou tou Abraam, ton katoikon tes Madiam kai ton anestrammenon komopoleon (tou laou tou Lot); Tous erthan oi Aggeliaphoroi tous me xekathara semadia (alla tous diepseudan, kai etsi esteile o Allakh ten timoria Tou s' autous). Pote de tha tous adikouse o Allakh, alla oi idioi adikesan tous eautous tous.

Oi pistoi, andres kai gunaikes, einai oi uposteriktes (oi kedemones kai oi prostates) o enas gia ton allo, diatazoun to kalo, apagoreuoun to kako, teloun ten proseukhe, parakhoroun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai upakououn ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. Ekeinoi einai autoi pou tha tous eleesei o Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

O Allakh ekhei uposkhethei stous pistous, andres kai gunaikes, kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta, kai uperokhes katoikies stous kepous tes monimes diamones, kai ten euarestese tou Allakh, pou einai e megalutere (apo ola auta). Aute einai e megale epitukhia.

O, Prophete! Agonisou enantia stous apistous kai tous upokrites, kai na eisai skleros apenanti tous. Kai (ste Mellousa Zoe) e katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, kai kheiristos einai, pragmati, autos o proorismos.

Orkizontai (oi upokrites pseudos) ston Allakh oti den eipan tipota (ap' auta pou sou ephtasan, o, Prophete, oti se prosbalan kai katekrinan te threskeia sou), eno ontos propheran logia apistias kai apostatesan aphou eikhan dekhtei to Islam, kai prospathesan na kanoun auto pou telika den katapheran na to kanoun. Kai den katekrinan para mono oti o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou ekhoun parakhoresei s' autous apo te gennaiodoria Tou! An straphoun me metameleia, tha einai kalutero gi' autous, alla an apomakrunthoun, o Allakh tha tous timoresei me mia odunere timoria sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai de tha ekhoun ste ge kanenan kedemona oute kanenan uposterikte.

Uparkhoun kapoioi ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou edosan uposkhese ston Allakh (legontas): <<An mas dosei (o Allakh) apo te gennaiodoria Tou, sigoura tha xodepsoume se eleemosune kai tha eimaste apo tous enaretous.>>
Alla otan tous edose (o Allakh) apo te gennaiodoria Tou, eginan tsigkounedes m' auta (pou tous edose, kai den xodepsan se eleemosune) kai apomakrunthekan arnoumenoi.

Etsi, (o Allakh) ekane os sunepeia gi' auta pou ekanan (ekeinoi oi upokrites), na rizosei e upokrisia stis kardies tous mekhri ten Emera pou tha Ton sunantesoun, logo tes atheteses tes uposkheses tous ston Allakh kai logo oson eipan apo psemata.
De gnorizoun (ekeinoi oi upokrites) oti o Allakh gnorizei ta mustika tous kai tis idiotikes sunomilies tous kai oti o Allakh einai o Pantognostes olon ton aoraton;

Ekeinoi (oi upokrites) pou katakrinoun tous pistous pou ethelontika dinoun (megalo poso se) eleemosune (opos ton Ampnt Ar-Rakhman mpin 'Aouph pou edose to miso tou plouto se eleemosune -edose tesseris khiliades ntirkham- alla oi upokrites eipan oti ta edose gia epideixe kai okhi gia khare tou Allakh), kai koroideuoun tous allous (pistous) pou den briskoun (ti na dosoun se eleemosune) para osa einai ste dunatoteta tous (opos ton Ampou Akeil Al-Irasei pou edose se eleemosune ena apo ta duo Sa' -dokheio pou khoraei peripou tria kila- khourmades pou eikhe, alla oi upokrites eipan oti o Allakh de khreiazetai ap' auton to ena Sa' pou edose). O Allakh tha tous koroideuei (antapodidontas ten koroidia tous pou ekanan stous pistous), kai gi' autous tha uparkhei ena odunero marturio.

Eite (o, Prophete) zetas sugkhorese gi' autous (tous upokrites), eite de zetas sugkhorese gi' autous, -akoma ki an zeteseis sugkhorese gi' autous ebdomenta phores (del. oso ki an zeteseis)-, o Allakh de tha tous sugkhoresei. Auto epeide den pisteuan ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous anupakouous.

Ekeinoi (oi upokrites) pou de bgekan (gia te makhe tes Tampouk) kharekan pou emeinan (ste Mantina kai de bgekan gia to Tzikhant) se antithese me ton Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh, kai misousan na agonizontai sto dromo tou Allakh me ta ploute kai tous eautous tous, kai eipan (o enas ston allon): <<Me bgainete (gia te makhe) s' aute te zeste.>> Pes (tous, o, Mokhammant): <<E Photia tes Kolaseos (pou ten proetoimase o Allakh gia tous anupakouous) einai pio entone ste zeste.>> An mporousan na katalaboun!
As gelasoun (ekeinoi oi upokrites) gia ligo (sten egkosmia zoe) kai as klapsoun polu (ste Mellousa Zoe) os antapodose gia osa dieprattan (apo kakes praxeis).

Ean o Allakh se epestrepse (o, Prophete) se mia omada ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) kai zetesoun ten adeia sou na bgoun mazi sou (s' alle makhe), pes (tous): <<De tha bgeite pote mazi mou, oute tha polemesete mazi mou kanenan ekhthro. Esastan ikanopoiemenoi me to na meinete piso (ste Mantina kai na me bgeite) ten prote phora (gia te makhe tes Tampouk), etsi, meinete m' autous pou tha meinoun piso (kai de tha bgoun gia to Tzikhant).>>

Men teleis (o, Prophete) ten epikedeia proseukhe gia kanenan ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou pethane, oute na stekesai dipla ston tapho tou (gia na zeteseis sugkhorese gi' auton). Pragmati, autoi arnethekan ten piste ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai pethanan os anupakouoi.

Gi' auto, as me se entuposiasoun ta ploute tous kai ta paidia tous (ton upokriton). O Allakh thelei mono na tous timoresei meso auton sten egkosmia zoe (kanontas tous na trekhoun ole te zoe tous me kourase piso ap' auta) kai (mekhri) na bgoun oi psukhes tous apo ta somata tous eno einai apistoi.

Otan apokaluphthei (ston Prophete) ena Kephalaio (pou na diataxei) oti: <<Pistepste ston Allakh kai agonisteite (sto dromo Tou) mazi me ton Aggeliaphoro Tou.>>, oi euporoi anamesa tous (stous upokrites), sou zetoun ten adeia (na me bgoun gia te makhe), kai lene: <<Aphese mas na meinoume m' autous pou tha meinoun piso (pou ekhoun egkure dikaiologia na men bgoun gia te makhe).>>

Einai ikanopoiemenoi (oi upokrites) me to na meinoun m' autous pou tha meinoun piso (pou ekhoun egkure dikaiologia na me bgoun ste makhe)! Oi kardies tous (ton upokriton) ekhoun sphragistei, kai etsi, den katalabainoun.

Alla o Aggeliaphoros kai oi pistoi mazi tou, agonizontai me ta ploute tous kai tous eautous tous, kai pragmati, ekeinoi tha ekhoun ta kala (opos ten nike kai ton Paradeiso), kai ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

O Allakh ekhei proetoimasei gi' autous kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai aute einai e megale epitukhia.

Merikoi apo tous Bedouinous (apo te Mantina kai apo ta perikhora tes) erthan (se sena, o, Prophete) gia na zetesoun na tous epitrepseis na me bgoun (gia te makhe tes Tampouk), eno oi alloi pou diepseusan ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou emeinan piso (khoris na erthoun kan gia na zetesoun ten adeia). Tha plexei ekeinous pou den pisteuan anamesa tous, ena odunero marturio.

St' aletheia, stous adunamous (pou den mporoun na bgoun gia te makhe), tous arrostous e ekeinous (tous phtokhous) pou de briskoun tipota na xodepsoun (gia na etoimastoun gia te makhe), den uparkhei amartia (to na me bgoun gia te makhe) an einai aphosiomenoi pros ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. Den uparkhei dromos (timorias e epiplexes) enantion ekeinon pou prattoun to kalo (ap' ekeinous pou ekhoun egkuro logo na me bgoun gia te makhe). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oute uparkhei amartia s' ekeinous pou erthan se sena (o, Prophete) zetontas na tous parekheis zoa pou na ta kabalesoun, kai esu eipes: <<De brisko zoa na sas parekho gia na ta kabalesete.>>, kai etsi, gurisan me polla dakrua sta matia apo te thlipse oti de briskoun tipota na xodepsoun (gia na etoimastoun gia te makhe).

Alla uparkhei dromos (timorias e epiplexes) mono enantion ekeinon pou sou zetesan ten adeia (na me bgoun gia te makhe tes Tampouk) eno einai plousioi (kai ekhoun te dunatoteta na proetoimastoun gia te makhe). Einai ikanopoiemenoi (ekeinoi oi upokrites) me to na meinoun m' autous pou tha meinoun piso (pou ekhoun egkure dikaiologia na me bgoun gia te makhe). O Allakh sphragise tis kardies tous, kai etsi, de gnorizoun (to kalo tous kai to kako tous).

(O, pistoi) tha sas poun (oi upokrites, abasimes) dikaiologies otan tha epistrepsete s' autous (apo te makhe). Pes (o, Prophete): <<Men peite dikaiologies, epeide de tha sas pistepsoume. Pragmati, o Allakh mas ekhei enemerosei gia tis upotheseis sas. O Allakh tha dei kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou epises, tis praxeis sas (an tha strapheite me metameleia pros Auton e tha sunekhisete sten upokrisia sas), epeita tha epistrepsete ston Pantognoste tou aoratou kai tou oratou, kai tha sas enemerosei gia o,ti kanate.>>

Otan tha epistrepsete (o, pistoi) s' autous (tous upokrites), tha orkistoun sto Onoma tou Allakh enopion sas (gia tis abasimes dikaiologies tous) gia na tous aphesete esukhous (khoris epiplexe e kategoria). Apomakruntheite, loipon, ap' autous (periphronontas tous), giati einai akathartoi poneroi. E katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, os timoria gia osa dieprattan.

Orkizontai enopion sas gia na eiste eukharistemenoi mazi tous (kai na dekhteite tis dikaiologies tous). Akoma ki an tha eiste eukharistemenoi mazi tous, o Allakh de tha einai Eukharistemenos me tous anupakouous anthropous.

Oi (apistoi kai oi upokrites) Bedouinoi (pou zoun sten eremo) einai oi kheiroteroi sten apistia kai ten upokrisia (ap' ekeinous pou zoun stis poleis). Kai einai plesiesteroi sto na me gnorizoun ta oria (ton praxeon latreias kai ton kanonon) pou esteile o Allakh ston Aggeliaphoro Tou (logo tes apoxenoses, tes sklerotetas kai tes diamones tous makria apo te gnose kai tous logious). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Uparkhoun anamesa stous Bedouinous ekeinoi (oi upokrites) pou theoroun oti o,ti xodeuoun (sto dromo tou Allakh) einai apoleia (nomizontas oti de tha antameibontai gi' auta kai oti de tha timorethoun an den xodeuoun). Kai perimenoun na sas sumbei (o, pistoi) kati kako. Alla to kako tha pesei s' ekeinous! Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Kai uparkhoun anamesa stous Bedouinous ekeinoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, kai pairnoun o,ti xodeuoun (sto dromo tou Allakh) os meso eggutetas ston Allakh kai gia na kerdisoun tis epikleseis tou Aggeliaphorou (ston Allakh na tous sugkhoresei kai na tous antameipsei). Pragmati, auta (pou xodeuoun) einai ena meso pou tous phernei pio konta (ston Allakh). O Allakh tha tous eisagei sto eleos Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou espeusan protoi (na aspastoun to Islam), oi opoioi etan apo tous Al-Moukhatzirein (tous metanastes apo te Makka pros te Mantina) kai tous Al-Ansar (tous uposteriktes, tous katoikous tes Mantinas), kai ekeinous pou tous akolouthesan me kalosune, o Allakh einai Eukharistemenos mazi tous kai ekeinoi einai eukharistemenoi mazi Tou. Proetoimase (o Allakh) gi' autous kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai aute einai e megale epitukhia. [Auto to Edaphio episemainei ten arete ton suntrophon tou Prophete, sumperilambanomenon ton Ampou Mpakr, Omar, Outhman, Ali, AIsa, kai allon].

Metaxu ton Bedouinon pou katoikoun guro sas (sten eremo guro apo te Mantina) uparkhoun upokrites, opos kai apo tous katoikous tes Mantinas, oi opoioi epemeinan sten upokrisia. Den tous xereis (o, Prophete), alla Emeis tous xeroume. Tha tous timoresoume duo phores (ste zoe tous kai stous taphous tous), epeita tha odegethoun pros ena megalo marturio.

Kai uparkhoun alloi (apo tous katoikous tes Mantinas, o Ampou Loumpampa kai oi suntrophoi tou) pou paradekhtekan tis amarties tous (oti den eikhan dikaiologia to na me bgoun gia te makhe tes Tampouk, kai den epinoesan abasimes dikaiologies). Ekhoun anakatepsei mia kale praxe (oti straphekan me metameleia, kai tis proegoumenes kales praxeis tous) me mia kake praxe (oti de bgekan gia te makhe). Isos o Allakh na dekhtei te metameleia tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Pare (o, Prophete) eleemosune apo ten periousia tous (ekeinon pou straphekan me metameleia pros ton Allakh, kai dose ten stous phtokhous) gia na tous exagniseis (apo tis amarties tous) kai na tous upsoseis m' auten (ten eleemosune kai na tous bgaleis apo tis theseis ton upokriton) kai epikalesou ton Allakh na tous sugkhoresei. St' aletheia, oi epikleseis sou einai eleos kai kathesukhase gi' autous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Sami' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

De gnorizoun (ekeinoi pou straphekan me metameleia) oti o Allakh einai Autos pou dekhetai te metameleia apo tous doulous Tou kai dekhetai ten eleemosune tous, kai oti o Allakh einai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos);

Kai pes (o, Prophete, s' ekeinous pou straphekan me metameleia): <<Kante (kales praxeis), kai o Allakh tha dei tis praxeis sas, epises kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou kai oi pistoi (tha tis doun). Kai epeita tha epistrepsete ston Pantognoste tou aoratou kai tou oratou, kai tha sas enemerosei gia osa kanate.>>

Kai uparkhoun kai alloi (oi treis apo tous katoikous tes Mantinas, o Mourara mpin Ar-Rampi', o Ka'mp mpin Malik kai o Khilal mpin Oumaia, pou de bgekan gia te makhe tes Tampouk parolo pou den eikhan dikaiologia) pou to thema tous tha anablethei mekhri na erthei e entole tou Allakh. Eite tha tous timoresei, eite tha dekhtei te metameleia tous! Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Uparkhoun kai ekeinoi (oi dodeka upokrites apo tous katoikous tes Mantinas) pou ekhtisan ena tzami gia na blaptoun (tous Mousoulmanous), kai os apistia (me skopo na antitithentai ston Prophete) kai gia na diakhorisoun tous pistous (me to na teloun ekei kapoioi pistoi tis proseukhes, aphenontas to tzami tes Koumpa' pou to ekhtise o Prophetes) kai os proetoimasia gi' ekeinon (ton Ampou 'Amir, ton monakho) pou eikhe polemesei prin enantion tou Allakh kai tou Aggeliaphorou Tou (kai eikhe kanei summakhia me tous eidololatres kai pege ston Erakleio, ton Buzantino autokratora, gia na steilei enan strato enantion ton Mousoulmanon). Tha orkistoun (oi upokrites) oti: <<De skopeuame (me to na khtisoume auto to tzami) para mono to kalo.>>, alla o Allakh martura oti einai pseutes! [Ekhtisan to tzami prin te makhe tes Tampouk kai kalesan ton Prophete na erthei gia na odegesei ten proseukhe ekei, alla tous eipe oti tha erthei an to thelei o Allakh otan tha gurisei apo te makhe, omos gurizontas kathodon apo te makhe, o Allakh tou apokalupse gia to skopo tous, kai etsi o Prophetes esteile kapoious na kapsoun ekeino to tzami].

Pote (o, Prophete) men teleseis kamia proseukhe s' ekeino (to tzami pou ekhtisan oi upokrites). Pragmati, ena tzami (tes Koumpa') pou idrutheke me eulabeia apo ten prote mera, einai pio axio to na teleis ten proseukhe mesa tou. Mesa tou uparkhoun anthropoi pou agapoun na exagnistoun, kai o Allakh agapa ekeinous pou exagnizontai.

Einai kaluteros, autos pou ethese ta themelia tou ktiriou tou sten eusebeia pros ton Allakh kai sten anazetese tes euaresteses Tou, e ekeinos pou ethese ta themelia tou ktiriou tou sten akre enos gkremou pou etan etoimo na pesei, kai etsi epese mazi tou ste Photia tes Kolaseos; Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous anthropous.

Auto to ktirio tous pou ekhtisan (oi upokrites) tha paramenei os amphibolia kai upokrisia stis kardies tous mekhri na kopoun oi kardies tous (me to thanato). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei agorasei apo tous pistous tous eautous tous kai ta ploute tous, kai se antallagma tha ekhoun ton Paradeiso. Polemoun sto dromo tou Allakh, kai etsi e skotonoun e skotonontai. Aute einai mia alethine uposkhese ap' Auton sten Tora, to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou) kai to Kor'an. Poios einai pio axiopistos apo ton Allakh sto na ekplerosei ten uposkhese tou; Na khaireste loipon gia te sunallage pou ekhete kanei (mazi Tou). Kai aute einai e megale epitukhia.

(Ekeinoi oi pistoi) einai autoi pou strephontai me metameleia (pros ton Allakh), oi latreis (tou Allakh), oi eugnomones (pros ton Allakh), pou nesteuoun, oi upoklinomenoi kai autoi pou pephtoun se Siztount stase (stis proseukhes tous), pou diatazoun to kalo kai apagoreuoun to kako, kai pou teroun ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh. Kai dose (o, Prophete) ta kharmosuna nea stous pistous.

Den epitrepetai gia ton Prophete, oute gia tous pistous na epikalestoun (ton Allakh) gia te sugkhorese ton eidololatron, akoma ki an etan suggeneis tous, aphou egine saphes s' autous (tous pistous) oti (ekeinoi oi eidololatres) einai oi katoikoi tou Puros (aphou pethanan sten apistia tous).

Oso gia ten epiklese tou Abraam (pros ton Allakh) gia te sugkhorese tou patera tou, den etan para mono logo mias uposkheses pou eikhe dosei s' auton (ton patera tou, oti tha zetouse apo ton Allakh na ton sugkhoresei). Ostoso, otan tou egine saphes oti (o pateras tou) etan ekhthros tou Allakh, ton aparnetheke. Pragmati, o Abraam ekane epikleseis (pros ton Allakh me tapeinoteta) polu sukhna, kai etan makrothumos (gia osous ton adikesan).

O Allakh de tha ekrine kapoious anthropous na parastratesoun aphou tous eikhe kathodegesei, mekhri na tous xekatharize prota ti prepei na apopheugoun (tis apagoreuseis Tou, an omos tis dieprattan, tote tha ekrine na parastratesoun). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Pragmati, ston Allakh anekei e Kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges, Autos einai pou dinei te zoe kai ten aphairei, kai pragmati, den ekhete peran tou Allakh, kanenan kedemona, oute kanenan uposterikte.

Pragmati, o Allakh dekhteke te metameleia tou Prophete (gia to oti edose ten adeia stous upokrites na me bgoun gia te makhe tes Tampouk), kai ton Al-Moukhatzirein (metanaston apo te Makka) kai ton Al-Ansar (uposterikton, ton katoikon tes Mantinas) pou ton akolouthesan (ton Prophete) ten ora tes kakoukhias (sto taxidi gia te makhe tes Tampouk), aphou prota kontepsan oi kardies kapoion ap' autous na parekklinoun (apo to na bgoun gia te makhe, epeide etan megalo taxidi, se uperbolike zeste kai elleipse ephodion, sto semeio pou duo andres moirastekan enan khourma, kai kapoioi andres kabalesan enallax mia kamela). Epeita (o Allakh) dekhteke te metameleia tous (kai statheropoiese tis kardies tous kai bgekan gia te makhe). Pragmati, Autos einai Ra'ouph (Poluepieikes) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos) pros autous.

(Epises o Allakh dekhteke te metameleia) kai ton trion (Mourara mpin Ar-Rampi', Ka'mp mpin Malik kai Khilal mpin Oumaia, pou de bgekan gia te makhe tes Tampouk parolo pou den eikhan dikaiologia) pou aphethekan (mekhri na dekhtei o Allakh te metameleia tous), ospou e ge egine stene gi' autous, para ten aperantosune tes (aphou o Prophetes dietaxe tous pistous na men tous milesoun), kai ta stethe tous eginan stena gia tous idious, kai emathan me bebaioteta oti den uparkhei kataphugio apo ton Allakh para mono pros Auton. Epeita tous kathodegese sto na straphoun me metameleia, oste na straphoun me metameleia (pros ton Allakh). Pragmati, o Allakh einai o At-Taouamp (Autos pou apodekhetai te metameleia), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai na eiste mazi me tous eilikrineis.

Den epitrepetai gia tous katoikous tes Mantinas, oute gia tous Bedouinous pou katoikoun guro tous (guro apo te Mantina), na meinoun piso kai na me bgoun me ton Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh (gia te makhe) e na diakhorisoun tous eautous tous ap' auton (me to na men ton suntropheuoun sto taxidi tou kai ste makhe, protimontas ten xekourase, eno o Prophetes agonizetai kai antimetopizei tis kakoukhies). Auto (oti den epitrepetai na ton aphenoun einai) epeide, de tha tous eplette kamia dipsa, kourase e peina sto dromo tou Allakh, oute tha patousan se ena edaphos pou tha ekane tous apistous na exorgistoun, oute tha eplettan kanenan ekhthro me kati (apo phono e aikhmalosia), para na katagraphotan gi' autous m' auto (pou ekanan) mia kale praxe. Pragmati, o Allakh den aphenei ten antamoibe ekeinon pou prattoun to kalo na khathei.

Oute tha xodeuan (sto dromo tou Allakh) -eite ligo, eite polu-, oute tha dieskhizan kamia koilada, para na katagraphotan gi' autous, oste o Allakh na tous antameipsei ten kalutere antamoibe gia o,ti ekanan.

Den prepei oi pistoi na bgoun oloi gia to Tzikhant. (An menei o Prophetes ste Mantina kai stelnei taxiarkhies gia makhe) as bgoun kapoioi apo kathe omada (e phule), (kai as meinoun mazi tou kapoioi alloi) gia na apoktesoun gnose ste threskeia, kai gia na nouthetesoun tous laous tous (me o,ti emathan) otan tha epistrepsoun s' autous, isos kai (oi laoi tous) na prosexoun (apo ten timoria tou Allakh, kai etsi na teroun tis entoles Tou kai na apekhoun apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Polemeste tous apistous pou einai guro sas kai as briskoun se sas skleroteta, kai na xerete oti o Allakh einai m' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Otan apokaluptetai ena Kephalaio, merikoi ap' ekeinous (tous upokrites) lene (khleuazontas): <<Poion apo sas ton ekane auto to Kephalaio na auxethei sten piste (tou ston Allakh kai se o,ti ephere o Mokhammant);>> Oso gia tous pistous, tous ekane (auto to Kephalaio) na auxethoun sten piste kai einai kharoumenoi (me o,ti apokaluphtheke).

Alla oso gi' ekeinous pou stis kardies tous uparkhei arrostia (tes upokrisias kai tes amphibolias), tous ekane (auto to Kephalaio) na auxethoun sten akatharsia (apistia kai upokrisia) pano apo ten akatharsia tous (logo tes diapseuse tous gia to Kor'an, kai etsi opote apokaluptetai ena Kephalaio, auxanetai e diapseuse tous kai e arrostia ton kardion tous), kai etsi pethainoun eno einai apistoi.

De blepoun (oi upokrites) oti dokimazontai mia e duo phores kathe khrono (me phtokheia kai kakoukhies e me to na phanei e upokrisia tous stous pistous e me to na doun te nike tou Prophete kai ton piston); Epeita, oute strephontai me metameleia pros ton Allakh, oute lambanoun nouthesia!

Otan apokaluptetai ena Kephalaio (ston Prophete pou na phanerosei ten katastase ton upokriton), koitazoun (oi upokrites) o enas ton allon (legontas): <<Sas blepei kaneis (an sekotheite na phugete apo te sugkentrose tou Prophete);>> Epeita pheugoun (apo phobo gia skandalo). O Allakh ekhei strepsei tis kardies tous (makria apo ten kathodegese kai to kalo), giati einai enas laos pou den katanoei.

(O, Arabes) pragmati, erthe s' esas enas Aggeliaphoros (o Mokhammant) apo sas tous idious, ton thliboun opoiesdepote kakoukhies antimetopizete, einai polu prothumos gia ten kathodegese sas, kai einai gia tous pistous gematos sumponia kai eleos.

Alla an apomakrunthoun (kai den pisteuoun, o, Prophete, se o,ti epheres apo ton Kurio sou), tote pes: <<Mou eparkei o Allakh. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Auton empisteuomai kai einai o Kurios tou Megaloprepous Thronou.>>

A, L, R (Aliph-Lam-Ra', tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio). Auta einai ta Edaphia tou teleiou kai sophou Bibliou (tou Kor'an).

Exeplexe tous anthropous oti apokalupsame se enan anthropo ap' autous, (diatazontas ton) oti: <<Proeidopoiese tous anthropous kai dose ta kharmosuna nea stous pistous oti tha ekhoun spoudaia amoibe (kai upsele these) apo ton Kurio tous.>>; Omos oi apistoi eipan: <<Autos den einai para xekatharos magos!>>

Pragmati, o Kurios sas einai o Allakh, o Opoios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge se exi emeres kai epeita anebeke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei sten Megaloprepeia Tou). Dieuthetei oles tis upotheseis, kai kaneis den mporei na mesolabesei (gia otidepote) para mono me ten adeia Tou. Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas, gi' auto latrepste Ton. Ma de tha to labete upopse;

Pros Auton einai e epistrophe olon sas. E uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine. Arkhizei te demiourgia kai meta ten epanapherei (xana ste zoe ten Emera tes Kriseos), gia na antameipsei me dikaiosune osous pisteuan kai eprattan kales praxeis. Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste tha ekhoun brasto nero gia na pioun kai epoduno marturio epeide arnethekan ten piste.

Autos einai pou ekane ton elio os pege lamperou photos kai te selene os phos (pou antanaklatai) kai prokathorise ten poreia tes (kathe mena) se apostaseis (28 phaseis, theseis kai diaphores morphes) [kai e selene krubetai mia e duo meres sumphona me to an o seleniakos menas einai 29 e 30 meres], gia na gnorizete ton arithmo ton eton kai ton upologismo (tou khronou ton eton kai tou arithmou ton emeron tous, kai ton oron ton emeron tous). O Allakh de demiourgese ola auta para mono me ten aletheia. Exegei leptomeros ta Semadia gia tous anthropous pou gnorizoun.

Pragmati, ste diadokhe tes nukhtas kai tes emeras, kai se o,ti demiourgese o Allakh stous ouranous kai ste Ge, uparkhoun Semadia gi' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou den elpizoun ste sunantese Mas (kai den ten perimenoun, oute te phobountai) kai einai ikanopoiemenoi me ten egkosmia zoe kai einai kathesukhasmenoi s' auten, kai ekeinoi pou gia ta Semadia Mas adiaphoroun,
e katoikia tous tha einai e Photia, gia o,ti dieprattan.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai prattoun kales praxeis, o Kurios tous tha tous kathodegesei (dinontas tous phos ten Emera tes Kriseos) logo tes pistes tous. Potamia tha kulesoun apo kato tous stous kepous tes eudaimonias (ston Paradeiso).

E epikleseis tous mesa tou (ston Paradeiso) tha einai: <<Soumpkhanaka Allakhouma (doxa Soi, o, Allakh)!>>, kai o khairetismos tous tha einai: <<Salam (eirene).>>, kai to telos ton epikleseon tous tha einai: <<Al-Khamntou Lellakhi Rampa Al-'Alamein (oloi oi epainoi anekoun ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon).>>

An o Allakh epispeude gia tous anthropous to kako (pou se mia katastase thumou epikalestekan gia ton eauto tous, ta paidia tous e ta ploute tous), opos epispeudei na antapokrinetai stis epikleseis tous gia to kalo, tha tous eikhe phtasei e katastrophe tous.
