Kai aphenoume ekeinous, pou den elpizoun ste sunantese Mas (kai den ten perimenoun, oute te phobountai), sten plane kai ten turannia tous na paramenoun se sugkhuse.

Otan plettei ton anthropo kapoia sumphora, Mas epikaleitai (me tapeinose kai se opoia katastase brisketai) eite xaplomenos sto plai tou, eite kathismenos, eite orthios. Alla otan aphairoume te sumphora tou, sunekhisei (na diaprattei tis amarties opos prin) san na men Mas eikhe epikalestei na aphairesoume te sumphora pou ton eplexe! (Kai opos phaneke oraio gi' auton na sunekhisei sten plane tou), etsi phanekan oraia gia tous parabates auta pou ekanan (apo apistia kai amarties).

Pragmati, eikhame katastrepsei ta ethne pou etan prin apo sas (o, eidololatres) otan adikesan, kai tous erthan oi Aggeliaphoroi tous me xekathara Semadia, alla de tha pisteuan (logo tes epimones tous sto na diapseudoun tous Aggeliaphorous). Etsi timoroume tous kakous anthropous.
Epeita sas kaname (o, anthropoi) diadokhous tous (ekeinon ton ethnon) ste ge, gia na doume pos tha prattete.

Otan apaggellontai s' autous (tous eidololatres) ta Edaphia Mas pou einai xekathara kai deikhnoun ten aletheia, ekeinoi pou den elpizoun ste sunantese Mas (oute te phobountai, oute pisteuoun sten anastase), lene: <<Phere allo ena Kor'an, anti gi' auto (pou katakrinei tous theous mas) e allaxe to (kanontas tis allages pou theloume mesa tou).>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Den epitrepetai gia mena na to allaxo apo monos mou. Pragmati, akoloutho mono o,ti mou apokaluptetai (apo ton Kurio mou). Pragmati, phobamai an parakouso ton Kurio mou, na me plexei to marturio mias megales Emeras.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<An ethele o Allakh, de tha to apeggeila (to Kor'an) se sas, oute tha sas ekane na mathate tipote gi' auto (to Kor'an). Emeina anamesa sas mia zoe (saranta khronia) prin ap' auto (to Kor'an na apokaluphthei, kai kata ta opoia khronia oute exera na grapho, oute na diabazo, oute me eidate na psakhno gi' auto to thema). Ma den sullogizeste (gia na katalabete oti auto pou sas ephera einai apo ton Allakh);>>
Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh e diapseudei ta Edaphia Tou; Pragmati, oi kakoi de tha epitukhoun pote.

Latreuoun (oi eidololatres), ektos tou Allakh, auta (ta eidola) pou den mporoun oute na tous blapsoun, oute na tous ophelesoun. Kai lene: <<Auta (ta eidola) einai oi mesolabetes mas enopion tou Allakh.>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Plerophoreite ton Allakh gia kati (skhetika me ta eidola sas) pou den to xerei oute stous ouranous, oute ste Ge; Doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (apo etairous ste latreia kai apo o,ti pseude mekhaneuontai).

Oi anthropoi den etan para mono ena ethnos (se mia threskeia, to Islam), epeita diakhoristekan (se pistous kai apistous, otan kapoioi epinoesan ten eidololatria). An den eikhe proegethei e apophase tou Kuriou sou (oti tha krinei anamesa tous sten Mellousa Zoe), tha eikhe krithei anamesa tous s' auta pou diaphonoun metaxu tous (del. tha eikhe katastrepsei o Allakh tous apistous kai tha eikhe sosei kai antameipsei tous pistous).

Lene (oi eidololatres): <<An tou stelnotan ena semadi apo ton Kurio tou (ap' auta pou zetesame, opos to na metatrepsei to lopho As-Sapha se khruso e na aphairesei ta bouna tes Makkas kai na kanei stis theseis tous kepous, gia na pistepsoume)!>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ta aorata anekoun mono ston Allakh (kai to na stalthoun ta Semadia einai kati apo ta aorata, kai mono Autos xerei an ta zetesate gia na pistepsete e apo alazoneia kai iskhurognomosune)! Perimenete loipon (na krinei o Allakh metaxu mas), ki ego perimeno mazi sas.>>

Otan dinoume stous anthropous (tous eidololatres) eleos (apo brokhe, ugeia kai euemeria) meta apo mia sumphora (apo leipsudria, arrostia kai kakoukhies) pou tous eplexe, arkhizoun meta na sunomotoun (me koroidia kai khleuasmo) enantia sta Edaphia Mas. Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Allakh einai pio Gregoros sto skhedio (na sas sernei stadiaka pros ten timoria pou tha pesei xaphnika pano sas ap' ekei pou den ten perimenete). Pragmati, Oi aggeloi Mas pou steilame (gia na katagrapsoun tis praxeis sas) katagraphoun o,ti sunomoteite.>>

Einai Autos pou sas dieukolune na taxidepsete ste steria kai ste thalassa. Ospou otan eiste sta ploia, ta opoia pleoun m' ekeinous (tous epibates) me enan eunoiko anemo, gia ton opoio (eunoiko anemo) kharekan (oi epibates), kai erkhetai xaphnika s' auta (ta ploia) enas thuellodes anemos, kai erkhontai s' autous (tous epibates) ta kumata apo oles tis pleures, kai nomizoun (oi epibates) oti ekhoun perikuklothei (kai oti den uparkhei diaphuge), tote epikalountai ton Allakh me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton kai mono, (legontas): <<An mas soseis ap' auto, sigoura tha eimaste anamesa stous eugnomones!>>

Ostoso, aphou tous esose, arkhizoun na skorpizoun ten adikia kai to kako (apo apistia kai amarties) ste ge. O, anthropoi! St' aletheia, e adikia (kai to kako) sas tha einai mono eis baros sas. Mia apolause sten egkosmia zoe, epeita se Mas tha einai e epistrophe sas kai tha sas plerophoresoume gia o,ti kanate.

Pragmati, to paradeigma tes egkosmias zoes (kai tou poso suntomes einai oi apolauseis tes) einai san auto tou nerou (tes brokhes) pou to stelnoume kato (ste ge) apo ton ourano* me to opoio (nero) phutrosan kai plekhtekan (logo puknotetas) ta phuta tes ges, apo ta opoia trephontai oi anthropoi kai ta zoa: eos otou e ge ntuthei me te diakosmese tes kai stolistei, kai oi anthropoi nomizoun pos ten kuriarkhoun apolutos, erkhetai s' aute (te ge) e Entole Mas, te nukhta e ten emera, kai ten kanoume entelos therismene san na men etan anthismene khthes! Etsi exegoume ta Semadia Mas leptomeros gia tous anthropous pou skeptontai.
O Allakh kalei (tous anthropous) pros ton Oiko tes Eirenes (kai tes asphaleias, ton Paradeiso) kai kathodegei opoion thelei (o Allakh) ston isio dromo.

Gi' ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo, tha uparkhei e kalutere antamoibe (o Paradeisos) kai parapano (ap' auten, oti tha koitazoun to Prosopo tou Kuriou tous). De tha kalupsei ta prosopa tous oute skone (e skotos), oute tapeinose. Autoi einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou diaprattoun kakes praxeis, e timoria mias kakes praxes isoutai me mia (kai okhi parapano), kai tha tous kalupsei e tapeinose. De tha ekhoun kanenan prostate pou na tous prostatepsei apo ton Allakh. Ta prosopa tous tha einai san na ekhoun ntuthei me to skotos mias skoteines nukhtas. Autoi einai oi katoikoi tes Photias, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.

Ten Emera pou tha tous sugkentrosoume olous mazi, epeita tha poume stous eidololatres: <<Meinete ekei pou eiste, eseis kai oi (legomenoi) etairoi sas (pou latreuate)!>> Ste sunekheia, tha tous khorisoume, kai oi etairoi (ta eidola) tous tha poun (aparnoumenoi ekeinous): <<De mas latreuate!

O Allakh arkei os Marturas anamesa se mas kai se sas oti den xerame tipote gia te latreia sas (pros emas, aphou den mporousame oute na doume, oute na akoume, oute na mathoume tipote gi' auta pou kanate)!>>

Tote, kathe psukhe tha dei (kai tha mathei) ti ekhei kanei (sten egkosmia zoe). Kai (oi eidololatres) tha epistrepsoun ston Allakh, ton Alethino tous Kedemona, kai tha exaphanistei ap' autous o,ti epinoesan apo psemata (oti ta eidola tous tha mesolabesoun gia logariasmo tous enopion tou Allakh).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Poios einai Autos pou sas parekhei apo ton ourano kai te ge; E, poios einai Autos pou katekhei ten akoe kai ten orase (sas); Kai poios einai Autos pou bgazei ton zontano apo ton nekro (opos ton anthropo apo to sperma kai to pouli apo to augo), kai bgazei ton nekro apo ton zontano (opos to sperma apo ton anthropo kai to augo apo to pouli); Kai poios einai Autos pou dieuthetei oles tis upotheseis;>> Tha poun: <<O Allakh.>> Pes: <<De tha phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou);>>
Autos einai o Allakh, o Alethinos Kurios sas. Ti allo uparkhei (gia sas) meta apo ten aletheia (an den te thelete), para mono e plane! Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo ten aletheia);
Etsi o Logos (to diatagma) tou Kuriou sou (o, Prophete) egine upokhreotikos enantion ekeinon pou parekklinan apo ten aletheia, oti de tha pistepsoun pote.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Mporei kanenas apo tous (legomenous) etairous (eidola) sas (pou latreuete) na arkhisei te demiourgia (khoris kanena proegoumeno paradeigma) kai epeita na ten epanapherei (meta apo to thanato tes);>> Pes: <<O Allakh arkhizei te demiourgia (khoris kanena proegoumeno paradeigma) kai epeita ten epanapherei (xana ste zoe ten Emera tes Kriseos)! Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo ten aletheia);>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Mporei kanenas apo tous (legomenous) etairous (eidola) sas (pou latreuete) na kathodegesei sten aletheia;>> Pes: <<O Allakh kathodegei sten aletheia.>> Einai Autos pou kathodegei sten aletheia pio Axios na akolouthethei, e ekeinos pou den (mporei na) kathodegethei (apo monos tou), ektos na ton kathodegesei (kapoios allos); Ti sumbainei loipon me sas, pos krinete (pseudos oti uparkhoun etairoi gia ton Allakh);

Den akolouthoun oi perissoteroi ap' autous (tous eidololatres) para mono eikasies (kai auta gia ta opoia den ekhoun gnose). Ostoso, oi eikasies den mporoun na antikatastesoun ten aletheia (kai te gnose) se tipote. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti kanoun.

Auto to Kor'an (o, eidololatres) de tha mporouse na ekhei epinoethei apo opoiodepote apo ta demiourgemata tou Allakh (opos iskhuristekate oti o Prophetes to epinoese e to emathe apo allon andra)! Alla einai (e apokalupse kai) e epibebaiose gi' auta (ten Tora kai to In-tzel -to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou) pou etan prin ap' auto, kai mia plere exegese tou Bibliou (oson graphtekan apo tous nomous, tis upokhreotikes praxeis kai tis apagoreuseis) - den uparkhei kamia amphibolia s' auto (to Kor'an) - (to opoio) apokaluphtheke apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.

E lene (oi eidololatres): <<To ekhei epinoesei (o Mokhammant kai iskhuristeke oti einai apo ton Allakh)>>; Pes: <<Tote pherte ena kephalaio (pou na to ekhete epinoesei) paromoio m' auto (to Kor'an) kai kaleste (gia boetheia) osous mporeite ektos tou Allakh, an eiste eilikrineis!>>

(Pragmati, de se diapseudoun, o, Mokhammant) alla diepseusan auto gia to opoio den ekhoun gnose (to Kor'an kai o,ti anapherei apo tis proeidopoieseis, ten anastase, ton Paradeiso kai te Photia klp.) kai den tous erthe akoma e pragmatopoiese tou (autou pou tous uposkhetheke o Allakh apo timoria). Omoios, diepseusan ekeinoi (apo ta proegoumena ethne) pou etan prin ap' autous. Koita loipon pos etan to telos ton adikon!

Kai ap' autous (tous eidololatres) uparkhoun ekeinoi pou tha pistepsoun s' auto (to Kor'an), eno kapoioi alloi ap' autous de tha pistepsoun s' auto (apo peisma kai alazoneia mekhri na pethanoun). Kai o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei kalutera ekeinous pou skorpizoun to kako (kai epimenoun sten apistia, kai tha tous timoresei gi' auten).

(O, Prophete) an se diapseusoun (oi eidololatres), pes: <<Ekho (te threskeia kai) tis praxeis mou (kai tha ekho tis sunepeies tous) kai eseis ekhete (te threskeia kai) tis praxeis sas (kai tha ekhete tis sunepeies tous)! Eseis (aparnetheite o,ti kano, kai) den ekhete euthune gia o,ti kano, kai ego (aparnoumai o,ti kanete, kai) den ekho euthune gia o,ti kanete).>>

Kai ap' autous (tous eidololatres) uparkhoun ekeinoi pou se akoun (o, Prophete, otan apaggelleis to Kor'an kai otan milas). Alla mporeis esu (o, Prophete) na kaneis tous kophous na akousoun, akoma kai an (pera apo oti den akoun) den katanooun;

Kai ap' autous (tous eidololatres) uparkhoun ekeinoi pou se koitoun (o, Prophete, kai blepoun tis apodeixeis sou). Alla mporeis esu (o, Prophete) na kathodegeseis tous tuphlous, akoma ki an de blepoun (ten aletheia);

Pragmati, o Allakh den adikei tous anthropous sto elakhisto, alla oi anthropoi einai oi idioi pou adikoun ton eauto tous (me to phanatismo tous gia ten plane, ten apistia, to psema, ten alazoneia kai to peisma).

Ten Emera (tes Kriseos) pou (o Allakh) tha tous sugkentrosei (tous anthropous), (tha aisthanontai) san na men ekhoun meinei (sten egkosmia zoe) para mono mia ora mias emeras, (kata ten opoia) gnoristekan metaxu tous. Pragmati, ekhasan ekeinoi pou diepseusan te sunantese tou Allakh, kai den etan kathodegemenoi.

Eite sou deixoume (o, Prophete) kati ap' auto pou tous uposkhethekame (apo ten timoria), eite aphairesoume te zoe sou (khoris na to deis auto), (stis duo periptoseis) se Mas einai e epistrophe tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos), kai o Allakh einai Marturas oson kanoun.

Gia kathe ethnos (apo ta proegoumena ethne) uperkhe enas Aggeliaphoros. Otan tha erthei o Aggeliaphoros tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos), tha krithei (e upothese) metaxu tous me dikaiosune kai de tha adikethoun.
(O, Mokhammant) kai lene (oi apistoi apo to lao sou): <<Pote tha ulopoiethei aute e uposkhese (gia ten timoria), an eiste (esu, o, Mokhammant kai oi opadoi sou) eilikrineis;>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Den einai ste duname mou oute na empodiso kapoio kako na mou sumbei, oute na phero gia ton eauto mou kapoio ophelos, ektos apo o,ti thelei o Allakh. Gia kathe ethnos uparkhei mia prokathorismene ora (thanatou). Otan erthei e ora tous, den mporoun oute na ten kathusteresoun oute mia stigme, oute na te pheroun noritera.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Blepete ean e timoria Tou erthei se sas te nukhta e ten emera (tha mporesete na ten empodisete);>> Ti biazontai oi kakoi ap' aute (ten timoria, aphou einai oi idioi pou tha katastraphoun);
Aphou sumbei (e timoria), tote tha pistepsete s' aute; Tora (pisteuete) eno prin biazosastan gi' aute (diapseudontas ten);
Epeita (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha eipothei stous adikous: <<Geuteite to aionio marturio! Tha labete os antapodose kati allo ektos ap' auta pou kanate (sten egkosmia zoe sas);>>

(Oi eidololatres) se rotoun (o, Mokhammant): <<Einai aletheia (to marturio pou mas uposkhethekes ste Mellousa Zoe);>> Pes: <<Ma ton Kurio mou! Nai, einai aletheia! Kai de tha mporeite na xephugete (apo ton Allakh an thelei na epibalei se sas auto to marturio).>>

An kathe psukhe pou adikese (diaprattontas apistia) kateikhe o,ti uparkhei ste Ge, tha to prosphere gia na lutrosei ton eauto tes (apo to marturio). Tha krupsoun (oi apistoi) tis tupseis tous otan tha doun to marturio. Tha krinei (o Allakh) metaxu tous me dikaiosune kai de tha adikethoun.
Pragmati, ston Allakh anekoun o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste Ge. Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh (gia to marturio ton apiston) einai alethine, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de gnorizoun.
Einai Autos pou dinei zoe kai ten aphairei, kai s' Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.

O, anthropoi! Pragmati, sas erthe (to Kor'an) apo ton Kurio sas (to opoio apotelei) nouthesia, therapeia gia o,ti uparkhei stis kardies (apo tis astheneies tes agnoias, tes amphibolias kai ton pothon), kathodegese kai eleos gia tous pistous.

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous anthropous): <<(Auto to Kor'an staltheke se sas) apo te khare tou Allakh kai to eleos Tou.>> As kharoun loipon m' auto. (Pragmati, to Kor'an) einai polu kalutero apo o,ti sussoreuoun (apo tis apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Peite mou gi' auta pou sas esteile o Allakh apo (epitrepta kai kala) agatha, apo ta opoia kapoia ta thesate os apagoreumena (gia sas kai ta orisate sta eidola sas), eno alla ta thesate os epitrepta (gia sas).>> Pes (tous): <<Einai o Allakh pou sas epetrepse (na kanate auta) e enantion tou Allakh epinoeite psemata;>>

Ti nomizoun ekeinoi, pou epinooun psemata enantion tou Allakh,oti tha tous sumbei ten Emera tes Kriseos; [Nomizoun oti tha sugkhorethoun; Pragmati, tha mpoun me te thelese tou Allakh sten Kolase]. Pragmati, o Allakh kanei polles khares stous anthropous (kai ap' autes einai oti den epispeudei na timoresei tous anupakouous sten egkosmia zoe, dinontas tous ten eukairia na straphoun me metameleia kai anaballontas ten krise gi' autous mekhri ten Emera tes Kriseos), ostoso oi perissoteroi ap' autous den einai eugnomones (gia tis khares Tou).

Kai den askholeisai (o, Prophete) me kanena thema (apo ta themata sou), oute apaggelleis apo to Kor'an, oute prattete (o, anthropoi) kamia praxe, para na eimaste Martures se sas otan ten kanete. Tipota den einai krupho apo ton Kurio sou oute kan to baros enos atomou (moriou e mikrou murmegkiou) ste Ge e ston ourano, oute tipota mikrotero e megalutero ap' auto. (Kai den uparkhei tipote apo ola auta) para na einai (grammeno) se ena xekatharo Biblio.

Pragmati, gia tous Aoulia' (eusebeis pistous) tou Allakh, de tha uparkhei phobos (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Oi opoioi einai autoi pou pisteuoun kai phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).
Gi' autous uparkhoun ta kharmosuna nea sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Den uparkhei allage sta Logia (e sten uposkhese) tou Allakh. Pragmati, aute einai e megale epitukhia.

Kai as me se stenakhoroun (o, Prophete) ta logia tous (ton eidololatron pou se diapseudoun). Pragmati, ole e duname anekei ston Allakh. Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Pragmati, ston Allakh anekei opoios brisketai stous ouranous kai opoios brisketai ste ge. Ti akolouthoun, loipon, ekeinoi pou epikalountai (tous legomenous) etairous ektos tou Allakh; Pragmati, den akolouthoun para mono ten eikasia, kai (auto pou kanoun) den einai para oti pseudontai.
Einai Autos pou ekane gia sas te nukhta gia na xekourasteite s' aute kai ten emera photeine. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gi' ekeinous pou akoun.

Lene: <<O Allakh apektese enan gio.>> [Oi eidololatres iskhuristekan oti oi aggeloi einai oi kores tou Allakh, kai oi Khristianoi iskhuristekan oti o Iesous einai o gios tou Allakh]. Doxa s' Auton! Einai o Al-Ganei (o Plousios, o Eleutheros apo kathe anagke). S' Auton anekoun o,ti brisketai stous ouranous kai o,ti brisketai ste Ge. Den ekhete kamia apodeixe gi' auto (pou iskhurizeste pseudos). Lete gia ton Allakh auta pou de gnorizete;
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, ekeinoi pou kataskeuazoun psemata enantion tou Allakh, de tha epitukhoun pote.>>
Mia (suntome) apolause sten egkosmia zoe, epeita se Mas tha einai e epistrophe tous, kai epeita tha tous kanoume na geutoun to austero marturio, epeide arnethekan ten piste.

Apaggelle tous (o, Prophete) ten istoria tou Noe, otan eipe ston lao tou: <<O, lae mou! An e paramone mou (anamesa sas) kai oti (sas) noutheto me ta Semadia tou Allakh, ekhoun ginei aphoreta gia sas (kai apophasisete na me skotosete e na me dioxete), tote ton Allakh empisteuomai. Apophasiste, loipon, o,ti skopeuete na kanete (se mena), kai kaleste tous etairous sas (tous pseutikous theous sas, gia boetheia an mporoun), epeita, as men einai to skhedio sas asaphes gia sas, kai ste sunekheia, ekteleste to enantion mou kai khoris na mou dosete anabole.

Ma an apomakruntheite (apo to kalesma mou, auto tha einai logo esas kai okhi emena, aphou) den ekho zetesei kamia amoibe apo sas. E antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Allakh kai ekho prostakhthei na eimai apo tous Mousoulmanous (del. ekeinous pou upotassontai ste Boulese tou Allakh).

Ekeinoi omos ton diepseusan, opote sosame ton idio kai autous pou etan mazi tou, sten Kiboto, kai tous kaname diadokhous (ton apiston, ste ge), kai pnixame ekeinous pou diepseudan ta Semadia Mas. Koita loipon pos etan to telos ekeinon pou proeidopoiethekan.

Epeita steilame meta ap' auton (ton Noe) Aggeliaphorous (ton Khount, ton Salikh, ton Abraam, ton Lot, ton Sou'aimp kai allous) stous laous tous, tous erthan me xekathara Semadia, alla de tha pisteuan s' auta (ta semadia) pou eikhan ede diapseusei prin (ta doun, logo tes epimones tous sto na diapseudoun tous Aggeliaphorous). Etsi sphragizoume tis kardies ton parabaton.

Epeita steilame meta ap' autous (tous Aggeliaphorous) ton Mouse kai ton Aaron me ta Semadia Mas ston Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou, alla (o Pharao kai oi arkhegoi) edeixan alazoneia kai etan kakoi anthropoi.
Otan tous erthe e aletheia apo Mas, eipan: <<Aute einai pragmati mia xekathare mageia!>>
O Mouses eipe: <<Lete gia ten aletheia aphou sas erthe <<Mageia einai aute;>>; Pragmati, oi magoi de tha epitukhoun pote.>>

Eipan (o Pharao kai oi arkhegoi): <<Mas erthes (o, Mouse) gia na mas apomakruneis ap' auto (to dogma kai te threskeia) pou brekame tous progonous mas na akolouthoun, kai gia na ekhete oi duo sas (esu kai o adelphos sou) kuriarkhia (kai doxa) ste ge; Pragmati, de tha pistepsoume pote se sas!>>
O Pharao eipe (stous boethous tou): <<Pherte mou kathe mago pou ekhei kale gnose.>>
Otan erthan oi magoi, o Mouses tous eipe: <<Rixte o,ti ekhete na rixete.>>

Etsi, otan erixan (ta skhoinia kai ta kontaria tous gia na kanoun te mageia tous), o Mouses eipe: <<O,ti kanate apo mageia, pragmati o Allakh tha to katastesei mataio. Pragmati, o Allakh den aphenei to ergo ekeinon pou skorpizoun to kako na epiteukhthei.
O Allakh edraionei (upsonei kai phaneronei) ten aletheia me ta Logia (ten entole kai ta Semadia) Tou, akoma ki an oi kakoi to misoun auto.>>

Kai den pistepsan ston Mouse apo to lao tou (Pharao), para mono kapoioi neoi (opos e gunaika tou Pharao -Asia mpinet Mouzakhim-, e uperetria pou khtenize ten kore tou Pharao, kai o andras tes kai alloi), para to phobo tous apo ton Pharao kai tous dikous tous arkhegous, oti mporei na tous apomakrunei (o Pharao) apo ten piste tous (me to basanismo). St' aletheia, o Pharao etan enas turannos ste ge kai etan enas apo tous parabates (sten apistia kai tis amarties).
O Mouses eipe: <<O, lae mou! An pisteuete pragmatika ston Allakh, tote empisteuteite Ton, an eiste pragmati Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Boulese tou Allakh).>>

Eipan: <<Ton Allakh empisteuomaste. [Kai epikalestekan ton Allakh legontas] Kurie mas! Me mas kaneis os dokimasia gia ton adiko lao (del. men tous kaneis na mas nikesoun kai etsi na nomizoun oti briskontai sten aletheia, kai etsi na auxethei e apistia tous, e na mas apotrepsoun apo te threskeia mas).
Kai sose mas me to eleos Sou apo ton apisto lao.>>

Empneusame ton Mouse kai ton aderpho tou oti: <<Parte gia ton lao sas (del. diataxte tous na paroun) oikous ste Misr (os kataphugio), kai kante tous oikous sas topous latreias (epeide phobaste apo ton Pharao kai den mporeite na proseukhetheite se demosious khorous latreias), kai teleite ten proseukhe kai doste ta kharmosuna nea stous pistous.>>

O Mouses eipe: <<Kurie mas! Pragmati, parakhoreses ston Pharao kai stous arkhegous tou laou tou stolidia kai plouto sten egkosmia zoe (alla den etan eugnomones)! Kurie mas! (Ta khresimopoiesan) gia na parastratesoun (tous anthropous) apo to dromo Sou. Kurie mas! Katestrepse ta ploute tous kai sklerune tis kardies tous, kai etsi na men pistepsoun mekhri na doun to odunero marturio.>>

(O Allakh) eipe (ston Mouse kai ston Aaron): <<E epiklese sas eisakousteke, kai etsi as eiste statheroi (ston isio dromo kai ste threskeia sas) kai men akoloutheite to dromo ekeinon pou de gnorizoun (to dromo tes aletheias).>>

Kaname ta paidia tou Israel na perasoun to nero (aphou diataxame ton Mouse na to khtupesei me to rabdi tou, kai etsi skhisteke se duo). Etsi, o Pharao kai oi stratiotes tou tous akolouthesan, apo adikia kai parabase, ospou otan pnigotan (o Pharao), eipe: <<Pisteuo oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, ston Opoio pisteuoun ta paidia tou Israel. Kai eimai enas apo tous Mousoulmanous (pou upotassontai ste Boulese tou Allakh).>>
(Eipotheke s' auton): <<Tora (pisteueis) eno parakouses (ton Allakh) prin (pesei se sena e timoria) kai esoun enas ap' ekeinous pou skorpizoun to kako;

Semera loipon tha sosoume to soma sou (apo to nero kai tha to baloume se mia upsele ge gia na se doun ta paidia tou Israel pou kapoioi ek ton opoion den pistepsan oti pethanes, kai), oste na gineis paradeigma gia osous erkhontai meta apo sena. Ostoso, polloi anthropoi gia ta Semadia Mas einai adiaphoroi.>>

Pragmati, kaname ta paidia tou Israel na egkatastathoun se mia kale ge kai tous pareikhame apo ta kala agatha. Kai de diepheran metaxu tous (skhetika me ton prophete pou perimenan ton erkhomo tou apo tous idious) para mono aphou tous erthe e gnose (oti stalthekes, o, Mokhammant, apo tous Arabes kai okhi apo ta paidia tou Israel). Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) tha krinei metaxu tous ten Emera tes Kriseos gi' auto sto opoio diaphonousan.

An ekheis amphibolia (o, Prophete) gi' auto pou sou steilame (oti ta paidia tou Israel eikhan omophonia gia ton erkhomo sou kai tis perigraphes sou), tote rota autous (tous eilikrineis rabinous apo tous Ebraious kai tous Khristianous, opos ton rabino Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai tous suntrophous tou pou aspastekan to Islam) pou diabasan to Biblio prin apo sena (kai exeran tis perigraphes sou sten Tora kai to In-tzel -to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou-). [Ta logia edo de semainoun oti o Prophetes eikhe amphibolia, alla einai arabike ekphrase, opos otan leei enas sto paidi tou oti an einai pragmatika paidi tou tha perasei tis exetaseis! Kai auta ta logia apeuthunontai stous pistous, stous apistous kai se opoion mporei na ekhei amphibolia, os epibebaiose kai apodeixe oti oi perigraphes tou Prophete uparkhoun sta proegoumena Theia Biblia. Epises, anaphertheke se ena Khantith oti o Prophetes eipe: <<Pragmati, oute amphiballo, oute rotao.>>]. Pragmati, sou erthe e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, gi' auto men eisai pote ap' ekeinous pou amphiballoun.
Kai men eisai (o, Prophete) ap' ekeinous pou diapseusoun ta Semadia tou Allakh, kai etsi na eisai anamesa stous khamenous.
Pragmati, ekeinoi stous opoious ekhei ginei upokhreotikos o Logos (to diatagma kai e katara) tou Kuriou sou (o, Prophete), de tha pistepsoun pote,
akoma ki an tous erkhotan kathe Semadi, mekhri na doun to odunero marturio.

Kamia (apiste) komopole pou pistepse (aphou eikhe dei ten timoria), den ten ophelese e piste tes, para mono (e komopole) tou laou tou Iona! (Otan ephuge o Ionas, katalaban oi anthropoi oti e timoria plesiazei, kai etsi straphekan me alethine metameleia gia saranta meres, etsi) otan pistepsan (alethina), aphairesame apo pano tous ten timoria tes atimoses sten egkosmia zoe kai tous pareikhame agatha gia kapoio khroniko diastema (mekhri na pethanoun).

An ethele o Kurios sou, tha eikhan pistepsei osoi einai ste ge, oloi mazi! Tha anagkaseis loipon (o, Prophete) tous anthropous na ginoun pistoi; (Den mporeis na to kaneis, oso kai an eisai prothumos na kathodegeseis tous anthropous, aphou mono o Allakh pou kathodegei opoious thelei).
Kamia psukhe de tha pistepsei para mono me to thelema tou Allakh, kai (o Allakh) stelnei ten timoria s' ekeinous pou de sullogizontai (ta Semadia, tis apodeixeis kai tis entoles Tou).

Pes (o, Prophete stous eidololatres): <<Koitaxte ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste ge (apo ta Semadia tou Allakh)!>> Alla ta Semadia kai oi proeidopoieseis den opheloun ekeinous pou den pisteuoun (pou epimenoun sten apistia, ten alazoneia kai ten iskhurognomosune tous).

Perimenoun (oi eidololatres kati allo) para mono (mia emera opou tha pesei e timoria pano tous) opos ekeines tis emeres (tes timorias) ekeinon (pou arnethekan ten piste apo ta proegoumena ethne) pou erthan prin ap' autous; Pes (o, Prophete): <<Tote perimenete (ten timoria sas), pragmati, perimeno ki ego mazi sas (auto pou sas uposkhetheke o Allakh).>>

Epeita (aphou steilame ten timoria sta proegoumena ethne) sosame tous Aggeliaphorous Mas kai tous pistous. Etsi (opos tous sosame, tha sosoume esena, o, Mokhammant, kai tous pistous), einai mia desmeuse (pou te grapsame) se Mas (kai ten analabame), na sosoume tous pistous.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O, anthropoi (eidololatres)! An ekhete amphibolia gia te threskeia mou (sten opoia sas kalo), tote (as xerete oti) ego de latreuo ekeinous pou latreuete ektos tou Allakh (apo eidola, ta opoia den mporoun oute na akoun, oute na blepoun, oute na miloun. Pos loipon na ekhete amphibolia ste threskeia mou, anti ste threskeia sas;)! Alla latreuo ton Allakh, pou sas aphairei te zoe, kai ekho diatakhthei na eimai enas apo tous pistous!

Kai (ekho diatakhthei epises) oti: <<Kai na eisai statheros ste threskeia (to Islam) apoklinontas apo ola ta mataia dogmata kai teinontas mono pros ten alethine threskeia, kai men eisai apo ekeinous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.
Kai men epikalesteis ektos tou Allakh otidepote pou den mporei oute na se ophelesei, oute na se blapsei, giati an to kaneis, tha eisai tote enas apo tous adikous.>>.>>

Ean o Allakh se plettei (o, Prophete) me mia sumphora, kaneis den mporei na ten aphairesei para monon Autos. Kai an thelei kati kalo gia sena, kaneis den mporei na empodisei te gennaiodoria Tou. To parakhorei (to kalo e te sumphora) se opoion thelei apo tous doulous Tou. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O, anthropoi! Pragmati, erthe se sas e aletheia (to Kor'an) apo ton Kurio sas. Opoios loipon kathodegeitai (kai pisteuei), to ophelos tes kathodegeses tou einai mono gia ton eauto tou, kai opoios parastratesei, tha einai eis baros tou. Den eimai kedemonas se sas (alla eimai mono enas proeidopoietes).>>

Akolouthese (o, Prophete) o,ti sou apokaluptetai (apo ton Kurio sou) kai kane upomone (gia o,ti se blaptoun) mekhri na krinei o Allakh (uposterizontas esena me nike enantion tous). Pragmati, Autos einai o Kaluteros apo tous krites.

A, L, R (Aliph-Lam-Ra', tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio). Auto einai ena Biblio tou opoiou Edaphia einai teleia (apallagmena apo kathe elattoma e elleipse), kai ste sunekheia exegountai leptomeros, ap' Auton pou einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

(To opoio Biblio staltheke ston Mokhammant, o opoios sas diatazei) oti: <<Me latreuete para mono ton Allakh. Pragmati, eimai apestalmenos se sas ap' Auton, os enas proeidopoietes kai enas Aggeliaphoros kharmosunon eideseon.

Kai na zetesete te sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas, kai epeita na strapheite pros Auton me metameleia (kai upakoe), oste na sas parekhei kala agatha (kai kale zoe) mekhri ena orismeno khrono (otan pethanete), kai na dosei se kathe enan pou prattei to kalo ten antamoibe gia to kalo pou ekane. Alla an apomakruntheite, pragmati, phobamai gia sas to marturio mias megales Emeras (tes Kriseos).
Ston Allakh tha einai e epistrophe sas, kai Autos einai gia ta panta Ikanos.>>

Pragmati, (oi eidololatres kai oi upokrites) gernoun ta stethe tous mprosta (otan miloun metaxu tous e kanoun kati) gia na kruphtoun ap' Auton (nomizontas etsi oti kruboun o,ti uparkhei stis kardies tous). Pragmati, akoma kai otan kaluptontai me ta roukha tous, Autos xerei o,ti kruboun kai o,ti phaneronoun. Pragmati, Autos einai o Pantognostes gia osa uparkhoun stis kardies.

Den uparkhei kanena kinoumeno plasma ste ge, ektos o Allakh na tou parekhei ten pronoia tou, kai na gnorizei ton topo katoikias tou (ste ge) kai ton topo thanatou tou. Ola einai (grammena) se ena xekatharo Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).

Einai Autos pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge se exi emeres, kai o Thronos Tou etan (prin te demourgia tous) pano sto nero, (tous demiourgese) gia na sas dokimasei, poios apo sas tha einai o kaluteros stis praxeis (tou). Alla an peis (o, Prophete, stous anthropous): <<Pragmati, tha anastetheite meta thanaton.>>, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste tha poun: <<Auto den einai para xekathare mageia!>>

An kathusterousame ten timoria tous gia ena prokathorismeno khrono, tha elegan (khleuazontas): <<Ti ten empodizei (ten timoria);>> Pragmati, ten emera pou tha tous erthei, de tha apotrapei ap' autous. Kai tha tous perikuklosei (kai tha pesei pano tous) auto pou khleuazan.
An diname ston anthropo apo to eleos Mas (kai tis khares Mas), kai epeita tou to aphairousame, tote ginotan apelpismenos kai akharistos.

Kai an tou diname mia eulogia meta apo mia sumphora pou ton eplexe, tha elege: <<Ephugan ta deina mou.>> (khoris omos na einai eugnomon pros ton Allakh). Pragmati, khairetai kai kaukhietai (me alazoneia kai akharistia).

Ektos ap' ekeinous pou upemeinan kartarika (stis kakoukhies kai latrepsan ton Allakh) kai kanoun kales praxeis (kai deikhnoun eugnomosune stis khares Tou), autoi tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai megale antamoibe.

Tha aphenes, loipon, (o, Prophete) meros ap' auto pou apokaluptetai se sena kai tha steneue to stethos sou na to metadoseis epeide lene (oi eidololatres): <<Giati den tou staltheke enas thesauros (gia na xodepsei ap' auton) e den erkhotan mazi tou enas Aggelos (gia na epibebaiosei ten apostole tou);>>! (Bebaia de tha to ekanes, gi' auto as me se thlibei o,ti lene, kai metadose o,ti sou apokaluptei o Allakh) pragmati, eisai mono enas proeidopoietes, kai o Allakh einai o Diakheiristes ton panton.

E lene (oi eidololatres): <<To ekhei epinoesei (to Kor'an)>>! Pes: <<Tote pherte deka kephalaia epinoemena kai paromoia m' auto, kai kaleste gia boetheia opoion mporeite ektos tou Allakh, an eiste eilikrineis!>>

Alla an den antapokrinontai se sas (o, pistoi, kai de pheroun auto pou zetesate, epeide einai adunato na to kanoun), as xerete oti (to Kor'an) ekhei apokaluphthei me te gnose tou Allakh (kai den einai epinoemeno), kai oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Tha eiste loipon (meta ap' aute te megale apodeixe) Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste Boulese tou Allakh);

Opoios anazeta (me tis kales praxeis tou) ten egkosmia zoe kai ta stolidia tes (apo pheme, khremata e exousia klp.), (se tetoious anthropous) tha tous antapodosoume pleros gia tis praxeis tous s' aute (te zoe, me agatha, ugeia, ploute klp.), kai tipota (apo ten amoibe tous) de tha meiothei gi' autous s' auten (te zoe).
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou de tha ekhoun ste Mellousa Zoe para mono te Photia. Katargethekan oi amoibes gia osa ekanan s' ekeine (ten egkosmia zoe), kai o,ti ekanan etan mataio.

Einai ekeinos (o Mokhammant kai oi pistoi mazi tou, isoi me tous apistous, parolo) pou ekhei xekathare apodeixe (to Kor'an) apo ton Kurio tou, kai to apaggelei (to Kor'an) enas marturas (o Gabriel) pou staltheke ap' Auton (ton Allakh), kai prin ap' auto (ton erkhomo tou Mokhammant, uperkhe) to Biblio tou Mouse (e Tora pou epibebaionei ten apostole tou Mokhammant), to opoio (e Tora) etan odegos kai eleos; Ekeinoi (oi pistoi) pisteuoun s' auto (to Kor'an). Opoios omos apo tis omades (apo tous opadous kathe threskeias ste Ge) den pisteuei s' auto, e Photia tha einai to uposkhomeno telos tous. Men ekheis loipon kamia amphibolia gi' auto, pragmati, einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi den pisteuoun.

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou epinoei psemata enantion tou Allakh (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia e iskhurizetai oti o Allakh apektese enan gio); Ekeinoi (pou kanoun auto) tha parousiastoun enopion tou Kuriou tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos gia na tous dikasei). Tote tha poun oi martures (apo tous Aggelous, tous Aggeliaphorous kai ta akra tou somatos tous): <<Autoi einai pou epinoesan psemata enantion tou Kuriou tous.>> As pesei e katara tou Allakh stous adikous.

Oi opoioi (adikoi) einai ekeinoi pou empodizoun (tous anthropous) apo ton dromo (tes threskeias) tou Allakh, kai theloun na ginei (autos o dromos) strabos (oste na men ton akolouthesei kaneis), kai den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe.

Ekeinoi de tha mporoun na xephugoun ste ge (apo ten timoria tou Allakh), oute tha ekhoun kanenan prostate (e uposterikte) ektos tou Allakh. E timoria tous tha diplasiastei. Pragmati, oute mporousan na akousoun (ten aletheia kai ten kathodegese sten egkosmia zoe), oute eblepan (ta Semadia tou Allakh sto sumpan logo tes phanatikes arneses tous gia ten aletheia).
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou ekhasan ton eauto tous (katastrephontas ton ste Photia) kai tous egkateleipse o,ti epinoesan (kai o,ti apedidan apo etairous ston Allakh ste latreia).
Pragmati, ekeinoi tha einai oi pio khamenoi ste Mellousa Zoe!
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pisteuoun, kanoun kales praxeis kai upotassontai ste Boulese tou Kuriou tous, tha einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.
To paradeigma ton duo omadon (apiston kai piston) einai san ekeino: tou tuphlou kai kophou, kai autou pou blepei kai akouei. Einai isoi; De tha to labete upopse loipon;
Pragmati, steilame ton Noe ston lao tou. (Eipe o Noe:) <<St' aletheia, eimai gia sas enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia,
na men latreuete kanenan ektos apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, phobamai gia sas ten timoria mias epodunes Emeras.>>

Omos oi arkhegoi pou arnethekan ten piste apo ton lao tou, eipan: <<De se blepoume (o, Noe) para mono os enan anthropo san emas, kai de se blepoume na se akolouthoun para mono ekeinoi pou einai oi katoteroi anamesa mas, opos nomizoume. De blepoume na ekhete (esu kai oi opadoi sou) kamia uperokhe apenanti mas, alla pragmati nomizoume oti eiste pseutes.>>

Eipe (o Noe): <<O, lae mou! Blepete, pos an ekho mia xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio mou (pou epibebaionei ten eilikrineia mou), kai mou edose eleos (kai kathodegese kai apostole) ap' Auton, alla sas einai aorate (logo tes agnoias sas), tha prepei na sas anagkasoume na pistepsete s' aute parolo pou te miseite; [Okhi den mporoume, aphou mono o Allakh pou kathodegei opoious thelei sten piste].

O, lae mou! De sas zeto khremata gi' auto (pou sas metadido apo ton Kurio mou). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Allakh. Kai de tha dioxo (makria mou) autous (tous phtokhous) pou pisteuoun (kai pou zetesate na tous dioxo). Pragmati, tha sunantesoun ton Kurio tous, alla sas blepo os enan lao pou ekhei agnoia.
O, lae mou! Poios tha me prostateue apo ton Allakh, an tous ediokhna; De tha labete nouthesia loipon;

De sas leo oti ekho ta thesaurophulakia tou Allakh (gia na sas doso ap' auta an pistepsete), oute xero ta aorata, oute leo oti eimai enas aggelos, oute leo gi' ekeinous (tous phtokhous pistous) pou ta matia sas tous periphronoun, oti de tha tous dosei o Allakh kalo (apo piste kai antamoibe). Pragmati, o Allakh xerei kalutera o,ti uparkhei mesa tous. Pragmati, (an kano kati tetoio) tote tha eimai enas apo tous adikous.>>
Eipan (oi apistoi alazonika): <<O, Noe! Suzetouses mazi mas kai diaphonouses polu mazi mas, opote phere mas auto pou mas uposkhethekes (apo ten timoria), an eisai apo tous eilikrineis!>>
Eipe (o Noe): <<Einai o Allakh pou tha sas to pherei, an thelei, kai den mporeite na xephugete (apo ten timoria tou Allakh).
Kai de tha sas ophelesei e sumboule mou, -an thelo na sas sumboulepso-, an o Allakh thelei na sas parastratesei apo ton isio dromo. Einai o Kurios sas kai s' Auton tha epistrepsete.>>

E lene (o, Mokhammant, oi eidololatres apo ton lao sou): <<To ekhei epinoesei (o Mokhammant auto to Kor'an kai ten istoria tou Noe kai iskhuristeke oti einai apo ton Allakh)>>; Pes: <<Ean to eikha epinoesei, tote tha phero ten amartia mou (gi' auto), kai ego de phero o,ti diaprattete apo amarties (kai o,ti epinoesete enantion tou Allakh, alla tis aparnoumai)!>>
Apokaluphtheke ston Noe oti: <<De tha pistepsoun apo ton lao sou, para mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun ede pistepsei. Me stenakhoriesai loipon gia o,ti ekanan (oi apistoi apo diapseuse kai khleuasmo).

Kai na kataskeuaseis ten Kiboto me ten epiblepse Mas kai ten empneuse Mas (oste na xereis pos na ten kataskeuaseis) kai me Mou milas skhetika m' ekeinous pou adikesan (oute na Me epikalesteis na tous sugkhoreso), pragmati, tha pnigoun.>>

Arkhise (o Noe) na kataskeuazei ten Kiboto kai opote pernousan apo dipla tou kapoioi arkhegoi tou laou tou, ton khleuazan (epeide den uperkhe ekei oute thalassa, oute potamia). Eipe: <<An mas khleuazete tora, suntoma tha sas khleuazoume kai emeis (otan tha pnigeite) opos eseis mas khleuazete.
Tha mathete se poion tha erthei mia timoria pou tha ton atimasei (sten egkosmia zoe) kai tha pesei pano tou ena aionio marturio (ste Mellousa Zoe).>>

Otan erthe e entole Mas kai to nero anabluse apo ton phourno (san enan pidaka apo te ge, os semadi gia ton Noe oti e plemmura xekinaei), eipame: <<Bale s' aute (ten Kiboto) ena zeugari, arseniko kai theluko, apo kathe eidos (zoou) kai ten oikogeneia sou, ektos ap' autous gia tous opoious ekhei ede apophasistei (oti tha pnigoun), kai (bale kai) autous pou pisteuoun.>> Kai den pistepsan s' auton para mono ligoi.
(O Noe) eipe: <<Mpeite mesa tes. Sto onoma tou Allakh e pleuse tes kai to agkurobolio tes. Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>

Kai aute (e Kiboto) eplee m' autous (tous pistous) mesa apo kumata san ta bouna, kai o Noe phonaxe ston (apisto) gio tou, o opoios apomonotheke se ena meros (makria apo ton patera tou kai ton lao tou): <<Gie mou! Mpes mazi mas kai men eisai mazi me tous apistous.>>

Eipe (o gios tou): <<Tha kataphugo se ena bouno pou na me prostatepsei apo to nero.>> (O Noe) eipe: <<Semera den uparkhei tipote pou na prostatepsei apo ten entole tou Allakh (oti tha pnigoun oi apistoi) ektos apo opoion tha ton eleesei.>> Tote tous khorisan ta kumata, kai etan enas ap' ekeinous pou pnigekan.

Kai eipotheke: <<O, Ge! Katapie to nero sou. O, ourane! Stamata (te brokhe sou)!>> To nero upokhorese (kai e steria stegnose) kai e entole ekplerotheke (kai oi apistoi katastraphekan). Kai (e Kibotos) egkatastatheke sto (oros) Al-Tzounti, kai eipotheke: <<As apomakrunthei (apo to eleos tou Allakh kai as katastraphei) o adikos laos!>>

O Noe phonaxe ton Kurio tou, legontas: <<Kurie mou! O gios mou einai enas apo ten oikogeneia mou (kai mou uposkhethekes na soseis ten oikogeneia mou), kai e uposkhese Sou einai alethine kai Esu eisai o Dikaioteros (kai o Sophoteros) ton kriton!>>

(O Allakh) eipe: <<O, Noe! Autos den einai apo ten oikogeneia sou (kai sou eikha pei na baleis sten Kiboto ten oikogeneia sou ektos ap' ekeinous pou ekhei ede apophasistei na pnigoun). Einai me enareto ergo (auto pou diepratte o gios sou apo apistia, kai den einai enareto ergo to na zeteseis sugkhorese gia enan apisto), opote me Mou zetas kati gia to opoio den ekheis gnose. Pragmati, se noutheto, gia na men eisai apo tous adaeis.>>
(O Noe) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Anazeto kataphugio s' Esena apo to na Sou zeteso kati gia to opoio den ekho gnose. An de me sugkhoreseis kai de me eleeseis, tha eimai sigoura enas apo tous khamenous.>>

Eipotheke: <<O, Noe! Kateba (apo ten Kiboto) me eirene apo Mas, kai me eulogies se sena kai se merika ethne (apogonous pou tha pistepsoun kai tha erthoun) ap' autous pou einai mazi sou. Oso gia ta alla ethne (pou tha arnethoun ten piste), tha tous parekhoume agatha (kai tha tous aphesoume sten apolause tes egkosmias zoes gia ligo), kai epeita tha tous plexei ena odunero marturio apo Mas.>>

Autes einai merikes apo tis eideseis tou aoratou pou sou apokaluptoume (o, Mokhammant). Tis opoies den tis gnorizes oute esu, oute o laos sou prin ap' aute (ten apokalupse). Etsi, na eisai upomonetikos. Pragmati, e nike sto telos tha einai gi' ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Kai ste (phule) 'Ant steilame ton adelpho tous, Khount. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Pragmati, den eiste (se o,ti apodidete apo etairous ston Allakh ste latreia) para mono pseutes.
O, lae mou! De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono ap' Auton pou me demiourgese. Ma de sullogizeste;

O, lae mou! Zeteste sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas kai epeita strapheite me alethine metameleia pros Auton, oste na steilei epano sas apo ton ourano aphthone brokhe kai na sas dosei duname pano apo te duname sas. Men apomakruneste loipon (ap' auto pou sas kalo) os kakoi (apistoi).>>
Eipan: <<O, Khount! De mas epheres kamia xekathare apodeixe, kai de tha egkataleipsoume tous theous mas exaitias tou logou sou, oute tha pistepsoume se sena.

De leme para mono oti kapoioi theoi mas se eplexan me kapoio kako (kai trela exaitias tou logou sou enantion tous).>> Eipe (o Khount): <<Pragmati, kalo ton Allakh os Martura, kai gineste ki eseis martures, oti aparnoumai otidepote latreuete (apo eidola kai pseutikous theous klp.),
peran tou Allakh. Sunomoteiste, loipon, enantion mou oloi mazi, kai me mou dosete kamia anabole.

Pragmati, empisteuomai ton Allakh, ton Kurio mou kai ton Kurio sas. Den uparkhei kanena kinoumeno (zontano) plasma pou na men to kuriarkhei Autos (o Allakh, kai na dieuthetei ola ta themata tou). Pragmati, o dromos tou Kuriou mou einai o isios dromos.

Alla an apomakruntheite, pragmati ekho metapherei se sas auta me ta opoia staltheka se sas, kai o Kurios mou (tha sas katastrepsei kai) tha pherei allous anthropous anti esas os diadokhous sas kai den mporeite na Ton blapsete se tipote. Pragmati, o Kurios mou parakolouthei ta panta (kai tha me prostatepsei apo to kako sas).>>
Otan erthe e entole Mas, sosame ton Khount kai osous pistepsan mazi tou me to eleos Mas, kai tous sosame apo mia sklere timoria (pou steilame ston lao tou).

Aute etan e (phule) 'Ant pou (oi anthropoi tes) arnethekan ta Semadia tou Kuriou tous, parakousan tous Aggeliaphorous Tou kai akolouthesan ten entole kathe adikou peismatare (pou einai alazonikos enantia sten aletheia).

Kai akolouthethekan me mia katara s' auton ton kosmo kai ten Emera tes Kriseos. Pragmati, oi anthropoi apo te phule 'Ant arnethekan ton Kurio tous, as apomakrunthei (apo to eleos tou Allakh kai as katastraphei) e 'Ant, o laos tou Khount!

Kai stous (anthropous tes phules) Thamount steilame ton adelpho tous, Salikh. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Na latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Einai Autos pou sas demiourgese apo te ge kai sas egkatestese ekei. Zeteste, loipon te sugkhorese Tou kai epeita strapheite me metameleia pros Auton. Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai konta (se opoion Ton latreuei me aphosiose) kai apanta stis epikleseis (autou pou Ton epikaleitai).>>

Eipan: <<O, Salikh! Eikhame elpides se sena (na ekheis upsele these anamesa mas) prin ap' auto (pou eipes). Mas apagoreueis na latreuoume auta pou latreuan oi pateres mas; Ekhoume amphibolia gi' auto pou mas kaleis, e opoia egeirei ten kategoria (enantion sou oti les psemata).>>

Eipe (o Salikh): <<O, lae mou! Peite mou an ekho mia xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio mou, kai mou ekhei kharisei eleos (kai apostole) ap' Auton, poios tha mporouse na me prostateusei apo ton Allakh, an Ton parakouso (kai de sas kalo sto na latreuete mono Auton); Pragmati, (an to kano) de tha me auxesete para mono se apoleia.

O, lae mou! Aute einai mia kamela pou sas esteile o Allakh os Semadi gia sas. Apheste ten loipon na boskesei ste ge tou Allakh kai men ten aggixete me kako, gia na men pesei se sas ena marturio suntoma.>>

Alla ten esphaxan kai etsi (o Salikh) eipe: <<Na khareite (te zoe sas) ste ge sas gia treis meres (epeita tha pesei se sas e timoria tou Allakh). Aute einai mia uposkhese pou den einai pseudes (alla tha pragmatopoiethei oposdepote)!>>

Otan erthe e entole Mas, sosame ton Salikh kai ekeinous pou pistepsan mazi tou, me to eleos Mas kai apo ten atimose ekeines tes emeras. Pragmati, o Kurios sou einai o Al-Kaouei (Paniskhuros), o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).
Etsi, katestrepse e megale krauge ekeinous pou adikesan kai etsi epesan nekroi ste ge tous me ta prosopa kai ta gonata tous.
San na men eikhan katoikesei ekei pote. Pragmati, oi anthropoi apo te phule Thamount arnethekan ten piste ston Kurio tous, as apomakrunthei (apo to eleos tou Allakh kai as katastraphei) e Thamount.

Oi (Aggeloi) Aggeliaphoroi Mas erthan ston Abraam (me anthropine morphe) me kharmosuna nea (gia enan gio, ton Isaak, kai enan eggono, ton Iakob). Eipan: <<Salam (Eirene).>> Eipe: <<Salam.>> Kai suntoma ephere ena pseto moskharaki (nomizontas oti etan anthropoi).

Otan eide (o Abraam) oti (den etrogan kai) ta kheria tous den pegainan pros auto (to phageto), breke ten apokhe tous (apo to phageto) os kati katakriteo (epeide den exere oti einai Aggeloi kai gi' auto tous upopsiasteke oti theloun na tou kanoun kako kai etsi tous rotese: <<Den trote;>>) kai eniose phobo mesa tou ap' autous. Eipan: <<Me phobasai. Ekhoume stalei ston lao tou Lot (gia ten timoria tous).>>

E suzugos tou (e Sara) stekotan (piso apo to peplo gia na tous uperetesei kai akouse ta logia tous) kai gelase (otan akouse oti o adikos laos tou Lot tha katastraphei khoris na xerei gi' auto), kai etsi tes dosame ta kharmosuna nea gia ton Isaak kai meta apo ton Isaak, ton Iakob (ton gio tou Isaak).
Eipe (e Sara): <<Alimono mou! Pos tha ekho ena paidi eno eimai elikiomene, ki o antras mou einai elikiomenos; Pragmati, auto einai periergo pragma!>>

Eipan (oi Aggeloi): <<Eisai ekplekte me to diatagma tou Allakh; Eithe to eleos kai oi eulogies tou Allakh na einai pano sas, o, oikogeneia tou oikou (tou Abraam). Pragmati, Autos einai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou) kai Matzeint (Endoxos).>>

Otan o phobos ephuge apo ton Abraam kai tou erthan ta kharmosuna nea (gia ton Isaak kai ton Iakob), arkhise na suzetaei me tous Aggelous Mas skhetika me ton lao tou Lot (anesukhontas gia ton Prophete Lot, alla oi Aggeloi tou apantesan oti tha ton sosoun).
Pragmati, o Abraam etan makrothumos (gia osous ton adikesan), ekane epikleseis polu sukhna (pros ton Allakh me tapeinoteta), kai epestrephe sunekhos me metameleia pros ton Allakh.

(Oi Aggeloi eipan): <<O, Abraam! Aphese to auto (to thema kai te suzetese gia ten timoria tou laou tou Lot), giati pragmati e entole tou Kuriou sou ekhei ede erthei, kai tha tous erthei mia timoria pou de tha apotrapei (oute me suzetese, oute me epikleseis).>>

Otan oi (Aggeloi) Aggeliophoroi Mas erthan ston Lot (os xenoi episkeptes kai me anthropine morphe), ekeinos (den exere oti einai Aggeloi kai phobotan gi' autous apo ton lao tou pou etan omophulophiloi kai) aisthantheke askhema gia ton erkhomo tous kai to stethos tou stenepse apo ten anesukhia tou gi' autous, kai eipe: <<Aute einai mia duskole emera.>>

Oi anthropoi tou laou tou (Lot, aphou emathan apo te gunaika tou Lot gia tous episkeptes kai poso omorphoi einai), erthan s' auton speudontas (gia na kanoun me tous episkeptes mia aiskhre praxe) kai prin ap' auto eikhan ede sunethisei na kanoun tis kakes praxeis (ten omophulophilia metaxu ton andron). Eipe (o Lot): <<O, lae mou! Na tes oi kores mou (del. oi gunaikes tes phules gia na tis pantreuteite) einai pio agnes gia sas (apo tous andres kai apo tous episkeptes mou). Phulakhtheite loipon apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai me me atimasete skhetika me tous kalesmenous mou. Den uparkhei anamesa sas kanenas logikos antras;>>
Eipan: <<Ksereis ede oti den ekhoume anagke tis kores sou (tis gunaikes tes phules) kai pragmati xereis ti theloume!>>
Eipe: <<Makari na eikha duname (kai uposteriktes) gia na sas stamateso e na mporousa na kataphugo (kai na basisto) se mia dunate uposterixe (phule gia na me prostatepsei kai na sas stamateso)!>>

(Epeita oi Aggeloi tou) eipan: <<O, Lot! Pragmati, eimaste oi Aggeliaphoroi tou Kuriou sou. Den mporoun na se phtasoun. Bges loipon me ten oikogeneia sou se mia skoteine ora tes nukhtas kai kanenas apo sas den prepei na koitaxei piso. (Pare ten oikogeneia sou) ektos apo te gunaika sou, pragmati, tha ten plexei aute (e timoria) pou tha plexei kai tous allous. E kathorismene ora tous einai to proi. Den einai konta to proi;>>

Otan erthe e entole Mas (ten ora pou orisame gia ten katastrophe tous, anapodogurisame ten komopole tous kai) kaname ta psela mere tes, na einai ta kato mere tes kai rixame pano tous petres apo sklero psemeno pelo, diadokhika se seires, e mia meta apo ten alle.
(Oi opoies petres) markarismenes enopion tou Kuriou sou (o, Mokhammant), kai den einai makria apo tous adikous (eidololatres apo ton lao sou, an de tha straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh).

Kai stous anthropous tes phules Madiam steilame ton adelpho tous, Sou'aimp. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Na latreuete ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para mono Auton. Kai me meionete (kai me peirazete) te monada metreses kai zugises (stis sunallages sas exapatontas tous allous). Sas blepo se euemeria (gi' auto men allaxete te khare tou Allakh se sas meso ton amartion), pragmati, phobamai gia sas to marturio mias Emeras pou perikuklonei (tous adikous).
O, lae mou! Ekpleroste ten monada metreses kai zugises (stis sunallages sas), men meionete tipote apo ta pragmata (kai ta dikaiomata) ton anthropon kai me skorpizete to kako ste ge.

O,ti apomenei (gia sas apo epitrepto kerdos) apo ten pronoia tou Allakh einai kalutero gia sas (apo opoiodepote apagoreumeno kerdos apo exapatese), an eiste (alethina) pistoi. Den eimai phulakas pano sas (gia na metreso tis praxeis sas).>>

Eipan: <<O, Sou'aimp! H proseukhe sou se diatazei na egkataleipsoume o,ti latreuan oi progonoi mas (apo eidola) e na me diakheirizomaste ta ploute mas opos theloume (me to na kerdisoume me exapatese); [Sunekhisan khleuazontas ton] pragmati, eisai makrothumos kai logikos anthropos (eno etsi emeis kai oi progonoi mas eimaste oi anoetoi)!>>

Eipe (o Sou'aimp): <<O, lae mou! Blepete, ean ekho mia xekathare apodeixe apo ton Kurio mou (pou epibebaionei ten eilikrineia mou), kai mou parekhei kala agatha ap' Auton (khoris na exapateso kanenan), (pos tha einai loipon e katastase sas an arneiste to kalesma mou;)! Kai de thelo na diapratto o,ti sas apagoreuo, (oute thelo kapoia prosopika sumpheronta) alla auto pou thelo einai mono e diorthose (tes katastase sas) oso kalutera mporo. E epitukhia mou de basizetai se kanenan para mono ston Allakh. Auton kai mono empisteuomai kai pros Auton kai mono strephomai me metameleia.

O, lae mou! As me sas odegesei e ekhthroteta sas pros emena, sto na pesei pano sas mia timoria paromoia m' auten pou epese ston lao tou Noe, ton lao tou Khount e ton lao tou Salikh. Kai o laos tou Lot den einai makria apo sas.

Zeteste sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas kai epeita strapheite pros Auton me metameleia. Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos) kai Ouantount (Autos pou ekhei megale agape kai storge gia tous enaretous).>>

Eipan: <<O, Sou'aimp! Den katalabainoume polla ap' auta pou les (kai den xeroume ten aletheia gi' auta), kai st' aletheia se blepoume adunamo anamesa mas (aphou ekheis problemata orases kai den eisai apo tous arkhegous anamesa mas). An den etan e oikogeneia sou, sigoura tha se eikhame (brisei kai) lithobolesei, kai den eisai kapoios pou na ekhei axia kai sebasmo anamesa mas (oute eisai iskhuros apenanti mas).>>

Eipe: <<O, lae mou! E oikogeneia mou ekhei pio timemene these sta matia sas apo te these tou Allakh; Kai Ton thesate piso apo ten plate sas (kai den Ton upakoute, oute Ton doxazete)! Pragmati, o Kurios mou perikleiei ola osa kanete (kai tipote den einai krupho ap' Auton).

O, lae mou! Sunekhiste na kanete o,ti kanete (me ton idio tropo sten apistia kai ten plane). Pragmati, kai ego tha pratto (o,ti me diatazei o Kurios mou). Sigoura tha mathete se poion tha erthei mia timoria pou tha ton atimasei, kai (tha mathete) poios einai pseutes (anamesa mas). Perimenete loipon (ten timoria), kai ego tha perimeno mazi sas!>>

Otan erthe e entole Mas (ten ora pou orisame gia ten katastrophe tous), sosame ton Sou'aimp kai ekeinous pou pistepsan mazi tou me to eleos Mas. Kai (o dunatos seismos kai) e megale krauge katestrepse ekeinous pou adikesan, kai etsi epesan nekroi sta prosopa kai ta gonata tous ste ge tous!
San na men eikhan katoikesei ekei pote. As apomakrunthei (apo to eleos tou Allakh kai as katastraphei) e Madiam opos apomakruntheke e Thamount.
Pragmati, steilame ton Mouse me ta Semadia Mas kai tis xekathares apodeixeis,

ston Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou, alla (oi arkhegoi) akolouthesan ten entole tou Pharao (kai ton dromo kai te methodo tou sten plane), an kai e entole (kai o dromos) tou Pharao den etan orthe (pou na odegesei sten kathodegese).
Tha einai (o Pharao) sten prote gramme tou laou tou ten Emera tes Kriseos, odegontas tous ste Photia. Kai athlia einai pragmati aute e eisodos sten opoia tha eisagontai!

Kai akolouthethekan me katara s' auten (ten egkosmia zoe) kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Athlies einai pragmati autes pou dothekan (e mia meta apo ten alle, apo ten timoria tou Allakh kai apo ten katara sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe)!

Autes einai merikes apo tis istories ton komopoleon pou se plerophoroume (o, Prophete). Kapoies ap' autes (tis komopoleis) ton opoion mnemeia uparkhoun akome (opos e Egra -Manta'in Salikh-), eno kapoies alles ekhoun exontothei entelos.

Den tous adikesame, alla ekeinoi einai pou adikesan ton eauto tous. Oi theoi tous, tous opoious epikalestekan ektos tou Allakh, den tous prostatepsan se tipote otan erthe e entole tou Kuriou sou, kai den tous auxesan para mono se katastrophe kai apoleia.
Etsi einai e timoria tou Kuriou sou (o, Mokhammant) otan timorei tis komopoleis aphou einai adikes. Pragmati, e timoria Tou einai epodune kai austere.

Pragmati, uparkhei s' aute (ten austere timoria) Semadi (kai nouthesia) gia osous phobountai ten timoria tes Mellousas Zoes. Ekeine einai e Emera (tes Kriseos) sten opoia tha sugkentrothoun oi anthropoi kai ekeine einai e Emera sten opoia oloi tha einai parontes (kai kaneis de tha leipei).
Kai den ten anabaloume (ten Emera tes Kriseos) para gia ena prokathorismeno khrono.
Ten emera pou tha erthei, kaneis de tha milesei para mono me ten adeia Tou. Kapoioi (anthropoi) tha einai athlioi eno alloi tha einai eukharistemenoi.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou tha einai athlioi, tha einai ste Photia, opou tha ekhoun ekei ekpnoe kai eispnoe (me tromere phone apo to marturio).

Tha meinoun ekei mesa (ste Photia) gia oso kairo tha paramenoun oi ouranoi kai e Ge (tes Mellousas Zoes pou tha antikatastesoun tes egkosmias, del. gia panta), ektos apo o,ti thelei o Kurios sou (gia tous amartolous pistous pou tha laboun mia timoria ste Photia kai epeita tha tous eisagei o Allakh ston Paradeiso me to eleos Tou). Pragmati, o Kurios sou kanei o,ti thelei.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou tha einai eukharistemenoi, tha einai ston Paradeiso, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia oso kairo tha paramenoun oi ouranoi kai e Ge (tes Mellousas Zoes pou tha antikatastesoun tes egkosmias, del. gia panta), ektos apo o,ti thelei o Kurios sou (del. ektos apo to diastema pou tha laboun oi amartoloi pistoi prota mia timoria ste Photia kai epeita tha tous eisagei o Allakh ston Paradeiso me to eleos Tou). Mia adiakope parokhe.

Men ekheis loipon (o, Prophete) kamia amphibolia skhetika me o,ti latreuoun ekeinoi (oi eidololatres, del. oti einai mataia, plane kai eidololatria). De latreuoun (oi eidololatres ekeina ta eidola) para mono opos latreuan oi progonoi tous prin (khoris kamia apodeixe e entole apo ton Allakh oti axizoun te latreia, alla ta latreuoun mimoumenoi tous progonous tous). Pragmati, tha tous dosoume olo to meridio tous (apo ten timoria) ameioto.

Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora, opos sou dosame, o, Mokhammant, to Kor'an), alla (o laos tou) diaphonouse gi' auto (kai kapoioi pistepsan s' auto eno alloi to diepseusan, opos diaphonouse kai o laos sou gia to Kor'an). An den eikhe proegethei e apophase tou Kuriou sou (oti de tha epispeudei to marturio stous doulous Tou sten egkosmia zoe, kai oti tha tous dosei eukairies gia na straphoun me metameleia pros Auton), tha eikhe krinei anamesa tous (katastrephontas tous adikous, kai sozontas tous pistous). Kai ekeinoi (pou diepseusan to Biblio) pragmati ekhoun gi' auto (to Biblio) amphibolia pou tous egeirei sugkhuse (an einai apo ton Allakh e okhi, kai an einai e aletheia e okhi)!
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) tha dosei se olous tous ten antapodose ton praxeon tous (amoibe gia tis kales kai timoria gia tis kakes). Pragmati, Autos gia o,ti kanoun ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Na parameineis, loipon, (o, Prophete) statheros ston isio dromo opos ekheis diatakhthei, (esu) kai osoi straphekan me metameleia pros ton Allakh apo tous pistous mazi sou, kai men xepernate ta oria (ton entolon tou Allakh). Pragmati, Autos blepei ola osa kanete.

Kai men klinete pros tous adikous (eidololatres me storge kai me to na men tous katakrinete gia ta logia apistias pou lene), oste na me sas plexei e Photia (ste Mellousa Zoe logo autou), opou tote de tha ekhete prostates ektos tou Allakh, kai epeita de tha boethetheite.

Kai telese ten proseukhe stis duo akres tes emeras (sten arkhe kai sto telos tes) kai se orismenes ores tes nukhtas. Pragmati, oi kales praxeis sbenoun tis kakes. Aute einai mia upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gia osous tha te laboun upopse.
Kai na eisai upomonetikos, giati pragmati o Allakh den aphenei ten antamoibe auton pou prattoun to kalo na khathei.

An uperkhan metaxu ton geneon prin apo sas, ekeinoi pou eikhan kalosune (kai logike kai upakoe pros ton Allakh kai esozan ton eauto tous apo ten Orge Tou) me to na apagoreuoun (sta ethne tous) te diadose tou kakou ste ge, (alla den uperkhan) ektos apo ligous pou tous sosame ap' ekeines (tis genies)! Oso gia tous adikous, akolouthesan auta pou apolambanan, kai etan kakoi.
Pote de tha katestrephe o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) tis komopoleis apo adikia, eno oi laoi tous eprattan to kalo (kai to diedidan ste ge)!

An to eikhe thelesei o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), tha eikhe kanei olous tous anthropous na einai mono mia koinoteta (pou tha akolouthouse mono mia threskeia, to Islam). Kai akoma diapheroun (se diaphores threskeies kai pothous),

ektos apo opoious eleesei o Kurios sou (oi opoioi akolouthoun te threskeia Tou). Kai gi' aute (te dokimasia sten opoia oi anthropoi diakhorizontai se pistous kai apistous) tous demiourgese. Kai o Logos tou Kuriou sou ekhei ede apophasistei (kai tha ekplerothei): <<Sigoura tha gemiso ten Kolase me (tous apistous kai tous amartolous) tzinn kai anthropous mazi.>>

Ola osa se plerophoroume (o, Prophete) apo tis istories ton Aggeliaphoron, einai gia na statheropoiesoume ten kardia sou (kai na me stenepsei to stethos sou otan se diapseudoun kai se blaptoun oi apistoi). Pragmati, sou erthe s' auto (to Kephalaio) e aletheia, kai mia nouthesia kai mia upenthumise gia tous pistous.

Kai pes (o, Prophete) s' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun: <<Sunekhiste na kanete opos kanete (me ton idio tropo sten apistia kai ten plane). Pragmati, kai emeis tha prattoume (o,ti mas dietaxe o Kurios mas).
Kai perimenete. Perimenoume ki emeis (ti tha pesei pano sas apo ten timoria).>>
Ston Allakh anekoun ta aorata ton ouranon kai tes Ges, kai s' Auton epistrephoun ola ta themata. Latrepse Ton loipon kai empisteusou Ton. Pragmati, o Kurios sou den agnoei o,ti kanete.

A, L, R [Aliph-Lam-Ra', tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. Auta einai ta Edaphia tou xekatharou Bibliou.
St' aletheia, to ekhoume steilei auto to Kor'an sta arabika isos kai sullogisteite (kai katanoesete, epeide e arabike glossa einai e pio euglotte, saphestere kai eurutere apo tis glosses).

Emeis sou diegoumaste (o, Prophete) tis kaluteres istories me o,ti apokaluptoume ap' auto to Kor'an se sena, an kai prin ap' auto (to Kor'an) esoun metaxu auton pou de gnorizan (tipote gi' autes tis istories, opos oi suntrophoi sou pou sou zetesan na tous plerophoreseis gia kapoies apo tis istories ton proegoumenon ethnon).

(Anaphere, loipon, o, Prophete) otan o Ioseph eipe ston patera tou (ton Iakob): <<O, patera mou! Pragmati, eida (sto oneiro) enteka asteria, ton elio kai to pheggari - ta eida na pephtoun se Sitzount stase (bazontas to metopo kai tis palames tous sto edaphos) enopion mou.>>

Eipe (o Iakob): <<O, gie mou! Me diegetheis to orama sou stous adelphous sou, mepos (to katalaboun kai zelepsoun) kai skhediasoun mia sunomosia enantion sou, giati o Satanas einai enas prophanes ekhthros gia ton anthropo (me xekathare ekhthroteta).

Kai etsi (opos eides auto to orama) o Kurios sou tha se epilexei kai tha sou mathei ten ermeneia ton oneiron kai tha oloklerosei ten eunoia Tou se sena kai ston oiko tou Iakob, opos ten oloklerose stous propatores sou, ton Abraam kai ton Isaak prin. Pragmati, o Kurios sou einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).>>
Pragmati, sten istoria tou Ioseph kai ton adelphon tou uparkhoun Semadia (mathemata kai nouthesia) gia osous rotoun.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipan (oi adelphoi tou Ioseph metaxu tous): <<St' aletheia, o Ioseph kai o adelphos tou (Mpentzamin, ta eterothale adelphia mas) einai pio agapetoi ston patera mas apo mas, an ki eimaste mia omada toson pollon! Pragmati, o pateras mas kanei xekathara lathos!

Skotoste ton Ioseph e dioxte ton se alle ge, oste to prosopo (kai e prosokhe) tou patera sas na einai mono pros esas, kai meta ap' auto (na strapheite me metameleia pros ton Allakh kai) na ginete dikaioi anthropoi.>>
Enas ap' autous eipe: <<Me skotosete ton Ioseph, alla rixte ton ston pato enos pegadiou, gia na ton paroun kapoioi perastikoi taxidiotes, ean eiste apophasismenoi na kanete (auto pou eipate).>>
Eipan (ston Iakob): <<O, patera mas! Giati de mas empisteuesai na apheseis mazi mas ton Ioseph (otan bgainoume exo apo ten komopole), an kai ton prosekhoume pragmatika;
Steile ton mazi mas aurio (exo apo ten komopole) gia na diaskedasei (kai na apolausei to phageto) kai na paixei, kai sigoura tha ton prostatepsoume (mekhri na gurisei piso).>>
Eipe (o Iakob): <<Pragmatika me stenakhorei to na ton parete makria (apo mena) kai phobamai na ton phaei o lukos, eno tha eiste aprosektoi gi' auton.>>
Eipan: <<An ton phaei o lukos, parolo pou eimaste mia (iskhure) omada, tote sigoura tha emaste khamenoi!>>

Ste sunekheia, otan ton peran (ton Ioseph) kai ephugan kai sumphonesan na ton rixoun ston pato enos pegadiou, tou apokalupsame (tou Ioseph): <<Sigoura (mia mera sto mellon) tha tous enemeroseis gi' auto pou kanoun, khoris na katalaboun (poios eisai).>>
Kai erthan ston patera tous to bradu klaigontas.
Eipan: <<O, patera mas! Pegame na agonistoume kai aphesame ton Ioseph me ta uparkhonta mas, alla enas lukos ton ephage. Alla de tha mas pistepseis pote, oso kai na eimaste eilikrineis.>>

Kai epheran to poukamiso tou me pseutiko aima (pou den etan to aima tou Ioseph, alla enos probatou). (O Iakob eide oti to poukamiso den ekhei kopsimata apo ta dontia tou lukou, kai etsi) eipe: <<Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizeste), st' aletheia, oi psukhes sas sas deleasan na kanete kati kako (ston Ioseph). Tha deixo loipon mia kale upomone (khoris na paraponiemai se kanenan anthropo). Kai apo ton Allakh (kai mono) zetao te boetheia enantia s' auta pou perigraphete (pseudos).>>

Kai erthan kapoioi perastikoi taxidiotes kai esteilan ekeinon pou tous phernei nero, o opoios katebase ton kouba tou (sto pegadi). Eipe: <<O, ti kala nea! Auto einai ena agori!>> (Autos pou phernei to nero kai oi suntrophoi tou) ton ekrupsan (ton Ioseph apo tous upoloipous taxidiotes sto karabani) os kapoio emporeuma, alla o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti ekanan.
Ton poulesan me mia penikhre time, merika ntirkham kai etan adiaphoroi gia te time poleses tou (thelontas na ton xephortothoun).

Kai ekeinos pou ton agorase apo te Misr, eipe ste gunaika tou: <<Phersou kallista ste diamone tou (kai kane ten anete), isos na mas ophelesei e na ton uiothetesoume.>> (Kai opos sosame ton Ioseph) etsi dosame ston Ioseph duname ste ge, kai gia na tou didaxoume apo ten ermeneia ton oneiron. Pragmati, o Allakh ektelei ten entole Tou (kai tipote den mporei na ten empodisei), alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.

Otan ephtase (o Ioseph) sten elikia tes dunames tou, tou dosame sophia (ten apostole tou os Prophete, ten katanoese, kai ten orthoteta sta logia kai stis praxeis) kai gnose. Etsi antameiboume autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Omos ekeine, sto spiti tes opoias briskotan (o Ioseph os uperetes), prospathese na ton apoplanesei. Ekleise tis portes kai eipe: <<Ela edo se mena!>> Autos eipe: <<Anazeto kataphugio ston Allakh! St' aletheia, (o suzugos sou) o aphentes mou mou phertheke kallista ste diamone mou edo (kai pote de tha ton prodoso)! St' aletheia, oi adikoi de tha epitukhoun pote.>>

Kai aute ton pothouse, ki ekeinos skephteke na tes apantesei, an den eblepe to Semadi apo ton Kurio tou. Etsi (tou deixame to Semadi) gia na apomakrunoume ap' auton to kako kai ten anethikoteta. Pragmati, (o Ioseph) etan enas apo tous eklektous doulous Mas.

Ormesan kai oi duo pros ten porta (o Ioseph gia na phugei, kai aute gia na ton empodisei) kai ekeine eskise to poukamiso tou apo piso, kai brekan ton andra tes sten porta. Ekeine eipe: <<Poia tha einai e timoria gia kapoion pou ethele na kanei kako (anethikoteta) ste gunaika sou, ektos apo to na phulakistei e na labei mia odunere timoria!>>

(O Ioseph) eipe: <<Aute pou prospathese na me apoplanesei.>> Enas marturas apo ten oikogeneia tes eipe: <<An to poukamiso tou skisteke apo mprosta, tote aute leei ten aletheia kai autos einai pseutes.
Alla an to poukamiso tou skisteke apo ten plate, tote ekeine leei psemata kai autos einai eilikrines.>>
Otan (o andras tes) eide oti to poukamiso tou (Ioseph) etan skismeno apo ten plate, eipe: <<Auto einai apo to skhedio sas [o, gunaikes]. Pragmati, to skhedio sas einai iskhuro!
O, Ioseph! Pareblepse auto (pou egine kai men to anaphereis se kanenan). Alla esu [o, gunaika mou], zeta sugkhorese gia ten amartia sou, an eisai apo tous amartolous (anthropous).>>

Merikes gunaikes sten pole eipan: <<E suzugos tou kuriou Upourgou prospathei na apoplanesei ton uperete tes. E agape tes pros auton ekhei kurieusei ten kardia tes. Blepoume oti brisketai se xekathare plane.>>

Otan akouse gia ta koutsompolia tous (kai to skhedio tous gia na doun ton Ioseph), tous kalese kai proetoimase gi' autes enan khoro me maxilaria kai phageto, kai edose se kathemia ena makhairi (gia na kopsoun to phageto) kai eipe (ston Ioseph): <<Bges exo mprosta tous.>> Otan ton eidan, ton thaumasan (logo tes omorphias tou) kai traumatisan ta kheria tous (khoris na to katalaboun eno ekoban kitra) kai eipan: <<Theos phulaxoi! Autos den einai enas anthropos, autos den einai para enas eugenes aggelos.>>

(Ekeine tous) eipe: <<Autos einai gia ton opoio me kategoresate, kai pragmati prospathesa na ton apoplaneso, ma arnetheke. Alla an de tha kanei auto pou ton diatazo, sigoura tha phulakistei, kai tha einai apo tous atimasmenous.>>

(O Ioseph) eipe: <<O, Kurie mou! E phulake einai pio agapete se mena ap' auto sto opoio me kaloun. An den apomakruneis to skhedio tous apo mena, sigoura tha klino pros autes kai tha eimai apo tous adaeis.>>
Etsi o Kurios tou apantese sten epiklese tou kai apomakrune ap' auton to skhedio tous. Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).

Epeita phaneke s' autous (ston upourgo kai stous boethous tou) aphou eidan tis apodeixeis (tes athootetas tou Ioseph) oti tha prepei na ton phulakisoun gia kapoio khrono (gia na men apokaluphthei to skandalo).

Kai mpekan mazi tou ste phulake duo nearoi. Enas ap' autous eipe: <<Eida se oneiro oti estipsa (staphulia gia) krasi.>> O allos eipe: <<Eida se oneiro oti koubalousa psomi pano sto kephali mou, apo to opoio etrogan ta poulia.>> (Kai tou eipan): <<Pes mas ten ermeneia tous, giati se blepoume os enan ap' autous pou kanoun to kalo.>>

(O Ioseph) eipe: <<De tha sas erthei phageto pou tha parekhetai se sas, ektos na sas enemeroso gia ten ermeneia tou (del. ti tha einai kai tis perigraphes tou) prin sas erthei. (Auto den einai manteia, oute eimai enas mantes, alla) auto einai apo o,ti me didaxe o Kurios mou. (S' Auton pisteuo kai) ekho aparnethei te threskeia ekeinon pou den pisteuoun ston Allakh kai arnountai ten piste ste Mellousa Zoe.

Akoloutho te threskeia ton pateron mou, tou Abraam, tou Isaak kai tou Iakob (to Islam). Den einai gia mas na apodidoume ston Allakh kanenan etairo ste latreia. Auto einai apo ten eunoia tou Allakh se mas (oti mas kathodegese ste threskeia Tou) kai stous anthropous (oti tous esteile prophetes), alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de deikhnoun eugnomosune.

O, suntrophoi mou ste phulake! Einai kalutere e latreia pros diaphorous kurious (oi opoioi einai demiourgemata) e pros ton Allakh, o Opoios einai o Al-Ouakheint (o Enas Alethinos Theos), o Al-Kakhar (Autos pou nika kai upotassei opoion thelei);

(Eseis) de latreuete ektos Autou (tou Allakh) para mono onomata, ta opoia eseis kai oi progonoi sas (epinoesate kai) dosate s' auta (ta eidola)! Gia ta opoia o Allakh den ekhei steilei kamia apodeixe (oute exousia oti tha prepei na latreuontai mazi Tou). St' aletheia, e entole anekei mono ston Allakh. Dietaxe na me latreuete kanenan allon ektos ap' Auton. Aute einai e orthe threskeia, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.

O, suntrophoi mou ste phulake! Oso gia enan apo sas (pou eide sto oneiro oti estipse staphulia gia krasi), (tha sothei kai) tha serbirei krasi ston kurio tou (ton basilia). Oso gia ton allon (pou eide oti koubalouse psomi sto kephali), tha staurothei kai ta poulia tha phane apo to kephali tou. To thema gia to opoio rotate ekhei ede apophasistei (kai oposdepote tha ginei).>>

Kai eipe (o Ioseph) s' ekeinon pou exere oti tha sothei: <<Anaphere to thema (kai ten istoria) mou ston kurio sou (ton basilia).>> Alla o Satanas ton ekane na xekhasei na anapherei auto to thema ston kurio tou, ki etsi emeine (o Ioseph) ste phulake gia merika khronia.

O Basilias eipe: <<Eida sto oneiro epta megales agelades pou tis ephagan epta adunates. Kai epta prasina stakhua kai alla (epta) xera. O, kurioi (kai arkhegoi)! Exegeste mou to oneiro mou, an mporeite na ermeneusete ta oneira.>>
Eipan: <<Auta einai anakatemena pseutika oneira (kai den einai kati, oute uparkhei ermeneia gi' auta), kai de gnorizoume ten ermeneia ton oneiron.>>
Omos ekeinos pou sotheke (apo te phulake) thumetheke (ton Ioseph) meta apo kairo kai eipe: <<Ego tha sas enemeroso gia ten ermeneia tou, gi' auto steilte me (na roteso ton Ioseph ste phulake).>>

(Eipe): <<O, Ioseph, esu pou eisai eilikrines! Pes mas gia epta megales agelades pou tis ephagan epta adunates, kai epta prasina stakhua kai alla epta xera, oste na epistrepso stous anthropous (ston basilia kai s' ekeinous pou einai guro tou) kai na mathoun (ten ermeneia autou tou oneirou kai na katalaboun ten axia sou).>>

(O Ioseph) eipe: <<Tha kalliergesete os sunethos epimelos gia epta sunekhomena khronia. O,ti sugkomide mazepsete, (apothekeuste ten kai) apheste ten sta stakhua tes (gia na prostateuetai apo te phthora), ektos apo lige gia na phate.

Meta ap' auto tha erthoun epta khronia kakoukhion pou tha katabrokhthisoun (del. eseis tha katanalosete ap') auta pou eikhate apothekeusei gi' auta (ta agona khronia), ektos apo ligo pou tha apothekeusete.
Meta ap' auto tha erthei mia khronia kata ten opoia oi anthropoi tha ekhoun aphthone brokhe kai tha stiboun (staphulia, elies, zakharokalamo, klp.).>>

O Basilias eipe (stous boethous tou otan tou ephtase e ermeneia tou Ioseph): <<Pherte ton (Ioseph) se mena.>> Otan omos o aggeliaphoros (tou basilia) erthe s' auton (ton Ioseph), (o Ioseph tou) eipe: <<Pegaine piso ston kurio sou (ton basilia) kai rotese ton (gia na phanei prota e athoteta mou mprosta tou kai mprosta se olous): <<Poia einai e istoria ton gunaikon pou traumatisan ta kheria tous;>> Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai gia to dolo tous Pantognostes.>>

(O basilias tis kalese kai tous) eipe: <<Poia etan e istoria sas otan prospathesate na apoplanesate ton Ioseph;>> Eipan: <<Theos phulaxoi! Den xerame tipota kako gi' auton (alla e gunaika tou upourgou pou prospathese na ton apoplanesei).>> E suzugos tou upourgou eipe: <<Tora phanerotheke e aletheia. Emoun ego pou prospathesa na ton apoplaneso, kai autos einai apo tous eilikrineis.
Auto (to leo) gia na xerei (o Ioseph) oti den ton prodosa (epinoontas psemata enantion tou) eremen tou. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei to dolo ton prodoton (pou epinooun psemata kai skhedia).

Kai de leo oti eimai athoa. Pragmati, e (anthropine) psukhe diatazei sukhna to kako (ston anthropo), ektos apo osous eleese o Kurios mou (kai tous prostateuei ap' auto). Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>

O basilias eipe: <<Pherte ton (Ioseph) se mena, gia na ton kano enan apo tous sumboulous mou.>> Epeita, otan tou milese (kai eide to kalo kharaktera kai te gnose tou), eipe: <<Semera edo mazi mas tha eisai se upsele these kai axios tes empistosunes mas.>>
(O Ioseph) eipe: <<Kane me upeuthuno (upourgo) gia tis apothekes tes ges. Pragmati, eimai axiopistos phulakas kai ekho gnose (gi' auto pou tha mou empisteuteis).>>
Etsi dosame duname ston Ioseph ste ge, na pegainei s' auten opou thelei. Dinoume to eleos Mas se opoion theloume, kai den aphenoume ten antamoibe auton pou prattoun to kalo na khathei.
Kai pragmati, e antamoibe tes Mellousa Zoes einai kalutere gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).

Ta adelphia tou Ioseph erthan kai mpekan ston topo tou (Ioseph, aphou o pateras tous tous esteile se emporiko karabani gia na agorasoun phageto, logo ton agonon khronon, khoris na steilei ton mikro adelpho, Mpentzamin). (O Ioseph) tous anagnorise alla ekeinoi den ton gnorisan.

Otan tous edose to meridio tous (apo phageto, epeide edine se kathe enan agoraste mono ena phortio mias kamelas), (kai otan katalabe ap' autous oti ekhoun ena mikrotero eterothale adelpho pou den erthe, kai tou eipan ten istoria tou), eipe: <<Pherte mou ton eterothale adelpho sas pou einai apo ton patera sas (gia na xero oti mou eipate ten aletheia skhetika m' auton, kai gia na sas doso ten alle phora allo ena epipleon phortio mias kamelas). De blepete oti ekplerono te monada metreses phagetou kai eimai o kaluteros pou philoxenei;
Alla an de tha mou ton pherete, (tote auta pou mou eipate etan psemata kai) de tha labete apo mena kanena phortio phagetou pou na to metreso gia sas, oute na erthete konta mou (ste khora mou).>>
Eipan: <<Tha ton zetesoume apo ton patera tou epimelos (kai tha kanoume o,ti kalutero mporoume gia na ton peisoume) kai pragmati tha to kanoume (auto pou eipame kai mas to zeteses).>>

(O Ioseph) eipe stous uperetes tou: <<Balte (ta khremata kai) ta emporeumata tous (pou edosan os antallagma gia to phageto) piso xana stis aposkeues tous (khoris na to katalaboun) oste na ta anagnorisoun otan epistrepsoun sten oikogeneia tous. Isos kai na epistrepsoun (xana se mas otan tha doun te gennaiodoria mas, kai epeide e threskeia tous, apagoreuei na agorasoun kati khoris na to plerosoun).>>

Otan epestrepsan ston patera tous, eipan: <<O, patera mas! Mas apagorepsan na paroume xana opoiodepote allo phortio phagetou (mekhri na pheroume mazi mas ton adelpho mas). Steile loipon ton adelpho mas mazi mas gia na mporoume xana na agorasoume phortia phagetou kai sigoura tha ton prostatepsoume.>>
Eipe: <<Tha ton empisteuomoun se sas, opos empisteuteka se sas ton adelpho tou prin; Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Kaluteros Prostates kai einai o pio Eleemon apo tous eleemones.>>

Otan anoixan tis aposkeues tous, diapistosan oti tous eikhan epistraphei (ta khremata kai) ta emporeumata tous (pou edosan os antallagma gia to phageto). Eipan: <<O, patera mas!
