Ti allo theloume (parapano ap' auto); Edo einai (ta khremata kai) ta emporeumata mas epistraphekan se mas. (Steile ton adelpho mas mazi mas gia) na pheroume phageto sten oikogeneia mas, kai tha prostateusoume ton adelpho mas kai tha paroume ena epipleon phortio mias kamelas (me phageto). Auto to epipleon phortio mias kamelas einai eukolo (gia ton upourgo na mas to dosei).>>

Eipe (o Iakob): <<De tha ton steilo mazi sas mekhri na mou dosete uposkhese orkizomenoi sto Onoma tou Allakh oti sigoura tha ton pherete piso se mena, ektos an perikuklotheite me katastrophe (kai katastrapheite).>> Otan tou edosan ten uposkhese tous, eipe: <<O Allakh einai Marturas autou pou leme.>>

Eipe (o Iakob): <<O, gioi mou! Men mpeite oloi (ste khora) apo mia mono pule, alla mpeite apo diaphoretikes pules (auto einai pio asphales gia sas). Den mporo na sas prostatepso se tipota enantia sten entole tou Allakh (an orise na sas sumbei kati). Pragmati, e entole anekei mono ston Allakh. Auton empisteuomai kai Auton as empisteuontai oi pistoi.>>

Otan mpekan (ste khora) apo ekei pou tous eikhe diataxei o pateras tous, -auto (del. to na mpoun apo diaphoretikes pules) de tha tous prostateue se tipote enantia sten entole tou Allakh (an orise na tous sumbei kati)-, ostoso (o Iakob to eipe auto) mono gia mia anagke ste psukhe tou Iakob pou ten ikanopoiese (e opoia etan to oiktos tou pros ta paidia tou pou to phanerose s' autous). Etan (o Iakob) pragmati enas anthropos me gnose pou tou ten ekhoume mathei (oti e entole anekei mono ston Allakh), alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun!

Otan mpekan ste sugkentrose tou Ioseph, (o Ioseph) pere ton adelpho tou (Mpentzamin) konta tou kai eipe (krupha): <<Ego eimai o adelphos sou (o Ioseph), opote me stenakhoriesai gia o,ti ekanan (ta adelphia sou) prin (kai krata auto mustiko, kai tha kano ena skhedio gia na se krateso edo mazi mou).>>

Otan tous edose to meridio tous (apo phageto), ebale to (basiliko) dokheio stis aposkeues tou adelphou tou, (Mpentzamin). Epeita, (aphou arkhisan na phugoun) kapoios phonaxe: <<O, anthropoi tou karabaniou! Eiste klephtes!>>
Eipan kathos gurisan piso pros autous: <<Ti khasate;>>
Eipan (autos pou phonaxe kai oi suntrophoi tou): <<Khasame to dokheio tou basilia. Opoios tha to pherei tha ekhei (os brabeio) ena phortio mias kamelas (me phageto), kai ego to egguomai.>>
Eipan: <<Ma ton Allakh! Kserete kala oti den erthame gia na skorpisoume to kako ste ge, oute eimaste klephtes.>>
Eipan: <<Poia tha einai e timoria tou (klephte ste threskeia sas), an eiste pseutes (kai brethei anamesa sas);>>
Eipan: <<E timoria autou (tou klephte) pou tha brethei (to klemmeno dokheio) stis aposkeues tou, tha einai oti o idios tha upodoulothei. Etsi timoroume tous adikous.>>

Etsi, arkhise (o Ioseph) na psakhnei stis aposkeues tous prin apo tis aposkeues tou adelphou tou (tou Mpentzamin), kai meta ten ebgale apo tis aposkeues tou adelphou tou. Etsi skhediasame gia ton Ioseph (to na rotesoun ta adelphia tou poia einai e timoria tou klephte ste threskeia tous), diaphoretika de tha mporouse na kratesei ton adelpho tou sumphona me to nomo tou basilia (pou timorei ton klephte me to khtupema kai to na plerosei te diplasia axia tou klemmenou), ektos an to ethele o Allakh. Exupsonoume se upseles theseis autous pou theloume. Kai pano apo kathe enan pou ekhei gnose, uparkhei allos pou ekhei perissotere gnose.

Eipan: <<An eklepse (tote den einai periergo), giati kai enas adelphos tou (del. o Ioseph) eikhe klepsei prin (ena eidolo tou pappou tou apo ten pleura tes meteras tou, gia na to spasei).>> O Ioseph to kratese (auto pou eipan) mesa tou kai den tous to phanerose, kai eipe (mesa tou): <<Eiste se kheirotere these (enopion tou Allakh logo auton pou kanate kai tes zelias sas). Kai o Allakh gnorizei kalutera (ten aletheia gi') auto pou perigraphete (pseudos).>>

Eipan (ston Ioseph): <<O, kurie upourge! Pragmati, (o mikros adelphos mas) ekhei enan elikiomeno patera (o opoios ton agapaei polu), pare loipon enan apo mas anti gi' auton, pragmati, se blepoume enan ap' ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.>>

(O Ioseph) eipe: <<Anazetoume kataphugio ston Allakh apo to na paroume kapoion allon ektos ap' ekeino pou brekame ta pragmata mas mazi tou, giati (an tha kaname kati tetoio) tote tha emastan adikoi.>>

Otan apelpistekan na ton peisoun (ton Ioseph), suzetesan metaxu tous idiotika. O megaluteros tous eipe: <<Den xerete oti o pateras sas ekhei parei apo sas (mia uposkhese kai) enan orko sto Onoma tou Allakh (oti tha ton pherete piso), kai apo prin eikhate ede paramelesei ton Ioseph; Os ek toutou, de tha phugo ap' aute te ge eos otou o pateras mou na mou epitrepsei (na guriso kai na me sugkhoresei) e o Allakh na apophasisei gia mena (to na mporeso na paro ton adelpho mou). Pragmati, Autos einai o Kaluteros ton kriton.

Guriste piso ston patera sas kai peite: <<O, patera mas! O gios sou eklepse, kai de (sou) leme para mono auta pou eidame (oti brekan to dokheio stis aposkeues tou), kai de gnorizame ta aorata (oti tha eklebe).
Rota (tous anthropous) sten komopole pou emastan, kai to karabani me to opoio erthame, kai pragmati eimaste eilikrineis (s' auta pou leme).>>.>>

(O Iakob) eipe: <<Okhi (den einai opos eipate oti eklepse), alla st' aletheia, oi psukhes sas sas deleasan na kanete kati (ston Mpentzamin opos kanate prin ston Ioseph). Tha deixo mia kale upomone (khoris na paraponiemai se kanenan ektos apo ton Allakh). Eithe o Allakh na mou tous pherei olous! Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>
Strapheke makria tous kai eipe: <<O, lupe kai thlipse mou gia ton Ioseph!>> Kai ta matia tou eginan aspra apo te thlipse, kai etan gematos thlipse pou ten kratouse mesa tou.
Eipan: <<Ma ton Allakh, de tha papseis na thumasai ton Ioseph mekhri na katastraphei to soma kai to mualo sou (apo te thlipse) e na pethaneis!>>
Eipe: <<St' aletheia, paraponiemai mono ston Allakh gia ten agonia kai te thlipse mou, kai xero apo ton Allakh auto pou den xerete.
O, gioi mou! Pegainete na mathete ta nea tou Ioseph kai tou adelphou tou, kai men apelpizeste apo to eleos tou Allakh. Pragmati, den apelpizontai apo to eleos tou Allakh para mono oi apistoi.>>

Otan erthan ste sugkentrose tou (Ioseph), eipan: <<O, kurie upourge! Oi antixootetes khtupesan emas kai ten oikogeneia mas, kai pherame liga khremata (kai agatha pou den einai toso kala, me antallagma to phageto). Dose mas, loipon, to pleres metro tou phortiou (apo sitera opos ekanes prin) kai dose mas os eleemosune (te diaphora metaxu tou pleres phortiou kai ton khrematon mas pou den tou phtanoun), pragmati, o Allakh antameibei autous pou dinoun eleemosune.>>
Eipe (o Ioseph): <<Kserete (kai thumaste) ti (kako) kanate ston Ioseph kai ston adelpho tou eno eikhate agnoia (gia tis sunepeies);>>

Eipan: <<Esu eisai pragmati o Ioseph;>> Eipe: <<Eimai o Ioseph kai autos einai o adelphos mou. O Allakh mas edose khares (pou mas esose kai upsose te these mas). Pragmati, gia opoion phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai deikhnei upomone, o Allakh den aphenei pote ten antamoibe ekeinon pou prattoun to kalo na khathei.>>
Eipan: <<Ma ton Allakh! O Allakh se epelexe (kai se protimese) pano apo mas, kai pragmati emastan amartoloi (gi' auta pou kaname se sena kai ston adelpho sou).>>
Eipe (o Ioseph): <<Den uparkhei kamia epiplexe gia sas semera. Eithe o Allakh na sas sugkhoresei. Pragmati, Autos einai o pio Eleemon apo tous eleemones.
Pegainete me to poukamiso mou auto kai rixte to sto prosopo tou patera mou, tha anaktesei ten orase tou. Kai pherte mou ole ten oikogeneia sas.>>

Otan xekhorese to karabani, o pateras tous eipe (se osous etan mazi tou apo ta paidia tou kai apo ten oikogeneia tou): <<Pragmati, murizo te murodia tou Ioseph, an kai me khleuazete (legontas oti eimai elikiomenos pou leei auta pou den xerei kai khoris na aisthanetai).>>
Eipan (osoi etan mazi tou apo ta paidia kai ten oikogeneia tou): <<Ma ton Allakh! Eisai akoma sto palio sou lathos (kai den xekhnas ton Ioseph).>>

Otan erthe autos pou ekhei ta kala nea, to petaxe (to poukamiso) sto prosopo tou (Iakob) kai amesos anektese ten orase tou. Eipe (o Iakob): <<De sas eipa oti xero apo ton Allakh auta pou den xerete;>>
Eipan: <<O, patera mas! Zeta sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) gia tis amarties mas, pragmati emastan amartoloi (gi' auta pou kaname).>>
Eipe (o Iakob): <<Tha zeteso apo ton Kurio mou na sas sugkhoresei. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>
Otan erthan ste sugkentrose tou Ioseph, agkaliase tous goneis tou kai eipe (sten oikogeneia tou): <<Mpeite ste Misr, an thelei o Allakh, asphaleis.>>

Kai (o Ioseph) anebase tous goneis tou sto krebati (tou) kai oloi (oi goneis kai ta adelphia tou) epesan enopion tou se Sitzount stase (me tis palames kai to metopo sto edaphos, os khairetismos kai sebasmos kai okhi gia latreia, kati pou epitrepotan tote s' autous). Eipe: <<O, patera mou! Aute einai e pragmatopoiese tou oneirou mou prin. O Kurios mou to ekane alethino, kai mou parakhorese apo tis khares Tou pou me ebgale apo te phulake kai sas ephere olous edo apo tous bedouinous, aphou o Satanas eikhe khalasei te skhese mou me ta adelphia mou. Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai Eugenes (ste diakheirise) gia o,ti thelei. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

[Kai kalese o Ioseph ton Kurio tou:] <<Kurie mou! Pragmati, mou edoses apo ten exousia kai mou emathes apo ten ermeneia ton oneiron. O, Demiourge ton ouranon kai tes Ges! Esu eisai o Prostates (kai o Kedemonas) mou sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Kane me na pethano os Mousoulmanos (upotagmenos ste Boulese Sou) kai enose me me tous dikaious (kai tous prophetes sto upselotero epipedo ston Paradeiso).>>

Auto einai ena meros apo tis eideseis ton aoraton, pou apokalupsoume se sena (o, Mokhammant). Kai den esoun mazi tous (tous adelphous tou Ioseph) otan apophasisan gia to thema tous (skhetika me ton Ioseph), kai skhediasan.
St' aletheia, oi perissoteroi anthropoi de tha pistepsoun, oso prothumos ki an eisai (o, Prophete, gia ten kathodegese tous).

Kai den tous zetas kamia antamoibe (gia te diadose tou Kor'an, kai parola auta apekhoun apo ten piste san tha khreothoun gi' auto). (Pragmati, to Kor'an) einai mono mia nouthesia (kai upenthumise) gia olo ton kosmo.
Posa einai ta Semadia stous ouranous kai ste ge, apo ta opoia pernoun, alla apomakrunontai ap' auta adiaphoroi;
Kai oi perissoteroi ap' autous den pisteuoun ston Allakh ektos na Tou apodidoun etairous ste latreia.
Aisthanontai asphaleis apo to na tous erthei mia timoria apo ton Allakh pou tha tous kalupsei e apo to na tous erthei e Ora xaphnika khoris na to aisthanontai;

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Autos einai o dromos (kai o tropos) mou. Kalo ston Allakh me apodeixe kai gnose, ego kai opoioi me akolouthoun. Doxa ston Allakh (einai Anoteros apo kathe ateleia kai apo o,ti Tou apodidoun apo etairous ste latreia). Kai den eimai ap' ekeinous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.

Pragmati, de steilame prin apo sena para mono andres (san esena, o, Mokhammant, kai okhi Aggelous) apo tous anthropous ton komopoleon, stous opoious (andres) apokalupsame. Ma den taxideuoun ste ge (ekeinoi pou se diapseudoun) gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon pou etan prin ap' autous (pou diepseudan tous Aggeliaphorous tous); Pragmati, e Mellousa Zoe einai polu kalutere gia osous phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Ma de sullogizeste;

(Den timoresame kanena ethnos pou diepseude) mekhri pou oi Aggeliaphoroi apelpistekan (apo tous laous tous) kai (oi laoi tous) bebaiothekan oti (oi Aggeliaphoroi) tous eipan psemata (gia ton erkhomo tes timorias), tote tous erthe (stous Aggeliaphorous) e boetheia Mas, kai sosame opoious thelame, kai e timoria Mas den apotrepetai makria apo tous kakous anthropous (otan tous erthei).

Pragmati, uparkhei stis istories tous (ton Aggeliaphoron me tous laous tous), ena mathema gia osous ekhoun mualo (gia na tis sullogistoun). Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) den einai kataskeuasmenos logos, alla einai epibebaiose auton pou tou proegethekan (apo Theia Biblia), leptomeres exegese ton panton, kai kathodegese kai eleos gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun.

A, L, M, R [Aliph-Lam-Meim-Ra', tessera xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. Auta ta Edaphia tou Bibliou (tou Kor'an) kai auto pou ekhei stalei se sena (o, Prophete) apo ton Kurio sou, einai e aletheia, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi den pisteuoun.

O Allakh einai Autos pou upsose tous ouranous khoris stulous (opos) tous blepete, kai epeita anebeke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou). Upetaxe ton elio kai te selene (gia ta sumpheronta sas), kai to kathena tous trekhei (sten poreia tou) gia ena orismeno khrono. Dieuthetei (o Allakh) oles tis upotheseis (opos thelei) kai exegei leptomeros ta Semadia (pou deikhnoun te Duname Tou), mepos kai na eiste sigouroi gia te sunantese me ton Kurio sas (ste Mellousa Zoe).

Kai einai Autos pou aplose te ge (gia na perpatesete s' auten) kai topothetese s' auten statherous passalous (bouna pou te statheropoioun) kai potamia, kai demiourgese s' auten kathe eidous karpous ana zeugaria. Kaluptei me te nukhta ten emera (kai etsi ekhete skotadi gia na xekourazeste). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gi' ekeinous pou sullogizontai.

Kai ste ge uparkhoun (diaphoretikes) ektaseis ges, e mia dipla sten alle, kai kepoi me ampelia, kalliergeies kai khourmadies pou merikes ap' autes phutronoun se sustades apo mia riza kai merikes pou e kathe mia phutronei mone tes. Ola potizontai me to idio nero, omos kanoume kapoia ap' auta na uperekhoun sta alla se geuse (kai ophele). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gi' ekeinous pou sullogizontai.

An anarotiesai (o, Prophete, pos einai dunaton oi apistoi na latreuoun eidola), tote tha prepei na anarotetheis perissotero gia ta logia tous: <<Ma (einai dunaton oti) aphou (tha pethanoume kai) tha ekhoume ginei skone, tha demiourgethoume xana;>> Ekeinoi einai autoi pou arnethekan ten piste ston Kurio tous, kai einai autoi pou tha ekhoun desma sto laimo tous, kai autoi tha einai oi katoikoi tes Photias, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.

Sou zetoun (oi apistoi, o, Prophete) na epispeuseis gi' autous to kako (kai ten timoria) prin to kalo (del. anti na sou zetesoun to eleos, ten euemeria kai ten asphaleia), parolo pou ekhoun ede perasei oi timories prin ap' autous (sta paromoia ethne kai tous ekanan os paradeigma kai mathema)! Pragmati, o Kurios sou kharizei sugkhorese stous anthropous (pou strephontai me metameleia pros Auton) meta apo tis adikies (amarties) tous, kai pragmati, o Kurios sou einai Austeros sten timoria (gi' ekeinous pou epimenoun sten adikia tous).

Oi apistoi lene: <<An tou stelnotan (ston Mokhammant) ena Semadi apo ton Kurio tou (ap' auta pou zetesame, opos to na metatrepsei to lopho As-Sapha se khruso e na aphairesei ta bouna tes Makkas kai na kanei stis theseis tous kepous, gia na pistepsoume)!>> Pragmati, eisai mono enas proeidopoietes, kai gia kathe lao uparkhei enas (Prophetes pou stelnotan) gia na tous kathodegesei.
O Allakh gnorizei ti ekhei kathe theluko ste metra, kai o,ti ekhoun oi metres apo meiose (apobole) e auxese (sten periodo tes egkumosunes). Ta panta enopion Tou ekhoun ena sugkekrimeno metro.
Einai o Pantognostes tou aoratou kai tou oratou, o Al-Kampeir (o Megas), o Al-Mouta'al (o Upsistos).
Einai to idio (enopion Tou kai ste gnose Tou), opoios apo sas milaei krupha kai opoios milaei phonakhta, kai opoios krubetai te nukhta kai opoios phainetai ten emera.

(O Allakh) ekhei autous (tous Aggelous) pou erkhontai diadokhika (se kathe atomo apo ten proseukhe Phatzr mekhri ten 'Asr kai to antistropho) gia na ton phulaxoun apo mprosta kai piso tou, me ten entole tou Allakh (apo ta panta ektos apo o,ti tou orise o Allakh, kai gia na katagrapsoun tis praxeis tou). O Allakh den allazei ten katastase kapoion anthropon (apo kale se kake), mekhri oi idioi na allaxoun ton eauto tous (me tis amarties kai ten akharistia). Kai an o Allakh thelei na pesei kati kako (apo timoria) se kapoious anthropous, tote de tha apotrapei me tipote, oute tha ekhoun ektos Autou kanenan prostate.
Einai Autos pou sas deikhnei astrapes, gia phobo (apo tous keraunous) kai elpida (gia brokhe). Kai (einai Autos pou) demiourgei ta sunnepha pou einai baria phortomena (me aphthono nero).

E bronte (Ton) doxazei eugnomonontas Ton, to idio kanoun kai oi Aggeloi apo phobo (kai sebasmo) pros Auton. Autos stelnei tous keraunous kai ktupa opoion thelei m' autous. Kai omos autoi (oi apistoi) amphisbetoun gia ton Allakh (te Megaloprepeia Tou, kai oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos). Pragmati, Autos einai Austeros sten timoria Tou.

S' Auton kai mono anekei to kalesma tes aletheias (oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos). Alla ekeinoi (oi pseutikoi theoi kai ta eidola) pou tous epikalountai (oi eidololatres) ektos Autou, den antapokrinontai s' autous se tipote, para mono san ekeinon pou aplonei ta kheria tou (mesa se pegadi) pros to nero (pou einai makria tou, kai kalei to nero) gia na phtasei sto stoma tou, alla de tha tou phtasei pote. Oi epikleseis ton apiston den einai para se plane.

Pros ton Allakh pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me tis palames kai to metopo sto edaphos) opoioi briskontai stous ouranous kai ste ge, thelontas e me, kai (to idio kanoun kai) oi skies tous (pephtoun se Sitzount stase me plere upotage) sten arkhe tes emeras kai sto telos tes.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Poios einai o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges;>> Pes: <<O Allakh.>> Pes: <<Ekhete parei (gia latreia) ektos Autou kedemones (kai prostates), oi opoioi den ekhoun kamia duname na pheroun ophelos ston eauto tous, oute na empodizoun kapoio kako apo ton eauto tous;>> Pes: <<Einai o tuphlos isos m' auton pou blepei; E einai ta skotadia isa me to phos;>> E apodidoun ston Allakh etairous (ste demiourgia), oi opoioi demiourgesan paromoia me te dike Tou demiourgia, kai etsi mperdeutekan me ta demiourgemata (auton kai tou Allakh);>> Pes: <<O Allakh einai o Demiourgos ton panton, kai Autos einai o Al-Ouakheint (Enas), o Al-Kakhar (Autos pou nika kai upotassei opoion thelei).>>

(To paradeigma tes aletheias kai tes planes einai san auto tou nerou), (o Allakh) stelnei nero apo ton ourano, kai etsi reoun koilades, e kathe mia analoga me te khoretikoteta tes, kai o kheimarros metapherei pano tou aphro, kai [to idio paradeigma einai san kai] auton (ton metallon) pou oi anthropoi bazoun ste photia epidiokontas na phtiaxoun stolidia e ophelima pragmata, (ta liomena metalla ekhoun pano tous) paromoio aphro (skouria). Etsi o Allakh dinei to paradeigma tes aletheias kai tes planes: oson aphora ton aphro, autos tha phugei kai tha exaphanistei, alla o,ti einai ophelimo stous anthropous (apo nero e metalla) tha parameinei ste ge. Etsi dinei o Allakh ta paradeigmata (gia na phanei e aletheia).

Autoi pou antapokrithekan ston Kurio tous (otan tous kalese pros ten piste kai ten upakoe), tha ekhoun ten kalutere antamoibe (ton Paradeiso). Omos, oso gi' ekeinous pou den antapokrithekan s' Auton, an kateikhan o,ti uparkhei ste ge (apo thesaurous) kai ta paromoia mazi tou, tha ta prospheran os lutra gia ton eauto tous. Ekeinoi tha logodotesoun polu austera kai e katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, kai ti athlio krebati (kai katoikia) einai aute!

Einai autos pou gnorizei, oti auto pou sou staltheke apo ton Kurio sou einai e aletheia, isos m' auton pou einai tuphlos; Tha to laboun upopse (kai os nouthesia) mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun (ugie) muala (gia na to sullogistoun).
Oi opoioi einai autoi pou ekpleronoun te desmeuse pou tous anethese o Allakh, kai den athetoun te desmeuse (tous pros Auton).
Kai oi opoioi einai autoi pou diateroun o,ti o Allakh dietaxe na diaterethei (apo tous desmous suggeneias), kai phobountai ton Kurio tous, kai phobountai apo to na ekhoun austere logodotese.

Kai oi opoioi einai autoi pou deikhnoun upomone anazetontas ten eukharistese tou Kuriou tous, kai teloun ten proseukhe, kai xodeuoun (se eleemosune) krupha kai demosia apo o,ti tous parekhoume, kai apothoun to kako me to kalo. Autoi tha ekhoun ten kalutere telike katoikia (ston Paradeiso ste Mellousa Zoe).

Tha mpoun stous kepous monimes diamones (Paradeiso), mazi me osous einai dikaioi apo tous goneis tous, tous suzugous tous kai tous apogonous tous. Oi Aggeloi tha erthoun s' autous apo kathe pule (gia na tous khairetesoun kai na tous sugkharoun).
(Oi Aggeloi tha tous poun): <<Eirene se sas, gia osa upomenate. Poso exairetike einai e telike katoikia (sas ston Paradeiso)!>>

Oso gi' ekeinous pou athetoun te desmeuse pou tous anethese o Allakh (oti na men Tou apodidoun kanenan etairo ste latreia), aphou ekhei epibebaiothei (meso tes apostoles ton apostolon kai ton Biblion), kai koboun o,ti dietaxe o Allakh na diaterethei (apo tous desmous suggeneias), kai skorpizoun to kako ste ge, ekeinoi tha ekhoun ten katara (tou Allakh pou tha pesei pano tous) kai tha ekhoun te kheirotere katoikia (ste Photia ste Mellousa Zoe).

O Allakh dieurunei ta agatha pou parekhei gia opoious thelei e ta periorizei. Khairontai (oi apistoi) me ten egkosmia zoe (kai tis apolauseis tes), an kai e egkosmia zoe se sugkrise me te Mellousa Zoe, den einai para mia pheugalea (asemante kai lige) apolause!

Oi apistoi lene (apo peisma kai iskhurognomosune): <<An tou stelnotan (ston Mokhammant) ena Semadi apo ton Kurio tou (ap' auta pou zetesame, opos to na metatrepsei to lopho As-Sapha se khruso e na aphairesei ta bouna tes Makkas kai na kanei stis theseis tous kepous, gia na pistepsoume)!>> Pes: <<Pragmati, o Allakh odegei (me te Dikaiosune Tou) opoion thelei sto na parastratesei, kai kathodegei pros Auton (me te Khare Tou) opoion strephetai pros Auton me metameleia.>>

Ekeinous (pou tous kathodegei o Allakh) einai autoi pou pisteuoun kai ton opoion oi kardies kathesukhazontai me ten exumnese tou Allakh (kai me ten apaggelia tou Bibliou Tou). Pragmati, mono sten exumnese tou Allakh oi kardies kathesukhazontai.
Autoi pou pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis, tha ekhoun eudaimonia (kai kale katastase) kai kale epistrophe (ston Paradeiso).

Etsi se steilame se ena ethnos, prin apo to opoio eikhan perasei alla ethne, gia na tous apaggeileis auto (to Kor'an) pou sou apokalupsame (kai to opoio einai to megalutero Semadi pou epibebaionei ten apostole sou), alla autoi den pisteuoun ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona)! Pes: <<(O Ar-Rakhman) einai o Kurios mou. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Auton empisteuomai kai s' Auton einai e epistrophe mou me metameleia.>>

Akoma ki an stelnotan ena Kor'an (allo Theio Biblio) me to opoio (kai ten apaggelia tou) tha metakinontousan ta bouna, tha khorizotan e ge (se potamia) e tha milousan oi nekroi, [de tha pisteuan oi apistoi]! [Kai an tha kaname ena Theio Biblio pou na ekane auta, tha etan auto to Kor'an]! Ston Allakh anekei ole e entole (gia ola ta themata kai gia ta Semadia kai ta thaumata). Den xeroun oi pistoi oti an o Allakh ethele, tha eikhe kathodegesei olous tous anthropous (kai khoris na steilei kanena Semadi)! Tha sunekhisoun oi sumphores na plettoun tous apistous e na pephtoun konta (ste ge kai) stous oikous tous, exaitias oson dieprattan (apo apistia kai amarties), mekhri na erthei e uposkhese tou Allakh (del. e timoria tous). Pragmati, o Allakh den athetei ten uposkhese Tou.

Pragmati, (polloi) Aggeliophoroi khleuastekan prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant), alla edosa anabole s' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, kai meta tous arpaxa me ten timoria. Poso (tromere) etan e timoria pou (tous) esteila!

Einai Autos pou (sunterei ta panta kai) parakolouthei kathe psukhe se o,ti kanei (kai tha ten antameipsei e timoresei gi' auta), [o pio Axios na latreuetai e ekeina ta eidola pou den mporoun oute na ophelesoun ton eauto tous]; Ostoso, (oi apistoi adika kai pseudos) apodidoun ston Allakh etairous (apo tous pseutikous theous kai ta eidola tous)! Pes (o, Prophete): <<Peite (mou) ta onomata (kai tis idiotetes) tous (ekeinon ton pseutikon theon sas, an eiste eilikrineis)! E mepos plerophoreite ton Allakh gia kati (oti ekhei etairous, kati) pou den to xerei ste ge; E (mepos Ton enemeronete) gia apla mia delose (sas, pou den einai pragmatike);>> Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizontai), alla oraiopoietheke (apo to Satana) sta matia ton apiston to kako skhedio (kai o mataios logos) tous, kai empodistekan (oi apistoi) apo ton isio dromo. Opoion o Allakh ton kanei na parastratesei, de tha uparkhei gi' auton kaneis pou mporei na ton kathodegesei.
Tha laboun timoria sten egkosmia zoe, alla e timoria tes Mellousas Zoes einai pio austere, kai de tha ekhoun kanenan prostate enantia ston Allakh.

E perigraphe tou Paradeisou, pou ton uposkhetheke (o Allakh) stous eusebeis pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) einai oti kato ap' auton (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tou) reoun potamia, oi karpoi tou einai monimoi, to idio kai e skia tou. Aute einai e telike katoikia ekeinon pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh, eno e telike katoikia ton apiston einai e Photia!

Ekeinoi stous opoious dosame to Biblio (apo tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious pou pistepsan se sena, o, Mokhammant, opos o Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai alloi) khairontai gi' auto (to Kor'an) pou staltheke se sena (epeide briskoun tis perigraphes sou stis Graphes tous), alla uparkhoun kapoies omades (apo tous Khristianous, tous Ebraious, tous eidololatres kai allous, pou ekanan summakhia enantion sou) pou arnountai meros tou (to opoio de sumphonei me tis epithumies tous kai katakrinei ten plane kai ten apistia tous). Pes: <<Pragmati, diatakhtheka na latreuo mono ton Allakh kai na men Tou apodido etairous ste latreia. Auton kai mono epikaloumai kai pros Auton kai mono tha einai e epistrophe mou (ten Emera tes Kriseos).>>

(Opos steilame ta proegoumena Theia Biblia stis glosses ton laon tous), etsi, steilame auto (to Kor'an) os teleio (kai xekatharo Biblio kai kriterio) sta arabika (me to opoio tha krineis, o, Prophete, metaxu ton anthropon). An tha akolouthouses tis epithumies tous meta ap' auto pou sou erthe apo te gnose, de tha eikhes enantia ston Allakh kanenan uposterikte e prostate.

Pragmati, eikhame steilei prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) Aggeliaphorous, kai tous parakhoresame suzugous kai paidia. Den enapokeitai se kanenan Aggeliaphoro to na pherei kapoio Semadi, para mono me ten Adeia tou Allakh. Gia kathe prokathorismeno khrono (kathenos pragmatos kai kathemias entoles pou orise o Allakh), uparkhei ena biblio (sto opoio einai grammeno).

O Allakh aphairei o,ti thelei (apo tis upotheseis ton anthropon kai tous kanones tes threskeias gia kapoia sophia pou ten xerei) e to epibebaionei, kai ekhei to Kurio Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud, sto opoio ola einai grammena, kai tipote den allazei mesa tou).

Eite sou deixoume (o, Prophete) kati ap' auto pou tous uposkhethekame (apo ten timoria), eite aphairesoume te zoe sou (khoris na to deis auto), (kai stis duo periptoseis) to kathekon sou einai mono na diabibaseis (to Menuma xekathara) kai Emeis eimaste pou tha tous pheroume gia ton apologismo.

De blepoun (oi apistoi) oti meionoume te ge apo tis akres tes (del. meionoume te ge ton apiston dinontas ston Mokhammant te nike enantion tous); O Allakh krinei kai tipote den mporei na apotrepsei ten krise Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros sto apologismo (ton praxeon ton doulon Tou, dinontas tous ten antapodose gi' autes).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous ekanan skhedia sunomotontas (enantion ton Aggeliaphoron tous, kai ta skhedia tous etan mataia). O Allakh kuriarkhei pano ap' ola ta skhedia (kai kuriarkhei pano ap' oles tis aities epiteuxes tous, kai etsi, den mporei kanena skhedio na blapsei kanenan ektos an thelei o Allakh, kai to skhedio tou Allakh einai to iskhurotero enantion ton apiston kai tipote den mporei na to apotrepsei). Kserei ti kanei kathe psukhe, kai oi apistoi tha mathoun poios tha ekhei ten kalutere telike katoikia (otan autoi tha mpoun ste Photia, eno oi pistoi tha mpoun ston Paradeiso ste Mellousa Zoe).

Lene oi apistoi (se sena, o, Mokhammant): <<Den eisai Apestalmenos.>> Pes: <<O Allakh arkei os Marturas anamesa se mena kai se sas, kathos kai autoi pou ekhoun (kapoia) gnose ton (proegoumenon) Biblion (apo tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious pou pistepsan se mena gnorizontas tis perigraphes mou kai tis endeixeis tou erkhomou mou).>>

A, L, R [Aliph-Lam-Ra', tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. Auto einai ena Biblio pou sou steilame (o, Prophete), gia na bgaleis tous anthropous apo ta bathe tou skotous sto phos, me ten adeia tou Kuriou tous, sto monopati tou Al-'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos), tou Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).
O Allakh, einai Autos ston Opoio anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste Ge. Alimono stous apistous apo ena austero marturio!

Oi opoioi (apistoi) protimoun ten egkosmia zoe para te Mellousa Zoe, apotrepoun (tous anthropous) apo to dromo (threskeia) tou Allakh, kai epidiokoun na ginei (autos o dromos) strabos (oste na men ton akolouthesei kaneis). Pragmati, ekeinoi ekhoun parastratesei polu makria (apo ten aletheia).

De steilame kanenan Aggeliaphoro para ste glossa tou laou tou gia na dieukrinesei s' autous (o,ti ephere apo ton Kurio tou). O Allakh kanei opoious thelei na parastratesoun kai kathodegei opoious thelei. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Pragmati, ekhoume steilei ton Mouse me ta Semadia Mas (diatazontas ton): <<Bgale ton lao sou apo to bathu skotadi sto phos, kai upenthumise tous tis emeres (ton eunoion) tou Allakh (s' autous).>> Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia kathe polu upomonetiko kai polu eugnomon anthropo.

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<Thumetheite te khare tou Allakh se sas otan sas esose apo tous anthropous tou laou tou Pharao, pou sas ekanan na geuteite ena tromero marturio: esphaxan tous gious sas kai aphesan (tis kores kai) tis gunaikes sas na zesoun (os doules), kai s' auto (oti sas esose ap' autous) uperkhe mia megale dokimasia (kai khare) apo ton Kurio sas (an tha esastan eugnomones meta ap' auto).

Kai (thumetheite) otan o Kurios sas delose xekathara: <<An tha eiste eugnomones (gia tis khares Mou), tha sas auxeso sigoura (se khare)* alla an tha eiste agnomones, pragmati, e timoria Mou einai austere.>>.>>
Kai o Mouses eipe: <<An tha arnetheite ten piste, eseis kai oloi osoi briskontai ste ge, pragmati, o Allakh einai Ganei (Eleutheros apo kathe anagke, Plousios) kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).>>

De sas ephtase e eidese (gia ten katastrophe) ekeinon pou etan prin apo sas, tou laou tou Noe, tes (phules) 'Ant, tes (phules) Thamount kai auton (ton pollon ethnon) pou erthan meta ap' autous - pou kaneis den xerei posa etan para monon o Allakh; Oi Aggeliaphoroi tous erthan s' autous me xekathares apodeixeis, alla ebalan ta kheria tous sto stoma tous (dagkonontas ta dakhtula tous apo thumo) kai eipan: <<Arnoumaste auto me to opoio ekhete stalthei, kai ekhoume amphibolia gi' auto sto opoio mas kaleite, e opoia (amphibolia) mas egeirei te sugkhuse (kai ten kategoria enantion sas oti lete psemata).>>

Oi Aggeliaphoroi tous, eipan: <<Einai dunaton na uparkhei amphibolia gia ton Allakh, ton Demiourgo ton ouranon kai tes Ges; Sas kalei (sten piste) gia na sugkhoresei kapoies apo tis amarties sas kai na sas dosei anabole (me stelnontas se sas mia timoria pou na sas exontosei) mekhri ena prokathorismeno khrono (tou telous tes zoes sas).>> Eipan: <<Eseis den eiste para anthropoi san emas! Thelete na mas apotrepsete apo o,ti (eidola) latreuan oi propatores mas. Pherte mas loipon mia xekathare apodeixe!>>

Tous eipan oi Aggeliaphoroi tous: <<St' aletheia, den eimaste para mono anthropoi san esas. Alla o Allakh parakhorei te khare Tou se opoion thelei apo tous doulous Tou. Den enapokeitai se mas na sas pheroume apodeixe para mono me ten adeia tou Allakh. Kai ton Allakh as empisteutoun oi pistoi.

Kai pos na men empisteuomaste ton Allakh, kathos Autos einai pou mas kathodegese ston pio ortho apo tous dromous! Sigoura tha upomenoume karterika se o,ti mas blaptete. Kai ton Allakh as empisteutoun oi pistoi.>>

Oi apistoi eipan stous Aggeliaphorous tous: <<Sigoura tha sas dioxoume apo te ge mas, ektos an tha epistrepsete ste threskeia mas.>> Tote o Kurios tous tous enepneuse: <<Pragmati, tha katastrepsoume tous adikous.

Kai tha sas kanoume na katoikesete (eseis kai oi opadoi sas) ste ge meta ap' autous.>> Aute (e uposterixe Mou) einai gia opoion phobatai oti tha stathei enopion Mou (gia logodotese ten Emera tes Kriseos) kai phobatai ten proeidopoiese Mou (kai etsi terei tis entoles Mou).
Kai (oi Aggeliaphoroi) epikalestekan (ton Allakh) gia nike, kai etsi, ekhase (kai katastrapheke) kathe peismatares adikos (kai alazonikos).
Ton perimenei (auton ton adiko) mprosta tou e Kolase kai tha tou dothei na piei (mesa tes) apo nero pou einai puon kai aima (ton plegon ton katoikon tes Photias).

Tha to piei (to puon, anagkasmenos) me megale duskolia (logo tes entones pikradas, zestes kai bromas tou) kai duskola tha to katapiei (me uperbolike dusareskeia, kai auto to poto tha tou kopsei ta entera tou kai tha bgei xana apo to soma tou). O thanatos tha tou erthei apo kathe kateuthunse, alla de tha pethanei. Kai mprosta tou tha einai ena sklero marturio.

To paradeigma ton (kalon) praxeon ekeinon pou arnethekan ten piste ston Kurio tous einai san ekeino tes stakhtes pou te khtupese enas dunatos anemos se mia thuellode mera (kai etsi exaphanisteke). De tha mporoun na paroun e na broun tipota apo o,ti ekanan (epeide oi kales praxeis prepei na ekhoun os base te soste piste ston Allakh). Auto (pou ekanan apo kales praxeis khoris alethine piste) einai e (xekathare) plane pou einai polu makria (apo ten aletheia).

De blepeis (o, anthrope) oti o Allakh demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge me ten aletheia (kai okhi askopa); An thelei, mporei na sas aphairesei kai na pherei (anti esas) mia nea demiourgia (pou tha Ton upakouei kai tha Ton latreuei).
Kai auto den einai duskolo gia ton Allakh.

(Ten Emera tes Kriseos) oloi (oi anthropoi tha bgoun apo tous taphous tous kai) tha parousiastoun enopion tou Allakh. Oi adunamoi tha poun s' autous pou etan alazonikoi: <<Emastan oi akolouthoi sas, tha mas prostatepsete loipon se otidepote enantia sten timoria tou Allakh;>> Tha poun (oi alazonikoi): <<An mas eikhe kathodegesei o Allakh, tha sas eikhame kathodegesei (alla protimesame ten plane kai etsi sas paraplanesame). Einai to idio kai gia mas kai gia sas, eite de tha mporoume na antexoume to marturio, eite tha upomenoume karterika, de tha uparkhei gia mas kamia diaphuge!>>

Ki otan tha teleiosei to thema (me to na mpoun oi pistoi ston Paradeiso kai oi apistoi ste Photia), o Satanas tha pei: <<Pragmati, o Allakh sas eikhe uposkhethei ten alethine uposkhese, eno ego sas eikha uposkhethei, alla athetesa ten uposkhese mou se sas. Den eikha kamia exousia (e duname) pano sas, ektos tou oti sas kalesa, ki eseis me akolouthesate. Opote me me kategoreite, alla kategoreiste ton eauto sas. Oute tha sas soso, oute tha me sosete. Aparnoumai tis praxeis sas otan me apodidate prin os etairo ston Allakh ste latreia (kai sten upakoe). Pragmati, oi adikoi tha ekhoun ena epoduno marturio.>>

Osoi pisteuoun kai kanoun kales praxeis tha eisakhthoun se kepous (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta, me ten adeia tou Kuriou tous. O khairetismos tous ekei tha einai <<Eirene!>>

Den eides (o, Prophete) pos edose o Allakh to paradeigma enos kalou logou (la ilakha illa Allakh -den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh-) oti einai san (to paradeigma) enos kalou dentrou (khourmadias); E riza tou einai stathere (ste ge) kai ta kladia tou pros ton ourano.

Apodidei tous karpous tou ole ten ora me ten adeia tou Kuriou tou (etsi einai e riza tes pistes stathere sten kardia tou pistou, eno ta kladia tes apo tis kales praxeis anebainoun ston ourano ole ten ora). O Allakh dinei paradeigmata stous anthropous, isos na ta laboun upopse (kai na laboun nouthesia).

Alla to paradeigma enos kakou logou (tes apistias) einai san (to paradeigma) enos kakou dentrou (anarrikhomenou sten epiphaneia tes ges), pou xerizotheke apo ten epiphaneia tes ges, (epeide) den eikhe bathies rizes.

O Allakh statheropoiei tous pistous ston stathero Logo (la ilakha illa Allakh -den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh-) sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. O Allakh kanei tous adikous na parastratoun (makria apo ten kathodegese), kai o Allakh kanei o,ti thelei.

Den eides (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous apistous apo ton lao sou, Kourais) pou antallaxan tis eunoies tou Allakh (s' autous) me apistia (arnoumenoi ten piste, aphou se esteile o Allakh s' autous) kai odegesan ton lao tous ston oiko tes katastrophes;
(O opoios oikos) einai e Kolase, opou tha eisakhthoun gia na kaoun mesa tes, poso athlia einai aute os monime diamone!

Apedidan (oi apistoi) antipalous (kai omoious kai etairous) ston Allakh gia na paraplanesoun tous anthropous apo ton dromo (threskeia) Tou. Pes (o, Prophete): <<Apolauste (gia ligo)! O telikos proorismos sas tha einai e Photia.>>

Pes (o, Prophete) stous doulous Mou pou pisteuoun, na teloun ten proseukhe kai na xodepsoun apo o,ti tous parekhoume, krupha kai phanera, protou erthei mia Emera pou de tha uparxei kamia sunallage (de tha mporei kaneis na dosei lutra gia na sosei ton eauto tou apo ten timoria), oute kamia philia (gia na diamesolabesei kaneis gia ton philo tou)!

O Allakh einai Autos pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge kai esteile kato nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano, me to opoio (nero) ebgale (apo te ge) karpous os agatha gia sas. Upetaxe se sas ta ploia gia na diaskhizoun te thalassa (gia ta sumpheronta sas) me ten entole Tou, kai upetaxe se sas ta potamia (gia na pieite eseis kai ta booeide sas).

Upetaxe se sas ton elio kai to pheggari, pou trekhoun sunekheia sten poreia tous (diadokhika gia ta sumpheronta sas), kai upetaxe se sas ten nukhta (gia ten xekourase kai ton upno sas) kai ten emera (gia tis apaskholeseis sas).

Sas edose polla apo ola osa zetesate (kai apo o,ti de zetesate, alla ta khreiazeste ste zoe sas). An prospathesete na metresete tis khares tou Allakh (se sas), de tha mporeite na tis metresete. Pragmati, o anthropos einai adikos (pros ton eauto tou me tis amarties tou) kai akharistos (gia tis khares tou Allakh).
Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) otan o Impraem (Abraam) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Kane auten ten pole (te Makka) asphale, kai krata emena kai ta paidia mou makria apo te latreia ton eidolon.

Kurie mou! Pragmati, auta (ta eidola) paraplanesan pollous anthropous [pou nomizan oti ta agalmata pou ephtiaxan gia tous apothanontes enaretous tha einai oi diamesolabetes tous pros ton Allakh, alla me ton parodo tou khronou, ta latreuan]. Opoios loipon me akolouthei, einai apo mena (del. apo tous opadous mou). Alla opoios me parakouei, tote pragmati, Esu eisai (gia opoious theleis) Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Kurie mas! Ekana merikous apo tous apogonous mou (ton Ismael kai tous apogonous tou meta) na katoikesoun se mia koilada khoris kalliergeia (oute nero) konta ston Aparabato Oiko Sou (ste Makka). Kurie mas! (To ekana upo ten entole Sou) gia na ekteloun ten proseukhe (ston Oiko Sou). Kane loipon tis kardies pollon anthropon na thelesoun na pane me agape pros autous, kai parakhorese s' autous apo tous karpous, isos kai na einai eugnomones (pros Esena).
Kurie mas! Pragmati, gnorizeis o,ti kruboume mesa mas kai o,ti phaneronoume. Tipota den einai krupho apo ton Allakh, oute ste ge, oute ston ourano.
Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh pou mou kharise, para te megale mou elikia, ton Ismael kai ton Isaak. Pragmati, o Kurios mou einai o Panakouos ton epikleseon.
Kurie mou! Kane me stathero sten proseukhe, (epises) kai tous apogonous mou. Kurie mas! Dexou tis epikleseis mou (kai antapokrisou s' autes).
Kurie mas! Sugkhorese emena, tous goneis mou kai tous pistous ten Emera pou tha ginei o apologismos.>>

Men nomizeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh agnoei o,ti kanoun oi adikoi (otan anaballei ten timoria tous)! [Edo einai mia proeidopoiese gia ton adiko kai paregoria gia ton adikemeno]. Tous anaballei mono gia mia Emera pou ta matia tha koitoun orthanoikhta pros ta pano (me phrike kai khoris na anoigokleinoun).

(Ekeine ten Emera oi anthropoi tha bgoun apo tous taphous tous kai) tha trexoun (pros auton pou tous kalei) me sekomena ta kephalia tous, ta matia tous (tha koitoun pros ton ourano me phobo kai) de tha epistrepsoun pros autous kai oi kardies tous tha einai adeies (logo tes phrikes).

(O, Prophete) proeidopoiese tous anthropous gia ten Emera pou tha tous erthei to marturio, kai oi adikoi tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Dose mas anabole gia ligo khrono, gia na antapokrithoume sto kalesma Sou kai na akolouthesoume tous Aggeliaphorous!>> [Tha eipothei s' autous:] <<Ma den orkistekate prin (sten egkosmia zoe) oti de tha uparkhei gia sas kamia metabase (apo ten egkosmia zoe pros te Mellousa Zoe, kai diapseusate ten anastase);

Kai zousate stis katoikies ekeinon (ton proegoumenon ethnon) pou adikesan ton eauto tous (me ten apistia), kai sas egine saphes pos kaname ten timoria s' autous, kai sas dosame paradeigmata (oste na labete nouthesia).>>

Pragmati, (oi apistoi) ekanan to skhedio tous sunomotontas (na skotosoun ton Prophete), alla o Allakh perikuklose to skhedio tous me te gnose (kai te duname) Tou (kai etsi de tha mporesoun na kanoun tipote). Kai de tha mporouse to skhedio tous na metakinesei ta bouna (logo tes adunamias tou).

Pote men nomizeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh tha athetouse ten uposkhese Tou (gia nike) pros tous Aggeliaphorous Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Ikanos gia antapodose.

(Kai aute e antapodose tha einai) ten Emera pou e Ge tha allakhtei m' alle diaphoretike Ge, to idio kai oi ouranoi, kai (oi anthropoi tha bgoun apo tous taphous tous kai) tha parousiastoun enopion tou Allakh, tou Al-Ouakheint (Enas), tou Al-Kakhar (Pantodunamos pou upotassei ta panta).
Ekeine ten Emera tha deis (o, Prophete) tous kakous (apistous) demenous mazi, me alusides (kai me ta kheria kai ta podia demena).
Ta roukha tous (ton apiston) tha einai apo pissa kai e Photia tha kalupsei ta prosopa tous.
Gia na antapodosei o Allakh se kathe psukhe o,ti ekane. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros ston upologismo (ton praxeon ton doulon Tou, kai gia na tous antapodosei gi' autes).

Auto to (Kor'an) einai ena menuma gia olous tous anthropous, kai gia na proeidopoiethoun m' auto kai na gnorizoun oti uparkhei mono Enas Theos (pou axizei na latreuetai), kai gia na to laboun upopse (kai na laboun nouthesia) ekeinoi pou ekhoun (ugies kai ortho) mualo.

A, L, R [Aliph-Lam-Ra', tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. Auta einai ta Edaphia tou Bibliou kai tou xekatharou Kor'an.
Poso tha eukhethoun oi apistoi (ten Emera tes Kriseos) na etan Mousoulmanoi (sten egkosmia zoe)!
Aphese tous loipon (o, Prophete) na trone kai na diaskedazoun kai na tous apaskholei e elpida (tous gia tis egkosmies apolauseis kai ten paramone sten egkosmia zoe), suntoma tha mathoun!
Pote den katastrepsame kamia (adike) komopole ektos na uperkhe gi' auten enas prokathorismenos khronos (ste Gnose tou Allakh gia ten katastrophe tes).
Kanena ethnos de tha katastraphei prin ton erkhomo tou prokathorismenou khronou tou, oute tha laboun (oi anthropoi tou) kamia anabole (meta ton erkhomo tou).

Kai eipan (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant, se sena): <<O, esu ston opoio ekhei stalei e Upenthumise (to Kor'an), pragmati, eisai paraphron (pou mas kaleis na se akolouthoume kai na aphesoume ta eidola kai tous theous mas)!
Giati den mas pherneis Aggelous (gia na marturesoun oti eisai Aggeliaphoros), an eisai pragmati apo tous eilikrineis!>>

De stelnoume tous Aggelous para mono me ten aletheia (me to Theio Menuma stous Aggeliaphorous e me ten timoria stous apistous), kai (otan tous stelnoume me ten timoria stous apistous) tote de tha tous dothei kamia anabole.
Pragmati, Emeis eimaste pou steilame ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) kai Emeis eimaste pou tha ten prostatepsoume (apo to na alloiothei e na khathei).
Pragmati, steilame (Aggeliophorous) prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) sta proegoumena ethne.
Den tous erthe kanenas Aggeliaphoros, para na ton khleuazan.

(Opos eisagame ten arnese stis kardies ton proegoumenon ethnon epeide diepseudan tous Aggeliaphorous tous peismatika), etsi eisagoume aute (ten arnese) stis kardies ton kakon (apiston apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant).

De tha pistepsoun s' auto (to Kor'an mekhri na doun ten timoria). Pragmati, o kanonas (tou Allakh, oti stelnei ten timoria stous apistous) ekhei perasei sta proegoumena ethne (as to laboun upopse loipon oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant).
Akoma kai an anoigame gi' autous (tous apistous) mia porta ston ourano kai sunekhizan mesa tes na anebainoun (kai na doun apo ta Semadia tou Basileiou tou Allakh),
(pali de tha pisteuan kai) tha elegan: <<Ta matia mas einai magemena. Pragmati, den eimaste para magemenoi anthropoi (pou mas magepse o Mokhammant)!>>
Pragmati, ekhoume topothetesei megala asteria (kai asterismous) ston ourano kai ton stolisame gia tous theates,
kai ton ekhoume phulaxei apo kathe katarameno diabolo,
ektos ap' ekeinon (ton diabolo) pou kruphakouse (tous Aggelous ston ourano), tote amesos ton akolouthei (kai ton kunegaei) ena lampro pephtasteri.
Kai aplosame te ge (gia na egkatastatheite, o, anthropoi) kai topothetesame s' auten stathera bouna, kai phutrosame s' auten apo ola (ta phuta) me te deousa analogia.
Kai kaname s' aute (te ge) mesa bioporismou gia sas kai gia osous den tous parekhete mesa bioporismou (del. ta alla plasmata).

Den uparkhei kanena pragma pou na men katekhoume to thesaurophulakio tou (del. Emeis pou to demiourgoume kai to katekhoume pleros kai to stelnoume s' ola ta plasmata), kai den to stelnoume para mono me kathorismeno poso (pou ekhoume orisei).

Kai stelnoume tous anemous gia na gonimopoioun [ta sunnepha me nero], meta stelnoume nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano (apo ta sunnepha) kai etsi sas to dinoume gia na pieite, kai den mporeite na to apothekeusete (alla Emeis pou to apothekeuoume se peges kai potamia apo to na khathei bathia ste ge, kai den mporeite na to apotrepsete apo opoious tous to dinoume).
Pragmati, Emeis eimaste pou dinoume te zoe kai ten aphairoume, kai Emeis eimaste oi Kleronomoi (tes Ges kai oson briskontai pano tes otan ola ta plasmata tha pethanoun).
Pragmati, gnorizoume osous apo sas ekhoun perasei kai gnorizoume osous tha erthoun akome.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) einai Autos pou tha tous sugkentrosei olous (ten Emera tes Kriseos). Pragmati, Autos einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Pragmati, demiourgesame ton anthropo (ton Adam) apo xero pelo (san ta keramika), phtiagmeno apo maure laspe (pou emeine polu kairo mekhri) pou allaxe e murodia kai to khroma tes.
Kai ton tzinn (ton Implis, ton patera ton tzinn) ton eikhame demiourgesei prin (na demiourgesoume ton Adam), apo akapne puraktomene photia.

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Kurios sou eipe stous Aggelous: <<Tha demiourgeso enan anthropo apo xero pelo (san ta keramika), phtiagmeno apo maure laspe (pou emeine polu kairo mekhri) pou allaxe e murodia kai to khroma tes.

Otan ton diamorphoso kai tou emphuseso to pneuma pou demiourgesa, tote peste oloi mprosta tou se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, os khairetismo, sebasmo kai time pros auton).>>
Etsi, oloi oi Aggeloi epesan se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos),
ektos apo ton Implis (-ton Satana- pou etan tzinn kai okhi Aggelos), arnetheke na einai mazi m' ekeinous (tous Aggelous) pou epesan se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos).
(O Allakh) eipe: <<O, Implis! Ti se empodise apo to na eisai mazi m' ekeinous pou epesan se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos);>>

Eipe (o Implis -o Satanas-): <<Pote de tha epephta se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) enopion enos anthropou pou ton demiourgeses apo xero pelo (san ta keramika), phtiagmeno apo maure laspe (pou emeine polu kairo mekhri) pou allaxe e murodia kai to khroma tes!>>
Eipe (o Allakh): <<Bges loipon ap' aute (te these sou anamesa stous Aggelous). Pragmati, eisai kataramenos kai diogmenos,
kai e katara tha einai epano sou mekhri ten Emera tes Kriseos.>>
(O Satanas) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Dose mou anabole mekhri ten Emera pou tha anastethoun (oi anthropoi, oi apogonoi tou Adam).>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Eisai enas ap' autous pou tha laboun anabole,
mekhri ten Emera tou Kathorismenou Khronou.>>
(O Satanas) eipe: <<O, Kurie mou! Epeide me ekanes na parastrateso, pragmati tha oraiopoieso gi' autous (tis amarties kai tis apolauseis) ste ge, kai tha tous paraplaneso olous (tous anthropous),
ektos ap' tous eklektous (alethinous pistous) doulous Sou anamesa tous.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Autos einai enas isios dromos pou odegei se Mena.
Pragmati, de tha ekheis kamia exousia pano stous doulous Mou, ektos pano s' ekeinous pou tha se akolouthesoun apo tous paraplanemenous.>>
Kai pragmati e Kolase tha einai to uposkhomeno meros gia olous tous (del. ton Satana kai olous osous ton akolouthesan).
E opoia (Kolase) ekhei epta pules, gia kathe pule uparkhei enas kathorismenos arithmos (anthropon).
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) tha briskontai se kepous kai peges (ston Paradeiso).
(Tha eipothei s' autous:) <<Mpeite s' auton (ton Paradeiso) me eirene kai asphaleia!>>

Tha aphairesoume opoiodepote misos (e ekhthroteta) apo tis kardies tous. Tha einai adelphia, kathismenoi se krebatia (o kathenas sto megalo stolismeno krebati tou) o enas apenanti apo ton allon (del. kaneis de tha dosei ten plate tou ston allon).
Kamia kourase de tha tous aggixei mesa tou (ston Paradeiso), oute tha diokhthoun pote ap' auton.
(O, Prophete) enemerose tous doulous Mou oti pragmati Ego eimai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Kai oti to marturio Mou einai pragmati to pio odunero marturio.
Kai enemerose tous gia tous (Aggelous) episkeptes tou Abraam.

Otan mpekan sto meros tou (Abraam) kai eipan: <<Salam (Eirene)!>> [Alla otan tous prosephere phageto kai eide oti den trone, khoris na xerei oti einai Aggeloi, nomize oti theloun na ton skotosoun kai] eipe: <<Pragmati, phobomaste apo sas!>>
Eipan: <<Me phobasai. Pragmati, sou dinoume kharoumena nea gia ena agori (ton Isaak) pou tha ekhei polu gnose (ste threskeia).>>
Eipe: <<Mou dosate kharoumena nea (oti tha ekho ena agori) para ta gerateia mou; Gia poio pragma, loipon, mou dinete kharoumena nea!>>
Eipan: <<Sou ekhoume dosei kharmosuna nea me ten aletheia, gi' auto men eisai ap' ekeinous pou apelpizontai!>>
Eipe: <<(Den eimai ap' ekeinous pou apelpizontai), kai poios tha apelpizotan apo to eleos tou Kuriou tou para mono oi paraplanemenoi!>>
Eipe: <<Poio einai loipon to thema sas (gia to opoio stalthekate), o, Apestalmenoi;>>
Eipan: <<Ekhoume stalei se enan kako lao (gia na ton katastrepsoume),
ektos apo ten oikogeneia tou Lot, pou tha tous sosoume olous (kai tha tous bgaloume apo ten komopole),
ektos apo te gunaika tou, ekhoume krinei (me ten entole tou Allakh) oti tha einai anamesa s' ekeinous pou tha meinoun piso (sten katastrophe).>>
Otan oi (Aggeloi) Aggeliaphoroi erthan sten oikogeneia tou Lot (me anthropine morphe),
Eipe (o Lot): <<Pragmati! Eiste agnostoi anthropoi (se mena).>>
Eipan: <<Okhi (me phobasai), alla erthame se sena (gia na katastrepsoume ton lao sou) m' ekeine (ten timoria) gia ten opoia amphebalan.
Erthame se sena me ten aletheia, kai eimaste pragmati eilikrineis.

Bges loipon me ten oikogeneia sou se mia skoteine ora tes nukhtas, kai perpata piso tous (tous suggeneis sou) kai kanenas apo sas den prepei na koitaxei piso, kai pegainete opou tha sas diatakhthei.>>
Ton enemerosame apokaluptontas auto to diatagma (pou diataxame) oti autoi (oi anthropoi tou laou tou) tha exontothoun noris to proi.>>
Oi katoikoi tes poles (Sodoma) erthan (ston Lot) kharoumenoi (thelontas na diapraxoun ten omophulophilia me tous episkeptous tou, aphou emathan gia ten omorphia tous apo te gunaika tou).
(O Lot) eipe (ston lao tou): <<Autoi einai oi kalesmenoi mou, opote me me ntropiazete.
Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai me me atimasete (skhetika me tous kalesmenous mou).>>
Eipan: <<De sou apagoreusame na philoxeneis (kai na prostateueis) opoiondepote apo tous anthropous (odoiporous, epeide emeis tous theloume);>>
Eipe: <<Na tes oi kores mou (del. oi gunaikes tes phules gia na tis pantreuteite, einai pio agnes gia sas apo tous andres) an thelete na to kanete (del. na ikanopoiesete tis anagkes sas).>>
Ma te zoe sou (o, Mokhammant)! Periplanethekan tuphla sten plane (kai ten agnoia kai tous pothous) tous.
Etsi tous katestrepse e megale krauge ten ora tes anatoles,
kai (anapodogurisame ten komopole tous kai) kaname ta psela mere tes na einai ta kato mere tes, kai rixame pano tous petres apo sklero psemeno pelo.
Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gi' ekeinous pou sullogizontai.
Kai aute (e pole tous, Sodoma) brisketai se stathero dromo (kai ten blepoun oi taxidiotes pou pernoun apo ekei).
Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto Semadi gia tous pistous.
Pragmati, kai oi katoikoi tes komopoles ton strimmenon dentron (konta ste Madiam) etan adikoi (apistoi, kai stous opoious staltheke o Prophetes Sou'aimp opos staltheke ste Madiam).
Tous ekdikethekame. Ekeines oi duo (e komopole tou Lot kai e komopole ton strimmenon dentron) briskontai se enan xekatharo dromo (gia opoion pernaei apo ekei).
Pragmati, kai (e phule Thamount) oi katoikoi tes (koiladas) Al-Khitzr (anamesa ste Khitzaz kai to Lebante) diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Prophete Salikh).
Tous steilame ta Semadia Mas (pou epibebaionan ten apostole tou Salikh), alla ekeinoi apomakrunthekan ap' auta.
Skalisan spitia sta bouna, kai etan asphaleis.
Alla, tous katestrepse e megale krauge to proi.
Kai den tous prostatepsan se tipota (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) auta pou kerdisan (apo ploute kai spitia).

De demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te Ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous para mono me ten aletheia (kai okhi askopa). Pragmati, e Ora erkhetai oposdepote (gia na labei o kathenas ten antamoibe e ten timoria tou), gi' auto sugkhorese (o, Mokhammant) me mia kale sugkhorese (ekeinous pou se diapseudoun, kai men antimetopizeis to kako tous me to kako, alla me to kalo).
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) einai o Al-Khallak (Demiourgos ton panton), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Pragmati, sou dosame (o, Mokhammant) ephta (Edaphia tes Sourat Al-Phatikha) apo ta sukhna epanalambanomena (Edaphia tou Kor'an pou epanalambanoun tous kanones, ta Semadia, tis apodeixeis, tis eideseis, tis nouthesies kai ta aorata) kai olo to Megalo Kor'an.

Men koitas (o, Mokhammant) stis (pheugalees) apolauseis pou ekhoume dosei se orismenes omades ap' autous (tous apistous), oute na lupasai gi' autous (gia ten apistia tous kai gia ten diapseuse pou kanoun enantion sou), kai na eisai epieikes me tous pistous.
Kai pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, ego eimai o proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei xekathara.>>
(Kai proeidopoiese, o, Mokhammant, tous eidololatres gia mia timoria) opos steilame (prin) s' ekeinous pou diakhorisan (ta Theia Biblia, pisteuontas se ena meros tous kai aporriptontas allo).
Oi opoioi (eidololatres) diakhorisan to Kor'an (sta logia tous, legontas einai mageia, manteia, poiese e muthoi ton arkhaion).
Ma ton Kurio sou! Pragmati, tha tous kalesoume olous na logodotesoun,
gia o,ti ekanan.

Epomenos keruxe anoikhta auto pou diatakhthekes (to Menuma Tou Allakh), kai apomakrunsou ap' ekeinous pou apodidoun ston Allakh etairous ste latreia (kai men dineis semasia se o,ti lene kai o,ti kanoun gia na se apotrepsoun apo to Menuma tou Allakh).
Pragmati, Emeis eparkoume na se prostatepsoume apo tous khleuastes.
Oi opoioi thetoun ektos tou Allakh kai allon theo (pou ton latreuoun kai ton epikalountai ektos tou Allakh). Pragmati, tha mathoun (tis sunepeies ton praxeon tous).
Pragmati, xeroume oti to stethos sou steneuei m' auta pou lene (khleuazontas kai diapseudontas esena).
Doxaze, loipon, ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton, kai na eisai ap' ekeinous pou pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos enopion Tou).
Kai na latreueis ton Kurio sou, mekhri na erthei se sena to bebaio (o thanatos).

To diatagma tou Allakh (del. e timoria pou orise gia sas, o, apistoi) erkhetai, epomenos me biasteite na erthei noritera. Doxa s' Auton einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (apo pseutikous theous ste latreia)!

Stelnei tous Aggelous me ten apokalupse tes entoles Tou se opoion thelei apo tous doulous Tou, me oti: <<Proeidopoieste (o, Aggeliaphoroi, tous anthropous) oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Ego! Gi' auto phulakhtheite (o, anthropoi) apo ten timoria Mou (terontas tis entoles Mou).>>
Demiourgese tous ouranous kai te Ge me ten aletheia (kai os endeixe tes Dunames Tou kai okhi askopa). Einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (apo pseutikous theous ste latreia)!

Demiourgese ton anthropo apo mia (aduname) Noutpha (stagones apo anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon), kai epeita autos (ginetai alazonikos kai akharistos kai) diaphonei sklera (me ten aletheia) kai phaneronei (te diaphonia tou uperaspizomenos ten plane kai diapseudontas ten anastase)!
Demiourgese kai ta booeide (gia sas), ekhete ap' auta zestasia (roukhismo) kai alla ophele, kai ap' auta trote.
Kai ekhete s' auta omorphia (kai eukharistese) otan ta phernete to bradu sta mantria kai otan ta bgazete to proi gia boske.
Kai metapheroun ta baria sas phortia se alle pole pou de tha mporousate na te phtasate para me megale duskolia. Pragmati, o Kurios sas einai Ra'ouph (Poluepieikes) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Kai (demiourgese) ta aloga, ta moularia kai ta gaidouria gia na ta kabalesete kai os stolismo (gia sas otan ta kabalate), kai demiourgei kai alla (demiourgemata) pou de gnorizete.

Ston Allakh enapokeitai to na deixei ton isio dromo (tou Islam, epeita opoios kathodegeitai einai gia to kalo tou, kai opoios parastratei tha einai eis baros tou). Kai ap' autous (tous dromous) uparkhoun kapoioi (dromoi) pou parekklinoun (apo ten aletheia). An ethele (o Allakh), tha sas eikhe kathodegesei olous!
Einai Autos pou stelnei nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano, apo to opoio pinete, kai apo to opoio megalonoun dentra (kai phuta) anamesa sta opoia boskeite (ta booeide sas).
Phutronei gia sas m' auto (to nero) kalliergeies, elies, khourmadies, ampelia kai apo olous tous karpous. Pragmati, uparkhei Semadi s' auto gia tous anthropous pou sullogizontai.

Kai upetaxe gia sas te nukhta (gia na xekourasteite), ten emera (gia tis ergasies sas), ton elio kai te selene (gia na ekhete phos kai gia na xerete tous khronous), kai ta asteria upotagmena (gia sas) me ten entole Tou (gia na sas kathodegesoun sta taxidia sas ste steria kai ste thalassa). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia tous anthropous me katanoese.

Kai (upetaxe gia sas) o,ti ekhei demiourgesei gia sas ste Ge me diaphora khromata (apo karpous, booeide, kalliergeies kai metalla). Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto Semadi gia tous anthropous pou tha to laboun upopse.

Einai Autos pou upetaxe te thalassa, gia na trote ap' auten malako kreas (psariou) kai na bgalete ap' auten stolidia gia na ta phoresete. Kai blepeis ta ploia na ten diaskhizoun, (sta opoia ploia epibibazeste) gia na anazetesete (mesa bioporismou) apo te gennaiodoria Tou, kai isos na eiste eugnomones (me oles autes tis khares kai na latreuete mono Auton).
Kai topothetese ste Ge stathera bouna gia (te statheropoioun kai) na men tremei me sas, kai (ekane na reoun mesa tes) potamia kai (demiourgese) monopatia, mepos kai kathodegetheite (sto dromo sas).
Kai (ekane) toposema (apo bouna klp. gia na kathodegountai oi anthropoi sto dromo tous ten emera) kai me ta asteria kathodegountai (ten nukhta).
Einai Autos (o Allakh) pou demiourgei Isos m' auton pou de demiourgei; De tha to labete upopse loipon;
An prospathesete na metresete tis khares tou Allakh, de tha mporesete pote na tis metresete. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei o,ti sugkaluptete kai o,ti phaneronete.
Pragmati, ekeinoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou tous epikalountai (oi eidololatres) ektos tou Allakh de demiourgoun tipota, alla oi idioi demiourgountai (apo tous eidololatres).
(Auta ta eidola) einai nekra, okhi zontana, kai oute gnorizoun pote tha anastethoun.

O (Alethinos) Theos sas (pou mono Autos axizei na latreuetai) einai Enas Theos. Oso gi' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, oi kardies tous arnountai (auto, epeide de phobountai apo ten timoria tou Allakh) kai einai oi idioi alazonikoi.
Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei o,ti sugkaluptoun kai o,ti phaneronoun. Pragmati, Autos de sumpathei tous alazonikous.
Otan legetai s' autous: <<Ti esteile o Kurios sas (ston Mokhammant);>> Lene: <<(Den esteile tipote, alla einai o Mokhammant pou mas parousiazei) tous muthous ton arkhaion!>>

Gia na pheroun pleros tis amarties tous ten Emera tes Anastases kai meros apo tis amarties ekeinon pou paraplanesan khoris gnose (del. tis ises amarties ton opadon tous pou skhetizontai me ten plane tous, khoris na meiothei tipote apo tis amarties ton opadon). Poso athlio einai auto pou pheroun apo amarties!

Pragmati, ekeinoi (oi apistoi) pou etan prin ap' autous sunomotousan (enantion ton Aggeliaphoron tous), etsi o Allakh xerizose ta ktiria tous apo ta themelia, kai etsi epesan oi steges pano tous, kai tous erthe e timoria apo ekei pou den ten perimenan!

Epeita, ten Emera tes Anastases, tha tous atimasei (o Allakh) kai tha pei: <<Pou einai oi (legomenoi) etairoi Mou, gia khare ton opoion deixate ekhthroteta (stous Aggeliaphorous Mou);>> Ekeinoi stous opoious dotheke gnose tha poun: <<Pragmati, e atimose semera kai to kako tha einai pano stous apistous.>>

Oso gi' ekeinous pou tous aphairoun oi Aggeloi tis zoes tous, eno adikoun ton eauto tous (menontas sten apistia) kai etsi paradothekan (sten entole tou Allakh, tha poun): <<Den kaname tipota kako.>> [Nomizontas oti etsi tha sothoun, alla tha eipothei s' autous]: <<Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou eipate), alla pragmati o Allakh gia o,ti kanate einai Pantognostes!
Mpeite loipon stis pules tes Kolases, opou tha meinete ekei mesa gia panta. Poso athlia einai e katoikia ton alazonikon!>>

Oso gi' ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), tha eipothei s' autous: <<Ti esteile o Kurios sas (ston Mokhammant);>> Tha poun: <<To (megalo) kalo.>> Ekeinoi pou prattoun to kalo, tha laboun s' aute ten egkosmia zoe mia kale antamoibe, kai pragmati, e Mellousa Zoe einai polu kalutere. Ti uperokhe einai e katoikia ekeinon pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh!

Tha mpoun stous kepous monimes diamones (Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Tha ekhoun ekei o,ti epithumoun. Etsi antameibei o Allakh ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).
Oso gi' ekeinous pou tous aphairoun oi Aggeloi tis zoes tous eno einai agnoi (apo ten apistia), tha tous poun: <<Eirene se sas. Mpeite ston Paradeiso gia o,ti kanate (apo kales praxeis).>>

Perimenoun (oi apistoi) mono to na tous erthoun oi Aggeloi (pou tha tous aphairesoun te zoe) e na erthei e entole (e timoria) tou Kuriou sou; Etsi ekanan kai ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous (kai tous katestrepse o Allakh). Den tous adikese o Allakh (me ten katastrophe tous), alla ekeinoi etan pou adikesan ton eauto tous (me ten apistia tous)!
Tous eplexan oi kakes sunepeies (kai oi timories) ton praxeon pou dieprattan, kai tous perikuklose auto (to marturio) pou sunethizan na khleuazoun.

Ekeinoi pou apodidoun ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, lene: <<Ean ethele o Allakh, de tha latreuame oute emeis oute oi propatores mas tipote allo ektos ap' Auton, oute tha apagoreuame tipota khoris ten entole Tou.>> To idio ekanan (kai eipan) ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous. Uparkhei stous Aggeliaphorous kamia alle euthune para na diadosoun xekathara to menuma;

Pragmati, ekhoume steilei se kathe ethnos enan Aggeliaphoro, (me ten entole) oti: <<Na latreuete mono ton Allakh kai na apopheugete oles tis pseutikes theotetes.>>, etsi, kapoioi ap' autous (tous anthropous) tous kathodegese o Allakh, kai kapoioi alloi (arnethekan ten piste kai) axizan ten plane. Perpateste (kai taxidepste) loipon ste ge (o, anthropoi) gia na deite pos etan to telos auton pou diepseudan (tous Aggeliaphorous apo ta proegoumena ethne)!

Oso prothumos kai na eisai (o, Prophete) na tous kathodegeseis, pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei autous pou tous kanei na parastratesoun, kai de tha ekhoun uposteriktes (apenanti sten timoria tou Allakh).

Orkizontai ston Allakh me polu zelo ston orko tous oti o Allakh de tha anastesei autous pou pethainoun. Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou lene), alla (bebaia tha to kanei kai) einai mia alethine uposkhese ap' Auton, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.

(Tha tous anastesei olous) gia na diasaphenisei s' autous auto gia to opoio diaphonousan (skhetika me ten alethine threskeia), kai gia na xeroun oi apistoi oti etan pseutes (otan iskhuristekan oti o Allakh ekhei etairous kai oti de tha anastesei tous nekrous)!
Pragmati, o Logos Mas se kati otan to theloume (na ginei kai na uparxei) einai oti mono leme s' auto: <<Genetheto!>> kai etsi ginetai!

Ekeinoi pou (aphesan tis periousies tous kai) metanasteusan (apo te Makka) gia khare tou Allakh aphou katapiestekan (kai basanistekan apo tous apistous ekei), pragmati, tha tous egkatastesoume se kalutero meros (ste Mantina) sten egkosmia zoe, alla kai e antamoibe tes Mellousas Zoes einai megalutere, an exeran (ekeinoi pou akoma den metanasteusan, tha espeudan na metanasteusoun).
(Ekeinoi pou metanasteusan) einai autoi pou upemeinan karterika kai empisteuontai ton Kurio tous.

Pragmati, de steilame prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) para mono andres (Aggeliaphorous), stous opoious apokalupsame. (An eseis, o, apistoi, lete oti o Allakh de tha estelne enan anthropo os Aggeliaphoro), roteste loipon ekeinous ton proegoumenon Theion Biblion (tes Toras kai tou In-tzel -tou prototupou Euaggeliou tou Iesou- an oi Aggeliaphoroi pou esteile o Allakh prin etan anthropoi e Aggeloi) an de gnorizete!

(Steilame tous Aggeliaphorous) me xekathares apodeixeis kai Theia Biblia, kai steilame se sena (o, Mokhammant) ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) gia na diasapheniseis stous anthropous auto pou tous ekhei stalei, kai isos na sullogistoun.
Ekeinoi pou skhediasan tis kakes sunomosies, aisthanontai asphaleis apo to na kanei o Allakh te ge na tous katapiei e na tous erthei e timoria apo ekei pou den perimenoun;

E (aisthanontai asphaleis) apo to na steilei (o Allakh) s' autous ten timoria xaphnika kata te diarkeia ton askholion kai ton taxidion tous; Pragmati, (otan tha pesei e timoria) de tha mporoun na tes xephugoun.

E (aisthanontai asphaleis) apo to na steilei (o Allakh) s' autous ten timoria kata te diarkeia tou phobou tous (ap' auten kai eno ten perimenoun); Pragmati, o Kurios sas einai Ra'ouph (Poluepieikes) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos) [pou den epispeudei ten timoria stous doulous Tou dinontas tous eukairies na straphoun me metameleia].
De blepoun oti o,ti demiourgese o Allakh (apo demiourgemata pou ekhoun skia), ton opoion oi skies klinoun dexia kai aristera (proskunontas) se Sitzount stase enopion tou Allakh me kathe tapeinose;

Pros ton Allakh pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me tis palames kai to metopo sto edaphos) opoioi briskontai stous ouranous, kai opoioi briskontai ste Ge apo kathe kinoumeno plasma, epises kai oi Aggeloi (pephtoun se Sitzount stase) kai den deikhnoun alazoneia (apenanti ste latreia Tou).
Phobountai (oi Aggeloi) apo ton Kurio tous, o Opoios (o Idios kai e Duname kai e Exousia Tou) einai pano tous, kai kanoun o,ti diatazontai.
O Allakh eipe (stous doulous Tou): <<Men parete gia latreia duo theous. Pragmati, uparkhei mono Enas Theos (pou axizei na latreuetai), gi' auto na phobaste mono Emena.>>
S' Auton anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste Ge, kai s' Auton kai mono anekei e upakoe (kai e latreia kai e aphosiose) gia panta. Tha phobaste loipon kanenan allon ektos tou Allakh;
Opoia eunoia ekhete, einai apo ton Allakh. Epeita, otan sas plexei opoiodepote kako, mono Auton epikaleiste me zelo (gia boetheia).
Epeita, otan aphairei to kako apo pano sas, tote merikoi apo sas apodidoun ston Kurio tous etairous ste latreia,
gia na deixoun akharistia se o,ti tous dosame (apo eunoies). Apolauste (gia ligo), pragmati, tha mathete (tis sunepeies tes akharistias kai tes anupakoes sas).

Kai ap' auta (ta agatha) pou tous parekhoume, orizoun (oi apistoi) ena meridio s' auta (ta eidola) pou den ta gnorizoun (del. pou den ta eidan pote na tous pheroun kapoio kalo, oute na empodisoun ap' autous kapoio kako). Ma ton Allakh! Tha kletheite na logodotesete gia o,ti epinoesate pseudos.

Ston Allakh apodidoun (oi apistoi tous Aggelous os) kores (Tou) - doxa s' Auton (einai polu Anoteros apo to na ekhei gious e kores) - eno gia ton eauto tous epilegoun auto pou epithumoun (delade to na ekhoun gious kai okhi kores).
Otan ta nea (tes genneses) enos thelukou erkhontai se kapoion ap' autous, to prosopo tou skoteiniazei, kai gemizei me thlipse mesa tou!
Krubetai apo tous anthropous logo ton kakon eideseon pou plerophoretheke. Na to kratesei (to theluko moro) para ten atimose, e na to thapsei sto khoma; Ti athlio einai auto pou krinoun!

S' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe (-kai apodidoun ston Allakh oti ekhei kores-) anekoun oi kakes perigraphes (apo ateleies, agnoia, apistia kai anagkes), alla ston Allakh anekoun oi upseloteres perigraphes (apo apolute Gnose kai Duname kai oti den ekhei anagke tipote). Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

An o Allakh (espeude na) timoresei tous anthropous gia ten adikia (kai ten apistia) tous, de tha aphene kanena kinoumeno on ste ge, alla (ant' autou) tous dinei anabole gia enan kathorismeno khrono. Otan erthei o kathorismenos khronos (tou telous tes zoes) tous, de tha paroun anabole oute gia ligo, oute tha tous erthei noritera.

Apodidoun ston Allakh auto pou to antipathoun gia ton eauto tous (del. oti ekhei kores), kai oi glosses tous lene pseudos oti (an tha anastethoun opos eipe o Mokhammant, tote) tha ekhoun ten kalutere katoikia (ton Paradeiso). Pragmati, tha ekhoun te Photia, kai tha aphethoun (mesa tes kai de tha bgoun pote).

Ma ton Allakh! Ekhoume steilei (Aggeliaphorous) se ethne prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant), alla o Satanas oraiopoiese sta matia tous tis kakes praxeis tous (apo apistia kai amarties). Semera (sten egkosmia zoe, o Satanas) einai o kedemonas tous (pou ton upakoun), alla (ste Mellousa Zoe) tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

De sou steilame (o, Mokhammant) to Biblio (to Kor'an), para mono gia na diasapheniseis s' autous (olous tous anthropous) auto gia to opoio diaphonoun (skhetika me ten alethine threskeia kai tous kanones tes kai ten anastase), kai os kathodegese kai eleos gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.
O Allakh stelnei nero apo ton ourano, kai anazoogonei m' auto ten (nekre) ge meta ton thanato tes. Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto Semadi gia tous anthropous pou akoun!

Pragmati, ekhete sta booeide ena Semadi gia na to labete upopse: sas dinoume na pinete ap' auto pou uparkhei sten koilia tous, to opoio (bgainei) apo anamesa sta koprana (kai ta oura) kai to aima [otan ta booeide khoneuoun to phageto, to gala pegainei stous mastous kai to aima stis phlebes kai ta oura sten kuste, khoris na aphenei to ena kataloipa sto allo], (bgainei) os agno kai eugeusto gala gia osous to pinoun!

Kai apo tous karpous ton khourmadion kai ton ampelion, phtiakhnete [apagoreumena] methustika pota kai (phtiakhnete epises kai epitrepta) kala agatha (opos apoxeramenous khourmades, staphides kai xudi). Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto ena Semadi gia tous anthropous pou sullogizontai.
O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) enepneuse stis melisses: <<Phtiaxte spitia sta bouna, sta dentra kai s' auta pou khtizoun (oi anthropoi).

Epeita, phate apo kathe eidos karpon (pou epithumeite), kai akoloutheste tous dromous pou sas enepneuse o Kurios sas kai tous dieukolune gia sas.>> Apo ten koilia tous bgainei poto (meli) diaphoron khromaton, mesa sto opoio uparkhei therapeia gia tous anthropous. Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto ena Semadi gi' ekeinous pou sullogizontai.

O Allakh sas demiourgese kai epeita (otan erthei e prokathorismene ora sas) sas aphairei te zoe. Anamesa sas uparkhoun ekeinoi pou phtanoun sten pio exathliomene elikia (gerateia), oste na men xeroun tipota, meta apo te gnose pou eikhan. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta).

O Allakh ekane merikous apo sas na uperekhoun apo tous allous sta mesa bioporismou (kai etsi uparkhoun plousioi kai phtokhoi, kai aphentika kai uperetes). Osoi uperekhoun de tha dosoun apo ta agatha tous stous uperetes tous (to poso) pou na tous kanei isous sunetairous s' auta (ta agatha) [pos loipon iskhurizontai oi apistoi oti o Allakh ekhei etairous apo tous doulous Tou, eno autoi arnountai na ekhoun sunetairous apo tous uperetes tous;]. Einai akharistoi gia tis khares tou Allakh (apodidontas s' Auton etairous ste latreia);

O Allakh ekane gia sas suzugous apo sas tous idious, kai ekane gia sas apo tis suzugous sas paidia kai eggonia, kai sas parekhei apo ta kala agatha. Ma sto pseudos (kai tous pseutikous theous pou den tous parekhoun tipote) pisteuoun, kai pros (oles autes) tis khares tou Allakh einai akharistoi;
Latreuoun ektos tou Allakh ekeinous (tous pseutikous theous kai ta eidola) pou den katekhoun kanena agatho gia na tous to parekhoun apo tous ouranous kai te Ge, oute mporoun (na katekhoun tipota).

Men thesete loipon (o, anthropoi) gia ton Allakh paromoious (theous kai etairous ste latreia, ap' auta ta eidola). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei (tis Idiotetes tou Megaleiou kai tes Teleiotetas Tou) eno eseis de gnorizete!

O Allakh parousiazei ena paradeigma enos sklabou upo ten idioktesia kapoiou, o opoios (sklabos) den ekhei tipota, kai enos (eleutherou) anthropou ston opoio dosame kala agatha apo Mas, kai etsi xodeuei ap' auta krupha kai phanera, einai autoi oi duo isoi; Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh! Alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous (tous eidololatres) de gnorizoun!

O Allakh parousiazei kai ena paradeigma duo andron, o enas ap' autous einai boubos (kai kouphos) kai den mporei na kanei tipota, o opoios einai baros gia ton kedemona tou (pou ton prosekhei), opou kai (o kedemonas) na ton steilei, de phernei kanena kalo (epeide oute milaei, oute akouei), einai isos m' auton pou (milaei kai akouei, kai) diatazei te dikaiosune kai brisketai ston isio dromo;

Ston Allakh anekei to aorato ton ouranon kai tes Ges. Pragmati, to thema tes Oras (kai to poso gregora ginetai aute me ten entole tou Allakh) den einai para en ripe ophthalmou e akoma pio gregora. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
O Allakh sas ebgale apo tis koilies ton meteron sas, de gnorizate tipota, kai sas edose akoe, orase kai kardies, isos kai ginete eugnomones.

De blepoun (oi eidololatres) ta poulia, ta opoia ta ekane (o Allakh) na petoun ston ourano (kai pos tous edose ten ikanoteta kai tous enepneuse pos na petoun kai epebale ton aera na tous koubalaei); Kaneis den tous krata (apo to na pesoun) para mono o Allakh. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.

O Allakh ekane gia sas ta spitia sas (pou einai phtiagmena apo petra klp.) topo anapauses (kai egkatastases), kai ekane gia sas apo ta dermata ton booeidon spitia (skenes kai tholous) ta opoia einai elaphria gia sas (na ta koubalesete) ten emera pou metakineste kai ten emera pou tha egkatastatheite. Kai (ekane gia sas) apo to malli, te gouna kai tis trikhes tous (ton booeidon), epipla kai ophelema pragmata (kalummata klp.) gia kapoio khroniko diastema.

O Allakh ekane gia sas skies ap' auta pou demiourgese (opos ta dentra), kai ekane gia sas sta bouna kataphugia (kai spelies pou sas prostateuoun apo ton kairo kai ton ekhthro), kai ekane gia sas endumata pou (ta phtiakhnete apo bambaki kai malli klp., ta opoia) sas prostateuoun apo te zeste (kai to kruo), kai endumata (panoplies pou phtiakhnete apo sidera) pou sas prostateuoun ste makhe sas. Etsi, teleiopoiei te khare Tou se sas, isos kai upotakhtheite (ste Boulese Tou).
An omos straphoun makria, tote to kathekon sou (o, Mokhammant) einai mono na diabibaseis (to menuma) me xekatharo tropo.

Gnorizoun tis khares tou Allakh (kai ap' autes einai oti se esteile, o, Mokhammant), epeita arnountai autes (kai ten apostole sou), kai oi perissoteroi ap' autous (apo ton lao sou) einai akharistoi (kai apistoi).

Ten Emera pou tha pheroume apo kathe ethnos enan martura (ton Aggeliaphoro, gia na marturesei gia ten piste ton piston kai ten apistia ton apiston), epeita de tha epitrapei stous apistous na dikaiologethoun, oute tha gurisoun sten egkosmia zoe gia na straphoun me metameleia (kai na praxoun tis praxeis pou eukharistoun ton Kurio tous).
Otan ekeinoi pou dieprattan adikia (apistia), doun to marturio, tote de tha tous elaphrunthei (to marturio), oute tha tous dothei anabole.

Otan ekeinoi pou apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, doun tous (legomenous) etairous tous (pou tous apedidan ston Allakh ste latreia), tha poun (oste na koubalesoun mazi tous tis amarties): <<Kurie mas! Autoi einai oi etairoi mas (sten apistia, kai autoi) pou tous epikaloumastan ektos apo Esena.>> Alla (oi pseutikoi theoi kai ta eidola) tha tous poun: <<Pragmati, eiste pseutes (epeide de sas kalesame na mas latreuete).>>
Ekeine ten emera tha upotakhthoun ston Allakh (kai sten Krise Tou), kai tha tous egkataleipsoun ola osa epinoesan apo psemata.
Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai empodizan (tous anthropous) apo to Dromo tou Allakh (to Islam), gi' autous tha prosthesoume kai allo marturio pano sto marturio (tous) gia o,ti kako skorpizan.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete, gia) ten Emera pou tha pheroume apo kathe ethnos enan martura (ton Aggeliaphoro) apo tous idious gia na marturesei gi' autous (gia ten piste ton piston kai ten apistia ton apiston), kai tha se pheroume (o, Prophete) os martura gi' autous (tous anthropous tou ethnous sou). Pragmati, sou steilame to Biblio os exegese ton panton kai os kathodegese, eleos kai eukharistes eideseis gia tous Mousoulmanous.
