St' aletheia, o Allakh diatazei te dikaiosune, ten kalosune (kai ten telese tes latreias me ton kalutero tropo), kai ten terese ton desmon suggeneias kai ton dikaiomaton ton suggenon, kai apagoreuei kathe aiskhre praxe, kathe apagoreumene praxe (sto Islam), kai kathe eidous katapiese. Sas nouthetei, isos kai na to labete upopse.

Ekpleroste te desmeuse pou dosate sto Onoma tou Allakh otan desmeueste, kai men athetesete tous orkous aphou tous epibebaiosate kai kalesate ton Allakh os Martura se sas (oti tha tous ekplerosete). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei ola osa kanete.

(Men athetesete tous orkous sas gia na) men eiste san ekeine (te gunaika me elaphru mualo ste Makka) pou xepleke ten uphanse tes se klostes aphou ten eikhe plexei gera. Pairnete tous orkous sas os meso exapateses metaxu sas, (kai tous atheteite) otan blepete ena ethnos (e mia omada) pio megale se arithmo (kai duname) apo to allo ethnos (pou tou dosate orko gia summakhia klp.). Pragmati, o Allakh sas dokimazei m' auto (an tha ekplerosete tous orkous e okhi), kai pragmati, ten Emera tes Anastases, tha diasaphenisei se sas auta sta opoia diaphonousate metaxu sas.

An ethele o Allakh, tha sas ekane olous mono ena ethnos (se mono mia threskeia, to Islam), alla kanei opoion thelei na parastratesei kai kathodegei opoion thelei, kai pragmati, tha kletheite na logodotesete gia o,ti kanate.

Men kanete tous orkous sas meso exapateses metaxu sas, gia na me glistresei to podi (sas apo ton isio dromo pros ten katastrophe) aphou etan stathero (ston isio dromo kai sten asphaleia), kai tote tha geuteite to kako logo (auton ton anthropon) pou apotrepsate apo ton Dromo tou Allakh (meso ton orkon kai tes exapateses, epeide eidan oti prodidete tous orkous sas kai etsi de tha sas pistepsoun), kai tote tha ekhete ena megalo marturio!

Men antallassete (to na ekplerosete) te desmeuse pou dosate sto Onoma tou Allakh me kapoio mikro timema. Pragmati, o,ti ekhei o Allakh (apo antamoibe gia sas otan ekplerosete tous orkous sas) einai polu kalutera gia sas, an to gnorizete.

Osa (kai an) ekhete (o, anthropoi, apo ploute kai apolauseis) tha teleiosoun, alla o,ti ekhei o Allakh (apo antamoibe) tha parameinei gia panta. Pragmati, tha dosoume s' autous pou edeixan upomone, ten antamoibe tous sumphona me tis kaluteres praxeis tous.

Opoios kanei enaretes praxeis, eite andras, eite gunaika, eno einai pistos, pragmati tha ton kanoume na zesei mia kale zoe (sten egkosmia zoe), kai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha tous dosoume ten antamoibe tous sumphona me tis kaluteres praxeis tous.
Otan tha diabazeis (o, piste) to Kor'an, anazeta (prota) kataphugio ston Allakh apo ton katarameno Satana (kai tous psithurous tou).
Pragmati, (o Satanas) den ekhei kamia duname stous pistous (na tous paraplanesei), autous pou empisteuontai ton Kurio tous (kai anazetoun kataphugio s' Auton apo ton katarameno Satana).
Alla, (o Satanas) ekhei duname mono s' ekeinous pou ton pairnoun os kedemona tous (kai ton upakoun), kai oi opoioi apodidoun s' Auton (ston Allakh) etairous ste latreia.

Otan antikathistoume enan kanona pou anapheretai se ena Edaphio me enan allon - kai o Allakh gnorizei kalutera ti stelnei (apo tous kanones kai ti allazei ap' autous sumphona me te sophia Tou kai gia to kalo ton doulon Tou) - tote lene (oi apistoi se sena, o, Mokhammant): <<St' aletheia, eisai pseutes (pou apodideis ston Allakh logia pou den ta eipe).>> Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou lene), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de gnorizoun (kala ton Allakh, tous kanones tes threskeias Tou, kai te Sophia Tou).

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous apistous) oti (auto to Kor'an den to epinoeses kai meta to apedoses ston Allakh, opos iskhurizontai pseudos, alla) to ephere to agio pneuma (o Aggelos Gabriel) apo ton Kurio sou me ten aletheia, gia na statheropoiesei tous pistous (sten piste tous) kai os kathodegese kai kharmosuna nea gia tous Mousoulmanous.

Pragmati, xeroume oti (oi eidololatres) lene: <<St' aletheia, uparkhei enas anthropos pou didaskei auton (ton Mokhammant auto to Kor'an).>> Alla e glossa, autou pou iskhurizontai oti ton didaskei, einai xene, eno auto (to Kor'an) apokaluphtheke se mia euglotte arabike glossa!
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun sta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) tou Allakh, o Allakh de tha tous kathodegesei, kai gi' autous tha uparxei ena odunero marturio.
St' aletheia, ekeinoi pou mekhaneuontai pseude, einai ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun sta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) tou Allakh, kai ekeinoi einai oi pseutes.

Opoios arneitai ten piste ston Allakh, aphou eikhe pistepsei (einai autos pou mekhaneuetai pseude), ektos ap' auton pou exanagkasteke (upo ten apeile), eno e kardia tou paramenei stathere (kai kathesukhasmene) sten piste. Alla oso gi' ekeinous, ton opoion oi kardies kharekan me ten apistia, tha pesei pano tous e orge apo ton Allakh, kai tha ekhoun ena tromero marturio.
Auto epeide protimousan ten egkosmia zoe para te Mellousa Zoe, kai o Allakh den kathodegei tous apistous anthropous.
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou o Allakh ekhei sphragisei tis kardies, ten akoe kai ten orase tous, kai ekeinoi einai autoi pou ekhoun agnoia (gia to ti tous proetoimase o Allakh apo marturio).
Pragmati, ekeinoi tha einai ste Mellousa Zoe oi khamenoi.

Epeita, pragmati o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant, einai Polueusplakhnos) gi' ekeinous pou metanasteusan (apo te Makka pros te Mantina), aphou basanistekan (gia na poun logia apistias kai ta eipan apo basanismo, eno oi kardies tous etan gemates me ten piste), kai epeita agonistekan (sto Dromo tou Allakh) kai upemeinan karterika, pragmati, o Kurios sou meta ap' auto einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Ten Emera pou e kathe psukhe tha erthei gia na milesei gia ton eauto tes (thetontas oles tis dikaiologies pou mporei), kai kathe psukhe tha apoplerothei pleros gia o,ti ekane, kai de tha adikethoun.

O Allakh parousiazei ena paradeigma mias komopoles (Makkas) pou etan asphales (eno oi phules guro tes apegagan e mia ten alle, alla den epitethekan ste Makka logo tou sebasmou tous pros ton Iero Oiko pou ekhtise o Abraam), kai etan kathesukhasmene (pou oi katoikoi tes den khreiazontousan na metanasteusoun gia na psaxoun gia nero kai trophe, opos oi alles phules), kai tes erkhontousan ta agatha tes me aphthonia apo kathe meros, ostoso, edeixe akharistia gia tis khares tou Allakh (kai oi katoikoi tes apedidan etairous ston Allakh ste latreia), etsi o Allakh tes ekane na geutei tromere peina kai phobo gia o,ti ekanan (oi katoikoi tes).

Pragmati, tous erthe (stous katoikous tes Makkas) enas Aggeliaphoros (o Mokhammant) apo anamesa tous, alla ton diepseudan, kai etsi tous arpaxe e timoria (tes peinas kai tou phobou kai skotothekan polloi apo tous arkhegous tous ste makhe tou Mpantr) eno etan adikoi.

Phate, loipon, (o, anthropoi) apo o,ti epitrepta kai kala agatha sas parekhei o Allakh, kai na eiste eugnomones gia tis khares tou Allakh, an pragmati latreuete mono Auton (kai den Tou apodidete etairous ste latreia).

St' aletheia, sas apagorepse (na katanalonete) mono ta nekra (zoa kai poulia pou de sphagiastekan sumphona me ton Islamiko tropo), to aima, te sarka tou khoirou kai opoiodepote zoo pou kata te sphage tou anaphertheke to onoma allou ektos apo tou Allakh. Opoios omos anagkasteke (na katanalosei kati ap' auta, p.kh. epeide khatheke sten eremo kai kontepse na pethanei), khoris na to katanalosei apo epithumia, oute na uperbei (to orio tes anagkaiotetas), tote o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Me lete (o, eidololatres), epeide oi glosses sas sunethisan na perigraphoun pseudos: <<Auto einai epitrepto kai auto einai apagoreumeno (apo ta booeide gia mas).>>, gia na apodidete logia ston Allakh pseudos (oti o Allakh ta epetrepse e ta apagorepse, eno eseis eiste pou ta apagorepsate, kai epinoesate onomata gi' auta, opos Mpakhira, Sa'impa, Oasila kai Kham). Pragmati, ekeinoi pou apodidoun logia ston Allakh pseudos de tha petukhoun pote.
(Tha ekhoun) mono lige apolause, kai epeita tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

Stous Ebraious, ekhoume apagoreusei auta (ta phageta) pou se ekhoume plerophoresei (o, Mokhammant) prin. Pragmati, den tous adikesame (m' auto), alla ekeinoi adikesan ton eauto tous (me tis amarties, kai etsi tous apagorepsame auta os poine).

Epeita pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) gi' ekeinous pou ekanan to kako me anoesia [del. kathe amartia einai anoesia] kai epeita meta ap' auto straphekan me metameleia pros Auton kai diorthosan (tis praxeis tous), o Kurios sou pragmati meta ap' auto einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Pragmati, o Abraam etan Imames (kai paradeigma kalou kharaktera gia na akolouthoun oi anthropoi tes kathodegeses), upotagmenos ste boulese tou Allakh kai apekline apo ola ta mataia dogmata akolouthontas ten alethine piste, kai den etan ap' ekeinous pou apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia.
Etan eugnomon gia tis khares Tou (Allakh). (O Allakh) ton epelexe (os Aggeliaphoro) kai ton kathodegese ston isio dromo.

Tou dosame sten egkosmia zoe to kalo (apo epainese kai kanontas ton enan Aggeliaphoro kai dinontas tou kalous apogonous), kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha einai anamesa stous dikaious (sto upselotero epipedo ston Paradeiso).

Epeita, apokalupsame se sena (o, Mokhammant) oti: <<Akoloutha te threskeia tou Abraam apoklinontas apo ola ta mataia dogmata, kai akolouthontas ten alethine piste, kai o opoios (o Abraam) den etan ap' ekeinous pou apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia.>>

Pragmati, to Sabbato oristeke (os mera latreias) mono gi' ekeinous (tous Ebraious) pou diepheran s' auto (parolo pou o Mouses tous dietaxe na sebontai ten Paraskeue, alla ekeinoi diepheran kai epelexan to Sabbato, kai etsi epebale o Allakh to Sabbato s' ekeinous me pio duskolous orous os poine gi' autous). Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) tha krinei anamesa tous ten Emera tes Anastases se o,ti diepheran.

Kalese (o, Mokhammant) tous anthropous sto Dromo tou Kuriou sou me te sophia kai ten kale nouthesia kai suzeta mazi tous me ton kalutero tropo. St' aletheia, o Kurios sou gnorizei kalutera ekeinon pou parastratese makria apo ton Dromo Tou, kai gnorizei kalutera tous kathodegemenous.

An timoresete (o, pistoi, tous ekhthrous sas), timoreste tous me ton idio tropo pou sas timoresan (kai okhi parapano). Alla an upomeinete karterika (kai den tous timoresete parolo pou ekhete te duname na to kanete), st' aletheia, auto einai kalutero gia tous upomonetikous.

Na eisai (o, Prophete) upomonetikos, kai e upomone sou den epitugkhanetai para mono me ten boetheia tou Allakh. Men stenakhoriesai gi' autous (pou arnountai ten piste kai ten kathodegese), oute na steneuei to stethos sou apo o,ti sunomotoun.
Pragmati, o Allakh (me ten uposterixe Tou) einai mazi m' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai m' autous pou prattoun to kalo.

Doxa s' Auton (ton Allakh), o Opoios pere to doulo Tou (ton Mokhammant) kata te nukhta, apo ton Iero Oiko (ste Makka) sto tzami Al-Aksa (sten Ierousalem), tou opoiou eulogesame o,ti einai guro tou, gia na tou deixoume apo ta Semadia Mas. Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Sami' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora) kai to kaname mia kathodegese gia ta Paidia tou Israel (Iakob), (kai tous diataxame): <<Men pairnete kanenan allon os theo pou na ton empisteueste ektos apo Emena.

Eseis eiste apo tous apogonous ekeinon pou metapherame (kai sosame sten Kiboto) me ton Noe (thumetheite aute te khare kai na eiste eugnomones opos o Noe), pragmati, (o Noe) etan enas eugnomon doulos (Mas).>>

Apokalupsame sta paidia tou Israel sto Biblio (Tora) oti: <<Pragmati, tha skorpizete to kako (ten adikia kai tis amarties) ste ge duo phores, kai pragmati, tha ginete alazonikoi kai turannoi se megalo bathmo.

Otan erthei e ora tes protes apo tis duo phores (pou tha skorpisete to kako ste ge), tha steiloume enantion sas kapoious doulous Mas me megale duname, kai tha periplanontai anamesa stous oikous (sas). Einai mia uposkhese (gia ten katastrophe sas logo tou kakou pou tha skorpisete ste ge) pou oposdepote tha ekplerothei.
Epeita epistrepsame te nike se sas enantion tous (aphou straphekate me metameleia pros Emas) kai sas dosame ploute kai paidia kai sas kaname megaluterous se arithmo.

An prattete to kalo, tha einai gia to kalo sas, alla an diaprattete to kako, tha einai eis baros sas. Otan tha erthei e ora tes deuteres phoras (pou tha skorpisete to kako ste ge), tha kalupsoun (oi ekhthroi sas) ta prosopa sas me atimose, kai tha mpoun sto Tzami (to Nao tes Ierousalem) opos mpekan s' auto ten prote phora, kai tha katastrepsoun teleios o,ti tha pesei sten exousia tous.

Isos o Kurios sas na sas eleesei (meta ap' auto, an strapheite me metameleia pros Auton), alla an epistrepsete (sten alazoneia kai ten turannia), tha epistrepsoume kai Emeis (sto na sas timoresoume). Kaname ten Kolase gia tous apistous mia phulake (apo ten opoia de tha bgoun pote).>>

Pragmati, auto to Kor'an kathodegei ston pio dikaio (kai pio isio) dromo (to Islam). Kai dinei kharmosunes eideseis stous pistous pou prattoun tis enaretes praxeis, oti tha ekhoun mia terastia antamoibe (ton Paradeiso).
Kai (plerophorei) oti gi' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, ekhoume proetoimasei ena epoduno marturio (sten Kolase).

O anthropos (apo ten agnoia tou, otan thumosei) epikaleitai (ton Allakh) gia to kako (enantion tou eautou, ton paidion e tes periousias tou), opos epikaleitai gia to kalo (del. me ton idio zelo kai biastika). Pragmati, o anthropos (apo te phuse tou) einai polu biastikos.

Kaname ten nukhta kai ten emera os duo Semadia. Aphairesame to phos tes nukhtas (del. ten skotiniasame) kai kaname ten emera photeine, gia na anazetesete (mesa bioporismou apo) te gennaiodoria tou Kuriou sas, kai na mathete ton arithmo ton eton kai ton upologismo (tou khronou). Kai ekhoume exegesei ta panta leptomeros.

Desame tis praxeis kathenos anthropou sto laimo tou (kai etsi mono autos einai upeuthunos gi' autes), kai ten Emera tes Anastases, tha tou pheroume ena biblio (ton praxeon tou), pou tha to brei anoikhto.
(Tha eipothei s' auton): <<Diabase to biblio sou, eparkei o eautos sou semera na metresei enantion sou (tis praxeis sou, gia na xereis apo monos sou to apotelesma).>>

Opoios kathodegeitai, e kathodegese tou tha einai mono gia to kalo tou, kai opoios parastratei, e parastratese tou tha einai mono eis baros tou. Kamia (amartole) psukhe de tha epomistei ten amartia kapoias alles. Pote den timoroume mekhri na steiloume (prota) enan Aggeliaphoro (gia na proeidopoiesei).

Otan thelame na katastrepsoume mia (adike kai akhariste) komopole, diataxame tous euporous (kai tous egetes) tes (pou tous akolouthousan oloi oi katoikoi tes), (na upakououn ton Allakh kai na akolouthoun tous Aggeliaphorous), alla ekeinoi parakousan s' aute (ten komopole diaprattontas amarties kai adikia), opote egine anapopheuktos o logos (gia ten timoria) gi' auten (ten komopole), kai etsi, ten katastrepsame entelos.

Posa (adika) ethne ekhoume katastrepsei meta ten epokhe tou Noe (opos te phule 'Ant kai te Thamount)! Eparkei o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) os Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta Panta) gia tis amarties ton doulon Tou.

Opoios epithumei aute te pheugalea zoe (kai tis parodikes apolauseis tes), epispeudoume gi' auton s' aute (te zoe) o,ti theloume (na tou dosoume) kai se opoion theloume. Epeita, (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tou ekhoume orisei ten Kolase, opou tha mpei gia na kaei mesa tes, periphronemenos kai diogmenos (apo to eleos tou Allakh).
Opoios omos epithumei te Mellousa Zoe kai prattei gi' auten tis kales praxeis pou tes armozoun, eno einai pistos, ekeinon ton anthropon oi prospatheies tha ektimethoun.

Dinoume kai stous duo, s' ekeinous (pou epithumoun ten egkosmia zoe) kai s' ekeinous (pou epithumoun te Mellousa Zoe), apo te gennaiodoria tou Kuriou sou. Pragmati, e gennaiodoria tou Kuriou sou (sten egkosmia zoe), den einai periorismene (gia kanenan, eite einai kalos, eite einai kakos).

Koita (o, Prophete) pos kaname merikous na uperekhoun apo allous (sten egkosmia zoe, sta ploute, ta paidia kai tis theseis), alla pragmati, e Mellousa Zoe ekhei megalutera epipeda (uperokhes metaxu tous apo o,ti eikhan sten egkosmia zoe, etsi kapoioi tha einai sta diaphoretika khamelotera epipeda tes Photias, eno alloi tha einai sta diaphoretika upselotera epipeda tou Paradeisou), kai ekhei polu megaluterous bathmous uperokhes (gia kapoious enanti allon).
Me theseis kanenan allo theo mazi me ton Allakh, diaphoretika tha kathiseis kategoroumenos (kai periphronemenos) kai egkataleimmenos (khoris kamia uposterixe ste Photia).

O Kurios sou dietaxe na me latreuete kanenan allon ektos ap' Auton, kai (dietaxe) ten kalosune pros tous goneis. Etsi, an enas ap' autous (tous goneis sou), e kai oi duo, phthasoun se megale elikia kata ten diarkeia tes zoes sou, men tous peis oute <<Ouphph>> (del. kamia lexe pou deikhnei elleipse sebasmou, oute kan 'Okh'), oute na tous phonaxeis, alla na tous peis kala kai eugenika logia.
Kai na eisai tapeinos pros autous apo eleos (pros autous), kai na les: <<Kurie mou! Eleese tous, kathos me anethrepsan otan emoun mikros.>>
O Kurios sas gnorizei kalutera ti (protheseis) ekhete mesa sas. An eiste dikaioi, tote gi' autous pou strephontai me metameleia pros Auton, Autos einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Kai na doseis (o, piste) ston suggene to dikaioma tou (apo kalosune kai terese kalon desmon suggeneias), kai (dose eleemosune) ston endee kai ton odoiporo. Alla kai men xodeueis (ten periousia sou) spatala (se amarties, se asemanta pragmata e khoris logo).

St' aletheia, oi spataloi (pou xodeuoun se amarties e khoris logo) einai ta adelphia (oi akolouthoi) ton satanadon (pou tous upakoun ste spatale). Pragmati, o Satanas einai agnomon pros ton Kurio tou.

Alla an strepseis to prosopo sou ap' autous (ton suggene, ton endee kai ton odoiporo, epeide den ekheis kati na tous doseis), perimenontas auto pou elpizeis apo eleos (agatha kai gennaiodoria) apo ton Kurio sou, tote pes tous eugenika logia [opos: <<Tha sas doso molis mou steilei o Allakh apo te gennaiodoria Tou.>>]

Men kaneis to kheri sou demeno sto laimo sou (me xodeuontas se o,ti dietaxe o Allakh), oute na to aploseis polu (me spatale), diaphoretika tha eisai epilepsimos (apo tous anthropous epeide den xodeueis e epeide edoses se merikous me spatale kai den edoses s' allous), kai (tha eisai) aporos (pou den ekheis tipote na xodeueis).

Pragmati, o Kurios sou dinei agatha me aphthonia se opoion thelei e ta periorizei. Pragmati, Autos einai gia tous doulous Tou, Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta Panta).
Me skotonete ta paidia sas apo phobo gia te phtokheia. Emeis eimaste pou parekhoume agatha s' auta kai s' esas. Pragmati, e dolophonia tous einai teratodes amartia.
Men plesiazete te moikheia, pragmati, einai mia megale aiskhre amartia kai enas kakos dromos (pou odegei sten Kolase).

Me skotonete kamia psukhe gia ten opoia o Allakh ekhei apagoreusei opoiadepote epithese, ektos gia dikaious logous (an to dikaio to apaitei - opos ten psukhe enos dolophonou). Opoios omos skototheke adika, ekhoume dosei ston kleronomo (e ton kedemona) tou ten exousia (na zetesei apo ton dikaste, te thanatike poine gia ton dolophono e ten apozemiose -se kapoies periptoseis-). Alla den prepei na uperbainei ta oria sta antipoina (opos to na zetesei te dolophonia duo e perissoteron athoon apo ten oikogeneia tou dolophonou gia ton dolophonemeno). Pragmati, tha labei ten uposterixe (mekhri na labei to dikaioma tou).

Men plesiazete ten periousia tou orphanou, para mono me ton kalutero tropo (gia na te beltiosete), mekhri na phtasei sten elikia tes dunames tou (tes ephebeias). Kai ekpleroste kathe desmeuse (sumphonia e uposkhese). Pragmati, gia kathe desmeuse tha apologetheite (kata ten Emera tou Apologismou).

Ekpleroste te monada metreses (barous e posotetas enos proiontos) otan poulate kati me te metrese, kai na zugizete me ten orthe zugaria. Auto einai kalo (gia sas s' auton ton kosmo), kai kalutero os sunepeia (ste Mellousa Zoe).

Men akoloutheis (o, anthrope) auto gia to opoio den ekheis gnose. Pragmati, gia ten akoe, ten orase kai ten kardia, gia ola auta tha logodotesei (o anthropos, se ti ta khresimopoiese, epises kai auta tha marturesoun gi' auton, ti akouse, ti eide, kai ti exere)!
Men perpatas ste ge alazonika. St' aletheia, oute mporeis na skhiseis (e na diaperaseis) te ge, oute tha phtaseis ta bouna se upsos.
Oles autes (oi proanapheromenes entoles kai apagoreuseis), pragmati, oi kakes (praxeis pou anapherthekan) anamesa tous einai misetes gia ton Kurio sou.

Autes (oi proanapheromenes entoles kai apagoreuseis) einai ena meros tes sophias pou sou ekhei apokalupsei o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant). Men theteis loipon kanenan allon theo mazi me ton Allakh, diaphoretika tha rikhteis sten Kolase, kategoroumenos kai diogmenos (apo to eleos tou Allakh).
(Einai dunaton, o, eidololatres, oti lete pseudos oti) orise o Kurios sas gia sas tous gious kai pere tous Aggelous os kores; Pragmati, lete teratode logia!

Pragmati, exegoume s' auto to Kor'an (tous kanones, tis nouthesies kai ta paradeigmata) gia na laboun nouthesia (oi anthropoi), alla aute (e exegese kai e diasaphenise) den tous auxanei (tous apistous) para se phuge (apo ten aletheia).

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<An uperkhan alloi theoi mazi m' Auton -opos iskhurizontai (pseudos)-, sigoura tha anazetousan enan dromo pros ton Kurio tou Thronou (gia na palepsoun mazi Tou gia to Throno).>>
Doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros kai pio psela apo o,ti lene (pseudos).

Ton doxazoun oi epta ouranoi kai e Ge kai oloi osoi briskontai s' auta. Den uparkhei tipota pou na men Ton doxazei eugnomonontas Ton, alla den katalabainete (o, anthropoi) pos doxazoun (ta alla demiourgemata). Pragmati, Autos einai Khaleim (Makrothumos) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Otan apaggelleis (o, Prophete) to Kor'an (kai akoun oi eidololatres tis nouthesies tou), bazoume anamesa se sena kai s' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, ena aorato phragma (gia na men katalaboun to Kor'an, os poine gia ten arnese tous).

Kai bazoume pano stis kardies tous kalummata, gia na men to katalabainoun (to Kor'an), kai kophose sta autia tous. Otan anaphereis ton Kurio sou kai mono Auton sto Kor'an (kai de se akoun oi eidololatres na anaphereis tous legomenous theous tous), gurizoun ten plate tous me antipatheia kai phuge.

Emeis gnorizoume kalutera ti akoun (kai me poio tropo akoun) otan se akoun (na apaggelleis to Kor'an, alla den anazetoun ten kathodegese). Kai (gnorizoume) otan sunomiloun kat' idian kai lene oi adikoi (opos o Al-Oualeint mpin Al-Mougeira kai oi suntrophoi tou ston oiko An-Nantoua skhetika me sena): <<Den akoloutheite (o, anthropoi), para enan magemeno andra.>>

Koita pos apodidoun se sena ta (kaka) paradeigmata (kai tis kakes perigraphes: magos, mantes, magemenos, paraphron e poietes), kai etsi parastratesan kai den mporoun na phtasoun sto dromo (tes aletheias).
Lene: <<Einai dunaton otan (tha pethanoume kai) tha ginoume kokkala kai skone, tha anastethoume kai tha demiourgethoume xana (os anthropoi opos eimastan prin);>>
Pes: <<Akoma kai an ginete petra e sidero,

e opoiodepote allo demiourgema pou pisteuete sta stethe sas oti einai pio megalo (kai pio adunato na epistraphei ste zoe, opos o ouranos, e ge e ta bouna, e akoma kai an ginete o idios o thanatos, pragmati, o Allakh tha sas epanapherei ste zoe)!>> Tha poun: <<Poios tha mas epanapherei (xana ste zoe);>> Pes: <<O Idios pou sas demiourgese ten prote phora (apo anuparxia).>> Tha kounesoun gia sena ta kephalia tous pano kato khleuazontas kai tha poun: <<Pote tha ginei auto;>> Pes: <<Isos tha einai suntoma.>>

(Tha epanapherei olous esas, o, anthropoi, ste zoe) ten Emera pou tha sas kalesei (na anastetheite apo tous taphous sas), kai tha antapokritheite (sten entole Tou, exumnontas Ton), kai olos o epainos anekei s' Auton, kai tha nomizete oti den eikhate meinei (sten egkosmia zoe) para mono gia ligo.

Pes (o, Prophete) stous doulous Mou na lene ta omorphotera (logia). St' aletheia, o Satanas prokalei dikhonoia anamesa tous (an den to kanoun). Pragmati, o Satanas einai gia ton anthropo enas prophanes ekhthros.

O Kurios sas (o, anthropoi) sas gnorizei kalutera (kai gnorizei poios axizei ten kathodegese, kai poios okhi). An thelei, tha sas eleesei (kai tha sas kathodegesei sten upakoe pros Auton), e an thelei, tha sas timoresei. Kai de se steilame (o, Prophete) os kedemona (kai paraterete) s' autous (me to na tous anagkaseis na pistepsoun e na metreseis tis praxeis tous kai na tous antameipseis e na tous timoreseis gi' autes, alla eisai mono enas proeidopoietes).

O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei kalutera olous osous einai stous ouranous kai ste ge. Pragmati, ekhoume eunoesei merikous prophetes enanti allon (me pollous opadous e me ten apokalupse Theiou Bibliou), kai dosame ston Dabid (ena Theio Biblio) to Az-Zampour.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Kaleste ekeinous pou iskhurizeste (oti einai theoi) ektos Autou, de tha mporesoun oute na apomakrunoun kanena kako apo sas (pou sas eplexe), oute na to metapheroun (apo sas se kapoion allon)!>>

Ekeinoi (oi prophetes, oi Aggeloi kai oi eusebeis) pou tous epikalountai (oi eidololatres), (oi idioi) anazetoun mesa eggutetas pros ton Kurio tous (meso tes upakoes kai tes latreias). (Kai sunagonizontai metaxu tous meso ton enareton praxeon) poios tha einai pio konta (ston Allakh). Kai elpizoun sto eleos Tou kai phobountai to marturio Tou. Pragmati, to marturio tou Kuriou sou einai auto pou tha prepei na to phobountai oloi (gia na men pesoun s' auto)!

Den uparkhei kamia (adike) komopole pou de tha ten katastrepsoume prin apo ten Emera tes Anastases e tha ten timoresoume me mia austere timoria. Pragmati, auto einai grammeno sto Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud, os Theia Moira).

O logos gia ton opoion de stelnoume ta Semadia (pou zetesan oi eidololatres apo ton Mokhammant, opos to na metatrepsei ton lopho As-Sapha se khruso e na aphairesei ta bouna tes Makkas kai na kanei ekei kepous), einai mono giati ta diepseusan (ta Semadia Mas) oi proegoumenoi laoi (kai etsi tous katastrepsame, kai an stelname stous eidololatres auta pou zetesan kai epeita den pisteuan, tha tous katastrephame khoris kamia anabole). Dosame stous anthropous tes phules Thamount ten kamela os saphes Semadi, alla ten arnethekan adika. Kai de stelnoume ta Semadia para mono os ekphobismo (gia tous anthropous, isos na pistepsoun kai na straphoun me metameleia, kai okhi sumphona me tis epithumies tous)!

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan sou eipame: <<Pragmati, o Kurios sou perikleiei olous tous anthropous (me te gnose kai te duname Tou, kai empodizei to kako tous apo esena, gi' auto diadose auto pou diatakhthekes).>> Den kaname o,ti eides (apo ta Semadia Mas) pou sou deixame (kata to nukhterino taxidi -Al-Isra'- apo te Makka pros to Ierousalem kai to antistropho) para mono os dokimasia gia tous anthropous (kai etsi, ta pistepsan oi pistoi kai ta diepseusan oi apistoi legontas: <<pos ekane tetoio taxidi se mono mia nukhta;>>). Kathos kai (os dokimasia) to katarameno dentro (Az-Zakoum pou phutronei sto bathos tes Kolases) pou anapheretai sto Kor'an (to opoio diepseusan oi apistoi legontas: <<pos phutronei ena dentro ste Photia;>>). Tous ekphobizoume (gia ten timoria Mas kai oti e trophe tous tha einai oi karpoi ekeinou tou dentrou), alla den tous auxanei auto para mono se megale adikia (apistia kai plane, kai khleuasan tous karpous ekeinou tou dentrou oti tha einai khourmades kai bouturo).

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipame stous Aggelous: <<Peste oloi se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos) enopion tou Adam (os khairetismo kai time pros auton, kai okhi latreia).>> Etsi, oloi epesan se Sitzount stase, ektos apo ton Implis (pou etan tzinn kai okhi Aggelos), o opoios eipe: <<Na peso se Sitzount stase enopion autou pou ton demiourgeses apo pelo;>>

(O Implis) eipe: <<Blepeis (o, Allakh) auton pou ekheis timesei pano apo mena! An mou doseis anabole (kai me apheseis zontano) mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, sigoura tha uperiskhuso (kai tha paraplaneso) tous apogonous tou, ektos apo ligous.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Phuge! Kai opoioi ap' autous tha se akolouthesoun, pragmati, e Kolase tha einai e timoria gia olous sas, aphthone os timoria.

Ksegelase (kai upokinese kai kalese) opoious mporeis ap' autous me te phone sou (me to kalesma sou na se upakousoun, kai me ta tragoudia kai te diaskedase), kai phere enantion tous, (ton strato sou apo) tous ippotes kai to peziko sou (pou pegainoun pros tis amarties kabalontas e perpatontas), kai ekhe meridio sta ploute tous (me to na tous diatazeis na ta apoktoun me amarties kai na ta xodeuoun se amarties) kai (ekhe meridio) sta paidia tous (me to na oraiopoieseis gi' autous na ekhoun philenades kai philous gia na apoktoun paidia apo moikheia ektos gamou kai na apomakrunoun ta paidia tous apo te threskeia Mou -to Islam-, sten opoia genniountai, pros alles threskeies pou tha epheuriskoun autoi), kai dose tous (pseutikes) uposkheseis!>> Pragmati, o Satanas den tous uposkhetai para mono exapatese kai plane!

(Eipe o Allakh): <<Pragmati, den ekheis kamia duname pano stous (upakouous pistous) doulous Mou (na tous paraplaneseis).>> Arkei o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) os Kedemonas (gia tous doulous Tou pou Ton empisteuontai).

O Kurios sas (o, anthropoi) einai Autos pou kanei ta ploia na pleusoun gia sas mesa ste thalassa, gia na anazetesete apo te gennaiodoria Tou (mesa bioporismou meso emporiou, psarematos kai douleias). Pragmati, Autos einai pros esas Polueusplakhnos.

Otan sas plettei (o, eidololatres) mia kakoukhia ste thalassa, exaphanizontai (apo to mualo sas) oloi osoi tous epikaleiste (kai latreuete) ektos ap' Auton. Alla otan sas sozei kai phtanete ste steria, apostrepheste xana (apo to na latreuete mono Auton, kai apodidete xana s' Auton etairous ste latreia)! Pragmati, o anthropos einai akharistos (ektos apo opoion ton prostateuei o Allakh apo tetoio kharaktera).

Aisthaneste asphaleis oti (aphou sas esose apo te thalassa) de tha kanei te steria na sas katapiei e de tha steilei pano sas petres (san brokhe, apo ton ourano); Kai tote de tha breite gia sas kanenan prostate.

E aisthaneste asphaleis oti de tha sas epistrepsei xana s' aute (te thalassa) kai de tha steilei epano sas mia katastrophike kataigida gia na sas pnixei exaitias tes apistias sas; Kai tote de tha breite gia sas kanena diadokho uposterikte enantion Mas (pou na Mas rotesei gi' auto pou kaname se sas, oute tha breite gia sas kamia axiose enantion Mas).

Pragmati, timesame ta paidia tou Adam (me oti tous dosame mualo, kale morphe, Theia Biblia, upotaxame ta panta sto sumpan na tous uperetoun, kai diataxame tous Aggelous na pesoun se Sitzount stase me to metopo sto edaphos enopion tou Adam os time kai khairetismo), kai ta metapherame ste steria (pano sta zoa) kai ste thalassa (sta ploia), kai tous pareikhame kala agatha, kai ta protimesame pano apo polla apo o,ti demiourgesame me axiosemeiote protimese.

Ten Emera pou tha kalesoume kathe omada anthropon me ton egete tous (pou ton akolouthousan sten egkosmia zoe), opoiou tha tou dothei to biblio (ton praxeon tou) sto dexi tou kheri, ekeinoi tha diabasoun to biblio tous (eutukhismenoi), kai de tha adikethoun, oute oso to nema tou koukoutsiou enos khourma.
Opoios omos etan s' aute (ten egkosmia zoe) tuphlos (apo ten aletheia), tha einai (akome pio) tuphlos ste Mellousa Zoe (apo to na kathodegethei ston Paradeiso) kai se pio khameno dromo.

Sunomotesan (oi apistoi, kai etan etoimoi) na se apotrepsoun (o, Prophete) ap' auto (enan kanona tou Kor'an) pou sou apokalupsame, gia na kaneis kati allo pou de sou to diataxame. Tote (an to ekanes), sigoura tha se eikhan parei gia steno philo.

An (de se uposterizame kai) de se statheropoiousame, tha eikhes skhedon teinei, ligo pros autous (pros to dolo tous, logo tes megales exapateses tous, kai logo tes megales epithumias sou gia ten kathodegese tous).
Tote (an to ekanes), tha se eikhame kanei na geuteis diple timoria, toso s' aute te zoe oso kai meta thanaton. Epeita, de tha ebriskes gia sena kanenan uposterikte enantion Mas.

Sunomotesan (oi apistoi, kai etan etoimoi) na se enokhlesoun (na se phulakisoun, na se exorisoun e na se skotosoun, e na upokinesoun tous anthropous enantion sou) ste ge (Makka) gia na se bgaloun ap' aute. Alla tote de tha emenan meta apo sena, para mono gia ligo. [Etsi, meta apo enamise khrono apo te metanasteuse tou Prophete pros te Mantina, o Allakh tous timorese, kai skotothekan polloi apo tous arkhegous tous ste makhe tou Mpantr].

Autos einai o epanalambanomenos kanonas (kai tropos Mas) me tous Aggeliaphorous pou steilame prin apo sena (oti timoroume opoio lao diapseudei e diokhnei ton Aggeliaphoro tou), kai de tha breis kamia metabole ston kanona Mas.

Telese (o, Prophete) ten proseukhe apo ten ora pou arkhizei e klise tou eliou (-to mesemeri- del. tis proseukhes Ad-Doukhr kai Al-'Asr), mekhri to skotadi tes nukhtas (del. Al-Magrimp kai Al-'Isa'), kai ten apaggelia tou Kor'an kata ten proseukhe Al-Phatzr (auges). Pragmati, kata ten apaggelia tou Kor'an sten proseukhe Al-Phatzr, parabriskontai (oi Aggeloi tes nukhtas kai tes emeras).

Kai kata te diarkeia tes nukhtas, xupna (o, Prophete) kai telese ten proseukhe, os auxese gia sena ste these (kai ta epipeda), oste o Kurios sou (ten Emera tes Anastases) na sou dosei mia axiepaine these.

Kai pes: <<Kurie mou! Kane me na mpo (ste Mantina) me mia ikanopoietike eisodo, kai na bgo (apo te Makka) me mia ikanopoietike exodo, kai steile mou apo Esena mia duname (kai ena epikheirema) pou na me uposterizei (enantion opoiou mou antitithetai).>>
Kai pes (stous eidololatres): <<Erthe e aletheia (se sas) kai khatheke e plane. Pragmati, e plane panta khanetai (enopion tes aletheias).>>
Stelnoume apo to Kor'an auta pou einai therapeia kai eleos gia tous pistous, alla den auxanei (to Kor'an) tous adikous para mono se apoleia (epeide otan to akoun, apostrephontai ap' auto).
Otan enapothesoume mia eunoia ston anthropo, apostrephetai (me akharistia) kai apomakrunetai (apo ten upakoe me alazoneia), alla otan ton plettei to kako, ginetai apelpismenos.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O kathenas energei me ton diko tou tropo (pou tou tairiazei kai moiazei me ten katastase tou os pros ten kathodegese kai ten paraplanese). Pragmati, o Kurios sas gnorizei kalutera poios einai pio kathodegemenos sto dromo (pros ten aletheia).>>

(Oi apistoi) se rotoun (o, Mokhammant) gia to pneuma (ten psukhe). Pes: <<E gnose gia to pneuma anekei mono ston Allakh, (kai to pneuma einai ena demiourgema me ten entole tou Allakh <<Gennetheto>> kai etsi egine). Kai de labate apo te gnose, (o, anthropoi), para mono lige.>>

An thelame, tha eikhame aphairesei (apo ta stethe kai tis graphes sas) auto (to Kor'an) pou sou apokalupsame (o, Mokhammant), kai tote de tha ebriskes gia sena kanenan uposterikte enantion Mas (pou na Mas zeta ten epistrophe tou, e na Mas apotrepsei apo to na kanoume auto)!

Alla (den to aphairesame) apo eleos apo ton Kurio sou (o, Mokhammant). Pragmati, e gennaiodoria Tou se sena einai polu megale (kai gi' auto tha prepei na khareis gia to Kor'an kai na me se stenakhorei e diapseuse ton paraplanemenon)!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ean oi anthropoi kai ta tzinn sugkentronontan (oloi mazi) gia na pheroun (kai na demiourgesoun) kati paromoio m' auto to Kor'an, de tha mporousan pote na pheroun kati paromoio m' auto, akome kai an uposterizan o enas ton allon.>>
Pragmati, ekhoume dosei (kai exegesei) s' auto to Kor'an, apo kathe paradeigma (kai nouthesia) stous anthropous, ostoso oi perissoteroi anthropoi epimenoun sten arnese (kai sten plane tous).
Kai eipan (Oi eidololatres, se sena, o, Prophete): <<De tha pistepsoume pote se sena mekhri na anabluseis gia mas mia pege apo te ge (tes Makkas),
e na ekheis enan kepo me khourmadies kai ampelia, kai na kaneis potamia na reoun aphthona anamesa tous,
e na kaneis ton ourano na pesei se kommatia -opos iskhuristekes- se mas (gia timoria) e na phereis ton Allakh kai tous Aggelous mprosta mas na tous blepoume (gia na marturesoun oti les ten aletheia),

e na ekheis ena spiti apo khruso, e na anebeis ston ourano, kai de tha pistepsoume (oti eisai Aggeliaphoros) logo tes anodou sou, mekhri na katebaseis se mas ena biblio (apo ton Allakh) pou na to diabasoume (kai na epibebaiosei ten apostole sou).>> Pes (tous): <<Doxa ston Kurio mou (einai Anoteros apo to na einai oi entoles Tou sumphona me tous pothous sas. Kaneis den mporei na epembainei sto Basileio Tou, kai Autos kanei o,ti thelei)! Eimai tipota allo ektos apo enan Apestalmeno anthropo (opos oloi oi alloi Aggeliaphoroi pou etan anthropoi);>>
Kai den empodise tous (apistous) anthropous to na pistepsoun otan tous erthe e kathodegese, ektos apo to oti eipan: <<Ekhei steilei o Allakh enan anthropo os Aggeliaphoro;>>
Pes (tous, o, Prophete): <<An uperkhan ste ge Aggeloi pou perpatousan kathesukhasmenoi, tha tous eikhame steilei apo ton ourano enan Aggelo os Aggeliaphoro.>>

Pes (tous, o, Prophete): <<Eparkei o Allakh os Marturas anamesa se mena kai se sas. Pragmati, Autos einai gia tous doulous Tou, Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).>>

Opoion kathodegei o Allakh, einai o alethina kathodegemenos, kai opoion kanei na parastratesei, gia tetoious (anthropous) de tha breis uposteriktes enantion Autou (kai tes timorias Tou). Ten emera tes Anastases, tha tous sugkentrosoume (sernontas tous) sta prosopa tous - tuphlous, alalous kai kouphous. E katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase. Opote tha upokhorei, tha auxanoume gi' autous te sphodroteta tes Photias.

Aute tha einai e timoria tous, epeide arnethekan ta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas kai eipan: <<Einai dunaton oti otan (tha pethanoume kai) tha ginoume osta kai skone, tha anastethoume pragmatika kai tha demiourgethoume xana (se mia nea demourgia os anthropoi, opos eimastan prin);>>

De blepoun oti o Allakh, o Opoios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge (para to megalo megethos tous), einai Ikanos na demiourgesei paromoious (epanapherontas ta adunama kai mikra somata ton anthropon opos etan prin); Ekhei orisei gi' autous (tous anthropous) mia kathorismene ora (gia to thanato kai ten anastase tous), gia ten opoia den uparkhei amphibolia, ostoso (meta ap' autes tis apodeixeis) oi adikoi epimenoun sten arnese (kai sten plane tous).

Pes (tous, o, Prophete): <<An kateikhate ta thesaurophulakia tou eleous tou Kuriou mou (pou den exantlountai pote), sigoura tha apeikhate apo to na ta xodeuete apo phobo na teleiosoun (kai na ginete phtokhoi)!>> Pragmati, o anthropos einai polu tsigkounes (ektos ap' auton pou ton prostateuei o Allakh apo tetoio kharaktera meso tes pistes.)

Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse ennea xekathara Semadia (pou epibebaionan ten apostole tou). Rota (o, Mokhammant) ta paidia tou Israel otan tous erthe (o Mouses m' auta ta Semadia), alla o Pharao tou eipe: <<O, Mouse! St' aletheia, nomizo oti eisai magemenos.>>

(O Mouses) eipe: <<Pragmati, xereis me bebaioteta oti kanenas den esteile auta (ta Semadia) ektos apo ton Kurio ton ouranon kai tes Ges, (ta esteile) os xekathares apodeixeis. St' aletheia, pisteuo oti esu, o, Pharao, eisai apokommenos apo kathe kalo!>>
Apophasise loipon (o Pharao) na tous exontosei apo te ge, alla ton pnixame kai olous osous etan mazi tou.

Kai meta ap' auton (kai ten katastrophe tou), eipame sta paidia tou Israel: <<Katoikeste ste ge (tou Lebante). Kai otan erthei e uposkhomene Ora tes Emeras tes Anastases, tha sas sugkentrosoume olous (apo tous taphous sas gia na logodotesete).>>

Me ten aletheia to steilame (to Kor'an), kai me ten aletheia staltheke (del. khoris kamia alloiose e diastreblose), kai de se steilame (o, Prophete) para mono os phorea kharmosunon neon kai proeidopoiete.
Kai (steilame) ena Kor'an pou ekhoume diasaphenisei, gia na to apaggelleis stous anthropous me argo ruthmo (gia na to sullogizontai), kai to ekhoume steilei tmematika.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pistepste s' auto (to Kor'an) e men pistepsete (auto de tha to auxesei se kati, oute tha to meiosei se kati).>> Pragmati, ekeinoi stous opoious dotheke e gnose (gia ta Theia Biblia) prin ap' auto (kai gnorizoun ten aletheia kai ten apokalupse, opos o Salman Al-Pharesi kai o Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam), otan apaggelletai (to Kor'an) s' autous, pephtoun (sto edaphos) me ta pegounia (ta prosopa) tous se Sitzount stase.
Kai lene: <<Doxa ston Kurio mas! Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Kuriou mas oposdepote tha ekplerothei.>>

Kai pephtoun (sto edaphos) me ta pegounia (ta prosopa) tous se Sitzount stase, klegontas (apo phobo pros ton Kurio tous). Kai tous auxanei (to Kor'an) se eulabeia (kai se tapeinophrosune enopion Tou).

Pes (o, Mokhammant, stous eidololatres pou se epekrinan oti epikaleisai ton Allakh me to Onoma Ar-Rakhman, nomizontas oti epikaleisai duo theous): <<Eite Ton epikaleiste, Allakh, eite Ton epikaleiste, Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), me opoio (Onoma apo ta Omorpha Onomata Tou) Ton epikalesteite, s' Auton anekoun ta Omorphotera Onomata (del. ekhete epikalesei ton Idio Theo).>> Men apaggelleis (to Kor'an) sten proseukhe sou dunata (kai na se akoun oi apistoi), oute psithurista (kai na men se akoun oi pistoi), alla akoloutha enan tropo sto endiameso.

Kai pes: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, o Opoios den apektese enan gio [aphou mono o adunamos einai autos pou khreiazetai enan gio os sunetairo, kleronomo, boetho otan tha gerasei, e khreiazetai apogonous ap' auton], oute ekhei kanenan etairo sto Basileio Tou [aphou mono oi adunamoi einai autoi pou khreiazontai etairous], oute khreiazetai kanenan uposterikte (e summakho e prostate) logo adunamias. Kai doxase Ton polu.>>
Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, o Opoios esteile ston doulo Tou to Biblio, kai to ekane (to Kor'an) na men ekhei kamia parekklise (apo ten aletheia).

Einai ortho (Biblio pou den ekhei kamia antiphase oute kanena lathos), (kai to esteile) gia na proeidopoiesei gia mia austere timoria ap' Auton, kai na dosei ta kharmosuna nea stous pistous pou kanoun enaretes praxeis, oti tha ekhoun kale antamoibe (ton Paradeiso),
opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta.
Kai na proeidopoiesei ekeinous (tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious) pou lene: <<O Allakh apektese enan gio (ton Iesou e ton Ouzair)!>>
Den ekhoun gi' auto (pou iskhurizontai) kamia gnose (e apodeixe) oute oi propatores tous! Ti teratodes lexe einai aute pou bgainei apo ta stomata tous! De lene para ena psema.

(O, Mokhammant) tha katestrephes ton eauto sou apo te thlipse (gi' ekeinous tous apistous) aphou apostraphekan, epeide den pisteuoun s' auto ton logo (to Kor'an); [Me lupasai gi' autous, epeide an o Allakh exere oti uparkhei kalosune mesa tous, tha tous eikhe kathodegesei, alla e euthune sou einai mono na diabibaseis to menuma xekathara].
Ekhoume kanei o,ti uparkhei pano ste ge os stolidia gi' auten, gia na tous dokimasoume (tous anthropous) poios ap' autous tha prattei kalutera (kai perissoteres kales praxeis).
Kai pragmati, tha metatrepsoume o,ti uparkhei pano tes (ges), se skone khoris blastese.

E nomizeis (o, Prophete) oti e istoria ton anthropon tou spelaiou kai tou pinaka (ston opoio pinaka graphtekan ta onomata tous) etan apo ta pio thaumasia Semadia Mas! [Men nomizeis auto, pragmati, pio thaumasia ap' aute, einai ta Semadia Mas ste demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes Ges, kai te gnose kai te sophia pou steilame se sena].

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan oi neoi katephugan sto spelaio (xepheugontas apo ton lao tous pou tous zetese na latreuoun eidola), kai eipan: <<Kurie mas! Kharise mas eleos apo Sena, kai dieukolune gia mas s' aute ten katastase mas, ten kathodegese.>>
Etsi, kalupsame ta autia tous (apo to na akoun, kai tous kaname na pesoun se bathu upno) sto spelaio gia polla khronia.
Epeita, tous kaname na xupnesoun gia na doume (del. na emphanistei auto pou ede xeroume) poio apo ta duo mere tha xerei poso kairo emeinan (sto spelaio).
Emeis diegoumaste se sena (o, Prophete) me ten aletheia ten istoria tous. Etan neoi pou pistepsan ston Kurio tous, kai tous auxesame se kathodegese.

Dunamosame tis kardies tous (me ten piste) otan stekontan (enopion tou apistou basilia pou tous rotese giati de latreuan ta eidola), kai eipan: <<Pragmati, o Kurios mas einai o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes Ges. De tha epikalestoume pote kanenan allon theo ektos Autou, giati tha legame etsi ena teratodes psema.>>

(Meta eipan metaxu tous): <<Autoi einai oi anthropoi tou laou mas, ekhoun parei ektos Autou allous theous (gia latreia). Tha mporousan na pheroun sapheis apodeixeis skhetika m' autous (oti axizoun te latreia); [Okhi bebaios]. Poios einai loipon pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou kataskeuazei psemata enantion tou Allakh;

Kai otan tha khoristeite ap' autous kai apo o,ti latreuoun ektos apo ton Allakh, tote na kataphugete sto spelaio, kai o Kurios sas tha aplosei gia sas apo to eleos Tou, kai tha dieukolunei gia sas sten katastase sas, me mesa bioporismou.>>

(Epeita tous kaname na pesoun se bathu upno). Tha eblepes ton elio otan aneteile, na apoklinei apo to Spelaio tous pros ta dexia [auto semainei oti e eisodos etan pros ton bora], kai otan edue, na apomakrunetai ap' autous pros ta aristera, eno briskontan se megalo khoro mesa tou (spelaiou). Auto etan ena apo ta Semadia tou Allakh. Opoion kathodegei o Allakh, einai o alethina kathodegemenos, kai opoion ton kanei na parastratesei, de tha breis pote gi' auton kanenan uposterikte pou na ton kathodegesei.

(An tous eblepes) tha nomizes oti etan xupnioi, an kai koimontousan. Tous gurizame ste dexia kai sten aristere tous pleura [gia na men tous phaei e ge e na ekhoun pleges kataklises klp.], kai o skulos tous tentone ta mprostina tou podia sten eisodo. An tous eblepes, tha eikhes phugei makria tous, kai tha esoun gematos tromo.

(Opos tous kaname ta parapano thaumata), omoios, tous kaname na xupnesoun gia na rotesei o enas ton allon. Eipe enas ap' autous: <<Poso kairo koimethekate;>> Eipan: <<Koimethekame gia mia emera e ena meros mias emeras.>> Eipan (oi alloi): <<O Kurios sas xerei kalutera poso kairo koimethekate. Steilte loipon enan apo sas m' auta ta asemenia nomismata sas sten pole, kai as dei poios ekhei pio kalo phageto kai na pherei agatha ap' auton, kai na einai eugenikos kai na men kanei kanenan na mathei gia sas.
Giati an mathoun gia sas, tha sas lithobolesoun e tha sas anagkasoun na epistrepsete ste threskeia tous, kai tote (an to kanete) de tha petukhete pote.>>

(Opos tous kaname ta parapano thaumata), omoios, kaname tous allous (tous katoikous tes poles kai ton basilia tous) na mathoun gi' autous (kai ten istoria tous, otan eidan ta palia nomismata m' auton pou pege na agorasei phageto). Gia na mathoun (oi katoikoi tes poles otan eidan auto to Semadi) oti e uposkhese tou Allakh (gia ten anastase) einai alethine, kai oti den uparkhei kamia amphibolia gia ten Ora (tes Emeras tes Kriseos). [Omos otan ephtasan, oi katoikoi, exo apo to spelaio, kai zetese ekeinos pou pege na agorasei phageto na mpei protos gia na men tromaxoun oi alloi, pethane autos kai oi suntrophoi tou sto spelaio], tote diaphonesan (oi anthropoi) metaxu tous gia to thema ekeinon (ton neon), kai etsi (kapoioi) eipan: <<Khtiste enan toikho sten eisodo tou spelaiou tous (gia na tous prostateuei). O Kurios tous gnorizei kalutera ten katastase tous (kai ten enarete these tous).>> Omos ekeinoi pou epikratesan sto thema tous, eipan: <<Pragmati, tha khtisoume ston topo tous ena tzami (topo latreias gia na tous thumomaste kai os time gi' autous).>>

Merikoi (Khristianoi kai Ebraioi pou tha suzetesoun gia ten istoria tous argotera) tha poun: <<Etan treis (neoi), kai o skulos tous etan o tetartos (se arithmo)>>, eno alloi tha poun: <<Etan pente, kai o skulos tous etan o ektos>>, - manteuontas (khoris apodeixe) gia kati pou den xeroun. Kai alloi tha poun: <<Etan epta, kai o skulos tous etan o ogdoos.>> Pes: <<O Kurios mou gnorizei kalutera ton arithmo tous, kai den xerei ton arithmo tous para mono ligoi. Gi' auto me suzetas (o, Prophete, mazi tous) gia ton arithmo tous, para mono mia epiphaneiake suzetese (me to na apaggelleis mono auto pou sou apokalupsame khoris na maloseis mazi tous), oute na roteseis kanenan ap' autous gia ten istoria ekeinon (ton neon, aphou den xeroun tis leptomereies tes, kai o,ti tha poun tha einai logia khoris gnose).>>
Kai men peis pote gia otidepote: <<Sigoura tha kano auto aurio>>,

khoris na prostheseis: <<In sa' Allakh (An thelei o Allakh).>> Kai exumnese ton Kurio sou (me to na peis <<In sa' Allakh.>>) an xekhaseis (na to peis), kai pes: <<Eithe o Kurios mou na me kathodegesei se kati pio konta sten kathodegese (kai ten epitukhia) ap' auto to thema.>>
Kai emeinan sto spelaio tous gia triakosia ennia khronia (mekhri pou pethanan).

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Allakh xerei kalutera poso kairo emeinan. S' Auton anekei e gnose ton aoraton ton ouranon kai tes ges. Poso teleia einai e Orase kai e Akoe Tou (Autou pou blepei kai akouei ta panta)! Den ekhoun (oi anthropoi) kanenan Alethino Kedemona (pou na dieuthetei ola ta themata tous) ektos ap' Auton, kai den moirazetai ten exousia Tou me kanenan.>>

Apaggeile (o, Prophete, kai akoloutha) o,ti apokaluphtheke se sena apo to Biblio tou Kuriou sou. Pote de tha uparkhei allage sta Logia Tou (o,ti uposkhetheke apo antamoibe e timoria, oposdepote tha pragmatopoiethei), kai de tha breis pote kanena kataphugio para mono s' Auton.

Kai na parameineis (o, Prophete) m' ekeinous (tous phtokhous pistous) pou epikalountai ton Kurio tous to proi kai to apogeuma epidiokontas ten Eukharistese Tou. Kai men apostrepheis ta matia sou ap' autous (pros tous apistous arkhegous) epidiokontas ta stolidia tes egkosmias zoes (del. men upakous tous apistous pou sou zetesan na apomakruneis tous phtokhous apo te sugkentrose sou gia na kathisoun autoi na se akousoun gia to Islam), kai men upakous ekeinon pou kaname ten kardia tou aprosekte apo ten exumnese Mas, kai akolouthese tous pothous tou, kai katelexe sten katastrophe.

Kai pes: <<E aletheia (pou metephera s' esas) einai apo ton Kurio sas, (kai de tha apomakruno tous phtokhous pistous apo guro mou gia na kathisete eseis na akousete gia to Islam), etsi, opoios epithumei as pistepsei, kai opoios epithumei as men pistepsei!>> Pragmati, ekhoume proetoimasei gia tous adikous ena Pur, oi toikhoi tou opoiou tha tous perikuklosoun. Kai an zetesoun boetheia (anakouphise e nero), tha tous dothei nero san brasto bromiko ladi pou tha kapsei ta prosopa tous. Poso athlio einai ekeino to poto, kai poso athlio einai (to Pur) os topos diamones!
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis (tha laboun ten antamoibe tous), pragmati, Emeis den aphenoume ten antamoibe ekeinon pou prattoun to kalo, na khathei.

Ekeinoi tha ekhoun kepous monimes diamones, kai kato apo tis katoikies tous tha reoun potamia. Tha stolistoun ekei me brakhiolia phtiagmena apo khruso, kai tha phoroun prasina imatia apo lepto kai pakhu metaxi, kai tha einai xaplomenoi se stolismena krebatia. Poso exairetike antamoibe einai aute, kai poso kalos (o Paradeisos) os topos diamones!

Dose tous (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres pou zetesan na apomakruneis tous phtokhous pistous gia na kathisoun na se akousoun gia to Islam) ena paradeigma duo andron (enos pistou kai enos apistou): se enan ap' autous (del. ston apisto) dosame duo kepous me ampelia kai tous perikuklosame me khourmadies kai kaname anamesa tous kalliergeies.
Kai oi duo kepoi paregagan tous karpous tous khoris kamia meiose, kai kaname na reei mesa tous ena ruaki.
Kai eikhe (o apistos) pollous karpous, kai eipe (kaukhomenos) ston suntropho tou kathos sunomilouse mazi tou: <<Ekho perissotero apo sena plouto kai uposteriktes.>>
Kai mpeke ston kepo tou (mazi me ton suntropho tou), eno adikouse ton eauto tou (me ten apistia kai ten alazoneia tou), kai eipe: <<Den nomizo na katastraphei autos (o kepos) pote,

oute nomizo oti tha erthei pote e Ora (tes Emeras tes Kriseos). Akoma ki an (upothesoume oti ekheis dikio oti tha ginei e anastase kai) tha epistrapho ston Kurio mou, sigoura tha bro oti epistrapheka se kalutero topo ap' auton (ton kepo).>>

O (pistos) suntrophos tou tou eipe kathos sunomilouse mazi tou: <<Arneisai ten piste s' Auton pou se demiourgese (del. demiourgese ton Adam) apo khoma, epeita (demiourgese tous apogonous tou) apo Noutpha (stagones apo anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phullon), kai epeita se diamorphose enan antra;
Omos ego leo oti Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios mou, kai den apodido ston Kurio mou kanenan ste latreia.

An mono otan mpekes ston kepo sou eikhes pei: <<O,ti thelei o Allakh, oposdepote ginetai, den uparkhei duname (na apokteso e prostateuso auton ton kepo) para mono me ten adeia kai ten uposterixe tou Allakh.>>, (auto tha etan kalutero gia sena). An me blepeis oti ekho ligotera apo sena ploute kai paidia (kai gi' auto kaukhiesai alazonika),

tote isos o Kurios mou na mou dosei kati kalutero apo ton kepo sou kai na steilei s' auton (ton kepo sou, logo tes apistias sou) mia timoria apo ton ourano, kai etsi na ginei (o kepos sou) mia agone olisthere ge.
E to nero tou (kepou) na buthistei (makria ste ge), opote de tha mporeis pote na to phtaseis.>>

Epeita, perikuklose e katastrophe olous tous karpous tou, kai arkhise na anapodogurizei tis palames tou (me apogoeteuse) gia osa eikhe xodepsei gi' auton (ton kepo), kathos (o kepos) eikhe katarreusei stis pergkoles tou. Kai eipe (metaniomenos): <<Makari na men eikha apodosei ston Kurio mou kanenan etairo ste latreia!>>
Kai den eikhe kamia omada (uposterikton) gia na ton prostatepsei apo ton Allakh, oute o idios mporouse na prostatepsei ton eauto tou (apo ten timoria tou Allakh).

Tote (se tetoies peristaseis), ole e uposterixe (e kedemonia kai e kuriarkhia) anekei mono ston Allakh, ton Enan Alethino Theo (kai epistrephei o anthropos me plere upotagei mono s' Auton). Autos ekhei ten kalutere antamoibe kai ekhei ton kalutero teliko proorismo (gia tous pistous).

Dose tous (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres pou zetesan na apomakruneis tous phtokhous pistous gia na kathisoun na se akousoun gia to Islam) to paradeigma tes egkosmias zoes: e opoia einai san nero pou steilame kato apo ton ourano, kai anameikhthekan mazi tou ta phuta tes ges (kai megalosan), kai epeita eginan akhura pou ta skorpisan oi anemoi. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

O ploutos kai ta paidia einai ta stolidia tes egkosmias zoes, alla oi enaretes praxeis pou tha meinoun (del. pou tha meinoun oi antamoibes tous ste Mellousa Zoe), ekhoun tis kaluteres antamoibes apo ton Kurio sou, kai ekhoun to kalutero pou mporoun na elpizoun (oi pistoi, apo o,ti perimenoun oi apistoi apo ta ploute kai ta paidia tous sten egkosmia zoe).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete, gia) ten Emera pou tha aphairesoume ta bouna, kai tha deis te ge na phanei (khoris bouna, ktiria e dentra), kai tha tous sugkentrosoume olous kai de tha aphesoume ap' autous kanenan (khoris na ton anastesoume).

Tha parousiastoun enopion tou Kuriou sou se seires, (kai tha tous eipothei): <<Pragmati, erthate se Emas opos sas demiourgesame ten prote phora (monous, xupolutous kai gumnous)! Alla iskhuristekate oti de tha orizame gia sas mia Ora (tes Emeras tes Kriseos, kata ten opoia tha anastetheite kai tha logodotesete)!>>

Tha topothetethei to biblio (ton praxeon sta kheria tous, sto dexi kheri tou pistou, kai sto aristero kheri tou apistou), kai tha deis tous kakous na phobethoun apo o,ti (kakes praxeis) einai (grammenes) mesa tou. Tha poun: <<Alimono mas! Ti ginetai m' auto to biblio, den aphenei oute mikre, oute megale (praxe), ektos na ten ekhei katagrapsei;>> Tha broun ola osa ekanan grammena (ekei). Pragmati, o Kurios sou den adikei kanenan.

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipame stous Aggelous, <<Peste se Sitzount stase (me tis palames kai ta metopa sto edaphos) enopion tou Adam (os khairetismo kai time pros auton, kai okhi latreia).>>, etsi epesan oloi se Sitzount stase ektos apo ton Implis, o opoios etan tzinn (kai okhi Aggelos), kai etsi parakouse ten entole tou Kuriou tou. Tha parete loipon (o, anthropoi) auton kai tous apogonous tou os kedemones (pou tha tous upakoute) anti Emena, parolo pou einai ekhthroi sas; Ti athlio einai auto gia tous adikous (oti pairnoun ten upakoe pros ton Implis) os antallagma (tes upakoes pros Emena)!

(Ekeinous pou tous pairnoun oi apistoi os kedemones kai tous upakoun -del. ton Satana kai tous apogonous tou-) den tous ekana na einai paron kata te demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes Ges (gia na Me boethesoun), oute kata te demiourgia ton idion (gia na Me boethesei o enas ste demiourgia tou allou). Oute tha epairna tous paraplanetes gia boethous.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete, gia) ten Emera pou tha pei (o Allakh s' ekeinous pou Tou apedidan etairous ste latreia): <<Kaleste autous pou iskhuristekate oti einai etairoi Mou!>> Etsi tha tous kalesoun, alla de tha antapokrithoun s' autous, kai tha kanoume anamesa tous katastrophe (te Photia opou tha katastraphoun oloi tous).
Oi kakoi tha doun te Photia kai tha bebaiothoun oti tha pesoun mesa tes, kai de tha broun kamia diaphuge ap' auten.

Pragmati, ekhoume diasaphenisei kai dosei s' auto to Kor'an kathe eidous paradeigma gia tous anthropous. Pragmati, o anthropos einai autos pou diaplektizetai perissotero (uperaspizomenos ten plane enanti tes aletheias).

Den empodise tous anthropous na pistepsoun, otan tous erthe e kathodegese (to Kor'an) kai na zetesoun sugkhorese apo ton Kurio tous, para mono (auto pou zetesan apo ton Prophete, apo peisma) na tous erthei o epanalambanomenos kanonas tou Allakh (del. e timoria Tou) pou eikhe erthei sta proegoumena adika ethne e na tous erthei e timoria mprosta sta matia tous.

De stelnoume tous Aggeliaphorous para mono os phoreis kharmosunon eideseon kai proeidopoietes. Alla ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste diaplektizontai me ten plane gia na aporripsoun ten aletheia m' auten (ten plane), kai peran ta Edaphia Mou kai aute (ten timoria) gia ten opoia elaban ten proeidopoiese, os antikeimeno khleuasmou.

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou elabe nouthesia apo ta Edaphia tou Kuriou tou, alla apostrapheke ap' auta kai xekhase (tis kakes sunepeies pou tha ekhei gia) o,ti ekhei diapraxei (apo apistia kai amarties)! Pragmati, balame pepla pano stis kardies tous gia na men to katalaboun (to Kor'an) kai (balame) kophose sta autia tous (gia na men to akoun me tropo pou na tous kanei na to katalaboun). Kai an tous kaleseis (o, Prophete) sten kathodegese, de tha kathodegethoun tote pote (oso uparkhoun auta ta pepla).

O Kurios sou einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Opoios ekhei eleos (pros tous doulous Tou). An thelei na timoresei autous (pou apostraphekan apo ta Edaphia Tou) gia osa diepraxan (khoris na tous dosei kamia anabole), tha epispeude gi' autous to marturio (sten egkosmia zoe, alla tous dinei eukairies na straphoun me metameleia pros Auton). Ostoso, uparkhei gi' autous mia kathorismene Ora, apo ten opoia de tha broun kamia diaphuge.

Autes oi (apistes) komopoleis (konta sas, opos tes phules 'Ant, tes Madiam kai tes Thamount), tis katastrepsame otan adikesan (ton eauto tous me ten apistia), kai eikhame orisei mia kathorismene ora gia ten katastrophe tous (e opoia otan erthe, katastraphekan).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Mouses eipe ston uperete tou (ton Iesou tou Naue, arabika: Giousa' mpin Noun): <<Akoma tha sunekhiso na perpatao mekhri na phtaso sto semeio opou sunantiountai ta duo somata nerou e tha perpateso gia polu kairo (mekhri na sunanteso ton Al-Khantir, gia na matho ap' auton).>> [Auto etan otan emathe apo ton Allakh gia ton Al-Khantir, pou eikhe perissotere gnose ap' auton. Kai emathe oti tha prepei na parei mazi tou ena psari se ena psathino kalathi, kai opou tha to khasei, ekei tha brei ton Al-Khantir].

Otan omos ephtasan sto semeio opou sunantiountai (ta duo somata nerou, koimetheke o Mouses dipla se enan brakho, kai to psari anastetheke, kai etsi) ekhasan to psari tous, to opoio pere ton anoikhto dromo tou sto nero, (alla o Iesous tou Naue xekhase na enemerosei ton Mouse otan xupnese).
Otan (xupnese o Mouses kai) xeperasan ekeino to meros, eipe (o Mouses) ston uperete tou: <<Phere mas to proino mas. St' aletheia, ekhoume polle kourase ap' auto to taxidi mas.>>

(O Iesous tou Naue) eipe: <<Thumasai otan kathesame dipla se enan brakho; Ekei ekhasa to psari, kai de me ekane na xekhaso na sou to anaphero auto, para mono o Satanas, kai (to psari anastetheke kai) pere ton dromo tou sto nero me thaumasto tropo.>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Auto akribos pou epidiokame (epeide ekei tha broume ton Al-Khantir).>> Etsi gurisan piso, akolouthontas ta bemata tous pou aphesan prin.
Etsi, brekan enan apo tous doulous Mas (ton Al-Khantir), ston opoio kharisame eleos apo Mas kai ton didaxame gnose apo Mas.
O Mouses tou eipe (ston Al-Khantir): <<Tha mporousa na se akoloutheso kai na mou didaxeis apo o,ti didakhtekes apo orthe gnose (kai kathodegese pou tha me ophelesei);>>
Eipe (o Al-Khantir): <<De tha mporeseis na ekheis upomone mazi mou.
Pos tha mporeseis na ekheis upomone me kati gia to opoio den ekheis gnose;>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Tha me breis, an thelei o Allakh, upomonetiko kai de tha parakouso kamia apo tis entoles sou.>>
Eipe (o Al-Khantir): <<An loipon me akoloutheseis, me me roteseis gia opoiodepote pragma (kano) mekhri ego na sou to anaphero (kai na sou to exegeso).>>

Anakhoresan loipon kai oi duo, ospou otan epibibastekan se ena ploio, to trupese (o Al-Khantir, parolo pou oi idioktetes tou ploiou, tous metepheran dorean os sebasmo gia ton Al-Khantir). (O Mouses) eipe: <<To trupeses gia na pnixeis tous epibates tou; Pragmati, ekheis kanei kati tromero!>>
(O Al-Khantir) eipe: <<De sou eikha pei oti de tha mporeseis na ekheis upomone mazi mou;>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Me sugkhoreis gi' auto pou xekhasa! Kai me mou kaneis to thema mou (sto na matho apo sena) na einai polu duskolo.>>

Ste sunekheia, prokhoresan mekhri pou sunantesan ena agori kai (o Al-Khantir) to skotose. (O Mouses) eipe: <<Skotoses mia agne (athoa) psukhe (pou den ekhei diapraxei kamia amartia, adika kai) khoris na einai antipoina gia dolophonia mias alles (psukhes); Pragmati, ekanes kati teratodes!>>
(O Al-Khantir) eipe: <<De sou eikha pei oti de tha mporeseis na ekheis upomone mazi mou;>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<An se roteso gia otidepote meta ap' auto, me me krateseis ste suntrophia sou, giati tote tha ekheis dikaiologia skhetika me mena.>>

Ste sunekheia, prokhoresan mekhri pou erthan stous katoikous mias komopoles, kai tous zetesan na tous dosoun phageto (os philoxenia), alla ekeinoi arnethekan na tous prospheroun philoxenia. Brekan ekei enan toikho pou etan etoimos na katarreusei, alla (o Al-Khantir) ton diorthose. (O Mouses) eipe: <<An etheles, tha mporouses na pareis kapoia plerome gi' auto!>>
(O Al-Khantir) eipe: <<Autos einai o khorismos metaxu emena kai esena. Tha se enemeroso gia ten ermeneia auton, gia ta opoia den mporouses na ekheis upomone.
Oso gia to ploio, aneke se kapoious phtokhous pou douleuan ste thalassa. Ethela na to kano elattomatiko, giati uperkhe enas basilias mprosta tous pou epairne kathe (kalo) ploio me te bia.

Oso gia to agori, oi goneis tou etan pistoi (alla o Allakh exere oti to agori tha arnethei argotera ten piste), kai etsi, etan kati miseto gia mena (kai tous lupetheka kai exera) oti (an megalosei) tha tous kalupsei me ten adikia kai ten akharistia (tou pros autous, e tha tous anagkasei na akolouthesoun ten adikia kai ten apistia tou, logo tes megales agapes tous pros auton).
Ethela loipon (m' auto pou ekana) na tous kharisei o Kurios tous anti autou, allo (paidi), pou tha einai kalutero ap' ekeino se kalosune kai pio eleemon.

Kai oso gia ton toikho, aneke se duo orphana agoria apo ten pole. Briskotan kato ap' auton enas thesauros pou aneke s' autous, kai o pateras tous etan enaretos andras. Etsi, o Kurios sou ethele na phtasoun ten elikia tes plerous dunames, kai na bgaloun to thesauro tous, os eleos apo ton Kurio sou. Kai den to ekana apo monos mou (alla etan me ten entole tou Allakh). Aute einai e exegese auton gia ta opoia den mporouses na deixeis upomone.
Se rotoun (o, Prophete) gia ton Dou-Al-Karnain (auton ton basilia me ta duo kerata). Pes: <<Tha sas po gi' auton kapoia eidese (os mia nouthesia).>>
Pragmati, Emeis tou dosame duname ste ge, kai tou dosame gia kathe pragma ta mesa (kai te gnose gia) na to petukhei.
Etsi, akolouthese enan dromo.

Ospou otan ephtase ste duse tou eliou, ton eide (ton elio) san na duei se mia therme pege (me maure laspe) kai breke ekei enan (apisto) lao. Eipame: <<O, Dou-Al-Karnain! E na (tous) timoreseis (an arnountai ten piste), e na tous pheresai me kalosune (me to na tous didaxeis ten piste).>>

Eipe (o Dou-Al-Karnain): <<Oso gia opoion adikei (epimenontas sten apistia), tha ton timoresoume, epeita (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha epistrepsei ston Kurio tou kai tha ton timoresei me ena tromero marturio.
Kai oso gia opoion pisteuei (ston Allakh) kai kanei enaretes praxeis, tha ekhei (apo ton Kurio tou ste Mellousa Zoe) ten kalutere antamoibe, kai tha tou poume (sten egkosmia zoe) kala logia.>>
Epeita, akolouthese allon enan dromo.

Ospou otan ephtase sten anatole tou eliou, ton eide (ton elio) na anatellei pano apo anthropous, gia tous opoious den kaname kanena peplo na tous kalupsei ap' auton (ton elio) [del. eite den eikhan bouna kai dentra, eite e ge tous den etan katallele gia na khtistoun spitia, eite o elios elampe ekei skhedon ole ten emera eno e nukhta etan mikre].
Paromoios (ekane m' auton ton lao opos ekane me ton proegoumeno), kai pragmati perikleioume me te gnose Mas o,ti eikhe (o Dou-Al-Karnain e ekeinos o laos kai to pos zouse ekei).
Epeita, akolouthese allon enan dromo.

Ospou otan ephtase (se ena anoigma) anamesa se duo phragmata (duo bouna e duo oroseires), breke mprosta tous, anthropous pou duskola katalabainan ta logia (ton allon, logo tes apomonoses tous apo tous allous anthropous).
Eipan: <<O, Dou-Al-Karnain! Pragmati, oi Gog kai Magog skorpizoun to kako ste ge. Tha mporoume na sou dosoume kapoia plerome kai na kaneis ena phragma anamesa se mas kai autous;>>

Eipe (o Dou-Al-Karnain): <<Auto pou mou edose o Kurios mou apo duname (kai exousia) einai kalutero (apo opoia plerome kai na mou prospherete). Boetheste me loipon me duname (apo andres kai ergaleia), kai tha kano anamesa se sas kai autous, ena mpazoma (phragma).

Pherte mou kommatia siderou [e brakhous siderou].>> Ospou otan isiose (to mpazoma kai to khtisimo) anamesa sta duo bouna, eipe: <<(Anapste photia kai) phusexte (s' aute)>>, ospou otan to ekane photia, eipe: <<Pherte mou liomeno khalko na ton khuso pano tou.>>
Etsi, den mporousan (oi laoi Gog kai Magog) na to upernikesoun, oute mporousan na to trupesoun.

Eipe (o Dou-Al-Karnain): <<Auto (to phragma) einai eleos apo ton Kurio mou. Alla otan tha erthei e ora pou orise o Kurios mou, tha to isopedosei (to phragma). Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Kuriou mou einai panta alethine (pou oposdepote tha pragmatopoiethei).>>

Kai tha tous aphesoume ekeine ten Emera (tes Kriseos) na anameikhthoun (oi anthropoi kai ta tzinn) o enas me ton allon. Kai tha phusexei (o Aggelos Israphel) to Keras (Salpigga, gia na anakoinosei ten anastase), kai tha tous sugkentrosoume olous mazi (ola ta demiourgemata).
Ekeine ten Emera tha deixoume ten Kolase stous apistous xekathara.
Ton opoion (apiston) ta matia etan kalummena (me ten apistia) apo to na doun ten Upenthumise Mou (to Kor'an kai ta Semadia Mou), kai den mporousan na akousoun (ta Edaphia Mou kai ten kathodegese).

Nomizoun oi apistoi oti to na paroun tous doulous Mou (Aggelous, Prophetes, e diabolous) os kedemones peran apo Emena, (oti tha tous ophelesoun e tha tous prostateusoun apo Emena); [Okhi bebaios]. Pragmati, ekhoume etoimasei ten Kolase gia tous apistous os mia katoikia.
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Na sas poume poioi einai oi pio khamenoi, anaphorika me tis praxeis tous;
Einai ekeinoi ton opoion oi praxeis apomakrunthekan (apo ten kathodegese) sten egkosmia zoe, eno nomizan oti ekanan kala.>>

Ekeinoi einai autoi pou arnethekan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) tou Kuriou tous kai ten piste ste sunantese Tou (ste Mellousa Zoe). Etsi, oi (kales) praxeis tous eginan mataies, kai ten Emera tes Anastases, de tha tous dosoume kamia axia.
Aute einai e timoria tous, e Kolase, gia ten apistia tous, kai gia to oti peran ta Edaphia Mou kai tous Aggeliaphorous Mou gia khleuasmo.
Pragmati, autoi pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun tous kepous tou Al-Phirntaous (to upselotero kai to kalutero epipedo tou Paradeisou) os katoikia.
Tha menoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai de tha zetesoun pote na metapherthoun ap' aute.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<An e thalassa etan melani gia (na graphtoun) ta Logia tou Kuriou mou, sigoura, e thalassa tha exantloutan prin na teleiosoun ta Logia tou Kuriou mou, akome ki an phername kai alles (thalasses) san ki aute gia na ten ephodiasoun.>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Pragmati, eimai mono enas anthropos san kai esas. Mou ekhei apokaluphthei oti o Theos sas einai mono Enas Theos (o Allakh). Etsi, opoios elpizei ste sunantese me ton Kurio tou, as prattei enaretes praxeis kai na men apodidei ston Kurio tou kanenan etairo ste latreia.>>

K, Kh, E, 'A, S (Kaph, Kha', Gia', 'Aein, Sant, pente xekhorista arabika grammata pou den apoteloun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun kapoia semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh prokalei opoiondepote amphiballei gia to Kor'an na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio).
(Aute einai) mia anaphora (o, Mokhammant) gia to eleos tou Kuriou sou ston doulo Tou, Zakharia.
Otan epikalesteke ton Kurio tou krupha.

(O Zakharias) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Pragmati, ta kokkala mou eginan adunama, kai to kephali mou phountose (del. gemise) me aspra mallia, kai den emoun pote steremenos apo ten antapokrise Sou, Kurie mou, sten epiklese mou pros Esena.

Kai phobamai ti tha kanoun oi suggeneis mou (kai ta paidia tou Israel, an tha allaxoun ta didagmata tes threskeias kai poios tha analabei te threskeutike egesia) meta apo mena, kai e gunaika mou einai steira. Kharise mou loipon ena kalo paidi (gia na ginei Prophetes meta apo mena).
O opoios tha kleronomesei (te gnose kai te threskeutike egesia) apo mena kai apo ten oikogeneia tou Iakob. Kurie mou! Kai kane ton euaresto se Esena.>>
(O Allakh eipe): <<O, Zakharia! Pragmati, sou dinoume ta kharmosuna nea gia enan gio, to onoma tou tha einai Giakhia (Ioannes o Baptistes). Ena onoma pou den ekhoume dosei prin se kanenan.>>

Eipe (o Zakharias, ekplektos apo te duname tou Allakh): <<Kurie mou! Pos tha ginei auto, oti tha apokteso enan gio, aphou e gunaika mou einai steira [del. tha prepei na pantreuto alle, e e idia tha mporesei na gennesei] kai ekho phtasei se bathia geramata [del. pos tha ekho te dunatoteta na kano te gunaika mou na sullabei];>>
(O Aggelos) eipe: <<Etsi tha ginei (opos eipotheke se sena). O Kurios sou eipe: <<Auto einai eukolo gia Mena, kai pragmati se demiourgesa prin otan esoun tipota!>>.>>

(O Zakharias) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Dose mou ena semadi (me to opoio na gnorizo oti e gunaika mou emeine egkuos).>> Eipe: <<To semadi sou einai oti de tha mporeis na mileseis stous anthropous gia treis sunekhomenes nukhtes (del. meres), parolo pou tha eisai ugies (kai okhi boubos, alla tha mporeis mono na exumneis ton Allakh).>>

Epeita (otan den mporouse na milesei), bgeke stous anthropous tou apo to khoro proseukhes (tou) kai tous dietaxe deikhnontas (e graphontas sto edaphos e se ena kharti) na doxasoun ton Allakh proi kai bradu.

(Aphou gennetheke o gios tou kai egine paidi, tou eipe o Allakh): <<O, Giakhia (Ioanne)! Pare to Biblio (del. mathe ten Tora kai epharmose tis entoles Mou) me duname.>> Kai tou dosame ten katanoese (tou Bibliou) eno etan akome paidi.
Kai tou dosame eleos apo Mas kai agnoteta (apo tis amarties), kai etan eusebes (pou panta phulassotan apo ten timoria Mas, terontas tis entoles Mas).
Kai etan kalos (kai eugenikos) me tous goneis tou, kai den etan alazonikos, oute anupakouos.
Eirene s' auton ten emera pou gennetheke, ten emera pou pethane kai ten emera pou tha anastethei zontanos!

Anaphere (o, Mokhammant) sto Biblio (to Kor'an) te Mariam (Maria, te metera tou Iesou Khristou), otan aposurtheke se apomonose apo ton lao (e ten oikogeneia) tes, se ena meros pou brisketai anatolika.

Kaluphtheke ap' autous [piso apo enan toikho, ena bouno e ena propetasma gia na latrepsei ton Allakh]. Etsi, tes steilame ton Aggelo Mas (ton Gabriel), kai emphanisteke mprosta tes ste morphe enos oloklerou andra.
(Otan ton eide e Maria, phobetheke kai) eipe: <<Anazeto kataphugio ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) apo sena. (Men mou kaneis kako) an phobasai apo ton Allakh.
(O Aggelos) eipe: <<Eimai mono enas Aggeliaphoros tou Kuriou sou, gia na sou khariso enan enareto gio.>>
(E Maria) eipe: <<Pos tha ekho enan uio, ephoson kaneis andras de me ekhei aggixei, oute eimai anethike;>>

(O Aggelos Gabriel) eipe: <<Etsi tha ginei (opos eipotheke se sena), o Kurios sou eipe: <<Auto einai eukolo gia Mena. Kai tha ton kanoume (ton Iesou) Semadi gia tous anthropous (gia te Duname Mas, oti tha gennethei apo metera kai khoris patera, opos demiourgesame ton Adam, khoris patera oute metera) kai eleos apo Mas. Pragmati, einai ena thema pou ekhei ede apophasistei (kai graphtei sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud, kai oposdepote tha ginei).>>.>>
Etsi, ton sunelabe (e Maria aphou o Aggelos phusexe sto enduma tes), kai aposurtheke (e Maria) m' auton (ton Iesou pou etan akoma sten koilia tes) se ena makrino meros.
Oi ponoi tes gennas ten odegesan ston kormo mias khourmadias. Eipe: <<Makari na eikha pethanei prin ap' auto, kai na emoun kati xekhasmeno pou kaneis de tha to anephere!>>
Tote (to moro Iesous) tes phonaxe apo kato tes, legontas: <<Me lupasai. O Kurios sou, (sou) ekhei paraskhei mia udatine pege kato apo sena.
Kai kouna pros esena ton kormo tes khourmadias, kai tha rixei se sena orimous kai phreskous khourmades.
Phae kai pies, loipon, kai na eisai kharoumene. Kai an deis kanenan anthropo, pes: <<St' aletheia, ekho orkistei nesteia gia ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), etsi de tha mileso se kanenan semera.>>.>>
Epeita to ephere (to moro) ston lao tes, koubalontas to. Eipan: <<O, Maria! St' aletheia, epheres ena teratodes pragma.
O, adelphe tou Aaron (del. o, omoia sten agnoteta kai ste latreia me ton eusebe andra Aaron, pou ezese ton kairo tes)! O pateras sou den etan moikhos, oute e metera sou etan anethike gunaika!>>
Epeita ekeine ton edeixe. Eipan: <<Pos mporoume na milesoume se ena paidi sto likno;>>
(O Iesous) Eipe: <<St' aletheia, eimai doulos tou Allakh, mou edose to Biblio (to In-tzel -to prototupo euaggelio tou Iesou-) kai me ekane Prophete.
Kai me ekane eulogemeno opou ki an eimai, kai me dietaxe na telo ten proseukhe, kai na dino te Zaka (upokhreotike eleemosune) gia oso zo.
Kai (me ekane) eusebe (kai upakouo) pros te metera mou. Kai de me ekane alazoniko kai anupakouo.

Eirene s' emena ten emera pou gennetheka, kai ten emera pou tha pethano [del. kata to deutero erkhomo tou Iesou ste ge], kai ten emera pou tha anastetho zontanos xana (kata ten Emera tes Anastases)!>>
Tetoios einai o Iesous, o uios tes Marias. Auta einai ta logia tes aletheias (skhetika m' auton), gia ten opoia amphiballoun (kai diaphonoun metaxu tous).

Den tairiazei ston Allakh (kai ste Megaloprepeia Tou) na apoktesei enan uio. Doxa s' Auton (einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun pseudos). Otan apophasisei kati, aplos tou leei: <<Genetheto!>> kai etsi ginetai.

(O Iesous eipe ston lao tou): <<St' aletheia, o Allakh einai o Kurios mou kai o Kurios sas. Etsi, latrepste Ton (khoris na Tou apodidete kanenan etairo ste latreia). Autos einai o isios dromos (pou prepei na ton akolouthesete).>>

Omos diaphonesan oi omades metaxu tous (skhetika m' auton, etsi, mia omada ton pistepse, oti einai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh, alle ton diepseuse, kai alle epinoese alla dogmata diaphoretika ap' ekeina pou didaxe o Iesous, kai etsi, ton latrepse). Alimono loipon stous apistous apo ten parousia tous sten megale Emera!
Poso kala (kai xekathara) tha akousoun kai tha doun ten Emera pou tha erthoun se Mas! Omos oi adikoi semera (sten egkosmia zoe) briskontai se xekathare plane.

Proeidopoiese tous (o, Mokhammant) gia ten Emera tes lupes, otan to thema tha ekhei teleiosei (kai oi pistoi tha ekhoun mpei ston Paradeiso, eno oi apistoi sten Kolase), alla autoi (tora sten egkosmia zoe) briskontai se adiaphoria kai ameleia (gia o,ti tous eikhan proeidopoiesei), kai den pisteuoun.
Pragmati, Emeis eimaste pou tha kleronomesoume te Ge kai osous briskontai pano tes (del. Emeis pou tha meinoume eno oloi tha ekhoun pethanei), kai se Mas tha epistraphoun.
Anaphere (o, Mokhammant) sto Biblio (to Kor'an) ton Abraam, o opoios etan eilikrines kai Prophetes.
Otan eipe (o Abraam) ston patera tou: <<O, patera mou! Giati latreueis kati pou oute akouei, oute blepei, oute mporei na se prostatepsei apo tipota;
O, patera mou! Pragmati, mou erthe apo te gnose auto pou de sou erthe! Gi' auto akolouthese me, na se kathodegeso se enan isio dromo.
O, patera mou! Me latreueis ton Satana (upakouontas ton). Pragmati, o Satanas einai anupakouos pros ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona).
O, patera mou! Pragmati, phobamai (an pethaneis os apistos) na se plexei ena marturio apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), kai etsi tha gineis enas suntrophos gia ton Satana (sten Kolase).>>
Eipe (o pateras tou): <<Apomakrunesai apo tous theous mou, o, Abraam; An de stamateseis (na tous katakrineis), sigoura tha se lithoboleso! Meine loipon makria mou gia polu kairo!>>
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Kanena kako de tha sou phtasei (apo mena). Tha zeteso apo ton Kurio mou na se sugkhoresei (kai na se kathodegesei). Pragmati, einai polu Eugenes (kai Polueusplakhnos) pros emena.

Tha apomakruntho apo sas kai apo o,ti epikaleiste (kai latreuete) ektos tou Allakh. Tha epikalesto (kai tha latrepso mono) ton Kurio mou, isos me ten epiklese (kai te latreia) mou pros ton Kurio mou, na men eimai apogoeteumenos (kai khamenos, opos eseis me te latreia ton eidolon sas).>>
Otan apomakruntheke ap' autous kai apo o,ti latreuan ektos tou Allakh, tou kharisame (ton gio tou) ton Isaak kai (ton eggono tou) ton Iakob, kai tous kaname Prophetes.
Kai kharisame s' autous (ston Isaak kai ston Iakob) apo to eleos Mas, kai kaname gi' autous na uparkhei mia upsele uperokhe epainese (stis glosses ton metagenesteron geneon).
Anaphere (o, Mokhammant) sto Biblio (to Kor'an) ton Mouse. Pragmati, etan eklektos (kai etan aphosiomenos ste latreia tou pros ton Allakh), kai etan enas Apestalmenos kai Prophetes.
Ton phonaxame apo ten dexia pleura tou orous (opos to koitazei o Mouses) [del. akouse te Phone Mas apo ekei, otan eide photia se ena dentro], kai upsosame te these tou milontas (apeutheias) s' auton.
Tou dosame apo to eleos Mas (aphou Mas epikalesteke), ton adelpho tou ton Aaron (na ton uposterixei) os Prophete.
Anaphere (o, Mokhammant) sto Biblio (to Kor'an) ton Ismael. Pragmati, etan pistos sten uposkhese tou kai etan enas Apestalmenos kai Prophetes.
Dietaze sten oikogeneia tou ten proseukhe kai te Zaka (upokhreotike eleemosune), kai o Kurios tou etan Eukharistemenos ap' auton.
Anaphere (o, Mokhammant) sto Biblio (to Kor'an) ton Intres. Pragmati, etan eilikrines kai Prophetes.
Kai ton upsosame se upsele these.

Ekeinoi (oi proanapheromenoi) tous eunoese o Allakh, oi opoioi etan apo tous prophetes, apo tous apogonous tou Adam, ap' autous pou tous kaname na epibibastoun mazi me ton Noe (sten Kiboto), kai apo tous apogonous tou Abraam kai tou Israel (Iakob), kai oi opoioi etan ap' ekeinous pou kathodegesame kai epilexame.
