Otan tous apaggellontan ta Edaphia tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), epephtan se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos) klaigontas.
Alla erthan meta ap' autous alloi anthropoi (kai genies) pou paramelesan ten proseukhe kai akolouthesan tous pothous tous, etsi tha laboun apoleia kai katastrophe (sten Kolase),
ektos ap' ekeinous pou straphekan me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) kai pistepsan kai ekanan kales praxeis, ekeinoi tha eiselthoun ston Paradeiso kai de tha adikethoun se tipote.

(Tha eiselthoun se) kepous monimes diamones (ston Paradeiso) pou ekhei uposkhethei o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) (sten egkosmia zoe) stous doulous Tou, eno den tous ekhoun dei. Pragmati, e uposkhese Tou oposdepote tha ekplerothei.

De tha akousoun ekei mataia logia, alla tha akousoun mono kala logia kai khairetismous (apo tous Aggelous pros autous), kai tha ekhoun agatha mesa tous (stous kepous) proi kai bradu (del. sunekheia opote theloun).

Autos einai o Paradeisos pou tha dosoume monima os kleronomia (ton kalon praxeon pou ekanan sten egkosmia zoe), se osous apo tous doulous Mas phulassontai apo ten timoria Mas (terontas tis entoles Mas).

[Pes, o, Gabriel, ston Mokhammant pou se rotese <<Giati de mas episkeptesai pio sukhna;>>]: <<Pragmati, den katebainoume (ste ge) para mono me ten entole tou Kuriou sou. S' Auton anekei o,ti erkhetai mprosta mas (apo ta themata tes Mellousas Zoes), o,ti einai piso mas (apo ta themata tes egkosmias zoes) kai o,ti brisketai anamesa tous. Pragmati, o Kurios sou den xekhnaei pote (oute se xekhase, oute se egkateleipse).>>

O Kurios ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai oson briskontai anamesa tous. Latreue Ton, loipon, kai na eisai statheros kai upomonetikos ste latreia Tou. Gnorizeis opoiondepote paromoio m' Auton; [Okhi bebaios].
O anthropos (del. o apistos) leei: <<Einai dunaton oti aphou pethano, tha (anastetho) kai tha bgo (apo ton tapho) zontanos xana;>>
De thumatai o anthropos (del. o apistos pou diapseudei ten anastase) oti Emeis ton demiourgesame prin otan den etan tipota;

(Orkizomai) ma ton Kurio sou (o, Mokhammant)! Oposdepote (tha anastesoume kai) tha sugkentrosoume (ten Emera tes Kriseos) autous (pou diepseusan ten anastase), epises kai tous diabolous (pou tous paraplanesan), kai epeita tha tous pheroume guro apo ten Kolase, gonatismenous.
Epeita tha arpaxoume apo kathe omada, ekeinous pou etan oi pio anupakouoi pros ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona).
Epeita, pragmati, Emeis gnorizoume kalutera poioi axizoun perissotero na kaoun mesa tes (Kolases).
Den uparkhei kaneis anamesa sas pou na men perasei apo pano tes (gephuras -As-Sirat- pou pernaei pano apo ten Kolase). Einai mia diatage apo ton Kurio sou pou oposdepote tha ekplerothei.
Epeita tha sosoume autous pou phulakhthekan (kata ten egkosmia zoe) apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai tha aphesoume tous adikous mesa tes (Kolases) gonatismenous.

Otan ta Edaphia Mas apaggellontai s' autous (stous anthropous), xekathara, lene oi apistoi (apo te phule Kourais) stous (phtokhous) pistous: <<Poia apo tis duo omades (anamesa mas) ekhei ton kalutero topo katoikias kai ton kalutero topo sugkentroses (me perissoterous parontes); [del. Pos iskhurizeste oti to Islam einai kalutero apo ten eidololatria, eno menete se khalia spitia kai sunantieste krupha ston oiko tou Al-Arkam;]>>
Posa (apista) ethne ekhoume katastrepsei prin ap' autous, ta opoia eikhan kaluteres idioktesies kai kalutere emphanise!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Opoios brisketai sten plane, o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) tha tou dosei anabole (oste na auxethei e plane tou kai na ton pherei o Allakh stadiaka pros ten timoria), ospou otan doun (oi apistoi) auto pou tous uposkhetheke, eite ten timoria (s' auton ton kosmo), eite ten Ora (tes Kriseos), mono tote tha xeroun poios ekhei ton kheirotero topo katoikias kai tous ligoterous uposteriktes!>>

O Allakh auxanei ekeinous pou kathodegethekan, se perissotere kathodegese (kai piste kai upakoe). Kai oi enaretes praxeis pou tha meinoun (del. pou tha meinoun oi antamoibes tous ste Mellousa Zoe), ekhoun tis kaluteres antamoibes apo ton Kurio sou (apo opoiondepote plouto sten egkosmia zoe), kai ekhoun tis kaluteres sunepeies (gia tous pistous).
Eides (o, Prophete) auton (ton Al-'As mpin Oua'il) pou arnetheke ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas kai eipe: <<Sigoura (an pethano kai anastetho) tha mou dothoun ploute kai paidia.>>!
Gnorize to aorato, e ekhei parei uposkhese apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) (oti otan tha anastethei tha mpei ston Paradeiso kai tha tou dothoun ploute kai paidia);
Okhi (de tha tou dothoun auta)! Tha katagrapsoume o,ti leei kai tha auxesoume gi' auton to marturio polu.

Kai tha kratesoume gi' auton auta (ta logia) pou eipe (os kleronomia tou apo ten egkosmia zoe, oste na ton timoresoume gi' auta ste Mellousa Zoe), kai tha erthei se Mas monos (khoris tipota ste Mellousa Zoe).
Ekhoun parei (oi eidololatres) allous theous ektos tou Allakh, gia na tous uposterizoun kai na tous prostateuoun!

Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizontai oi eidololatres)! Pragmati, (ta eidola tous kai oi legomenoi theoi tous) tha aparnethoun (ten Emera tes Kriseos) te latreia pros autous (pou ekanan oi eidololatres) kai tha antitithentai s' autous.

[Men ekplessesai, o, Prophete, gia to pos oi apistoi speudoun na skorpisoun to kako]. De blepeis oti (os timoria) steilame tous diabolous (del. tous dosame exousia) enantion ton apiston (pou peran tous diabolous os kedemones), kai etsi tous upokinoun polu (sten amartia, kai sto na polemesoun ten aletheia);

Me biazesai loipon skhetika m' autous (to na pesei e timoria pano tous). Pragmati, (tous dinoume anabole kai) metrame gi' autous me akribeia (tis praxeis, tis anases kai tis emeres tous sten egkosmia zoe).
(Anaphere, o, Prophete, gia) ten Emera pou tha sugkentrosoume tous enaretous enopion tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) se omades, kai tha einai timemenoi.
Kai tha odegesoume tous kakous pros ten kolase, polu dipsasmenous.

De tha ekhoun (oi apistoi) te duname na diamesolabesoun (o enas gia ton allon oute na laboun diamesolabese apo kanenan pisto), alla mono ekeinoi (oi pistoi tha mporoun na diamesolabesoun o enas gia ton allon) oi opoioi ekhoun labei (sten egkosmia zoe) apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) mia uposkhese (meso tes upakoes tous pros Auton, kai ekhoun labei ste Mellousa Zoe ten adeia na diamesolabesoun).

(Oi Khristianoi, oi Ebraioi kai oi eidololatres) iskhuristekan: <<O Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) apektese enan uio (ton Iesou, ton Ouzair kai tous Aggelous os kores Tou -doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros apo opoiadepote ateleia e anagke-)!>>
St' aletheia, epinoesate kati teratodes!
Prokeitai oi ouranoi na skhistoun, e ge na anoixei kai ta bouna na katarreusoun exaitias autou,
oti apedosan ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), enan uio.
Den tairiazei ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), (oute sten Megaloprepeia Tou) na apoktesei enan uio.
Pragmati, oloi osoi briskontai stous ouranous kai ste ge, de tha elthoun ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) para mono os douloi (kata ten Eskhate Emera).
Pragmati, tous perikleiei me te gnose Tou, kai tous ekhei metresei me akribeia.
O kathenas tous tha elthei s' Auton kata ten Emera tes Anastases monos tou (khoris uposteriktes e periousies).
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) tha balei gi' autous agape (stis kardies ton allon anthropon).

Pragmati, to dieukoluname (to Kor'an) ste glossa sou (o, Mokhammant, ta arabika), gia na dineis kharmosuna nea s' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai na proeidopoieis m' auto (to Kor'an) enan lao pou antitithetai sklera sten aletheia (kai uperaspizetai polu ten plane).
Posa (apista) ethne ekhoume katastrepsei prin ap' autous! Aisthanesai (tora e blepeis e briskeis, o, Prophete) kanena ap' auta e akous gi' autous kanenan psithuro;

T, Kh [Ta-Kha, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den apoteloun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
De steilame to Kor'an se sena (o, Prophete) gia na talaiporeisai (kai na lupasai ton lao sou pou arneitai ten piste).
Alla (to steilame) os nouthesia (kai upenthumise) gia osous phobountai (ton Allakh).
Mia apokalupse ap' Auton pou demiourgese te Ge kai tous upselous ouranous.
O Ar-Rakhman (Polueusplakhnos) upsotheke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei sten Megaloprepeia Tou).
S' Auton anekoun o,ti brisketai stous ouranous, ste ge, o,ti brisketai anamesa tous, kai o,ti brisketai kato apo to khoma.
Eite milas phonakhta, (eite krupha, o, Prophete), pragmati, Autos xerei o,ti einai mustiko, kai o,ti einai pio krummeno (opos tis skepseis tes psukhes).
Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. S' Auton anekoun ta Omorphotera Onomata.
Sou erthe (o, Prophete) e istoria tou Mouse;

Otan (ekhase ton dromo sto taxidi tou, kai) eide photia, kai eipe sten oikogeneia tou: <<Meinete edo. Ekho dei mia photia, isos na mporeso na phero ap' aute mia phloga gia sas, e na bro kapoion na mas kathodegesei ston dromo.>>
Otan ten ephtase, tou phonaxe (o Allakh): <<O, Mouse!
Pragmati, Ego eimai o Kurios sou (pou sou milaei). Bgale loipon ta upodemata sou, giati briskesai sten iere koilada, Toua.
Ego se epelexa, gi' auto akou auto pou tha apokaluphthei (se sena):
Pragmati, Ego eimai o Allakh. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Ego, gi' auto latrepse mono Emena kai telese ten proseukhe gia ten exumnese Mou.

Pragmati, e Ora erkhetai, alla skhedon ten kratao kruphe (alla tha xeroun oti plesiazei apo ta Semadia tes). (Tha erthei) gia na labei e kathe psukhe (ten antamoibe e ten timoria) gia o,ti ekane (apo kalo e kako).

Men apheseis, loipon, ekeinous pou den pisteuoun s' auten (ten Ora) kai akolouthoun tous pothous tous na se apostrepsoun ap' aute (kai na etoimazesai gi' auten me tis kales praxeis sou), diaphoretika tha katastrapheis.
Ti einai auto sto dexi sou kheri, o, Mouse;>> [To erotema edo trabaei ten prosokhe tou Mouse sto poso asemante einai e rabdos tou, alla m' aute tha kanei megala thaumata]!
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Einai e rabdos mou. Sterizomai s' aute kai khtupao ta dentra m' aute gia na pesoun ta phulla kai na ta phane ta probata mou, kai te khresimopoio kai gi' alles khreseis.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Rixe ten kato, o, Mouse!>>
Etsi, ten erixe kato (o Mouses), kai etsi egine (e rabdos) ena phidi pou kiniotan gregora.
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Pare ten piso kai me phobasai. Tha ten epanapheroume sten proegoumene katastase tes.
Kai bale to kheri sou kato apo te maskhale sou, tha bgei aspro khoris kanena kako (lepra), os allo ena Semadi.
Gia na sou deixoume apo ta megala Semadia Mas.
Pegaine ston Pharao, giati parabiase ta oria (me tis amarties kai ten apistia).>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Kane to stethos mou pio anoikhto (gia na antexo to kako tou Pharao),
kai dieukolune gia mena to thema (ten apostole) mou,
kai luse te glossa mou (gia na mileso me euglotta logia),
oste na katalaboun ta logia mou.
Kai orise gia mena enan boetho apo ten oikogeneia mou,
ton Aaron, ton aderpho mou.
Endunamose me, m' auton,
kai kane ton, ton sunetairo mou sto thema (ten apostole) mou.
Oste na Se doxazoume polu,
kai na Se exumnoume polu.
Pragmati, blepeis ta panta skhetika me mas (kai tipote den einai krupho gia Sena).>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<O, Mouse! Tha sou to dothei auto pou zeteses.
Kai pragmati, sou eikhame (ede) parakhoresei alle khare, se mia (proegoumene) phora, (otan gennethekes kai se sosame apo ton Pharao pou skotose ta neogenneta apo to lao sou).
Otan empneusame ste metera sou, auta (ta logia) pou empneusame (gia na sotheis ap' auton):

<<Bal' ton sto kalathi, kai meta bal' to sto nero (to potami), etsi to nero tha to metapherei sten akte (me ten entole Mou). Kai tha ton sekosei kapoios pou einai ekhthros Mou kai ekhthros tou.>> Kai enapothesa se sena (o, Mouse) agape apo Emena (kai etsi se agapesan oi anthropoi), kai gia na anatrapheis upo ten Orase kai te Merimna Mou.

Otan perpatese e aderphe sou (akolouthontas to kalathi sto nero, kai ste sunekheia se peran e oikogeneia tou Pharao kai epsaxan gia mia thelazousa, epeide arnethekes oles tis thelazouses) kai etsi (e aderphe sou) eipe: <<Na sas po gia mia pou mporei na ton thelasei (kai na ton anathrepsei);>> Etsi se epistrepsame ste metera sou, gia na kharei kai na me lupatai. Epeita, (aphou megaloses) skotoses (kata lathos) enan anthropo (apo tous ekhthrous sou, pou tsakotheke me enan apo ton lao sou), alla se sosame apo te thlipse, kai se balame se polles dokimasies. Kai (ephuges gia na men se skotosoun kai) emeines anamesa sto lao tes Madiam gia arketa khronia. Epeita ephtases (sto meros auto) sten prokathorismene ora (pou orisame gia ten apostole sou), o, Mouse!
Kai se epelexa gia (na metaphereis) to Menuma Mou.
Pegaine, esu kai o adelphos sou, me ta Semadia Mou, kai men eiste adunamoi sten Upenthumise Mou (sto na metapherete to Menuma Mou kai sten exumnese Mou).
Pegainete ston Pharao, giati parabiase ta oria (me tis amarties kai ten apistia).
Kai peite tou epia logia, isos apodekhtei ten nouthetese e na phobatai (Emena).>>
Eipan (o Mouses kai o Aaron): <<Kurie mas! Pragmati, phobomaste oti tha speusei na mas timoresei (prin tou phtasei to Menuma Sou) e na parabiasei ta oria (me ten adikia enantion mas).>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Me phobasthe! St' aletheia, Eimai mazi sas, akouo kai blepo.

Pegainete s' auton (ton Pharao) kai peite: <<Eimaste oi Aggeliaphoroi tou Kuriou sou, opote aphese ta paidia tou Israel (Iakob) na phugoun mazi mas, kai men tous basanizeis. Pragmati, erthame se sena me ena Semadi apo ton Kurio sou. Kai e asphaleia (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) einai gia opoion akolouthei ten alethine kathodegese.
Mas ekhei apokaluphthei oti e timoria tha pesei s' ekeinous pou diapseudoun (tous Aggeliaphorous) kai apostrephontai (apo ten aletheia).>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<Poios einai loipon o Kurios sas, o, Mouse;>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<O Kurios mas, einai Autos pou edose se kathe pragma te morphe tou, epeita kathodegese (kathe plasma s' auto gia to opoio to demiourgese).>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<Tote ti egine me ta proegoumena ethne (pou de latreuan ton Kurio sou kai latreuan allous theous);>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<E gnose gi' auta (ta apista ethne) einai me ton Kurio mou se ena biblio (to Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud, kai sto biblio ton praxeon tous). O Kurios mou oute sphallei, oute xekhna.>>

(O Allakh) einai Autos pou ekane te ge gia sas san krebati etoime na katoikesete s' auten, kai ephtiaxe s' aute monopatia gia sas, kai esteile nero (brokhe) apo ton ourano. Kai m' auto (to nero) phutrosame zeuge diaphoron phuton.
Phate (o, anthropoi) kai boskeste ta zoa sas. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gi' ekeinous pou ekhoun soste dianoia.
Ap' aute (te ge) sas demiourgesame, s' aute tha sas epistrepsoume (otan pethanete), kai ap' aute gia deutere phora tha sas bgaloume (apo tous taphous sas gia ten anastase).
Pragmati, deixame s' auton (ton Pharao) ola ta (ennea) Semadia Mas, alla ekeinos (ta) diepseuse kai arnetheke (na ta pistepsei).
(O Pharao) Eipe: <<Erthes se mas gia na mas dioxeis apo te ge mas, me te mageia sou, o, Mouse;

Sigoura tha sou pheroume mia paromoia mageia. Orise loipon mia ora gia na sunantethoume, ten opoia de tha ten paraleipsoume, oute emeis, oute esu, kai na einai se ena meros, dikaio (anamesa se mas kai se sas).>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<E ora sunanteses mazi sas tha einai e emera tes giortes, otan sugkentronontai oi anthropoi to proi.>>
Etsi, o Pharao ephuge kai prokhorese me apophasistikoteta sto skhedio tou (kai mazepse tous magous tou) kai meta erthe (ste sunantese).

(O Mouses) tous eipe (stous magous tou Pharao): <<Alimono sas! Men kataskeuazete psemata enantion tou Allakh (gia na paraplanesete tous anthropous me te mageia sas), diaphoretika tha sas exontosei me mia timoria. Pragmati, opoioi kataskeuazoun psemata (enantion tou Allakh), ekhoun khasei.>>
Etsi, suzetesan (oi magoi) metaxu tous gia to thema tous amphisbetontas (an o Mouses einai aletheia Prophetes e okhi, kai ti tha prepei na kanoun) kai kratesan te sunomilia tous idiotike.

Eipan (kapoioi magoi stous allous magous): <<St' aletheia, autoi (o Mouses kai o Aaron) einai duo magoi pou theloun na sas dioxoun apo te ge sas me te mageia tous, kai na nikesoun ton kalutero tropo sas (del. te threskeia, ton tropo mageias kai ton tropo zoes sas, gia na ekhoun autoi pheme kai ploute kai opadous).

Prokhoreste loipon sto skhedio sas me apophasistikoteta (kai me diaphoneite metaxu sas), meta elate mazi se mia seira. Pragmati, tha petukhei semera opoios tha epikratesei (kai tha upotaxei ton allon).>>
Eipan (oi magoi): <<O, Mouse! E na rixeis, e na rixoume protoi emeis!>>

(O Mouses) eipe: <<Okhi, rixte eseis prota.>> Tote (aphou erixan), ta skhoinia kai ta rabdia tous emphanistekan s' auton (ton Mouse), apo te mageia tous, san na (etan phidia pou) prokhorousan gregora.
Etsi, o Mouses eniose phobo mesa tou.
Eipame: <<Me phobasai, esu eisai pou tha epikrateseis.

Rixe kato aute (te rabdo) pou ekheis sto dexi sou kheri, (tha ginei ena megalo phidi, pou) tha katapiei o,ti ekhoun epinoesei. Auto pou epinoesan einai mono ena kolpo enos magou, kai o magos de tha epitukhei pote, opou ki an paei.>>

Etsi, oi magoi (katalaban oti auto den einai mageia, alla ena Semadi apo ton Alethino Theo, kai etsi) epesan se Sitzount stase (me ta metopa kai tis palames sto edaphos, gia ton Allakh). Eipan: <<Pisteuoume ston Kurio tou Aaron kai tou Mouse.>>

(O Pharao) eipe: <<Pistepsate s' auton prin na sas doso ten adeia! Pragmati, autos (o Mouses) einai o aphentes sas pou sas didaxe te mageia! Sigoura tha kopso ta kheria kai ta podia sas se antithetes pleures (del. to dexi kheri me to aristero podi e to antistropho) kai tha sas stauroso stous kormous ton khourmadion, kai tote tha mathete poianou timoria einai pio austere kai diarkei perissotero (e dike mou e tou Kuriou tou Mouse)!>>

Eipan (oi magoi): <<De tha se protimesoume pote pano apo ta xekathara Semadia pou mas erthan, oute pano ap' Auton pou mas demiourgese. Apophasise loipon o,ti theleis (na mas kaneis), pragmati, mporeis mono na apophasiseis (skhetika me mas) s' aute ten egkosmia zoe (kai epeita tha exaphanistei e exousia sou meta to thanato sou).

Pragmati, pisteuoume ston Kurio mas, kai eithe na mas sugkhoresei tis amarties mas kai te mageia pou mas anagkases na kanoume (enantion tou Mouse). Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei mia kalutere antamoibe (apo o,ti mas uposkhethekes), kai mia timoria pou diarkei perissotero (apo o,ti mas apeileses).>>
Pragmati, opoios erkhetai ston Kurio tou (ten Emera tes Kriseos) os apistos, tha ekhei ten Kolase (os timoria tou), opou de tha pethanei ekei mesa, oute tha zesei.
Alla opoios erkhetai s' Auton os pistos, ekhontas kanei kales praxeis, autoi einai pou tha ekhoun ta upselotera epipeda (ston Paradeiso).

(Tha eiselthoun se) kepous monimes diamones (ston Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. Kai aute einai e antamoibe gia opoion exagnizetai (apekhontas apo tis amarties kai ten apistia).

Pragmati, empneusame ston Mouse: <<Bges te nukhta (ap' ekeine te khora) me tous doulous Mou, kai kane gi' autous ena xero monopati mesa sto nero (khtupontas to me te rabdo sou). Men phobasai na sas prolaboun (o Pharao kai oi stratiotes tou), kai me phobasai (na pnigeite).>>
Tote, o Pharao tous katadioxe me tous stratiotes tou (kai mpekan sto xero monopati sto nero), alla tous kalupse apo to nero aute (e posoteta nerou) pou tous kalupse (kai etsi pnigekan).
Pragmati, o Pharao paraplanese ton lao tou (oraiopoiontas gi' auton ten apistia kai ten plane) kai den ton kathodegese (ston isio dromo).

O, paidia tou Israel! Sas sosame apo ton ekhthro sas, kai orisame gia sas mia kathorismene ora (gia na erthete me ton Mouse) ste dexia pleura tou orous (kai na apokalupsoume ston Mouse ten Tora gia sas). Kai sas steilame to manna (gluko poto san to meli) kai ta As-Saloa (poulakia pou moiazoun me ta ortukia).

(Kai sas eipame): <<Phate apo ta kala agatha pou sas parekhoume kai men xepernate ta oria s' auta (aphenontas o,ti epitrepsame kai pairnontas o,ti apagorepsame), diaphoretika tha pesei pano sas e Orge Mou. Pragmati, s' opoion pesei e Orge Mou, tha pesei sten katastrophe (kai ste Photia kai tha khathei)!
Pragmati eimai Gaphphar (Autos pou Sugkhorei sunekhos sto megisto bathmo) gi' opoion strephetai me metameleia pros Emena, pisteuei kai kanei kales praxeis kai epeita paramenei sten kathodegese.>>
(O Allakh eipe): <<Ti se ekane na biasteis na ertheis prin apo ton lao sou, o, Mouse!>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Einai piso mou tha me akolouthesoun. Alla espeusa pros Esena (sto meros pou me dietaxes), Kurie mou, zetontas ten eukharistese Sou (speudontas me ten upakoe).>>

(O Allakh) eipe: <<Pragmati, dokimasame ton lao sou aphou ephuges (ap' autous, alla ekeinoi den epemeinan ste threskeia tous). Kai tous paraplanese o As-Samirei [o Samires, del. ekeinos apo te phule e ten periokhe Samir, pou tous kalese na latrepsoun ena agalma moskhariou].>> [Prin ap' auto, aphou o Allakh tous esose apo ton Pharao, perasan apo enan lao pou latreue eidola, kai zetesan apo ton Mouse na kanei ena eidolo, alla autos tous epeplexe austera -bl. Sourat Al-Araph 7:138-].

Etsi, o Mouses epestrepse ston lao tou, thumomenos kai lupemenos. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! De sas uposkhetheke o Kurios sas mia kale uposkhese (oti tha steilei ten Tora kai tha uposterixei tous pistous); Mepos perasate polu kairo (khoris emena, kai xekhasate ten uposkhese kai tis khares Tou); E thelate (m' auto pou kanate) na pesei se sas e orge tou Kuriou sas, opote stamatesate na perpatate piso apo mena pros ton topo sunanteses (kai athetesate auto pou sas dietaxa, to na parameinete sten upakoe pros ton Allakh);>>

Eipan: <<De stamatesame na perpatame piso apo sena pros ton topo sunanteses (oute parakousame ten entole sou) me te thelese mas, alla phortothekame me amarties apo ta (khrusa) kosmemata tou laou (tou Pharao, -pou perame os laphura otan pnigeke o Pharao-, -e ta daneistekame prin bgoume apo te ge tou Pharao-, khoris na xeroume oti einai amartia na ta kratesoume), etsi ta petaxame (ste photia, sten lakkouba pou ten ephtiaxe o As-Samirei -Samires-)!>> Kai etsi petaxe kai o As-Samirei.

Kai ebgale (o As-Samirei, -Samires-) gi' autous (apo ta khrusa ste photia) ena agalma moskhariou, to opoio etan ena soma (khoris psukhe) kai eikhe enan khamelo ekho. Eipan (kapoioi stous allous): <<Autos einai o theos sas, kai o theos tou Mouse, alla (o Mouses ton) ekhei xekhasei (edo kai pege na ton brei kapou allou)!>>
Ma den eidan oti (ekeino to agalma) den tous apantouse sta logia tous, oute mporouse na tous prostatepsei apo kanena kako, oute na tous pherei kanena ophelos;

Pragmati, o Aaron tous eipe prin (erthei o Mouses): <<O, lae mou! St' aletheia, mono paraplanethekate m' auto (to agalma, kai aute einai mia dokimasia gia sas). Pragmati, o Kurios sas einai o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), gi' auto akoloutheste me kai upakouste ten entole mou.>>
Eipan: <<De tha stamatesoume na to latreuoume (to agalma) mekhri na epistrepsei o Mouses se mas.>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<O, Aaron! Ti se empodise, otan tous eides na parastratoun,

apo to na me akoloutheseis (esu kai osoi de latreuan to agalma, gia na mou peis kai na guriso); Parakouses ten entole mou (na pareis te these mou, na diorthoseis kai na me akoloutheseis tous kakous);>>

(O Aaron) eipe: <<O, gie tes meteras mou! (Parakalo) me trabas ta genia mou, oute to kephali mou! Phobomoun (an tous aphena kai erkhomoun se sena) oti tha eleges: <<Apheses ta paidia tou Israel na diairethoun, kai de diatereses ta logia mou!>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Ti sumbainei me sena, o, Samirei (Samire);>>
(O As-Samirei -Samires-) Eipe: <<Ematha auto pou den emathan, opote pera mia khouphta apo ta semadia tou Aggeliaphorou kai ten erixa. Etsi me othese o eautos mou (na kano).>>

(O Mouses) eipe: <<Phuge! Tha ekheis os timoria s' aute te zoe oti tha peis: <<Me me aggizei kaneis (oute na aggizo kanenan)>> [del. tha zei apokleros]. Kai tha ekheis mia kathorismene ora (ten Emera tes Kriseos), pou de tha tes xephugeis. Koita ton legomeno theo sou, pou ton latrepses, tha ton kapsoume kai meta tha ton skorpisoume sto nero (kai de tha uparkhei kanena ikhnos gi' auton).>>
(O, anthropoi), pragmati, o Theos sas einai mono o Allakh. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Perikleiei ta panta me te gnose Tou.

Etsi (opos se plerophoresame, o, Mokhammant, gia ton Mouse kai ton lao tou me ton Pharao), se plerophoroume apo tis istories pou perasan (sto parelthon). Pragmati, sou ekhoume dosei apo Emas mia Upenthumise (to Kor'an, gia na laboun oi anthropoi mia nouthesia).
Opoios apostrephetai ap' auto (to Kor'an), ten Emera tes Anastases tha koubalesei ena megalo phortio (amartion).
(Kai tetoioi anthropoi) tha meinoun s' auto (to phortio kai to marturio) gia panta. Ti athlio einai auto to phortio ten Emera tes Anastases!
Ten Emera opou tha phusekhtei to Keras (Salpigga, gia ten anastase), kai tha sugkentrosoume tous kakous (apistous, pou eginan) mple (apo te phrike tous).
Tha psithurisoun o enas ston allo: <<Pragmati, de meinate (sten egkosmia zoe) perissotero apo deka (meres).>>
Emeis xeroume kalutera ti tha poun (metaxu tous)! Kai o pio logikos anamesa tous tha pei: <<Pragmati, de meinate (sten egkosmia zoe) perissotero apo mia mera!>>
Se rotoun (o, Prophete) gia ta bouna (pos tha einai ten Emera tes Kriseos;), pes: <<O Kurios mou (tha ta aphairesei apo tis theseis tous, kai) tha ta skorpisei se skone.
Kai tha ten aphesei (te ge) epipede kai leia.
De tha blepeis s' aute (te ge) oute kamia anephora, oute kamia katephora sto edaphos.

Ekeine ten Emera, tha akolouthesoun (oi anthropoi) te phone autou pou kalei (pros te ge tes sugkentroses). De tha uparkhei kamia parekklise (gia kanenan) apo to na ton akolouthesei. Oles oi phones tha khamelosoun me tapeinose pros ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona). De tha akous para mono psithuro.
Ekeine ten Emera, kamia diamesolabese de tha ophelesei, ektos ekeinou pou tha tou epitrepsei o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) (na diamesolabesei) kai na dekhtei ta logia tou.
Gnorizei o,ti tha erthei mprosta tous (apo ta themata tes Mellousas Zoes), kai o,ti aphesan piso tous (apo ta themata tes egkosmias zoes), eno autoi den Ton perikleioun me te gnose tous.

Ola ta prosopa tha tapeinothoun gia ton Al-Khai (ton Aionia Zontano), ton Al-Kaioum (ton Uposterikte kai Sunterete olon). Pragmati, ekhei khasei opoios ekhei koubalesei adikia (kai apedide ston Allakh etairous ste latreia).

Opoios omos kanei enaretes praxeis, eno einai pistos, (tha labei ten antamoibe tou, kai) de tha phobatai kamia adikia (me to na phortothei me amarties kapoion allon), oute kamia meiose (sten antamoibe tou).

Kai etsi to steilame os ena arabiko Kor'an, kai dosame mesa tou diaphores proeidopoieseis, isos na phulassontai (oi anthropoi) apo ten timoria Mas (terontas tis entoles Mas) e na tous dosei (to Kor'an) mia nouthesia.

Upsistos einai o Allakh (kai Anoteros apo kathe ateleia), o Al-Malik (o Basileus), o Al-Khakk (o Alethinos Theos). Me biasteis (o, Prophete) na apaggeileis to Kor'an (kata ten apokalupse tou apo ton Gabriel, logo tes epithumias sou na to apomnemoneueis gregora), prin oloklerothei e apokalupse tou se sena. Kai pes: <<Kurie mou! Auxese me se gnose.>>

Pragmati, eikhame diataxei ton Adam prin, (na me phaei apo ena dentro), alla xekhase (ten entole Mas kai ephage aphou tou psithurise o Satanas), kai den ton eidame na ekhei duname apophasistikotetas (na teresei auto pou ton diataxame).

Kai (anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipame stous Aggelous: <<Peste oloi se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos) enopion tou Adam (os khairetismo kai time pros auton, kai okhi latreia).>> Etsi, epesan oloi se Sitzount stase, ektos apo ton Implis (Satana, pou etan tzinn kai okhi Aggelos), pou arnetheke (kai egine alazonikos).

Eipame: <<O, Adam! Autos (o Satanas) einai enas ekhthros gia sena kai te suzugo sou, opote men ton apheseis na sas dioxei apo ton Paradeiso (me tous psithurous tou gia diapraxe amartion), giati tote tha peseis se dustukhia.
Gia sena (os eunoia apo Mas) einai oti de tha peinas mesa tou (Paradeisou), oute tha eisai gumnos (logo elleipses roukhismou).
Kai oti de tha dipsas mesa tou (Paradeisou), oute tha upophereis apo kamia zeste.>>
Alla o Satanas tou psithurise kai eipe: <<O, Adam! Na sou deixo to dentro tes aioniotetas kai ena basileio pou de tha teleionei pote;>>

Etsi, ephagan ap' auto (to dentro), kai etsi, ta apokrupha semeia tous eginan phanera s' autous (aphou aphairetheke to kalumma -e to phos- pou ta ekrube), kai arkhisan na ta kaluptoun me ta phulla tou Paradeisou. O Adam parakouse ten entole tou Kuriou tou, kai etsi xeperase ta oria (tou epitreptou gi' auton, kai ekane auto pou den eprepe na kanei).
Epeita, o Kurios tou ton epelexe, dekhteke te metameleia tou kai ton kathodegese.

(O Allakh) Eipe: <<Peste oloi mazi ap' auton (ton Paradeiso pros te ge), os ekhthroi o enas gia ton allon (o Satanas einai ekhthros gia tous anthropous, kai to antistropho). Kai an tha sas elthei mia kathodegese apo Emena, tote opoios akolouthesei ten kathodegese Mou, de tha parastratesei (apo ten aletheia), oute tha talaiporethei (apo ten timoria ste Mellousa Zoe).
Alla opoios apostrephetai apo ten Upenthumise Mou, tha ekhei mia athlia zoe, kai ten Emera tes Anastases tha ton pheroume pros ton topo sugkentroses, tuphlo.>>
Tha pei (autos pou apostrapheke apo ten Upenthumise Mou): <<O, Kurie mou! Giati me epheres ston topo sugkentroses tuphlo, eno eikha orase (sten egkosmia zoe);>>
(O Allakh) tha pei: <<Opos elthan se sena ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, alla ta parameleses, etsi Semera tha parameletheis.>>

Etsi (me ten athlia zoe) timoroume (sten egkosmia zoe) auton pou parabiase ta oria kai den pistepse sta Edaphia tou Kuriou tou. Kai pragmati, e timoria tes Mellousas Zoes einai pio austere kai diarkei perissotero.

Den einai akome saphes s' autous (tous eidololatres) posa (apista) ethne prin ap' autous, ta katastrepsame, kai stis katoikies ton opoion perpatoun akome (kai blepoun ta semadia tes katastrophes tous); Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto semadia gi' ekeinous me soste dianoia.

An den uperkhe ede mia diatage apo ton Kurio sou (o, Prophete, oti tha tous edine anabole) kai (an den uperkhe ede) mia kathorismene ora (gia to thanato tous, ten timoria tous, e ten Emera tes Kriseos), tha etan anapopheukte (e amese timoria, pou ten axizoun logo tes apistias tous).

Gi' auto kane upomone (o, Prophete) me o,ti lene (autoi pou se diapseudoun), kai doxaze ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton, prin ten anatole tou eliou (sten proseukhe Phatzr) kai prin apo te duse tou (sten proseukhe 'Asr). Kai doxaze Ton kata te diarkeia tes nukhtas (ste proseukhe Isa) kai sten arkhe kai to telos tes emeras (stis proseukhes Doukhr kai Magrimp), oste na eisai eukharistemenos (me ten antamoibe).

Men koitazeis (o, Prophete) auta pou dosame se diaphores omades ap' autous (tous eidololatres), ta opoia einai mono stolidia autes tes egkosmias zoes, gia na tous dokimasoume m' auta. Alla ta agatha (kai e antamoibe) tou Kuriou sou (gia sena ste Mellousa Zoe) einai kalutera kai diarkoun perissotero.

Diataxe ten oikogeneia sou na teloun ten proseukhe, kai na eisai statheros me upomone kata ten telese tes (terontas tous pulones kai tous kanones tes). De sou zetame agatha (apo sena gia ton eauto sou e gia kanenan allon), alla eimaste Emeis pou parekhoume agatha se sena (kai se olous tous allous). Pragmati, e kalutere katalexe einai gia (autous pou teroun) ten eusebeia (kai phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou).

Lene (oi apistoi): <<An mono mas epherne ena Semadi apo ton Kurio tou (ap' auta pou proteiname), (tote tha pisteuame)!>> Ma den tous erthe (to Kor'an os) e exegese (kai e apodeixe) gia o,ti uperkhan stis proegoumenes Graphes (apo tis perigraphes tou Mokhammant, kai tis istories ton arkhaion laon parolo pou o Mokhammant oute exere na diabazei e na graphei, oute eikhe proegoumene gnose kai melete gia tis proegoumenes Graphes);

An tous eikhame katastrepsei me mia timoria prin ap' auto (del. prin steiloume enan Aggeliaphoro), tha elegan: <<Kurie mas! An mono mas estelnes enan Aggeliophoro, tha akolouthousame ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Sou prin na tapeinothoume kai na atimothoume!>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O kathenas (apo emas kai esas) perimenei (auta pou tha kanei o Allakh)! Perimenete loipon, pragmati tha mathete poioi briskontai ston isio dromo, kai poioi einai oi kathodegemenoi (emeis e eseis)!>>

Plesiazei stous anthropous e Ora tou apologismou tous, alla ekeinoi briskontai se adiaphoria kai ameleia (apaskholoumenoi me tis egkosmies apolauseis), kai apostrephontai (ten piste kai tis kales praxeis).
Den tous erkhetai kamia nea apokalupse apo ton Kurio tous, para na ten akoun eno paizoun,

kai eno oi kardies tous einai aprosektes (kai apaskholemenes me tous pothous tous). Oi adikoi sunomilesan idiotika kai krupha (legontas): <<Einai autos (o Mokhammant) kati allo, ektos apo enas anthropos san kai esas; Tha akolouthesete loipon te mageia (tou), eno (te) blepete;>>

Eipe (o Prophetes): <<O Kurios mou gnorizei kathe logo pou legetai stous ouranous kai ste ge (kai xerei ten kruphe sunomilia sas). Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>

(Den pisteuoun oti to Kor'an staltheke apo ton Allakh) alla (kapoia phora kapoioi ap' autous) lene: <<Auto (to Kor'an) einai mperdemena oneira (pou ta eide o Mokhammant)!>> (Alle phora alloi lene): <<Okhi (den einai etsi), alla to ekhei kataskeuasei!>> (Alle phora alloi lene): <<Okhi (den einai etsi), alla (o Mokhammant) einai enas poietes! As mas pherei, loipon, ena Semadi, opos stalthekan oi proegoumenoi Aggeliaphoroi (me Semadia pros tous laous tous).>>
Prin ap' autous, kamia pole pou ten ekhoume katastrepsei, den pistepse (parolo pou tous steilame ta Semadia pou proteinan, antitheta, ta diepseusan). Tha pisteuan autoi loipon;

Pragmati, de steilame prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) para mono andres (Aggeliaphorous), stous opoious apokalupsame. Roteste loipon (o, apistoi) ekeinous ton proegoumenon Theion Biblion (tes Toras kai tou In-tzel -tou prototupou Euaggeliou tou Iesou- an oi Aggeliaphoroi pou tous esteile o Allakh prin, etan anthropoi e Aggeloi), an de gnorizete!
Kai den tous demiourgesame (tous Aggeliaphorous, me) somata pou den etrogan phageto - oute etan athanatoi.

Epeita ekplerosame ten uposkhese Mas pros autous (tous Aggeliaphorous), kai etsi sosame autous kai osous thelame (del. tous pistous), kai katastrepsame ekeinous pou xeperasan ta oria (me ten apistia kai tis amarties).
(O, anthropoi) pragmati, sas steilame ena Biblio (to Kor'an) to opoio ekhei doxa (kai duname) gia sas (an to akolouthesete). Ma de sullogizeste;
Poses adikes poleis katastrepsame, kai demiourgesame meta ap' autes allous laous!
Otan eidan ten timoria Mas, arkhisan na trekhoun makria ap' auten (ten pole tous).

(Alla oi Aggeloi tous phonaxan sarkastika): <<Men trekhete, alla epistrepste stis apolauseis sas kai stis katoikies sas, isos na sas zetesoun (oi anthropoi kati, opos otan esastan prin, pou eikhate ploute, exousia kai duname).>>
Eipan (oi adikoi): <<Alimono mas! Pragmati, emastan adikoi (me ten apistia mas)!>>
De stamatese aute na einai e krauge tous eos otou tous kaname san therismena phuta, (nekrous) khoris kinese.
Pragmati, de demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous gia diaskedase (e askopa, alla einai mia endeixe tes Dunames Mas).

An thelame na eikhame mia diaskedase (opos to na eikhame mia suzugo e enan gio), tha ten eikhame parei apo o,ti ekhoume (kai okhi apo o,ti ekhete ste ge), kai pote de tha to kaname auto (aphou kati tetoio apotelei mia ateleia, e opoia den tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Mas).

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou iskhurizontai, oti o Allakh apektese enan gio e mia suzugo), alla pragmati, rikhnoume ten aletheia pano sten plane, kai etsi ten sunthlibei (kai ten katastrephei), kai etsi (e plane) pheugei (khamene). Alimono se sas (pou iskhurizeste kati tetoio) gia osa perigraphete pseudos!

S' Auton anekoun oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai ste ge. Autoi pou briskontai konta tou (del. oi Aggeloi) de ginontai pote alazonikoi apenanti ste latreia Tou, oute kourazontai (oute bariountai ap' auten) pote.
Ton doxazoun mera kai nukhta, khoris na kourazontai (e na bariountai).
E mepos peran (oi eidololatres gia latreia) theous apo te ge, pou mporoun na anastesoun tous nekrous;

An uperkhan s' autous (tous ouranous kai te ge) alloi theoi ektos apo ton Allakh, tha eikhan (oi ouranoi kai e ge) khathei (kai to sustema tous tha eikhe katarreusei, logo tes sugkrouses metaxu ton theon, kai logo tou oti o kathenas tous tha ethele to meridio tou). Doxa ston Allakh, ton Kurio tou Thronou, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (pseudos, apo ateleies).
Den krinetai gia o,ti kanei, alla autoi tha krithoun!

E peran (oi eidololatres gia latreia) allous theous ektos Autou; Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pherte ten apodeixe sas! Auto to Kor'an pou staltheke se mena, kai ta Theia Biblia pou stalthekan stous Aggeliaphorous prin apo mena (den perieikhan kamia apodeixe gi' auto pou iskhurizeste pseudos)!>> Ostoso, oi perissoteroi ex' auton (ton eidololatron) de gnorizoun ten aletheia (alla sterizontai sten plane), kai etsi apomakrunontai (apo ten aletheia).
De steilame prin apo sena (o, Prophete) kanenan Aggeliaphoro ektos na tou eikhame apokalupsei oti: <<Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Ego. Etsi latrepste mono Emena.>>

Eipan (oi apistoi): <<O Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) apektese paidia (del. oti oi Aggeloi einai oi kores Tou).>> Doxa s' Auton (einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun pseudos)! Den (ekhei paidia), alla (oi Aggeloi) einai timemenoi douloi (Tou).
De miloun (oi Aggeloi) pote prin ap' Auton, kai energoun mono upo te diatage Tou.

Gnorizei o,ti ekanan kai o,ti tha kanoun. Den mporoun na diamesolabesoun para mono gia opoion dekhetai (o Allakh). Kai autoi logo tou phobou tous pros Auton, einai epiphulaktikoi (sto na men parakoun kamia entole Tou).
An kapoios ap' autous tha elege: <<Eimai theos peran ap' Auton>>, tha ton timorousame me ten Kolase. Etsi timoroume tous adikous.

De blepoun (kai de gnorizoun) oi apistoi pos oi ouranoi kai e Ge etan kollemenoi (san mia eniaia ontoteta), kai epeita tous khorisame! Kai apo to nero demiourgesame kathe zontano on. De tha pistepsoun loipon;

Kai topothetesame ste Ge stathera bouna gia (na te statheropoiesoun kai) na men tarakounietai mazi tous (anthropous), kai phtiaxame s' auten (te Ge) platia monopatia, mepos kai kathodegethoun (stous dromous tous).
Kai kaname ton ourano ena prostateumeno tabani, alla (oi apistoi) apostrephontai ta Semadia pou uparkhoun s' auton (ton ourano).
Autos einai pou eplase te nukhta kai ten emera, kai ton elio kai to pheggari. Ola (ta ourania somata) kolumpoun se trokhia.
Den kaname kanenan anthropo prin apo sena (o, Prophete) na einai athanatos. An loipon pethaneis, tha zesoun autoi (meta apo sena) aionia; [Okhi bebaia].
Kathe psukhe tha geutei to thanato. Sas dokimazoume me to kako kai me to kalo, os dokimasia. Kai se Mas (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha epistrepsete.

Otan se blepoun oi apistoi, se pairnoun mono gia koroidia, (legontas): <<Autos einai pou anapherei tous theous sas katakrinontas tous;>> eno oi idioi arnountai ten exumnese tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), (kai arnountai na anapheroun tis khares Tou s' autous, kai ten Upenthumise Tou -to Kor'an-).
O anthropos demiourgetheke polu anupomonos. (O, apistoi, pou biazeste na pesei pano sas e timoria), pragmati, tha sas deixo ta Semadia (del. ten timoria) Mou, epomenos me biazeste!
Lene (oi apistoi): <<Pote tha ulopoiethei aute e uposkhese (gia ten timoria), an eiste (o, Mousoulmanoi) eilikrineis;>>

An oi apistoi gnorizan (ti tha pathoun) otan de tha mporoun na apotrepsoun te Photia oute apo ta prosopa tous, oute tis plates tous, kai oute tha boethethoun, (de tha paremenan sten apistia tous, oute tha biazontousan gia ten timoria).

Okhi (de tha arpaxei e Photia tous apistous eno ten perimenoun), alla tha tous erthei xaphnika kai tha tous sugklonisei. De tha mporoun na ten apotrepsoun, oute tha tous dothei anabole (gia na straphoun me metameleia kai na eleethoun)!
Pragmati, (polloi) Aggeliaphoroi prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) khleuastekan, alla ekeinoi pou tous khleuasan, perikuklothekan ap' auto (to marturio) pou to khleuazan!

Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous pou biazontai na tous pesei e timoria): <<Poios mporei na sas prostateusei te nukhta kai ten emera apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) (an steilei ten timoria se sas);>> Okhi (den anagnorizoun tis khares Tou s' autous), alla apomakrunontai apo ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an, te nouthesia kai ta Semadia) tou Kuriou tous!
E ekhoun (oi apistoi) theous pou mporoun na tous prostateusoun apo Mas; Pragmati, (oi legomenoi theoi tous) den mporoun kan na uposterixoun ton eauto tous, oute tha prostateutoun apo ten timoria Mas!

Okhi (de tha tous prostatepsoun oi legomenoi theoi tous), alla Emeis pareikhame agatha s' autous kai stous progonous tous, mekhri pou ezesan polu, (kai etsi xegelasan ton eauto tous nomizontas oti de tha timorethoun pote, kai paremenan sten apistia)! De blepoun oti Emeis meionoume te ge (tes apistias) apo ta akra tes (dinontas ston Mokhammant te nike, se mia pole meta apo ten alle); Einai autoi loipon pou tha epikratesoun; [Okhi bebaia].
Pes (o, Prophete, stous anthropous): <<Sas proeidopoio (gia ten timoria tou Allakh) mono me ten apokalupse (to Kor'an).>> Alla oi kophoi den akoun ten klese otan proeidopoiountai.
An tous aggize (tous apistous) kati ligo, apo ten timoria tou Kuriou sou (o, Prophete), tha elegan: <<Alimono mas! Pragmati, emastan adikoi.>>

Tha thesoume ten Emera tes Kriseos dikaious zugous (gia tis praxeis ton anthropon), kai kamia psukhe de tha adikethei se tipota. Akoma ki an (mia praxe) einai sto baros enos sinaposporou, tha te pheroume (gia na metrethei). Eparkei oti Emeis eimaste pou tha metresoume (tis praxeis ton doulon Mas).

Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse kai ston Aaron to Kriterio (ten Tora, pou diakhorizei ten aletheia apo ten plane), kai os lampero phos kai upenthumise gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou).
Oi opoioi einai autoi pou phobountai ton Kurio tous khoris na Ton ekhoun dei, kai phobountai ten Ora (tes Emeras tes Kriseos).
Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia eulogemene Upenthumise, to opoio ekhoume steilei. Eseis tha to arnetheite, loipon (parolo pou einai polu xekatharo);
Pragmati, dosame prin ston Abraam ten kathodegese tou (pros ten opoia kalouse tous anthropous), kai gnorizame ta panta gi' auton (kai ten piste tou).
Otan eipe (o Abraam) ston patera tou kai sto lao tou: <<Ti einai auta ta agalmata sta opoia eiste aphosiomenoi (me te latreia);>>
Eipan: <<Brekame tous progonous mas na ta latreuoun.>>
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Pragmati, eseis kai oi progonoi sas briskosastan se phanere plane.>>
Eipan: <<Epheres se mas ten aletheia, e eisai enas apo tous khleuastes;>>

(O Abraam) eipe: <<Okhi (den eimai enas apo tous khleuastes), alla (sas ertha me ten aletheia) pragmati, o Kurios sas einai o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges, o Opoios tous demiourgese. Kai s' auto (oti Autos einai o Kurios sas), eimai enas apo tous martures.>>
(Epeita eipe o Abraam mesa tou:) <<Ma ton Allakh! Tha katastrepso ta eidola sas me ena skhedio, aphou phugete (pros te giorte sas).>>
Etsi, ta espase se kommatia, ektos apo to megalutero auton, isos na epistrepsoun s' auto (to eidolo kai na to rotesoun poios to ekane)!
(Otan epestrepsan kai ta eidan) eipan: <<Poios ekane auto stous theous mas; Pragmati, einai enas apo tous adikous.>>
Kapoioi eipan: <<Akousame enan nearo na tous anapherei (katakrinontas tous), o opoios legetai Abraam.>>
Eipan: <<Pherte ton, loipon, enopion ton anthropon, gia na ginoun martures (se o,ti tha pei).>>
Eipan: <<Esu ekanes auto stous theous mas, o, Abraam;>>
(O Abraam) eipe (sarkastika): <<Okhi, alla auto to megalutero auton (ton eidolon) to ekane. Roteste ta, an mporoun na milesoun.>>
Etsi gurisan ston eauto tous (sullogizomenoi) kai (kapoioi) eipan: <<Pragmati, eseis eiste oi adikoi (pou latreuete auta pou den mporoun na milesoun).>>
Epeita, epestrepsan sto peisma tous kai eipan (ston Abraam): <<Pragmati, gnorizeis kala oti auta (ta eidola) de miloun! (Tote pos mas zetas na tous rotesoume;)>>
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Einai dunaton na latreuete anti ton Allakh, auta (ta eidola) pou den mporoun na sas ophelesoun se tipote, oute na sas blapsoun;>>
<<Ouph (mia ekphrase thumou kai dusareskeias), se sas kai s' auta pou latreuete anti ton Allakh! Ma de sullogizeste;>>
Eipan: <<Kapste ton (Abraam) kai uposterixte tous theous sas, an pragmatika tha to kanete (to na ton timoresete).>>
(Aphou ton erixan se megale photia) eipame (Emeis): <<O, photia! Na eisai psukhraime kai asphales gia ton Abraam.>>
Ethelan na ton blapsoun me to skhedio tous, alla tous kaname na einai oi khamenoi!

Sosame auton (ton Abraam) kai ton Lot, kai tous pherame (apo to Irak) pros te ge [tou Lebantes] sten opoia eulogesame mesa tes (me agatha) gia tous anthropous (kai me to oti steilame ekei pollous Prophetes).
Kharisame s' auton (ton Abraam): ton Isaak (ton gio tou), kai ton Iakob (ton eggono tou), os khare (apo Emas), kai tous kaname olous enaretous.

Kai tous kaname egetes, pou kathodegousan (tous anthropous pros te latreia Mas) me ten entole Mas, kai tous empneusame na kanoun enaretes praxeis, na teloun ten proseukhe kai na dinoun te Zaka (upokhreotike eleemosune). Pragmati, etan latreis pros Emas (me aphosiose kai upotage).
Ston Lot dosame orthe krise kai gnose, kai ton sosame apo ten komopole (Sodoma) pou ekane tis epaiskhuntes praxeis (tes omophulophilias). Pragmati, etan enas kakos kai anupakouos laos.
Kai ton eisagame (ton Lot) sto eleos Mas. Pragmati, etan enas apo tous enaretous.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Noe, otan Mas epikalesteke prin (gia ten katastrophe ton apiston), kai etsi antapokrithekame, kai sosame auton kai (tous pistous kai tous pistous apo) ten oikogeneia tou apo te megale thlipse (kai ten plemmura).
Kai ton uposterixame enantia stous anthropous pou diepseusan ta Semadia Mas. Pragmati, etan kakoi anthropoi, opote tous pnixame olous.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Dabid kai ton Solomonta, otan ekrinan (metaxu duo andron) skhetika me tis kalliergeies, otan skorpistekan s' autes ta probata merikon anthropon te nukhta (kai tis khalasan), kai Emastan Martures tes krises tous.

Kaname ton Solomonta na ten katanoesei (ten upothese, -khoris ton Dabid-, kai na dosei mia kalutere krise). Kai stous duo dosame orthe krise (kai tous kaname Prophetes), kai gnose. Upotaxame ta bouna kai ta poulia na Mas doxazoun mazi me ton Dabid (opote autos Mas doxaze). Emeis eimaste pou ta kaname auta.
Tou didaxame (ston Dabid) pos na phtiaxei panoplies gia na sas prostateuoun kata te makhe sas. Tha eiste, loipon, eugnomones;
Ston Solomonta upotaxame ton dunato anemo, na phusaei me ten entole tou (opou thelei kai meta na epistrephei) pros te ge pou eulogesame (ton Lebantes). Pragmati, ekhoume plere gnose ton panton.

Kai (upotaxame) apo tous diabolous ekeinous pou na boutexoun gi' auton (ton Solomonta gia na tou pheroun margaritaria kai kosmemata) kai ekanan kai alles ergasies. Emeis eimaste pou tous kratesame (gi' auton, kai etsi den mporousan na ton parakousoun, kai xeroume ta panta skhetika m' autous kai tis ergasies kai ton arithmo tous).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Iob, otan epikalesteke ton Kurio tou: <<Me khtupesan oi antixootetes (e arrostia, kai ekhasa ton plouto kai ten oikogeneia mou), (sose me loipon ap' autes) kai pragmati, Esu eisai o pio Eleemon apo tous eleemones.>>

Antapokrithekame loipon s' auton kai tou anakouphisame tis antixootetes, kai tou apokatastesame ten oikogeneia tou, diplasia (se arithmo), os eleos apo Emas (pros auton), kai os upenthumise (kai kalo paradeigma) gia tous latreis (Mas, gia na to akolouthoun sto na deikhnoun upomone).
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Ismael, ton Intris kai ton Da-Al-Kiphl, oi opoioi etan oloi upomonetikoi.
Tous eisagame sto eleos Mas. Pragmati, autoi etan apo tous enaretous.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai auton (ton Iona) me to psari, otan ephuge (khoris ten adeia Mas) thumomenos (apo tous apistous anthropous tou, kai den edeixe upomone s' autous), nomizontas oti de tha steneuame te zoe tou (kai de tha ton timorousame gi' auto pou ekane). (Alla diataxame to psari na ton katapiei ste thalassa kai na ton kratesei asphale mesa sten koilia tou, kai) tote epikalesteke (o Ionas) sta bathe tou skotous: <<Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Esu. Doxa Soi! Pragmati, emoun apo tous adikous (m' auto pou ekana).>>
Etsi, antapokrithekame s' auton kai ton sosame apo te thlipse. Etsi sozoume tous pistous.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Zakharia, otan epikalesteke ton Kurio tou: <<Kurie mou! Me me apheseis na eimai monos (khoris enan gio). Pragmati, Esu eisai o kaluteros ap' autous pou tha parameinoun, (kharise mou, loipon, enan gio pou tha parameinei meta apo mena).>>

Antapokrithekame loipon s' auton, kai tou kharisame ton Giakhia (ton Ioanne ton baptiste), kai kaname te gunaika tou gonime. Pragmati, espeudan panta na kanoun kales praxeis, kai Mas epikalountan me elpida (gia ten antamoibe Mas) kai me phobo (apo ten timoria Mas), kai etan upotagmenoi enopion Mas.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai (te Maria) ekeine pou phulage ten agnoteta tes. Etsi, diataxame ton Aggelo Mas (ton Gabriel) na emphusesei se mia skhisme sto enduma tes (kai etsi sunelabe ton Iesou). Kaname auten kai ton uio tes, ena Semadi gia olous tous anthropous.

(O, anthropoi) pragmati, aute einai e threskeia sas (kai olon ton Aggeliaphoron apo ton Adam mekhri ton Mokhammant), e opoia einai mono mia threskeia (o Monotheismos, to Islam), kai Ego eimai o Kurios sas, gi' auto latrepste mono Emena.

Alla oi anthropoi diepheran metaxu tous oson aphora te threskeia tous (kai epheuriskan aireseis, parolo pou e threskeia tou Abraam, tou Iakob, tou Mouse kai tou Iesou, etan to Islam). Pragmati, oloi (oi anthropoi) se Emas tha epistrepsoun.
Opoios loipon kanei enaretes praxeis eno einai pistos, oi prospatheies tou de tha aporriphthoun (alla tha antameiphthoun), kai Emeis tis katagraphoume oles.
Einai apagoreumeno (kai adunaton) gia opoiadepote (apiste) pole pou ten ekhoume katastrepsei, na epistrepsei (xana sten egkosmia zoe gia na straphei me metameleia).
Kai otan anoixei to phragma ton laon Gog kai Magog, kai kateboun gregora apo kathe anakhoma,

kai plesiasei e Alethine Uposkhese (e Emera tes Kriseos kai emphanizontai ta Semadia tes), tote ta matia ekeinon pou arnountai ten piste tha koitaxoun me phrike, (kai tha poun): <<Alimono mas! Emastan pragmati se adiaphoria kai ameleia (kai den proetoimazomastan) gi' auten (ten megale Emera). Okhi (mono), alla emastan kai adikoi.>>

Pragmati, eseis (o, eidololatres) kai o,ti latreuete peran tou Allakh (apo eidola, anthropous e tzinn pou dekhtekan na tous latreuete), tha eiste kausimo gia ten Kolase, opou tha eisakhtheite mesa tes.

An autoi (ta eidola, kai oi anthropoi pou dekhtekan na tous latreuoun oi alloi) etan pragmati theoi, de tha eisakhthoun mesa tes (Kolases). Oloi (oi proanapheromenoi legomenoi theoi, kai osoi tous latrepsan) tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.
Tha ekhoun ekei (sten Kolase) polu tromere ekpnoe (logo tes austeres timorias kai ton ponon tous), kai de tha akoun ekei tipota.

Oso gi' ekeinous gia tous opoious eikhame orisei apo prin oti tha ekhoun ten kalutere antamoibe, (gnorizontas ede oti tha eisakhthoun ston Paradeiso, opos oi pistoi), tha einai polu makria ap' auten (ten Kolase). [Kai den iskhuei auto pou iskhuristekan oi apistoi, oti o Iesous, o Ouzair kai oi Aggeloi, tha eisakhthoun ste Photia epeide tous latrepsan oi anthropoi! Okhi, de tha eisakhthoun mesa tes, aphou de dekhtekan na tous latrepsei kaneis].
(Oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou) de tha akousoun (ston Paradeiso) ten paramikre phone tes (Kolases), kai tha parameinoun se o,ti epithumoun (apo eudaimonia kai apolauseis) gia panta.

De tha lupethoun apo to Megalo Phobo (otan tha phusexei o Aggelos sto Keras -Salpigga-), kai oi Aggeloi tha tous upodekhtoun (me ta kharmosuna nea, legontas): <<Aute einai e Emera sas, gia ten opoia (kai gia ten antamoibe tes) labate uposkhese.>>

Ten Emera opou tha tulixoume tous ouranous, opos tuligetai e pergamene me o,ti einai grammeno mesa. Kai opos arkhisame ten prote demiourgia, etsi tha ten epanapheroume (ste zoe). Einai mia uposkhese apo Emas, pou oposdepote tha ten ekplerosoume.

Ekhoume grapsei sta Theia Biblia, aphou eikhe graphtei sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud: oti te ge (tou Paradeisou) tha ten kleronomesoun oi dikaioi douloi Mou. [Auto anapheretai kai ste Sourat Az-Zoumar 39:74].
Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto (to Kor'an) o,ti eparkei stous anthropous pou latreuoun (ton Allakh, gia na phtasoun ten eukharistese tou Allakh, kai ton Paradeiso).
Pragmati, de se steilame (o, Mokhammant) para mono os eleos gia olon ton kosmo.
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, mou apokaluphtheke oti o Theos sas (pou mono Autos axizei na latreuetai) einai mono Enas Theos. Tha upotakhtheite loipon (s' Auton);>>

An omos apomakrunthoun, tote pes: <<Sas ekho enemerosei, oste na ginoume isoi ste gnose (gia osa sas proeidopoiesa), kai den xero an aute (e timoria) gia ten opoia proeidopoiethekate, einai konta e makria!
Pragmati, Autos xerei ta phanera logia (sas), kai xerei ti apokruptete (apo ta logia sas).
Den xero an aute (e anabole gia ten timoria) einai mia dokimasia gia sas kai gia na apolausete gia ligo (oste na auxetheite sten plane kai na parasurtheite stadiaka pros ten katastrophe).>>

(O Prophetes) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Krine (anamesa se mas tous Mousoulmanous, kai s' autous tous apistous) me ten aletheia.>> (Kai eipe stous apistous): <<Apo ton Kurio mas, ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), zetame boetheia enantia se o,ti perigraphete (apo apistia kai diapseuse).>>
O, anthropoi! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Kuriou sas (terontas tis entoles Tou), pragmati, o seismos tes Oras (tes Emeras tes Kriseos) einai ena kati terastio.

Ten Emera pou tha te deite (del. ten Ora), kathe thelazousa tha paramelesei auto (to moro) pou thelazei, kai kathe egkuos gunaika tha apobalei auto (to moro) pou koubalaei. Tha deis tous anthropous methusmenous, parolo pou den einai methusmenoi, alla e timoria tou Allakh einai austere.

Anamesa stous anthropous uparkhei ekeinos pou amphisbetei khoris gnose, ton Allakh (kai te Duname Tou gia ten anastase ton anthropon)! Kai akolouthei (sten plane kai sta logia tou) kathe epanastatemeno diabolo (apo tous anthropous e ta tzinn)!

Ekhei graphtei oti opoios (anthropos) tha akolouthesei auton (ton diabolo apo tous anthropous e ta tzinn), (ekeinos o diabolos) tha ton paraplanesei kai tha ton odegesei sto marturio tes Phlegomenes Photias.

O, anthropoi! An amphiballete gia ten anastase, (labete upopse oti) pragmati, sas ekhoume plasei (ton Adam) apo khoma, epeita apo Noutpha (stagones apo anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon), epeita apo 'Alaka (kremameno thrombo aimatos), epeita apo Mountga (ena kommati sarkas, pou phainetai masemeno), to opoio einai skhematismeno (sten anthropine morphe) e den einai akome skhematismeno (opos sten periptose tes apoboles), gia na sas deixoume xekathara (te Duname Mas, pos sas demiourgesame se diaphoretika stadia). Kai kanoume opoious theloume na paramenoun stis metres (ton meteron tous) gia ena orismeno khrono. Epeita sas bgazoume exo os mora, epeita tha phtasete sten elikia tes dunames sas (tes neotetas). Merikoi apo sas pethainoun, kai merikous apo sas tous aphenoume na zesoun mekhri ta adunama gerateia, sta opoia de tha xeroun tipote, parolo pou gnorizan prin. Blepeis te ge agone, alla otan rikhnoume pano tes nero (brokhe), tarakounietai (apo zoe), kai phouskonei kai phutronei kathe loges oraia phuta.

Auto (to proanapheromeno einai gia na pistepsete) oti o Allakh einai o Al-Khakk (o Enas Alethinos Theos), kai oti Autos einai pou epanapherei tous nekrous ste zoe, kai oti Autos einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
Kai (gia na pistepsete) oti e Ora erkhetai, den uparkhei kamia amphibolia gi' auten, kai oti o Allakh tha anastesei autous pou briskontai stous taphous.

Anamesa stous anthropous uparkhei ekeinos pou amphisbetei ton Allakh (oti einai o Enas Alethinos Theos pou den ekhei kanenan etairo), khoris na ekhei oute (soste) gnose, oute (alethine) kathodegese, oute ena (xekatharo Theio) Biblio pou na photisei (ta epikheiremata tou).

Kai gurizei ton laimo tou (me alazoneia) gia na paraplanesei tous anthropous makria apo ton dromo tou Allakh. Gi' auton tha uparkhei e atimose sten egkosmia zoe, kai ten Emera tes Anastases tha ton kanoume na geutei to marturio tes kauses tes Photias!
(Kai tha eipothei s' auton): <<Auto (to marturio) einai gia o,ti diepraxan ta kheria sou, kai pragmati, o Allakh den adikei tous doulous (Tou).>>

Anamesa stous anthropous uparkhei ekeinos pou latreuei ton Allakh me distagmo: an tou erthei kati kalo, einai kathesukhasmenos m' auto (kai sunekhizei sten piste tou). Alla an ton plettoun kakoukhies, gurizei piso (egkataleipontas kai kategorontas te threskeia tou). Ekhase ten egkosmia zoe (epeide e apistia tou de tha ton sosei apo tis kakoukhies, oute tha tou pherei kanena ophelos), kai (ekhase kai) te Mellousa Zoe. Aute einai pragmati e prophanes apoleia.
Epikaleitai ektos tou Allakh, auta (ta eidola) pou den mporoun oute na ton blapsoun, oute na ton ophelesoun. Aute einai pragmati e plane pou ekhei xephugei makria.

Epikaleitai auta (ta eidola) ton opoion to kako einai pio konta (s' auton) apo to (khameno) ophelos tous [del. exaitias auton tha rikhtei ste Photia, kai de tha tou prospheroun pote kanena ophelos). Ti athlios uposteriktes einai autos (pou den mporei na uposterixei auton pou ton epikaleitai), kai ti athlios suntrophos einai autos (gi' auton pou ton latreuei kai ton pairnei os suntropho)!

Pragmati, o Allakh tha eisagei autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, se kepous kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Pragmati, o Allakh kanei o,ti thelei.

Opoios nomizei oti o Allakh de tha uposterixei auton (ton Prophete) sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, as epekteinei ena meso pros ton ourano (gia na phtasei ekei) kai epeita as kopsei (ten uposterixe kai ten apokalupse apo ton ourano pros ton Mokhammant), [e as epekteinei ena skoini mekhri to tabani kai as straggalistei kai epeita as kopsei to skoini], meta as dei: Apomakrune to skhedio tou (kai e praxe tou), auto pou ton enokhlouse (del. ten uposterixe tou Allakh pros ton Prophete);
Etsi (opos diasaphenisame tis apodeixeis gia ten anastase) steilame auto (to Kor'an) os xekathara Edaphia, kai pragmati, o Allakh kathodegei opoion thelei.

Pragmati, oso gia tous pistous, tous Ebraious, tous Mandaious (As-Sampi'a), tous Khristianous, tous Zoroastres kai tous eidololatres, o Allakh tha krinei anamesa tous ten Emera tes Anastases. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Marturas sta panta.

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti gia ton Allakh pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me upotage) oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai ste ge, kai o elios, to pheggari, ta asteria, ta bouna, ta dentra, ta kinoumena plasmata kai polloi apo tous anthropous; Uparkhoun omos kai polloi (anthropoi) stous opoious axizei e timoria. Opoion o Allakh atimasei, de tha uparkhei kaneis na ton timesei. Pragmati, o Allakh kanei o,ti thelei.

Autoi einai duo antipaloi (omada piston kai omada apiston) pou diaphonoun metaxu tous gia ton Kurio tous. Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, e Photia tha einai ta roukha tous, kai tha khunetai zematisto nero pano apo ta kephalia tous,
me to opoio (zematisto nero) tha liosei o,ti einai mesa sten koilia tous, kai ta dermata (tous, ta opoia tha ananaionontai sunekhos gia na geuontai to marturio).
Kai tha uparkhoun gi' autous siderenia sphuria (me ta opoia tha tous khtupesoun oi Aggeloi).

Kathe phora pou tha prospathesoun na bgoun ap' auten (te Photia) logo tes entones odunes (tous), tha tous epistrepsoun s' auten kai (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Geuteite to marturio tes kauses tes Photias!>>

Pragmati, o Allakh tha eisagei autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis se kepous, kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Tha stolistoun me brakhiolia apo khruso kai margaritaria, kai ta endumata tous mesa tou (Paradeisou) tha einai apo metaxi.
Eikhan kathodegethei (sten egkosmia zoe) sta kalutera logia (opos sten marturia tes pisteos kai sta logia exumneses tou Allakh), kai eikhan kathodegethei ston axiepaino dromo (tou Islam).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnountai ten piste kai apotrepoun tous anthropous apo ton dromo tou Allakh kai apo to Iero Tzami pou to kaname gia tous (pistous) anthropous, -sto opoio einai isoi (sto na menoun mesa tou kai ste Makka) o katoikos s' auto (del. ste Makka) kai o episkeptes (pou erkhetai apo makria)-, kai opoios thelei na parekklinei apo ten aletheia, diaprattontas adikia (amarties) mesa tou (sto Tzami), tha tous kanoume na geutoun ena odunero marturio.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan deixame ston Abraam ten topothesia tou (Ierou) Oikou (Ka'mpa) (gia na ton khtisei, kai eipame): <<Me Mou apodideis kanenan etairo ste latreia, kai exagnise ton Oiko Mou gi' ekeinous pou tha peripherontai (guro tou), ekeinous pou stekontai se proseukhe kai ekeinous pou upoklinontai kai pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos).
Anakoinose stous anthropous to proskunema, tha erthoun se sena me ta podia, kai tha erthoun me kathe lepte kamela (pou ekhase baros logo tes apostases) apo kathe apomakrusmeno dromo.

Gia na einai parontes s' auto pou ekhei ophele gi' autous (ste Mellousa Zoe apo praxeis latreias, kai sten egkosmia zoe apo emporio klp.), kai na exumnoun to Onoma tou Allakh se kathorismenes emeres, (eugnomonontas Ton) gia o,ti tous pareikhe apo zoa (thusias, kai na anapheroun to Onoma Tou kata te sphage tous). Phate loipon, (o, proskunetes) ap' auta kai taIste tous polu phtokhous.

Epeita as oloklerosoun tis teletourgies (tou proskunematos) tous (kai na bgoun apo ten katastase Ikhram), na ekplerosoun ta tamata tous (apo proskunema, eite Khatz, eite Oumra, e prosphora zoon thusias) kai na peripherontai guro apo ton Arkhaio Oiko (Ka'mpa, pou ton prostatepse o Allakh apo olous tous turannous).>>

Auto (ekhei diataxei o Allakh), kai opoios sebetai tis teletourgies (tes threskeias) tou Allakh (kai sebetai o,ti orise o Allakh os iero, kai apekhei apo o,ti apagorepse kata ten katastase Ikhram), auto tha einai kalutero gi' auton se antamoibe apo ton Kurio tou. Sas epitrepetai na katanalosete ta booeide, ektos ap' auta pou sas apaggelthekan (oti apagoreuontai). Apophugete loipon ten akatharsia tes eidololatrias kai apophugete to pseudos,

parekklinontas apo oles tis pseutikes threskeies kai akolouthontas mono te threskeia tou Allakh, khoris na apodidete s' Auton kanenan etairo ste latreia. Opoios omos, apodidei ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, einai san na epese apo ton ourano, kai etsi, eite ta arpaktika ptena arpazoun te sarka tou kommati kommati, eite ton rikhnei o anemos se ena makrino meros. [Etsi einai o eidololatres, ton arpazoun oi diaboloi apo kathe pleura, kai pephtei makria apo ten kathodegese].
Auto (ekhei diataxei o Allakh, to na apophugete ten eidololatria kai to pseudos), kai opoios sebetai tis teletourgies (tes threskeias) tou Allakh, auto proerkhetai apo ten eusebeia ton kardion.

Mporeite na epopheletheite ap' auta (ta zoa thusias, me to na ta kabalate e na pieite apo to gala tous klp.) mekhri ena orismeno khrono, epeita o topos thusias tous einai konta ston Arkhaio Oiko (Ka'mpa, pou ton prostatepse o Allakh apo olous tous turannous).

Gia kathe (proegoumeno pisto) ethnos orisame teletourgies (gia na thusiasoun booeide -pou moirazontai stous phtokhous- gia khare tou Allakh), gia na anapheroun to Onoma tou Allakh (eugnomonontas Ton) kata te sphage auton ton booeidon pou tous pareikhe. Pragmati, o Theos sas einai Enas Theos, gi' auto upotakhtheite mono s' Auton, kai dose (o, Prophete) ta kharmosuna nea stous tapeinous (pistous pou upotassontai ste Boulese tou Allakh),

oi opoioi (tapeinoi pistoi), otan anapheretai to Onoma tou Allakh, oi kardies tous gemizoun me deos kai phobo (gia ten timoria Tou, kai etsi den Ton parakoun), oi opoioi deikhnoun upomone gia o,ti tous eplexe, kai oi opoioi teloun ten proseukhe, kai apo o,ti tous parekhoume, xodeuoun (se eleemosune).

(To na thusiazete) tis kameles (kai tis agelades, to) kaname gia sas metaxu ton teletourgion (tes threskeias) tou Allakh (sto proskunema). Ekhete s' autes ophelos (antamoibe ste Mellousa Zoe epeide tis moirazete stous phtokhous, kai sten egkosmia zoe tis kabalate klp.). Anapherete loipon to Onoma tou Allakh kata te sphage tous, eno einai (oi kameles) orthies (eno einai to aristero tous podi demeno), meta otan pesoun sta plagia tous (nekres), tote mporeite (na tis mageirepsete kai) na phate ap' autes, kai na taIsete tous phtokhous, eite pou de zetianeuoun, eite pou zetianeuoun (logo tes anagkes tous). Etsi, upotaxame se sas auta (ta booeide thusias), isos kai na eiste eugnomones.

De tha phtasei ston Allakh, oute to kreas tous (ton booeidon thusias), oute to aima tous, alla tha phtasei s' Auton mono e eusebeia sas (oti phulasseste apo ten timoria Tou, terontas tis entoles Tou). Etsi, ta upotaxame se sas, oste na doxazete ton Allakh gia o,ti sas kathodegese. Dose loipon (o, Prophete) ta kharmosuna nea s' autous pou prattoun to kalo.
Pragmati, o Allakh uperaspizetai tous pistous. Pragmati, o Allakh den agapa kanenan prodote kai akharisto.

(Tora) dinetai e adeia s' autous (tous Mousoulmanous) pou elaban polemo (kai diogmous, to na polemesoun piso, aphou etan prin apagoreumeno, kai eprepe mono na deixoun upomone), auto epeide elaban adikia. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Ikanos na tous khoregesei te nike.

Oi opoioi (Mousoulmanoi) ekdiokhthekan apo ta spitia tous adika, mono kai mono epeide elegan: <<O Kurios mas einai o Allakh!>> An o Allakh den apothouse mia (adike) omada anthropon meso mias alles (meso polemou), (tha exaplonotan e adikia kai) tha katedaphizontan monasteria, ekklesies, sunagoges kai tzamia sta opoia (tzamia) mnemoneuetai polu to Onoma tou Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh uposterizei opoion uposterizei te threskeia Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).

Ekeinoi (oi Mousoulmanoi pou tha tous uposterizoume) einai autoi pou otan tous dinoume duname (kai nike enantion ton ekhthron tous) ste ge, teloun ten proseukhe, dinoun (stous phtokhous) te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai diatazoun to kalo kai apagoreuoun to kako. Ston Allakh katalegoun ola ta themata (gia ta opoia tha dosei eite antamoibe, eite timoria).

An se diapseusoun (oi apistoi, o, Prophete), pragmati, kai prin ap' autous, o laos tou Noe, e phule 'Ant kai e phule Thamount eikhan diapseusei (tous Prophetes tous, ton Noe, ton Khount kai ton Salikh),
epises kai o laos tou Abraam kai o laos tou Lot,

kai oi katoikoi tes Madiam (diepseusan ton Sou'aimp), kai (o Pharao kai o laos tou) diepseusan ton Mouse. Alla edosa anabole stous apistous, kai meta tous arpaxa me ten timoria. Pos etan e aporripse Mou (meso tes timorias tous, gia ten apistia tous)!

Poses poleis katastrepsame eno etan adikes (kai apistes), kai etsi, gkremistekan ta spitia tous (kai eginan oi poleis adeies apo tous katoikous tous)! Kai (posa) pegadia eginan egkataleleimmena, kai (posa) psela dunata palatia (den prostatepsan tous katoikous tous apo ten timoria Mas)!

Den taxidepsan (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant) ste ge (kai eidan kapoies poleis pou katastrepsame, opos tes phules 'Ant kai tes Thamount), kai etsi na ekhoun kardies pou na katalaboun (tis nouthesies) m' autes, e autia pou na akoun m' auta (ti egine prin); Pragmati, den einai ta matia pou tuphlonontai, alla einai oi kardies sta stethe pou tuphlonontai.

Se zetoun (oi apistoi, o, Prophete) na epispeuseis gi' autous ten timoria, kai o Allakh de tha athetesei ten uposkhese Tou (gia ten timoria tous)! Pragmati, e mia mera me ton Kurio sou (me ten timoria ste Mellousa Zoe) einai san khilia khronia ap' auta pou metrate (sten egkosmia zoe).
Poses poleis tous edosa anabole eno etan adikes, kai meta tis arpaxa me ten timoria! Kai se Emena einai o telikos proorismos (olon ton plasmaton).
Pes (o, Prophete): <<O, anthropoi! Pragmati, ego eimai mono enas proeidopoietes gia sas, pou proeidopoiei xekathara.>>
Etsi, osoi pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai gennaiodora agatha (ston Paradeiso).

Alla osoi speudoun na diapseusoun ta Edaphia Mas, (apotharrunontas tous anthropous apo to na pistepsoun, kai antitithentai se Emas) nomizontas oti tha xephugoun apo Emas, pragmati, ekeinoi einai oi katoikoi tou Puros tes Kolaseos.

De steilame prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) kanenan Aggeliaphoro e Prophete ektos apo to oti otan epithumouse (ten kathodegese tou laou tou) [e apeggeile, ta Edaphia tou Allakh], o Satanas erikhne (psithurous kai paranoeseis stis kardies ton anthropon) s' auto pou epithumouse (ekeinos o Prophetes, oste na men ton pistepsoun) [e -erikhne psithurous stis kardies tous gia ten apaggelia tou-]. Alla o Allakh aphairese auta pou erixe o Satanas (apo paranoeseis), kai meta epibebaiose o Allakh ta Semadia (kai ta xekathara Edaphia) Tou (diasaphanizontas ta, oste na men parameinei kamia paranoese, ektos stis kardies ton upokriton kai ton apiston). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Gia na kanei (o Allakh) auta pou erixe o Satanas (apo psithurous kai paranoeseis) os dokimasia gi' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou ekhoun stis kardies tous ten arrostia (tes upokrisias), kai gi' ekeinous (tous apistous) ton opoion oi kardies einai skleres. Pragmati, oi adikoi briskontai se akraia enantiose (pros ton Allakh kai tous Aggeliaphorous Tou), makria apo ten aletheia.

Kai (aphairese o Allakh tis paranoeseis kai epibebaiose ta Semadia kai ta Edaphia Tou) gia na xeroun ekeinoi (oi pistoi) stous opoious dotheke e gnose, oti aute einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, kai na pistepsoun s' auten, kai na tapeinothoun oi kardies tous pros auten. Pragmati, o Allakh tha kathodegesei autous pou pisteuoun, ston isio dromo.

Tha paramenoun oi apistoi se amphibolia gi' auto (to Kor'an) mekhri na tous erthei xaphnika e Ora e na tous erthei to marturio mias Emeras (tes Kriseos) kata ten opoia de tha ekhoun kanena eleos e kanena kalo.

To Basileio (kai e Kuriarkhia) ekeine ten Emera tha anekei mono ston Allakh, kai tha krinei anamesa tous (stous anthropous). Osoi pistepsan kai ekanan enaretes praxeis, tha briskontai stous kepous tes eudaimonias (ston Paradeiso).
Alla osoi arnethekan ten piste kai diepseusan ta Edapheia Mas, tha ekhoun ena tapeinotiko marturio (sten Kolase).

Osoi metanastepsan sto dromo tou Allakh (gia na uposterixoun te threskeia Tou, epidiokontas ten Eukharistese Tou) kai epeita skotothekan (ste makhe) e pethanan, o Allakh tha tous dosei kala agatha (kai terastia antamoibe ston Paradeiso). Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Kaluteros ekeinon pou parekhoun agatha (kai antamoibe).
Tha tous eisagei se ena meros (del. ston Paradeiso), opou tha einai eukharistemenoi m' auto. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

Auto (to proanapheromeno, to orise o Allakh gia tous metanastes, oti tha mpoun ston Paradeiso, kai orise gi' autous epises oti) kai opoios antapedose mia epithese, me ton idio tropo pou ten elabe, kai meta adiketheke xana, pragmati, o Allakh tha ton uposterixei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aphoou (Autos pou dinei aphese gia ta panta) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Auto (oti o Allakh tha uposterixei ton adikemeno, einai) epeide o Allakh (einai Ikanos gia ta panta kai) einai Autos pou eisagei te nukhta sten emera, kai eisagei ten emera ste nukhta (del. auxanei kai meionei tis ores tous kata to kheimona kai to kalokairi). Kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta Panta).
Auto epeide o Allakh einai o Al-Khakk (o Enas Alethinos Theos), kai o,ti epikalountai ektos ap' Auton einai e plane, kai o Allakh einai o Al-'Alei (Upsistos), o Al-Kampeir (Megas).

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh stelnei apo ton ourano nero, kai etsi e ge ginetai prasine! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Lateiph (Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou), kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).
S' Auton anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste ge. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh upetaxe se sas o,ti uparkhei ste ge, kai ta ploia na pleoun ste thalassa me ten entole Tou, kai krata ton ourano na men pesei pano ste ge para mono me ten adeia Tou! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Poluepieikes kai Polueusplakhnos pros tous anthropous.

Einai Autos pou sas edose te zoe, meta tha sas ten aphairesei, kai meta tha sas epanapherei ste zoe (kata ten anastase). Pragmati, o anthropos einai akharistos (pros tis eunoies tou Allakh, kai etsi apodidei s' Auton etairous ste latreia).

Gia kathe (proegoumeno pisto) ethnos orisame (kanones ste threskeia, kai) teletourgies (gia na thusiazoun oi pistoi kata to proskunema, booeide), tis opoies (teletourgies) akolouthousan. Etsi, (o, Prophete) as me diaphonoun mazi sou (oi eidololatres) s' auto to thema (tes thusias pou prosphereis stis emeres tes thusias sto proskunema, legontas se sena: <<Giati trote ta booeide pou thusiazete kai skotonete kai den trote ta nekra booeide pou ta skotose o Allakh;>>). Kalese loipon (tous eidololatres) pros ton Kurio sou (kai te threskeia Tou, kai sto na upakoun ten entole Tou me to na men trone ta nekra booeide kai na me thusiazoun gia ta eidola). Pragmati, esu eisai se isia kathodegese (eno oi eidololatres briskontai ste plane).
An diaphonoun mazi sou, pes: <<O Allakh xerei kalutera o,ti kanete.>>
O Allakh tha krinei metaxu sas (o, anthropoi) ten Emera tes Anastases se o,ti diaphonousate.

Den emathes (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh gnorizei ola osa uparkhoun ston ourano kai ste ge! Ola auta einai (grammena) se ena Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud). Aute (e gnose gia ta panta) einai kati eukolo gia ton Allakh.

Latreuoun (oi eidololatres) ektos tou Allakh, autous (tous legomenous theous kai ta eidola tous), gia tous opoious den esteile (o Allakh stous eidololatres) kamia apodeixe (sta Biblia Tou oti axizoun te latreia), oute ekhoun gi' autous kamia gnose, (alla tous latreuoun apo agnoia kai mimese ton progonon tous). Pragmati, gia tous adikous de tha uparkhei kanenas uposteriktes.

Otan ta xekathara Edaphia Mas apaggellontai s' autous, blepeis (o, Prophete) ten arnese sta prosopa ekeinon pou arnethekan ten piste. Paraligo na epitethoun s' autous (tous pistous) pou apaggelloun s' ekeinous ta Edaphia Mas! Pes: <<Na sas enemeroso gia kati kheirotero ap' aute (ten orge sas); Einai e Photia, ten opoia o Allakh ekhei uposkhethei s' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, kai ti athlios proorismos einai autos!

O, anthropoi! Parousiazetai ena paradeigma, akouste to loipon (prosektika): Pragmati, autoi (oi legomenoi theoi sas kai ta eidola) pou epikaleiste peran tou Allakh, de tha demiourgesoun oute kan muges, akoma ki an sugkentronontan oloi mazi gi' auton ton skopo! Akoma ki an oi muges ekleban ap' autous kati (polu mikro), de tha mporousan na to sosoun (kai na to anaktesoun) ap' autes! Adunamoi einai oi kunegoi (oi legomenoi theoi sas) kai oi kunegemenoi (oi muges).

De doxazan ton Allakh (kai oute exeran te megaloprepeia Tou) opos Tou armozei (otan latreuan peran ap' Auton, kapoia apo ta demiourgemata Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).
O Allakh epilegei Aggeliaphorous apo tous Aggelous kai apo tous anthropous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Gnorizei ti ekanan (ekeinoi oi Aggeliaphoroi, kai o,ti egine prin te demourgia tous) kai ti tha kanoun (kai ti tha ginei meta to thanato tous). Ston Allakh (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha epistrepsoun oles oi upotheseis.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Upoklitheite kai peste se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos, enopion tou Allakh), kai latrepste ton Kurio sas (kai mono) kai kante to kalo, isos kai petukhete.

Kai agonisteite sto dromo tou Allakh opos prepei (me ole te duname sas). Autos einai pou sas epelexe (gia te threskeia Tou kai sas kathodegese). De stenepse se sas te threskeia (oute epebale se sas duskolies). Einai e (idia) threskeia tou patera sas, Abraam. (O Allakh) einai Autos pou sas onomase Mousoulmanous apo prin (to Kor'an) kai s' auto (to Kor'an). Gia na einai o Aggeliaphoros marturas se sas (ten Emera tes Kriseos oti metadose se sas to Menuma tou Allakh), kai eseis na eiste martures stous anthropous (oti oi Aggeliaphoroi tous, metedosan s' autous to Menuma tou Allakh). Teleste loipon ten proseukhe, doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai empisteuteite ton Allakh. Autos einai o Kedemonas sas, kai einai o Kaluteros Kedemonas, kai einai o Kaluteros Uposteriktes!
Pragmati, epitukhemenoi einai oi pistoi.
Oi opoioi einai kata tis proseukhes tous, tapeinoi.
Oi opoioi apopheugoun ola ta mataia logia.
Oi opoioi dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune).
Oi opoioi phulassoun ta idiotika mere tous (kai ten agnoteta tous apo tis apagoreumenes sexoualikes praxeis).
Ektos (an oi sexoualikes epaphes tous einai) me tis suzugous tous e me tis doules tous, tote den uparkhei tipote mempto gi' autous.
Omos opoios anazeta kati pera ap' auto, tote ekeinoi einai oi parabates.
(Epises oi pistoi einai autoi) oi opoioi teroun ta katapisteumata kai tis sumphonies tous.
Oi opoioi teroun tis proseukhes tous.
Ekeinoi (oi pistoi) tha einai, pragmati, oi kleronomoi,
pou tha kleronomesoun ton Al-Phirntaous (to upselotero epipedo ston Paradeiso), opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta.
Pragmati, ekhoume plasei ton anthropo (ton Adam) apo laspe anamemeigmene apo ole te ge.
Epeita ton kaname (del. tous apogonous tou Adam) Noutpha (stagones apo anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon) mesa se proetoimasmeno asphale topo (te metra).

Epeita demiourgesame tis Noutpha (stagones ekkriseon ton duo phulon) se 'Alaka (kremameno thrombo aimatos), kai demiourgesame to 'Alaka se Mountga (ena kommati sarkas, pou phainetai masemeno), kai demiourgesame to Mountga se kokkala, kai ntusame ta kokkala me sarka, kai epeita to kaname ena allo neo plasma (apo apsukho pragma se enan anthropo, emphusontas to pneuma mesa tou). Upsistos einai o Allakh, o Aristos ton demiourgon.
Epeita meta apo ola auta (sto telos tes zoes sas) tha pethanete.
Epeita, ten Emera tes Anastases, tha anastetheite.

Pragmati, demiourgesame apo pano sas (o, anthropoi) epta ouranous, ton enan pano apo ton allon, kai pote den ekhoume paramelesei (oute xekhasame) te demiourgia Mas (alla ten perikleioume me te Gnose Mas).

Steilame nero apo ton ourano, se mia sugkekrimene posoteta (pou sas eparkei), kai to kaname na egkatastathei ste ge (gia na epopheletheite ap' auto, etsi, kuklophorei metaxu exatmises kai brokhes), kai Emeis eimaste Ikanoi na to aphairesoume (apo te ge)!
M' auto (to nero) demiourgesame gia sas kepous me khourmadies kai ampelia, stous opoious uparkhoun gia sas polla phrouta, kai ta opoia trote.
