Kai [demiourgesame m' auto to nero] ena dentro pou bgainei apo to bouno Saina' [opou apokaluphtheke ston Mouse e Tora], to opoio dentro bgazei ladi, kai sto opoio boutane [to psomi tous] ekeinoi pou trone.

Pragmati, uparkhei gia sas sta booeide ena Semadi gia na to labete upopse: sas dinoume na pinete ap' auto (to gala) pou uparkhei sten koilia tous, kai ap' auta ekhete polla ophele, kai ap' auta trote!
Kai pano s' auta (ta booeide) kai sta ploia metaphereste.

Pragmati, steilame ton Noe ston lao tou, kai etsi eipe: <<O, lae mou! Latrepste ton Allakh, den ekhete allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. De tha phulakhtheite loipon, (apo ten timoria Tou, terontas tis entoles Tou);>>

Eipan (metaxu tous) oi arkhegoi tou laou tou, pou arnethekan ten piste: <<Autos den einai para mono enas anthropos san kai esas, o opoios thelei na einai anoteros apo sas. An ethele o Allakh (na steilei Aggeliaphorous), tha estelne Aggelous. Den ekhoume akousei kati tetoio (pou to iskhurizetai) apo tous progonous mas.
Autos einai mono enas trelos andras, opote deixte upomone s' auton gia ligo (mekhri na therapeutei, e na stamatesei to kalesma tou, e na pethanei).>>
(O Noe) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Uposterixe me (enantion tous), gia o,ti me diepseusan.>>

Apokalupsame loipon s' auton (ton Noe) oti: <<Kataskeuase ten Kiboto upo ten Orase Mas kai ten empneuse Mas (gia to pos tha ten kataskeuaseis). Otan tha erthei e entole Mas, kai to nero tha anabluzei apo ton phourno (os semadi oti e plemmura xekinaei), tote bale s' aute (ten Kiboto, tous pistous, kai) ena zeugari, arseniko kai theluko, apo kathe eidos (zoou), kai ten oikogeneia sou, ektos ap' ekeinous gia tous opoious ekhei ede apophasistei (oti tha pnigoun). Kai me Mou milas skhetika m' ekeinous pou adikesan (oute na Me epikalesteis na tous sugkhoreso), pragmati, tha pnigoun.
Kai otan esu kai osoi einai mazi sou, epibibasteite sten Kiboto, pes: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, o Opoios mas esose apo tous adikous anthropous.>>
Kai pes: <<Kurie mou! Kane me na prosgeiotho me enan eulogemeno tropo (se mia eulogemene ge). Pragmati, Esu eisai o Kaluteros ap' autous pou mporoun na dosoun prosgeiose.>>.>>

Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia (oti sosame tous pistous kai katastrepsame tous apistous), kai pragmati, tha dokimazoume (tous anthropous, stelnontas Aggeliaphorous, prin katastrepsoume tous apistous).
Epeita demiourgesame meta ap' autous (tous apistous tou laou tou Noe) allo enan lao.

Kai tous steilame enan Aggeliaphoro ap' autous, (pou tous eipe) oti: <<Latrepste ton Allakh, den ekhete kanenan allon theo pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. De tha phulakhtheite loipon, apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou);>>

Omos oi arkhegoi tou laou tou, pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseusan te sunantese (me ton Allakh) ste Mellousa Zoe, kai stous opoious khoregesame agatha sten egkosmia zoe (alla etan akharistoi), eipan: <<Autos den einai para enas anthropos san kai esas. Troei apo o,ti trote, kai pinei apo o,ti pinete.
An upakousete enan anthropo san kai esas, sigoura tha eiste etsi oi khamenoi.
Sas uposkhetai oti aphou tha pethanete kai tha ginete khoma kai kokala, tha bgeite xana (kai tha anastetheite apo tous taphous sas);
Makria, makria (apo to na pragmatopoiethei) auto pou sas uposkhetheke!
Den uparkhei (alle zoe) para mono e egkosmia zoe mas, s' auten pethainoume, kai zoume (del. oi anthropoi pou tha gennethoun), kai de tha anastethoume pote (meta apo to thanato).
Autos den einai para enas anthropos pou apodidei logia pseudos ston Allakh, kai de tha pistepsoume pote s' auton.>>
(O Prophetes pou staltheke s' autous), eipe: <<Kurie mou! Uposterixe me (enantion tous), gia o,ti me diepseusan.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Pragmati, se ligo kairo tha metaniosoun.>>

Etsi, tous katestrepse e megale krauge, me ten aletheia (kai te dikaiosune), kai tous kaname san ton aphro tou kheimarrou (pou epipleei sto nero). As apomakrunthei loipon (apo to eleos tou Allakh, kai as katastraphei) o adikos laos!
Epeita, demiourgesame meta ap' autous allous laous.
Kanenas laos de tha katastraphei prin ton prokathorismeno khrono tou, oute tha laboun (oi anthropoi tou) kamia anabole (meta ton prokathorismeno khrono tous).

Epeita, steilame diadokhika tous Aggeliaphorous Mas. Opote erkhotan se enan lao o Aggeliaphoros tou, ton diepseudan. Etsi, katastrepsame diadokhika (tous apistous laous) ton enan meta ton allon, kai tous kaname na ginoun mono eideseis (sta logia ton metagenesteron laon). As apomakrunthoun (apo to eleos tou Allakh, kai as katastraphoun) ekeinoi oi anthropoi pou den pisteuoun!
Epeita, steilame ton Mouse kai ton adelpho tou, ton Aaron, me ta Semadia Mas kai mia xekathare apodeixe,
ston Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou, alla edeixan alazoneia (enanti tes pistes), kai etan alazonikoi anthropoi (enanti ton allon anthropon).
(O Pharao kai oi arkhegoi) eipan: <<Einai dunaton na pistepsoume se duo antres san kai emas, eno oi anthropoi tou laou tous (ta paidia tou Israel -Iakob-) einai upotagmenoi se mas;>>
Etsi, (o Pharao kai oi arkhegoi) tous diepseusan (ton Mouse kai ton Aaron), kai etsi, eginan apo tous katestrammenous.
Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora), isos kai na kathodegethoun (ta paidia tou Israel -Iakob-).

Kaname ton uio tes Marias (ton Iesou) kai te metera tou os ena Semadi (tes Dunames Mas, otan gennetheke o Iesous me ten entole Mas, khoris patera), kai tous kaname na kataphugoun se enan lopho me epipede epiphaneia, pou eikhe ena ruaki.
O, Aggeliaphoroi! Phate apo ta kala agatha kai kante enaretes praxeis. Pragmati, gia o,ti kanete eimai Pantognostes.
Pragmati, aute einai e threskeia olon sas, e opoia einai mono mia threskeia (to Islam), kai Ego eimai o Kurios sas, gi' auto phulakhtheite loipon apo ten timoria Mou (terontas tis entoles Mou)!

Alla (oi opadoi ton Aggeliaphoron meta) diepheran metaxu tous ste threskeia tous, se aireseis (demiourgontas diaphoretikes threskeies, kai egkataleipontas ten alethine threskeia ton Aggeliaphoron), kathe airese khairetai m' auto pou ekhei (nomizontas oti mono aute ekhei ten aletheia).
Aphese tous loipon, (o, Prophete, tous apistous tes Makkas) sten plane pou tous ekhei kalupsei, mekhri mia prokathorismene ora (opou tha tous pesei e timoria).
Nomizoun oti auta pou tous parekhoume apo ploute kai paidia,
einai oti epispeudoume gi' autous to kalo (epeide to axizoun); Okhi (den to axizoun), alla (einai os dokimasia kai gia na tous pheroume stadiaka pros ten katastrophe, eno) den to aisthanontai!

Pragmati, autoi (oi pistoi) oi opoioi apo to phobo tous pros ton Allakh (kai parolo pou pisteuoun kai prattoun kales praxeis), akoma phobountai (apo ten timoria Tou kai apo to na aporripsei tis praxeis tous, kai etsi speudoun sunekheia pros ten upakoe pros Auton kai sto na prattoun kales praxeis).
Oi opoioi (pistoi) pisteuoun sta Edaphia tou Kuriou tous.
Oi opoioi (pistoi) den apodidoun ston Kurio tous kanenan etairo ste latreia.

Oi opoioi (pistoi) kanoun autes (tis kales praxeis) pou kanoun, eno oi kardies tous phobountai (apo to na tis aporripsei o Allakh, kai epeide xeroun) oti tha epistrepsoun ston Kurio tous (gia na logodotesoun).
Ekeinoi (oloi oi proanapheromenoi pistoi) speudoun pros tis kales praxeis, kai einai protoi s' autes.
Den epibarunoume kamia psukhe perissotero apo o,ti antekhei. Ekhoume ena biblio (ton praxeon ton anthropon) pou leei ten aletheia, kai de tha adikethoun.

Okhi (den einai opos nomizoun oi apistoi oti tous dinoume ploute kai paidia epeide axizoun to kalo), alla oi kardies tous einai kalummenes me ten plane kai den katanooun auto (to Kor'an kai ta Semadia kai tis nouthesies tou). Kai ekhoun kai alles (kakes) praxeis (pera apo ten apistia tous), tis opoies kanoun (kai tha sunekhisoun na tis kanoun),
kai otan tha arpaxoume tous eukatastatous arkhegous tous me ten timoria, tha phonaxoun gia boetheia (apo ten timoria Mas).
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Me phonazete gia boetheia semera, pragmati, de tha uparkhei kamia boetheia gia sas enantion Mas!
Pragmati, apaggellontan se sas ta Edaphia Mou, eseis apostraphekate ap' auta.

Kai esastan alazonikoi (enanti ton anthropon) kai kaukhiosastan gi' auto (ton Iero Oiko, oti eiste oi katoikoi guro tou, kai oti ekhete perissotero dikaioma s' auton. Parolo pou oi pistoi einai autoi pou ekhoun perissotero dikaioma s' auto). Kai kathosastan te nukhta (guro apo ton Oiko) milontas me askhema logia.>>

Den ekhoun sullogistei ta Logia (tou Kor'an, gia na doun oti einai e aletheia); E (tous empodise apo to na pistepsoun oti) tous erthe auto (to Menuma, kai enas Aggeliaphoros) eno den erthe stous progonous tous; [Pragmati, ekhoume steilei Aggeliaphorous kai stous progonous tous]!
E (tous empodise apo to na pistepsoun oti) de gnorizoun ton Aggeliaphoro tous (ton Mokhammant, kai ten eilikrineia tou), opote ton arnountai;
E lene: <<Uparkhei trela mesa tou (ston Mokhammant);>> Okhi (den einai trelos), alla ekhei erthei s' autous me ten aletheia, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous apekhthanontai ten aletheia.

Pragmati, an e aletheia akolouthouse tis epithumies tous (kai dieuthetouse o Allakh ola ta themata sumphona m' autes), tha eikhan katastraphei oi ouranoi kai e ge, kai o,ti uparkhei mesa tous! Okhi (e aletheia de tha akolouthesei tis epithumies tous), alla tous steilame ten Upenthumise gi' autous (del. to Kor'an pou periekhei doxa kai duname gi' autous an to akolouthesoun), alla autoi apostraphekan apo ten Upenthumise tous.

E tous zeteses (o, Prophete) kapoia antamoibe (kai gi' auto den pisteuoun); [Bebaia den to ekanes] kai e antamoibe tou Kuriou sou (gia sena) einai kalutere (apo opoia antamoibe kai an sou edinan), kai Autos einai o Kaluteros ap' autous pou parekhoun agatha.
Esu pragmati (o, Prophete), tous kaleis pros ton isio dromo (tou Islam).
Alla ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, parekklinoun ap' auton ton (isio) dromo (pros allous dromous pou odegoun ste Photia).
Kai an tous deikhname eleos kai aphairousame tis kakoukhies (pou tous eplexan), tha paremenan sten parabase (kai sten apistia) tous me sugkhuse (anti na ginoun eugnomones)!

Pragmati, tous plexame (kai tous dokimasame) me ten timoria (del. tis kakoukhies kai ten peina), alla den upotakhthekan me tapeinose pros ton Kurio tous, oute (Ton) epikalestekan me tapeinose (gia na aphairesei tis kakoukhies, parolo pou eidan oti oi legomenoi theoi tous etan anikanoi na tous sosoun)!
Ospou otan tha anoixoume s' autous (ste Mellousa Zoe) mia pule me austere timoria, tote tha einai s' aute apelpismenoi (gia kathe kalo).
Einai Autos pou demiourgese gia sas ten akoe, ten orase kai tis kardies. Ligo omos einai auto pou deikhnete apo eugnomosune (pros Auton).
Einai Autos pou sas eplase ste ge, kai s' Auton tha sugkentrotheite oloi (ten Emera tes Kriseos).
Einai Autos pou dinei te zoe kai ten aphairei, kai s' Auton anekei e entole tes diadokhes tes nukhtas kai tes emeras. Ma de sullogizeste;
(De sullogizontai oi apistoi ta Semadia tou Allakh gia ten anastase), alla eipan ta idia pou elegan oi proegoumenoi (apistoi) laoi.
Eipan: <<Einai dunaton oti otan tha pethanoume kai tha ginoume skone kai kokala, tha anastethoume;
Pragmati, ekhoume labei uposkhese emeis kai oi progonoi mas prin gi' aute (ten anastase, alla den ten eidame na ulopoieitai). Auto den einai para oi muthoi ton arkhaion.>>
Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous pou diapseudoun ten anastase): <<Se Poion anekei e ge kai oloi osoi briskontai pano tes, an pragmatika gnorizete;>>
Tha poun: <<Anekoun ston Allakh.>> Pes: <<De tha to labete upopse, loipon, (oti Autos pou kuriarkhei te ge, einai Ikanos na sas anastesei);>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Poios einai o Kurios ton epta ouranon, kai o Kurios tou Megaloprepous Thronou;>>
Tha poun: <<O Allakh.>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<De tha phulakhtheite loipon apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou);>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Sto Kheri Poianou brisketai e kuriarkhia ton panton, kai Autos parekhei prostasia (se opoion thelei) kai kaneis den prostateuetai ap' Auton (an thelei na ton timoresei), an pragmatika gnorizete;>>

Tha poun: <<Anekei ston Allakh (e kuriarkhia ton panton).>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Tote pos paraplanethekate (makria apo ten aletheia, kai den pisteuete sten anastase, kai apodidete ston Allakh etairous ste latreia);>>
Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou iskhurizontai oti o Allakh ekhei etairous e apektese enan uio), alla steilame s' autous ten aletheia, alla autoi einai pseutes.

Den apektese o Allakh kanenan uio, oute uperxe pote mazi Tou kanenas allos theos. (Giati an uperkhe), tote o kathe theos tha epairne o,ti eikhe demiourgesei, kai o kathenas (theos) tha epedioke na uperiskhusei enanti tou allou. Doxa ston Allakh, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (pseudos apo ateleies).
O Pantognostes ton aoraton kai ton oraton. Upsistos kai Anoteros einai apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (oi apistoi) apo etairous.
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Kurie mou! An me kaneis na do aute (ten timoria) gia ten opoia elaban uposkhese (kai proeidopoiese),
tote, Kurie mou, me me kaneis na briskomai anamesa ston adiko lao (gia na me me plexei e timoria).>>

Pragmati, Emeis eimaste Ikanoi sto (na epispeusoume ten timoria tous, kai) na se kanoume (o, Prophete) na deis aute (ten timoria) pou tous uposkhethekame, (gi' auto me lupasai apo te diapseuse tous, tous dinoume mia anabole mekhri ten prokathorismene ora tous).

Apothese (o, Prophete) to kako me to kalo (kai an oi eidololatres se blapsoun, men apokrouseis to kako tous me kako, alla deixe sugkhorese kai upomone). Emeis gnorizoume ti perigraphoun (pseudos se Mas, oti ekhoume etairous, kai se sena, oti eisai poietes e magos e paraphron, kai tha tous timoresoume gi' auto).
Kai pes: <<Kurie mou! Anazeto kataphugio se Sena apo tous psithurous ton diabolon,
kai anazeto kataphugio se Sena, Kurie mou, apo to na parousiastoun (oi diaboloi se opoiadepote apo tis upotheseis mou).>>

Ospou otan erthei o thanatos se kapoion ap' autous (tous apistous, kai dei o apistos tous Aggelous, kai ti ekhei proetoimastei gi' auton), leei (metaniomenos gia te zoe tou pou perase askopa): <<Kurie mou! Epistrepste me sten egkosmia zoe,

oste na kano kales praxeis s' aute (ten egkosmia zoe) pou aphesa.>> Okhi (de tha epistrepsei)! Aute einai mono mia lexe pou ten propherei (kai an epistrephotan, de tha terouse ten uposkhese tou). Kai piso tous uparkhei ena phragma (apo to na epistrepsoun sten egkosmia zoe) mekhri ten Emera pou tha anastethoun.

Otan (o Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga), ekeine ten Emera de tha uparkhei kamia kaukhese metaxu tous gia te geneologia kai ten katagoge (opos ekanan sten egkosmia zoe), oute tha rotesei o enas ton allon (kai o kathenas tha einai apaskholemenos mono me ton eauto tou).
Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai baria, autoi tha einai oi epitukhemenoi.
Oso gi' ekeinous ton opoion e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai elaphria, ekeinoi tha einai autoi pou ekhasan ton eauto tous, tha parameinoun sten Kolase gia panta.
E Photia tha kapsei ta prosopa tous, kai tha parameinoun mesa tes sunophruomenoi.
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Den apaggellontan ta Edaphia Mou se sas (kata ten egkosmia zoe) kai eseis ta diapseudate;>>
Tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Mas kurieusan oi pothoi mas (pou mas odegesan ste dustukhia kai ten athlioteta), kai emastan parastratemenoi anthropoi (apo ten aletheia).
Kurie mas! Bgale mas ap' aute (te Photia), kai an epistrepsoume (sten apistia kai ten plane), pragmati, tha emaste adikoi.>>
(O Allakh) tha pei: <<Meinete ekei (ste Photia) periphronemenoi (kai atimasmenoi), kai me Mou milate.

Otan mia omada (piston) apo tous doulous Mou, elege (sten egkosmia zoe): <<Kurie mas! Pisteuoume (se Esena), sugkhorese mas loipon, kai eleese mas. Pragmati, Esu eisai o Kaluteros apo tous eleemones.>>,
eseis (o, apistoi) tous koroideuate, mekhri pou (oi khleuasmoi), sas ekanan na xekhasete ten exumnese Mou, kai gelousate s' autous (tous pistous).
Semera, tous ekho antameipsei (tous pistous), gia o,ti upemenan karterika, me to na einai autoi oi epitukhemenoi (pou kerdisan ton Paradeiso).>>
(O Allakh) tha pei (stous apistous gia na deixei poso asemante etan e egkosmia zoe): <<Posa khronia meinate ste ge;>>
Tha poun: <<Meiname mia mera e meros mias emeras. Roteste (o, Kurie) ekeinous pou metroun (kai katagraphoun).>>
(O Allakh) tha pei: <<Pragmati, de meinate (sten egkosmia zoe) para mono ligo, an mono gnorizate.
Nomizate oti sas demiourgesame mataia (kai askopa kai gia paikhnidi), kai oti de tha epistrephate se Mas;>>

Upsistos einai o Allakh (kai Anoteros apo o,ti ateleies Tou apodidoun oi apistoi), o Al-Malik (o Basilias), o Al-Khakk (o Enas Alethinos Theos)! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Kurios tou Eugenous Thronou.

Opoios epikaleitai allon theo ektos tou Allakh, gia ton opoio den ekhei kamia apodeixe (oti axizei te latreia), e logodotese tou tha einai enopion tou Kuriou tou (kai tha ton timoresei gi' auto pou ekane)! Pragmati, oi apistoi de tha epitukhoun pote.
Kai pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Kurie mou! Sugkhorese kai Eleese (me). Pragmati, Esu eisai o Kaluteros apo tous eleemones!>>
(Auto einai) ena Kephalaio pou to steilame kai katastesame tous kanones tou upokhreotikous. Kai steilame mesa tou xekathara Semadia, isos na ta labete upopse (kai na labete nouthesia).

Oso gia te moikhalida kai ton moikho, khtupeste (o, kubernetes e dikastes) ton kathena tous ekato mastigomata. Men aphesete ton oikto gi' autous na sas kanei na men epharmosete ten entole tou Allakh, ean pisteuete ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera. Kai as ginei mia omada piston marturas tes timorias tous.

O moikhos de diaprattei moikheia para me mia moikhalida e mia eidololatrissa (pou theorei te moikheia epitrepte), kai e moikhalida de diaprattei moikheia para me enan moikho e enan eidololatre (pou theorei te moikheia epitrepte)! Kai apagoreuetai aute (e moikheia) stous pistous.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou sukophantoun tis agnes gunaikes gia moikheia, kai den phernoun tesseris martures (pou eidan te moikheia xekathara, khoris kamia amphibolia), khtupeste tous (o, kubernetes e dikastes) me ogdonta mastigomata, kai me dekheste pote kamia marturia ap' autous. Pragmati, ekeinoi einai oi anupakouoi pros ton Allakh.

Ektos ap' ekeinous pou straphekan me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) meta ap' auto (te sukophantia), kai diorthosan (tis praxeis tous), tote (mporeite na dekhteite te marturia tous s' alla themata), pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou kategoroun tis gunaikes tous gia moikheia, kai den ekhoun martures para mono ton eauto tous, tha prepei na dosei o kathenas ap' autous, tesseris katatheseis, orkizomenos sto Onoma tou Allakh, oti einai eilikrines,
kai sten pempte (katathese na pei) oti as pesei e katara tou Allakh s' auton, an einai pseutes.
Alla tha apotrepsei apo ten idia ten timoria (tes moikheias), to na dosei tesseris katatheseis orkizomene sto Onoma tou Allakh, oti autos (o andras tes) einai pseutes,
kai sten pempte (katathese na pei) oti as pesei e Orge tou Allakh pano tes, an autos (o andras tes) einai eilikrines.

An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh se sas (o, anthropoi), kai oti o Allakh einai Taouamp (Autos pou sugkhorei kai apodekhetai te metameleia) kai Khakeim (Pansophos), (tha epispeude ten timoria se sas).

Pragmati, autoi pou epheran to psema [enantia tes suzugou tou Prophete, tes meteras ton piston, AIsa, pou khatheke apo to strato, kai te breke o Saphouan mpin Al-Mouatal, -pou ton ebale o Prophetes piso apo ton strato na brei ta khamena antikeimena-. Kai o opoios tes edose ten kamela tou kathos autos perpatouse odegontas ten kamela, mekhri te Mantina, khoris na tes milesei, oute mia lexe], einai mia omada apo sas (opos o epikephales ton upokriton, o Ampnt Allakh mpin Oumpai mpin Saloul pou tous sukophantese, kai oi treis pou epanelaban te sukophantia tou kai epeita straphekan me metameleia, o Khassan mpin Thampit, e Khamna mpinet Tzakhs, o Mistakh mpin Outhatha). Me nomizete oti auto (to psema pou epheran) einai kako gia sas, alla einai kalo gia sas (gia na phanoun oi alethinoi pistoi). Gia kathenan tous (e timoria gia) auto pou phortotheke apo (ekeine) ten amartia. Kai ekeinos (o mpin Saloul) pou ekhei phortothei me to megalutero meros ekeines tes amartias (kai xekinese aute te sukophantia), gi' auton tha uparkhei ena tromero marturio (ste Mellousa Zoe).

Tha eprepe otan ten akousate (te sukophantia), na pisteuan oi pistoi kai oi pistes gia ton eauto tous to kalo (del. ten athooteta tes meteras ton piston, tes AIsa, kai tou eusebe suntrophou, Saphouan mpin Al-Mouatal), kai na elegan: <<Auto einai ena xekatharo psema.>> [Opos ekane o Ampou Aioump Al-Ansari otan ton rotese e suzugo tou an akouse gia te sukophantia, tes eipe: <<Nai! Pragmati auto einai psema. Tha ekanes pote kati tetoio;>> Tou eipe: <<Okhi.>> Tes eipe: <<Ma ton Allakh! E AIsa einai kalutere apo sena!>>].
Tha ephernan tesseris martures gi' auto (to psema); An den phernoun tous martures (kai pote de tha tous pheroun), tote ekeinoi einai enopion tou Allakh, oi pseutes.

(O, eseis oi treis pou epanalabate ta logia tou upokrite, mpin Saloul), an den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh se sas sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe (oti dekhteke te metameleia sas), tha eikhe pesei se sas mia megale timoria gi' auto pou eipate.

Otan to perasate (to psema) apo te mia glossa sten alle, kai eipate me ta stomata sas, auto gia to opoio den ekhete kamia gnose (oute to epaletheusate), kai nomizate (oti to na to peite) auto, einai kati aplo (kai gia to opoio de tha phortotheite me amarties), eno auto einai enopion tou Allakh, kati teratodes!
Tha eprepe otan to akousate, na legate: <<Den epitrepetai se mas na milesoume me kati tetoio! Doxa Soi (o, Allakh)! Auto (pou eipan gia te metera ton piston) einai ena teratodes psema!>>
Sas apagoreuei o Allakh na epanalabete pote mia tetoia praxe, an eiste pragmati pistoi.
Kai diasaphenizei o Allakh ta Edaphia (pou periekhoun tous kanones kai tis nouthesies Tou), kai o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou tous aresei na diadidontai sukophanties gia tous pistous apodidontas tous epaiskhuntes praxeis, tha laboun mia odunere timoria sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei kai eseis de gnorizete.

An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh se sas (oti dekhteke te metameleia sas, o, eseis oi treis, pou epanalabate ta logia tou upokrite, mpin Saloul), kai oti o Allakh einai Ra'ouph (Poluepieikes) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos), (tha epispeude ten timoria se sas).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men akoloutheite ta bemata tou Satana. Giati opoios akolouthei ta bemata tou Satana (as mathei oti), autos (o Satanas) diatazei tis epaiskhuntes kai tis apagoreumenes praxeis. An den etan e khare kai to eleos tou Allakh se sas (oti dekhetai te metameleia sas), kaneis apo sas de tha eikhe exagnistei pote (apo tis amarties tou). Alla o Allakh exagnizei opoion thelei, kai o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Den prepei ekeinoi oi gennaiodoroi kai eukatastatoi anamesa sas (del. o Ampou Mpakr As-Sinteik, o pateras tes AIsa), na orkizontai oti de tha dosoun eleemosune stous suggeneis, tous aporous kai tous metanastes sto dromo tou Allakh [del. ston Mistakh mpin Outhatha, pou etan o xaderphos tou, kai etan phtokhos, kai metanastepse apo te Makka pros te Mantina. O Ampou Mpakr tou edose eleemosune taktika, mekhri pou akouse oti epanelabe ta logia tou mpin Saloul gia ten kore tou. Etsi, orkisteke na men tou xanadosei]. As sugkhoresoun kai as parablepsoun! Den epithumeite o Allakh na sas sugkhoresei; Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou sukophantoun (gia aiskhres praxeis), tis agnes, pistes gunaikes, pou stis kardies tous pote de skephtontai kati tetoio, einai kataramenoi kai sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai tha ekhoun ena tromero marturio.
Ten Emera pou oi glosses, ta kheria kai ta podia tous tha marturesoun enantion tous gia osa ekanan.

Ekeine ten Emera, o Allakh tha tous dosei te dikaie timoria tous, kai tha xeroun oti o Allakh einai o Al-Khakk (o Enas Alethinos Theos), o Al-Moumpein (Autos pou diasaphenise ten aletheia, kai tou Opoiou e Uparxe kai e Theoteta phainetai xekathara meso ton Semadion Tou sto sumpan).

Oi kakes (lexeis kai sukophanties) einai apo tous kakous (anthropous), kai oi kakoi (anthropoi) einai autoi pou lene tis kakes (lexeis kai sukophanties), kai oi kales (lexeis) einai apo tous kalous (anthropous), kai oi kaloi (anthropoi) einai autoi pou lene tis kales (lexeis). Ekeinoi (oi kaloi anthropoi) einai athooi apo osa lene (oi sukophantes gi' autous). Tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai gennaiodora agatha.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men mpeite s' alla spitia pera apo ta spitia sas, mekhri na zetesete ten adeia (eisodou) kai na khairetesete tous katoikous tous. Auto einai kalutero gia sas, isos na labete nouthesia.

Ean de breite kanenan mesa tous, men eiselthete mesa tous mekhri na sas dothei e adeia. Ean eipotheke se sas: <<Guriste piso>>, tote guriste piso. Auto einai pio agno gia sas. Kai o Allakh einai gia o,ti kanete, Pantognostes.

Den uparkhei amartia se sas an mpeite se akatoiketa spitia, sta opoia uparkhei kapoio ophelos gia sas (opos ta demosia katalumata gia tous odoiporous klp.). Kai o Allakh gnorizei o,ti phaneronete kai o,ti krubete.

Pes (o, Prophete) stous pistous na khamelonoun ta blemmata tous (apo to na koitaxoun otidepote apagoreuetai) kai na phulassoun ten agnoteta tous. Auto einai agnotero gi' autous. Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei pleros ola osa kanoun.

Kai pes stis pistes na khamelonoun ta blemmata tous (apo to na koitaxoun otidepote apagoreuetai), na phulassoun ten agnoteta tous, na men epideiknuoun ta stolidia tous, -ektos ap' auta pou einai emphane (opos ta semna endumata)-, na kaluptoun me ta kalummata tou kephaliou (te Mantila e to Khimar) kai ta stethe tous, na me deikhnoun ta stolidia tous, -para mono stous suzugous, tous pateres, tous pateres ton suzugon, tous gious, tous gious ton suzugon, tous adelphous, tous gious ton adelphon, tis Mousoulmanes gunaikes, kai tous sklabous tous, kai tous andres pou tis akolouthoun kai den ekhoun kamia epithumia gia gunaikes (opos tous trelous pou anazetoun phageto), e ta paidia pou den xeroun akoma tipota gia ta idiotika mere ton gunaikon- kai na men badizoun baria gia na me matheutoun ta krupha tous stolidia (opos ta kosmemata tou astragalou). Strapheite loipon, oloi sas, o, pistoi, pros ton Allakh me metameleia, mepos kai epitukhete.

Pantrepste tous anupantrous anamesa sas, kai tous eusebeis apo tous sklabous kai tis sklabes sas. An einai phtokhoi, o Allakh tha tous parekhei apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Ouasi' (Autos tou Opoiou to eleos kai e gennaiodoria eparkei gia olous) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Ekeinoi omos pou de briskoun ta mesa gia gamo, as phulaxoun ten agnoteta tous, mekhri o Allakh na tous parekhei apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Osoi apo tous doulous sas, zetoun mia sumbase (apeleutheroses, me to na sas dosoun kapoio poso), tha prepei na tous te dosete, an gnorizete oti ekhoun kalosune (kai ikanoteta na doulepsoun kai na to plerosoun), kai doste tous apo ta ploute tou Allakh, pou parekhei se sas. Men exanagkazete tis doules sas sten porneia, oi opoies epithumoun ten agnoteta, (opos o epikephales ton upokriton, o Ampnt Allakh mpin Oumpai mpin Saloul, pou exanagkase te Mousaika, sten porneia para te thelese tes), kai epidiokete (m' auto) ta kerde tes egkosmias zoes. Opoios tis exanagkazei (sten porneia), tote meta apo tetoio exanagkasmo, o Allakh einai (gi' autes) Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos), (ephoson etan exanagkasmenes, kai ekeinos pou tis exanagkase tha koubalesei tis amarties).

Pragmati, sas steilame (xekathara) Edaphia pou diasaphenizoun (ten aletheia), kai paradeigmata ekeinon (ton ethnon) pou perasan prin apo sas, kai mia nouthesia gi' ekeinous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).

O Allakh einai to Phos ton ouranon kai tes ges (o Opoios kathodegei opoious thelei). To paradeigma tou Photos Tou (del. tes kathodegeses kai tou Bibliou Tou -to Kor'an- sten kardia enos pistou) einai san mia esokhe se enan toikho, e opoia ekhei mia lampa (ladiou), e lampa einai se ena lampogualo [del. e esokhe einai to stethos tou pistou, e lampa einai to Kor'an kai e piste, kai to lampogualo einai e kardia tou pistou. Etsi to phos sugkentronetai sten esokhe kai de khanetai]. To lampogualo (apo to phos kai ten omorphia tou) einai san na etan ena photeino asteri. Photizetai (e lampa) apo (to ladi pou bgainei apo) mia eulogemene elia, pou den einai oute tes Anatoles oute tes Duses (del. ten blepei o elios ole ten emera, otan anatellei kai otan duei). To ladi tes (elias) skhedon tha elampe, akome kai an den to aggize e photia [etsi einai ta Semadia tou Allakh, tha ta katalabaine o pistos akoma kai an o Allakh den ta epibebaione perissotero sto Kor'an]. Phos pano sto phos. O Allakh kathodegei sto Phos Tou opoious thelei. O Allakh parousiazei ta paradeigmata gia tous anthropous, kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.
(Auto to Phos) einai se oikous (tzamia) pou o Allakh ekhei diataxei na khtistoun, kai na exumneitai to Onoma Tou mesa tous. Ton doxazoun (stis proseukhes) mesa tous (sta tzamia) proi kai bradu,

andres pou den tous apaskholei kanena emporio e kamia agorapolesia apo to na exumnoun ton Allakh, na teloun ten proseukhe, e na parekhoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune). Phobountai apo mia Emera, kata ten opoia tha straphoun epaneilemmena oi kardies (metaxu tes elpidas na sothoun kai tou phobou gia ten timoria), kai ta matia (koitazontas pros poion proorismo tha pane).

(Eprattan tis proanapheromenes kales praxeis) gia na tous antameipsei o Allakh sumphona me tis kales praxeis tous, kai na tous dosei akoma perissotera apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh parekhei se opoious thelei khoris metrese (aperiorista).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, oi praxeis tous einai san antikatoptrismos se mia pediada, pou ton nomizei enas dipsasmenos os nero, mekhris otou na ton phtasei, kai na brei oti einai tipota. (Etsi o apistos otan phtasei sto thanato, briskei oti oi praxeis tou einai mataies), kai tha brei ton Allakh ekei (ste Mellousa Zoe), kai tha tou dosei (o Allakh) ten timoria tou pleros. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros sto na kalei (tous doulous Tou) gia logodotese (kai sto na tous timoresei e na tous antameipsei gia tis praxeis tous).

E (oi praxeis ton apiston) einai san ta bathia skotadia sto butho mias bathias thalassas, o opoios (buthos) ekhei skepastei me kumata, kai apo pano tous uparkhoun kai alla kumata, kai apo pano tous uparkhoun (pukna kai skoteina) sunnepha (pou empodizoun to phos ton asterion). Bathia skotadia, to ena pano sto allo, pou an ebgaze kaneis to kheri tou, skhedon de tha to eblepe [kai etsi einai o apistos pou epese sta skotadia tes agnoias, tes amphibolias kai tes iskhurognomosunes]. Se opoion de dinei o Allakh phos (kathodegese kai gnose gia to Biblio Tou), de tha ekhei phos!

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti oloi osoi briskontai stous ouranous kai ste ge, doxazoun ton Allakh, epises (Ton doxazoun) kai ta poulia (pou petoun anamesa ston ourano kai ste ge) eno ta phtera tous einai anoikhta; O kathenas tous gnorizei (ton tropo gia) ten proseukhe tou kai te doxasia tou (pros ton Allakh). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia o,ti kanoun, Pantognostes.
Ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai ston Allakh einai o telikos proorismos.

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh kathodegei (me ten entole Tou) ta (mikra nea) sunnepha (opou thelei), epeita ta sugkentronei kai ta kanei ena soro, kai etsi blepeis te brokhe na bgainei apo mesa tous, kai (oti) stelnei apo ton ourano khalazi san ta bouna (sten posoteta), to opoio stelnei se opoion thelei kai to apomakrunei apo opoion thelei; Paraligo e lampse tou keraunou tous (ton sunnephon) na tuphlone tis oraseis!
O Allakh kanei te nukhta kai ten emera na diadekhontai e mia ten alle. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei mia nouthesia (kai ena Semadi) gi' ekeinous pou ekhoun matia.

O Allakh demiourgese kathe kinoumeno plasma apo nero. Kapoioi ap' autous kinountai me ten koilia tous, kai alloi perpatoun me duo podia kai alloi perpatoun me tessera (podia). O Allakh demiourgei o,ti thelei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
Pragmati, ekhoume steilei xekathara Edaphia (kai Semadia) pou diasaphenizoun (ton dromo tes aletheias), kai o Allakh kathodegei opoious thelei ston isio dromo.

(Oi upokrites) lene: <<Pisteuoume ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro kai upakoume.>> Epeita meta ap' auto, mia omada ap' autous apomakrunetai (apo to na dekhtei ten krise tou Aggeliaphorou). Tetoioi den einai oi pistoi.

Otan kalountai pros ton Allakh (del. sto Biblio Tou) kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, gia na krinei (o Aggeliaphoros) metaxu tous, mia omada ap' autous apomakrunetai. [Opos o Mpisr o upokrites pou eikhe diaphonia me enan Ebraio gia ena oikopedo, o Ebraios epemene na krinei metaxu tous o Aggeliaphoros Mokhammant, alla o Mpisr epemene na krinei kapoios allos, gnorizontas oti den eikhe dikio].
An omos xeroun oti ekhoun dikio (kai oti etsi o Aggeliaphoros tha ekrine uper tous), erkhontai s' auton me plere upakoe kai upotage (gia ten krise tou)!

Uparkhei arrostia stis kardies tous, e ekhoun amphibolia (oti o Mokhammant einai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh) e phobountai oti o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou tha tous adikesoun; Okhi (den phobountai oti tha tous adikesoun), alla pragmati ekeinoi einai oi adikoi!

Pragmati, ta logia ton piston otan kalountai pros ton Allakh (del. sto Biblio Tou) kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, gia na krinei (o Aggeliaphoros) metaxu tous, einai: <<Akoume kai upakououme.>> Pragmati, ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.
Opoios upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, kai phobatai ton Allakh kai phulassetai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou), tetoioi pragmati einai oi kerdismenoi.

(Oi upokrites) orkizontai ston Allakh me polu zelo stous orkous tous, oti an tous diataxeis, sigoura tha bgoun (mazi sou gia te makhe). Pes (o, Prophete): <<Men orkizeste! E (upotithemene) upakoe (sas) einai gnoste (oti einai mono logia khoris praxe). Pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete, ekhei plere gnose.>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous anthropous): <<Upakouste ton Allakh kai upakouste ton Aggeliaphoro.>> Alla an apomakrunontai, tote (o Prophetes) einai mono upeuthunos gi' auto pou tou anatetheke (del. to na metadosei to menuma tou Allakh) kai eseis eiste upeuthunoi gi' auto pou anatetheke se sas (del. to na upakousete). An ton upakousete, tha kathodegetheite. To kathekon tou Aggeliaphorou einai mono na metadosei (to menuma) xekathara.

O Allakh ekhei uposkhethei se osous apo sas pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, oti tha tous dosei duname na kuriarkhesoun ste ge, opos edose s' autous (tous pistous) pou etan prin ap' autous. Kai tha kanei te threskeia tous pou epelexe gi' autous, na kuriarkhesei, kai tha allaxei ten katastase tous, apo phobo se asphaleia. Tha Me latreuoun (khoris phobo apo tous ekhthrous tous), khoris na Mou apodidoun kanenan etairo ste latreia. [Etsi, o Prophetes kai oi pistoi nikesan tous eidololatres, kai eginan asphaleis meta apo to phobo tous]. Opoioi omos meta ap' auto ginontai akharistoi, ekeinoi einai pragmati oi anupakouoi.
Teleste (o, pistoi) ten proseukhe, doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai upakouste ton Aggeliaphoro, isos na eleetheite (apo ton Allakh).
Me nomizeis (o, Prophete) oti oi apistoi mporoun na xephugoun ste ge (apo ten timoria Mou). (Kai ste Mellousa Zoe) e katoikia tous tha einai e Photia. Ti athlios proorismos!

O, seis pou pisteuete! As zetesoun ten adeia sas (prin mpoun sto khoro sas) oi douloi sas, kai osoi anamesa sas den ekhoun phtasei sten ephebeia, se treis stigmes: Prin ten proseukhe Al-Phatzr (auges), kai otan bgazete ta roukha sas to mesemeri (gia xekourase), kai meta ten proseukhe Al-'Isa' (to bradu). Autes einai treis idiotikes stigmes gia sas, ektos ap' autes den uparkhei amartia se sas e s' autous. Trigurizoun sunekheia se sas, o enas ston allon. (Opos diasaphenise tous kanones tes adeias tes eisodou), etsi o Allakh diasaphenizei gia sas ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia kai tous kanones tes threskeias). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Otan ta paidia anamesa sas phtasoun sten ephebeia, as zetoun ten adeia sas (prin mpoun sto khoro sas, se oles tis stigmes) opos zetesan ten adeia ekeinoi (oi megaluteroi) prin ap' autous. (Opos diasaphenise tous kanones tes adeias tes eisodou) etsi o Allakh diasaphenizei gia sas ta Edaphia Tou (kai ta Semadia kai tous kanones tes threskeias Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Oso gia tis elikiomenes gunaikes (pou einai sten emmenopause), oi opoies den ekhoun pia epithumia gia gamo, den uparkhei amartia s' autes na bgaloun (ena meros apo) ta (exoterika) endumata tous (del. to Tzilmpamp, pou phorietai pano apo ta roukha kai pano apo to Khimar), khoris na deixoun ta stolidia tous. Alla to na me bgaloun ta (exoterika) endumata tous, einai kalutero gi' autes. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

[Otan kapoios pegainei sto Tzikhant aphenontas to kleidi tou spitiou tou s' allon, opos se enan tuphlo, koutso e arrosto gia na phaei, alla o teleutaios leei oti to spiti einai katapisteuma s' auton, kai den epitrepetai na phaei eremen tou idioktete, as mathei oti:] den uparkhei amartia ston tuphlo, ston koutso e ston arrosto, oute se sas (o, anthropoi): an trote sta spitia sas (del. ton paidion kai ton suzugon sas eremen tous), e tou patera e tes meteras sas, e ton adelphon sas, andron e gunaikon, e ton theion sas, andron e gunaikon -apo ten pleura tou patera e tes meteras sas-, e sta spitia (e stous kepous e stis apothekes) pou ekhete ta kleidia tous, e sta spitia ton philon sas, [ephoson kaneis apo tous parapano de delose oti den to epitrepei auto khoris ten adeia tou, kai ephoson trote mono auto pou sas arkei]. [Oso gi' autous pou ekhoun to ethimo na men trone mekhri na uparkhei kapoios na moirastei mazi tous to phageto] den uparkhei amartia se sas an trote me allous e monoi sas. Kai otan mpeite sta spitia, khaireteste o enas ton allon, me ena eulogemeno kai kalo khairetismo apo ton Allakh. Etsi diasaphenizei o Allakh ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia tes threskeias) gia sas, isos na sullogisteite.

Pragmati, oi alethinoi pistoi einai ekeinoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, kai otan briskontai mazi tou (ton Aggeliaphoro) gia kapoio koino thema (gia to ophelos ton Mousoulmanon), de pheugoun mekhri na tou zetesoun ten adeia. Pragmati, ekeinoi pou zetoun ten adeia sou (o, Prophete), einai autoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou. Etsi, otan zetoun ten adeia sou (na phugoun) gia kapoio (idiotiko) thema tous, dose ten adeia se opoion theleis ap' autous, kai zeta te sugkhorese tou Allakh gi' autous (gia tis amarties tous). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

(O, eseis pou pisteuete)! Men kanete to kalesma tou Aggeliophorou anamesa sas (otan sas kalei), opos otan kalei o enas sas ton allon (pou mporei na phugei khoris ten adeia tou kalounta), (kai men kaleite ton Prophete me to onoma tou legontas <<o, Mokhammant>>, opos kalei o enas sas ton allon me to onoma tou, alla kaleste ton legontas <<o, Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh>>). Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei ekeinous anamesa sas pou pheugoun krupha krubomenoi piso ap' allous [opos tous upokrites pou ephugan krupha, kata to skapsimo tou khantakiou, kai kata to kerugma tes Paraskeues]. As prosekhoun, loipon, osoi parakoun ten entole tou (tou Prophete, e tou Allakh, to na me phugoun khoris adeia), mepos kai pesei pano tous mia dokimasia (kai kakoukhies) e tous plexei ena odunero marturio (ste Mellousa Zoe).

Pragmati, ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste ge. Kserei oles tis katastaseis sas (apo kalo kai kako, kai xerei oles tis praxeis sas). Ten Emera pou tha epistrepsoun (oi anthropoi) s' Auton, tha tous enemerosei gia o,ti ekanan. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.
Upsistos einai Autos pou esteile ston doulo Tou (ton Mokhammant) to Kriterio (to Kor'an, pou diakhorizei ten aletheia apo ten plane), gia na ginei proeidopoietes gia olo ton kosmo.

Autos ston Opoion anekei to Basileio (kai e Kuriarkhia) ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai den apektese kanenan uio, oute ekhei kanenan etairo sto Basileio Tou. Demiourgese kathe pragma, kai kathorise te demiourgia tou me akribeia (sumphona me tis katalleles analogies tou).

Ekeinoi (oi eidololatres) ekhoun parei allous theous ektos apo Auton (gia latreia), oi opoioi (legomenoi theoi) den mporoun na demiourgesoun tipota, eno einai oi idioi demiourgemenoi. Den mporoun na apotrepsoun apo ton eauto tous kanena kako, oute na ophelesoun ton eauto tous! Den mporoun na aphairesoun kamia zoe, oute na dosoun kamia zoe, oute na anastesoun tous nekrous.

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene: <<Auto (to Kor'an) den einai para ena psema pou to kataskeuase (o Mokhammant), kai ton boethesan s' auto alloi anthropoi.>> Pragmati, (oi apistoi) epinoesan (m' auta pou eipan) mia adikia kai ena teratodes psema!
Kai lene (oi apistoi): <<(Auto to Kor'an) einai oi muthoi ton arkhaion, pou tous egrapse (o Mokhammant), kai ston opoion tous upagoreuoun proi kai bradu.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, to ekhei steilei (to Kor'an) Autos pou gnorizei o,ti einai mustiko (e krupho) stous ouranous kai ste ge. Pragmati, Autos einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>

Kai lene (oi apistoi): <<Pos einai dunaton autos (pou iskhurizetai oti einai) o Aggeliaphoros (tou Allakh), na troei phageto kai na perpata stis agores (gia na agorasei phageto opos emeis); An stelnotan enas Aggelos s' auton gia na einai proeidopoietes mazi tou, (tote tha ton pisteuame)!
E an tou dinotan enas thesauros, e eikhe enan kepo apo ton opoio tha etroge, (tote tha ton pisteuame)!>> Oi adikoi eipan: <<St' aletheia, den akoloutheite, para enan magemeno andra.>>

Koita (o, Mokhammant) pos apodidoun se sena tis (paraloges) perigraphes (legontas oti epinoeses to Kor'an kai oti eisai magemenos, klp.)! Kai etsi, (logo autou pou eipan) ekhoun parastratesei kai de tha mporesoun na phtasoun sto dromo (tes aletheias).

Eulogemenos einai Autos, pou an ethele, tha sou edine kalutera pragmata ap' auta (pou proteinan oi apistoi), (tha sou edine sten egkosmia zoe) kepous kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta dentra tous) reoun potamia (gia na phas apo tous karpous tous me anese), kai tha sou edine palatia (gia na katoikeseis mesa se eudaimonia).

Okhi (de se diapseudoun epeide tros phageto kai perpatas stis agores), alla diapseudoun ten Ora (ten Emera tes Kriseos), kai gi' autous pou diapseudoun ten Ora, ekhoume etoimasei mia phlegomene Photia!
Otan (e Photia) tha tous dei (tous apistous) apo makria, tha akousoun ten orge kai to brukhethmo tes.

Otan rikhtoun (oi apistoi) se ena polu steno khoro mesa tes (Photias), me ta kheria tous na einai demena (stous laimous), tha phonaxoun ekei: <<Alimono mas (makari na katastraphoume, gia na teleiosei to marturio)>>!
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Me phonaxete Semera <<alimono mas>> mono mia phora, alla phonaxte to polles phores!>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous): <<Einai auto (to proanapheromeno marturio) kalutero e o Paradeisos tes aioniotetas, pou ekhei uposkhethei stous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou);>> O opoios (Paradeisos) tha einai gi' autous os antamoibe kai telikos proorismos.
Tha ekhoun ekei (ston Paradeiso) o,ti epithumoun, kai tha parameinoun ekei gia panta. Aute einai mia uposkhese apo ton Kurio sou, pou oposdepote tha ulopoiethei.

Ten Emera pou tha tous sugkentrosei (tous apistous) mazi m' ekeinous pou tous latreuan ektos tou Allakh, tha pei (o Allakh stous legomenous theous, os epiplexe gia tous apistous): <<Esastan eseis pou paraplanesate tous doulous Mou autous (diatazontas tous na sas latreuoun), e oi idioi ekhoun parastratesei monoi tous apo ton isio dromo (latreuontas sas apo monoi tous);>>

Tha poun: <<Doxa Soi (o, Allakh, eisai polu Anoteros apo to na ekheis etairous)! Den etan prepon gia mas (del. gia olous tous demiourgemenous) na paroume ektos apo Esena kanenan allon theo. Alla (oi eidololatres to ekanan aphou) pareikhes agatha s' autous kai stous progonous tous, ospou xekhasan ten exumnese Sou (kai o,ti esteiles stous Aggeliaphorous), kai etan anthropoi pou katastraphekan.>>

Etsi, (oi legomenoi theoi sas, o, eidololatres) sas diepseusan s' auto pou iskhuristekate (oti ekeinoi einai pou sas kalesan na tous latrepsete). Kai etsi de tha mporesete na apotrepsete (ten timoria), oute na uposterixete ton eauto sas. Opoios apo sas (o, anthropoi) adikei (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia), tha ton kanoume na geutei ena megalo marturio.

De steilame kanenan Aggeliaphoro prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) pou na men ephagan phageto kai na men perpatousan stis agores. Kaname kapoious apo sas (o, anthropoi) na einai dokimasia gia tous allous (dinontas tous plouto, ugeia, paidia klp. gia na sas dokimasoume) an tha deixete upomone (e okhi)! Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) blepei ta panta.

Ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun ste sunantese Mas (ten Emera tes Kriseos), lene: <<An stelnontousan se mas oi Aggeloi e blepame ton Kurio mas, (tha eikhame pistepsei).>> Pragmati, eginan polu alazonikoi mesa tous (m' auta pou eipan) kai parabiasan polu ta oria.

Ten emera pou tha doun tous Aggelous (otan pethanoun, stous taphous kai ste Mellousa Zoe), de tha uparxoun ekeine ten emera kharmosuna nea gia tous kakous (apistous)! (Oi Aggeloi) tha poun: <<Apagoreuontai entelos (opoiadepote kharmosuna nea) gia sas.>>
Kai o,ti ekanan apo (kales) praxeis, tis kaname diasparta aioroumena somatidia skones.
Oi anthropoi tou Paradeisou ekeine ten Emera, tha ekhoun ten kalutere katoikia kai to kalutero meros anapauses.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ten Emera pou o ouranos tha skhistei kai tha phanoun (apo ta anoigmata tou) aspra sunnepha kai oi Aggeloi tha staloun kato diadokhika.
E alethine Kuriarkhia ekeine ten Emera, anekei ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), kai tha einai mia duskole Emera gia tous apistous.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ekeine ten Emera pou o adikos tha dagkosei ta kheria tou (metaniomenos), legontas: <<Makari na eikha parei mazi me ton Aggeliaphoro enan dromo (pros te soteria)!
Alimono mou! Makari na men eikha parei ton tade os steno philo!
Me paresure (o apistos philos mou makria) apo ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) aphou mou ephtase (meso tou Prophete).>> Pragmati, o Satanas panta prodidei ton anthropo.
O Aggeliaphoros tha pei (ekeine ten Emera): <<O, Kurie mou! O laos mou ekhei egkataleipsei auto to Kor'an.>>

(O, Aggeliaphore, opos se eblapsan kai se diepseusan oi eidololatres), Etsi kaname gia kathe Prophete, na uparkhoun ekhthroi apo tous kakous (tous apistous). Eparkei o Kurios sou gia na kathodegesei kai na uposterixei (esena enanti ton apiston).

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene: <<An tou eikhe stalei (ston Mokhammant) to Kor'an oloklero se mia phora, (tote tha pisteuame).>> Etsi (to steilame) gia na dunamosoume ten kardia sou m' auto, kai to steilame stadiaka (kai to exegesame xekathara).
De tha parousiasoun se sena ena paradeigma (gia na se diapseusoun), ektos na steiloume meta se sena ten aletheia (pou tha tous apantesei), kai ten kalutere exegese.
Ekeinoi pou tha surthoun me ta prosopa tous pros ten Kolase, tha ekhoun ton kheirotero topo, kai ton pio parastratemeno dromo.
Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio kai kaname ton adelpho tou, ton Aaron, na einai mazi tou os uposteriktes.
Eipame (ston Mouse kai ton Aaron): <<Pegainete stous anthropous pou diepseusan ta Semadia Mas.>> (Alla tous diepseusan) kai etsi tous katastrepsame oloskheros.
Epises oi anthropoi tou Noe, otan diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous, tous pnixame, kai tous kaname gia tous anthropous os Semadi (tes Dunames Mas). Kai etoimasame gia tous adikous ena odunero marturio.
Epises (katastrepsame) te phule 'Ant kai te phule Thamount, kai tous anthropous tou Pegadiou, kai polla alla ethne metaxu tous.

Sto kathena (ap' ekeina ta ethne) dosame ta paradeigmata (ton proegoumenon apiston pou katastrepsame, kai steilame sto kathena ta Semadia kai ta epikheiremata), kai katastrepsame entelos to kathena (aphou arnetheke ten piste).

Pragmati, (oi eidololatres apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant) ekhoun perasei (sta taxidia tous) apo ten pole (Sodoma) pou epese pano tes mia tromere brokhe (apo petres, logo tes omophulophilias kai tes apistias tes). Den ten ekhoun dei (gia na laboun mia nouthesia); Alla den pisteuoun sten anastase!
Otan se blepoun (o, Prophete), de se pairnoun para mono gia khleuasmo (legontas): <<Einai autos pou esteile o Allakh os Aggeliaphoro;

Tha mas eikhe skhedon parasurei makria apo tous theous mas, an den emastan toso statheroi ste latreia tous.>> Pragmati, tha mathoun otan tha doun ten timoria, poios brisketai ston paraplanemeno dromo!

Eides (o, Prophete) ekeinon pou pairnei ten epithumia (kai tous pothous) tou os theo tou! Tha eisai esu, o phulakas s' auton (apotrepontas ton apo ten apistia kai anagkazontas ton na pistepsei); [Okhi, aphou e euthune sou einai mono na proeidopoieseis xekathara].

E nomizeis (o, Prophete) oti oi perissoteroi ap' ekeinous akoun e katanooun; Ekeinoi den einai para opos ta booeide (de sullogizontai), pragmati einai kai pio parastratemenoi sto dromo (apo ta booeide)!

De blepeis (o, Prophete) pos o Kurios sou epekteinei te skia (me ten kinese tes ges kai tou eliou); An ethele, tha ten ekane stathere. Epeita kaname ton elio na einai e endeixe gia tis katastaseis tes (skias, e o odegos tes).
Epeita ten trabame stadiaka pros Emas.
Einai Autos pou ekane gia sas te nukhta os enduma (gia na sas kaluptei), kai ton upno gia anapause, kai ekane ten emera gia na skorpizeste stis enaskholeseis sas.
Einai Autos pou stelnei tous anemous, os kharmosuna nea prin to eleos Tou (te brokhe). Kai stelnoume apo ton ourano katharo nero,
gia na dosoume zoe m' auto (to nero) se mia nekre ge, kai na kanoume na pioun ap' auto (polloi) ap' auta pou demiourgesame: polla booeide kai pollous anthropous.

Pragmati, to moirazoume (to nero) anamesa tous (stelnontas te brokhe se mia ge kai okhi sten alle, kai to antitheto), oste na laboun (oi anthropoi) nouthesia, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi epimenoun sten akharistia tous.
An thelame, tha eikhame steilei se kathe pole enan proeidopoiete.
Etsi, men upakouseis (o, Prophete) tous apistous (pou zetoun na kaneis parakhoreseis ste threskeia), alla agonisou m' auto (to Kor'an) apenanti tous (metadidontas to) me te megiste prospatheia.

Einai Autos pou ekane ta duo nera (tou potamou kai tes thalassas) na eiskhoresoun to ena sto allo: to ena einai eugeusto kai gluko, kai to allo einai almuro kai pikro. Kai ekane anamesa tous ena phragma kai plere diakhorismo. [Opos otan to nero enos potamou eiskhoresei se mia thalassa, den allazei ten almuroteta tes, oute to antistropho, alla apokta tis idies perigraphes tes thalassas].

Einai Autos pou demiourgese anthropous (andres kai gunaikes) apo to nero (del. apo tis anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon), kai ekane metaxu tous (ton anthropon) desmous suggeneias katagoges kai desmous suggeneias gamou. Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) einai Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta).

Ostoso, (oi apistoi) latreuoun ektos apo ton Allakh, auta pou den mporoun oute na tous ophelesoun, oute na tous blapsoun! Pragmati, o apistos akolouthei (ton Satana kai ton uposterizei se) o,ti dusarestei ton Kurio tou.
De se steilame (o, Prophete) para mono os phorea kharmosunon neon kai proeidopoiete.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<De zeto apo sas kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo to Menuma), ektos kai an kapoios thelei na parei ena monopati pros ton Kurio tou (tote as xodepsei sto dromo Tou).>>

Empisteusou (o, Prophete) ton Al-Khai (ton Aionia Zontano) pou den pethainei pote, kai doxase Ton epainontas Ton. Pragmati, eparkei Autos os Khampeir (Autos pou ekhei plere gnose) gia tis amarties ton doulon Tou.

O Opoios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous se exi Emeres, epeita upsotheke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei sten Megaloprepeia Tou). Ar-Rakhman (o Panteleemonas)! Rota loipon (o, Prophete) Auton pou ekhei plere gnose ton panton, gi' Auton.

Otan tous legetai (stous eidololatres): <<Peste se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) enopion tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona)>>, lene: <<Poios einai o Ar-Rakhman; Na pesoume se Sitzount stase gi' Auton pou mas diatazeis esu;>> Kai tous odegei (to kalesma tou, to na latreuoun ton Ar-Rakhman), se megalutere apostrophe (apo ten piste).
Upsistos einai Autos pou topothetese ston ourano megala asteria (kai asterismous), kai topothetese s' auton enan lamptera (ton elio pou einai pege photos kai thermotetas) kai ena photeino pheggari.
Einai Autos pou ekane te nukhta kai ten emera na diadekhetai e mia ten alle, gia opoion thelei na to labei upopse, e thelei na ginei eugnomon (gia tis khares tou Allakh).

Oi (enaretoi) douloi tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) einai ekeinoi pou perpatoun ste ge me esukho tropo kai tapeinophrosune (kai okhi me turannia kai alazoneia), kai otan oi anoetoi tous apeuthunontai (me askhema e anoeta logia), apantoun me kalosune (kai ortha logia).
Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) pernoun meros tes nukhtas sten proseukhe pros ton Kurio tous, me to na pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) kai me to na stekontai (sten proseukhe tous).
Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) lene: <<Kurie mas! Apomakrune apo mas to marturio tes Kolases. Pragmati, to marturio tes einai monimo (kai den aphenei opoion mpei mesa tes).
Pragmati, aute (e Kolase) einai polu athlia os topos diamones kai katoikias.>>
Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) otan xodeuoun de spataloun, oute tsigkouneuontai, alla teroun metriopathe tropo metaxu tous.

Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) den epikalountai ektos apo ton Allakh kanenan allon theo, oute skotonoun kamia psukhe, gia ten opoia o Allakh apagorepse opoiadepote epithese enantion tes, ektos gia dikaious logous (an to dikaio to apaitei, opos ten psukhe enos dolophonou), oute diaprattoun moikheia. Kai opoios kanei kati ap' auta, tha labei ten timoria (ten Emera tes Kriseos).
To marturio tha diplasiastei gi' auton ten emera tes Anastases, kai tha meinei s' auto (to marturio) atimasmenos gia panta.

Ektos ap' auton pou (sten egkosmia zoe) ekhei straphei me eilikrine metameleia pros ton Allakh, kai pistepse (ston Allakh) kai ekane kales praxeis, gi' autous tous anthropous o Allakh tha antikatastesei tis kakes praxeis tous me kales praxeis. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakhem (Polueusplakhnos).
Opoios strephetai me metameleia pros ton Allakh kai kanei enaretes praxeis, pragmati, ekhei straphei me eilikrine metameleia pros ton Allakh.

Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) den pareuriskontai opou legetai to psema (e plane, ta tragoudia kai oi giortes ton eidololatron, oute dinoun pseude marturia), kai otan pernane kai akoune mataia logia (e blepoun mia mataie praxe, e plane), pernane khoris na emplekontai s' auta.
Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) otan tous nouthetoun me ta Edaphia tou Kuriou tous, de ginontai kouphoi kai tuphloi pros auta.

Kai oi opoioi (enaretoi) lene: <<Kurie mas! Kharise mas apo tous suzugous mas kai ta paidia mas, auto pou na einai pege kharas ton mation mas (otan tous blepoume na Se upakoun kai na Se latreuoun), kai kane emas na eimaste ena kalo paradeigma gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Sou, terontas tis entoles Sou).>>

Ekeinoi (pou ekhoun tis proanapheromenes perigraphes ton enareton) einai autoi pou tha antameiphthoun me ta upsela epipeda (ston Paradeiso) gia o,ti epemeinan karterika, kai tha laboun ekei khairetismous (apo tous Aggelous) kai tha ekhoun asphaleia (apo kathe kako),
Tha meinoun ekei gia panta. Ti exairetikos einai autos (o Paradeisos) os topos diamones kai katoikias!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ti na kanei o Kurios mou me sas (o, anthropoi, kai ti axia na ekhete enopion Tou), an den uperkhe e epiklese (kai e latreia) sas pros Auton; Alla eseis (o, apistoi) diapseusate, kai etsi (e timoria sas) tha einai anapopheukte gia sas.>>

T, S, M [Ta-Sein-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Auta einai ta Edaphia tou xekatharou Bibliou (pou diasaphenizei ten aletheia).
Isos tha katastrephes ton eauto sou apo te thlipse (o, Mokhammant, apo to poso prothumos gia ten kathodegese tous eisai), epeide de ginontai pistoi;
An thelame, tha eikhame steilei s' autous apo ton ourano ena Semadi, kai etsi tha emenan oi laimoi tous upotagmenoi me tapeinose pros auto.
Den tous erkhetai kamia nea apokalupse (kai nouthesia) apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), ektos na apostrephontai ap' auten.
Ekhoun diapseusei (auto pou staltheke apo ton Allakh), pragmati, tha tous erthoun ta nea autou pou koroideuan, (otan tha pesei pano tous e timoria).
De blepoun te ge, me posa kala eide phuton kaname na phutrosoun s' auten;
Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto ena Semadi (gia ten anastase), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den pisteuoun.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Kurios sou eipe ston Mouse: <<Pegaine stous adikous anthropous,
tous anthropous tou Pharao, (kai nouthetese tous), de tha phulakhtoun apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou);>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Phobamai na me diapseusoun,
kai etsi na stenepsei to stethos mou (apo te diapseuse tous) kai e glossa mou na pagosei, gi' auto steile (ten apokalupse kai) ston Aaron (kanontas ton Aggeliaphoro, na me uposterixei s' auto).
Kai ekhoun mia kategoria enantion mou (otan skotosa kata lathos me ena khtupema enan ap' autous, pou tsakotheke me enan apo ton lao mou), opote phobamai na me skotosoun.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Okhi (de tha se skotosoun)! Pegainete kai oi duo me ta Semadia Mas. Pragmati, Eimaste mazi sas (uposterizontas sas), akoume (ti tha peite kai ti tha poun).
Pegainete ston Pharao kai peite: <<Eimaste oi Aggeliaphoroi apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon,
(me te diatage) oti: steile mazi mas ta paidia tou Israel (Iakob).>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<De se megalosame (o, Mouse) os paidi anamesa mas, kai emeines mazi mas arketa khronia apo te zoe sou,
kai ekanes ekeine ten praxe pou ekanes (otan skotoses enan apo ton lao mou) kai esoun apo tous akharistous (gia tis khares mou se sena), (pos loipon iskhurizesai oti eisai Aggeliaphoros);>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Ekana tote ekeine (ten praxe), eno emoun ap' autous pou eikhan agnoia (del. kata lathos kai prin na erthei s' emena e apokalupse apo ton Allakh).
Etsi ephuga apo sas (pros te Madiam) otan phobetheka (oti tha me skotosete). Etsi, o Kurios mou mou kharise gnose (kai katanoese) kai me ekane enan apo tous Aggeliaphorous.
Einai aute mia khare pou mou te thumizeis: oti sklaboses ta paidia tou Israel;>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<Kai poios einai o Kurios olon ton kosmon;>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Einai o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous, an eiste bebaioi (kai ekhete statheres kardies pou psakhnoun gia ten aletheia)!>>
(O Pharao) eipe (eironika) se ekeinous pou briskontai guro tou: <<Den akousate (ti eipe, oti uparkhei allos Kurios ektos apo mena);>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Einai o Kurios sas kai o Kurios ton progonon sas.>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<(Autos pou iskhurizetai oti einai) o Aggeliaphoros sas pou ekhei stalei se sas, pragmati, einai paraphron!>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Einai o Kurios tes Anatoles kai tes Duses kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous, an ekhete muala pou katanooun kai sullogizontai!>>
(O Pharao) eipe (ston Mouse): <<An pairneis allo theo ektos apo mena, tha se kano apo tous phulakismenous.>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Akoma kai an sou phero mia xekathare apodeixe;>>
(O Pharao) eipe: <<Pherten, an eisai pragmati apo tous eilikrineis!>>
Etsi, petaxe (o Mouses) to rabdi tou, kai etsi metatrapeke se ena megalo phidi, (orato se olous).
Kai (ebale to kheri tou sto anoigma tou endumatos tou sto stethos tou, kai epeita) trabexe to kheri tou, kai bgeke (to kheri tou) lampero leuko mprosta stous theates.
(O Pharao) eipe stous arkhegous guro tou (suzetontas mazi tous): <<Autos einai pragmati enas magos me kale gnose!
Epidiokei na sas dioxei apo te ge sas. Poia einai e apopse sas loipon;>>
Eipan: <<Kathusterese ton kai ton adelpho tou, kai steile stis poleis ekeinous pou tha mazepsoun (tous magous).
Tha sou pheroun kathe mago pou ekhei kale gnose.>>
Etsi sugkentrothekan oi magoi gia mia prokathorismene ora (tes sunanteses to proi) se mia prokathorismene emera (tes giortes).
Kai eipotheke stous anthropous: <<Tha erthete ste sugkentrose,
gia na akolouthesoume tous magous (kai na doume oti e threskeia mas einai e alethine), an einai niketes;>>
Otan erthan oi magoi ston Pharao, eipan: <<Tha ekhoume mia antamoibe an tha eimaste emeis oi niketes;>>
Eipe: <<Nai, kai tha eiste tote ap' autous pou einai konta mou (se pseles theseis).>>
O Mouses tous eipe: <<Rixte auto pou tha rixete.>>
Etsi, erixan ta skhoinia kai ta rabdia tous, kai eipan (orkizomenoi): <<Ma te doxa tou Pharao! Emeis tha eimaste oi niketes!>>
Etsi, erixe kai o Mouses to rabdi tou, kai etsi (egine megalo phidi pou) katapie ola ta psemata pou edeixan.
Etsi, epesan oi magoi se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos).
Eipan (oi magoi): <<Pisteuoume ston Kurio olon ton kosmon,
ton Kurio tou Mouse kai tou Aaron.>>

(O Pharao) eipe: <<Pistepsate s' auton prin na sas doso ten adeia! Pragmati, autos (o Mouses) einai o aphentes sas pou sas didaxe te mageia! Sigoura tha deite: tha kopso ta kheria kai ta podia sas se antithetes pleures (del. to dexi kheri me to aristero podi e to antistropho) kai tha sas stauroso olous!>>
Eipan: <<Den mas blaptei (an kaneis auto pou mas apeileis), pragmati, ston Kurio mas tha epistrepsoume.
Elpizoume oti o Kurios mas tha mas sugkhoresei tis amarties mas, kathos eimaste oi protoi pistoi (ston Mouse apo ton lao sou).>>
Empneusame ston Mouse oti: <<Phuge te nukhta me tous doulous Mou. Pragmati, (o Pharao kai oi stratiotes tou) tha sas kunegesoun.>>
Etsi, o Pharao esteile stis poleis kapoious gia na mazepsoun to strato (gia na kunegesei ta paidia tou Israel pou ephugan).
(Kai eipe o Pharao): <<Autoi (ta paidia tou Israel) einai mia apekhthes omada kai einai ligoi,
oi opoioi mas ekhoun exorgisei,
alla eimaste oloi proetoimasmenoi (kai prosektikoi).>>
Etsi, tous bgalame (ton Pharao kai ton lao tou) apo (te ge tous pou eikhe) kepous kai peges,
kai thesaurous kai kalous topous sugkentroseon.
Etsi (opos bgalame ton Pharao kai ton lao tou apo autes tis eunoies), tis dosame sta paidia tou Israel (otan pegan sto Lebantes).
Etsi, (o Pharao kai o stratos tou) tous katadioxan (ta paidia tou Israel) me ten anatole tou eliou.
Otan oi duo omades eidan e mia ten alle, oi suntrophoi tou Mouse eipan: <<Sigoura tha mas prolaboun!>>
O Mouses eipe: <<Sigoura okhi! O Kurios mou einai mazi mou (me ten uposterixe Tou), tha me kathodegesei (sto dromo tes soterias).>>
Etsi, empneusame ton Mouse oti: <<Khtupa to nero me to rabdi sou>>, etsi khoristeke, kai kathe pleura egine san ena terastio bouno.
Kai pherame konta ekei tous allous (ton Pharao kai ton strato tou, pou mpekan sto dromo mesa sto nero).
Kai sosame ton Mouse kai olous osous etan mazi tou.
Epeita pnixame tous allous.
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Aphegesou (o, Prophete) s' autous (ston lao sou) ten istoria tou Abraam.
Otan eipe (o Abraam) ston patera tou kai ston lao tou: <<Ti einai auta pou latreuete;>>
Eipan: <<Latreuoume eidola, sta opoia eimaste aphosiomenoi ste latreia tous.>>
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Sas akoun otan tous epikaleiste,
e mporoun na sas ophelesoun e na sas blapsoun;>>
Eipan: <<Okhi, alla etsi brekame tous progonous mas na kanoun.>>
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Blepete auta pou latreuete,
eseis kai oi progonoi sas;
Pragmati, auta einai oi ekhthroi mou, ektos apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
O Opoios me demiourgese, kai einai Autos pou me kathodegei.
O Opoios einai Autos pou mou parekhei trophe kai nero.
Kai otan eimai arrostos, Autos einai pou me therapeuei.
O Opoios (einai Autos pou) tha aphairei te zoe mou (otan erkhetai e prokathorismene ora) kai epeita tha me pherei xana ste zoe (ten Emera tes Anastases).
O Opoios elpizo na sugkhoresei gia mena tis amarties mou, ten Emera tes Kriseos.>>
(O Abraam eipe): <<Kurie mou! Kharise mou gnose (kai orthe katanoese ste threskeia) kai enose me me tous enaretous (sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe).
Kane gia mena na uparkhei mia uperokhe epainese stis glosses ton metagenesteron geneon.
Kane me ap' autous pou tha mpoun ston Paradeiso tes Eudaimonias.
Sugkhorese ton patera mou, pragmati, einai apo tous parastratemenous.
Kai me me atimaseis (me ten timoria) ten Emera pou tha anastethoun oloi,
ten Emera opou de tha ophelesei (kanenan) oute o ploutos (tou pou to mazepse sten egkosmia zoe), oute oi gioi (tou, pou ton uposterixan sten egkosmia zoe),
ektos ap' ekeinon pou tha erthei ston Allakh me kathare kardia (kathare apo ten apistia kai ten upokrisia, auton tha ophelesei e kathare kardia tou).>>
(Ekeine ten Emera) o Paradeisos tha erthei konta stous eusebeis (pou phulassontan sten egkosmia zoe apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou).
Kai e Kolase tha emphanistei xekathara stous paraplanemenous,
kai tha eipothei s' autous: <<Pou einai autoi pou latreuate,
ektos apo ton Allakh; Mporoun na sas uposterixoun, e akoma na uposterixoun ton eauto tous;>>
Etsi, tha petakhtoun o enas pano ston allo mesa tes (sten Kolase), epises kai autoi pou tous paraplanesan (kai oi diaboloi),
kai oi stratiotes tou Implis (Satana), oloi mazi.
(Oi eidololatres) tha poun eno malonoun mesa tes (mazi me o,ti latreuan ektos tou Allakh):
<<Ma ton Allakh! Briskomastan se phanere plane,
otan sas exisoname (ste latreia) me ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Kaneis de mas paraplanese ektos apo tous kakous (pou mas kalesan na latreuoume allous ektos tou Allakh).
Tora den ekhoume oute mesolabetes,
oute kanena steno philo.
An eikhame mono ten eukairia na epistrepsoume (sten egkosmia zoe), tha emastan anamesa stous pistous.>>
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Oi anthropoi apo ton lao tou Noe diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Noe).
Otan o adelphos tous, o Noe tous eipe: <<De tha phulasseste apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Pragmati, eimai enas axiopistos Aggeliophoros pros esas.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.>>
Eipan: <<Tha pistepsoume se sena eno se akolouthoun oi katoteroi anthropoi;>>
(O Noe) eipe: <<Giati na ekho gnose gia o,ti ekanan (kai gia tis katastaseis kai ta epaggelmata tous, aphou e euthune mou einai mono na tous kalo pros ton Allakh);
O apologismos tous tha einai mono enopion tou Kuriou mou, an to katalabainete!
Kai de tha dioxo (makria mou) tous pistous.
Pragmati, den eimai para enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia!>>
Eipan: <<O, Noe! An de stamateseis, tha eisai ap' autous pou tha lithobolethoun!>>
(O Noe) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Oi anthropoi tou laou mou me diepseusan.
Krine, loipon, anamesa se mena kai s' autous, me mia krise (pou tha tous katastrepsei), kai sose emena kai osous einai mazi mou apo tous pistous.>>
Etsi, sosame auton kai osous etan mazi tou, ste phortomene Kiboto.
Epeita, pnixame meta olous tous upoloipous.
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
E phule 'Ant diepseuse tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Khount).
Otan o adelphos tous, o Khount tous eipe: <<De tha phulasseste apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Pragmati, eimai enas axiopistos Aggeliophoros pros esas.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Khtizete ena ktisma se kathe pselo meros, os paikhnidi (kai os epideixe dunames kai alazoneias, kai okhi gia kati ophelimo);
Kai phtiakhnete gia ton eauto sas palatia kai okhura, elpizontas oti tha zesete gia panta;
Kai otan epititheste (s' allous), epititheste aneleeta (me turannia kai adikia);
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Autou pou sas parekhei autes (tis khares) pou xerete:
Sas parekhei booeide, paidia,
kepous kai peges.
Pragmati, phobamai gia sas apo to marturio mias tromeres Emeras.>>
Eipan: <<To idio einai gia mas, eite mas noutheteis, eite okhi.
Auto (pou akolouthoume) den einai para e threskeia (ta ethima kai oi tropoi) ton proegoumenon anthropon,
kai de tha timorethoume pote (gi' auto pou kanoume, opos mas proeidopoieis).>>
Ton diepseusan, loipon, kai etsi, tous katastrepsame! Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
E phule Thamount diepseuse tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Salikh).
Otan o adelphos tous, o Salikh tous eipe: <<De tha phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Pragmati, eimai enas axiopistos Aggeliophoros pros esas.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
(Nomizete oti) tha aphetheite se o,ti uparkhei edo (apo eunoies gia panta) kai tha eiste asphaleis (apo to thanato kai apo ten timoria tou Allakh),
(menontas) se kepous kai peges,
kai kalliergeies kai khourmadies, ton opoion oi karpoi einai orimoi kai malakoi,
kai skalizontas sta bouna spitia me megale dexiotekhnia;
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
Kai men upakousete ten entole ekeinon pou xeperasan ta oria (stis amarties),
oi opoioi skorpizoun to kako ste ge kai de diorthonoun (tipota).>>
Eipan: <<Esu den eisai para enas apo tous magemenous anthropous!
Den eisai para enas anthropos san emas, opote phere ena Semadi, an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>

(O Salikh) eipe: <<Aute einai mia kamela (pou esteile o Allakh os Semadi), e opoia tha ekhei to meridio tes apo to nero se mia sugkekrimene emera (kata ten opoia de tha pieite), kai eseis tha ekhete to diko sas (ten epomene emera, kata ten opoia de tha piei aute).
Kai men ten aggixete me kako, gia na me sas plexei e timoria tes megales emeras.>>
Alla te skotosan, kai meta metaniosan.
Epomenos, tous eplexe e timoria. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
O laos tou Lot diepseuse tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Lot).
Otan o adelphos tous, o Lot tous eipe: <<De tha phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Pragmati, eimai enas axiopistos Aggeliophoros pros esas.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Pairnete tous andres apo tous anthropous gia sexoualike epaphe,
egkataleipontas tis suzugous sas pou tis demiourgese o Kurios sas gia sas (gia na ekhete paidia ap' autes, kai na breite eirene kai anapause s' autes);>>
Eipan: <<O, Lot! An de stamateseis, sigoura tha eisai ap' autous pou tha ekdiokhthoun.>>
(O Lot) eipe: <<Pragmati, eimai enas ap' autous pou apekhthanontai entelos ten praxe sas (ten omophulophilia).>>
(O Lot eipe): <<Kurie mou! Sose emena kai ten oikogeneia mou apo ten timoria pou tha pesei pano tous gi' auto pou kanoun.>>
Etsi, sosame auton kai ole ten oikogeneia tou (diatazontas ton na phugoun to bradu apo ten pole Sodoma),
ektos apo mia elikiomene (te gunaika tou), pou etan metaxu ekeinon pou emeinan piso (kai katastraphekan).
Meta katastrepsame tous upoloipous.
Rixame pano tous mia brokhe (apo petres). Poso tromere etan e brokhe pou epese s' ekeinous pou elaban ten proeidopoiese!
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oi katoikoi tes komopoles ton strimmenon dentron [konta ste Madiam, kai stous opoious staltheke o Prophetes Sou'aimp opos staltheke prin stous katoikous tes Madiam] diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous (del. ton Sou'aimp).
Otan tous eipe o Sou'aimp: <<De tha phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Pragmati, eimai axiopistos Aggeliophoros pros esas.
Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai upakouste me.
De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metadido se sas apo ton Kurio sas). Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
Ekpleroste te monada metreses kai zugises (stis sunallages sas), kai men eiste ap' ekeinous pou exapatoun.
Zugiste me ten orthe zugaria.
Me meionete tipota apo ta pragmata (kai ta dikaiomata) ton anthropon, kai me skorpizete to kako ste ge.
Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Autou pou demiourgese esas kai tous proegoumenous laous (me to na teresete tis entoles Tou).>>
Eipan: <<Esu den eisai para enas apo tous magemenous anthropous!
Den eisai para enas anthropos san emas, kai nomizoume oti eisai apo tous pseutes.
Kane, loipon, na pesoun pano mas kommatia apo ton ourano, an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>
(O Sou'aimp) eipe: <<O Kurios mou xerei kalutera o,ti kanete.>>
Alla ton diepseusan, kai etsi tous eplexe e timoria tes emeras tes skias enos sunnephou (apo to opoio katebeke e timoria kai e photia pano tous). Pragmati, etan mia timoria mias tromeres emeras!
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den etan pistoi.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete), einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) einai mia apokalupse apo ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
To katebase to axiopisto pneuma (o Gabriel),
sten kardia sou (o, Prophete) gia na eisai enas apo tous proeidopoietes,
se mia xekathare arabike glossa.
Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) anaphertheke stis Graphes ton proegoumenon Aggeliaphoron.

Den etan arkete apodeixe gi' autous (tous apistous apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant) oti oi logioi ton paidion tou Israel (opos o Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai oi alloi pou aspastekan to Islam), to exeran (to Kor'an oti einai e aletheia);
Akoma kai an to eikhame steilei (auto to Kor'an) se enan (me Araba Aggeliaphoro) pou den xerei arabika [e se ena zoo pou de milaei, e ena apsukho antikeimeno],
kai to eikhe apaggeilei s' autous (xekathara os thauma), akoma de tha pisteuan s' auto (to Kor'an, kai tha elegan <<To epheure>>)!
Etsi kaname auto [to na men pistepsoun sto Kor'an] na mpei stis kardies ton kakon (ton apiston, kai sphragisame tis kardies tous logo tes apistias tous).
De tha pistepsoun s' auto (to Kor'an) mekhri na doun ten odunere timoria,
pou tha tous erthei xaphnika eno den ten perimenoun.
Kai tha poun: <<Mporoume na paroume mia anabole (gia na straphoume me metameleia pros ton Allakh);>>
Biazontai na pesei pano tous e timoria Mas (os proklese pros esena, o, Prophete);
Blepeis (o, Prophete) an tous diname agatha kai anabole gia arketa khronia,
kai epeita tous erkhotan auto gia to opoio eikhan proeidopoiethei, (tha tous ophelouse se kati);
Pragmati, de tha tous prostateuan (apo ten timoria Mas) auta pou apolausan!
Pote den katastrepsame kamia pole, ektos na tes eikhan erthei prota oi proeidopoietes,
os upenthumise (kai nouthesia gi' auten). Pote den Emastan adikoi.
Den etan oi Satanades pou katebekan m' auto (to Kor'an apo ton ourano kai to epheran se sena, o, Mokhammant, -opos iskhurizontai oi apistoi-)!
Oute tha etan prepon gi' autous (aphou to Kor'an diatazei to kalo kai apagoreuei to kako, se antithese me tous Satanades), oute tha mporousan.

Pragmati, einai apokleismenoi apo to na kruphakousoun (to Kor'an apo ton ourano), [O Gabriel einai autos pou katebainei me ten apokalupse, kai kanenas Satanas de tha mporouse na erthei konta tou. Epipleon o Allakh ebale ston ourano Aggelous phrourous, kai phloges pou akolouthoun opoion Satana kruphakouei]!
Men epikaleisai loipon (o, Prophete) kanenan allon theo ektos apo ton Allakh, diaphoretika tha eisai ap' autous pou tha timorethoun.
Proeidopoiese (o, Prophete) te phule sou xekinontas apo tous pio kontinous se sena.
Na eisai (o, Prophete) epieikes kai eugenikos me osous se akolouthoun apo tous pistous.
Alla an se parakousoun (oi anthropoi tes phules sou kai de se akolouthesoun), pes: <<Pragmati, aparnoumai o,ti kanete (apo eidololatria kai apistia).>>
Kai empisteusou ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Ar-Rakheim (Poluesplakhno).
O Opoios se blepei otan sekonesai (kata te nukhta gia na teleseis ten proseukhe monos sou),
kai (blepei) te diadokhe ton kineseon sou (apo orthia, se upoklise, se Sitzount stase, otan eisai Imames stis pente upokhreotikes proseukhes) mazi me tous allous pou teloun ten proseukhe (mazi sou).
Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).
(O, eseis pou iskhurizeste oti oi Satanades einai autoi pou epheran to Kor'an ston Mokhammant)! Na sas enemeroso se poious katebainoun oi Satanades;
Katebainoun se kathe pseute kai amartolo (opos tous manteis).

Psithurizoun (oi Satanades stous manteis) auto pou kruphakousan [del. otan enas Satanas kruphakousei gregora kapoies lexeis ton Aggelon, -kai okhi to Koran, aphou den mporei-, tote ton akolouthei mia phloga. Omos mporei na prolabei na pei ekeines tis lexeis stous allous Satanades prin kaei], alla oi perissoteroi einai pseutes [pou prosthetoun s' autes tis lexeis pou akousan, ekato psemata kai ta lene stous manteis].

[Den iskhuei auto pou iskhurizeste, o, eidololatres, oti o Mokhammant einai poietes]! Oso gia tous poietes (eidololatres pou katakrinoun ton Prophete), einai autoi pou tous akolouthoun oi paraplanemenoi (pou epanalambanoun ta logia tous).
De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti (ekeinoi oi eidololatres poietes) miloun se kathe eidos mataion logon (kai psematon)! [Sukophantoun tis gunaikes, kakologoun tous kalous kai epainoun tous kakous]!
Kai oti lene pragmata pou den ta epharmozoun!
