Ektos ap' autous (tous pistous poietes, opos ton Khassan mpin Thampit) pou pisteuoun, kanoun enaretes praxeis, mnemoneuoun polu ton Allakh kai uperaspizontai ton eauto tous (meso tes poieses enantia stous apistous) aphou adikethekan, (gi' autous tous pistous poietes, den uparkhei tipota mempto). Pragmati, tha mathoun oi adikoi se poio proorismo tha epistrepsoun!

T, S [Ta-Sein, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. Auta einai ta Edaphia tou Kor'an kai tou xekatharou Bibliou (del. tou Kor'an).
(Ta opoia) apoteloun kathodegese kai kharmosuna nea gia tous pistous.
Oi opoioi (pistoi) teloun ten proseukhe, dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai pisteuoun me bebaioteta ste Mellousa Zoe.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, kaname tis (kakes) praxeis tous na phainontai oraies kai dikaies sta matia tous, kai etsi paramenoun se ateleiote sugkhuse.
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou tha ekhoun mia tromere timoria (sten egkosmia zoe), kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha einai oi pio khamenoi!
Pragmati, (o, Mokhammant) esu lambaneis to Kor'an apo Auton pou einai Khakeim (Pansophos) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Mouses (ekhase ton dromo se ena taxidi, kai) eipe sten oikogeneia tou: <<Ekho dei mia photia, tha sas phero ap' aute mia eidese (del. tha bro kapoion na mas kathodegesei ston dromo), e tha sas phero mia phloga gia na anapsete (ap' auten).>>
Otan ephtase s' aute, tou phonaxe (o Allakh): <<Eulogemenoi einai autoi pou briskontai ste photia kai guro tes (delade o Mouses kai oi Aggeloi). Doxa ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
O, Mouse! Ego eimai o Allakh, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai peta to rabdi sou.>> (Etsi, egine to rabdi ena phidi), kai otan to eide na kineitai san na etan megalo phidi, ephuge trekhontas khoris na koitaxei piso, kai de gurise. (O Allakh eipe): <<O, Mouse! Me phobasai, pragmati, oi Aggeliaphoroi Mou den prepei na phobountai (oute apo phidi, oute apo kanenan anthropo).

Omos oso gi' ekeinon pou adikese ton eauto tou (me ten amartia), epeita ekane to kalo (strapheke me metameleia pros Emena, kai ekane kales praxeis) meta apo to kako (ten amartia tou), tote pragmati eimai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Bale to kheri sou sto anoigma tou endumatos sou sto stethos sou, tha bgei lampero leuko khoris kanena kako (lepra), (os ena Semadi) apo ta ennia Semadia pros ton Pharao kai ton lao tou, oi opoioi einai anupakouoi anthropoi!>>
Otan omos ta Semadia Mas tous erthan phanera (ston Pharao kai ton lao tou), eipan: <<Aute einai xekathare mageia.>>
Kai ta diepseusan (ta Semadia Mas) adika kai alazonika, eno etan bebaioi mesa tous oti einai e aletheia. Koita loipon (o, Mokhammant) pos etan e katalexe ekeinon pou skorpizan to kako ste ge.
Pragmati, dosame gnose ston Dabid kai ston Solomonta. Eipan: <<Olos o epainos kai ole e doxa anekoun ston Allakh, pou mas eunoese pano apo pollous apo tous pistous doulous Tou.>>

O Solomontas diadekhtheke ton Dabid kai eipe: <<O, anthropoi! Didakhthekame ten katanoese ton logon ton ptenon, kai mas dothekan apo ola ta mesa (dunames kai basileiou). Pragmati, aute einai e xekathare eunoia.>>
Sugkentrothekan mprosta ston Solomonta, oi straties tou apo ta tzinn, tous anthropous kai ta poulia, kai oloi eikhan stathei se taxe.

Ospou otan ephtasan sten koilada ton murmegkion, ena murmegki eipe: <<O, murmegkia! Mpeite stis katoikies sas, gia na men sas spasoun (kai na suntripsoun) o Solomontas kai oi straties tou khoris na to katalaboun.>>

Etsi, (o Solomontas) khamogelase kai gelase (apo ten ekplexe tou) apo ta logia tou (murmegkiou), kai eipe: <<Kurie mou! Enepneuse me (kai kathodegese me) na deixo eugnomosune sten eunoia Sou pou parakhoreses se mena kai stous goneis mou, kai na pratto enaretes praxeis pou Se eukharistoun. Kai me to eleos Sou, eisegage me anamesa stous enaretous doulous Sou.>>
Epitheorese (o Solomontas) ta poulia (pou etan upotagmena s' auton, kai eikhe enan idiaitero tsalapeteino) kai eipe: <<Giati de blepo ton tsalapeteino - e einai anamesa stous apontes;
(Aphou leipei apo to kathekon tou, tote) eite tha ton timoreso austera (madontas ta poupoula tou), eite tha ton sphaxo, eite na mou pherei mia xekathare dikaiologia.>>
Omos o tsalapeteinos apousiase okhi gia polu kairo (kai epeita gurise) kai eipe (ston Solomonta): <<Ematha kati pou den xereis, kai ertha se sena apo to Sampa' [to basileio tou Saba] me sigoura nea.
Breka mia gunaika na tous kuberna, e opoia ekhei ola ta mesa (dunames kai basileiou), kai ekhei enan megalo throno.

Breka auten kai ton lao tes na latreuoun ton elio anti ton Allakh. O Satanas ekhei oraiopoiesei sta matia tous tis praxeis tous, kai etsi tous apetrepse apo ton isio dromo, kai etsi den kathodegountai.

(O Satanas ekhei oraiopoiesei sta matia tous tis praxeis tous) gia na me latreuoun ton Allakh, pou bgazei (sto phos) o,ti einai krummeno stous ouranous kai ste ge, kai xerei o,ti krubete kai o,ti phaneronete.
Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Kurios tou Megaloprepous Thronou.>>
(O Solomontas) eipe: <<Tha doume an eipes ten aletheia e eisai enas apo tous pseutes!
Pare auto to gramma mou, kai rixe to s' autous, meta aposursou ligo ap' autous kai koita ti tha poun metaxu tous.>>
(E basilissa) eipe: <<O, arkhegoi! Epese se mena ena eugenes gramma,
to opoio einai apo ton Solomonta, kai to opoio leei: <<Sto Onoma tou Allakh, tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), tou Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnou).
Me deixete alazoneia enopion autou, pros to opoio sas kalo (to na latreuete mono ton Allakh), kai elate se mena upotagmenoi (me upakoe pros ton Allakh).>>.>>
(E basilissa) eipe: <<O, arkhegoi! Sumboulepste me s' auto to thema mou, giati de tha apophasiza kati khoris na eiste parontes.>>
Eipan: <<Emeis ekhoume megale duname kai megale ikanoteta gia polemo, alla e apophase einai dike sou. Pes (mas) loipon ti diatazeis.>>
(E basilissa) eipe: <<Pragmati, oi basiliades otan mpainoun se mia pole (os kataktetes), skorpizoun to kako mesa tes kai kanoun tous eugeneis anthropous tes, atimasmenous. Kai etsi (panta) kanoun.
Tha tous steilo (ston Solomonta kai ton lao tou) kapoia dora, kai meta tha do me poia apantese tha epistrepsoun oi apestalmenoi.>>

Otan o apestalmenos erthe ston Solomonta, (o Solomontas) eipe: <<Mou dinete ploute; Auto pou mou ekhei parakhoresei o Allakh einai polu kalutero ap' auto pou sas ekhei parakhoresei. Okhi (de khairomai gia ta dora), alla eseis eiste pou khaireste me ta dora pou dinontai se sas!

Epestrepse s' autous. Pragmati, (an de dekhontai to kalesma mou na latreuoun mono ton Allakh), tha erthoume s' autous me stratiotes, pou de tha mporoun (oi anthropoi sou) na tous polemesoun, kai tha tous bgaloume ap' aute (ten pole tous) atimasmenous, kai eno einai pleros tapeinomenoi.>>
(O Solomontas) eipe (stous boethous tou): <<O, arkhegoi! Poios apo sas mporei na mou pherei ton throno tes prin erthoun se mena upotagmenoi;>>

Ena iskhuro tzinn eipe: <<Tha sou to phero prin sekotheis apo te these sou (del. apo to throno sou, e apo to sumboulio sou opou kathesai na krineis metaxu ton anthropon mekhri to mesemeri), kai eimai dunatos kai axiopistos na ton phero.>>

Alla ekeinos pou eikhe kapoia gnose apo to biblio [kai gnorizei to Megaloprepes Onoma tou Allakh, auto pou an kapoios epikalestei ton Allakh m' auto, o Allakh tha antapokrithei sten epiklese tou], eipe: <<Tha sou ton phero en ripe ophthalmou.>> Otan (o Solomontas) ton eide (ton throno tes) topothetemeno mprosta tou, eipe: <<Auto einai apo ten eunoia tou Kuriou mou, gia na me dokimasei an tha eimai eugnomon e akharistos. Opoios einai eugnomon, e eugnomosune tou tha einai gia to kalo tou. Alla opoios einai akharistos, tote o Kurios mou einai Ganei (Plousios, Apallagmenos apo oles tis anagkes) kai Kareim (Gennaiodoros).>>
(O Solomontas) eipe: <<Allaxte ligo ten emphanise tou thronou tes, gia na doume an tha kathodegethei (sto na xerei ton throno tes) e an tha einai ap' ekeinous pou den kathodegountai.>>

Otan (e basilissa) erthe, eipotheke (s' aute): <<Etsi einai o thronos sou;>> Eipe: <<Phainetai san na einai o idios. Mas erthe e gnose (gia to basileio tou Solomonta, kai katalabame oti einai Prophetes, otan epestrepse ta dora mas) prin ap' auto (to semadi, oti ephere ton throno mas edo), kai giname upotagmenoi (sten entole tou Solomonta).>>

Auto pou ten empodise (prin, apo to na kathodegethei sten aletheia) etan auto pou latreue ektos apo ton Allakh. Aute etan apo enan apisto lao (pou megalose anamesa tou, kai akolouthese te threskeia tou)!

Eipotheke s' aute: <<Mpes sten aithousa tou palatiou [pou eikhe mia gualine epiphaneia, kato apo ten opoia uperkhe nero].>> Otan (e basilissa) ten eide (ten aithousa), nomize oti etan nero, etsi apokalupse tis knemes tes (gia na patesei s' aute). (O Solomontas) eipe: <<Aute einai mia aithousa stromene me tzami.>> (E basilissa) eipe (epikaloumene ton Allakh): <<Kurie mou! Pragmati, adikesa ton eauto mou (me ten apistia mou), kai tora upotassomai mazi me ton Solomonta me upakoe pros ton Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.>>

Pragmati, steilame ston lao Thamount, ton adelpho tous Salikh, (pou tous dietaxe) oti: <<Latrepste ton Allakh.>>, alla autoi khoristekan se duo omades (piston kai apiston) pou ekhoun dikhonoia metaxu tous.
Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Giati zetate anupomona na erthei se sas to kako (e timoria) prin to kalo (to eleos tou Allakh); Tha zetousate loipon te sugkhorese tou Allakh, isos tote na eleetheite!>>

Eipan: <<Theoroume esena kai osous einai mazi sou oti mas phernete kake tukhe.>> (O Salikh) eipe: <<O,ti pathainete apo kalo e kako, to ekhei orisei o Allakh, alla eiste anthropoi pou dokimazontai (me to kalo kai to kako).>>
Uperkhan ennea andres sten pole pou skorpizan to kako (apo apistia kai amarties) ste ge kai de diorthosan tipota (me ten piste kai tis kales praxeis).

Eipan: <<As orkistoume oloi ston Allakh oti te nukhta tha ton skotosoume auton (ton Salikh) kai ten oikogeneia tou, epeita tha poume ston suggene tou (pou tha thelei ten ekdikese): <<Den eidame to phono (tou kai) tes oikogeneias tou, kai eimaste pragmati eilikrineis>>.>>
Etsi, sunomotesan me ena skhedio, kai Emeis kaname ena allo skhedio (enantion tous), eno autoi den to katalaban.
Koita loipon (o, Prophete), pos etan to telos tes sunomosias tous: Katastrepsame autous kai olo ton lao tous!
Ekeina einai ta spitia tous, einai entelos adeia (apo tous katoikous tous kai ereipomena), logo tes adikias tous. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei ena Semadi gia tous anthropous pou gnorizoun.
Kai sosame ekeinous pou pistepsan, kai phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) kai ton Lot, otan eipe ston lao tou: <<Diapratete auten ten epaiskhunte praxe (omophulophilia) eno gnorizete poso epaiskhunte einai;
Plesiazete (eseis oi andres) tous allous andres me potho anti tis gunaikes! Pragmati, eiste enas adaes laos!>>

Alla e apantese tou laou tou den etan para oti eipan: <<Dioxte ten oikogeneia tou Lot apo ten pole sas, giati einai anthropoi pou (apekhoun apo ten omophulophilia kai) diateroun tous eautous tous agnous!>>

Etsi, sosame auton (ton Lot) kai ten oikogeneia tou (diatazontas ton na phugei me ten oikogeneia tou to bradu apo ten pole) ektos apo te gunaika tou, pou orisame na einai ap' ekeinous pou tha meinoun piso (sten katastrophe).
Rixame pano tous mia brokhe (apo petres). Poso tromere etan e brokhe pou epese s' ekeinous pou proeidopoiethekan!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, kai eirene stous doulous Tou pou tous epelexe. Einai o Allakh Kaluteros e auta (ta eidola) pou ta apodidoun (oi eidololatres os etairous) s' Auton ste latreia;>>

(Einai e latreia pros tous legomenous theous tous kalutere) e pros Auton pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge, kai esteile gia sas nero apo ton ourano; Me to opoio (nero) demiourgesame kepous me oraia emphanise, pou de tha mporousate pote na kanete ta dentra tous na phutrosoun. Uparkhei kapoios allos theos (pou demiourgese auta) mazi me ton Allakh (kai etsi axizei na latreuetai mazi Tou); Okhi, alla ekeinoi (oi eidololatres) parekklinoun (apo ten aletheia, kai exisonoun allous me ton Allakh ste latreia).

(Einai e latreia pros tous legomenous theous tous kalutere) e pros Auton pou ekane te ge ena stathero meros (pou na men tremei me sas), ekane mesa tes potamia, topothetese s' auten stathera bouna (gia na men tremei e ge me sas), kai ekane anamesa sta duo nera (tou potamou kai tes thalassas, e ton duo potamon e ton duo thalasson) ena phragma; [Auto to aorato phragma kanei to nero enos potamou e mias thalassas, otan eiskhoresei se mia alle thalassa, na men allaxei ten almurotata kai tis perigraphes tes, oute to antistropho, alla apokta tis perigraphes autes]. Uparkhei kapoios allos theos (pou demiourgese auta) mazi me ton Allakh; Okhi, alla oi perissoteroi de gnorizoun (te Megaloprepeia tou Allakh)!

(Einai e latreia pros tous legomenous theous tous kalutere) e pros Auton pou antapokrinetai sten epiklese ekeinou pou Ton epikaleite eno brisketai se megales kakoukhies (kai se anagke), kai o Opoios aphairei tis kakoukhies kai kanei esas na diadekheste e mia genia ten alle ste ge; Uparkhei kapoios allos theos (pou kanei auta) mazi me ton Allakh; Ligo einai auto pou lambanete upopse apo ten nouthesia!

(Einai e latreia pros tous legomenous theous tous kalutere) e pros Auton pou sas kathodegei sta skotadia tes sterias kai tes thalassas, kai pou stelnei tous anemous os kharmosuna nea prin to eleos Tou (te brokhe); Uparkhei kapoios allos theos (pou kanei auta) mazi me ton Allakh; Upsistos kai polu Anoteros einai o Allakh apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (apo etairous ste latreia)!

(Einai e latreia pros tous legomenous theous tous kalutere) e pros Auton pou demiourgei te demiourgia apo ten arkhe (eite apo ule, eite apo anuparxia, khoris proegoumeno protupo), epeita ten epanapherei ste zoe (ten Emera tes Kriseos, e kai sten egkosmia zoe, opos ta sunnepha kai tous anemous pou ta demiourgei kai ta epanapherei sunekheia), kai pou sas parekhei apo ton ourano kai te ge; Uparkhei kapoios allos theos (pou kanei auta) mazi me ton Allakh; Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pherte tis apodeixeis sas (oti o Allakh ekhei etairous), an eiste eilikrineis!>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Kaneis stous ouranous kai ste ge de gnorizei to aorato, ektos apo ton Allakh.>> Oute xeroun (ola ta demiourgemata) pote tha anastethoun!

Okhi (den xeroun oi apistoi pote tha anastethoun), alla tha oloklerothei e gnose tous ste Mellousa Zoe (otan tha anastethoun)! Alla (sten egkosmia zoe) ekhoun amphibolia gi' auten (ten anastase), e akoma einai tuphloi gi' auten (kai de blepoun tis apodeixeis tes).
Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste, eipan: <<Einai dunaton otan emeis kai oi progonoi mas tha ginoume skone, tha bgoume (apo tous taphous mas, zontanoi xana);
Pragmati, eikhame labei aute ten uposkhese emeis kai oi progonoi mas prin (gia ten anastase, alla den ten eidame na ulopoieitai). Auto den einai para oi muthoi ton arkhaion.>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Taxidepste ste ge, kai koitaxte pos etan to telos ton kakon (pou diepseusan ten anastase apo ta proegoumena ethne).>>
Me lupasai gi' autous (oti apomakrunontai apo ten piste kai se diapseudoun), oute na steneuei to stethos sou apo o,ti sunomotoun.
Lene (oi apistoi): <<Pote tha ulopoiethei aute e uposkhese (gia ten timoria), an eiste (o, Mousoulmanoi) eilikrineis;>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Isos plesiazei se sas ena meros ap' aute (ten timoria) gia ten opoia biazeste!>>

Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei polles khares stous anthropous (kai den epispeudei na erthei e timoria stous anupakouous, isos kai na straphoun me metameleia), omos oi perissoteroi ap' autous einai akharistoi!
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei ola osa kruboun ta stethe tous, kai ola osa phaneronoun.
Den uparkhei tipota krupho (pou den to blepoun oi anthropoi) stous ouranous kai ste ge, ektos na einai (grammeno) se ena xekatharo Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).
Pragmati, auto to Kor'an enemeronei ta paidia tou Israel (gia ten aletheia) gia ta perissotera themata sta opoia diaphonoun (kai phaneronei tis parekkliseis tous kai ten paraplanese tous).
Kai auto (to Kor'an) apotelei kathodegese kai eleos gia tous pistous.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) tha krinei metaxu tous (olon ton anthropon) me te (dikaie) Krise Tou. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Etsi, empisteusou (o, Prophete) ton Allakh. Pragmati, eisai sten xekathare aletheia.

Esu (o, Prophete) den mporeis na kaneis tous nekrous (del. pou ekhoun nekres kardies logo tes apistias) na akousoun, oute mporeis na kaneis tous kophous na akousoun ten klese (sou) otan apomakrunontai (apo sena)!

Oute mporeis (o, Prophete) na kathodegeseis tous tuphlous apomakrunontas tous apo ten plane tous! Den mporeis na kaneis na akousoun (ten aletheia) para mono autous pou pisteuoun sta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas, giati autoi einai oi upakouoi (pros ton Allakh).

Otan tha ginei anapopheukte e timoria gi' ekeinous (tous apistous prin ten Emera tes Kriseos), tha steiloume s' autous ena zoo apo te ge (os Semadi apo Mas oti e Ora plesiazei, kai tote de tha ophelesei kanenan apisto to na pistepsei), to opoio (zoo) tha tous milesei kai tha tous pei oti oi anthropoi (oi apistoi) den pistepsan sta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ten Emera pou tha sugkentrosoume apo kathe ethnos mia omada, ap' ekeinous pou diepseusan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, kai etsi tha odegethoun (pros ton topo tou apologismou tous),
kai otan erthoun, (o Allakh) tha pei: <<Diapseusate ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mou, eno den eikhate gnose gi' Auta (kai milesate apo agnoia), e ti kanate (otan den ta labate upopse);
Etsi, egine anapopheukte e timoria gi' ekeinous gia o,ti adikia diepraxan, kai etsi, de tha milesoun (me kamia dikaiologia)!
De blepoun oti kaname te nukhta gia na xekourastoun kata te diarkeia tes, kai kaname ten emera photeine; Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ten Emera pou (o Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga), kai tha tromaxoun oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai ste ge ektos apo osous thelei o Allakh, kai oloi tha erthoun pros Auton, pleros tapeinomenoi.

Blepeis ta bouna, kai nomizeis oti einai akineta, alla kinountai opos kinountai ta sunnepha. Aute einai e demiourgia tou Allakh, o Opoios demiourgese ta panta teleia. Pragmati, Autos gia o,ti kanete, ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Opoios erkhetai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) me kales praxeis (me piste, aphosiose ste latreia), tha antameiphthei me mia kalutere antamoibe ap' autes, kai tetoioi (anthropoi) tha einai asphaleis apo te phrike ekeines tes Emeras.

Opoios omos erkhetai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) me kakes praxeis (me apistia kai amarties), tetoioi (anthropoi) tha rikhtoun me ta prosopa tous ste Photia. (Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Tha labete kati allo para auto pou kanate;>>

(Pes, o, Prophete): <<St' aletheia, diatakhtheka na latreuo ton Kurio autes tes poles, pou ten ekane iere* kai s' Auton anekoun ta panta* ki ekho diatakhthei na eimai apo tous Mousoulmanous (upotagmenous ste Boulese tou Allakh),
kai na apaggello to Kor'an.>> Etsi, opoios kathodegeitai, kathodegeitai mono gia to kalo tou. Kai opoios parastratesei, tote pes (o, Prophete): <<Ego eimai mono enas apo tous proeidopoietes.>>

Kai pes: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh. Tha sas deixei ta Semadia Tou (ston eauto sas, ston ourano kai ste ge), kai tha ta gnorizete.>> O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei kala o,ti kanete (o, anthropoi).

T, S, M [Ta-Sein-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Auta einai ta Edaphia tou xekatharou Bibliou (pou diasaphenizei ten aletheia).
Anapheroume me ten aletheia, se sena (o, Prophete) ena meros tes istorias tou Mouse kai tou Pharao, gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.

Pragmati, o Pharao edeixe turannia kai alazoneia ste ge kai khorise tous katoikous tes se omades. Katapieze ap' autous mia omada (del. ta paidia tou Israel -Iakob-), sphazontas tous gious tous kai aphenontas tis gunaikes tous zontanes (gia na uperetesoun). Pragmati, etan enas ap' ekeinous pou skorpizan to kako.

Emeis theloume na enapothesoume te khare Mas s' ekeinous pou katapiezontan ste ge kai na tous kanoume na einai ena kalo paradeigma (gia na akolouthesoun oi anthropoi tes epokhes tous) kai na tous kanoume tous diadokhous (pou tha sothoun meta ten katastrophe ton apiston, kai tha ekhoun agatha kai duname opos eikhe o Pharao kai o laos tou).

Kai na tous dosoume duname ste ge, kai na kanoume ton Pharao, ton Khaman (ton boetho tou) kai tous stratiotes tous, na doun ap' autous (ta paidia tou Israel -Iakob-) auto pou phobontousan (del. ten katastrophe kai ten exaphanise tou basileiou tous).

Empneusame te metera tou Mouse: <<Thelase ton, alla otan phobasai gi' auton (apo na ton skotosei o Pharao), bal' ton (se ena kalathi) sto nero [sto potami], kai me phobasai, oute na lupasai (oti tha einai makria sou). Pragmati, tha ton epistrepsoume se sena, kai tha ton kanoume enan apo tous Aggeliaphorous.>>

Etsi, ton brekan oi uperetes tou Pharao, -oste (na ekplerothei auto pou orise o Allakh kai) na ginei (o Mouses) enas ekhthros gi' autous (ton Pharao kai ton lao tou) kai na pherei s' autous te thlipse (otan tha katastraphoun). Pragmati, o Pharao, o Khaman (o boethos tou) kai oi stratiotes tous etan amartoloi.

E gunaika tou Pharao eipe: <<(Auto to moro) einai pege kharas gia mena kai gia sena (o, Pharao). Men ton skotosete, isos na mas ophelesei e na ton uiothetesoume.>> (Etsi ton peran) eno de gnorizan (ti tha ginei meta).

E kardia tes meteras tou Mouse egine adeia (ektos apo te skepse ston Mouse), kai paraligo na apokalupsei to thema tou (oti einai to paidi tes), an den kathesukhazame kai statheropoiousame ten kardia tes, gia na ginei apo tous pistous.
(E metera tou Mouse) eipe sten adelphe tou: <<Parakolouthese ton (apo makria).>> Etsi, ton parakolouthouse apo apostase, khoris na to katalaboun.

Kaname auton (ton Mouse) na arnethei oles tis thelazouses prin (na ton epistrepsoume ste metera tou). Etsi, (e adelphe tou) eipe (stous uperetes tou Pharao): <<Thelete na sas kateuthuno se mia oikogeneia pou mporei na ton prosekhei (kai na ton thelazei) gia sas, kai na einai axiopiste pros auton;>>

Etsi, ton epistrepsame ste metera tou gia na kharei, na me lupatai kai na xerei oti e Uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine. Alla oi perissoteroi ap' ekeinous (tous eidololatres) den xeroun (oute pisteuoun oti e Uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine).
Otan (o Mouses) ephtase sten elikia tes dunames tou, kai oloklerotheke e orimoteta tou, tou dosame orthe katanoese kai gnose. Etsi antameiboume autous pou prattoun to kalo.

(O Mouses) mpeke sten pole se mia stigme aprosexias ton anthropon tes (del. otan xekourazontai to mesemeri), kai breke duo andres na tsakonontai: o enas etan apo tous dikous tou anthropous (apo ta paidia tou Israel) kai o allos etan apo tous ekhthrous tou (apo ton lao tou Pharao). Etsi, ekeinos pou etan apo tous dikous tou, tou zetese boetheia enantia ston allon pou etan apo tous ekhthrous tou. Opote o Mouses ton khtupese (me ena khtupema), kai etsi, ton skotose (kata lathos). (O Mouses) eipe: <<Auto einai apo ta erga tou Satana (pou mou psithurise kai me othese na ton khtupeso). Pragmati, (o Satanas) einai xekatharos ekhthros pou paraplana (tous anthropous).>>

(O Mouses) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Adikesa ton eauto mou (m' aute ten amartia pou ekana khoris na eikha ten prothese na ton skotoso), gi' auto sugkhorese me.>> Etsi, (o Allakh) ton sugkhorese, pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Logo oson mou parakhoreses apo tis eunoies Sou, de tha gino pote uposteriktes gia tous kakous.>>

Etsi, (o Mouses) phobotan sten pole kai perimene ta nea. Tote ekeinos pou tou zetese te boetheia ten proegoumene mera, ton phonaxe xana gia boetheia (enantia se allon apo tous ekhthrous tou). O Mouses tou eipe: <<Pragmati, eisai xekathara paraplanemenos (epeide khthes tsakothekes me enan kai semera me allon).>>

Otan erthe (o Mouses) na khtupesei auton pou etan ekhthros kai ton duo, (ekeinos pou tou zetese boetheia, nomize oti o Mouses tha skotone ton idio, epeide o Mouses tou eipe: <<Eisai xekathara paraplanemenos>>, kai etsi) eipe: <<O, Mouse! Thes na me skotoseis opos skotoses kapoion khthes; Pragmati, de thes para na eisai enas turannos ste ge, kai de thes na eisai enas ap' autous pou diorthonoun ta pragmata (kai skorpizoun to kalo ste ge)!>>

Erthe enas andras speudontas apo to telos tes poles kai eipe: <<O, Mouse! Oi arkhegoi sunomotoun metaxu tous gia na se skotosoun, opote bges (apo ten pole). Eimai eilikrines mazi sou (kai sou dino mia eilikrine sumboule).>>
Ephuge (o Mouses) loipon apo ten pole phobismenos kai perimenontas (ti tha ginei). Eipe: <<Kurie mou! Sose me apo tous adikous anthropous.>>
Otan kateuthuntheke pros te Madiam, eipe: <<Elpizo oti o Kurios mou tha me kathodegesei ston ortho dromo (pros te Madiam).>>

Otan ephtase sto pegadi tes Madiam, breke ekei mia omada andron pou ebalan ta kopadia tous na pioun, kai dipla tous breke duo gunaikes pou kratousan piso ta kopadia tous. Eipe (stis duo gunaikes): <<Ti sumbainei me sas;>> Eipan: <<De bazoume ta kopadia mas na pioun, mekhri na paroun oi boskoi ta kopadia tous kai na phugoun, (gia na men anameikhthoume me tous andres), kai o pateras mas einai polu geros (pou den mporei na erthei o idios).>>

Etsi, (o Mouses) ebale ta kopadia tous (ton duo gunaikon) na pioun, epeita pege ste skia kai eipe: <<Kurie mou! St' aletheia, eimai se megale anagke gia o,ti kalo (del. phageto) na parakhoreseis se mena!>>

Tote erthe s' auton mia apo tis duo gunaikes, perpatontas semna. Eipe: <<O pateras mou se proskalei gia na se antameipsei pou ebales ta kopadia mas na pioun.>> Otan (o Mouses) pege s' auton kai tou eipe ten istoria (tou me ton Pharao), eipe (o geros): <<Me phobasai. Sothekes apo tous adikous anthropous.>>
Mia apo tis duo gunaikes eipe: <<O, patera mou! Proselabe ton! St' aletheia, o kaluteros pou mporeis na ton proslabeis, einai o iskhuros kai axiopistos.>>

Eipe: <<Tha ethela na se pantrepso me mia ap' autes tis duo kores mou, me ton oro oti tha douleueis gia mena (phrontizontas ta kopadia mou) gia okto khronia* ma an sumpleroseis deka khronia, auto tha etan mia khare apo sena, kai de thelo na se epibaruno (me to na sou zeteso na einai deka khronia). Tha me breis, an to thelei o Allakh, na eimai enas apo tous enaretous (sten ekplerose ton kathekonton mou).>>

(O Mouses) Eipe: <<Kanonisteke metaxu mas! Opoion apo tous duo kathorismenous khronous kai na ekpleroso, de tha uparkhei adikia se mena (del. de tha zeteseis parapano ap' auto), kai o Allakh einai Marturas se osa leme!>>

Otan o Mouses ekplerose ton sumphonemeno khrono kai ephuge me ten oikogeneia tou, eide mia photia sten pleura tou bounou, kai eipe sten oikogeneia tou: <<Meinete edo. Ekho dei mia photia, isos na phero gia sas ap' aute mia eidese (del. tha bro kapoion na mas kathodegesei ston dromo pou khasame), e na sas phero mia phloga apo te photia gia na anapsete (ap' auten) kai na zestatheite.>>

Otan ephtase (o Mouses) s' aute (te photia), ton phonaxe (o Allakh) apo te dexia pleura tes koiladas (kai tou orous), sto eulogemeno meros, apo te meria tou dentrou [del. akouse te Phone tou Allakh apo ekei, otan eide photia se ena dentro], legontas tou: <<O, Mouse! Pragmati, Ego eimai o Allakh, o Kurios olon ton kosmon.

Kai peta to rabdi sou.>> (Etsi, egine to rabdi ena phidi), kai otan to eide na kineitai san na etan ena megalo phidi, ephuge trekhontas, kai de gurise. (O Allakh eipe): <<O, Mouse! Prokhora (pros to dentro) kai me phobasai, pragmati, eisai enas ap' ekeinous pou einai asphaleis (kai de tha se blapsei to phidi).

Bale to kheri sou sto anoigma tou endumatos sou sto stethos sou, tha bgei lampero leuko khoris kanena kako (lepra), kai bale to kheri sou sto stethos sou gia na eremesei o phobos sou. Auta (to Semadi tou rabdiou kai tou kheriou pou ginetai lampero) einai duo apodeixeis apo ton Kurio sou pros ton Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou, oi opoioi einai anupakouoi anthropoi!>>
(O Mouses) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Skotosa enan apo ton lao tous, kai phobamai na me skotosoun.
O adelphos mou o Aaron einai pio euglottos apo mena ston logo, gi' auto steil' ton mazi mou os uposterikte gia na epibebaiosei kai na diasaphenisei ta logia mou, giati phobamai na me diapseusoun.>>

O Allakh eipe: <<Tha se uposterixoume meso tou adelphou sou, kai tha sas dosoume epikheiremata (kai uposterixe), kai etsi de tha mporoun na sas blapsoun. Me ta Semadia Mas, eseis kai osoi sas akolouthoun, tha eiste oi niketes.>>
Otan o Mouses erthe s' autous me ta xekathara Semadia Mas, eipan: <<Auto den einai para epinoemene mageia (tou Mouse). Den ekhoume akousei kati tetoio apo tous progonous mas.>>

O Mouses eipe: <<O Kurios mou gnorizei kalutera poios ekhei erthei me ten kathodegese ap' Auton, kai poios tha ekhei ten kalutere antamoibe ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, oi adikoi de tha epitukhoun pote.>>

O Pharao eipe: <<O, arkhegoi! De gnorizo na uparkhei kanenas allos theos gia sas ektos apo mena. O, Khaman! Anapse photia ste laspe, kai khtise mou enan purgo, isos na do ton Theo tou Mouse, giati nomizo oti einai apo tous pseutes.>>
Autos (o Pharao) kai oi stratiotes tou etan alazonikoi ste ge khoris kanena dikaioma kai nomizan oti de tha epistrepsoun se Emas.
Etsi timoresame auton (ton Pharao) kai tous stratiotes tou kai tous petaxame (kai tous pnixame) sto nero. Koita loipon (o, Prophete) pos etan to telos ton adikon!
Tous kaname (ton Pharao kai tous arkhegous tou laou tou) egetes pou kaloun pros te photia (opoion pairnei ton dromo tous). Kai ten Emera tes Anastases, de tha laboun kamia uposterixe.
Kai kaname ten katara na tous akolouthesei sten egkosmia zoe, kai ten Emera tes Anastases tha einai apo tous kataphronemenous.
Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora) aphou katastrepsame ta proegoumena (apista) ethne, os xekathare apodeixe gia tous anthropous, kai kathodegese kai eleos, isos kai na ta laboun upopse.

Den esoun (o, Mokhammant) ste dutike pleura (tou Orous) otan anathesame ston Mouse ten apostole (tou), oute esoun apo tous parontes (gia na matheis auta apo monos sou, alla einai mia apokalupse apo ton Allakh).

Alla Emeis demiourgesame alles genies (meta ton Mouse), kai perase polus kairos (kai xekhasan te desmeuse tous pros Emas). Kai den esoun (o, Mokhammant) katoikos anamesa ston lao tes Madiam apaggellontas ta Edaphia Mas s' autous (gia na matheis ap' autous ten istoria tou Mouse kai tou Sou'aimp ste Madiam), alla emastan Emeis pou steilame (esena os Aggeliaphoro, kai sou steilame auto to Kor'an pou periekhei tis istories tous).

Kai den esoun sten pleura tou orous otan phonaxame (ton Mouse), alla (emathes auta apo ten apokalupse apo ton Kurio sou, kai se steilame) os eleos apo ton Kurio sou, gia na proeidopoieseis enan lao, ston opoio den eikhe erthei kanenas proeidopoietes prin apo sena, isos kai na to laboun upopse.

An (prin se steiloume, o, Mokhammant) tous eplette mia timoria gia o,ti diepraxan, tha elegan: <<Kurie mas! An mas estelnes enan Aggeliaphoro, tha akolouthousame ta Edaphia Sou, kai tha emastan apo tous pistous!>>

Otan omos erthe e aletheia apo Emas s' autous (tous eidololatres), eipan (aphou tous proteinan oi Ebraioi na poun auto): <<An tou dinotan (ston Mokhammant to Kor'an oloklero se mia phora) opos dotheke (e Tora) ston Mouse (se mia phora), (tote tha pisteuame)!>> Ma den aperripsan auto pou dotheke ston Mouse apo prin (otan rotesan tous Ebraious kai brekan oti oi perigraphes tou Mokhammant uparkhoun stis Graphes tous); Eipan (gia to Kor'an kai gia ten Tora): <<Duo mageies pou uposterizoun e mia ten alle (sten plane)>>, kai eipan: <<Emeis aporriptoume ola auta!>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pherte loipon ena Biblio apo ton Allakh pou na einai kalutero sten kathodegese apo ta duo (to Kor'an kai ten Tora), oste na to akoloutheso, an eiste eilikrineis.>>

An omos den antapokrithoun se sena, tote na xereis oti akolouthoun mono tis epithumies tous. Poios einai loipon pio parastratemenos ap' ekeinon pou akolouthei ten epithumia tou khoris kamia kathodegese apo ton Allakh; Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous anthropous!
Pragmati, kaname na phtasoun s' ekeinous ta logia (ton istorion ton proegoumenon ethnon, kai ti kaname stous apistous), isos kai na ta laboun upopse.

Pragmati, ekeinoi, stous opoious steilame to Biblio (ten Tora tou Mouse kai to prototupo In-tzel tou Iesou) prin ap' auto (to Kor'an), pisteuoun s' auto (to Kor'an, opos o 'Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai o Salman Al-Pharisi kai alloi pou aspastekan to Islam aphou brekan stis graphes tous tis perigraphes tou Mokhammant).

Otan apaggelletai (to Kor'an) s' autous, lene: <<Pisteuoume s' auto. Pragmati, auto einai e Aletheia apo ton Kurio mas. Pragmati, emastan prin ap' auto upotagmenoi (ste Boulese tou Allakh, pisteuontas stous proegoumenous Aggeliaphorous -ton Mouse kai ton Iesou kai tous allous-).>>
Ekeinoi tha laboun ten antamoibe tous dipla, gia o,ti edeixan apo upomone. Apokrououn to kako me to kalo, kai apo o,ti tous paraskhoume, xodeuoun (se eleemosune).

Otan akoun mataia logia (apo tous eidololatres pou tous katakrinoun epeide aspastekan to Islam), apomakrunontai ap' auta kai lene: <<Gia mas einai oi praxeis mas, kai gia sas einai oi praxeis sas. Eiste asphaleis apo to na sas apantesoume me anoeta logia! Den epidiokoume ton tropo ton adaon.>>
Pragmati, esu (o, Mokhammant) den mporeis na kathodegeseis opoion agapas (opos ton theio sou, Ampou Talimp), alla o Allakh kathodegei opoious thelei. Kai Autos gnorizei kalutera tous kathodegemenous.

Lene (kapoioi eidololatres): <<An akolouthesoume ten kathodegese (to Islam) sto dromo sou (o, Mokhammant, kai aparnethoume tous theous mas), tha mas arpaxoun (me phono kai aikhmalosia) apo te ge mas (oi alles arabikes phules).>> Ma den tous kaname na meinoun se ena Iero kai asphales meros (te Makka, pou ekhei ton Iero Oiko pou ton doxazoun oi arabikes phules, kai etsi den epitithentai s' auten), kai pros to opoio (meros) phernoun tous karpous kathe eidous (pou khreiazontai), os agatha apo Emas; Alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous den xeroun (tis khares tou Allakh s' autous)!

Poses poleis katastrepsame pou etan akharistes pros tis eunoies pou tous pareikhame! Na tes oi katoikies tous, den katoikethekan meta ap' autous para mono liges (e gia ligo -apo tous odoiporous klp.-). Emastan Emeis oi Kleronomoi [del. den emeine kanenas apo ekeinous. Kai o Allakh einai o Idioktetes ton panton].

O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) de tha katestrephe pote tis komopoleis mekhri na steilei prota sten kuria komopole anamesa tous, enan Aggeliaphoro pou tha tous apaggellei ta Edaphia Mas. Kai de tha katastrephame tis komopoleis, ektos oi katoikoi tous na etan adikoi.
O,ti agatha labete (apo ton Kurio sas), einai mono e apolause kai ta stolidia tes egkosmias zoes, alla o,ti ekhei o Allakh (apo antamoibe) einai kalutero kai diarkei perissotero. Ma de sullogizeste;

Einai ekeinos ston opoio uposkhethekame ten kalutere antamoibe pou oposdepote tha te labei, san ekeinon ston opoio dosame ta agatha (kai ten apolause) tes egkosmias zoes, kai epeita ten Emera tes Anastases tha einai ap' ekeinous pou tha parebriskontai sten Kolase;
Ten Emera pou tha tous phonaxei legontas: <<Pou einai oi (legomenoi) etairoi Mou pou iskhuristekate (oti einai oi etairoi Mou ste latreia);>>

Ekeinoi (oi diaboloi kai oi egetes tes planes) stous opoious egine e timoria anapopheukte, tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Autoi pou tous paraplanesame, tous paraplanesame (apo epiloge tous) opos paraplanethekame ki emeis, (psithurisame s' autous, kai autoi epelexan ten plane, an kai esteiles Aggeliaphorous kai Biblia me uposkheseis kai proeidopoieseis kai nouthesies). Aparnoumaste enopion Sou (autous kai ten apistia tous), den latreuan emas, (alla tous pothous tous latreuan).>>

Tha eipothei (stous eidololatres): <<Kaleste ekeinous pou tous apodidate os etairous ston Allakh ste latreia (gia na sas uposterixoun).>> Tha tous kalesoun, alla ekeinoi de tha antapokrithoun s' autous. Tha doun ten timoria, kai tha eukhethoun na eikhan akolouthesei ten kathodegese.
Ten Emera pou (o Allakh) tha tous phonaxei (tous eidololatres) kai tha pei: <<Ti apantesate stous Aggeliaphorous;>>

Etsi, tha exaphanistoun oles oi dikaiologies ap' ekeinous (tous eidololatres) ekeine ten Emera (kai de tha xeroun ti na poun), kai etsi, de tha rotesoun o enas ton allon (epeide oloi tous tha einai isoi sten agnoia)!
Omos opoios (eidololatres, sten egkosmia zoe) straphei me metameleia pros ton Allakh, pisteuei kai kanei enaretes praxeis, tha einai apo tous epitukhemenous (ste Mellousa Zoe).

O Kurios sou demiourgei o,ti thelei kai epilegei (opoion thelei os Aggeliaphoro). Den ekhoun (oi eidololatres) ten epiloge (na poun: <<Giati de staltheke auto to Kor'an se enan spoudaio andra apo tis duo poleis -opos ston Al-Oualeint mpin Al-Mougeira ste Makka e ston Khampimp Ath-Thakaphei sten At-Ta'iph-;>>). Doxa ston Allakh, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (oi eidololatres apo etairous ste latreia)!
O Kurios sou gnorizei o,ti kruboun oi kardies tous kai o,ti phaneronoun.

Autos einai o Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. S' Auton anekei olos o epainos sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe. S' Auton anekei e krise, kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Blepete pos an o Allakh ekane te nukhta na parameinei se sas mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, poios allos theos ektos apo ton Allakh tha mporouse na sas pherei lampero phos; Ma den akoute (tis apodeixeis);>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Blepete pos an o Allakh ekane ten emera na parameinei se sas mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, poios allos theos ektos apo ton Allakh tha mporouse na sas pherei te nukhta sten opoia xekourazeste; Ma den blepete (ta Semadia Tou sto sumpan);>>

Apo to eleos Tou ekane gia sas te nukhta kai ten emera, gia na xekourasteite s' aute (te nukhta) kai na anazetate apo te gennaiodoria Tou (meso ton ergasion sas ten emera), kai isos na eiste eugnomones.
Ten Emera pou tha tous phonaxei legontas: <<Pou einai oi (legomenoi) etairoi Mou pou iskhuristekate (oti einai oi etairoi Mou ste latreia);>>

(Ekeine ten Emera) tha pheroume apo kathe ethnos enan martura (ton Aggeliaphoro tou), kai tha poume (s' ekeinous pou diepseusan tous Aggeiaphorous): <<Pherte ten apodeixe sas (gia ten apistia sas)!>> Tote tha xeroun oti e aletheia anekei ston Allakh, kai tha tous egkataleipsei o,ti epinoesan.

Pragmati, o Karoun etan enas apo tous anthropous tou Mouse, alla egine alazonikos apenanti tous. Tou eikhame paraskhei ploute, ton opoion ta thesaurophulakia tha barainan akoma kai mia omada dunaton andron. Otan o laos tou tou eipe: <<Me khairesai me alazoneia, giati o Allakh de sumpathei ekeinous (tous akharistous) pou khairontai me alazoneia.

Epidioke te Mellousa Zoe (kai ten antamoibe tes) me o,ti sou pareikhe o Allakh (me to na xodeueis se eleemosune), kai men apheseis to meridio sou apo ten egkosmia zoe (apo phageto kai roukhismo klp., alla khoris spatale). Kane to kalo opos o Allakh ekane kalo se sena kai men epidiokeis na skorpizeis to kako ste ge, giati o Allakh de sumpathei ekeinous pou skorpizoun to kako.>>

O Karoun eipe: <<Pragmati, ta elaba (ta ploute mou) logo tes gnoses pou ekho.>> Den exere oti o Allakh katestrepse prin ap' auton, apo tis proegoumenes genies, ekeinous pou etan pio dunatoi ap' auton kai sussoreuan perissotera (ploute ap' auton); Pragmati, de tha rotethoun oi kakoi gia tis amarties tous (gia na matheutoun ap' autous, aphou o Allakh tis xerei ede kai oi Aggeloi tis ekhoun katagrapsei, alla tha rotethoun oi kakoi os epiplexe kai timoria gi' autous).

Bgeke (o Karoun) mprosta stous anthropous tou me ta stolidia tou. Ekeinoi pou epithumousan ten egkosmia zoe (kai tis apolauseis tes) eipan: <<Makari na eikhame opos auto pou dotheke ston Karoun! Pragmati, ekhei megalo meridio (apo tis apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes).>>

Ekeinoi omos stous opoious dotheke gnose eipan: <<Alimono se sas! E antamoibe tou Allakh einai kalutere gia opoion pisteuei kai kanei enaretes praxeis. Kai de tha te laboun para mono oi upomonetikoi (pou upakoun ton Allakh).>>

Etsi, kaname te ge na katapiei auton (ton Karoun) kai to spiti tou. Den eikhe kamia omada na ton uposterixei enantia ston Allakh, oute o idios (o Karoun) tha mporouse na uposterixei ton eauto tou (enantia ston Allakh).

Ekeinoi pou epithumousan ten proegoumene emera na ekhoun mia these san te dike tou, arkhisan na lene: <<Den eides oti o Allakh dinei aphthona agatha se opoious thelei apo tous doulous Tou, kai periorizei (ta agatha gia opoious thelei)! An de mas eikhe eunoesei o Allakh, tha ekane te ge na mas katapiei. Den eides oti oi apistoi de tha epitukhoun pote!>>

Aute ten eudaimonia ste Mellousa Zoe, tha te dosoume s' ekeinous pou den epidiokoun ten alazoneia ste ge, oute na skorpizoun to kako (ste ge). Kai e antamoibe (kai o Paradeisos) sto telos, tha einai gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou).

Opoios erkhetai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) ekhontas kanei mia kale praxe, tha antameiphthei me kalutere antamoibe ap' aute (del. me dekaplasia amoibe e perissotere). Opoios omos erkhetai ekhontas kanei mia kake praxe, tote ekeinoi pou diepraxan tis kakes praxeis, de tha laboun os timoria para mono gia o,ti diepraxan.

Pragmati, Autos pou esteile se sena (o, Prophete) to Kor'an (kai epebale se sena na to diadoseis), tha se epistrepsei ston topo sou [te Makka apo ten opoia bgekes logo diogmon, kai sten opoia tha epistrepseis os niketes]. Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<O Kurios mou gnorizei kalutera poios ekhei erthei me ten kathodegese kai poios brisketai se xekathare plane.>>
Den to perimenes (prin ten apostole sou) na apokaluphthei se sena to Biblio (to Kor'an), alla etan eleos apo ton Kurio sou (oti to esteile se sena). Men uposterizeis loipon pote tous apistous.

Men tous apheseis (tous apistous) na se apomakrunoun apo ta Edaphia tou Allakh (kai apo to na ta diadoseis anamesa stous anthropous) aphou ekhoun stalei se sena. Kalese (tous anthropous) pros ton Kurio sou, kai men eisai pote ap' ekeinous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia.

Men epikaleisai ektos apo ton Allakh kanenan allo theo. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Ta panta tha khathoun ektos apo to Prosopo Tou. S' Auton anekei e Krise, kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.

A, L, M (Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an -Koranio- pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio).
Nomizoun oi anthropoi oti me to na lene: <<Pisteuoume>>, tha aphethoun kai de tha dokimazontai (me tis entoles kai tis apagoreuseis kai tis kakoukhies);

Pragmati, dokimazame ekeinous pou etan prin ap' autous, gia na xerei o Allakh (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakhorisei) tous eilikrineis (sten piste tous), kai na xerei tous pseutes.
E nomizoun ekeinoi pou diaprattoun tis kakes praxeis oti mporoun na Mas xephugoun (kai na sothoun apo ten timoria Mas); Poso athlio einai auto pou krinoun!

Opoios elpizei gia te sunantese tou Allakh (ste Mellousa Zoe kai elpizei gia ten antamoibe Tou), pragmati, e Ora (gia ten anastase) pou ekhei kathorisei o Allakh tha erthei. Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).

Opoios agonizetai (enantia ston eauto tou, terontas tis entoles tou Allakh, kai agonizetai ston dromo Tou), agonizetai mono gia to kalo tou. Pragmati, o Allakh den ekhei anagke kanenan apo olous tous kosmous.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha tous exileosoume tis amarties tous kai tha tous antameipsoume sumphona me tis kaluteres praxeis pou ekanan (del. me tis kales kai okhi me tis kakes).

Prostaxame ston anthropo ten kalosune pros tous goneis tou. Ma an (oi goneis sou) agonizontai na se kanoun na Mou apodoseis etairous ste latreia, gia tous opoious den ekheis kamia gnose (apo Emena oti einai etairoi Mou), tote men tous upakous. Pros Emena tha einai e epistrophe sas, kai tha sas enemeroso gia o,ti kanate.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha tous eisagoume anamesa stous enaretous.

Uparkhei anamesa stous anthropous ekeinos pou leei: <<Pisteuoume ston Allakh>>, alla an ton eblapsan (oi apistoi) logo tes pistes tou ston Allakh, theorei ten timoria (pou elabe) apo tous anthropous oti einai ise me ten timoria tou Allakh (kai etsi den mporei na deixei upomone sten timoria tous kai egkataleipei ten piste). Alla otan e nike erthei apo ton Kurio sou (o, Prophete, gia tous pistous), (tote tetoioi anthropoi) tha poun (stous pistous): <<Emastan mazi sas (uposterizontas sas enantia stous ekhthrous).>> De gnorizei o Allakh kalutera ti uparkhei stis kardies olon ton anthropon;
Kai (tha dokimazei o Allakh tous anthropous) gia na xerei o Allakh (-auto pou ede to xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas kai na diakhorisei) ekeinous pou pisteuoun, kai na xerei tous upokrites.

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene s' autous pou pisteuoun: <<Akoloutheste to dromo mas kai tha koubalesoume tis amarties sas.>> Alla pote de tha koubalesoun tipote apo tis amarties tous. Pragmati, einai pseutes.

Pragmati, (oi apistoi pou kaloun pros ten plane) tha koubalesoun ta bare (tis amarties) tous, kathos kai alla bare (tis ises amarties ekeinon pou tous akolouthesan s' auta pou tous akolouthesan) mazi me ta dika tous bare, kai ten Emera tes Anastases tha rotethoun gia o,ti epinoesan.
Pragmati, steilame ton Noe ston lao tou, kai emeine anamesa tous khilia khronia meion penenta khronia. Kai tous eplexe o Kataklusmos, eno etan adikoi.
Alla sosame auton (ton Noe) kai osous etan sten Kiboto kai ten kaname (ten Kiboto kai o,ti egine) os Semadi gia olous tous anthropous (gia na laboun nouthesia).
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ton Abraam otan eipe ston lao tou: <<Latrepste ton Allakh kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou). Auto einai kalutero gia sas, an mono to gnorizete.

Auta pou latreuete ektos apo ton Allakh, einai mono eidola, kai kataskeuazete psemata (oti axizoun te latreia). Pragmati, autoi pou latreuete ektos apo ton Allakh, den ekhoun kamia duname na sas parekhoun agatha. Gi' auto anazeteste ta agatha mono apo ton Allakh, latrepste Ton kai na eiste eugnomones pros Auton. Pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.
An (me) diapseusete, pragmati, kai alla ethne eikhan diapseusei (tous Aggeliaphorous tous) prin apo sas. To kathekon tou Aggeliaphorou einai mono na metadosei to menuma xekathara.>>

Den eidan (ekeinoi pou diapseudoun ten anastase) pos o Allakh demiourgei te demiourgia apo ten arkhe (eite apo ule, eita apo anuparxia) kai epeita ten epanapherei ste zoe (meta to thanato); [Opos e nekre ge anazoogoneitai otan pephtei pano tes nero]. Pragmati, auto gia ton Allakh einai kati eukolo.

Pes (o, Prophete, s' ekeinous pou diapseudoun ten anastase): <<Taxidepste ste ge kai deite pos (o Allakh) demiourgese te demiourgia apo ten arkhe [opos tous anemous, ta sunnepha kai polla alla pou ta demiourgei kai ta epanapherei sunekheia], epeita o Allakh tha demiourgesei te deutere demiourgia (ton plasmaton ten Emera tes Anastases). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.>>
Timorei opoion thelei (me te dikaiosune Tou) kai deikhnei eleos se opoion thelei (me to eleos Tou), kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.

Den mporeite na xephugete ste ge e ston ourano (apo ten timoria Tou) kai den ekhete apenanti ston Allakh kanenan kedemona oute kanenan uposterikte (pou na apotrepsei apo sas ten timoria tou Allakh).>>

Oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste sta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) tou Allakh kai ste sunantese Tou (ten Emera tes Kriseos), einai ekeinoi pou de tha ekhoun (ten Emera tes Kriseos) kamia elpida gia to eleos Mou (e gia ton Paradeiso Mou), kai ekeinoi tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

E apantese ton anthropon tou (Abraam sta logia tou) den etan para oti eipan: <<Skotoste ton e kapste ton!>> Alla o Allakh ton esose apo te photia (pou anapsan). Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.

(O Abraam) eipe: <<Ekhete parei eidola anti tou Allakh gia na ta latreuete, kai gia (na gnoristeite kai) na ekhete storge metaxu sas sten egkosmia zoe, alla ten Emera tes Anastases tha aparnetheite o enas ton allon kai tha katarasteite o enas ton allon. E katoikia sas tha einai e Photia, kai de tha ekhete uposteriktes!>>
O Lot loipon pistepse s' auton (ton Abraam). Kai (o Abraam) eipe: <<Tha metanasteuso gia khare tou Kuriou mou. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

Kharisame s' auton (ton Abraam): (ton gio tou) ton Isaak, kai (ton eggono tou) ton Iakob, kai kaname apo tous apogonous tou na uparkhoun Prophetes, kai s' autous steilame ta Biblia (ten Tora ston Mouse, to Zampour ston Dabid, to In-tzel ston Iesou kai to Kor'an ston Mokhammant). Kai tou dosame ten antamoibe tou sten egkosmia zoe, kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha einai anamesa stous enaretous.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant) ton Lot, otan eipe ston lao tou: <<Diaprattete mia tetoia epaiskhunte praxe (ten omophulophilia) pou kaneis apo olous tous anthropous den ten ekhei diapraxei prin apo sas!

Eseis (oi andres) plesiazete tous allous antres me sexoualike epaphe, stamatate tous dromous (ton taxidioton gia na tous lestepsete) kai kanete apagoreumenes praxeis stis sugkentroseis sas!>> Alla e apantese tou laou tou den etan para oti eipan: <<Phere mas ten timoria tou Allakh, an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>
(O Lot) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Uposterixe me enantia stous anthropous pou skorpizoun to kako ste ge.>>

Otan oi (Aggeloi) Aggeliaphoroi Mas erthan ston Abraam (me anthropine morphe) me ta kharmosuna nea (gia ton Isaak kai ton Iakob), eipan: <<Pragmati, tha katastrepsoume tous katoikous autes tes poles, pragmati, oi katoikoi tes einai adikoi.>>

(O Abraam) eipe: <<O Lot einai ekei!>> (Oi Aggeloi) eipan: <<Kseroume kalutera poios einai ekei. Pragmati, tha sosoume auton kai ten oikogeneia tou (diatazontas ton na phugei me ten oikogeneia tou to bradu apo ten pole), ektos apo te gunaika tou, e opoia tha meinei m' ekeinous pou tha meinoun piso (sten katastrophe).>>

Otan oi (Aggeloi) Aggeliophoroi Mas erthan ston Lot (os xenoi episkeptes kai me anthropine morphe), ekeinos (den exere oti einai Aggeloi kai phobotan gi' autous apo ton lao tou, kai) aisthantheke askhema gia ton erkhomo tous kai to stethos tou stenepse apo ten anesukhia tou gi' autous. Omos (oi Aggeloi) eipan: <<Me phobasai, oute na lupasai, pragmati, tha sosoume esena kai ten oikogeneia sou, ektos apo te gunaika sou, e opoia tha meinei m' ekeinous pou tha meinoun piso (sten katastrophe).
Pragmati, tha steiloume stous katoikous autes tes poles mia austere timoria apo ton ourano, logo tes anupakoes tous.>>

Pragmati, aphesame ap' aute [ten pole, e ten timoria] ena phanero semadi [del. mia nouthesia, e ta semadia tes katastrophe, e tis petres pou epesan pano tous apo ton ourano] gia tous anthropous pou katanooun.

Kai stous katoikous tes Madiam steilame ton adelpho tous, Sou'aimp. Eipe: <<O, lae mou! Na latreuete ton Allakh, na epidiokete ten antamoibe tes Eskhates Emeras (meso tes latreias pros Auton), kai na me skorpizete to kako ste ge.>>
Alla ekeinoi ton diepseusan, kai etsi, tous eplexe o dunatos seismos (kai e megale krauge) kai epesan nekroi me ta prosopa kai ta gonata tous ste ge tous!

Kai (katastrepsame) ton lao 'Ant kai ton lao Thamount, kati pou egine phanero se sas (o, katoikoi tes Makkas) apo tis (ereipomenes) katoikies tous (pou tis blepete sta taxidia sas). O Satanas oraiopoiese gi' ekeinous tis praxeis tous, kai etsi, tous apetrepse apo ton isio dromo, an kai eidan me sapheneia (ten kathodegese kai ten plane).
Kai (katastrepsame epises) ton Karoun, ton Pharao kai ton Khaman. O Mouses erthe s' ekeinous me xekathara Semadia, alla edeixan alazoneia ste ge. Kai den mporousan na xephugoun (apo ten timoria Mas).

Timoresame ton kathenan ap' autous gia ten amartia tou: se merikous steilame mia kataigida apo petres, allous tous katestrepse e megale krauge, allous kaname te ge na tous katapiei, kai allous tous pnixame. O Allakh de tha tous adikouse pote, alla etan oi idioi pou adikesan ton eauto tous!

To paradeigma ekeinon pou pairnoun (ta eidola kai tous pseutikous theous os) uposteriktes (kai kedemones kai tous latreuoun) ektos apo ton Allakh, einai san ekeino mias arakhnes pou ekhtise ena spiti (gia na ten prostatepsei). Pragmati, to pio adunamo spiti einai to spiti tes arakhnes, an gnorizan.

Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei o,ti epikalountai (kai latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton (kai oti auta ta eidola den apoteloun tipota, oute mporoun na ophelesoun e na blapsoun kanenan). Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
Tetoia paradeigmata parousiazoume stous anthropous, alla de tha ta sullogistoun para mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun gnose.
O Allakh demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge me ten aletheia (kai okhi askopa e mataia). Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto Semadi gia tous pistous.

Apaggeile (o, Mokhammant) o,ti staltheke se sena apo to Biblio (to Kor'an), kai telese ten proseukhe. Pragmati, e proseukhe apagoreuei kathe aiskhre praxe kai kathe apagoreumene praxe (kai apomakrunei ton anthropo ap' autes). Kai e exumnese pros ton Allakh einai spoudaiotere (apo otidepote allo), kai o Allakh gnorizei o,ti kanete.

Me suzetate me tous anthropous tou Bibliou (tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious kalontas tous pros to Islam) para me ton kalutero tropo (me xekathares apodeixeis kai kales nouthesies), ektos ap' ekeinous tous adikous anamesa tous (pou keruxan polemo enantion sas). Kai peite (s' autous): <<Pisteuoume s' auto (to Kor'an) pou staltheke se mas kai s' auto (ten prototupe Tora tou Mouse kai to prototupo In-tzel tou Iesou) pou staltheke se sas. O Theos mas kai o Theos sas einai Enas (o Allakh), kai eimaste pros Auton upotagmenoi me upakoe.>>

(Opos steilame Theia Biblia stous Aggeliaphorous prin apo sena), etsi steilame se sena (o, Mokhammant) to Biblio (to Kor'an). Ekeinoi stous opoious dosame to Biblio (ten Tora kai to In-tzel) pisteuoun s' auto (to Kor'an), [del. oi Khristianoi kai oi Ebraioi pou aspastekan to Islam, opos o Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam kai o Salman Al-Pharesei kai alloi, otan eidan tis perigraphes tou Mokhammant stis graphes tous], epises uparkhoun kai ekeinoi pou pisteuoun s' auto, ap' autous (tous Arabes otan eidan ta Semadia kai tis apodeixeis tou). Kai den aporriptoun ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, para mono oi apistoi!

Den apeggeiles (o, Mokhammant) kanena biblio prin ap' auto (to Kor'an), oute egrapses (kanena biblio) me to dexi sou kheri (aphou den xereis oute na grapheis, oute na diabazeis). Pragmati, (an exeres na diabazeis e na grapheis prin to Kor'an), tote tha ampheballan oi anthropoi tes planes.

Okhi (den uparkhei amphibolia sto Kor'an), alla auto (to Kor'an) einai xekathara Edaphia sta stethe ekeinon stous opoious dotheke gnose, kai den aporriptoun ta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas para mono oi adikoi.

Eipan (oi apistoi): <<An tou stelnontousan (ston Mokhammant) Semadia apo ton Kurio tou (ap' auta pou zetesame, opos to na metatrepsei to lopho As-Sapha se khruso e na aphairesei ta bouna tes Makkas kai na kanei stis theseis tous kepous, tha eikhame pistepsei)!>> Pes: <<Pragmati, ta Semadia ta stelnei mono o Allakh (opote thelei, sumphona me te Sophia Tou kai okhi me tous pothous sas, kai gnorizei an anazetate ten alazoneia e ten kathodegese), kai eimai mono enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia!
Den tous eparkei oti ekhoume steilei se sena to Biblio (to Kor'an), to opoio apaggelletai s' autous; Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto eleos kai upenthumise (nouthesia) gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Arkei oti o Allakh einai o Marturas anamesa se mena kai se sas. Gnorizei ola osa uparkhoun stous ouranous kai ste ge. Osoi pisteuoun sten plane kai arnountai ten piste ston Allakh, ekeinoi einai oi khamenoi!>>

Sou zetoun (o, Prophete) na epispeuseis ton erkhomo tes timorias. An den eikhe ede kathoristei (apo ton Allakh) mia sugkekrimene stigme (gia ten timoria tous, ten opoia den mporoun na ten anabaloun, oute na ten phernoun noritera), tha tous eikhe erthei e timoria. Pragmati, tha tous erthei xaphnika, eno den ten perimenoun.
Sou zetoun (o, Prophete) na epispeuseis ton erkhomo tes timorias. Pragmati, e Kolase tha periballei tous apistous.
Ten Emera pou tha tous perikuklosei to marturio apo pano tous kai apo kato apo ta podia tous, kai tha pei (o Allakh): <<Geuteite (to marturio gia) o,ti kanate!>>
O, douloi Mou pou pisteuete! Pragmati, e ge Mou einai platia (gia na metanastepsete an antimetopizete diogmous logo tes pistes sas), etsi, latreuete mono Emena!
Kathe psukhe tha geutei ton thanato, epeita pros Emas tha epistrepsete oloi.

Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, pragmati tha tous kanoume na katoikesoun se upsela epipeda ston Paradeiso, kato apo ta opoia (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta. Poso exairetike einai e antamoibe ekeinon pou eprattan (tis enaretes praxeis)!
Oi opoioi upemeinan karterika kai empisteuontai ton Kurio tous.

Polla zoa den koubaloun ta agatha tous (apothekeuontas ta gia ten epomene mera)! Einai o Allakh pou parekhei agatha s' auta (ta zoa) kai se sas, (etsi me phobaste apo ten peina gia na metanastepsete -apo te Makka pros te Mantina-). Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).

An (o, Prophete) tous rotouses (tous eidololatres): <<Poios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge, kai ekane ton elio kai te selene upotagmena (na uperetoun tous doulous Tou);>>, tha elegan: <<O Allakh.>> Pos loipon apomakrunontai (apo ten piste ston Allakh kai latreuoun pseutikous theous);
O Allakh parekhei aphthona agatha se opoious thelei apo tous doulous Tou, e ta periorizei gi' autous (pou thelei, sumphona me te Sophia Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

An (o, Prophete) tous rotouses (tous eidololatres): <<Poios stelnei apo ton ourano nero, me to opoio anazoogonei te ge meta ton thanato tes;>>, tha elegan: <<O Allakh.>> Pes: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh (pou phanerose ten aletheia apo ten omologia sas)>>, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de sullogizontai.
Aute e egkosmia zoe den einai para diaskedase kai paikhnidi, alla e Mellousa Zoe einai e alethine monime zoe, an mono to gnorizoun!

Otan (oi eidololatres) epibibazontai se ena ploio, epikalountai ton Allakh me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton (na tous sosei apo ton pnigmo). Alla otan tous sozei kai phtanoun ste steria, apodidoun s' Auton etairous ste latreia,
gia na deixoun akharistia se o,ti tous dosame (apo eleos kai eunoies)! As apolambanoun (gia ligo)! Pragmati, tha mathoun (tis sunepeies tes akharistias kai tes apistias tous).

De blepoun oti kaname ena Iero kai asphales meros (te Makka, opou katoikoun me asphaleia logo tou Ierou Oikou pou ton doxazoun oi arabikes phules), eno oi anthropoi (ton allon phulon) guro tous arpazontai (me phono kai aikhmalosia); Einai dunaton oti pisteuoun sten plane, alla pros tis khares tou Allakh, einai akharistoi;

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou mekhaneuetai pseude enantion tou Allakh (apodidontas s' Auton etairous ste latreia) e diapseudei ten aletheia aphou tou erthe (me ton Aggeliaphoro)! Den uparkhei sten Kolase topos katoikias gia tous apistous;

Oso gi' autous pou agonizontai sto dromo Mas (enantion: ton pothon tous, ton apiston kai tou Satana), tha tous kathodegesoume sta monopatia Mas (ston Isio Dromo). Pragmati, o Allakh (me ten uposterixe Tou) einai mazi m' ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo!

A, L, M [Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an -Koranio- pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Oi (Khristianoi) Buzantinoi ettethekan (apo tous Perses),
sten kontinotere (e ste khamelotere) ge, kai meta apo ten etta tous, tha nikesoun (oi Buzantinoi tous Perses),
mesa se merika khronia (mekhri deka khronia). Ston Allakh anekei e krise prin kai meta. Ekeine ten emera tha kharoun oi pistoi (oi Mousoulmanoi),

gia te nike pou tha dosei o Allakh (stous Khristianous), [oi Mousoulmanoi eukhethekan na kerdisoun oi Khristianoi epeide s' autous staltheke o Prophetes Iesous me to Theio Biblio <<In-tzel>>, eno oi eidololatres eukhethekan na kerdisoun oi Perses pou latreuan eidola kai photia]. (O Allakh) dinei nike se opoious thelei. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Aute einai mia uposkhese apo ton Allakh. O Allakh den athetei pote ten uposkhese Tou, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de to gnorizoun,
gnorizoun omos mono mia exoterike pleura tes egkosmias zoes (ta khremata, ta stolidia kai tis apolauseis), eno einai adiaphoroi gia te Mellousa Zoe!

De sullogizontai ton eauto tous (pos tous demiourgese o Allakh); De demiourgese o Allakh tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous para mono me ten aletheia (kai okhi askopa), kai (orise gi' autous) mia kathorismene stigme (ten Emera tes Kriseos). Pragmati, polloi anthropoi arnountai ten piste ste sunantese me ton Kurio tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos).

Den taxidepsan ste ge gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin ap' autous; Etan pio iskhuroi ap' autous, ekhtisan perissotera kai pio dunata khtisimata ste ge, kai ezesan s' auten perissotera apo o,ti ekhoun zesei (oi eidololatres). Oi Aggeliaphoroi tous erthan s' ekeinous me xekathares apodeixeis. De tha tous adikouse pote o Allakh, alla etan oi idioi pou adikesan ton eauto tous!

Epeita to telos ekeinon pou dieprattan to kako, etan to kheirotero (del. katastraphekan kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha mpoun sten Kolase), epeide diepseudan ta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) tou Allakh kai ta khleuazan.

O Allakh demiourgei te demiourgia apo ten arkhe (eite apo ule, eite apo anuparxia, kai khoris kanena proegoumeno protupo), epeita ten epanapherei (ste zoe, meta apo to thanato), epeita pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.
Ten Emera pou tha ginei e Ora, tha apelpistoun oi kakoi (oi apistoi).
De tha ekhoun kanenan mesolabete ap' ekeinous pou tous apedidan ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia, kai (oi apistoi) tha tous aparnethoun.
Ten Emera pou tha ginei e Ora, tote tha diakhoristoun (oi pistoi apo tous apistous).
Oso gi' ekeinous pou pistepsan kai ekanan enaretes praxeis, tha einai se kepo (del. ston Paradeiso) opou tha khairontai kai tha apolambanoun.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseusan ta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas kai te sunantese tes Mellousas Zoes, tha tous pheroun sto marturio.
Doxa ston Allakh (del. doxaste Ton sten proseukhe) otan einai bradu (stis proseukhes Magrimp kai 'Isa') kai otan einai proi (sten proseukhe Phatzr).
S' Auton anekei olos o epainos stous ouranous kai ste ge, kai (doxaste Ton) to apogeuma (sten proseukhe 'Asr) kai otan einai mesemeri (sten proseukhe Doukhr).
Bgazei ton zontano apo ton nekro, kai bgazei ton nekro apo ton zontano. Anazoogonei te (nekre) ge meta ton thanato tes, kai etsi tha bgeite (zontanoi xana apo tous taphous sas).
Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai oti sas demiourgese apo khoma, epeita idou eiste anthropoi (apo sarka kai aima) pou skorpizeste (ste ge)!

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai oti eplase gia sas suzugous apo sas tous idious, gia na breite eirene kai anapause s' autes, kai ethese metaxu sas storge kai eleos. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia tous anthropous pou sullogizontai.
Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai e demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai e diaphora metaxu ton glosson kai ton khromaton sas. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia osous ekhoun gnose.

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai o upnos sas te nukhta, kai e emera (pou diadekhetai te nukhta), kai e epidioxe sas gia te gennaiodoria Tou (meso ton ergasion sas). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia tous anthropous pou akoun.

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai oti sas deikhnei tis astrapes, prokalontas sas phobo (apo tous keraunous) kai elpida (gia sas gia te brokhe), kai stelnei apo ton ourano nero, me to opoio anazoogonei te ge meta ton thanato tes. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia tous anthropous pou sullogizontai.

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai oti stekontai stathera o ouranos kai e ge me ten entole Tou (khoris kolones kai khoris na katarreuoun). Epeita, otan tha sas kalesei me ena mono kalesma gia na bgeite apo te ge, tote amesos tha bgeite (apo tous taphous sas).
S' Auton anekoun oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai ste ge. Oloi einai upotagmenoi me upakoe pros Auton (kai ten entole Tou: apo ten uparxe, te zoe, to thanato kai ten anastase tous).

Einai Autos pou demiourgei te demiourgia apo ten arkhe (eite apo ule, eite apo anuparxia, kai khoris kanena proegoumeno protupo), kai epeita ten epanapherei (ste zoe meta ton thanato tes), kai auto einai (akoma) eukolotero gi' Auton. S' Auton anekei e Upsiste Perigraphe stous ouranous kai ste ge. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Parathetei gia sas (o, eidololatres) ena paradeigma apo esas tous idious: Ekhete metaxu ton sklabon sas, sunetairous pou moirazontai exisou mazi sas o,ti parekhoume se sas (apo agatha kai ploute), kai etsi phobaste ap' autous (mepos paroun to meridio tous kai phugoun), opos (eseis oi eleutheroi) phobaste o enas (sunetairos) ton allon; [Pos loipon apodidete ston Allakh etairous;] Etsi diasaphenizoume ta Edaphia gia tous anthropous pou sullogizontai!

Okhi (den epithumeite na ekhete sunetairous apo tous sklabous sas sta ploute sas), alla oi adikoi akolouthoun tis epithumies tous khoris kamia gnose. Poios mporei na kathodegesei ekeinous pou tous ekane o Allakh na parastratesoun (logo tes adikias kai tes apistias tous); De tha ekhoun uposteriktes.

These loipon (o, Prophete) to prosopo sou me aphosiose pros te threskeia (to Islam) akolouthontas ten kai parekklinontas apo oles tis pseutikes threskeies. Einai e threskeia tou Allakh sten opoia demiourgese tous anthropous. Den uparkhei allage ste threskeia tou Allakh (kai men ten allaxete me ton polutheismo kai ten apistia). Aute einai e orthe threskeia, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.

(Theste, o, Prophete, esu kai oi pistoi ta prosopa sas pros te threskeia) strephomenoi pros Auton me metameleia, phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou), teleite ten proseukhe kai men eiste ap' ekeinous pou apodidoun etairous ston Allakh ste latreia,

ap' ekeinous pou diairesan te threskeia tous (te threskeia tou Abraam, -to Islam-) kai diaspastekan se aireseis (Ioudaismo kai Khristianismo klp.), kathe airese khairetai m' auto pou ekhei (nomizontas oti mono aute ekhei ten aletheia).

Otan oi kakoukhies plettoun tous anthropous, epikalountai ton Kurio tous, strephomenoi pros Auton me metameleia. Epeita otan tous dinei eleos ap' Auton (aphairontas tis kakoukhies tous), tote mia omada ap' autous apodidoun etairous ston Kurio tous ste latreia,
gia na deixoun akharistia se o,ti tous dosame (apo eleos kai eunoies)! Apolauste (gia ligo), pragmati, tha mathete (tis sunepeies tes akharistias kai tes apistias sas).
E eikhame steilei ena epikheirema (kai ena Biblio), to opoio milaei uposterizontas o,ti apodidoun (oi eidololatres) apo etairous s' Auton ste latreia;

Otan dinoume stous anthropous eleos (kai eunoia apo ploute e kale ugeia klp.), khairontai m' auto. Ma an tous plexoun oi kakoukhies gia o,ti diepraxan (apo kakes praxeis), apelpizontai (san na men uparkhei diexodos apo tis kakoukhies)!

De blepoun oti o Allakh parekhei agatha me aphthonia se opoious thelei, kai ta periorizei (gia opoious thelei, sumphona me te Sophia Tou)! Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun.

Dose, loipon, ston suggene sou to dikaioma tou (terontas kalous desmous suggeneias), kai ston endee kai ston odoiporo (dose tou eleemosune). Auto einai kalutero gi' ekeinous pou epizetoun ten eukharistese tou Allakh, kai ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

O,ti khremata dinete me skopo ten tokogluphia gia na auxethoun apo ta khremata ton anthropon, de tha auxethoun enopion tou Allakh (del. de tha ta eulogesei, alla tha ta katastrepsei). O,ti dinete se eleemosune, epizetontas ten eukharistese tou Allakh, tote ekeinoi (pou dinoun se eleemosune) tha einai autoi pou tha ekhoun pollaples antamoibes (apo ton Allakh).

O Allakh einai Autos pou sas demiourgese, epeita sas parekhei agatha, epeita tha aphairesei te zoe sas kai epeita tha sas epanapherei ste zoe! Uparkhei kapoios ap' ekeinous pou tous apodidete ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia, pou mporei na kanei kati ap' auta; Doxa s' Auton, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun apo etairous (kai pseutikous theous) ste latreia!

To kako (oi kakoukhies, oi astheneies, e elleipse eulogias, kai e elleipse brokhes kai karpon) emphanisteke ste ge kai te thalassa, exaitias oson dieprattan oi anthropoi (apo kakes praxeis). (Emphanisteke) gia na tous kanei (o Allakh) na geutoun meros autou pou dieprattan, isos na straphoun (me metameleia pros Auton).
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Taxidepste ste ge, kai koitaxte pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin. Oi perissoteroi ex auton, apedidan ston Allakh etairous ste latreia!>>

These, loipon, (o, Prophete) to prosopo sou me aphosiose pros ten orthe threskeia (to Islam), protou erthei mia Emera apo ton Allakh, pou tipote den mporei na ten apotrepsei. Ekeine ten Emera oi anthropoi tha khoristoun (se pistous, kai apistous).
Opoios arnetheke ten piste, tha koubalesei ten apistia tou, alla opoios ekane enaretes praxeis, (tetoioi anthropoi) ekhoun etoimasei gia ton eauto tous (ton dromo gia na mpoun ston Paradeiso).
(Oi anthropoi tha khoristoun se duo omades) oste na antameipsei (o Allakh) apo te khare Tou, ekeinous pou pisteuan kai ekanan enaretes praxeis. Pragmati, Autos den agapaei tous apistous!

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai oti stelnei tous anemous os kharmosuna nea (gia te brokhe), kai gia na sas dosei apo to eleos Tou (euemeria), na pleusoun ta ploia me ten entole Tou, kai na anazetesete apo te gennaioteta Tou (meso ton ergasion kai tou emporiou sas), kai isos na eiste eugnomones.

Pragmati, steilame prin apo sena (o, Prophete) Aggeliaphorous stous laous tous, kai erthan s' autous me xekathares apodeixeis (alla tous diepseusan). Etsi, ekdikethekame autous pou dieprattan to kako. Pragmati, einai mia uposkhese apo Emas to na uposterixoume tous pistous.

O Allakh einai Autos pou stelnei tous anemous, oi opoioi demiourgoun kai kinoun ta sunnepha, meta (o Allakh) ta aplonei (ta sunnepha) ston ourano opos thelei, kai ta khorizei se diaphora kommatia, kai meta blepeis te brokhe na pephtei apo mesa tous. Otan te stelnei (te brokhe) se opoious thelei apo tous doulous Tou, tote khairontai,
an kai etan prin stalei s' autous, apelpismenoi.

Koita, loipon, ta semadia tou eleous tou Allakh (del. tis sunepeies tes brokhes), pos (o Allakh) anazoogonei (m' aute te brokhe) te ge meta to thanato tes. Pragmati, Autos (pou edose zoe ste nekre ge), einai Autos pou tha anastesei tous nekrous, kai einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
An stelname enan (dunato) anemo kai tis eblepan (tis kalliergeies tous) na kitrinizoun (del. khalasmenes), tha emenan meta ap' auto, akharistoi (gia o,ti eunoies tous pareikhame prin)!

Esu (o, Prophete) den mporeis na kaneis tous nekrous (del. pou ekhoun nekres kardies logo tes apistias) na akousoun, oute mporeis na kaneis tous kophous na akousoun ten klese (sou), otan apomakrunontai (apo sena)!

Oute mporeis (o, Prophete) na kathodegeseis tous tuphlous apomakrunontas tous apo ten plane tous! Den mporeis na kaneis na akousoun (ten aletheia) para mono autous pou pisteuoun sta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas, giati autoi einai oi upakouoi (pros ton Allakh).

O Allakh einai Autos pou sas demiourgese apo adunamia (apo adunames ekkriseis ton duo phulon), epeita meta apo ten adunamia, sas edose duname, epeita meta apo te duname, sas ekane se katastase adunamias kai gerateion. Demiourgei o,ti thelei, kai Autos einai o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta).

Ten Emera pou tha erthei e Ora, oi kakoi tha orkistoun oti den eikhan meinei (sten egkosmia zoe -e stous taphous tous-) para mono mia ora (lige ora). Etsi (tha poun to psema) opos (sten egkosmia zoe) apomakrunthekan (apo ten aletheia kai eipan pseudos oti de tha uparkhei anastase)!

Ekeinoi stous opoious dotheke gnose kai piste tha poun: <<Pragmati, meinate se o,ti orise o Allakh (apo ten emera tes demiourgias sas) mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases. Aute einai e Emera tes Anastases, alla den to xerate (oti einai alethine, kai etsi te diapseudate).>>
Ekeine ten Emera, de tha ophelesoun tous adikous oi dikaiologies tous, oute tha tous zetethei na anazetesoun ten eukharistese tou Allakh (meso tes metameleias kai tes upakoes)!

Ekhoume parousiasei gia tous anthropous s' auto to Kor'an kathe eidous paradeigma. An ephernes (o, Prophete) s' autous (tous apistous) kathe Semadi (eite ap' auta pou proteinan, eite apo alla), ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste tha elegan: <<Den eiste (o, Mokhammant, kai oi akolouthoi sou), para anthropoi pou akolouthoun mia plane.>>
Etsi o Allakh sphragizei tis kardies ekeinon pou den ekhoun gnose (kai katanoese gia o,ti tous epheres, o, Prophete, apo nouthesies, apodeixeis kai Semadia).

Kane, loipon, upomone (o, Prophete). Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh (gia te nike sou enantion tous) einai alethine. As me se agkhonoun (me o,ti lene e kanoun), ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun (kai as me se kanoun na apheseis ten upomone).

A, L, M [Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an -Koranio- pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Auta einai ta Edaphia tou teleiou kai sophou Bibliou (tou Kor'an).
(Ta opoia Edaphia einai) kathodegese kai eleos gi' ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.
Oi opoioi teloun ten proseukhe, dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai pisteuoun me bebaioteta ste Mellousa Zoe.
Ekeinoi briskontai se kathodegese apo ton Kurio tous kai ekeinoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

Metaxu ton anthropon uparkhei ekeinos pou agorazei (e epilegei kai epithumei) ta mataia logia (kai ta logia planes kai ta tragoudia), gia na apotrepsei (tous anthropous), khoris gnose, apo to dromo tou Allakh, kai ta pairnei (ta Edaphia kai to dromo tou Allakh) os koroidia. Tetoioi anthropoi tha ekhoun ena tapeinotiko marturio.
Otan tou apaggellontai ta Edaphia Mas, apomakrunetai me alazoneia, san na men ta akouse, san na uperkhe kophose sta autia tou. Enemerose ton loipon oti ton perimenei ena odunero marturio.
Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun tous kepous tes eudaimonias,
opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta. E uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Demiourgese tous ouranous khoris kolones, opos tous blepete, ebale stathera bouna ste ge gia na men tremei mazi sas, kai skorpise pano tes (ges) kathe eidous kinoumena (zontana) plasmata. Kai steilame apo ton ourano nero kai kaname na phutrosoun s' aute (te ge) kathe eidous kalo phuto.

Aute einai e demiourgia tou Allakh, deixte Mou, loipon, (o, eidololatres) ti ekhoun demiourgesei ekeinoi, -pou tous latreuete ektos ap' Auton-; Okhi, (de demiourgesan tipote), alla pragmati, oi adikoi briskontai se xekathare plane.

Pragmati, dosame ston Loukman te sophia (ten katanoese ste threskeia kai ten orthe krise), (legontas): <<Deixe eugnomosune pros ton Allakh.>> Opoios einai eugnomon, tha einai mono gia to kalo tou, kai opoios einai akharistos, tote pragmati o Allakh einai Ganei (Eleutheros apo kathe anagke, Plousios) kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Loukman eipe ston gio tou, nouthetontas ton: <<Gie mou! Men apodideis ston Allakh kanenan etairo ste latreia. Pragmati, e apodose etairon ston Allakh sten latreia, einai mia terastia adikia (pros ton eauto sou, pou tha se odegesei sten Kolase).>>

Prostaxame ton anthropo na deixei kalosune (kai upakoe) pros tous goneis tou. E metera tou ton koubalouse me duskolia kai kourase. Kai o apogalaktismos tou ginetai meta apo duo khronia. Deixe eugnomosune pros Emena kai tous goneis sou. Se Emena brisketai o telikos proorismos.

Ma an (oi goneis sou) agonizontai na se kanoun na Mou apodoseis etairous ste latreia, gia tous opoious (etairous) den ekheis kamia gnose, tote men tous upakous (s' auto), alla na tous suntropheueis sten egkosmia zoe me ton kalutero tropo, kai na akoloutheis ton dromo ekeinou pou strephetai pros Emena me metameleia kai upakoe. Epeita, pros Emena tha einai e epistrophe sas, kai tha sas enemeroso gia o,ti kanate.

(O Loukman eipe): <<O, gie mou! Akoma ki an (mia kale e kake praxe) ekhei (to megethos kai) to baros enos kokkou moustardas, kai einai eite mesa se ena brakho, eite stous ouranous, eite ste ge, pragmati, tha te pherei o Allakh (ten Emera tes Kriseos). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Lateiph (Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

O, gie mou! Telese ten proseukhe, prostaxe to kalo, apagoreuse to kako, kai kane upomone me o,ti se plettei (apo tous anthropous otan tous kaleis pros to kalo kai tous apagoreueis to kako). Pragmati, ola auta einai apo tis upokhreotikes praxeis (pou ekhei prostaxei o Allakh, kai khreiazontai stathere apophasistikoteta).
Men apostrepheis to prosopo sou apo tous anthropous me alazoneia, oute na perpatas ste ge me uperephaneia. Pragmati, o Allakh de sumpathei kathe alazoniko pou kaukhietai.
Na eisai metriopathes sto badisma sou (khoris alazoneia) kai khamelose te phone sou. Pragmati, e pio askheme phone, einai e phone ton gaidaron.>>
