De blepete (o, anthropoi) oti o Allakh upotaxe o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste ge (ton elio, ta zoa kai ta phuta klp.) gia na sas ophelesoun, kai sas ekhei kharisei aphthones eunoies ap' Auton, phaneres kai kruphes; Ostoso, uparkhoun anamesa stous anthropous ekeinoi pou suzetoun gia ton Allakh, khoris (na ekhoun) gnose, oute kathodegese, oute ena (Theio) Biblio pou phaneronei (ton dromo tous).

Otan legetai s' autous: <<Akoloutheste o,ti esteile o Allakh>>, lene: <<Okhi! Alla akolouthoume mono auto pou brekame tous pateres mas na akolouthoun.>> (Tha tous akolouthesoun) akoma kai an o Satanas tous kalei etsi pros to marturio tes Phlegomenes Photias;

Opoios strephei to prosopo tou pros ton Allakh me upakoe kai upotage, eno prattei to kalo, ekhei piasei to pio axiopisto kai sphikhto skhoini (pou den kobetai pote, kai etsi de tha pesei sten katastrophe). Ston Allakh anekei e katalexe olon ton upotheseon.

Opoios omos arnetheke ten piste, as me se stenakhoresei (o, Prophete) e apistia tou. Pros Emas tha einai e epistrophe tous, kai tha tous enemerosoume gia o,ti ekanan. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti uparkhei sta stethe.
Tha tous parekhoume agatha aphenontas tous stis apolauseis tous gia ligo (sten egkosmia zoe), epeita (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha tous anagkasoume na mpoun se ena sklero marturio.

An tous rotouses (o, Prophete): <<Poios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge;>> Tha elegan: <<O Allakh!>> Pes: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh (pou phanerose ten aletheia apo ten omologia sas).>> Alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de gnorizoun (kai de sullogizontai se Poion anekei olos o epainos, kai etsi, apodidoun s' Auton etairous ste latreia)!
Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai ste ge. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

An ola ta dentra ste ge (kobontousan kai) etan penes, kai e thalassa (etan melani) kai ten ephodiazan aphou teleione, alles epta thalasses, akoma ta logia tou Allakh de tha exantlountan (gia na ta grapsoun). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

E demiourgia sas kai e anastase sas, den einai para opos (e demiourgia kai e anastase) mias kai mono psukhes. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh eisagei te nukhta sten emera, kai eisagei ten emera ste nukhta (del. auxanei kai meionei tis ores tous, to kheimona kai to kalokairi), kai oti ekhei upotaxei ton elio kai to pheggari (gia na sas ophelesoun), kai o kathenas tous trekhei (sten trokhia tou) gia ena kathorismeno khrono, kai oti o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose;

Auto epeide o Allakh einai o Al-Khakk (o Enas Alethinos Theos), kai o,ti epikalountai (kai latreuoun oi apistoi), ektos ap' Auton, einai plane, kai o Allakh einai o Al-'Alei (Upsistos), o Al-Kampeir (Megas).
De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti ta ploia pleoun ste thalassa me te khare tou Allakh, gia na sas deixei merika apo ta Semadia Tou; Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia kathe upomonetiko kai eugnomon.

Otan tous periballoun ta kumata san ta bouna (pou tous skiazoun), epikalountai ton Allakh me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton kai mono. Alla otan tous sozei kai phtanoun ste steria, tote merikoi ap' autous einai metriopatheis (sto na deixoun eugnomosune pros ton Allakh, kai merikoi ap' autous ginontai akharistoi). Pragmati, den aporriptei ta Semadia Mas, para kathe akharistos prodotes.

O, anthropoi! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Kuriou sas (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai na phobaste mia Emera, kata ten opoia kanenas pateras de tha ophelesei ton gio tou, oute kanenas gios tha ophelesei ton patera tou. E uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine, epomenos men aphesete na sas exapatesei e egkosmia zoe, oute na aphesete na sas exapatesei autos pou exapataei (eite einai o diabolos, eite einai enas anthropos) kai na sas apomakrunei apo ton dromo tou Allakh.

Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei te gnose gia ten Ora (pote tha ginei), stelnei te brokhe kai gnorizei ti uparkhei stis metres. Kamia psukhe den xerei ti tha kerdisei aurio, kai kamia psukhe den xerei se poia ge tha pethanei! Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

A, L, M [Aliph-Lam-Meim, tria xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an -Koranio- pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Aute einai) e apokalupse tou Bibliou, sto opoio den uparkhei kamia amphibolia, (kai to opoio apokaluphtheke) apo ton Kurio olon ton Kosmon.

E lene (oi eidololatres) oti (o Mokhammant) to ekhei epinoesei (to Kor'an); Okhi (den to epinoeses), alla einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio sou, gia na proeidopoieseis enan lao, ston opoio den ekhei stalei kanenas proeidopoietes prin apo sena, isos kai na kathodegethoun.

Einai o Allakh pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous se exi Emeres, epeita upsotheke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei sten Megaloprepeia Tou). Den ekhete enanti tou Allakh kanenan kedemona (pou mporei na sas prostatepsei), oute kanenan diamesolabete (pou mporei na mesolabesei gia sas enopion tou Allakh khoris ten adeia Tou). De tha to labete upopse loipon;

Dieuthetei ola ta zetemata apo ton ourano pros te ge, epeita anebainoun (zetemata) pros Auton, se mia Emera, e diarkeia tes opoias einai khilia khronia ap' auta pou metrate (sten egkosmia zoe). [bl. Sourat Al-Khatz 22:47].
Autos einai o Pantognostes tou aoratou kai tou oratou, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
O Opoios teleiopoiese o,ti demiourgese, kai demiourgese apo ten arkhe ton anthropo (ton Adam) apo pelo (khoris proegoumeno protupo).
Epeita demiourgese tous apogonous tou apo ekkriseis adunamou ugrou (kai ton duo phulon).
Epeita ton diamorphose kai tou emphusese to pneuma pou demiourgese. Demiourgese gia sas ten akoe, ten orase kai tis kardies. Ligo omos einai auto pou deikhnete apo eugnomosune (pros Auton).

Lene (oi apistoi): <<Einai dunaton oti aphou (pethanoume kai) khathoume ste ge, tha demiourgethoume xana (kai tha anastethoume);>> Okhi (den anazetoun ten aletheia), alla arnountai na pistepsoun ste sunantese me ton Kurio tous!
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Tha aphairesei te zoe sas, o Aggelos tou thanatou, pou tou anethese (o Allakh) na aphairesei te zoe sas, epeita tha epistrepsete ston Kurio sas.>>

An eblepes (o, Prophete, ten Emera tes Kriseos) tous kakous otan tha khamelosoun (me atimose) ta kephalia tous enopion tou Kuriou tous (kai tha poun): <<Kurie mas! Tora blepoume (te Mellousa Zoe pou te diapseusame prin) kai akoume. Steile mas piso (sten egkosmia zoe), gia na praxoume enaretes praxeis. Pragmati, tora pisteuoume me bebaioteta (ste Mellousa Zoe).>>, (tote tha eblepes poso athlia einai e katastase tous)!

An thelame, tha eikhame dosei se kathe anthropo (ap' autous tous apistous) ten kathodegese tou, alla o Logos Mou (me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun), tha ekplerothei: <<Pragmati, tha gemiso ten Kolase me osous apo ta tzinn kai tous anthropous mazi (tha akolouthesoun ton Satana).>> [Bl. Sourat Al-A'raph 7:18]

(Kai tha eipothei s' autous): <<Geuteite (ten timoria) epeide adiaphorousate gia te sunantese autes tes Emeras (tou apologismou) sas (kai esastan apaskholemenoi me tous pothous sas). Kai Emeis tha sas aphesoume (sten timoria). Geuteite to aionio marturio gia o,ti kanate.>>

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou pisteuoun sta Edaphia Mas, einai mono autoi pou otan tous upenthumizoun gi' auta (kai tous nouthetoun m' auta), pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) kai doxazoun ton Kurio tous eugnomonontas Ton, kai de deikhnoun alazoneia.

(Oi opoioi sekonontai kata te nukhta apo ton upno, kai) ton opoion ta pleura apomakrunontai apo ta krebatia, gia na epikalestoun ton Kurio tous me phobo kai elpida, kai apo o,ti tous parekhoume, xodeuoun (se eleemosune).
Kamia psukhe den xerei ti (ekhei etoimastei kai ti) einai krummeno gi' autous (tous pistous) apo antamoibe pou tha tous kanei kharoumenous! Mia antamoibe gia o,ti ekanan (apo enaretes praxeis).
Einai autos pou einai pistos isos m' ekeinon pou einai anupakouos; Okhi, den einai isoi.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun tous kepous tes monimes katoikias, os antamoibe gia o,ti ekanan.

Oso omos gia tous anupakouous, e katoikia tous tha einai e Photia. Kathe phora pou prospathoun na bgoun ap' aute, tha epistraphoun s' auten, kai tha eipothei s' autous: <<Geuteite to marturio tes Photias pou to diapseudate (sten egkosmia zoe).>>

Pragmati, tha tous kanoume (tous anupakouous) na geutoun te mikrotere timoria (apo kakoukhies sten egkosmia zoe) prin apo te megale timoria (ste Mellousa Zoe), isos na epistrepsoun (me metameleia pros ton Allakh).
Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou ton nouthetesan me ta Edaphia tou Kuriou tou, alla epeita apostrapheke ap' auta; Pragmati, tha ekdikethoume tous kakous.

Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora), opote men ekheis kamia amphibolia (o, Mokhammant) gia te sunantese tou [del. oti tha sunanteseis ton Mouse sto nukhterino taxidi, -e oti o Mouses elabe to Biblio kai epharmose tis entoles tou-, -e oti elabes to Kor'an opos elabe o Mouses ten Tora]. Kai to kaname (ten Tora) kathodegese gia ta paidia tou Israel.

Kaname merikous ap' autous (apo ta paidia tou Israel) egetes, pou kathodegoun (tous allous pros te latreia Mas) me ten entole Mas, otan edeikhnan upomone kai pisteuan me bebaioteta sta Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) Mas.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) einai Autos pou tha krinei metaxu tous ten Emera tes Anastases, se o,ti diaphonousan.

Den einai akome saphes s' autous (tous eidololatres ste Makka), posa (apista) ethne katastrepsame pou etan prin ap' autous, kai stis katoikies ton opoion perpatoun (kai blepoun ta semadia tes katastrophes tous); Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia. Ma den akoun;

De blepoun (oi apistoi pou diapseudoun ten anastase) oti Emeis stelnoume to nero sten agone ge, kai kanoume m' auto na phutronoun kalliergeies, apo tis opoies trone ta booeide tous kai oi idioi; Ma de blepoun;
Lene (oi apistoi pou diapseudoun ten anastase): <<Pote tha einai aute e Krise (e Emera tes Kriseos, pou tha krinei metaxu mas, opos iskhurizeste, o, Mousoulmanoi), an eiste eilikrineis;>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ten Emera ekeines tes Krises, de tha ophelesei ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, to na pistepsoun tote, oute tha tous dothei kamia anabole.>>
Apomakrunsou, loipon, (o, Prophete) ap' autous, kai perimene (ti tha tous kanei o Allakh), kai autoi perimenoun (auta pou tous uposkhethekes apo ten timoria kai ten Emera tes Kriseos)!

O, Prophete! Na parameneis statheros sto na phulakhtheis apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), kai men upakous tous apistous kai tous upokrites. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
Akoloutha o,ti sou apokaluptetai apo ton Kurio sou. Pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete, ekhei plere gnose.
Enapothese ten epistosune sou ston Allakh. Eparkei o Allakh os Uposteriktes kai Diakheiristes (olon ton upotheseon).

O Allakh den ekane gia kanenan antra duo kardies mesa tou, oute ekane tis gunaikes sas, pou tis kathistate apagoreumenes gia sas (me to apagoreumeno eidos diazugiou Ad-Dikhar), na einai oi pragmatikes meteres sas, oute ekane tous thetous sas gious (pou tous dinete to epitheto sas), na einai oi pragmatikoi sas gioi. Auta einai ta logia sas pou lete (eno den iskhuoun), alla o Allakh leei ten aletheia kai Autos kathodegei ston isio dromo.

Apokaleste tous (uiothetemenous gious) me ta epitheta ton pateron tous (kai okhi me ta epitheta sas), auto einai pio dikaio enopion tou Allakh. Alla an de gnorizete tous pateres tous, tote (oi uiothetemenoi gioi sas) einai adelphia sas ste threskeia kai apeleutheromenoi douloi sas (me tous opoious ekhete stene skhese, san tes suggeneias, kai etsi phonaxte tous <<adelphe>> e me to onoma tous khoris na tous dosete ta epitheta sas). Den uparkhei amartia se sas gi' auto pou kanete kata lathos (to na tous apokalesete kata lathos me to epitheto ekeinon pou tous uiothetesan), alla (tha uparkhei amartia se sas) gia o,ti kanete me skopime prothese sten kardia sas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Prophetes einai pio konta stous pistous apo ton eauto tous [kai ekhei pio eleos gi' autous apo ton eauto tous, kai tha prepei na ton upakoun kai na ton agapoun perissotero apo ton eauto tous, kai an kapoios pethanei khreomenos e ekhei mikra paidia, o Prophetes tha phrontisei to khreos kai ta paidia tou]. Kai oi gunaikes tou (Prophete) einai oi meteres tous (ton piston, del. den epitrepetai kanenas na pantreutei mia ap' autes meta to thanato tou Prophete). Oi suggeneis ex aimatos ekhoun megalutero dikaioma na kleronomesei o enas ton allon sumphona me ten krise tou Allakh, apo tous allous pistous kai tous metanastes (pou einai adelphoi tous ste threskeia)! [O Prophetes ekhei demiourgesei mia sundese adelphosunes metaxu ton piston tes Medinas kai ton metanaston pou erthan apo te Mekka]. Ektos an kanete stous adelphous sas ste threskeia, kalosune (kai orisete eleemosune ste diatheke sas, tote den uparkhei tipota mempto se sas). Auto ekhei graphtei sto Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan Emeis perame mia desmeuse apo olous tous prophetes, kai apo sena, ton Noe, ton Abraam, ton Mouse kai ton Iesou, ton uio tes Marias. Perame apo olous tous mia iskhure desmeuse.

Gia na rotesei tous eilikrineis (Aggeliaphorous, ti tous apantesan oi laoi tous) skhetika me ten eilikrineia tous (del. ten aletheia pros ten opoia tous kalesan)! Kai ekhei etoimasei gia tous apistous ena odunero marturio.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Thumetheite ten eunoia tou Allakh pros esas (ste makhe Al-Khanntak -tou Khantakiou-, e Al-Akhzamp -ton summakhikon phulon-) otan erthan enantion sas stratiotes (deka khiliades apo tis Arabikes phules kai sas perikuklosan ste Mantina, se sunomosia me tous Ebraious tes Mantinas pou prodosan te sumphonia tous me ton Prophete), alla steilame enantion tous enan biaio anemo (pou ebgale tis skenes tous) kai stratiotes (apo Aggelous) pou den tous eidate, (kai etsi, ephugan ettemenoi khoris polemo). Pragmati, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

Otan erthan (oi apistoi) apo pano sas kai apo kato sas (apo ten koruphe kai to kato meros tes koiladas), kai ta matia sas koitousan mono pros tous ekhthrous sas, kai oi kardies sas ephtasan stous laimous sas (apo to phobo), kai nomizate diaphores skepseis gia ton Allakh (del. oi upokrites nomizan oti o Prophetes kai oi pistoi tha ettethoun, eno oi pistoi etan bebaioi gia te nike apo ton Allakh).
Ekei oi pistoi dokimastekan kai klonistekan entona.

Kai otan oi upokrites kai autoi pou eikhan ten arrostia (tes amphibolias) stis kardies tous (kai eikhan aduname piste), eipan: <<Auto pou mas uposkhethekan o Allakh kai o Aggeliophoros Tou (gia nike), den einai para mono plane!>>

Kai otan mia omada ap' autous (tous upokrites) eipe: <<O, anthropoi tes Giathrimp (Mantinas, pou bgekate gia na polemesete), den uparkhei gia sas these edo, opote epistrepste (sta spitia sas).>> Mia alle omada ap' autous zetese ten adeia tou Prophete gia na phugoun, legontas: <<Ta spitia mas einai ektetheimena (konta stous ekhthrous, gi' auto dose mas ten adeia na pame na ta prostatepsoume)>>, parolo pou den etan ektetheimena, alla den ethelan para mono te diaphuge.

An (oi apistoi) empainan s' autous (tous upokrites) apo oles tis pleures tes poles, kai tous zetousan na epistrepsoun sten apistia kai ten eidololatria, tha to eikhan kanei kai de tha kathusterousan para mono gia ligo.

(Ekeinoi oi upokrites) eikhan ede dosei uposkhese pros ton Allakh prin, oti de tha trapoun se phuge (apo opoiadepote makhe). Pragmati, gia ten uposkhese pou dinoun ston Allakh, tha tous rotesei (o Allakh kai tha tous timoresei an ten athetesoun)!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<E phuge de tha sas ophelesei, an phugete apo (te makhe phoboumenoi) to thanato e to na skototheite, [aphou kathe psukhe ekhei mia kathorismene ora gia to thanato tes], akoma kai (an phugete, alla e kathorismene ora sas den ekhei erthei akoma) tote de tha apolausete para mono gia ligo (mekhri na erthei e kathorismene ora sas).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Poios mporei na sas prostateusei apo ton Allakh, an thelei na sas plexei kati kako, e an thelei gia sas eleos;>> De tha broun gia ton eauto tous apenanti ston Allakh kanenan kedemona, oute kanenan uposterikte (pou na tous prostatepsei)!

O Allakh gnorizei ekeinous (tous upokrites) anamesa sas pou apotharrunoun tous allous (apo to na polemesoun mazi me ton Prophete), kai ekeinous pou lene stous adelphous tous: <<Elate pros emas (kai men pegainete ste makhe gia na men pethanete).>>, kai den erkhontai ste makhe para spania (gia na men ntrapoun kai okhi gia na uposterixoun te threskeia tou Allakh)!

(Ekeinoi oi upokrites) einai tsigkounedes mazi sas (kai den xodeuoun gia te makhe). Otan erkhetai o phobos (kai xekinaei e makhe), tous blepeis (o, Prophete) na se koitoun me ta matia tous na gurizoun san auton pou brisketai ste dine tou thanatou! Alla otan phugei o phobos (kai teleiosei e makhe), sas blaptoun (o, pistoi) me skleres glosses, kai ekhoun aplestia gia ta laphura. Ekeinoi den pisteuoun pragmatika, opote o Allakh katestese tis kales praxeis tous mataies, kai auto einai kati eukolo gia ton Allakh.

Nomizoun (oi upokrites apo to phobo tous) oti oi summakhikes phules den ekhoun phugei akoma. Kai an oi summakhikes phules erkhontousan xana, tha ethelan (oi upokrites) na eleipan (apo te Mantina kai na etan) sten eremo mazi me tous Bedouinous, kai na rotesoun gia ta nea sas (meta apo te makhe). Akoma ki an etan anamesa sas (o, pistoi), de tha polemousan (mazi sas) para mono gia ligo.
Pragmati, ekhete ston Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh ena kalo paradeigma gia na akoloutheite, gia opoion epithumei ten antamoibe tou Allakh, kai te Mellousa Zoe, kai mnemoneuei ton Allakh polu.

Otan oi pistoi eidan tis summakhikes phules, eipan: <<Auto einai pou mas eikhe uposkhethei o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou (apo dokimasia kai nike), kai o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou eipan ten aletheia.>> Kai den tous auxese auto para mono se piste kai upotage (pros ton Allakh).

Anamesa stous pistous uparkhoun andres pou teresan auto pou uposkhethekan ston Allakh (to na einai statheroi kai upomonetikoi stis dokimasies kai na agonizontai sto dromo Tou). Merikoi ap' autous ekplerosan ten uposkhese tous (kai epeita epestrepsan ston Kurio tous, opos ekeinoi pou eginan martures ste makhe Mpantr), kai alloi perimenoun (sunekhizontas na ekpleronoun ten uposkhese tous), kai den ekhoun allaxei (auto pou uposkhethekan ston Allakh, opos ekanan oi upokrites).

(O Allakh dokimazei tous doulous Tou) gia na antameipsei o Allakh tous eilikrineis gia ten eilikrineia tous (kai ten upomone tous sten ekplerose autou pou uposkhethekan), kai na timoresei tous upokrites an thelei (me to na men tous kathodegesei sto na straphoun me metameleia, kai na pethanoun sten upokrisia tous) e (na tous kathodegesei sto na straphoun me metameleia kai) na dekhtei te metameleia tous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Allakh edioxe ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste orgismenous (kai apogoeteumenous, oti den petukhan te nike, kai) khoris na kerdisoun kanena kalo. Kai o Allakh ekane (me ton anemo pou esteile stous apistous) na men khreiastoun oi pistoi na mpoun se makhe. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos).

Kai ekeinous apo tous Anthropous tou Bibliou (tous Ebraious tes Mantinas) pou sterixan autous (tous apistous kai sunomotesan enantion tou Prophete kai ton piston), tous katebase (o Allakh) apo ta okhura tous, kai erixe phrike stis kardies tous. Kai etsi, mia omada te skotosate (o, pistoi) kai mia alle omada ten aikhmalotisate (ste makhe Mpani Kouraida).

(O Allakh) sas edose (o, pistoi, os laphura) te ge, ta spitia kai ta ploute tous, kai (tha sas dosei apo allous ekhthrous sas) mia ge sten opoia den ekhete patesei (akoma). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

O, Prophete! Pes stis suzugous sou: <<An epithumeite ten egkosmia zoe kai ta stolidia tes, elate na sas doso ta dikaiomata sas (ta khremata tou diazugiou) kai na sas doso ena entimo diazugio me kalosune.

Alla an epithumeite ten eukharistese tou Allakh kai tou Aggeliaphorou Tou kai ten antamoibe tes Mellousas Zoes, o Allakh ekhei etoimasei gi' ekeines apo sas pou prattoun to kalo, mia terastia antamoibe.>>
O, suzugoi tou Prophete! An mia apo sas diepratte mia xekathare epaiskhunte praxe, e timoria (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha diplasiazotan gi' auten. Auto einai eukolo gia ton Allakh.
Alla opoia apo sas upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou kai kanei enaretes praxeis, tha tes dosoume diple antamoibe kai ekhoume etoimasei gi' auten mia gennaiodore antamoibe (ston Paradeiso).

O, suzugoi tou Prophete! Den eiste san opoiadepote alle gunaika, an phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Me milate loipon me sigane phone, mepos kai kapoios me astheneia (del. lagneia e upokrisia) sten kardia tou, epithumesei. Kai peite kala logia.

Katheste (me axioprepeia kai eremia) sta spitia sas kai (otan bgeite) me stolizeste opos (ekanan oi gunaikes) sten epokhe tes protes agnoias (pro-islamike epokhe). Teleste ten proseukhe kai doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. O Allakh thelei (me o,ti sas dietaxe) na kratesei to kako makria sas, o, mele tes oikogeneias (tou Prophete), kai na sas exagnisei pleros.

Kai thumetheite (anapherete kai tereste) o,ti apaggelletai sta spitia sas apo ta Edaphia tou Allakh kai te sophia (te Sounna tou Prophete). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Lateiph (Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Pragmati, gia tous Mousoulmanous, tis Mousoulmanes, tous pistous, tis pistes, tous upakouous, tis upakoues, tous eilikrineis andres kai gunaikes, tous upomonetikous, tis upomonetikes, tous eulabeis andres kai gunaikes, autous pou dinoun eleemosune kai autes pou te dinoun, autous pou nesteuoun, autes pou nesteuoun, autous pou diaphulassoun ten agnoteta tous kai autes pou te diaphulassoun, autous pou mnemoneuoun ton Allakh polu kai autes pou Ton mnemoneuoun, gia olous autous o Allakh ekhei etoimasei sugkhorese kai mia terastia antamoibe.

Den armozei se enan pisto e se mia piste, otan orisoun o Allakh kai o Aggeliaphoros Tou kati, na ekhei alle epiloge anaphorika me to thema tou. Kai opoios parakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, pragmati ekhei parastratesei xekathara.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipes s' ekeinon (ton doulo sou pou ton apeleutheroses kai ton uiotheteses -prin o Allakh na apagorepsei ten uiothetese-, ton Zaint mpin Kharitha) pou tou kharise o Allakh mia khare (tes kathodegeses sto Islam) kai tou kharises mia khare (tes apeleutheroses tou, kai ton pantrepses me ten xaderphe sou, te Zainamp mpinet Tzakhs, kai autos erthe se sena thelontas na te khorisei): <<Krata te gunaika sou, kai phulaxou apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou)!>> Kratas mesa sou (o, Prophete, ten eidese pou o Allakh se enemerose oti o Zaint tha khorisei te Zainamp, kai epeita tha ten pantreuteis) kati pou tha to phanerosei o Allakh (meso tou diazugiou tous kai tou gamou sas), kai phobasai tous anthropous (ti tha poun, epeide theorousan prin to Islam oti o uiothetemenos uios einai san ton pragmatiko uio, kai etsi den epitrepetai na pantreutei kaneis te diazeugmene gunaika tou uiothetemenou uiou tou), eno o Allakh einai Autos pou prepei na Ton phobasai. Etsi, otan o Zaint den eikhe pia epithumia gi' auten kai te khorise, se pantrepsame m' auten, gia na xeroun oi pistoi oti den uparkhei amartia s' autous an pantreutoun tis diazeugmenes suzugous ton uiothetemenon gion tous, otan den ekhoun pia epithumia gi' autes kai tis khorisoun. Pragmati, to diatagma tou Allakh oposdepote tha ekplerothei.

Den uparkhei amartia ston Prophete gia o,ti tou epetrepse o Allakh (kai ton dietaxe na to kanei, to na pantreutei te diazeugmene gunaika tou uiothetemenou uiou tou). Autos etan o epanalambanomenos tropos tou Allakh m' ekeinous tous (Prophetes) pou etan prin (oti den uparkhei amartia gia o,ti tous epetrepse). Pragmati, e entole tou Allakh einai ena diatagma pou oposdepote tha ekplerothei.

Oi opoioi (Prophetes) metedosan ta Menumata tou Allakh kai phobethekan ap' Auton, kai de phobethekan apo kanenan allon ektos apo ton Allakh. Arkei o Allakh (gia sena, o, Mokhammant) os Autos pou gnorizei tis praxeis ton doulon Tou kai tha tous pherei se apologismo.
O Mokhammant den einai o pateras kanenos apo tous andres sas, alla einai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh, kai o teleutaios ton propheton. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Mnemoneuste ton Allakh me polle mnemoneuse,
kai doxaste Ton proi kai bradu.

Einai Autos pou (otan Ton exumneite kai doxazete) sas eleei kai sas epainei, kai oi Aggeloi Tou Ton epikalountai na sas bgalei apo ta skotadia sto Phos. Pragmati, (o Allakh) einai Eleemon pros tous pistous (kai den tous timorei an Ton upakoun).

O khairetismos tous (ton piston) ten Emera pou tha Ton sunantesoun, tha einai <<Salam (eirene kai asphaleia apo kathe kako)>>, kai (o Allakh) tous ekhei proetoimasei mia gennaiodore antamoibe (ton Paradeiso).
O, Prophete! Pragmati, se ekhoume steilei os martura, phorea kharmosunon eideseon kai proeidopoiete,
kai os enan pou kalei (tous anthropous) pros ton Allakh me ten adeia Tou kai os ena lukhnari pou diadidei phos.
Dose stous pistous ta kharmosuna nea oti tha ekhoun megale gennaiodoria apo ton Allakh.

Men upakous tous apistous kai tous upokrites kai parablepse te blabe tous (pou sou kanoun kai deixe upomone s' aute kai as me se empodisei apo to na metadideis to Menuma tou Allakh). Empisteusou ton Allakh, kai arkei o Allakh os Uposteriktes kai Diakheiristes (olon ton upotheseon).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan pantreueste tis pistes gunaikes kai epeita tis khorizete khoris na tis ekhete aggixei, tote den uparkhei upokhreose s' autes pros esas to na perimenoun ten orismene periodo anamones ('Inta) pou na ten upologisete (meta to diazugio gia na phanei an einai egkues e okhi). Doste tous loipon ena doro (os apozemiose apo ta khremata sas) kai doste tous diazugio me omorpho tropo.

O, Prophete! Pragmati, epitrepsame se sena tis gunaikes sou pou tous edoses tis proikes tous, kai tis doules sou pou sou kharise o Allakh (opos te Maria pou ten esteile o Al-Moukaoukis o basilias tes Aiguptou os doro pros ton Prophete). [Sem. opoios aspasteke to Islam alla ekhei parapano apo tesseris gunaikes, eprepe na kratesei mono tesseris kai na khorisei tis upoloipes, oi opoies tha mporousan meta na pantreutoun me allous. Omos o Allakh epetrepse ston Prophete na ekhei parapano apo tesseris suzugous gia pollous logous. An o Prophetes khorize mia, aute de tha mporouse na pantreutei me allon, epeide oi gunaikes tou einai oi meteres ton piston! Epises prin to Islam, se oles tis alles threskeies kai koinonies, den uperkhe orio suzugon gia tous andres, gia politikous, koinonikous kai oikonomikous logous, opos anapheretai stis graphes ton Khristianon kai ton Ebraion]. Kai kaname epitrepto na pantreuteis apo tis xadelphes sou -apo ten pleura ton theion sou, andron e gunaikon, eite apo ten pleura ton patera sou, eite apo ten pleura tes meteras sou-, pou ekhoun metanasteusei mazi sou. Kai kaname epitrepto na pantreuteis mia piste gunaika an e idia prospherthei ston Prophete na ten pantreutei (khoris proika), kai an o Prophetes epises epithumei na ten pantreutei. Kai (to na prospherei mia piste to gamo khoris proika) einai apokleistika gia sena, kai okhi gia tous upoloipous pistous. Gnorizoume ti ekhoume orisei s' autous (tous pistous) skhetika me tis suzugous tous (oti prepei na tous dosoun proika, na pheroun duo martures kata to sumbolaio gamou), kai skhetika me tis doules tous (an ekhoun). (Auto orisame gia sena) gia na men uparkhei amartia e duskolia se sena. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Anabaleis opoia thes ap' autes (pou prospheroun se sena to gamo, e anabaleis te seira tes dianuktereuses gia mia apo tis suzugous sou), kai pherneis pros esena opoia thes, kai den uparkhei amartia se sena an epizetas opoiadepote ap' autes pou ekheis anabalei. Auto einai plesiestero sto na einai ikanopoiemenes, na me stenokhorethoun kai na einai ikanopoiemenes m' auta pou tous dineis se oles. O Allakh gnorizei ti uparkhei stis kardies sas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khaleim (Makrothumos).

Den epitrepetai gia sena (o, Prophete) na pantreuteis alles gunaikes peran (ap' autes pou proanapherame), oute na antikatasteseis kapoia ap' autes (tis suzugous sou) me alles (me to na khoriseis mia gia na pantreuteis alle), akoma kai an tha sou arese e omorphia allon. (Den epitrepetai na pantreuteis alles gunaikes peran ap' autes pou proanapherame) ektos ap' ekeines tis doules pou katekheis. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Parateretes ton panton.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men mpeite sta spitia tou Prophete ektos na sas dothei e adeia kalontas sas gia phageto, kai khoris (na erthete noris gia) na perimenete na ginei to phageto. Alla otan kletheite, tote mpeite, kai otan phate, diaskorpisteite, kai men meinete apolambanontas o enas te sunomilia tou allou. Pragmati, auto prokalouse enokhlese ston Prophete, alla ntrepotan na sas to ekphrasei, alla o Allakh den ntrepetai na pei ten aletheia. An zetesete kati apo tis suzugous tou (opos kapoia skeue phagetou), zeteste to ap' autes eno eiste piso apo ena khorisma (e ena propetasma). Auto einai pio agno gia tis kardies sas kai tis kardies tous. Den epitrepetai na prokaleite enokhlese ston Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh, oute na pantreuteite pote tis suzugous tou meta ap' auton (aphou pethanei e an khorisei opoiadepote ap' autes), giati auto einai pragmati mia teratodes amartia enopion tou Allakh.
Eite phaneronete kati, eite to krubete, pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.

Den uparkhei amartia s' autes (tis suzugous tou Prophete) skhetika me [to na milesoun apeutheias khoris propetasma kai khoris na baloun to tzilmpamp -pou phorietai pano apo ta roukha tous- kai na deixoun ta epitrepta exoterika stolidia tous, apenanti] stous pateres [sem. mporei edo na sumperilambanontai oi theioi, opos ste Sourat Al-Mpakara 2:133 opou onomase ton theio, patera], tous gious, ta adelphia, tous gious ton adelphon -andron kai gunaikon-, tis gunaikes pou einai ap' autes [del. tis Mousoulmanes] kai tous sklabous tous. Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (o, gunaikes tou Prophete, terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Marturas.

Pragmati, o Allakh stelnei tis eulogies kai to eleos Tou ston Prophete, kai oi Aggeloi epikalountai ton Allakh na ton eulogesei kai na ton eleesei. O, eseis pou pisteuete! Epikalesteite ton Allakh na ton eulogesei kai na ton eleesei, kai na ton kratesei asphale apo kathe kako.

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou prosballoun ton Allakh (me tis amarties e me to na Tou apodidoun kati pou den tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou, opos ateleies e etairous ste latreia e enan uio) kai (prosballoun e enokhloun) ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, o Allakh tous katarasteke sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, kai etoimase gi' autous ena tapeinotiko marturio.
Kai ekeinoi pou blaptoun (lektika e me praxeis) tous pistous kai tis pistes adika, ekhoun phortothei te kheirotere sukophantia kai mia olophanere amartia.

O, Prophete! Pes stis suzugous kai stis kores sou kai stis gunaikes ton piston na kaluphthoun kala me tous mandues (tzilmpamp) tous, etsi oste na anagnorizontai (os entimes kai sebasmies gunaikes) kai na men parenokhlountai. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Ean de stamatesoun oi upokrites (pou kruboun mesa tous ten apistia eno deikhnoun ten piste) kai ekeinoi pou ekhoun arrostia (tes amphibolias, tes agapes tes moikheias kai ton lagnon) stis kardies tous, kai ekeinoi pou skorpizoun ta psemata ste Mantina (kai lene pseudos stous pistous oti erthan oi ekhthroi se sas, e uperbaloun gia te duname ton ekhthron gia na apotharrunoun tous pistous, e otan oi pistoi bgainoun se kapoia makhe, lene pseudos stous anthropous oti oi pistoi ettethekan kai skotothekan), tote tha se steiloume (o, Prophete) na tous timoreseis, epeita (tha tous dioxoume kai) de tha meinoun ste geitonia sou s' aute (ten pole) para mono gia ligo.
Einai kataramenoi, kai opou kai an brethoun, tha prepei na sullephthoun kai na skotothoun (gia o,ti kako skorpizoun ste ge).

Einai o epanalambanomenos kanonas tou Allakh pou perase s' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou etan prin (kai edeikhnan ten upokrisia tous). Kai de tha breis (o, Prophete) ston kanona tou Allakh kamia allage!
Oi anthropoi se rotoun (o, Prophete) gia ten Ora (tes Emeras tes Kriseos). Pes: <<E gnose gi' aute einai mono me ton Allakh.>> Pos na xereis, isos e Ora na einai konta!
Pragmati, o Allakh katarasteke tous apistous kai etoimase gi' autous mia phlegomene Photia,
opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta, kai de tha broun kanenan kedemona (pou na tous ophelesei) e kanenan uposterikte (pou na apotrepsei ten timoria ap' autous).
Ten Emera pou ta prosopa tous tha anapodogurisoun ste Photia, tha poun: <<Makari na eikhame upakousei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro!>>
Tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Upakousame tous arkhegous mas kai tous megaluterous mas, alla autoi mas parastratesan makria apo ton (isio) dromo.
Kurie mas! Dose tous diple timoria kai na tous katarasteis me mia megale katara.>>

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Me ginete san ekeinous (tous Ebraious) pou eblapsan (lektika) ton Mouse, alla o Allakh phanerose oti auto pou eipan gi' auton, (etan psema kai) den iskhuei. Pragmati, (o Mouses) etan timemenos enopion tou Allakh.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai peite ortha logia,

oste na diorthosei tis praxeis sas (kathodegontas sas stis enaretes praxeis) kai na sugkhoresei gia sas tis amarties sas. Opoios upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, pragmati, ekhei epitukhei ena upertato kerdos.

Pragmati, prospherame [os epiloge kai okhi entole] to katapisteuma (del. te threskeia kai tis upokhreotikes praxeis) stous ouranous, te ge kai ta bouna (pou an tha to terousan, tha antameibontan, kai an to paramelousan, tha timorountan), alla ekeinoi [os epiloge tous] arnethekan na to antexoun kai to phobethekan. Alla o anthropos to dekhteke, kai einai pragmati adikos (gia ton eauto tou) kai adaes (gia te sunepeia tes epiloges tou an den ten terouse).

Gia na einai os apotelesma (tes epiloges tou anthropou pou dekhteke os kathekon te threskeia kai tis upokhreotikes praxeis) oti o Allakh tha timoresei tous upokrites, andres kai gunaikes, kai ekeinous tous andres kai tis gunaikes pou apodidoun s' Auton etairous ste latreia, kai tha dekhtei o Allakh te metameleia ton piston, andron kai gunaikon. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, ston Opoio anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste ge, kai s' Auton anekei olos o epainos ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos), o Al-Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Gnorizei o,ti mpainei ste ge kai o,ti bgainei ap' auten, kai o,ti katebainei apo ton ourano kai o,ti anebainei s' auton. Pragmati, Autos einai o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos), o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Lene oi apistoi: <<E Ora de tha mas erthei pote.>> Pes: <<Okhi (den iskhuei auto), alla (orkizomai) ma ton Kurio mou, tha sas erthei.>> (De gnorizei pote tha erthei para mono) o Pantognostes tou aoratou, tipote den einai krupho ap' Auton oute kan to baros enos atomou (moriou) stous ouranous e ste ge, oute uparkhei tipota mikrotero e megalutero ap' auto, ektos apo to oti einai katagegrammeno se ena xekatharo Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).
(Tha erthei e Ora) gia na antameipsei ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, oi opoioi tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai mia gennaiodore antamoibe (ston Paradeiso).

Alla osoi speudoun na diapseusoun ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, (kai antitithentai stous Aggeliaphorous Mas) nomizontas oti tha xephugoun apo ten timoria Mas, ekeinoi tha ekhoun ena baru odunero marturio.

Kai (tha erthei e Ora oste) na doun ekeinoi (oi pistoi) stous opoious dotheke gnose, oti o,ti ekhei stalei se sena (o, Prophete) apo ton Kurio sou einai e aletheia kai oti odegei sto monopati tou Al-'Azeiz (Aniketou, Pantodunamou), tou Al-Khameint (Axiou kathe epainou).

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene (o enas ston allon khleuazontas): <<Tha thelate na sas deixoume enan anthropo (del. ton Prophete) pou tha sas enemerosei oti otan (tha pethanete kai) ta somata sas tha ginoun kommatia skorpismena (se skone), tha demiourgetheite ek neou (kai tha anastetheite);

Ekhei kataskeuasei ena psema enantion tou Allakh e einai trelos;>> Okhi (oute to ena, oute to allo), alla ekeinoi pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, tha brethoun sto marturio (ste Mellousa Zoe), kai briskontai (sten egkosmia zoe) se akraia plane!

De blepoun o,ti einai mprosta tous kai o,ti einai piso tous apo tous ouranous kai te ge; An thelame, tha eikhame kanei te ge na tous katapiei e na epephtan pano tous kommatia apo ton ourano. Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto gia kathe doulo pou strephetai me metameleia pros ton Allakh, ena Semadi (oti Autos pou mporei na kanei auto, mporei epises na sas anastesei meta ton thanato sas).
Pragmati, ekhoume dosei eunoies apo Emas ston Dabid: <<O, bouna! Epaineste ton Allakh otan Ton epainesei kai autos, kai ta poulia epises!>> Kai kaname to sidero malako gi' auton.

(Kai tou eipame) oti: <<Phtiaxe olokleres aspides (pou na sas prostatepsoun stis makhes) kai kane tis bides na tairiazoun sta daktulia. Kai kante (oloi sas) enaretes praxeis. Pragmati, Ego blepo o,ti kanete!>>

Kai ston Solomonta (upotaxame) ton anemo: phusouse to proi (mekhri to mesemeri, -del. metephere auton kai o,ti ethele-) se apostase enos menos perpatematos, kai phusouse to mesemeri (mekhri to bradu) se apostase enos menos perpatematos. Kai kaname ton oreikhalko na liosei gi' auton, kai (upotaxame gi' auton) merika tzinn pou douleuan gi' auton me ten adeia tou Kuriou tou. Opoio ap' auta (ta tzinn) parekkline apo ten entole Mas (to na upakouei ton Solomonta), tha to kanoume na geutei to marturio tes Phlegomenes Photias.

(Ta tzinn) tou ephtiaxan o,ti ethele apo ktiria (kai temenous), eikones [sem. e paromoioseis apsukhon pragmaton], lekanes megales san dexamenes kai terastia stathera kazania. (Kai eipame): <<O, oikogeneia tou Dabid! Praxte (kales praxeis) os eugnomosune!>> Pragmati, ligoi einai autoi apo tous doulous Mou pou einai eugnomones!

Kai otan orisame ton thanato tou (Solomonta), den tous edeixe (sta tzinn) oti etan nekros, para mono ta entoma tes ges (oi termites) etrogan to rabdi tou (sto opoio sterikhtheke). Otan (o Solomontas) epese kato, ta tzinn suneidetopoiesan oti an gnorizan to aorato, de tha eikhan parameinei sten tapeinotike douleia.

Uperkhe ena Semadi (ton eunoion tou Allakh kai tes Dunames Tou) gia (tous anthropous apo) to Sampa' [to basileio tou Saba] ston topo katoikias tous: (to opoio etan) duo kepoi, enas sta dexia kai enas sta aristera. (Kai eipame): <<Phate apo ta agatha tou Kuriou sas kai na eiste eugnomones pros Auton. Mia kale ge, kai enas Kurios pou einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta, gia osous strephontai me metameleia pros Auton).>>

Alla apostraphekan (apo to na deixoun eugnomosune), etsi steilame s' autous mia katastrophike plemmura (pou katestrepse to phragma tous) kai antikatastesame tous duo kepous tous me allous duo kepous pou paregagan pikrous karpous, dentra almuriki (pou den paregagan phagosimous karpous) kai liga dentra Sintr [Tzitziphia].
Etsi tous timoresame gia ten akharistia kai ten apistia tous. Tha timorousame kanenan allon ektos apo tous akharistous apistous;

Kai [apo tis khares Mas stous anthropous tou Sampa' -tou basileiou tou Saba-] oti kaname anamesa tous kai tis komopoleis pou eikhame eulogesei, alles emphaneis kai kontines komopoleis, kai orisame metaxu tous tis apostaseis perpatematos (kai etsi metakinethekan apo te mia sten alle khoris duskolia), (kai eipame): <<Perpateste (kai taxidepste) anamesa tous gia nukhtes kai meres me asphaleia (khoris phobo apo ten peina, te dipsa e tous ekhthrous).>>

Alla ekeinoi (etan akharistoi kai) eipan: <<Kurie mas! Kane tis apostaseis kata ta taxidia mas na einai pio makrines [gia na kabalame tis kameles mas kai na paroume ephodia mazi mas]>>, kai adikesan ton eauto tous (me ten akharistia tous). Etsi, tous kaname eideseis (sta logia ton metagenesteron anthropon) kai tous diaskorpisame (ste ge). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia kathe upomonetiko kai eugnomon.
O Satanas epharmose s' autous ten eikasia tou (oti tha mporouse na paraplanesei tous anthropous), etsi ton akolouthesan ektos apo mia omada piston.

Kai den eikhe (o Satanas) kamia exousia pano tous (gia na tous anagkasei na paraplanethoun, alla psithurise s' autous kai oraiopoiese gi' autous ten plane), (kai den ton empodisame ap' auto) oste na diakrinoume [-auto pou ede xeroume-, kai na emphanistei auto se sas] autous pou pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe ap' ekeinous pou amphiballoun gi' auten. O Kurios sou (o, Prophete) parakolouthei ta panta (kai diaphulassei tis praxeis ton doulon Tou gia na tous antameipsei e na tous timoresei gi' autes).

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Epikalesteite autous pou iskhurizeste (oti einai theoi) ektos apo ton Allakh (gia opoiadepote anagke sas, de tha antapokrithoun, epeide) den katekhoun tipote oute kan sto baros enos atomou (moriou), oute stous ouranous, oute ste ge, oute ekhoun kanena meridio s' autous (tous ouranous kai te ge). Den ekhei (o Allakh) kanenan boetho ap' autous.>>

Kamia mesolabese de tha ophelesei enopion Tou, ektos ap' ekeinon pou tou to epetrepse. [Apo te megaloprepeia Tou, einai oti otan milaei e krinei kati stous ouranous, oi Aggeloi khtupoun ta phtera tous me apolute upotage kai upakoe pros Auton], kai otan o phobos pheugei apo tis kardies tous, lene (o enas ston allon): <<Ti eipe o Kurios sas;>> Apantoun: <<Ten Aletheia, kai Autos einai o Al-'Alei (Upsistos), o Al-Kampeir (Megas).>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Poios sas parekhei agatha apo ton ourano kai te ge;>> Pes: <<O Allakh! Eite emeis eimaste, eite eseis eiste, se kathodegese e se xekathare plane!>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<De tha erotetheite (ten Emera tes Kriseos) gia o,ti kaname apo amarties, oute tha erotethoume gia o,ti kanate.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Kurios mas tha sugkentrosei emas kai esas, epeita tha krinei metaxu mas me ten aletheia. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Phattakh (Krites anamesa stous doulous Tou), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Deixte mou (me ten apodeixe) autous pou apodidete s' Auton os etairous ste latreia, (ti ekhoun demiourgesei e ti katekhoun stous ouranous e te ge)! Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizeste)! Alla, Autos einai o Allakh, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).>>

De se steilame (o, Mokhammant) para gia olous tous anthropous os Aggeliaphoro kharmosunon eideseon (tou Paradeisou) kai proeidopoiete. Alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun (aphou apomakrunontai apo ten aletheia).
Lene (oi apistoi): <<Pote (tha ulopoiethei) aute e uposkhese (gia ten Emera tes Anastases), an eiste (o, Mousoulmanoi) eilikrineis;>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Uparkhei gia sas mia kathorismene Emera pou de tha mporeite oute na ten anabalete gia mia ora (oute mia stigme), oute na te pherete pio prin.>>

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene: <<De tha pistepsoume pote s' auto to Kor'an, oute se opoiodepote (Biblio) staltheke prin apo auto!>> An eblepes (o, Prophete) otan oi adikoi tha stathoun enopion tou Kuriou tous, kai tha apantoun o enas sta logia tou allou (rikhnontas ten euthune o enas ston allon, tha eblepes se poia tromere katastase tha briskontai)! Autoi (oi opadoi) pou etan adunamoi tha poun s' autous (tous arkhegous tes planes) pou etan alazonikoi: <<An den esastan eseis (pou mas paraplanesate), tha emastan pistoi!>>

Ekeinoi (oi arkhegoi tes planes) pou etan alazonikoi tha poun s' ekeinous (tous opadous) pou etan adunamoi: <<Emastan emeis autoi pou sas empodisame apo ten kathodegese aphou erthe se esas; Okhi, alla eseis esastan ede kakoi.>>

Ekeinoi (oi opadoi) pou etan adunamoi tha poun s' ekeinous (tous arkhegous tes planes) pou etan alazonikoi: <<Okhi, alla (auto pou mas empodise apo ten kathodegese) etan e sunomosia (sas) mera-nukhta: otan mas diataxate na arnethoume ten piste ston Allakh kai na Tou apodidoume etairous ste latreia!>> Oloi tous tha krupsoun tis tupseis tous (gia ten apistia tous) otan doun to marturio. Kai tha baloume desma stous laimous ekeinon pou arnethekan ten piste. Tha laboun kati allo para mono (ten timoria) gi' auta pou ekanan (apo apistia kai amarties);
Den ekhoume steilei kanenan proeidopoiete se kamia pole ektos apo to oti oi euporoi tes na eipan: <<Emeis s' auto me to opoio stalthekate (o, Aggeliaphoroi), den pisteuoume!>>

Kai eipan (oi apistoi): <<Ekhoume perissotera ploute (apo sas) kai perissotera paidia (pou de tha ta eikhame an o Allakh den etan Eukharistemenos mazi mas), kai de tha timorethoume pote (oute tha uparkhei anastase, akoma kai an tha uperkhe, tha mas edine o Allakh perissotera ploute kai de tha mas timorouse).>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous akharistous apistous): <<Pragmati, o Kurios mou dinei agatha me aphthonia se opoion thelei (os dokimasia an tha einai eugnomon e akharistos) e ta periorizei (os dokimasia an tha deixei upomone kai piste e thumo kai akharistia), alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun (oti o Allakh dinei e periorizei ta agatha sumphona me te Sophia kai te Gnose Tou)!>>

Oute ta ploute sas, oute ta paidia sas einai auta pou tha sas phernoun pio konta se Emas! Alla osoi pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, einai autoi pou tha ekhoun pollaple antamoibe gia o,ti ekanan kai tha einai asphaleis sta psela epipeda (ston Paradeiso).

Alla osoi speudoun na diapseusoun ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, (kai antitithentai stous Aggeliaphorous Mas) nomizontas oti tha xephugoun apo ten timoria Mas), ekeinous tha tous pheroun sten timoria.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, o Kurios mou dinei agatha me aphthonia se opoion thelei e ta periorizei gi' auton. O,ti xodepsete (se eleemosune kai gia te khare tou Allakh), (o Allakh) tha ta apozemiosei (dinontas sas kalutera ap' auta sten egkosmia zoe, kai mia gennaiodore antamoibe ste Mellousa Zoe). Pragmati, Autos einai o Kaluteros ekeinon pou parekhoun agatha.>>
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ten Emera pou (o Allakh) tha tous sugkentrosei olous mazi, kai tha pei stous Aggelous (os epiplexe gia tous eidololatres): <<Autoi einai ekeinoi pou sas latreuan;>>

Tha poun (oi Aggeloi): <<Doxa Soi! Esu eisai o Kedemonas mas (pou latreuoume, kai emeis eimaste oi douloi Sou), kai aparniomaste autous (kai te latreia tous pros emas, kai pote den tous eipame na mas latreuoun). Alla autoi latreuan (del. upakouan) ta Tzinn (tous diabolous pou tous paraplanesan kai oraiopoiesan s' autous to na latreuoun tous Aggelous kai ta eidola), oi perissoteroi ex auton (ton eidololatron) pistepsan autous (tous diabolous).>>
Etsi, Semera de tha mporeite na ophelesete e na blapsete o enas ton allon. Kai tha poume s' ekeinous pou adikesan: <<Geuteite to marturio tes Photias pou te diapseudate!>>

Otan apaggellontai s' autous (tous apistous) ta Edaphia Mas xekathara, lene: <<Autos (o Mokhammant) den einai para enas anthropos pou thelei na sas apotrepsei apo o,ti latreuan oi progonoi sas!>> Kai lene: <<Auto (to Kor'an) den einai para ena psema pou to ekhei kataskeuasei (o Mokhammant kai iskhurizetai oti einai o Logos tou Allakh)!>> Kai ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste eipan gia ten Aletheia otan tous erthe: <<Auto den einai para xekathare mageia!>>,

parolo pou den tous ekhoume dosei Biblia na ta diabasoun (apo ta opoia emathan oti to Kor'an einai ena psema pou to kataskeuase o Mokhammant), oute steilame s' autous prin apo sena kanenan proeidopoiete!

Ekeinoi (apo ta proegoumena ethne) pou etan prin ap' autous diepseusan (tous Aggeliaphorous Mou), -an kai (oi anthropoi tou laou sou, o, Prophete) den ephtasan oute to ena dekato apo o,ti eikhame dosei (apo ploute kai duname) s' ekeinous-, ostoso (ekeinoi apo ta proegoumena ethne) diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous Mou. (Koita loipon, o, Prophete) pos etan e arnese (del. e timoria) Mou (s' autous)!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Sas protrepo na kanete ena pragma: na statheite gia khare tou Allakh (me eilikrineia, egkataleipontas tis epithumies kai ton phanatismo sas), ana duo (gia na suzetesete o enas me ton allon) kai memonomena, kai na analogisteite (ton kharaktera tou Mokhammant, pou ton xerete kai xerete ten eilikrineia tou, kai tha phtasete sto oti) den uparkhei trela ston suntropho sas (ton Mokhammant). Pragmati, den einai para enas proeidopoietes gia sas prin apo ena austero marturio.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<An sas eikha zetesei pote kamia antamoibe (gia o,ti metadido se sas apo to Menuma tou Allakh), tote einai dike sas! Pragmati, e antamoibe mou einai mono apo ton Allakh, kai Autos einai Marturas ton panton.>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Kurios mou stelnei ten aletheia (stous Aggeliaphorous kai exaleiphei to pseudos) kai einai o Pantognostes ton aoraton.>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<E aletheia erthe, kai e plane (exaphanisteke kai) den mporei oute na xekinesei tipota, oute na apokatastesei tipota.>>

Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous pou sou lene oti parastrateses apo ten aletheia epeide katakrineis te threskeia tous): <<An parastratousa (apo ten aletheia opos iskhurizeste), e parastratese mou tha etan pano mou, alla an kathodegetheka, einai me o,ti mou apokaluptei o Kurios mou. Pragmati, Autos einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Kareimp (Autos pou einai panta konta me te Gnose kai te Duname Tou).>>
An eblepes (o, Prophete) otan tha tromaxoun (oi apistoi otan doun to marturio, tha eblepes kati tromero)! De tha uparkhei diaphuge, kai tha tous arpaxoun apo ena kontino meros (konta sto marturio).

Tha poun: <<Tora pisteuoume s' Auton (ston Allakh)>>, alla pos tha laboun (ten piste) apo ena makrino meros (aphou teleiose e egkosmia zoe pou einai o oikos ton praxeon, eno e Mellousa Zoe einai o oikos tes antamoibes kai tes timorias)!

Kai (pos na tous ophelesei e piste tora) aphou arnethekan ten piste s' Auton prin (sten egkosmia zoe), kai sukophantesan me eikasies (ton Prophete) apo ena makrino meros (legontas oti einai magos e poietes, kai milesan gia to aorato iskhurizomenoi oti de tha uparkhei anastase, Photia e Paradeisos)!

Kai tha empodistoun apo o,ti epithumoun (to na straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh) opos egine prin me tous paromoious tous (apo ta proegoumena ethne, pou otan eidan ten timoria sten egkosmia zoe, den etan dekto to na straphoun me metameleia ekeine te stigme), oi opoioi eikhan amphibolia (gia tous Aggeliaphorous Mou) pou tous odegouse se sugkhuse kai agonia.

Ole e doxa anekei ston Allakh, ton Demiourgo ton Ouranon kai tes ges. O Opoios ekane tous Aggelous Aggeliaphorous (pou epharmozoun tis entoles Tou), oi opoioi ekhoun duo, tria, e tessera phtera, auxanei (o Allakh) ste demiourgia o,ti thelei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Ikanos.

O,ti anoigei o Allakh apo eleos (ploute, kathodegese e eutukhia) gia tous anthropous, kaneis den mporei na to empodisei, kai o,ti sugkrata, kaneis den mporei meta ap' auto na to steilei. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

O, anthropoi! Thumetheite te khare tou Allakh se sas! Uparkhei kapoios allos demiourgos ektos apo ton Allakh pou sas parekhei agatha apo ton ourano kai te ge; Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo ten aletheia);
(O, Prophete) an se diapseudoun (oi anthropoi tou laou sou), pragmati, uperkhan kai alloi Aggeliaphoroi prin apo sena pou tous diepseudan (oi laoi tous). Ston Allakh tha epistrepsoun ola ta themata.

O, anthropoi! Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine, epomenos men aphesete na sas exapatesei e egkosmia zoe, oute na sas exapatesei autos pou exapataei (o diabolos, e opoiosdepote anthropos) kai na sas apomakrunei apo ton dromo tou Allakh!
Pragmati, o Satanas einai enas ekhthros gia sas, opote parte ton os ekhthro. St' aletheia, kalei tous opadous tou na einai anamesa stous katoikous tes Phlegomenes Photias.
Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, tha ekhoun ena sklero marturio, alla oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun sugkhorese kai mia terastia antamoibe.

Einai autos sta matia tou opoiou oraiopoiethekan (apo ton Satana) oi kakes praxeis tou, kai etsi tis eide os kales, (san auton pou ton kathodegese o Allakh kai blepei to kalo os kalo, kai to kako os kako); Pragmati, o Allakh (me te dikaiosune Tou) kanei opoion thelei na parastratesei, kai (me te khare Tou) kathodegei opoion thelei. Men katastrepseis loipon (o, Prophete) ton eauto sou me thlipse gi' autous (pou epimenoun sten apistia tous). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia o,ti kanoun, Pantognostes.

O Allakh einai Autos pou stelnei tous anemous, oi opoioi demiourgoun kai kinoun ta sunnepha, kai etsi, ta kateuthunoume se mia nekre ge, kai m' auto (to nero) anazoogonoume te ge meta ton thanato tes. Etsi (opos anazoogonoume te nekre ge) tha ginei e anastase!

Opoios anazeta te duname kai te doxa (sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe, as tis anazetesei mono apo ton Allakh meso tes upakoes, aphou) pragmati, ole e duname kai e doxa anekoun mono ston Allakh. S' Auton anebainoun ta kala logia (e mnemoneuse Tou apo tous doulous Tou), kai oi enaretes praxeis (oi praxeis latreias) einai autes pou ta anebazoun (pros Auton). Alla ekeinoi pou skhediazoun kai diaprattoun tis kakes praxeis, tha ekhoun ena austero marturio, kai ta skhedia (kai oi praxeis) ekeinon tha khathoun.

O Allakh sas demiourgese (del. ton patera sas ton Adam) apo khoma, epeita (ekane tous apogonous tou na erthoun) apo stagones (ekkriseon ton duo phulon), kai sas ekane zeugaria (arseniko kai theluko pou pantreueste). Kanena theluko de sullambanei, oute genna para mono me te gnose Tou. Se kanenan de dinetai makrozoia, oute periorizetai e zoe tou ektos na einai grammeno se ena Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud). Pragmati, auto einai eukolo gia ton Allakh.

Ta duo somata nerou den einai omoia: to ena einai gluko, eugeusto kai eukolo sten pose, kai to allo einai almuro kai pikro. Ostoso, apo to kathena trote truphera psaria. Kai bgazete stolidia (margaritaria) pou ta phorate. Kai blepeis ta ploia na to diaskhizoun (to nero), (sta opoia epibibazeste) gia na anazetesete (mesa bioporismou) apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Kai isos na eiste eugnomones.

(O Allakh) eisagei te nukhta sten emera, kai eisagei ten emera ste nukhta (del. auxanei kai meionei tis ores tous, to kheimona kai to kalokairi), kai ekhei upotaxei ton elio kai to pheggari (na sas ophelesoun), kai to kathena trekhei (sten trokhia tou) gia ena kathorismeno khrono. Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas (pou ekane auta). S' Auton anekei e kuriarkhia, eno ekeinoi pou tous epikaleiste ektos ap' Auton, den katekhoun oute kan te phlouda enos koukoutsiou enos khourma.

An tous epikalesteite (ekeina ta eidola kai tous legomenous theous), de tha akousoun ten epiklese sas, kai akome kai an tha akougan, de tha antapokrinontan se sas. Ten Emera tes Anastases tha aparnethoun (auto pou kanate) pou apodidate tous idious ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia. Kai kaneis den mporei na se enemerosei (gi' auto, o, Prophete) opos Autos pou ekhei plere gnose ton panton.
O, anthropoi! Eseis eiste pou ekhete anagke ton Allakh, eno o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).
An thelei, mporei na sas exaphanisei kai na pherei mia alle nea demiourgia,
kai auto den einai duskolo gia ton Allakh.

Den uparkhei kamia amartole psukhe pou tha epomistei ten amartia kapoias alles. Ean mia phortomene psukhe (me amarties) zetesei apo opoiondepote na koubalesei to phortio tes, de tha koubalethei tipote ap' auto, akoma kai an etan enas stenos suggenes tes. E proeidopoiese sou (o, Prophete) tha ophelesei mono autous pou phobountai ten timoria tou Kuriou tous khoris na ten ekhoun dei kai teloun ten proseukhe. Opoios exagnizetai, exagnizetai mono gia to kalo tou. Ston Allakh brisketai o telikos proorismos.
Den einai isoi, o tuphlos kai autos pou blepei [del. o apistos kai o pistos],
oute ta skotadia kai to phos [del. e apistia kai e piste],
oute e skia kai o kautos anemos [del. o Paradeisos kai e Photia],

oute einai isoi, oi zontanoi kai oi nekroi [del. oi pistoi kai oi apistoi]. Pragmati, o Allakh kanei auton pou thelei (na ton kathodegesei), na akousei, alla esu (o, Prophete) den mporeis na kaneis ekeinous pou briskontai stous taphous, na akousoun (del. tous apistous pou den akoun san na etan nekroi).
Den eisai (o, Prophete) para enas proeidopoietes.
Pragmati, se steilame me ten aletheia os phorea kalon eideseon kai os proeidopoiete. Den uparkhei kanena ethnos pou na men ekhei erthei s' auto enas proeidopoietes.

An se diapseusoun (o, Prophete), pragmati, kai ekeinoi (oi apistoi) pou etan prin ap' autous diepseusan (tous Aggeliaphorous tous). Oi Aggeliaphoroi tous erthan s' autous me xekathares apodeixeis, Theia Biblia kai to Biblio pou phaneronei kai dinei phos (ston isio dromo).
Epeita arpaxa me ten timoria ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste. Poso (tromere) etan e arnese (del. e timoria) Mou!

De blepeis oti o Allakh katebazei apo ton ourano nero (brokhe) kai (parolo pou einai ena eidos) bgazoume m' auto karpous me diaphora khromata, kai oti (demiourgesame) kapoia bouna me leukes kai kokkines grammes, me diaphora khromata, kai me katamaures (grammes);

Kai (oti demiourgesame) tous anthropous, ta zoa kai ta booeide, me diaphora khromata; Pragmati, autoi pou phobountai ton Allakh (kai doxazoun te Megaloprepeia Tou), einai mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun gnose metaxu ton doulon Tou (del. ekhoun gnose gia tis Idiotetes Tou, kai te Duname kai ta Semadia Tou sto sumpan). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Autoi pou apaggelloun to Biblio tou Allakh (to Kor'an), teloun ten proseukhe kai xodeuoun krupha kai phanera (se eleemosune) apo o,ti tous parekhoume, pragmati, elpizoun se mia sunallage pou de tha khathei,

(de tha khathei) gia na tous dinei tis antamoibes tous pleros, kai na tous auxanei apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Pragmati, Autos einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Sakour (Eugnomon gia tous upakouous kai tous antameibei gi' auto).

Auto pou sou apokalupsame (o, Prophete) apo to Biblio (to Kor'an), einai e aletheia pou epibebaionei o,ti apokaluphtheke prin ap' auto (apo Theia Biblia). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia tous doulous Tou, Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Epeita dosame to Biblio (to Kor'an) s' autous (tous Mousoulmanous) pou epilexame apo tous doulous Mas, alla ap' autous merikoi adikoun ton eauto tous (me tis amarties), merikoi einai metriopatheis (kai teloun tis upokhreotikes praxeis latreias, alla aphenoun kapoies proairetikes), kai merikoi me ten adeia (kai ten kathodegese) tou Allakh speudoun pros tis kales praxeis (eite upokhreotikes, eite proairetikes). Auto (oti epilexame tous Mousoulmanous to na laboun to Kor'an) einai e megale khare (kai e megale gennaiodoria).
Tha eiselthoun se kepous monimes diamones (ston Paradeiso), kai tha stolistoun ekei me brakhiolia apo khruso kai margaritaria, kai ta endumata tous mesa tou (Paradeisou) tha einai apo metaxi.

Kai tha poun: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh pou mas aphairese kathe thlipse. Pragmati, o Kurios mas einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Sakour (Eugnomon gia tous upakouous kai tous antameibei gi' auto).
O Opoios apo te khare Tou, mas ekane na egkatastathoume ston oiko tes aionias diamones (ston Paradeiso), opou de tha mas aggixei ekei kamia kourase, oute kamia kopose.>>

Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, tha ekhoun te Photia tes Kolases, de tha oristei gi' ekeinous o thanatos gia na pethanoun, oute tha tous elaphrunthei to marturio tes. Etsi timoroume kathe akharisto apisto.

Tha ourliazoun ekei: <<Kurie mas! Bgale mas exo, gia na kanoume enaretes praxeis, se antithese me o,ti kaname prin.>> (O Allakh tha tous pei): <<De sas dosame arkete zoe oste na labei nouthesia s' aute opoios tha ethele na te labei, kai erthe se sas enas proeidopoietes; Geuteite loipon (to marturio)! Pragmati, gia tous adikous de tha uparkhei kanenas uposteriktes!>>
Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Pantognostes ton aoraton, ton ouranon kai tes ges. Pragmati, einai o Pantognostes oson uparkhoun stis kardies!

Einai Autos pou sas ekane genies -pou e mia diadekhetai ten alle- ste ge (gia na sas dokimasei anaphorika me tis praxeis sas). Opoios arneitai ten piste, e apistia tou tha einai eis baros tou. De tha auxesei tous apistous, e apistia tous, enopion tou Kuriou tous, para mono se periphronese. De tha auxesei tous apistous, e apistia tous, para mono se apoleia.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Blepete autous pou apodidete ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia, tous opoious epikaleiste ektos apo ton Allakh! Deixte mou, ti ekhoun demiourgesei ste ge! E mepos ekhoun meridio ste demiourgia ton ouranon;>> E mepos tous dosame (stous eidololatres) ena Biblio, kai etsi ekhoun ap' auto mia apodeixe (gia ten eidololatria tous); Okhi (den iskhuei tipote apo ola auta), alla pragmati, auto pou uposkhontai oi adikoi o enas ston allon (oti ta eidola einai oi mesolabetes tous enopion tou Allakh kai tous phernoun pio konta ston Allakh), den einai para mono mia exapatese!

Pragmati, o Allakh krata tous ouranous kai te ge apo to na ektrepontai apo tis theseis tous. An omos ektrapoun, kanenas allos, ektos ap' Auton, de tha mporouse na tous sugkratesei. Pragmati, Autos einai Khaleim (Makrothumos) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Orkistekan me to Onoma tou Allakh me polu zelo sten orkomosia tous oti an tha tous erkhotan enas proeidopoietes, tha ginontousan pio kathodegemenoi apo ta alla ethne (tous Khristianous kai tous Ebraious klp.). Alla otan tous erthe enas proeidopoietes, den tous auxese (o erkhomos tou) para mono se apostrophe (apo ten aletheia).

(Apostraphekan apo ten aletheia) os alazoneia ste ge kai os diapraxe kai skhediase tou kakou (tes apistias, apotrepontas tous anthropous apo to na akolouthesoun ton Prophete kai sunomotontas enantion tou), alla e diapraxe kai e skhediase tou kakou den periballei para mono ekeinous pou to ekanan. Perimenoun kati allo ektos apo na erthei s' autous o epanalambanomenos kanonas (tou Allakh, -del. e timoria Tou-) pou perase stous proegoumenous (apistous) laous; De tha breis (o, Prophete) ston kanona tou Allakh kamia allage (del. de tha allakhthei e timoria me kati allo), oute tha breis ston kanona tou Allakh kamia metabole (del. de tha allaxei e timoria apo enan lao kai na pesei se kapoion allo).

Den taxidepsan ste ge gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin ap' autous kai etan pio iskhuroi ap' autous; Kanena on stous ouranous e ste ge, den mporei na xephugei apo ten timoria tou Allakh (an thelei o Allakh na ton timoresei). Pragmati, Autos einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta).

An o Allakh (espeude na) timoresei tous anthropous gia o,ti dieprattan, de tha aphene kanena kinoumeno on ste ge, alla tous dinei anabole gia enan kathorismeno khrono. Otan erthei o kathorismenos khronos tous, tote o Allakh ede blepei ta panta skhetika me tous doulous Tou (tis praxeis tous, kai tous upakouous kai tous anupakouous).

E, S [Gia-Sein, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Kai (orkizomai) ma to teleio kai sopho Biblio (to Kor'an)!
Oti eisai enas apo tous Aggeliaphorous (tou Allakh),
(kai eisai) se enan isio dromo.
[Aute einai] mia apokalupse apo ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Ar-Rakheim (Poluesplakhno).

Gia na proeidopoieis enan lao (ton Kourais), tou opoiou oi progonoi den eikhan proeidopoiethei [den tous erthe kanenas proeidopoietes gia na tous proeidopoiesei gia ten eidololatria tous pou epheuriskan polu kairo meta apo ton Prophete Ismael], kai etsi den ekhoun gnose (gia ten piste kai ten kathodegese).

Pragmati, o Logos (Mou me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana oti tha gemiso ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos (del. e timoria egine anapopheukte) gia tous perissoterous ap' autous (opos ton Ampou Tzakhl kai alloi pou arnethekan ten piste kai edeixan megale ekhthroteta enantion tou Prophete), kai etsi den pisteuoun.

Ekhoume balei stous laimous tous desma (pou denoun ta kheria stous laimous tous), kai (ta kheria tous) phtanoun sta pegounia, kai ta kephalia tous sekomena pros ta pano (kai etsi apotrapekan apo kathe kalo).
Kai balame mprosta tous ena phragma kai apo piso tous ena phragma, kai kalupsame ta matia tous, kai etsi de blepoun.
Eite tous proeidopoieseis (o, Prophete), eite okhi, einai to idio gi' autous, den pisteuoun.

E proeidopoiese sou (o, Prophete) tha ophelesei mono opoion akolouthei ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) kai phobatai ten timoria tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) khoris na ten ekhei dei. S' auton dose ta kharmosuna nea gia sugkhorese kai mia gennaiodore antamoibe.

Emeis eimaste pou dinoume zoe stous nekrous (ten Emera tes anastases) kai katagraphoume o,ti ekanan (apo kales e kakes praxeis sten egkosmia zoe) kai o,ti aphesan (meta to thanato tous apo sunekhomenes kales e kakes praxeis), kai ekhoume katagrapsei ta panta se ena Ksekatharo Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).
Dose tous (o, Prophete) ena paradeigma ton anthropon tes komopoles, otan oi Aggeliaphoroi erthan s' auten.
Otan tous steilame duo (Aggeliaphorous), alla tous diepseusan, etsi tous eniskhusame me enan trito kai eipan: <<Eimaste Apestalmenoi se sas.>>
(Oi anthropoi) eipan: <<Eseis den eiste para anthropoi san kai emas, kai o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) den ekhei steilei tipota. Pragmati, eseis mono pseudeste.>>
(Oi Aggeliaphoroi) eipan: <<O Kurios mas gnorizei oti eimaste Apestalmenoi pros esas.
Kai den uparkhei se mas allo kathekon para mono na metapheroume (to menuma) me xekatharo tropo.>>
(Oi anthropoi) eipan: <<Eiste gia mas enas kakos oionos. Ean de stamatesete, tha sas lithobolesoume kai tha sas plexoume me mia odunere timoria.>>

(Oi Aggeliaphoroi) eipan: <<O kakos oionos sas einai mazi sas sunekheia (exaitias tes apistias sas). (Theoreite oti eimaste gia sas enas kakos oionos) epeide labate nouthesia (apo mas); Okhi (den eimaste kakos oionos gia sas), alla eiste enas laos pou xeperna ta oria stis amarties.>>

Erthe enas (pistos) andras speudontas apo to telos tes poles (phoboumenos gia tous anthropous tou pou diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous kai skopeuan na tous skotosoun) kai eipe: <<O, lae mou! Akoloutheste tous Aggeliaphorous!
Akoloutheste autous pou de zetoun apo sas kamia antamoibe (gia o,ti metadidoun se sas apo to Menuma tou Allakh) kai einai kathodegemenoi.
Kai pos na me latreuo Auton pou me demiourgese, kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete oloi!

Einai dunaton na paro gia latreia ektos ap' Auton allous theous, ton opoion e diamesolabese, an o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) thelei na me blapsei, den mporei na me ophelesei se tipote, oute oi idioi mporoun na me sosoun;
(An tha ekana kati tetoio), pragmati, tote tha emoun se xekathare plane!
Pragmati, pisteuo ston Kurio (mou kai ton Kurio) sas, gi' auto akouste me (kai upakouste tous Aggeliaphorous).>> [Alla o laos tou ton skotose].
Etsi, eipotheke s' auton (aphou ton skotosan): <<Mpes ston Paradeiso [e tha mpeis ston Paradeiso os antamoibe].>> Eipe: <<Makari na xeroun oi anthropoi tou laou mou,
ton logo (del. ten piste mou) gia ton opoio o Kurios mou me sugkhorese kai me ekane enan apo tous timemenous.
Kai de steilame meta ap' auton (kai ton thanato tou), stratiotes apo ton ourano enantion tou laou tou, oute tha to kaname (aphou e katastrophe tous einai kati eukolo)!
Den etan para mono mia krauge, kai amesos katastraphekan.
Alimono stous (apistous) doulous, (poso megales tha einai oi tupseis tous gia ton eauto tous ten Emera tes Anastases)! Den tous erthe kanenas Aggeliaphoros, para na ton khleuasan!
De blepoun (oi apistoi apo te phule Kourais) posa (apista) ethne prin ap' autous ekhoume katastrepsei, ta opoia de tha epistrepsoun pote s' autous (sten egkosmia zoe);
Pragmati, oloi (oi anthropoi ten Emera tes Anastases) tha pareurethoun enopion Mas.
Os Semadi gi' autous (gia ten anastase) einai e nekre ge, pou ten anazoogonoume kai phutronoume ap' aute sitaria, apo ta opoia trone,
kai kanoume s' aute kepous me khourmadies kai ampelia, kai anabluzoume mesa tes peges nerou,
gia na phane apo tous karpous tous (ton kepon pou tous ephtiaxe o Allakh), tous opoious den ephtiaxan ta kheria tous. Ma de tha ginoun, loipon, eugnomones;
Doxa s' Auton pou demiourgese ola ta zeugaria (arsenika kai theluka) apo o,ti paragei e ge, kathos kai apo ton eauto tous (tous anthropous), kai apo o,ti de gnorizoun.
Os Semadi gi' autous einai e nukhta: oti aphairoume ap' aute to phos tes emeras, kai etsi menoun sto skotadi.

Kai oti o elios trekhei se mia kathorismene trokhia (gia enan kathorismeno khrono, mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases). Auto einai pou to ekhei orisei o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Kai oti gia to pheggari ekhoume orisei sugkekrimenes phaseis (emiseleno, panseleno klp.), eos otou epistrepsei (se emiseleno sten arkhe tou seleniako mena) san ena palio xerameno kotsani khourmadias.

Den epitrepetai ston elio na prolabei to Pheggari (me to na emphanistei te nukhta kai na aphairesei to phos tou), oute epitrepetai ste nukhta na xeperna ten emera. Ola tous kolumpoun me akribeia stis trokhies tous.
Os Semadi gi' autous einai oti metapherame tous progonous tous ste phortomene Kiboto (tou Noe, kathos kai oti kanoume te thalassa na metapherei ta ploia tous).
Kai demiourgesame gi' autous paromoia (ploia) m' aute (ten Kiboto tou Noe), sta opoia epibibazontai.
An thelame, tha tous pnigame, kai tote de tha uperkhe kaneis na tous sosei, oute tha mporousan oi idioi na sothoun!
Ektos ki an (tous sosoume) os eleos apo Emas aphenontas tous na apolausoun (ta agatha Mas) gia enan kathorismeno khrono.

Otan tous legetai: <<Phulakhtheite (meso tes tereses ton entolon tou Allakh) apo o,ti (timoria) perase prin apo sas (sta proegoumena apista ethne), kai apo o,ti tha erthei meta apo sas (ste Mellousa Zoe), isos na eleetheite>>, (tote apostrephontai adiaphorontas)!
Den tous erkhetai kanena Semadi apo ta Semadia tou Kuriou tous, para na apomakrunthoun ap' auto.

Otan tous legetai: <<Ksodepste (se eleemosune) apo o,ti sas parekhei o Allakh>>, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene stous pistous: <<Tha taIsoume autous pou an ethele o Allakh, tha tous eikhe taIsei; Pragmati, den eiste para se xekathare plane!>>
Lene (oi apistoi): <<Pote (tha ulopoiethei) aute e uposkhese (gia ten Emera tes Anastases), an eiste (o, Mousoulmanoi) eilikrineis;>>

Den perimenoun (oi apistoi) para mono mia krauge (otan tha phusexei o Aggelos Israphel to Keras -Salpigga-) pou tha tous piasei xaphnika, eno ekeinoi tha einai apaskholemenoi me suzeteseis kai diaphonies metaxu tous (sta egkosmia zetemata tous).
Tote de tha mporoun oute na kanoun kamia diatheke (gia ta ploute tous), oute na epistrepsoun stis oikogeneies tous!
(O Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga, to deutero phusema gia ten anastase), kai tote tha bgoun apo tous taphous tous speudontas pros ton Kurio tous.
Tha poun: <<Alimono mas! Poios mas anestese apo tous taphous mas;>> (Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Auto einai pou to uposkhetheke o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), kai oi Aggeliaphoroi eipan ten aletheia!>>
De tha einai para mono mia krauge, kai amesos tha pareurethoun enopion Mas.
Semera (ten Emera tes Kriseos) kamia psukhe de tha adikethei sto elakhisto, oute tha labete (antamoibe e timoria) para mono gia o,ti kanate.
Pragmati, Semera oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, tha einai apaskholemenoi diaskedazontas.
Oi opoioi oi idioi kai oi suzugoi tous tha einai kato apo skies (tou Paradeisou), xaplomenoi se krebatia (pou einai stolismena me ta omorphotera kalummata).
Tha ekhoun ekei (apo ola ta) phrouta kai o,ti epithumoun (kai zetoun).
(Tha tous eipothei): <<Salam (eirene se sas kai asphaleia apo kathe kako)>> - mia Lexe (khairetismou) apo ton Enan Polueusplakhno Kurio.
(Tha eipothei stous apistous): <<O, kakoi! Diakhoristeite Semera (apo tous pistous).
O, paidia tou Adam! De sas dietaxa (meso ton Aggeliaphoron Mou) na men latreuete ton Satana, o opoios einai gia sas enas prophanes ekhthros;
Kai (de sas dietaxa) na latreuete mono Emena; Aphou autos einai o isios dromos.
Pragmati, (o Satanas) ekhei paraplanesei polla plethe apo esas. Den eikhate tote kamia logike;
Aute einai e Kolase, gia ten opoia eikhate labei uposkhese.
Mpeite Semera mesa tes gia na kaeite gia o,ti arnethekate apo ten piste.>>
Semera tha sphragisoume ta stomata tous (gia na men arnethoun tis amarties tous), kai tha Mas milesoun ta kheria tous, kai tha marturesoun ta podia tous gia osa diepraxan.
An thelame, tha sphragizame ta matia tous, kai etsi tha espeudan pros ton dromo, kai pos tha eblepan!
Kai an thelame, tha eikhame paramorphosei te demiourgia tous stis theseis tous, kai etsi de tha mporousan na prokhoresoun mprosta, oute na gurisoun piso!
Se opoion dinoume makrozoia, ton epistrephoume stadiaka sten prote katastase tes demiourgias tou (se adunamia). Ma de sullogizontai (oti e egkosmia zoe einai mono prosorine);
Den tou ekhoume mathei (ston Mokhammant) ten poiese, oute einai prepon gi' auton! Auto den einai para mia Upenthumise kai ena xekatharo Kor'an,

oste na proeidopoiesei opoion einai zontanos (del. pistos pou ekhei zontane kardia kai sullogizetai), kai na ginei o Logos (Mou me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana oti tha gemiso ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) anapopheuktos gia tous apistous.
De blepoun oti Emeis demiourgesame gi' autous booeide, apo o,ti demiourgesan ta Kheria Mas, kai epeita ta ekhoun autoi sten katokhe tous;
Kai (de blepoun) oti ta kaname (ta booeide) upo ton elegkho tous, kai etsi ta kabalane, kai ap' auta trone;
Kai (de blepoun) oti ekhoun ap' auta (ta booeide, polla) ophele kai ap' auta pinoun (gala); Ma de tha ginoun eugnomones;
Ostoso, ekhoun parei gia latreia allous (pseutikous) theous ektos apo ton Allakh, elpizontas oti tha laboun uposterixe!

(Oi opoioi pseutikoi theoi) den mporoun na tous uposterixoun, kai (oi idioi oi apistoi) einai oi stratiotes pou pareuriskontai gi' autous (gia na tous uperaspistoun an kapoios tous katakrinei parolo pou den tous prospheroun tipote)!
Epomenos, as me se stenakhoroun (o, Prophete) ta logia tous (ton eidololatron pou se diapseudoun). Pragmati, gnorizoume o,ti kruboun kai o,ti phaneronoun!

De blepei o anthropos oti ton demiourgesame apo (adunames) stagones (ekkriseon ton duo phulon), kai epeita autos (ginetai alazonikos kai akharistos kai) diaphonei polu kai xekathara (diapseudontas ten anastase)!
(O apistos) Mas dinei mia parabole, kai xekhna te dike tou demiourgia. Leei: <<Poios tha dosei zoe s' auta ta osta aphou sapisoun kai thrummatistoun;>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Tha tous dosei zoe Autos pou ta demiourgese ex' arkhes! Pragmati, Autos einai gia kathe demiourgemeno on, Pantognostes!>>
Autos einai pou ekane gia sas apo ta prasina dentra photia (parolo pou ekhoun mesa tous nero), kai etsi anabete ap' auta.

Den einai Autos pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge, Ikanos na demiourgesei xana tous idious (anthropous kai na tous anastesei meta apo ton thanato tous); Bebaia mporei, kai Autos einai pragmati o Al-Khalak (Demiourgos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).
Pragmati, e Entole Tou otan thelei kati na uparkhei, einai oti apla leei gi' auto (pou thelei): <<Genetheto>>, kai etsi ginetai!
Doxa s' Auton, stou Opoiou to Kheri brisketai e kuriarkhia ton panton, kai s' Auton tha epistrepsete oloi.
Orkizomai ma autous (tous Aggelous) pou einai paratagmenoi se seires!
Kai orkizomai ma autous (tous Aggelous) pou sprokhnoun (kai odegoun ta sunnepha opou thelei o Allakh).
Kai orkizomai ma autous (tous Aggelous) pou apaggeloun ta Edaphia (tou Allakh).
Oti o (Alethinos) Theos sas (pou mono Autos axizei na latreuetai), einai Enas!
O Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous, kai o Kurios olon ton semeion ton anatolon.
Pragmati, ekhoume stolisei ton kontinotero ourano me ta asteria,
kai ta kaname (ta asteria) os prostasia (gia ton kontinotero ourano) apo kathe epanastatemeno diabolo, (pou ton lithoboloun an prospathesei na kruphakousei).

Den mporoun (oi diaboloi) na kruphakousoun ten upselotere sunaxe (ton Aggelon ston ourano otan miloun me o,ti tous apokalupse o Allakh), kai (an prospathesoun na kruphakousoun), lithobolountai apo kathe pleura,
gia na tous dioxoun makria, kai tha ekhoun (ten Emera tes Kriseos) ena aionio marturio.
(Den mporoun oi diaboloi na kruphakousoun tous Aggelous ston ourano) para mono opoios (diabolos) arpaxei gregora merikes lexeis, kai amesos tha ton akolouthesei ena lampero diaperastiko pephtasteri.

Rota loipon (o, Mokhammant) autous (tous apistous pou diapseudoun ten anastase): <<Einai autoi pio dunatoi ste demiourgia (kai e demiourgia tous einai pio megale), e o,ti demiourgesame (apo tous ouranous kai te ge);>> Pragmati, tous demiourgesame (tous anthropous -ton Adam-) apo kollode pelo.

Okhi (e demiourgia ton anthropon den einai pio megale apo ton ouranon kai tes ges), alla esu ekplessesai (o, Mokhammant, apo te diapseuse tous ten anastase), eno autoi (oi apistoi) eironeuontai (auta pou tous les)!
Otan tous dinetai mia nouthesia, den te lambanoun upopse.
Otan blepoun (apo ton Prophete) ena Semadi, to eironeuontai.
Lene: <<Auto den einai para xekathare mageia.
Einai dunaton oti otan tha pethanoume kai tha ginoume skone kai kokala, tha anastethoume;
E oi propatores mas (tha anastethoun);>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Nai (tha anastetheite oloi) eno tha eiste atimasmenoi kai upotagmenoi.>>
Pragmati, tha einai mono mia krauge (to deutero phusema sto Keras -Salpigga-), kai amesos (tha bgoun apo tous taphous kai) tha koitaxoun (tis phrikaleotetes tes Emeras tes Anastases).
Tha poun: <<Alimono mas! Aute einai e Emera tou Apologismou (opou tha uparkhei antamoibe kai timoria)!>>
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Aute einai e Emera tes Kriseos pou te diapseudate!>>
(Tha eipothei stous Aggelous): <<Sugkentroste ekeinous pou adikesan kai tous paromoious tous (pou tous uposterixan e akolouthesan) kai o,ti latreuan (apo eidola kai pseutikous theous),
(pou tous latreuan) ektos apo ton Allakh, kai odegeste tous pros ton dromo tes Kolases,
kai stamateste tous (prin ten Kolase), pragmati, tha rotethoun.>>
