(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Giati den uposterizete tora o enas ton allon (opos iskhuristekate prin oti ta eidola sas sas uposterizoun);>>
Okhi (de tha uposterixei kanenas tous ton allon), alla Semera tha einai upotagmenoi (sten Krise tou Allakh)!
Tha straphoun o enas ston allon epiplettontas ton.

(Oi opadoi) tha poun (stous arkhegous tes planes): <<Pragmati, mas plesiazate apo te dexia (del. apo ten pleura tes aletheias gia na mas paraplanesete ap' aute, kai oraiopoiesate sta matia mas ten apistia kai tis amarties).>>
(Oi arkhegoi tes planes) tha poun: <<Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizeste), alla eseis oi idioi den esastan pistoi!
Kai den eikhame kamia exousia se sas (gia na sas anagkasoume sten apistia), alla eseis oi idioi esastan parabates (sten apistia kai stis amarties).

Tora o Logos tou Kuriou mas (me ton opoio proeidopoiese ton Satana oti tha gemisei ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos gia mas. Pragmati, tha geutoume (to marturio).
Kai sas kalesame pros ten plane, giati eimastan paraplanemenoi, (kai eseis antapokrithekate apo epiloge sas).>>
Pragmati, ekeine ten Emera tha einai oloi tous mazi sten timoria.
Etsi kanoume stous kakous (apistous).
Pragmati, opote legotan s' autous: <<Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh>>, ginontan alazones.
(Oi apistoi apo te phule Kourais) lene: <<Tha egkataleipsoume tous theous mas gia enan trelo poiete;>>
Okhi (o Mokhammant den einai oute trelos, oute poietes), alla erthe me ten aletheia, kai epibebaiose tous Aggeliaphorous.
Pragmati, tha geuteite to odunero marturio,
kai de tha labete para mono (timoria) gia o,ti kanate.
Ektos apo tous aphosiomenous eklektous pistous doulous tou Allakh, (oi opoioi tha einai asphaleis apo ten timoria kai tha laboun pollaple antamoibe).
Ekeinoi (oi pistoi) tha ekhoun mia gnoste antamoibe (ton Paradeiso, kai agatha proi-bradu, sunekheia opote theloun),
phrouta (del. to phageto kai to poto tous tha einai gia apolause kai okhi apo peina), kai tha einai timemenoi,
stous Kepous tes Eudaimonias,
kathismenoi o enas apenanti apo ton allon se (uperupsomena stolismena) krebatia (kai kaneis de tha dosei ten plate tou ston allon).
(Oi uperetes) tha peripherontai anamesa tous me diskopotero apo ena trekhoumeno ruaki (krasiou).
(To opoio krasi tha einai) leuko kai nostimo gia osous to pinoun.
De tha uparkhei s' auto (to krasi) kanena kako (apo pono sten koilia e ponokephalo), oute tha methaei to mualo tous.
Tha ekhoun semnes gunaikes pou periorizoun ten orase tous (kai ten kardia tous) stous suzugous tous kai mono, kai tha ekhoun megala omorpha matia.
(Ekeines oi gunaikes) san na etan kala diateremena parthena margaritaria (pou kaneis den tis ekhei aggixei prin).
Tha straphoun (oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou) o enas pros ton allo rotontas (gia to ti ekanan sten egkosmia zoe).
Enas ap' autous tha pei: <<Eikha enan philo (sten egkosmia zoe),
o opoios (mou) elege: <<Eisai enas ap' ekeinous pou pisteuoun (sten anastase);
Einai dunaton oti otan tha pethanoume kai tha ginoume skone kai kokala, (tha anastethoume kai) tha mas pheroun gia na logodotesoume (kai na laboume timoria e antamoibe gia tis praxeis mas);>>.>>
(O pistos omiletes) tha pei (stous suntrophous tou ston Paradeiso): <<Thelete na koitaxete (ste Photia, gia na doume te moira ekeinou pou arnetheke ten anastase);>>
Etsi (o pistos) tha koitaxei kato kai tha ton dei (ton apisto) ste mese tes Phlegomenes Photias.
(O pistos) tha pei (ston apisto): <<Ma ton Allakh! Paraligo na me eikhes katastrepsei (meso ton prospatheion sou na me apotrepseis apo ten piste).
An den etan e khare tou Kuriou mou, tha emoun (Semera) anamesa s' ekeinous pou briskontai (sten Kolase).
De tha pethanoume emeis (oi pistoi),

para mono ton proto mas thanato, kai de tha timorethoume; [Nai de tha pethanoume ste Mellousa Zoe, kai tha meinoume emeis oi pistoi se aionia eudaimonia, eno eseis oi apistoi tha meinete se aionio marturio]!
Pragmati, aute einai e megale epitukhia!>>
Gia tetoia (antamoibe), as prattoun ekeinoi (oi pistoi) pou prattoun (kales praxeis sten egkosmia zoe).
Aute (e eudaimonia) einai kalutere os diamone e to dentro tou Az-Zakoum;
Pragmati, to kaname (auto to dentro) na einai mia dokimasia gia tous adikous (pou diepseusan kai eipan <<Pos phutronei ena dentro mesa sten Kolase;>>)!
Pragmati, einai ena dentro pou bgainei apo ton puthmena tes Kolases.
Oi karpoi tou opoiou moiazoun me ta kephalia ton diabolon.
Pragmati, tha phane ap' autous (tous karpous), kai tha gemisoun tis koilies tous.
Epeita, (tha pane gia na pioun kai) tha ekhoun ena zematisto nero pou tha ginei (sten koilia tous) meigma (me tous karpous pou ephagan).
Epeita, e epistrophe tous (aphou pioun to zematisto nero) tha einai sten Kolase (kai etsi tha kinountai apo ena marturio sto allo).
Pragmati, (o, Mokhammant, oi apistoi apo ton lao sou) brekan tous progonous tous paraplanemenous,
kai etsi speudoun akolouthontas ta bemata tous (ton progonon tous sten apistia, apo mimese kai khoris apodeixe)!
Pragmati, prin autous (tous apistous apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant), oi perissoteroi apo tous proegoumenous laous eikhan parastratesei!
Pragmati, eikhame steilei anamesa tous proeidopoietes (Aggeliaphorous).
Koita loipon (o, Prophete) pos etan to telos ekeinon pou eikhan proeidopoiethei (alla diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous, kai katastraphekan).
Ektos apo tous aphosiomenous eklektous pistous doulous tou Allakh, (oi opoioi sothekan kai tha laboun pollaple antamoibe).
Pragmati, o Noe Mas epikalesteke (enantion tou laou tou pou ton diepseuse), kai poso exairetika antapokrithekame (s' auton)!
Sosame auton (ton Noe) kai ten oikogeneia tou apo te megale duskolia (tou pnigmou sten plemmura).
Kaname tous apogonous tou na einai autoi pou tha meinoun meta (ste ge, kai oloi oi anthropoi meta katagontai ap' ekeinous).
Kaname na meinei enas epainos gi' auton stis metagenesteres genies:
<<Eirene ston Noe anamesa se olous tous anthropous.>>
Etsi antameiboume ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.
Pragmati, etan enas apo tous pistous doulous Mas.
Epeita pnixame tous allous (me ten plemmura).
Pragmati, enas ap' autous pou akolouthesan te threskeia tou (Noe, meta), etan o Abraam.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan erthe (o Abraam) pros ton Kurio tou me agne kardia.
Otan eipe (o Abraam) ston patera tou kai ston lao tou: <<Ti einai auta pou latreuete;
Anazetate gia latreia pseutikous theous anti tou Allakh;
Ti pisteuete loipon gia ton Kurio ton kosmon (o,ti tha sas kanei ten Emera tes Kriseos);>>
Erixe loipon (o Abraam) mia matia sta asteria (skeptomenos),
kai eipe (ston lao tou): <<Eimai arrostos (e adunamos).>>
Etsi ton aphesan kai ephugan (pros ten giorte tous).
Etsi espeuse krupha pros tous theous (ta eidola) tous kai eipe (khleuazontas tous): <<Den trote (auto to phageto pou sas ebale o laos mou);
Ti sumbainei me sas pou de milate;>>
Etsi pege pros autous khtupontas tous me to dexi tou kheri (gia na tous spasei).
Etsi (aphou brekan oi anthropoi ta eidola tous spasmena kai akousan oti o Abraam einai autos pou ta eikhe katakrinei prin), erthan pros auton speudontas.
(O Abraam) eipe: <<Einai dunaton na latreuete auta (ta eidola) pou eseis oi idioi ta ekhete skalisei,
eno o Allakh einai Autos pou demiourgese esas kai o,ti phtiakhnete;>> [Del. demiourgese to xulo kai ten petra klp. apo ta opoia phtiakhnete ta eidola sas].
Eipan: <<Khtiste gi' auton mia kataskeue (pura) kai rixte ton ste phlegomene photia.>>
Eikhan gi' auton ena kako skhedio, alla (ton sosame kai) tous kaname tous katoterous!
(O Abraam) eipe: <<(Tha metanastepso kai) tha pao pros ton Kurio mou (se ena meros opou tha mporo na Ton latreuo), o Opoios tha me kathodegesei (pros to kalo).
Kurie mou! Kharise mou enaretous apogonous.>>
Etsi, tou dosame ta kharmosuna nea gia ena paidi (ton Ismael), pou (otan tha megalosei) tha einai makrothumos.

Otan (o gios tou) ephtase sten elikia na ton boethesei (ton patera tou) stis ergasies tou, (o Abraam) tou eipe: <<Gie mou! Eida ston upno mou oti se esphaxa [kai ta oneira ton Propheton einai apokalupse kai entole apo ton Allakh]. Koita loipon, ti nomizeis!>> Eipe: <<O, patera! Kane o,ti diatakhtekes (apo ton Allakh). Tha me breis, an thelei o Allakh, na eimai apo tous upomonetikous kai tous upakouous.>>
Otan kai oi duo upotakhtekan sto thelema tou Allakh, kai (o Abraam) ton eikhe balei (ton gio tou) me to metopo katages kai plagia,
tou phonaxame: <<O, Abraam!
Ekpleroses to orama sou (ephoson eikhes ten prothese na to ekpleroseis, alla tha sas sosoume apo tetoia dokimasia). Etsi, antameiboume ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo (kai ekteloun tis entoles Mas).
Pragmati, aute etan mia olophanere (kai duskole) dokimasia.
Ton sosame (ton uio tou) kanontas (na sphakhthei) anti autou mia megale thusia (ena megalo kriari).
Kaname na meinei enas epainos gi' auton (ton Abraam) stis metagenesteres genies:
<<Eirene kai asphaleia ston Abraam.>>
Etsi, antameiboume ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.
Pragmati, etan enas apo tous pistous doulous Mas.
Tou dosame (ston Abraam) ta kharmosuna nea gia (ena paidi) ton Isaak, pou tha ginei enas Prophetes, kai enas apo tous enaretous.
Eulogesame auton (ton Abraam) kai ton Isaak. Alla anamesa stous apogonous tous uperkhan ekeinoi pou eprattan to kalo kai ekeinoi pou adikesan xekathara ton eauto tous.
Pragmati, dosame eunoia ston Mouse kai ston Aaron (kanontas tous duo Prophetes),
sosame autous kai ton lao tous apo te megale duskolia (ten upodoulose ston Pharao kai ton pnigmo sto nero),
tous uposterixame (enantion tou Pharao kai ton stratioton tou), kai etsi etan oi niketes,
tous dosame (ston Mouse kai ston Aaron) to xekatharo Biblio (ten Tora),
tous kathodegesame ston isio dromo,
kai kaname na meinei enas epainos gi' autous tous duo stis metagenesteres genies:
<<Eirene kai asphaleia ston Mouse kai ston Aaron.>>
Etsi antameiboume ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.
Pragmati, etan kai oi duo apo tous pistous doulous Mas.
Pragmati, kai o Elias etan enas apo tous Aggeliaphorous.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan eipe (o Elias) ston lao tou: <<De tha phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou);
Einai dunaton na epikaleiste (kai na latreuete) ena eidolo os kurio kai theo, kai na egkataleipsete te latreia pros ton Kalutero ton demiourgon,
ton Allakh, ton Kurio sas kai ton Kurio olon ton progonon sas;>>
Alla (oi apistoi) ton diepseusan (sto oti tha prepei na latreuoun mono ton Allakh), opote sigoura tha pareurethoun (ten Emera tes Kriseos sten timoria).
Ektos apo tous aphosiomenous eklektous pistous doulous tou Allakh, (oi opoioi tha einai asphaleis apo ten timoria kai tha laboun pollaple antamoibe).
Kaname na meinei enas epainos gi' auton (ton Elia) stis metagenesteres genies:
<<Eirene kai asphaleia ston Elia.>>
Etsi antameiboume ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.
Pragmati, etan enas apo tous pistous doulous Mas.
Pragmati, kai o Lot etan enas apo tous Aggeliaphorous.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan ton sosame kai ole ten oikogeneia tou (diatazontas ton na phugei to bradu apo ten pole Sodoma),
ektos apo mia elikiomene (te gunaika tou), pou etan metaxu ekeinon pou emeinan piso (kai katastraphekan).
Meta katastrepsame tous upoloipous.
Eseis (o, anthropoi tes phules Kourais) pernate apo ta ereipia tous (kata ta taxidia sas) ten emera,
kai te nukhta. Ma de sullogizeste;
Pragmati, kai o Giounous (Ionas) etan enas apo tous Aggeliaphorous.
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan ephuge (apo ton lao tou khoris ten adeia tou Kuriou tou) sto phortomeno ploio.
(Paraligo to ploio na buthistei logo tou barous kai sumphonesan oi epibates na kanoun klero), kai etsi erixe (o Ionas) klero, alla etan metaxu ekeinon pou ekhasan (kai pedexan ste thalassa).
Etsi, to megalo psari ton katapie (ton Iona zontano), kathos eikhe kanei (o Ionas) mia praxe axia epiplexes (oti ephuge khoris ten adeia tou Kuriou tou).

An den etan (o Ionas prin) enas ap' autous pou doxazoun kai exumnoun polu ton Allakh (kai an den eikhe epikalestei ton Allakh mesa sten koilia tou psariou legontas: <<Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Esu! Doxa Soi! Pragmati, emoun enas apo tous adikous>>),
tha eikhe meinei sten koilia tou (psariou) mekhri ten Emera pou tha anastethoun (oi anthropoi).

Etsi, (ton sosame kai) ton petaxame exo (apo to psari, kanontas to psari na ton aphesei) se mia anoikhte akte (opou den uperkhan dentra, oute ktiria pou na ton skiazan) eno etan polu adunamos (san to neogenneto moro e ena kotopoulaki khoris poupoula),
kai kaname na phutrosei (dipla tou) ena phuto kolokuthas gia na ton skiasei.
Kai ton steilame (ton Iona xana ston lao tou) se ekato khiliades kai akome perissoterous.
Kai etsi pistepsan, kai pareikhame agatha s' autous gia enan prokathorismeno khrono (tou telous tes zoes tous).

Rota loipon (o, Mokhammant) autous (tous apistous apo ton lao sou) pos einai dunaton na apodidoun ston Kurio sou oti ekhei kores (tous Aggelous, parolo pou oi idioi oi apistoi den epithumoun na ekhoun kores) kai epithumoun gia ton eauto tous to na ekhoun gious!
E mepos demiourgesame tous Aggelous os theluka eno (oi apistoi) etan parontes (kai eidan te demiourgia tous);
Pragmati, einai apo to pseudos tous (ton eidololatron) oti lene:
<<O Allakh apektese paidia>>, kai autoi einai pragmati, pseutes!
Einai dunaton (na apodidete s' Auton) oti epelexe na ekhei kores (parolo pou eseis oi idioi den epithumeite na ekhete kores), anti to na ekhei gious (eno eseis epithumeite na ekhete gious);
Ti sumbainei me sas; Pos krinete (me to na apodidete ston Allakh kati pou den epithumeite kan gia ton eauto sas);
De tha labete loipon mia nouthesia;
E mepos ekhete kapoia xekathare apodeixe (apo ena biblio pou esteile o Allakh);
Pherte loipon to biblio sas (pou sas erthe apo ton Allakh kai uposterizei ta logia sas), an eiste eilikrineis!

Epises iskhurizontai (oi eidololatres) oti uparkhei suggeneia metaxu Autou (tou Allakh) kai ton tzinn [legontas oti oi aoratoi Aggeloi einai oi kores Tou apo tis arkhegous ton tzinn pou tis pantreuteke o Allakh, kai oti o Satanas einai o adelphos tou Allakh! -Doxa ston Allakh! Einai polu Anoteros ap' auta pou iskhurizontai-]. Pragmati, ta tzinn xeroun kala oti tha brethoun (enopion tou Allakh gia na logodotesoun, pos loipon na eikhan suggeneia mazi Tou;)!
Doxa ston Allakh, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (oi anthropoi pseudos, apo ateleies).
Ektos apo tous aphosiomenous eklektous pistous doulous tou Allakh (oi opoioi apodidoun s' Auton Upseles Idiotetes pou tairiazoun ste Megaloprepeia Tou).
Eseis loipon (o, eidololatres) kai o,ti latreuete (ektos apo ton Allakh),
den mporeite na parasurete kanenan makria ap' aute (ten alethine threskeia),
ektos apo kapoion pou (einai ede ste gnose tou Allakh oti) tha mpei sten Kolase gia na kaei mesa tes!

(Oi Aggeloi eipan): <<Den uparkhei kanenas anamesa mas pou den ekhei mia gnoste these [ston ourano kai ste latreia pros ton Allakh, kai den eimaste kores tou Allakh opos iskhurizontai oi eidololatres].
Pragmati, emeis eimaste autoi pou stekontai paratetagmenoi se seires (ste latreia pros ton Allakh).
Kai emeis eimaste autoi pou doxazoun (ton Allakh).>>
(Oi eidololatres apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete, prin ten apostole sou) sunethisan na lene:
<<An eikhame ena Biblio (kai mia nouthesia) apo tous proegoumenous (Prophetes pou na mas plerophoroun gia ta proegoumena ethne),
tha eimastan emeis oi aphosiomenoi eklektoi pistoi douloi tou Allakh.>>
Alla (otan tous erthe to Kor'an) to arnethekan. Pragmati, tha mathoun (ti tous perimenei apo timoria)!
Pragmati, o Logos Mas ekhei ede dothei stous Aggeliaphorous doulous Mas,
oti ekeinoi einai autoi pou tha laboun ten uposterixe (Mas, enantion ton ekhthron tous),
kai oti pragmati, oi stratiotes Mas tha einai oi niketes.
Apomakrunsou loipon (o, Prophete) ap' autous (tous peismataredes apistous) gia ligo.
(Perimene) kai koita tous (otan tha ettethoun), pragmati, tha doun (kai autoi)!
Biazontai (os proklese pros esena, o, Prophete) na pesei pano tous e timoria Mas;
Otan tha pesei (e timoria Mas) s' autous (kai stous oikous tous), poso tromero tha einai ekeino to proi ekeinon pou elaban proeidopoiese!
Apomakrunsou loipon (o, Prophete) ap' autous (tous peismataredes apistous) gia ligo.
(Perimene) kai koita (otan tha ettethoun), pragmati, tha doun (kai autoi)!
Doxa ston Kurio sou, ton Kurio tes Dunames, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (apo ateleies).
Eirene kai asphaleia stous Aggeliaphorous.
Doxa ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.

S (Sant, ena arabiko grammata pou den apotelei kamia lexe, alla ekhei semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tou. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata pou ta miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio). (Orkizomai) ma to Kor'an pou periekhei upenthumise kai nouthesia (gia tous anthropous)! (Oti den iskhuei auto pou iskhurizontai oi apistoi oti o Allakh ekhei etairous).
Okhi (o Allakh den ekhei etairous), alla ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste briskontai se alazoneia kai dikhonoia.

Posa (apista) ethne prin ap' autous (tous apistous apo te phule Kourais) ekhoume katastrepsei, kai phonaxan (epikaloumenoi Emas gia boetheia kai straphekan me metameleia pros Emas otan eidan ten timoria), alla den etan e ora na sothoun (apo ten timoria meso metameleias)!
To briskoun periergo oti tous erthe enas proeidopoietes (o Mokhammant) ap' autous tous idious, kai oi apistoi lene: <<Autos einai pseutes magos!

Einai dunaton na leei oti oloi autoi oi theoi einai mataioi, kai oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Enas Theos (o Opoios akouei tis epikleseis olon ton anthropon); Pragmati, auto einai kati periergo!>>

Oi arkhegoi anamesa tous (pou pegan ston Ampou Talimp, ton theio tou Prophete, dusarestemenoi oti o Prophetes katakrinei tous theous tous), ephugan legontas (metaxu tous): <<Sunekhiste (ste threskeia sas) kai na eiste statheroi ste latreia ton theon sas. Pragmati, auto (pou mas kalei o Mokhammant) einai kati pou epidioketai (apo ton Mokhammant gia na kerdisei egesia kai kuriarkhia se olous mas).

Den ekhoume akousei kati tetoio [oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Enas Theos] sten teleutaia threskeia (del. oute ste threskeia ton progonon mas, oute ste threskeia ton Khristianon)! Auto den einai para ena psema (pou to ekhei kataskeuasei o Mokhammant)!

Einai dunaton oti apo olous mas na tou ekhei stalei (ston Mokhammant) e Upenthumise (eno emeis eimaste oi arkhegoi);>> Okhi (de miloun apo gnose), alla briskontai se amphibolia gia ten Upenthumise Mou (kai miloun apo amphibolia gia na apotrepsoun ten aletheia)! Okhi (den iskhuoun auta pou lene), alla (tolmesan na ta poun) epeide den ekhoun akome geutei ten timoria (Mou).

E mepos katekhoun ta thesaurophulakia tou eleous (kai tes gennaiodorias) tou Kuriou sou, tou Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamou, Aniketou), tou Al-Ouakhamp (Autou pou kharizei me gennaiodoria khoris kanena antallagma), [-gia na apotrepsoun ten Apokalupse apo ton Mokhammant kai na te steiloun se opoious epilegoun apo tous kakous anamesa tous-];

E mepos ekhoun ten kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson briskontai anamesa tous (gia na steiloun ten apokalupse se opoious theloun); As aneboun loipon (ston ourano) me opoia mesa (gia na apotrepsoun ten apokalupse apo ton Mokhammant)!
(Autoi oi apistoi) einai kapoioi stratiotes pou tha ettethoun opos oi (proegoumenes apistes) omades (pou ettethekan).
Pragmati, kai prin ap' autous diepseusan (tous Aggeliaphorous), o laos tou Noe, e phule 'Ant, o Pharao pou eikhe tous passalous,
e phule Thamount, o laos tou Lot, kai oi katoikoi tes komopoles ton strimmenon dentron (konta ste Madiam)! Ekeinoi etan oi (proegoumenes apistes) omades.
Den uperkhe kamia omada ap' autes, para na diepseuse tous Aggeliaphorous, epomenos e timoria egine anapopheukte (gi' ekeine).
Den perimenoun (oi apistoi apo te phule Kourais) para mono mia krauge (otan tha phusexei o Aggelos Israphel to Keras -Salpigga-), e opoia (krauge) einai me anastrepsime!
Lene (oi apistoi khleuazontas): <<Kurie mas! Phere mas gregora to meridio mas (apo ten timoria) prin apo ten Emera tou Apologismou.>>

Deixe loipon (o, Mokhammant) upomone gia o,ti lene (oi apistoi). Kai anaphere ton doulo Mas, Dabid, pou eikhe duname (ste latreia kai sten upakoe pros Emas, kai enantia stous ekhthrous tou) kai (doxaze polu Emas, kai) strephotan sunekhos me metameleia pros Emas.
Upotaxame ta bouna na doxazoun mazi tou ton Allakh to bradu kai to proi,
kai (to idio ekanan) ta poulia pou sugkentrothekan (gi' auton): ola upakoua s' auton (ton Dabid, kai doxasan mazi tou ton Allakh).
Eniskhusame to basileio tou (Dabid) kai tou dosame sophia kai orthe krise ston logo kai sten apophase.
Erthe se sena (o, Mokhammant) e eidese ton duo antipalon (Aggelon), otan mpekan sto domatio tes latreias tou (Dabid, khoris na perasoun apo ten kleiste porta tou);

Otan mpekan ston topo tou Dabid, kai (o Dabid) tromaxe ap' autous, eipan: <<Me phobasai! Eimaste duo antipaloi, pou adikesame o enas ton allon. Krine loipon metaxu mas me te dikaiosune, men adikeseis (emas me ten krise sou) kai kathodegese mas sto sosto dromo.>>
(Enas ap' autous eipe): <<Autos einai o aderphos mou. O opoios ekhei enenenta ennea probatines eno ego ekho mono mia. Kai (mou) eipe: <<Dos' te mou.>> kai me nikese sta logia.>>

(O Dabid) eipe: <<Pragmati, se adikese pou zetese na prosthesei ten probatina sou stis probatines tou. Pragmati, polloi sunetairoi katapiezoun o enas ton allon, ektos ap' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, kai poso ligoi einai autoi!>> Tote o Dabid katalabe oti Emeis ton dokimazame (m' aute ten upothese), kai etsi, zetese sugkhorese apo ton Kurio tou, epese se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) kai strapheke me metameleia. [Den anapheretai edo giati zetese sugkhorese, alla mporei epeide ekrine aphou akouse ton enan kai khoris na akousei ton allon].
Etsi, tou to sugkhoresame auto, kai (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha einai enas apo tous kontinous doulous Mas kai tha ekhei ena kalo meros epistrophes (ton Paradeiso).

(Eipame): <<O, Dabid! Pragmati, se kaname kuriarkho ste ge (sto basileio sou), krine loipon metaxu ton anthropon me ten aletheia kai men akoloutheis tis epithumies sou gia na me se parasuroun makria apo to dromo tou Allakh.>> Pragmati, osoi parekklinoun apo to dromo tou Allakh, tha ekhoun austero marturio ten Emera tou Apologismou gia o,ti paramelesan (apo kales praxeis kai apo to na krinoun me ten aletheia metaxu ton anthropon).

Pragmati, de demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous mataia! Aute einai e eikasia ekeinon pou arnethekan ten piste! Alimono s' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste (kai tha katastraphoun) ste Photia!

Einai dunaton oti tha metakheiristoume autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, opos autous pou skorpizoun to kako ste ge; E einai dunaton oti tha metakheiristoume tous eusebeis opos tous asebeis;
Auto einai ena eulogemeno Biblio pou steilame se sena (o, Mokhammant), gia na sullogistoun (oi anthropoi) ta Edaphia tou kai na to laboun upopse (kai na laboun nouthesia) ekeinoi pou ekhoun logike!
Kharisame ston Dabid, ton Solomonta! Poso kalos doulos (Mas) etan (o Solomontas), o opoios (Mas doxaze polu, kai) strephotan sunekhos me upakoe kai metameleia pros Emas!
Anaphere (o, Prophete) otan parousiastekan mprosta tou (Solomonta) to apogeuma kala, orthia kai gregora aloga.

(O Solomontas) eipe: <<Ekho ten agape gia ta kala (ta aloga) logo tes exumneses tou Kuriou mou (epeide Ton doxazo gia tis khares Tou kai khresimopoio ta aloga stis makhes sto dromo Tou).>> Mekhri pou (ephugan ta aloga kai) exaphanistekan (apo ten orase tou).
(Dietaxe o Solomontas): <<Pherte ta (aloga) piso se mena>>, kai arkhise na khaideuei ta podia kai tous laimous (tous os time pros auta).

Pragmati, dokimasame ton Solomonta kai rixame sto throno tou ena soma [eite semainei oti egine arrostos san na men eikhe psukhe, e oti aphou orkisteke oti e kathe mia apo tis gunaikes tou, tha gennesei ena paidi pou tha agonizetai sto dromo tou Allakh, khoris omos na pei <<me to thelema tou Allakh>>, kai etsi mono mia gennese, alla ena paramorphomeno paidi], epeita strapheke [me metameleia pros ton Allakh].

(O Solomontas) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Sugkhorese me kai kharise mou ena basileio, pou de tha dothei (tetoio) pote se kanenan meta apo emena. Pragmati, Esu eisai o Al-Ouakhamp (Autos pou kharizei me gennaiodoria khoris kanena antallagma).>>
Tou upotaxame loipon ton anemo, o opoios phusouse apala (para ten takhuteta kai te duname tou) me ten entole tou (Solomonta) opou ethele,
kai (tou dosame exousia) stous diabolous, kapoioi ekhtizan (o,ti ethele) kai alloi boutexan (ste thalassa gia na tou pheroun kosmemata),
kai alloi etan demenoi me alusides (aphou ton parakousan).

(Eipame ston Solomonta): <<Aute einai e khare Mas (pou dinoume se sena apo kuriarkhia kai exousia), dose loipon (ap' auto to basileio se opoion theleis) e krata (apo opoion theleis), khoris euthune (se sena).>>
Pragmati, (ten Emera tes Kriseos, o Solomontas) tha einai enas apo tous kontinous doulous Mas kai tha ekhei ena kalo meros epistrophes (ton Paradeiso).

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) ton doulo Mas, ton Iob, otan epikalesteke ton Kurio tou [aphou emeine arrostos arketa khronia, oi anthropoi apomakrunthekan ap' auton -ektos apo te gunaika tou kai duo philous tou- kai ekhase ta ploute tou]: <<Mou prokalese o Satanas ponous kai kakoukhies (sto soma, ston plouto kai sten oikogeneia mou).>>
(Eipame): <<Khtupa to edaphos me to podi sou (gia na anablusei to nero): aute einai mia drosere pege gia na plenesai (kai na therapeuteis) kai gia na pieis.>>
Kai epistrepsame s' auton ten oikogeneia tou kai perissoterous mazi tous os eleos apo Emas kai os upenthumise gia tous anthropous pou ekhoun ugie nou.

(Eipame s' auton, aphou thumose apo te gunaika tou kai orkisteke oti tha te khtupesei, otan autos tha therapeutei): <<Pare sto kheri sou ena matso malako khorto (pou tha ekhei ton idio arithmo ton khtupematon pou orkistekes) kai khtupa m' auto (mono mia phora te gunaika sou) kai etsi de tha ekheis athetesei ton orko sou.>> Pragmati, ton brekame upomonetiko. Poso kalos doulos (Mas) etan (o Iob), o opoios (Mas doxaze polu, kai) strephotan sunekhos me upakoe kai metameleia pros Emas.
Anaphere (o, Prophete) tous doulous Mas: ton Abraam, ton Isaak kai ton Iakob, oi opoioi eikhan duname (ste latreia kai ten upakoe) kai katanoese (ste threskeia).
Pragmati, tous epilexame kai tous dosame ten arete tou na thumountai te Mellousa Zoe (kai etsi panta upakousan ton Allakh kai kalesan tous anthropous sten upakoe pros Auton).
Pragmati, autoi einai enopion Mas, apo tous eklektous kai tous enaretous.
Anaphere (o, Prophete) ton Ismael, ton Elisaio kai ton Da-Al-Kiphl, oloi tous etan apo tous enaretous.
Aute einai mia upenthumise. Pragmati, oi eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou) tha ekhoun ena kalo meros epistrophes:
(To opoio tha einai) kepoi monimes diamones (ston Paradeiso), me tis pules orthanoikhtes gi' autous.
Tha einai xaplomenoi ekei (pano sta stolismena krebatia), kai tha zetesoun ekei (apo tous uperetes) na tous pheroun phrouta, polla (osa theloun) kai pota.
Tha ekhoun semnes gunaikes pou tha periorizoun ten orase tous (kai ten kardia tous stous suzugous tous kai mono), oi opoies tha einai oles sten idia elikia.
Auto einai pou sas uposkhetai (o Allakh, o, eusebeis) oti tha to labete ten Emera tou Apologismou.
Pragmati, aute einai e antamoibe Mas (gia tous enaretous), e opoia den teleionei (oute diakoptetai) pote.
Aute (tha einai e antamoibe ton eusebon). Alla oi parabates tha ekhoun to kheirotero meros epistrophes:
Tha eiselthoun sten Kolase gia na kaoun. Poso athlios einai autos o topos diamones!
Auto (to marturio) tha to geutoun, (tha pioun) zematisto nero kai puon,
kai (tha ekhoun) allo (marturio) paromoio m' auto, diaphoron eidon.

(Oi parabates tha poun o enas ston allon otan tha doun tous opadous tous na eiserkhontai sten Kolase): <<Aute einai mia omada pou tha eiselthei mazi sas (sten Kolase). Makari na men einai eurukhores oi theseis tous (sten Kolase, kai de tha uparkhei kanena kalosorisma gi' autous)! Pragmati, tha kaoun sten Kolase.>>

(Oi opadoi) tha poun: <<Antitheta, makari gia sas na men einai eurukhores oi theseis sas (sten Kolase, kai de tha uparkhei kanena kalosorisma gia sas)! Pragmati, eseis eiste pou mas to pherate auto (otan mas kalesate sten apistia). Poso tromero meros egkatastases einai auto!>>
(Oi opadoi) tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Opoios mas to ephere auto (epeide mas kalese sten apistia), dose tou diplo marturio sten Kolase.>>

(Oi parabates) tha poun (metaxu tous os epiplexe gia ton eauto tous epeide koroideuan tous Mousoulmanous prin): <<Giati de blepoume (sten Kolase) kapoious andres (tous phtokhous Mousoulmanous) pou theorousame (sten egkosmia zoe) oti etan apo tous athlious (pou ekhasan ten apolause tes egkosmias zoes epeide pistepsan sto Islam kai katekrinan te threskeia mas);
Tous koroidepsame (adikos sten egkosmia zoe) e mepos (einai sten Kolase mazi mas alla) ta matia mas den tous blepoun;>>
Auto (pou anapherame) gia te diaphonia metaxu ton katoikon tes Photias (kai oti tha malonoun o enas ton allon), einai aletheia (pou den uparkhei amphibolia s' aute kai oposdepote tha ginei)!

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, ego eimai mono enas proeidopoietes, kai den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh, o Al-Ouakheint (o Enas Alethinos Theos), o Al-Kakhar (Autos pou nika kai upotassei opoion thelei),
o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Gaphphar (Autos pou sugkhorei sunekhos sto megisto bathmo).>>
Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous pou lene oti esu kataskeuases to Kor'an): <<Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia spoudaia eidese,
apo ten opoia eseis apomakruneste!

Den eikha kamia gnose gia ten anotate sunaxe (ton Aggelon) otan suzetousan (skhetika me te demiourgia tou Adam, kai eseis xerete oti den eikha tetoia gnose prin, kati pou apodeiknuei se sas oti to Kor'an ekhei apokaluphthei apo ton Allakh).
Den apokaluptetai (auto pou apokaluptetai apo ton Allakh) se mena para mono epeide eimai enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia!>>
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan o Kurios sou eipe stous Aggelous: <<Pragmati, tha demiourgeso enan anthropo apo pelo.
Otan tha ton diamorphoso kai emphuseso (del. ebala) s' auton to pneuma pou demiourgesa, peste oloi mprosta tou se Sitzount stase (me to metopo os khairetismos kai time pros auton).>>
Etsi, oloi oi Aggeloi epesan se Sitzount stase (me to metopo),
ektos apo ton Implis (-ton Satana- pou etan tzinn), (arnetheke kai) egine alazonas, kai etsi egine apo tous apistous.

(O Allakh) eipe (os epiplexe): <<O, Implis (Satana)! Ti se empodise na peseis se Sitzount stase (me to metopo os khairetismos kai time) gi' auton pou ton demiourgesa me ta Kheria Mou; Egines alazonas tote (kai se empodise e alazoneia ap' auto) e esoun ede apo tous alazones (prin ap' auto);>>
(O Satanas) eipe: <<Eimai kaluteros ap' auton, me demiourgeses apo photia eno ton demiourgeses apo pelo.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Bges loipon ap' aute (te these sou anamesa stous Aggelous). Pragmati, eisai kataramenos kai diogmenos,
kai tha einai epano sou e katara Mou mekhri ten Emera tes Kriseos.>>
(O Satanas) eipe: <<Kurie mou! Dose mou anabole mekhri ten Emera pou tha anastethoun (oi anthropoi, oi apogonoi tou Adam).>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<Eisai enas ap' autous pou tha laboun anabole,
mekhri ten Emera tou Kathorismenou Khronou.>>
(O Satanas) eipe: <<(Orkizomai) ma te Duname Sou! Tha tous paraplaneso olous,
ektos ap' tous eklektous (alethinous pistous) doulous Sou anamesa tous.>>
(O Allakh) eipe: <<E Aletheia einai, kai ten Aletheia leo:
Pragmati, tha gemiso ten Kolase me sena kai me osous tha se akolouthesoun ap' autous, me olous sas mazi.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metaphero se sas apo to Menuma tou Allakh), oute eimai ap' ekeinous pou iskhurizontai kati pseudos (gia na peite oti ekho kataskeuasei to Kor'an e ekho metapherei kati parapano apo o,ti mou apokalupse o Allakh).
Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) den einai para mia Upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gia olo ton kosmo,
kai pragmati, tha mathete ten aletheia tou (Kor'an, skhetika me tis uposkheseis kai tis proeidopoieseis tou) meta apo ligo.>>
(Aute einai) e apokalupse tou Bibliou apo ton Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-Khakeim (Pansopho).
Pragmati, steilame se sena (o, Prophete) to Biblio me ten aletheia, latrepse loipon ton Allakh, me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton ste threskeia (ste latreia kai sten upakoe).

Pragmati, ston Allakh kai mono anekei e agne threskeia (e pleres upakoe kai e latreia). Oso gi' ekeinous pou pairnoun allous os kurious (kai theous) ektos apo Auton, [legontas], <<Den tous latreuoume para mono gia na mas pheroun pio konta ston Allakh>>, pragmati, o Allakh tha krinei metaxu tous s' auto sto opoio diaphonoun. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei kanenan pou einai pseutes kai epimonos apistos.

An ethele o Allakh na ekhei enan uio, tha eikhe epilexei o,ti ethele apo o,ti demiourgese. Doxa s' Auton (einai polu Anoteros apo to na ekhei enan uio)! Einai o Allakh, o Al-Ouakheint (o Enas Alethinos Theos), o Al-Kakhar (Autos pou nika kai upotassei opoion thelei).

Demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge me ten Aletheia (kai okhi mataia)! Kanei te nukhta na kaluptei (kai na katadiokei gregora) ten emera, kai kanei ten emera na kaluptei (kai na katadiokei gregora) te nukhta. Upetaxe ton elio kai to pheggari na trekhei to kathena tous (ste dike tou trokhia) gia enan kathorismeno khrono. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Gaphphar (Autos pou sugkhorei sunekhos sto megisto bathmo).

Sas demiourgese olous apo ena mono atomo (ton Adam), epeita, demiourgese ap' auton, te suzugo tou (ten Eua). Esteile se sas kato (ste ge) okto booeide se zeugaria (tis kameles, tis agelades, ta probata kai ta katsikia). Sas demiourgei mesa stis metres ton meteron sas, mia demiourgia (phase) meta apo ten alle, mesa se tria stromata skotadiou. Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas. S' Auton anekei e Kuriarkhia, kai den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo te latreia pros Auton kai latreuete allous pseutikous theous pou den demiourgoun tipota);

An arneiste ten piste, pragmati o Allakh den sas ekhei anagke (oute ekhei anagke ten piste sas, oute tha Ton blapsei e apistia sas). De dekhetai ten apistia gia tous doulous Tou. Alla an eiste eugnomones, te dekhetai (ten eugnomosune) apo sas (kai tha sas antameipsei gi' aute). Kamia (amartole) psukhe de tha epomistei ten amartia kapoias alles. Epeita, pros ton Kurio sas tha einai e epistrophe sas, kai tha sas enemerosei gia ola osa kanate. Pragmati, Autos einai gia o,ti uparkhei stis kardies, Pantognostes.

Otan kapoia sumphora aggixei ton anthropo (ton apisto), epikaleitai ton Kurio tou (na ton sosei), strephomenos pros Auton me plere metameleia. Epeita otan (o Allakh) tou parakhorei mia khare ap' Auton, tote egkataleipei (o anthropos) ten epiklese pou ekane prin pros Auton (otan briskotan se kakoukhies), kai apodidei ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, gia na paraplanesei allous apo to Dromo Tou. Pes (o, Prophete, se auton): <<Apolause ten apistia sou gia ligo* pragmati, esu eisai apo tous katoikous tes Photias!>>

Einai dunaton oti autos pou upakouei ton Allakh, kai kata te nukhta pephtei se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) kai steketai (telontas te nukhterine proseukhe), phoboumenos (ten timoria kata) te Mellousa Zoe kai elpizontas sto Eleos tou Kuriou tou, (na einai isos m' ekeinon pou epikaleitai ton Allakh stis kakoukhies kai epeita aphou sothei, apodidei ston Allakh etairous ste latreia); Pes (o, Prophete): <<Einai autoi pou gnorizoun (ton Kurio tous kai te threskeia Tou), isoi m' ekeinous pou de gnorizoun;>> Pragmati, tha to laboun upopse (kai os nouthesia) mono ekeinoi pou ekhoun ugie nou (gia na to sullogistoun).

Pes (o, Prophete, metapherontas ta Logia Mou): <<O, douloi Mou pou pisteuete! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Kuriou sas (terontas tis entoles Tou). Osoi kanoun kales praxeis s' aute ten egkosmia zoe, tha laboun mia kale antamoibe (sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe). Pragmati, e ge tou Allakh einai eurukhore (gia na metanastepsete, oste na mporeite na latrepsete ton Allakh, an antimetopizete diogmous logo tes threskeias sas). Pragmati, oi upomonetikoi tha laboun ten antamoibe tous khoris logariasmo (aperiorista).>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, ekho diatakhthei na latreuo ton Allakh, me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton ste threskeia (ste latreia kai sten upakoe).
Kai ekho diatakhthei na eimai o protos Mousoulmanos (ap' auto to ethnos, del. upotagmenos ste boulese tou Allakh).>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, phobamai, an parakouso ton Kurio mou, na labo ena marturio se mia tromere Emera.>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Mono ton Allakh latreuo, me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton ste threskeia mou (ste latreia mou kai sten upakoe mou pros Auton).

Latrepste loipon eseis o,ti thelete ektos apo Auton, (pragmati, tha deite tis kakes sunepeies ton praxeon sas).>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, oi khamenoi einai autoi (oi apistoi) pou tha khasoun ton eauto tous (ste Photia) kai tis oikogeneies tous ten Emera tes Anastases (epeide tote de tha tous xanasunantesoun pote). Aute einai pragmati e xekathare apoleia.>>

Tha ekhoun apo pano tous stromata apo Photia pou tha tous skepasoun kai apo kato tous stromata pou tha tous skepasoun. M' auto (to proanapheromeno) o Allakh apeilei tous doulous Tou. O, douloi Mou! Phulakhtheite loipon apo ten timoria Mou (terontas tis entoles Mou).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou apopheugoun te latreia ton pseutikon theon kai strephontai me metameleia pros ton Allakh, gi' autous uparkhoun ta kharmosuna nea (gia ton Paradeiso). Dose loipon (o, Prophete) ta kharmosuna nea stous doulous Mou,
oi opoioi akoun ton logo kai akolouthoun ta kalutera tou. Ekeinoi einai autoi pou tous kathodegese o Allakh kai ekeinoi einai autoi pou ekhoun ugie nou.
Oso gi' auton gia ton opoion o Logos gia ten timoria egine anapopheuktos, tha mporeis esu (o, Mokhammant) na soseis opoion brisketai ste Photia; [Okhi, den mporeis].

Alla ekeinoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Kuriou tous (terontas tis entoles Tou), tha ekhoun upseles katoikies (palatia), khtismenes se stromata to ena pano sto allo, kato apo tis opoies tha reoun potamia. Aute einai e uposkhese tou Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh den athetei pote ten uposkhese Tou.

De blepeis (o, Prophete) oti o Allakh stelnei nero apo ton ourano kai to eisagei se peges ste ge, epeita phutronei m' auto kalliergeies diaphoron khromaton, kai epeita xerainontai kai tis blepeis kitrinismenes, kai epeita tis kanei kommatia! Pragmati, uparkhei s' auto mia upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gia tous anthropous pou ekhoun ugie nou.

Einai autos tou opoiou to stethos (to ekhei kathodegesei kai) to ekhei anoixei o Allakh pros to Islam, kai etsi brisketai se phos apo ton Kurio tou, (isos m' ekeinon ton apisto pou ekhei sklere kardia); Alimono s' ekeinous pou ekhoun skleres kardies apenanti sten exumnese tou Allakh. Pragmati, ekeinoi briskontai se xekathare plane!

O Allakh esteile ta kalutera Logia (to Kor'an), ena Biblio tou opoiou ta mere moiazoun to ena me to allo (sten teleioteta kai ten aletheia, kai den periekhoun antiphaseis metaxu tous), kai mesa sto opoio (Biblio) epanalambanontai [oi kanones, oi istories, oi nouthesies kai oi apodeixeis, kai etsi, opoios diabasei opoiodepote Kephalaio, tha briskei o,ti khreiazetai apo nouthesies klp.]. Anatrikhiazei to derma ekeinon pou phobountai ton Kurio tous, ap' auto (to Biblio, otan akoun tis apeiles tou gia ten timoria ton apiston), kai meta malakonei to derma kai oi kardies tous me ten exumnese tou Allakh (to Kor'an, otan akoun tis uposkheseis tou gia ten antamoibe ton piston). Aute einai e kathodegese tou Allakh, me ten opoia kathodegei opoious thelei. Alla opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, den uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na ton kathodegesei.

Einai ekeinos (o apistos) pou tha prospathei na apophugei te kheirotere timoria me to prosopo tou (epeide ta kheria kai ta podia tou tha einai demena) ten Emera tes Anastases, (isos m' auton pou tha brisketai sten aionia eudaimonia ston Paradeiso); Tha eipothei stous adikous: <<Geuteite o,ti eikhate kanei.>>
Ekeinoi (apo ta proegoumena ethne) pou etan prin ap' autous (tous eidololatres apo te phule Kourais) diepseusan (tous Aggeliaphorous), kai etsi, tous erthe e timoria apo ekei pou den ten perimenan.
Etsi, o Allakh tous ekane na geutoun ten atimose sten egkosmia zoe, alla e timoria tes Mellousas Zoes, tha einai polu megalutere, an to exeran.
Pragmati, ekhoume parousiasei gia tous anthropous s' auto to Kor'an, kathe eidous paradeigma, isos kai na to laboun upopse.
(To kaname na einai) ena Kor'an sta arabika, pou den periekhei kamia sugkhuse (e antiphase), oste (oi anthropoi) isos na phulakhtoun apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis xekathares entoles Tou).

O Allakh parousiazei ena paradeigma enos sklabou, o opoios anekei se diaphoretika aphentika pou diaphonoun metaxu tous (kai etsi den mporei na tous upakousei olous mazi), kai enos sklabou pou anekei mono se enan aphente. Einai isoi (oi duo sklaboi) se sugkrise; Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh! Alla oi perissoteroi den xeroun (kai gi' auto apodidoun ston Allakh etairous ste latreia).
Pragmati, esu (o, Prophete) tha pethaneis kai autoi tha pethanoun,
epeita, ten Emera tes Anastases (o, anthropoi), enopion tou Kuriou sas tha kritheite (se o,ti diaphonesate metaxu sas sten egkosmia zoe).

Poios einai pio adikos ap' ekeinon pou leei psemata gia ton Allakh (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia e iskhurizetai oti o Allakh ekhei enan uio) kai diapseudei ten aletheia (to Kor'an) aphou ephtase s' auton (me ton Prophete Mokhammant); Den uparkhei sten Kolase enas topos katoikias gia tous apistous; [Bebaios uparkhei].

Oso gi' ekeinon (ton Mokhammant) pou erthe me ten aletheia (to Kor'an) kai gi' ekeinous pou pistepsan s' aute, ekeinoi einai pragmati oi eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).
Tha ekhoun o,ti epithumoun (ston Paradeiso apo agatha) apo ton Kurio tous. Aute einai e antamoibe oson prattoun to kalo.

Gia na sugkhoresei o Allakh gi' autous to kako (tis amarties) pou ekanan (aphou eikhan straphei me metameleia pros Auton sten egkosmia zoe), kai na tous dosei ten antamoibe tous gia to kalo pou eprattan.

De tha prostatepsei o Allakh (kai de tha uposterixei) ton doulo Tou (ton Mokhammant); [Bebaios tha ton uposterixei]! Se ekphobizoun (oi eidololatres) m' ekeinous (tous pseutikous theous kai ta eidola tous) pou tous latreuoun ektos apo Auton (oti tha se blapsoun epeide tous katakrineis)! Pragmati, opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, den uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na ton kathodegesei.
Kai opoion kathodegei o Allakh, kaneis den mporei na ton paraplanesei. Den einai o Allakh 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai Ikanos gia antapodose; [Bebaios einai].

An (o, Prophete) tous roteseis (tous eidololatres): <<Poios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge;>> Tha poun: <<O Allakh.>> Pes: <<Tote peite mou, tha mporoun ekeinoi (oi pseutikous theoi kai ta eidola) pou tous latreuete ektos apo ton Allakh, an o Allakh thelei na me blapsei, na aphairesoun te blabe pou thelei na mou kanei; E an thelei na mou kharisei eleos, tha mporoun na empodisoun to eleos Tou;>> Pes: <<Mou eparkei o Allakh (se ola ta zetemata mou). Mono Auton empisteuontai oi pistoi.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O, lae mou! Sunekhiste na kanete (auto pou kanete) me ton idio tropo sas (sten apistia kai ten plane). Pragmati, kai ego tha kano (o,ti me diatazei o Kurios mou). Pragmati, tha mathete,
se poion tha erthei mia timoria pou tha ton atimasei (sten egkosmia zoe), kai tha pesei pano tou ena aionio marturio (ste Mellousa Zoe).>>

Pragmati, apokalupsame se sena (o, Prophete) to Biblio, me ten aletheia, gia (na kathodegesei) tous anthropous. Opoios, loipon, kathodegeitai, tha einai pros to ophelos tou, alla opoios parastratei, tha einai eis baros tou. Den eisai upeuthunos (e kedemonas) gi' autous.

Einai o Allakh pou aphairei tis psukhes otan erkhetai e stigme tou [megalou] thanatou tous, kai (krataei epises) ekeines (tis psukhes) pou den pethanan (kai den erthe akoma e ora tous), kata ton upno tous [del. kata ton mikro thanato tous]. Ste sunekheia, krataei ekeines (tis psukhes) gia tis opoies ekhei orisei to thanato, kai stelnei tis alles (psukhes, xana sta somata tous) gia enan kathorismeno khrono. Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gi' autous pou sullogizontai.

E mepos (oi eidololatres) ekhoun parei ekeina (ta eidola) os mesolabetes ektos apo ton Allakh (gia na mesolabesoun enopion tou Allakh gia tis anagkes tous); Pes (o, Prophete): <<Akoma kai an (auta ta eidola) den katekhoun tipota, oute katanooun;>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ole e mesolabese anekei mono ston Allakh (del. kaneis den mporei na mesolabesei gi' kapoion allon enopion Tou para mono me ten adeia Tou, gi' auto latrepste mono Auton kai okhi ta eidola)! S' Auton anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges, epeita pros Auton tha epistrepsete (ten Emera tes Kriseos).>>

Otan anapheretai to Onoma tou Allakh kai mono, apostrephontai oi kardies ekeinon pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, eno otan anapherontai ta onomata ton allon (pseutikon theon kai ton eidolon pou ta latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton, tote khairontai.
Pes (o, Prophete): <<O, Allakh! Demiourge ton ouranon kai tes ges! Pantognoste ton aoraton kai ton oraton! Esu eisai pou tha krineis metaxu ton doulon Sou se o,ti diaphonousan.>>

Ean oi adikoi kateikhan o,ti uparkhei ste ge kai alla tosa, tha ta prospheran gia na sothoun apo to kheirotero marturio, ten Emera tes Anastases! Tha tous emphanistei apo ton Allakh, auto (to marturio) pou den to perimenan pote.
Tha tous phanerothoun oi kakes sunepeies oson diepraxan, kai tha tous perikuklosei auto (to marturio) pou sunethizan na khleuazoun.

Otan plettei ton anthropo kapoia sumphora, Mas epikaleitai (me tapeinose), epeita otan tou dinoume mia khare apo Emas, (ginetai akharistos kai) leei: <<Elaba auto logo tes gnoses (pou ekho, kai epeide o Allakh xerei oti to axizo).>> Okhi (den iskhuei auto), alla einai mia dokimasia (an tha deikhnei eugnomosune e akharistia), alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de gnorizoun.

Pragmati, (auta ta proanapheromena logia pou ta lene kai oi apistoi apo te phule Kourais) ta eikhan pei kai ekeinoi pou etan prin ap' autous (opos o Karoun kai alloi apistoi), alla den tous prostatepsan se tipota (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) auta pou kerdisan (apo ploute, oute e latreia tous pros ta eidola),

kai etsi, tous eplexan oi kakes sunepeies oson diepraxan! Pragmati, kai osoi ap' autous (apo te phule Kourais) adikoun, tha tous plexoun epises oi kakes sunepeies oson diepraxan, kai de tha mporoun na xephugoun (apo ten timoria).

De gnorizoun oti o Allakh parekhei agatha me aphthonia se opoious thelei, kai ta periorizei (gia opoious thelei, sumphona me te Sophia Tou, kai os dokimasia an tha deixei o anthropos eugnomosune kai piste e akharistia kai apistia); Pragmati, s' auto uparkhoun Semadia gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun.

Pes (o, Mokhammant, oti o Allakh leei): <<O, douloi Mou (tou Allakh), pou eikhate spatalesei enantion tou eautou sas polles amarties! Men apelpizeste gia to eleos tou Allakh (oti o Allakh de tha sas sugkhoresei): pragmati, o Allakh sugkhorei oles tis amarties (gi' ekeinous pou strephontai me metameleia pros Auton). Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>
Strapheite me metameleia kai upakoe ston Kurio sas kai upotakhtheite s' Auton prin na erthei se sas to marturio, kai epeita de tha labete kamia uposterixe.

Akoloutheste to kalutero ap' auto pou ekhei stalei se sas apo ton Kurio sas (akolouthontas tis entoles tou Kor'an kai apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis tou), protou sas erthei to marturio aiphnidiastika, eno de tha to antilephtheite!

(Kante auta) oste na men pei kapoios (ten Emera tes Kriseos): <<Alimono se mena gia o,ti paramelesa apo ten upakoe pros ton Allakh! Den emoun para ap' ekeinous pou khleuasan (ten aletheia kai tous pistous).>>
E na pei: <<An me eikhe kathodegesei o Allakh (pros te threskeia Tou), tha emoun anamesa stous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou).>>
E na pei otan tha dei to marturio: <<Makari na eikha alle mia eukairia, oste na gino ap' autous pou prattoun to kalo.>>

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou eipes oti an o Allakh se eikhe kathodegesei pros te threskeia Tou, tha esoun apo tous eusebeis), alla pragmati erthan se sena ta Edaphia Mou, alla ta diepseuses kai edeixes alazoneia kai esoun apo tous apistous!

Ten Emera tes Anastases, tha deis (o, Prophete) autous pou eipan psemata gia ton Allakh (kai apedidan s' Auton etairous ste latreia e iskhuristekan oti apektese enan uio), me skoteiniasmena ta prosopa tous. Den uparkhei sten Kolase enas topos katoikias gia tous alazones; [Bebaios uparkhei].

Kai tha sosei o Allakh autous pou phulakhthekan apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou), meso tes epitukhias tous (me to na eiselthoun ston Paradeiso). Kanena kako de tha tous aggixei, oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
O Allakh einai o Demiourgos ton panton. Kai Autos einai o Diakheiristes ton panton.

Se Auton anekoun ta kleidia (ton thesauron) ton ouranon kai tes ges (kai dinei ap' autous tous thesaurous se opoious thelei). Oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste sta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) tou Allakh, ekeinoi einai oi khamenoi.
Pes (o, Prophete, stous apistous): <<Me diatazete na latreuo allon ektos apo ton Allakh, o, anideoi;>>

Pragmati, apokaluphtheke se sena (o, Prophete) kai s' ekeinous (tous Prophetes) pou etan prin apo sena oti: <<Ean apodideis ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, oi kales praxeis sou tha ginoun mataies kai tha eisai apo tous khamenous.>>
Okhi (men tous upakous), alla mono ton Allakh na latreueis, kai na eisai apo tous eugnomones (gia tis khares Tou pros esena).

Den ekhoun doxasei ton Allakh opos Tou armozei. Ten Emera tes Anastases oloklere e Ge tha einai mesa sto Kheri Tou kai oi ouranoi tha einai tuligmenoi sto Dexi Tou Kheri. Doxa s' Auton, einai Anoteros apo o,ti apodidoun (oi eidololatres) s' Auton apo etairous ste latreia!

(Ten Emera tes Anastases, o Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga) kai oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai oloi osoi einai ste ge tha pesoun nekroi, ektos apo osous thelei o Allakh. Epeita tha to xanaphusexei, kai amesos tha stathoun zontanoi koitazontas.

Tha lampsei e ge me to Phos tou Kuriou tes (otan o Allakh tha emphanistei stous doulous Tou gia na krinei metaxu tous), tha topothetethei (anoikhto) to biblio ton praxeon (tou kathenos), tha pheroun (oi Aggeloi) tous Prophetes kai tous martures (pou tha marturesoun gia to oti oi Prophetes metepheran to Menuma sta ethne tous), kai tha krinei metaxu tous me ten aletheia kai de tha adikethoun.
Kathe psukhe tha labei pleros (eite antamoibe, eite timoria) gia o,ti ekane. Pragmati, Autos gnorizei kalutera o,ti kanoun.

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste, tha odegethoun pros ten Kolase se omades, ospou otan phtasoun ekei, oi pules tes tha anoixoun kai oi (Aggeloi) phulakes tes tha tous poun: <<Den erthan se sas Aggeliophoroi apo anamesa sas, pou apeggeilan se sas ta Edaphia tou Kuriou sas kai sas proeidopoiesan gia te sunantese autes tes Emeras;>> Tha poun: <<Nai ontos (erthan), alla o Logos (tou Allakh) gia ten timoria (me ton opoio proeidopoiese ton Satana, oti tha gemisei ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos gia tous apistous.>>
Tha eipothei: <<Eiselthete apo tis pules tes Kolases opou tha meinete ekei mesa gia panta. Poso tromeros einai o topos katoikias ton alazonon!>>

Oso gi' ekeinous pou phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Kuriou tous (terontas tis entoles Tou) tha odegethoun pros ton Paradeiso se omades, ospou otan phtasoun ekei, oi pules tou tha anoixoun kai oi (Aggeloi) phulakes tou tha tous poun: <<Eirene kai asphaleia se sas! Praxate kala (kai etsi e antamoibe sas tha einai kale), etsi mpeite mesa tou (Paradeisou) gia na katoikesete gia panta.>>

Kai (oi pistoi) tha poun: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh pou ekplerose ten uposkhese Tou pros emas kai mas edose os kleronomia aute te ge (tou Paradeisou), kai etsi katoikoume opou theloume ston Paradeiso. Poso exairetike einai e antamoibe auton pou prattoun (tis kales praxeis)!>>

Tha deis (o, Prophete) tous Aggelous na periballoun ton Throno doxazontas ton Kurio tous kai eugnomonontas Ton. Tha krinei metaxu tous (tous doulous tou Allakh) me ten aletheia, kai tha eipothei: <<Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.>>

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Aute einai) e apokalupse tou Bibliou apo ton Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-'Aleim (Pantognoste).

O Opoios einai Autos pou sugkhorei tis amarties, dekhetai te metameleia (ton doulon Tou), Austeros sten timoria (gia tous apistous) kai o Katokhos ton eunoion (pou parekhei aphthones eunoies stous doulous Tou). Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Pros Auton tha einai o telikos proorismos.

De diaphonoun gia ta (xekathara) Semadia (kai ta Edaphia) tou Allakh (diapseudontas ta), para mono ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste (ston Allakh). Epomenos, (o, Prophete) as me se exapatoun oi metakineseis tous (me emporio kai apolauseis) ste ge.

Kai prin ap' autous (tous apistous apo te phule Kourais) diepseusan (tous Prophetes): oi anthropoi apo ton lao tou Noe kai meta ap' autous oi omades [del. e phule Thamount, o laos tou Lot, kai oi katoikoi tes komopoles ton strimmenon dentron konta ste Madiam]. Oi anthropoi tou kathenos ethnous (ap' auta) sunomotesan gia na sullaboun kai na skotosoun ton Aggeliaphoro tous. Kai uposterixan to pseudos gia na antikrousoun m' auto ten aletheia. Etsi tous arpaxa me ten timoria. Poso tromere etan e timoria Mou!

(Kai opos e timoria egine anapopheukte gia ta proegoumena apista ethne), etsi o Logos tou Kuriou sou (me ton opoio proeidopoiese ton Satana oti tha gemisei ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, oti tha einai oi katoikoi tes Photias.

Autoi (oi Aggeloi) pou koubaloun ton Throno kai osoi einai guro tou, doxazoun ton Kurio tous eugnomonontas Ton, pisteuoun s' Auton, kai zetoun sugkhorese gia tous pistous, (legontas): <<Kurie mas! Peribaleis ta panta me to eleos kai te gnose Sou, opote sugkhorese autous pou straphekan me metameleia pros Esena kai akolouthesan ton dromo (te threskeia) Sou, kai prostatepse tous apo to marturio tes Phlegomenes Photias.

Kurie mas! Eisegage tous se kepous monimes diamones (ston Paradeiso) pou tous uposkhethekes, kai osous einai enaretoi apo tous pateres tous, tis suzugous tous kai ta paidia tous! Pragmati, Esu eisai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
Prostatepse tous apo tis kakes sunepeies (ton amartion tous). Pragmati, opoion prostateueis apo tis kakes sunepeies ekeine ten Emera, ton ekheis eleesei, kai aute einai e upertate epitukhia.>>

Pragmati, (oi Aggeloi) tha phonaxoun tous apistous (otan mpoun ste Photia): <<Pragmati, e apekhtheia tou Allakh pros esas, -otan klethekate (apo tous Aggeliaphorous) pros ten piste, alla ten arnethekate-, etan megalutere apo ten apekhtheia sas pros ton eauto sas (tora).>>

(Oi apistoi) tha poun: <<Kurie mas! Mas ekanes na pethanoume duo phores, kai mas epheres ste zoe duo phores, kai tora anagnorizoume tis amarties mas. Uparkhei kapoia diexodos gia na bgoume (apo ten Kolase kai na praxoume kales praxeis);>>

(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Auto (to marturio) einai epeide otan kapoioi epikalestekan (kai latreuan) mono ton Allakh, eseis arnethekate ten piste (kai apodidate etairous ston Allakh ste latreia), alla kai otan kapoioi alloi apedidan etairous ston Allakh ste latreia, eseis pistepsate (sten apistia tous). E krise anekei mono ston Allakh, ton Al-'Alei (Upsisto), ton Al-Kampeir (Mega).>>

Einai Autos pou sas deikhnei ta Semadia Tou (ston orizonta kai ston eauto sas, oste na kathodegetheite), kai sas stelnei agatha (kai brokhe) apo ton ourano, alla de tha ta laboun upopse (kai na laboun nouthesia) para mono ekeinoi pou strephontai me metameleia kai upakoe pros Auton.
Epikalesteite loipon mono ton Allakh me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton ste latreia kai sten upakoe, akoma ki an oi apistoi to antipathoun auto.

O Upsistos pou katekhei tis Upsistes Perigraphes (o Opoios einai pano apo ta panta, katekhei tis upseles theseis tou Paradeisou pou tis dinei stous pistous, einai Autos pou upsose tous ouranous), kai einai o Katokhos tou Thronou. Stelnei ten apokalupse me ten entole Tou se opoion thelei apo tous doulous Tou, gia na proeidopoiesei (tous anthropous) gia ten Emera tes Sunanteses.

Ten Emera pou tha emphanizontai oloi (enopion Tou, aphou tha ekhoun bgei apo tous taphous tous), tipota gi' autous de tha einai krupho apo ton Allakh. (O Allakh tha pei): <<Se poion anekei to Basileio (kai e Kuriarkhia) Semera;>> (O Allakh tha apantesei): <<Ston Allakh, ton Al-Ouakheint (ton Enan Alethino Theo), ton Al-Kakhar (Auton pou nika kai upotassei opoious thelei)!>>
Semera e kathe psukhe tha labei (eite antamoibe, eite timoria) gia o,ti ekane. De tha uparkhei kamia adikia Semera! Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gregoros ston apologismo.>>

Proeidopoiese tous (o, Prophete) gia ten Emera pou plesiazei, kata ten opoia oi kardies tha phtasoun sto laimo (apo to phobo), kai tha einai (oi anthropoi) siopeloi (kai gematoi agonia), kai de tha uparkhei gia tous adikous oute kanenas stenos philos, oute kanenas mesolabetes tou opoiou ta logia na akoustoun.
(O Allakh) xerei o,ti (blepoun ta matia apo) krupha blemmata, kai o,ti kruboun oi kardies.

O Allakh krinei me ten aletheia, eno ekeinoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou tous epikalountai (oi eidololatres kai tous latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton, den mporoun na krinoun tipote. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o As-Sami' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Den taxidepsan (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete) ste ge gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin ap' autous; Oi opoioi etan pio iskhuroi ap' autous kai ekhtisan perissotera kai pio dunata kteria ste ge, alla o Allakh tous arpaxe me ten timoria gia tis amarties tous, kai den eikhan kanenan na tous prostateusei apo ton Allakh.

Auto epeide tous erthan oi Aggeliaphoroi me xekathares apodeixeis, alla arnethekan ten piste, kai etsi tous arpaxe o Allakh me ten timoria. Pragmati, Autos einai Paniskhuros kai Austeros sten timoria.
Pragmati, steilame ton Mouse me ta Semadia Mas kai tis xekathares apodeixeis,
ston Pharao, ton Khaman kai ton Karoun, alla eipan: <<Autos (o Mouses) einai enas magos kai pseutes!>>

Otan (o Mouses) erthe s' autous me ten aletheia apo Emas, eipan: <<Skotoste tous gious oson pistepsan s' auton kai krateste tis gunaikes tous zontanes (gia na sas uperetesoun).>> Ostoso, oi sunomosies ton apiston de tha einai para apotukhemenes!

O Pharao eipe: <<Apheste me na skotoso ton Mouse, kai as epikalestei ton Kurio tou (gia na ton prostateusei)! Giati phobamai na allaxei te threskeia sas (me te mageia tou) e na exaplosei to kako ste ge (del. te threskeia tou kai te latreia pros ton Kurio tou).>>
O Mouses (otan emathe gia ten apeile tou Pharao) eipe:<<Anazeto kataphugio ston Kurio mou kai ton Kurio sas (ton Allakh) apo kathe alazona pou den pisteuei sten Emera tou Apologismou.>>

Enas pistos apo ton lao tou Pharao, o opoios ekrube ten piste tou, eipe: <<Tha skotosete enan anthropo, mono epeide leei: <<O Kurios mou einai o Allakh>>, parolo pou erthe se sas me xekathares apodeixeis apo ton Kurio sas; An einai pseutes, to pseudos tou tha einai eis baros tou, alla an einai eilikrines, tote tha sas plexoun merika ap' auta pou sas uposkhetai. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei opoion einai parabates kai pseutes.

O, lae mou! Semera ekhete ten kuriarkhia kai eiste anoteroi ste ge, alla poios tha mas uposterixei enantia sten timoria tou Allakh, an mas erthei;>> O Pharao eipe: <<De sas deikhno (kai leo) para mono auto pou blepo (sosto), kai de sas kathodego para mono sto sosto dromo.>>
Ekeinos o pistos eipe: <<O, lae mou! Phobamai gia sas (an skotosete ton Mouse adika, mia duskole emera me timoria) san ten emera ton omadon (ton proegoumenon apiston laon).

Opos egine me ton lao tou Noe, te phule 'Ant, te phule Thamount, kai m' autous (ton lao tou Abraam kai tou Lot) pou erthan meta ap' autous. Pragmati, o Allakh de thelei adikia gia tous doulous (Tou, kai den katestrepse ekeinous tous laous para mono gia ten apistia tous)!
O, lae mou! Phobamai gia sas ten Emera pou tha phonaxete o enas ston allon.

Ten Emera pou tha gurisete pheugontas, men ekhontas kanenan na sas prostateusei apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, den uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na ton kathodegesei.

Pragmati, o Ioseph erthe se sas prin (apo ton Mouse) me tis xekathares apodeixeis, alla sunekhisate (kata te zoe tou) na ekhete amphibolia gia o,ti ephere se sas (apo ten aletheia). Ospou otan pethane, (auxetheke e amphibolia sas kai) eipate: <<O Allakh de tha steilei meta ap' auton kanenan allon Aggeliaphoro.>> Etsi o Allakh kanei na parastratesei opoion einai parabates (pou parabiase ta oria sten plane) kai pou amphiballei polu (gia ton Allakh).>>

Pragmati, autoi pou diaphonoun (kai amphibaloun) gia ta Semadia tou Allakh khoris na tous eikhe erthei kamia apodeixe, (e praxe tous) einai polu apekhthes enopion tou Allakh kai enopion ton piston! Etsi o Allakh sphragizei ten kardia kathenos alazonikou turannou.
O Pharao eipe: <<O, Khaman! Khtise gia mena enan purgo, isos na phtaso sta monopatia,

ta monopatia pros tous ouranous, oste na do ton Theo tou Mouse, an kai nomizo oti (o Mouses) einai pseutes.>> Etsi, oraiopoiethekan sta matia tou Pharao oi kakes praxeis tou, kai empodisteke apo ton (isio) dromo! To skhedio tou Pharao den etan para apotukhemeno.
Ekeinos o pistos eipe: <<O, lae mou! Akoloutheste me, oste na sas kathodegeso pros ton isio dromo.
O, lae mou! Pragmati, aute e egkosmia zoe einai mono mia (pheugalea) apolause, eno e Mellousa Zoe einai e monime katoikia!

Opoios kanei mia kake praxe, de tha labei para mono to idio (del. tha timorethei gi' aute)* kai opoios kanei kales praxeis, eite einai andras, eite einai gunaika, eno einai pistos, ekeinoi tha eiselthoun ston Paradeiso, opou tha tous parekhontai agatha khoris orio.
O, lae mou! Pos ginetai ego na sas kalo pros (ten piste kai) te soteria, kai eseis na me kaleite pros (ten apistia kai) te photia;

Eseis me kaleite sto na arnetho ten piste ston Allakh kai na apodido s' Auton etairous ste latreia, -gia tous opoious (etairous) den ekho kamia gnose (oute apodeixe oti axizoun te latreia)-, eno ego sas kalo pros ten piste ston Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-Gaphphar (Auton pou sugkhorei sunekhos sto megisto bathmo)!

Pragmati, autoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou eseis me kaleite na pistepso s' autous, den tous anekei kamia epiklese (kai den mporoun na antapokrithoun se kamia epiklese), oute sten egkosmia zoe, oute ste Mellousa Zoe. Pragmati, e epistrophe mas tha einai pros ton Allakh, kai pragmati, oi parabates tha einai oi katoikoi tes Photias.

Tha to thumetheite auto pou sas leo (kai tha metaniosete oti den to dekhtekate), kai empisteuomai oles tis upotheseis mou ston Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh blepei ta panta skhetika me tous doulous (Tou).>>
Etsi, o Allakh ton prostatepse apo to kako autou pou sunomotesan (to na ton skotosoun), kai mia tromere timoria periebale tous anthropous tou Pharao (kai etsi pnigekan).

(Oi psukhes tous mesa stous taphous tous) blepoun te Photia proi kai bradu (kai tis theseis tous pou tous perimenoun ekei). Kai ten Emera pou tha ginei e Ora (tes Kriseos, tha eipothei): <<Eisagete tous anthropous tou Pharao sto pio austero marturio.>>

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan tha malosoun o enas ton allon ste Photia, kai etsi oi adunamoi (oi opadoi) tha poun s' autous pou etan alazonikoi: <<Emastan oi akolouthoi sas (sten plane), tha mas apallaxete loipon apo ena meros tes timorias mas ste Photia (me to na to parete eseis);>>
Autoi pou etan alazonikoi tha poun: <<Eimaste oloi mesa tes (Photias). Pragmati, o Allakh ekrine ede metaxu ton doulon (Tou, kai edose se kathenan auto pou tou axizei).>>
Osoi einai ste Photia tha poun stous (Aggelous) phulakes tes Kolases: <<Epikalesteite ton Kurio sas na mas apallaxei apo ten timoria gia mia mono mera.>>

(Oi Aggeloi phulakes tes Kolases) tha poun: <<Den erthan se sas oi Aggeliaphoroi sas me tis xekathares apodeixeis;>> (Oi katoikoi tes Photias) tha poun: <<Nai, ontos erthan.>> (Oi Aggeloi) tha poun: <<Epikalesteite (Ton) loipon eseis! Pragmati, e epiklese ton apiston, den einai para apotukhemene.>>

Pragmati, Emeis uposterizoume tous Aggeliaphorous Mas kai tous pistous, sten egkosmia zoe kai sten Emera pou tha marturesoun oi martures (apo tous Aggelous, tous Prophetes kai tous pistous pou tha marturesoun enantia stous apistous).
Ten Emera pou de tha ophelesoun tous adikous oi dikaiologies tous, kai tha ekhoun ten katara kai tha ekhoun ton kheirotero topo katoikias.
Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse ten kathodegese, kai dosame sta paidia tou Israel to Biblio (ten Tora),
os kathodegese kai upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gi' ekeinous pou ekhoun ugie nou.

Kane loipon upomone (o, Prophete), pragmati, e Uposkhese tou Allakh (gia te nike sou) einai alethine. Zeta sugkhorese gia ten amartia sou [os morphe doxasias pros ton Allakh -kai de semainei oti o Prophete ekane amartia-] kai doxase ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton, bradu kai proi.

Pragmati, autoi pou diaphonoun (kai amphibaloun) gia ta Semadia tou Allakh khoris na tous eikhe erthei kamia apodeixe, den ekhoun sta stethe tous para ten alazoneia (enantia sten aletheia), kai de tha te phtasoun (to na einai anoteroi apo sena, o, Prophete, e apo ten aletheia)! Anazeta loipon kataphugio ston Allakh (apo kathe kako), pragmati, Autos einai o As-Sami' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Pragmati, e demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges einai megalutere apo te demiourgia ton anthropon, (etsi, o Allakh pou demiourgese ola auta, einai Ikanos na anastesei tous anthropous), alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun (kai de sullogizontai auto os apodeixe gia ten anastase).

Den einai isoi, o tuphlos (del. o apistos) kai autos pou blepei (o pistos), oute autoi pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis einai isoi m' ekeinous pou diaprattoun to kako. Liga einai auta pou ta lambanete upopse!
Pragmati, e Ora erkhetai, den uparkhei kamia amphibolia gi' auten, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi den pisteuoun.

O Kurios sas leei: <<Epikalesteite Me* tha antapokritho stis epikleseis sas. Pragmati, ekeinoi pou ginontai alazonikoi, arnoumenoi te latreia pros Emena, tha eiselthoun sto Pur tes Kolaseos tapeinomenoi.>>

Einai o Allakh pou ekane gia sas te nukhta gia na xekourazeste s' aute, kai (ekane) ten emera photeine (gia tis ergasies sas). Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei ametretes khares pros tous anthropous, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de deikhnoun eugnomosune!

Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas, o Demiourgos ton panton. Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Pos loipon apomakruneste (apo te latreia Tou, kai latreuete demiourgemata);
Etsi apomakrunontai autoi pou arnethekan ta Semadia tou Allakh.

Einai o Allakh pou ekane gia sas te ge os stathero topo katoikias, kai ton ourano ena teleio ktisma (os stegastro kai tholo pano apo te ge, o opoios steketai khoris kolones), sas edose morphe, kai ekane te morphe sas teleia (anamesa sta alla plasmata), kai sas parekhei apo ta kala agatha. Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios sas. Upsistos einai o Allakh, o Kurios olon ton kosmon.

Autos einai o Al-Khai (o Aionia Zontanos)! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Epikalesteite loipon mono Auton me eilikrine aphosiose pros Auton ste latreia kai sten upakoe. Doxa ston Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Mou ekhei apagoreutei na latreuo autous pou tous epikaleiste (kai tous latreuete) ektos apo ton Allakh, aphou mou erthan oi xekathares apodeixeis apo ton Kurio mou. Kai ekho diatakhthei na upotakhtho mono ston Kurio olon ton kosmon.>>

Einai Autos pou demiourgese esas (del. ton Adam) apo khoma, epeita (demiourgese esas tous apogonous tou) apo Noutpha (stagones ekkriseon ton duo phulon), epeita apo 'Alaka (kremameno thrombo aimatos), epeita sas bgazei brephe, epeita (tha megalosete) gia na phtasete sten elikia plerous dunames, epeita (tha megalosete) gia na ginete elikiomenoi. Merikoi apo sas, omos, pethainoun noritera. Kai (tha megalosete) gia na phtasete enan kathorismeno khrono (tou thanatou sas). Isos kai na sullogisteite!
Einai Autos pou dinei te zoe kai ten aphairei. Otan apophasisei kati, aplos tou leei: <<Genetheto!>>, kai etsi ginetai.
De blepeis (o, Prophete) autous pou diaphonoun (kai amphibaloun) gia ta Semadia tou Allakh, pos apomakrunontai (apo ten aletheia);
Autoi pou diepseusan to Biblio kai o,ti steilame stous Aggeliaphorous Mas, pragmati, tha mathoun,
otan ta desma tha einai stous laimous tous, kai me tis alusides tha sernontai,
sto zematisto nero, epeita ste Photia tha kaoun.
Epeita tha tous eipothei: <<Pou einai autoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou tous apodidate ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia, kai tous latreuate,
ektos apo ton Allakh; Tha poun: <<Mas egkateleipsan! Alla pragmati prin (sten egkosmia zoe) de latreuame tipote (pou na axize te latreia).>> Etsi, o Allakh kanei tous apistous na parastratesoun.
(Tha tous eipothei): <<Auto (to marturio) einai gia oses phores kharekate (sten apistia kai stis amarties sas) ste ge adika, kai gia oses phores diaskedazate alazonika (adikontas tous anthropous).
Mpeite apo tis pules tes Kolaseos opou tha meinete ekei mesa gia panta. Poso tromeros einai o topos katoikias gia tous alazones!>>

Kane, loipon, upomone (o, Prophete). Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh (gia te nike sou enantion tous) einai alethine. Eite sou deixoume kati apo o,ti tous uposkhethekame (apo ten timoria), eite aphairesoume te zoe sou (khoris na to deis), (kai stis duo periptoseis) pros Emas tha einai e epistrophe tous (ten Emera tes Kriseos)!

Pragmati, ekhoume steilei prin apo sena (o, Prophete) Aggeliaphorous. Gia merikous ap' autous se ekhoume plerophoresei, kai gi' allous de se ekhoume plerophoresei. Den enapokeitai se kanenan Aggeliaphoro na pherei kanena Semadi, para mono me ten Adeia tou Allakh. Opote erkhetai e entole tou Allakh, krinetai me ten aletheia (metaxu ton Aggeliaphoron kai ton laon tous), kai tote khanontai oi anthropoi tes planes!
Einai o Allakh pou ekane gia sas ta booeide, gia na kabalate kapoia ap' auta, kai ap' auta na trote,

kai na ekhete ap' auta (ta booeide) kapoia ophele, kai (kaname ta booeide) gia na metapherete pano tous ta phortia kai na ekplerosete mia anagke pou ekhete sta stethe sas (to na phtasete se makrina mere), kai pano s' auta kai pano sta ploia, metaphereste.
Sas deikhnei ta Semadia Tou. Poia loipon apo ta Semadia tou Allakh tha arnetheite;

Den taxidepsan (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant) ste ge gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin ap' autous; Oi opoioi etan perissoteroi ap' autous, anoteroi se duname kai aphesan pio dunata semadia ste ge (eskapsan sta bouna spitia kai ekhtisan pio dunata kteria), alla den tous prostatepsan (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) o,ti kerdisan (apo duname).

Otan tous erthan oi Aggeliaphoroi tous me tis xekathares apodeixeis, (tous diepseusan, kai apo ten agnoia tous) etan ikanopoiemenoi me o,ti eikhan apo gnose (kai eipan: <<Emeis xeroume kalutera ap' autous, pragmati, de tha anastethoume, oute tha timorethoume!>>), kai tous perikuklose aute (e timoria) pou sunethizan na te khleuazoun.
Otan omos eidan ten timoria Mas, eipan: <<Pisteuoume (tora) mono ston Allakh kai aporriptoume o,ti apodidame s' Auton os etairous ste latreia.>>

Alla e piste tous (tora) den tous ophelese otan eidan ten timoria Mas. Autos einai o epanalambanomenos kanonas tou Allakh, pou epharmosteke stous (apistous) doulous Tou, (oti e metameleia den ophelei tous apistous otan doun ten timoria), kai tote oi apistoi etan se apolute apotukhia.

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Auto to Kor'an) einai mia apokalupse apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), ton Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhno).
Ena Biblio, tou opoiou ta Edaphia exegountai leptomeros, ena Kor'an (pou apokaluphtheke) sta Arabika, (kai exegeitai) gia tous anthropous pou gnorizoun (kai sullogizontai ta Edaphia tou).

(To opoio Biblio) anaggellei kharmosunes eideseis (gia tous pistous) kai proeidopoiei (tous apistous). Omos oi perissoteroi ap' autous (apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete) straphekan makria, kai etsi den akoun (ten kathodegese).

Kai eipan: <<Oi kardies mas einai mesa se kalummata pou tis empodizoun ap' auto sto opoio mas kaleis, uparkhei kophose sta autia mas, kai uparkhei ena phragma anamesa se mas kai se sena (kai de phtanei se mas tipote apo o,ti les). Sunekhise loipon tis praxeis sou (me ton tropo sou), kai emeis tha sunekhisoume tis praxeis mas (me ton tropo mas).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, eimai mono enas anthropos san kai esas. Mou ekhei apokaluphthei oti o Theos sas (o Allakh) einai mono Enas Theos. Ginete loipon statheroi sten upakoe kai te latreia pros Auton, kai zeteste te sugkhorese Tou.>> Alimono loipon s' ekeinous pou apodidoun s' Auton etairous ste latreia,
oi opoioi de dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe.
Pragmati, autoi pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis, tha ekhoun adialeipte amoibe.
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Einai dunaton na arneiste ten piste s' Auton pou demiourgese te Ge se duo Emeres, kai na apodidete s' Auton etairous ste latreia; Autos einai o Kurios olon ton kosmon.

Kai topothetese s' aute (te Ge) stathera bouna (san passalous) epano tes, kai ten eulogese (kanontas ten na ekhei panta agatha) kai orise s' auten ta agatha tes, (kai ola auta) se tesseris isaxies Emeres [duo meres gia te demiourgia tes Ges, kai alles duo gia ta upoloipa], (kai aute e eidese einai) gia osous rotoun (gia te demiourgia).
Epeita prokhorese ste demiourgia tou ouranou pou etan kapnos, kai eipe s' auton kai ste Ge: <<Upotakhtheite (sten entole Mou), eite ekousia, eite akousia.>> Eipan: <<Upotassomaste me upakoe.>>

Etsi, tous ekane (tous ouranous) epta ouranous se duo Emeres, kai apokalupse se kathe ourano o,ti ekhei orisei ekei.>> Pragmati, stolisame ton khamelotero ourano me lampteres (asteria), kai ta kaname (ta asteria) os prostasia (gia to khamelotero ourano, apo kathe diabolo pou prospathei na kruphakousei). Ola auta ta ekhei orisei o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).
An omos (oi eidololatres) apomakrunthoun (apo ten aletheia), tote pes (o, Prophete): <<Sas proeidopoio gia mia terastia timoria san ekeine ten timoria pou epese ste phule 'Ant kai te phule Thamount.

Otan oi Aggeliaphoroi erthan s' autous (ste phule 'Ant kai te phule Thamount) apo mprosta tous kai apo piso tous (legontas) oti: <<Me latreuete kanenan allon ektos apo ton Allakh.>>, eipan (oi apistoi): <<An ethele o Kurios mas, tha estelne Aggelous (os Aggeliaphorous). Pragmati, den pisteuoume s' auto me to opoio ekhete stalei.>>

Oso gia te phule 'Ant, etan alazonikoi ste ge adika, kai eipan: <<Poioi einai pio iskhuroi apo mas;>> Den eidan oti o Allakh pou tous demiourgese, einai pio Dunatos ap' autous; Kai arnethekan ta Semadia Mas.

Etsi, steilame s' autous enan biaio kruo anemo me dunato ekho, se emeres pou (logo tes timorias) etan kakes (gi' autous), gia na tous kanoume na geutoun ten timoria tes tapeinoses sten egkosmia zoe, kai pragmati, e timoria tes Mellousas Zoes tha einai polu pio tapeinotike, kai de tha laboun kamia uposterixe.

Oso gia te phule Thamount, tous deixame ten kathodegese, alla protimesan ten tuphlose apo ten kathodegese! Etsi, tous arpaxe e katastrophe tes tapeinotikes timorias gia o,ti diepraxan (apo apistia kai amarties).
Kai sosame ekeinous pou pisteuan kai phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou).
Ten Emera pou (oi Aggeloi phulakes tes Photias) tha sugkentrosoun tous ekhthrous tou Allakh pros te Photia, tha mazepsoun tous protous me tous teleutaious (odegontas tous me biaio tropo).
Eos otou phtasoun s' aute (te Photia), tha marturesoun enantion tous oi akoes tous, oi oraseis tous kai ta dermata tous gia o,ti diepraxan (apo kakes praxeis).

(Oi apistoi) tha poun sta dermata tous: <<Giati marturesate enantion mas;>> Tha poun: <<O Allakh mas ekane na milesoume, o Opoios einai Autos pou ekane ta panta na milesoun, kai einai Autos pou sas demiourgese ten prote phora, kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete.

(Sten egkosmia zoe otan diapraxate amarties), de phulakhthekate (oute phobethekate) apo to na marturesoun enantion sas oi akoes sas, oi oraseis sas kai ta dermata sas (epeide den pisteuate ste Mellousa Zoe). Alla nomizate oti o Allakh den xerei polla ap' auta pou kanate, (kai eipate: <<O Allakh mas akouei an milame dunata, kai de mas akouei an milame siga.>>).
Auto etan pou nomizate gia ton Kurio sas, to opoio sas katestrepse, kai etsi, ginate apo tous khamenous.>>

Eite tha upomenoun karterika (to marturio, eite okhi, tha einai to idio gi' autous), e Photia tha einai o topos diamones tous (kai de tha ekhoun kamia diaphuge)! Kai an zetesoun na epistrepsoun sten egkosmia zoe gia na praxoun kales praxeis kai na zetesoun ten eukharistese tou Allakh, auto de tha to laboun pote.

Orisame gi' autous (tous apistous sten egkosmia zoe), paromoious suntrophous (tous diabolous), pou oraiopoiesan gi' autous: o,ti etan mprosta tous (apo plane kai apolauseis sten egkosmia zoe), kai o,ti tha einai meta ap' autous (me to na diapseusoun te Mellousa Zoe). Etsi, o Logos (Mou me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana, oti tha gemiso ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos (del. e timoria egine anapopheukte) gi' autous mazi me alla ethne apo ta tzinn kai tous anthropous pou perasan prin ap' autous. Pragmati, autoi (oloi) etan khamenoi.
Autoi pou arnethekan ten piste (apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete) eipan: <<Men akoute auto to Kor'an, kai kante phasaria kata ten apaggelia tou (apo ton Mokhammant kai tous pistous), isos nikesete.>>
Pragmati, tha kanoume autous pou arnethekan ten piste na geutoun ena austero marturio, kai tha tous timoresoume gia tis kakes praxeis pou diepraxan.
Aute einai e timoria gia tous ekhthrous tou Allakh: e Photia! Opou tha ekhoun mesa tes mia aionia katoikia, os timoria gia to o,ti arnethekan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas.

Autoi pou arnethekan ten piste tha poun: <<Kurie mas!
