Deixe mas autous tous duo (diabolous -e eidos diabolon-) apo ta tzinn kai tous anthropous pou mas paraplanesan [del. ton Implis pou xekinese ten apistia, kai ton Kain pou xekinese to phono], oste na tous baloume kato apo ta podia mas (ste Photia), oste na ginoun apo tous katoterous (kai na ekhoun pio austere timoria apo mas).>>

Pragmati, autoi pou lene: <<O Kurios mas einai o Allakh>>, kai meta paramenoun statheroi (sten aletheia kai ten upakoe), oi Aggeloi tha kateboun s' autous (ten ora tou thanatou tous kai tha tous poun): <<Me phobaste, oute na lupetheite, alla na khareite gia ton Paradeiso, gia ton opoio labate uposkhese.

Emeis eimaste oi uposteriktes (kai oi suntrophoi) sas sten egkosmia zoe (pou sas kathodegesame kai sas prostatepsame me ten entole tou Allakh), epises kai ste Mellousa Zoe. Tha ekhete s' auton (ton Paradeiso) o,ti epithumeite, kai tha ekhete s' auton o,ti zetesete,
os parokhe (kai agatha) ap' Auton pou einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Poios ekhei kalutera logia ap' auton pou kalei (tous anthropous) pros ton Allakh, kanei enaretes praxeis kai leei: <<Eimai enas apo tous Mousoulmanous>>!

To kalo kai to kako den einai isa. Apothese (to kako) m' auto pou einai kalo, etsi, autos pou ekhei ekhthra mazi sou, (an antimetopiseis to kako pou sou ekane, me to kalo), tha ginei san na etan enas kontinos sou philos!

Kaneis de tha ten petukhei (aute ten arete, to na apothesei to kako me to kalo), para mono ekeinoi pou edeixan upomone. Kai de tha ten petukhei (aute ten arete) para mono autos pou ekhei megale kalosune (kai einai upselou ethikou kharaktera).
An erthei se sena enas kakos psithuros apo ton Satana, anazetese kataphugio ston Allakh. Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Anamesa sta Semadia Tou einai e nukhta kai e mera, o elios kai to pheggari. Men pesete se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) gia ton elio e to pheggari, alla peste se Sitzount stase mono gia ton Allakh pou ta demiourgese, an pragmatika Ton latreuete (kai Ton upakoute).

Alla an (o, Prophete) deikhnoun alazoneia (oi apistoi kai arnountai na latreuoun mono ton Allakh), tote (as mathoun oti) autoi (oi Aggeloi) pou einai konta ston Kurio sou, Ton doxazoun nukhta kai mera kai den kourazontai (oute bariountai) pote (apo te latreia tous pros Auton).

Kai anamesa sta Semadia Tou einai oti blepeis te ge agone, alla otan rikhnoume nero pano tes, tarakounietai (me phuta) kai phouskonei. Pragmati, Autos pou tes edose zoe, tha anastesei tous nekrous. Pragmati, Autos einai gia ta panta, Ikanos.

Pragmati, oso gi' autous pou parekklinoun apo (ten aletheia skhetika me) ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas (kai ta diapseudoun, ta khleuazoun e diastreblonoun tis ennoies tous), e katastase tous den einai kruphe apo Emas! Einai kaluteros autos pou tha rikhtei ste Photia e autos pou tha erthei asphales ten Emera tes Anastases; Kante o,ti thelete, pragmati, Autos blepei ola osa kanete.

Pragmati, autoi pou arnethekan ten piste sten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) otan tous erthe, (tha ekhoun ena austero marturio). Pragmati, auto einai ena iskhuro kai aniketo Biblio (pou kaneis den mporei na to diastreblosei).

Den mporei na to plesiasei to pseudos apo mprosta e apo piso tou (del. den mporei o Satanas na to plesiasei, kai einai prostateumeno apo opoiadepote prosthese, aphairese e diastreblose), kai einai mia apokalupse ap' Auton pou einai Khakeim (Pansophos), kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

De legetai se sena (o, Prophete, apo tous apistous) para mono o,ti eipotheke (apo ta proegoumena apista ethne) stous Aggeliaphorous prin apo sena. (Gi' auto deixe upomone se o,ti lene), pragmati, o Kurios sou einai Autos pou ekhei sugkhorese (gia opoion strephetai me metameleia pros Auton), kai ekhei sklere timoria (gia opoion epimenei sten apistia tou).

An to eikhame kanei to Kor'an se mia xene glossa (kai okhi sta Arabika), tha elegan (oi apistoi apo to lao sou, o, Prophete): <<Exegountai ta Edaphia tou (gia na ta katalaboume); Einai dunaton auto (to biblio) na einai se mia xene glossa, eno autos (o Aggeliaphoros) einai enas Arabas;>> Pes: <<Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia kathodegese kai therapeia gia osous pisteuoun. Alla oso gi' autous pou den pisteuoun, uparkhei mia kophose sta autia tous, kai auto (to Kor'an) ekhei pano tous (kai stis kardies tous) mia tuphlose (kai etsi den mporoun na kathodegethoun meso autou, oute na doun tis apodeixeis tou). Ekeinoi einai san na tous kalei kapoios apo makrino meros (kai etsi oute ton akoun, oute tou apantoun).>>

Pragmati, dosame ston Mouse to Biblio (ten Tora, opos sou dosame, o, Mokhammant, to Kor'an), alla (oi anthropoi apo ton lao tou) diepheran s' auto (kai etsi, kapoioi pistepsan s' auto, eno alloi to diepseusan). An den eikhe proegethei mia apophase apo ton Kurio sou (oti tha krinei metaxu ton doulon Tou ten Emera tes Kriseos), tha eikhe ede krithei metaxu tous. Pragmati, autoi (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete) ekhoun gi' auto (to Kor'an) amphibolia pou tous egeirei sugkhuse!
Opoios kanei enaretes praxeis, tha einai pros to ophelos tou, eno opoios diaprattei to kako, tha einai eis baros tou. Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) den adikei pote tous doulous Tou.

S' Auton (kai mono) anekei e gnose tes Oras. Kanenas karpos de bgainei apo to phloio tou, kai kanena theluko den kuophorei e genna para mono me te gnose Tou. Ten Emera pou tha tous kalesei (tous apistous): <<Pou einai oi (upotithemenoi) etairoi Mou (pou tous apodidate se Emena os etairous ste latreia);>> (Oi apistoi) tha poun: <<Delonoume enopion Sou oti kaneis apo mas (tora) de martura kati tetoio.>>
Tha tous egkataleipsei o,ti epikalestekan (kai apedidan os etairous ston Allakh ste latreia) prin, kai tha xeroun me bebaioteta oti den ekhoun kamia diaphuge.

O anthropos (o apistos) den kourazetai na zeta ta kala agatha (apo ploute klp.), alla an ton aggixei to kako, brisketai se apognose (apo to na brei diexodo) kai einai apelpismenos (oti de tha labei to eleos tou Allakh).

Alla an tou dosoume eleos apo Emas aphou ton eplexan oi antixootetes, tha pei: <<Auto anekei se mena (epeide to axizo), kai de nomizo oti e Ora tha erthei pote, alla kai an epistrepso ston Kurio mou, sigoura tha ekho apo Auton ten kalutere antamoibe (ton Paradeiso).>> Pragmati, tha enemerosoume autous pou arnethekan ten piste gia o,ti ekanan kai tha tous kanoume na geutoun ena sklero marturio.
Otan dinoume mia khare ston anthropo (ton apisto), apostrephetai (me akharistia) kai apomakrunetai (apo ten upakoe me alazoneia), alla otan ton plettei to kako, katapheugei se polles epikleseis.

Pes (o, Prophete, stous eidololatres): <<Peite mou, an auto to (Kor'an) einai apo ton Allakh (opos sas plerophoresa), kai epeita eseis to arnethekate, tote poios einai pio paraplanemenos ap' auton pou antitithetai polu (sten aletheia);>>

Pragmati, tha tous deixoume ta Semadia Mas ston orizonta (kai sto sumpan), kai stous eautous tous, mekhri na ginei phanero s' autous oti auto (to Kor'an) einai e aletheia. Den arkei oti o Kurios sou einai o Marturas sta panta;
Pragmati, ekhoun amphibolies gia te sunantese me ton Kurio tous. Alla pragmati, Autos periballei ta panta (me te gnose kai te duname Tou).

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
'A, S, K [Ain-Sein-Kaph, tria xekhorista arabika grammata].
Etsi apokaluptei se sena (o, Prophete) kai (apokalupse) s' autous pou etan prin apo sena, o Allakh, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
S' auton anekoun o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste ge, kai Autos einai o Al-'Alei (Upsistos), o Al-'Adeim (Megas).

Oi ouranoi paraligo na skistoun apo pano tous (o enas pano apo ton allon -e pano apo ta epta stromata tes ges-, apo te Megaloprepeia tou Allakh), kai oi Aggeloi doxazoun ton Kurio tous eugnomonontas Ton, kai zetoun sugkhorese gia osous briskontai ste ge (apo tous pistous). Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Oso gi' ekeinous pou pairnoun allous (del. tous pseutikous theous) os kedemones (kai theous pou tous latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton, o Allakh einai Parateretes pano tous, kai den eisai (o, Prophete) upeuthunos (e kedemonas) gi' autous.

Etsi, apokalupsame se sena (o, Prophete) auto to Kor'an sta arabika gia na proeidopoieseis te metera ton komopoleon (te Makka) kai autes pou einai guro tes, kai na proeidopoieseis (tous anthropous) gia ten Emera tes sugkentroses, gia ten opoia den uparkhei kamia amphibolia, kata ten opoia mia omada tha einai ston Paradeiso, eno e alle tha einai sten Kolase.

An ethele o Allakh, tha tous ekane olous mono ena ethnos (sten kathodegese kai sto Islam), alla eisagei sto eleos Tou opoious thelei, eno oi adikoi de tha ekhoun kanenan kedemona, oute kanenan uposterikte.

E ekhoun parei (oi eidololatres tous pseutikous theous kai ta eidola tous os) kedemones (pou tous latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton; Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Oualei (Alethinos Kedemonas), Autos einai pou dinei zoe stous nekrous, kai Autos einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Gia otidepote diaphoneite metaxu sas, e krise gi' auto anekei ston Allakh. (Pes, o, Prophete): <<Autos einai o Allakh, o Kurios mou. S' Auton enapotheto ten empistosune mou kai pros Auton strephomai me metameleia kai upakoe.>>

Einai o Demiourgos ton ouranon kai tes ges. Eplase gia sas suzugous apo sas tous idious (gia na breite eirene kai anapause s' autes), kai (eplase gia sas) ta booeide se zeugaria (arsenika kai theluka). Sas demiourgei meso autes (tes suzugikes skheses, kai sas sunterei meso tes anaparagoges ton booeidon sas). Den uparkhei tipota paromoio (iso e sugkrisimo) me Auton, kai Autos einai o As-Sami' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).
Se Auton anekoun ta kleidia ton thesauron ton ouranon kai tes ges. Parekhei agatha me aphthonia se opoious thelei e ta periorizei. Pragmati, Autos einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.

(O Allakh) orise gia sas (o, anthropoi) apo te threskeia, auto pou dietaxe ton Noe, kai to opoio apokalupsame se sena (o, Mokhammant) kai to opoio diataxame ton Abraam, ton Mouse kai ton Iesou, oti: <<Na teleite o,ti diatakhthekate ste threskeia, kai na me diairetheite s' auten (se aireseis).>> Anupophoro einai gia tous eidololatres auto sto opoio tous kaleis. O Allakh epilegei opoious thelei pros to dromo Tou, kai kathodegei pros to dromo Tou, opoious strephontai me metameleia kai upakoe pros Auton.

De diairethekan (se aireseis kai threskeies, ekeinoi apo ta proegoumena ethne, pou apedidan etairous ston Allakh ste latreia), para mono apo adikia (kai peisma kai phthono) metaxu tous, aphou tous elthe e gnose (me ton Noe kai tous Aggeliaphorous oti tha prepei na teloun o,ti diatakhthekan ste threskeia, kai na me diairethoun se aireseis>>). An den eikhe proegethei e apophase tou Kuriou sou (oti de tha epispeusei to marturio stous doulous Tou) mekhri enan kathorismeno khrono (tes Emeras tes Kriseos), tote tha eikhe ede krithei anamesa tous (kai tha empainan oi pistoi ston Paradeiso kai oi apistoi sten Kolase). Pragmati, autoi (to ethnos tou Mouse kai tou Iesou) pou erthan meta ap' autous (tous laous tou Noe, tou Abraam kai ton allon Propheton), kai stous opoious dotheke to Biblio (e Tora kai to In-tzel), ekhoun amphibolia gi' auto (del. gia ten alethine threskeia pou dietaxe o Allakh ton Noe, ton Abraam, ton Mouse, ton Iesou kai ton Mokhammant), e opoia (amphibolia) tous egeirei sugkhuse (epeide akolouthoun tis epithumies ton progonon tous apo mimese kai okhi apo apodeixe kai gnose)!

Kalese, loipon, (o, Prophete, tous anthropous) pros auto (to Islam, te threskeia pou te dietaxe o Allakh se olous tous Prophetes), kai meine statheros opos diatakhthekes, kai men akoloutheseis tis epithumies tous, kai pes: <<Pisteuo se o,ti esteile o Allakh apo Biblia, kai diatakhtheka na krino me dikaiosune anamesa sas. O Allakh einai o Kurios mas kai o Kurios sas. Gia mas einai oi praxeis mas, kai gia sas einai oi praxeis sas. Den uparkhoun alles suzeteseis metaxu mas (aphou e aletheia einai phanere). O Allakh tha mas sugkentrosei olous (ten Emera tes Kriseos), kai pros Auton tha einai o telikos proorismos.>>

Oso gi' ekeinous (mia omada Ebraion) pou diaphonoun (me mataia epikheiremata) gia te threskeia tou Allakh (kai theloun na apotrepsoun tous Mousoulmanous apo to Islam) aphou antapokrithekan (oi anthropoi) s' aute (te threskeia kai ten akolouthesan), ta epikheiremata tous tha exaphanistoun (kai einai mataia) enopion tou Kuriou tous, kai pano tous uparkhei e Orge (Tou), kai tha ekhoun ena austero marturio.
Einai o Allakh pou esteile to Biblio me ten aletheia kai te dikaiosune. Pos na xereis (o, Prophete), isos e Ora einai konta!

Osoi den pisteuoun s' aute (ten Ora) zetoun (os proklese) na erthei suntoma, alla autoi pou pisteuoun aisthanontai phobo apo ton erkhomo tes kai xeroun oti einai e aletheia. Pragmati, osoi amphisbetoun ten Ora, briskontai se megale plane.
O Allakh einai Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou, parekhei agatha se opoious thelei, kai Autos einai o Al-Kaouei (Paniskhuros), o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).

Opoios anazeta (meso ton praxeon tou) te sugkomide (antamoibe) tes Mellousas Zoes, tha tou auxesoume te sugkomide tou (katagraphontas gi' auton kathe kale praxe os deka e perissoteres). Kai opoios anazeta (mono) te sugkomide (antamoibe) tes egkosmias zoes, tha tou dosoume ap' aute (o,ti ekhei ede prokathoristei gi' auton), alla ste Mellousa Zoe de tha ekhei kanena meridio (apo ten antamoibe tes).

E ekhoun (oi eidololatres) autous (tous legomenous theous) pou tous apodidoun os etairous (se Emena ste latreia), oi opoioi (oi legomenoi theoi) ekhoun orisei gi' autous (tous eidololatres) ste threskeia auta pou den ta epetrepse o Allakh (opos ten eidololatria klp.); An den eikhe proegethei e apophase (apo ton Allakh gia enan kathorismeno khrono) gia ten krise, tha eikhe ede krithei metaxu tous. Pragmati, oi adikoi tha ekhoun ena odunero marturio.

Tha deis (o, Prophete, ten Emera tes Kriseos) tous adikous, phobismenous (apo to marturio) gia o,ti diepraxan, to opoio (marturio) anapopheukta tha pesei pano tous. Alla osoi pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, tha briskontai stous kepous tou Paradeisou. Tha ekhoun o,ti epithumoun os antamoibe apo ton Kurio tous. Pragmati, aute einai e megale gennaiodoria.

Auta einai ta kharmosuna nea pou dinei o Allakh stous doulous Tou pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis. Pes (o, Prophete, ston lao sou): <<De sas zeto kamia antamoibe gi' auto (pou metaphero se sas apo to Menuma tou Allakh), para mono ten kalosune logo tes suggeneias mas.>> Opoios kanei mia kale praxe, tha tou auxesoume ten antamoibe tes (katagraphontas ten os deka e perissoteres). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Sakour (Eugnomon gia tous upakouous kai tous antameibei gi' auto).

E lene (oi eidololatres): <<(O Mokhammant) ekhei epinoesei psemata gia ton Allakh (apodidontas pseudos to Kor'an ston Allakh)>>; An ethele o Allakh, tha eikhe sphragisei ten kardia sou (an ekanes kati tetoio). O Allakh exaleiphei to pseudos kai epibebaionei ten aletheia me ta Logia Tou. Pragmati, Autos einai o Pantognostes oson uparkhoun sta stethe (ton anthropon).
Einai Autos pou dekhetai te metamelia apo tous doulous Tou kai sugkhorei tis amarties, kai gnorizei ola osa kanete.
Antapokrinetai stis epikleseis auton pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis kai auxanei gi' autous apo te gennaiodoria Tou. Alla oso gia tous apistous, tha ekhoun ena austero marturio.

An o Allakh pareikhe (uperbolika) aphthona agatha se (olous) tous doulous Tou, tha exaplonan ten adikia ste ge. Alla stelnei (agatha) sto bathmo pou thelei. Pragmati, Autos einai gia tous doulous Tou, Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta panta).

Einai Autos pou stelnei te brokhe (stous doulous Tou) aphou eikhan apelpistei, kai skorpizei to eleos Tou (stelnontas te brokhe se polla diaphoretika mere). Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Oualei (Kedemonas, Prostates), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai e demiourgia ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai osa (demiourgese kai) skorpise apo kinoumena plasmata s' autous (tous ouranous kai te ge), kai opote thelei, einai Ikanos na ta sugkentrosei (ola ta kinoumena plasmata ten Emera tes Kriseos).
Opoiadepote sumphora plettei esas (o, anthropoi), einai gia o,ti diepraxan ta kheria sas (apo amarties), kai (o Allakh) sugkhorei polla.

Den mporeite na xephugete ste ge (apo ten timoria tou Allakh, an thelei na sas timoresei), kai den ekhete enantia ston Allakh kanenan kedemona, oute kanenan uposterikte (pou na apotrepsei apo sas ten timoria tou Allakh).
Metaxu ton Semadion Tou einai ta ploia, pou pleoun ste thalassa san na etan (megala) bouna, [kai o Allakh ekane to nero na ta koubalesei kai ton anemo na ta sproxei].
An thelei (o Allakh), tha kanei ton anemo akineto, kai etsi tha emenan (ta ploia) akineta sten epiphaneia tes (thalassas). Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gia kathe upomonetiko kai eugnomona.
E (an thelei), tha ta katastrepsei (ta ploia, stelnontas s' auta thuellodeis anemous) gia osa diepraxan (oi anthropoi apo amarties), alla sugkhorei polla.
Kai tote (an tha katastrepsei ta ploia) tha mathoun osoi amphisbetoun (kai diapseudoun) ta Semadia Mas, oti de tha ekhoun kamia diaphuge (apo ten timoria Mas).

O,ti sas dotheke (o, anthropoi, apo ploute, kuros, paidia klp.), den einai para mia (pheugalea) apolause tes egkosmias zoes, alla o,ti ekhei o Allakh (apo antamoibe) einai kalutero kai diarkei gia panta, gi' autous pou pisteuoun kai empisteuontai ton Kurio tous.
Oi opoioi (pistoi) apopheugoun tis megales amarties kai tis epaiskhuntes praxeis, kai otan thumonoun (apo kapoion pou tous eblapse), sugkhoroun (kai den ton timoroun).

Kai oi opoioi antapokrinontai ston Kurio tous (telontas tis entoles Tou), teloun ten proseukhe, apophasizoun gia tis upotheseis tous me amoibaia diabouleuse, kai apo o,ti tous parekhoume, xodeuoun (se eleemosunes kai sto dromo tou Allakh).
Kai oi opoioi otan tous plexei e adikia (apo kapoion pou den axizei na ton sugkhoresoun), tote epidiokoun te dikaiosune (oste na men xanadiapraxei ten adikia tou, khoris omos na ton adikesoun).

(Kai opoios epidiokei te dikaiosune gia ten adikia pou elabe, tote) e antapodose tou kakou einai e isoduname timoria (khoris adikia e uperbole), alla opoios sugkhorei kai diorthonei (te skhese tou m' auton pou ton adikese), e antamoibe tou tha einai apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, (o Allakh) den agapaei tous adikous.
Opoios omos epidiokei te dikaiosune, aphou elabe adikia, se autous den uparkhei phtaiximo.
To phtaiximo (kai e timoria) einai mono s' autous pou adikoun tous anthropous kai adikoun ste ge, ekeinoi tha ekhoun ena epoduno marturio.

Opoios omos deikhnei upomone (sten adikia kai to kako pou elabe apo kapoion allon) kai sugkhorei (apothontas to kako me kalosune kai sugkhorese), pragmati, aute einai apo tis axiepaines praxeis (pou tis ekhei diataxei o Allakh kai katekhoun megales antamoibes).

Opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, de tha ekhei kanenan kedemona meta ap' auto. Tha deis (o, Prophete, ten Emera tes Kriseos) tous adikous otan doun to marturio, na lene: <<Uparkhei tropos na epistrepsoume (sten egkosmia zoe oste na straphoume me metameleia pros ton Allakh kai na praxoume enaretes praxeis);>>

Tha tous deis (o, Prophete, tous adikous) otan ektithentai s' auten (te Photia) na einai upotagmenoi apo tapeinose, kai na koitazoun krupha (pros te Photia) me tapeinomena misanoikhta matia (apo to phobo tous). Autoi pou pisteuoun tha poun: <<Pragmati, oi khamenoi einai autoi pou ekhasan ton eauto tous kai tis oikogeneies tous ten Emera tes Anastases.>> Pragmati, oi adikoi tha parameinoun se aionio marturio.
De tha ekhoun uposteriktes pou na tous uposterixoun enantia ston Allakh. Opoion ton kanei o Allakh na parastratesei, de tha uparkhei gi' auton kanenas dromos (pros ten kathodegese).

Antapokritheite ston Kurio sas (telontas tis entoles Tou) protou erthei apo ton Allakh mia Emera, pou tipote de tha mporesei na ten apotrepsei. Ekeine ten Emera de tha ekhete kanena kataphugio, oute tha mporeite na arnetheite (tis amarties sas, oute na deixete antirrese, oute tha ekhete kanenan uperaspiste).

Alla an apomakrunthoun (o, Prophete, apo ten aletheia), tote (aphese tous, pragmati) de se steilame os paraterete pano tous (gia na katagrapseis tis praxeis tous, Emeis tis katagraphoume kai tha tous pheroume se apologismo). To kathekon sou einai mono na diabibaseis (to menuma me xekatharo tropo). An dosoume eleos apo Emas ston anthropo (apo ploute e kale ugeia klp.), khairetai gi' auto, alla an tous plexei (tous amartolous) mia sumphora gia o,ti diepraxan ta kheria tous, tote o anthropos ginetai polu akharistos (gia tis khares tou Allakh s' auton kai thumatai mono te sumphora pou ton eplexe).
Ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges, demiourgei o,ti thelei, kai kharizei se opoious thelei (paidia) koritsia, kai kharizei se opoious thelei agoria,
e tous dinei ta duo phula: agoria kai koritsia* kai kanei opoion thelei steiro. Pragmati, Autos einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta).

Den enapokeitai se kanenan anthropo to na tou milesei o Allakh para mono meso apokalupses, e piso apo ena kalumma, e stelnontas enan Aggelo-Aggeliaphoro na apokalupsei me ten adeia Tou o,ti thelei (o Allakh). Pragmati, Autos einai 'Alei (Upsistos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai etsi (opos apokalupsame stous proegoumenous Prophetes), apokalupsame se sena (o, Mokhammant) mia apokalupse (kai eleos) apo tis Entoles Mas. Oute gnorizes ti einai to Biblio (ta Theika Biblia), oute gnorizes ti einai e piste. Alla to kaname (to Kor'an) os ena phos, meso tou opoiou kathodegoume opoion theloume apo tous doulous Mas. Pragmati, esu (o, Mokhammant) kathodegeis (kai kaleis tous anthropous) pros ton isio dromo,
to dromo tou Allakh, ston Opoio anekei o,ti brisketai stous ouranous, kai o,ti brisketai ste ge. Pragmati, pros ton Allakh epistrephoun ola ta themata.

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Orkizomai) ma to xekatharo Biblio (pou diasaphenizei ten aletheia)!
Oti pragmati to ekhoume steilei, to Kor'an sta arabika, isos na sullogisteite [epeide e arabike glossa einai e pio euglotte, saphestere kai eurutere glossa].
To opoio (Kor'an) to ekhoume sto Kurio Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud), kai ekhei upsele these, kai einai teleio kai sopho (Biblio).

(Nomizete, o, eidololatres, oti) tha sas aphesoume kai de tha anapheroume se sas (ten timoria Mas, gia o,ti diapseusate apo to Kor'an), eno eiste parabates (eidololatres, pou den pisteuete ston Kurio sas);
Posous Prophetes steilame sta proegoumena ethne!
Den tous erthe (sta proegoumena ethne) kanenas Prophetes, para na ton khleuazan.

Etsi, katastrepsame autous pou (diepseusan tous Prophetes tous apo ta proegoumena ethne, oi opoioi) etan pio dunatoi ap' autous (tous apistous apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant), kai dotheke to paradeigma (tes timorias) ton proegoumenon ethnon (gia na to labete upopse).
An tous roteseis (o, Prophete): <<Poios demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge;>> Tha poun: <<Tous demiourgese o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>
Einai Autos pou ekane gia sas te ge etoime na egkatastatheite (kai na perpatesete pano tes), kai ephtiaxe gia sas mesa tes monopatia, oste na kathodegetheite (sto dromo sas).
Einai Autos pou esteile apo ton ourano nero, se mia sugkekrimene posoteta (pou na sas eparkei), me to opoio anazoogonoume mia nekre ge. Etsi tha bgeite (kai tha anastetheite apo tous taphous sas).
Einai Autos pou demiourgese ola ta zeuge (arseniko kai theluko), kai ephtiaxe gia sas ta ploia kai ta booeide, me ta opoia metakineste,

gia na anebete (sta katastromata kai) stis plates tous (ton booeidon), epeita na thumetheite te khare tou Kuriou sas (se sas) otan anebeite ekei, kai na peite: <<Doxa s' Auton pou to upetaxe auto gia mas, giati de tha mporousame na to eikhame kanei monoi mas,
kai pragmati pros ton Kurio mas tha epistrepsoume (meta apo to thanato mas).>>

Orisan (oi apistoi) gi' Auton ena meridio apo tous doulous Tou (iskhurizomenoi pseudos oti o Allakh ekhei enan uio e oti oi Aggeloi einai oi kores Tou). Pragmati, o anthropos (o apistos) einai xekathara akharistos.
E (lete, o, apistoi, oti o Allakh) ekhei parei gia ton Eauto Tou kores apo o,ti demiourgese, kai sas ekhei eunoesei me gious;

Otan kapoios ap' autous (apokta mia kore kai) tou erkhontai ta nea, gia to idio pragma pou to apodidei ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) (oti o Allakh ekhei kores -tous Aggelous-), to prosopo tou menei (apo ekeine te stigme) skoteiniasmeno, kai gemizei me thlipse mesa tou!

E (apodidoun oi apistoi ston Allakh, kores) autes pou megalonoun me stolidia kai otan malonoun (m' allous) de khresimopoioun xekathara epikheiremata (logo tes eugeneias, tes euaisthesias kai tes leptotetas tous)!

Iskhurizontai (oi apistoi) oti oi Aggeloi, -pou einai oi douloi tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona)-, einai gunaikes. Etan martures tes demiourgias tous; E marturia tous (kai auto pou eipan) tha graphtei, kai tha logodotesoun (gi' auto)!

Lene (oi apistoi): <<An ethele o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), de tha tous latreuame (tous Aggelous, alla aphou tous latreuoume, auto semainei oti dekhteke auto apo mas).>> Den ekhoun gi' auto (pou lene) kamia gnose, pragmati, de lene para psemata.
E mepos tous dosame (stous apistous) prin ap' auto (to Kor'an), ena biblio (pou tous epitrepei na latreuoun allous ektos apo ton Allakh), kai etsi proskollontai s' auto (os apodeixe);
Okhi (den egine auto), alla (oi apistoi) eipan: <<Pragmati, brekame tous progonous mas se mia sugkekrimene threskeia, kai emeis akolouthoume ta bemata tous.>>

Omoios, de steilame kanenan proeidopoiete prin apo sena (o, Mokhammant) se kamia pole, ektos oi euporoi anamesa tous na lene: <<Pragmati, brekame tous progonous mas se mia sugkekrimene threskeia, kai pragmati emeis akolouthoume ta bemata tous.>>

(O kathe Prophetes) eipe (ston lao tou): <<(Tha akolouthesete ta bemata ton progonon sas) parolo pou ephera se sas ten kathodegemene threskeia (ten alethine threskeia), pou einai se antithese s' aute (ten plane) pou brekate tous progonous sas na akolouthoun;>> Eipan (oi apistoi stous Prophetes tous): <<Emeis s' auto, me to opoio stalthekate (o, Prophetes), den pisteuoume!>>
Etsi, tous ekdikethekame. Koita loipon pos etan to telos ekeinon pou diepseudan!
(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan (o Abraam) eipe ston patera tou kai ston lao tou: <<Pragmati, aparnoumai o,ti latreuete,
ektos ap' Auton pou me demiourgese, o Opoios tha me kathodegesei.>>

Kai (o Abraam) to ekane (auto pou eipe: <<Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh>>) na einai e phrase (kai e diatheke) pou tha parameinei anamesa stous apogonous tou (gia na ten akolouthesoun), isos na epistrepsoun (pros ton Allakh me upakoe kai metameleia).

Den (epespeusa ten timoria s' autous tous eidololatres apo ton lao sou, o, Mokhammant), alla tous aphesa kai tous progonous tous na apolambanoun te zoe (khoris na tous steilo ten timoria), mekhri pou tous erthe e aletheia (to Kor'an) kai enas Aggeliaphoros pou proeidopoiei me xekatharo tropo.
Alla otan tous erthe e aletheia (to Kor'an), eipan: <<Auto einai mia mageia, kai emeis to arnoumaste.>>

Eipan (oi eidololatres): <<Giati de staltheke auto to Kor'an se enan spoudaio andra apo tis duo komopoleis (opos ston Al-Oualeint mpin Al-Mougeira ste Makka, e ston Khampimp Ath-Thakaphei sten At-Ta'iph)!>>

Tha moirazoun autoi (oi eidololatres) to eleos tou Kuriou sou (dinontas to se opoion theloun kai apotrepontas to apo opoion theloun); Pragmati, Emeis moirasame ta pros to zen metaxu tous sten egkosmia zoe, kai upsosame merikous ap' autous pano apo allous, se taxeis (plousias, mesaias kai phtokhes), oste na uperetoun o enas ton allon. Pragmati, to eleos tou Kuriou sou (o, Mokhammant, otan tha eisagei tous pistous ston Paradeiso) einai kalutero apo o,ti sussoreuoun (oi anthropoi apo ploute sten egkosmia zoe).

An den etan oti oi anthropoi tha ginontousan mia koinoteta (sten apistia, kai sten anazetese ton apolauseon, otan doun tous apistous se euemeria), tha eikhame kanei sta spitia oson arnountai ten piste ston Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), steges apo asemi, kai skales (apo asemi) me tis opoies tha anebainan, [epeide oles oi apolauseis tes egkosmias zoes, den ekhoun kamia axia enopion tou Allakh],
(kai tha eikhame kanei) gia ta spitia tous, portes (apo asemi) kai krebatia (apo asemi) sta opoia plagiazoun,

kai (tha tous eikhame dosei kai) khruso! Pragmati, ola auta den einai para mono e (pheugalea) apolause tes egkosmias zoes, eno e Mellousa Zoe (kai oi antamoibes tes) apo ton Kurio sou (tha einai kalutere) gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou).

Opoios apomakrunetai apo ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an) tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona), (kai koitaei sta Semadia kai ta Edaphia Tou me tropo san na eikhe kake orase), orizoume s' auton (os timoria) enan diabolo pou tha ginei o suntrophos tou.

Oi opoioi (diaboloi) tha tous apotrepsoun apo ton isio dromo (oraiopoiontas ten plane sta matia oson apomakrunontai apo to Kor'an), kai etsi tha nomizoun oti einai kathodegoumenoi (sten aletheia, kai oti e plane tous einai e kathodegese).

Ospou otan (autos pou apomakruntheke apo to Kor'an) erthei se Emas, tha pei (ston diabolo pou etan o suntrophos tou): <<Makari na uperkhe anamesa se mena kai se sena (mia apostase) oso einai e apostase anamesa sten Anatole kai te Duse. Poso athlios suntrophos esoun!>>

(O Allakh tha pei s' autous pou apomakrunthekan apo to Kor'an): <<Semera, -aphou adikesate (ton eauto sas me ten apistia kai tis amarties)-, de tha sas ophelesei oti tha eiste sto marturio mazi (me tous suntrophous sas, tous diabolous, aphou o kathenas sas tha ekhei to meridio tou kai de tha koubalesei tipote apo ten timoria tou allou).>>

Mporeis esu (o, Prophete) na kaneis tous kophous (del. tous apistous pou den akoun ten aletheia) na akousoun, e na kathodegeseis tous tuphlous (pou de blepoun ten aletheia), kai (na kathodegeseis) opoion brisketai se xekathare plane;
Akoma ki an sou aphairesoume te zoe (o, Prophete, prin deis ten timoria tous), pragmati, tha tous ekdikethoume (timorontas tous sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe).
E an sou deixoume (o, Prophete) auto pou tous uposkhethekame (apo ten timoria), pragmati, ekhoume plere duname pano tous.
Gi' auto, krata gera auto (to Kor'an) pou apokaluptetai se sena. Pragmati, esu briskesai ston isio dromo.

Pragmati, auto (to Kor'an) einai doxa (kai duname) gia sena kai gia ton lao sou (an to akolouthesei, kai einai upenthumise gia sas), kai pragmati, tha erotetheite (gia to pos telesate tis entoles tou).

Rota (o, Prophete) tous Aggeliophorous Mas pou steilame prin apo sena, an eikhame orisei allous theous na latreuontai ektos apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona); [Edo apeuthunetai ste phule Kourais gia na mathei oti den uperkhe kanenas Aggeliaphoros pou na dietaxe te latreia allon ektos apo ton Allakh].
Pragmati, steilame ton Mouse me ta Semadia Mas, ston Pharao kai stous arkhegous tou laou tou, kai eipe: <<Pragmati, eimai o Aggeliaphoros tou Kuriou olon ton kosmon.>>
Otan erthe s' autous me ta Semadia Mas, ta koroidepsan.
Den tous deixame kanena Semadi ektos na etan megalutero apo to proegoumeno, kai tous arpaxame me ten timoria, isos na epestrephan (me metameleia pros Emas).

(Otan epese pano tous meros tes timorias) eipan (ston Mouse): <<O, mage [ennoousan enan logio]! Epikalesou ton Kurio sou gia mas, skhetika m' auto pou anephere se sena (oti an tha pistepsoume se sena, tha aphairesei ten timoria apo mas), giati pragmati, tha akolouthesoume ten kathodegese (sou).>>
Alla otan aphairesame ten timoria ap' autous, athetesan ten uposkhese tous.
O Pharao diakeruxe ston lao tou: <<O, lae mou! Den anekei se mena to basileio tes Misr, kai auta ta potamia kuloun kato apo mena; De blepete;
E den eimai kaluteros ap' auton ton adunamo (pou den katekhei tipote) kai pou skhedon de milaei xekathara;

Giati de stalthekan s' auton (apo ton Kurio tou) khrusa brakhiolia (os endeixe tes kuriarkhias tou gia na ton upakoume, opos ekhoun oloi oi arkhegoi edo), e (giati) den erthan mazi tou oi Aggeloi o enas meta apo ton allon (gia na ton uposterixoun);>>
Etsi, xegelase ton lao tou (me ta logia tou) kai autoi ton upakousan. Pragmati, etan enas laos pou bgeke apo ten upakoe pros ton Allakh.
Otan Mas exorgisan (me ten epimone tous sten apistia), tous ekdikethekame kai tous pnixame olous.
Etsi tous kaname na einai (sten katastrophe) proegoumenoi (gia ta epomena apista ethne) kai os paradeigma (kai nouthesia) gia tis epomenes genies.

Otan [apokaluphtheke to Edaphio (Al-Anmpia' 21:98): <<Eseis (o, eidololatres) kai o,ti latreuete peran tou Allakh (apo eidola, kai anthropous e tzinn pou dekhtekan na tous latreuete), tha eiste kausimo gia ten Kolase.>>, tote], dotheke (apo tous eidololatres) to paradeigma (tou Iesou) tou uiou tes Marias (legontas: <<Ti ginetai me ton Iesou (pou ton latreuoun oi Khristianoi, tha mpei kai autos ste Photia);>>), tote o laos sou ekane phasaria apo te khara gi' auto (to paradeigma, nomizontas oti nikesan te suzetese)! [Etsi apokaluphtheke (Al-Anmpia' 21:101): <<Oso gi' ekeinous gia tous opoious eikhame orisei apo prin oti tha ekhoun ten kalutere antamoibe, (gnorizontas ede oti tha eisakhthoun ston Paradeiso, opos oi pistoi, kai o Iesous, o Ouzair kai oi Aggeloi pou de dekhtekan na tous latrepsei kaneis), tha einai makria ap' auten (ten Kolase).>>].

Eipan (oi eidololatres): <<Einai oi theoi mas kaluteroi e autos (o Iesous pou ton latreuoun oi Khristianoi);>> [del. an oi theoi mas tha mpoun ste Photia, tote kai o Iesous to idio]. Sou to anepheran (to paradeigma tou Iesou) mono gia na deixoun diaphonia (kai okhi gia na phtasoun sten aletheia). Alla pragmati einai enas laos pou anazeta na antitithetai (sten aletheia, uposterizontas to psema).

Pragmati, autos (o Iesous) den einai para enas doulos (Mas), ston opoio ekhoume enapothesei te khare Mas (kanontas ton Aggeliaphoro), kai ton kaname os paradeigma (kai Semadi) gia ta paidia tou Israel (oti ton demiourgesame san ton Adam khoris patera).
An theloume, (tha sas katastrepsoume olous kai) tha sas antikatastesoume me Aggelous, pou tha sas diadekhtoun ste ge (kai tha latreuoun ton Allakh khoris na apodidoun s' Auton etairous ste latreia).

Pragmati, autos (o Iesous) tha einai ena semadi tes Oras (kata te deutere eleuse tou ste ge, tha spasei to stauro kai oi anthropoi tha ton akolouthesoun sto Islam, kai tha skotosei ton antikhristo). Men amphibalete loipon gi' aute (ten Ora). (Kai pes tous, o, Prophete): <<Akoloutheste me, pragmati, auto (pou ephera se sas apo ten aletheia) einai o isios dromos.>>
Men aphenete ton Satana na sas apotrepsei (apo ton isio dromo), pragmati, autos einai gia sas enas prophanes ekhthros.

Otan o Iesous erthe (ston lao tou) me ta xekathara Semadia, eipe: <<Pragmati, ertha se sas me te sophia (ten apostole mou) kai gia na xekathariso se sas merika ap' auta gia ta opoia diaphoneite. Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai upakouste me.
Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Kurios mou kai o Kurios sas. Latreuete loipon mono Auton, autos einai o isios dromos.>>

Omos diaphonesan oi omades metaxu tous (skhetika me ton Iesou, kai etsi, mia omada ton diepseuse, mia alle ton pistepse oti einai enas Aggeliaphoros, kai mia alle epinoese te theoteta tou kai ton latrepse). Alimono stous adikous (apistous), apo to marturio mias epodunes Emeras!

Perimenoun (ekeinoi pou diepseusan ton Iesou e ton latrepsan, kati allo gia na pistepsoun sten alethine piste kai na straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh), para na tous erthei e Ora xaphnika khoris na ten perimenoun;
Ekeine ten Emera, oi stenoi philoi (pou einai apistoi) tha ginoun ekhthroi o enas pros ton allon, ektos apo tous eusebeis (pou phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou).
(O Allakh tha pei stous eusebeis): <<O, douloi Mou! Semera de tha uparkhei phobos gia sas (apo ten timoria), oute tha lupetheite (gia otidepote paramelesate apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Osoi pistepsan sta Edaphia Mas kai upotakhthekan (ste Boulese Mas).
Eiselthete ston Paradeiso, eseis kai oi suntrophoi sas (oi pistoi pou epraxan opos praxate, apo tis suzugous, ta paidia kai tous suntrophous sas), opou tha khareite sten eudaimonia.>>

(Oi uperetes) tha peripherontai anamesa tous me khrusous diskous kai diskopotera. Mesa tou (Paradeisou) tha uparkhoun o,ti epithumoun oi psukhes, kai o,ti kanei ta matia na kharoun. <<Tha meinete ekei (o, pistoi) gia panta.
Autos einai o Paradeisos pou tha kleronomesete gia o,ti kanate.
Tha ekhete ekei aphthona phrouta (pou den teleionoun pote), apo ta opoia tha phate.>>
Pragmati, oi kakoi tha briskontai sto marturio tes Kolaseos gia panta.
De tha elaphrunthei (to marturio) gi' autous, kai tha parameinoun ekei se apolute apognose.
Pragmati, den tous adikesame (me to marturio), alla ekeinoi etan oi adikoi (pou adikesan ton eauto tous me ten apistia kai tis amarties tous).
Tha phonaxoun (ston phulaka tes Photias): <<O, Malik! As aphairesei te zoe mas o Kurios sou!>> Tha pei: <<Pragmati, tha meinete (edo gia panta).>>
(O, phule Kourais)! Pragmati, steilame se sas (ton Aggeliaphoro Mas me) ten aletheia, alla oi perissoteroi apo sas antipathoun ten aletheia!

E ekhoun sunomotesei (oi apistoi) kapoio skhedio (enantion tou Mokhammant kai tes aletheias); Pragmati, kai Emeis ekhoume katastrosei ena (anotero) skhedio (pou tha katastrepsei to skhedio tous kai tha tous timoresei gi' auto).

E nomizoun oti den akoume ta mustika tous kai tis mustikes sunomilies tous; Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou nomizoun), alla pragmati (akoume kai gnorizoume o,ti kruboun), kai oi Aggeloi-Aggeliaphoroi Mas einai mazi tous kai katagraphoun (ta panta).

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Ean o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) eikhe enan uio (opos iskhurizeste), tha emoun o protos ton latreon (kai tha espeuda na latrepso ton Allakh m' auto to dogma, alla den ekhei kanenan uio, oute auto tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou).>>
Doxa ston Kurio ton ouranon kai tes ges, ton Kurio tou Thronou, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun (pseudos apo ateleies).
Etsi, aphese tous (o, Prophete) na buthizontai (kai na miloun) sten plane tous kai na paixoun (sten egkosmia zoe), mekhri na sunantesoun ten Emera pou tous uposkhetheke.

Einai Autos pou einai o Enas Alethinos Theos (pou mono Autos axizei na latreuetai) ston ourano kai einai o Enas Alethinos Theos ste ge, kai Autos einai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).

Upsistos einai Autos pou katekhei ten kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous. Mono Autos katekhei te gnose tes Oras, kai pros Auton tha epistrepsete (ten Emera tes Kriseos).

Ekeinoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou tous epikalountai (oi eidololatres kai tous latreuoun) ektos ap' Auton, den mporoun na diamesolabesoun (enopion tou Allakh gia logariasmo opoioudepote), para mono autoi (opos o Iesous, o Ouzair kai oi Aggeloi) pou marturoun ten aletheia (oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh) eno gnorizoun (auto pou marturoun).
An tous roteseis (o, Prophete), Poios tous demiourgese, tha poun: <<O Allakh!>> Pos, loipon, apomakrunontai (apo ten aletheia kai apo te latreia pros Auton);
(O Allakh gnorizei) ta logia tou (Prophete): <<O, Kurie! Pragmati, autoi einai anthropoi pou den pisteuoun!>>
Apomakrunsou loipon (o, Prophete) ap' autous kai pes <<Eirene>>, (kai men antimetopizeis to kako tous me kako). Pragmati, tha mathoun (ti tha laboun apo ten timoria)!

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Orkizomai) ma to xekatharo Biblio (pou diasaphenizei ten aletheia)!

Oti Emeis to katebasame (to Kor'an apo to Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud -ton Diateremeno Pinaka- kai to steilame ston proto ourano, kai xekinese e apokalupse tou ston Prophete) se mia eulogemene nukhta (tou Al-Kantr -tou Diatagmatos- kata ton mena tou Ramantan -Ramazaniou-). Pragmati, Emeis (meso tes apostoles ton Aggeliaphoron kai ton Biblion) proeidopoioume (tous anthropous, gia na men ekhoun kamia dikaiologia enopion Mas).

Kata ten opoia (te Nukhta tou Al-Kantr) kathorizetai kathe teleia kai analloiote entole [gi' ekeine te khronia: apo zoe, thanato, kai agatha klp., kai o Allakh stelnei, apo to Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud stous Aggelous-grapheis, ti tha grapsoun sta biblia tous, apo ti tha sumbei ekeine te khronia].
(E opoia -e kathe entole-) einai mia entole apo Emas. Pragmati, Emeis eimaste pou stelnoume (tous Aggeliaphorous stous anthropous),
os eleos apo ton Kurio sou (pros tous anthropous). Pragmati, Autos einai o As-Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta), o Al-'Aleim (o Pantognostes).

Einai o Kurios ton ouranon kai tes ges kai oson uparkhoun anamesa tous, -ean eiste bebaioi (gi' auto, tote latrepste mono Auton, kai na xerete oti o Kurios ton panton, einai o Enas Alethinos Theos ton panton)-!
Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Einai Autos pou dinei te zoe kai ten aphairei, kai einai o Kurios sas kai o Kurios ton progonon sas.
Okhi (autoi oi eidololatres den pisteuoun sten aletheia), alla briskontai se amphibolia paizontas (kai adiaphorontas).

(Epeide epikalestekes, o, Prophete, ton Allakh na se uposterixei enantion ton peismataredon apiston, me xerasia san ekeine pou egine ten epokhe tou Ioseph), perimene loipon mekhri ten emera pou o ouranos tha pherei orato kapno,
pou tha kalupsei tous anthropous, (oi opoioi apo ten peina tous tha koitaxoun pros ton ourano, alla tha blepoun mono kapno -e kati san kapno-). Aute einai mia epodune timoria.
(Tha epikalestoun tote ton Allakh): <<Kurie mas! Aphairese ten timoria apo emas. Pragmati, (an tha ten aphaireseis), tha pistepsoume!>>
Pos tha lambanan te nouthesia upopse (kai tha strephontousan me metameleia pros ton Allakh), eno eikhe erthei s' autous enas Aggeliaphoros pou tous exegese xekathara,
epeita apomakrunthekan ap' auton kai eipan: <<Emathe auta apo allous (kai den einai Aggeliaphoros), kai einai enas trelos>>;
Pragmati, tha aphairesoume ten timoria gia ligo, alla pragmati, eseis (tha athetesete ten uposkhese sas kai) tha epistrepsete (sten apistia)!
Ten emera pou tha (tous) timoresoume me te megale timoria [ten emera tes makhes Mpantr, -e ten Emera tes Kriseos-], pragmati, tha (tous) ekdikethoume.
Pragmati, prin ap' autous, dokimasame tous anthropous tou Pharao, kai erthe s' autous enas eugenes Aggeliaphoros (o Mouses).
(O opoios tous eipe) oti: <<Paradoste mou tous doulous tou Allakh (ta paidia tous Israel). Pragmati, eimai pros esas enas axiopistos Aggeliaphoros.
Kai men eiste alazonikoi apenanti ston Allakh. Pragmati, ertha se sas me xekathares apodeixeis.
Pragmati, anazeto kataphugio ston Kurio mou kai ton Kurio sas (ton Allakh), apo to na me lithobolesete (e na epitetheite se mena me logia e praxeis).
An de me pisteuete (se o,ti ephera apo ton Kurio mou), apheste me (kai me me plesiazete me kanena kako).>>
Etsi, epikalesteke (o Mouses) ton Kurio tou: <<Autoi einai kakoi anthropoi (pou axizoun ten timoria).>>
Etsi, (empneusame ston Mouse): <<Phuge te nukhta me tous doulous Mou. Pragmati, (o Pharao kai oi anthropoi tou) tha sas kunegesoun.

Kai (khtupa to nero me to rabdi sou kai tha skhistei, kai aphou to perasete), aphese to nero opos einai (esukho kai khorismeno). Pragmati, autoi (o Pharao kai oi anthropoi tou) einai enas stratos pou tha pnigei.>>
Posous kepous kai peges aphesan (o Pharao kai oi anthropoi tou) piso tous,
kai kalliergeies kai kala mere,
kai anete zoe pou ten apolambanan;

Etsi (bgalame ton Pharao kai tous anthropous tou ap' autes tis eunoies), kai tis dosame (tetoies eunoies apo kepous, peges kai kalliergeies) se allous anthropous (del. sta paidia tou Israel se allo meros).
Oute o ouranos, oute e ge tous eklapsan (ton Pharao kai tous anthropous tou), oute tous dosame anabole (gia ten timoria tous).
Pragmati, sosame ta paidia tou Israel apo ta tapeinotika basana,
(pou elaban) apo ton Pharao. Pragmati, etan enas alazonas kai ap' autous pou xeperasan ta oria (stis amarties)!
Pragmati, tous epilexame (ta paidia tou Israel) en gnose (Mas) apo olous tous allous anthropous (tes epokhes tous kai tes epokhes tou Mouse).
Kai tous dosame Semadia, sta opoia uperkhan xekathares dokimasies.
Pragmati, autoi (oi apistoi apo ton lao sou, o, Prophete) lene:
<<Den uparkhei para mono o protos thanatos mas (sten egkosmia zoe kai den uparkhei zoe meta ap' auto), kai de tha anastethoume!
Pherte loipon (o, Mokhammant kai oi opadoi sou) tous progonous mas (xana ste zoe), an eiste eilikrineis (oti tha uparkhei anastase).>>

Einai autoi (oi eidololatres pou se diapseudoun, o, Prophete) kaluteroi (kai anoteroi ste duname) e o laos tou Toumpa' kai ekeinoi (oi apistoi laoi) pou etan prin ap' autous; Tous katastrepsame, kai pragmati, etan kakoi.
De demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous gia diaskedase (e askopa).
Den tous demiourgesame para mono me ten aletheia, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous de gnorizoun.
Pragmati, e Emera tes Kriseos einai e prokathorismene ora gia olous tous!
Ten Emera pou kanenas suggenes (e philos) de tha ophelesei kanenan allon suggene (e philo), oute tha laboun kamia uposterixe,
ektos apo osous tous deixei eleos o Allakh. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
Pragmati, to dentro tou Az-Zakoum,
tha einai e trophe ton (apiston) amartolon.
(Oi karpoi ekeinou tou dentrou, tha einai) san to bromiko ladi pou tha brazei stis koilies,
san to brasimo tou zematistou nerou.
(Tha eipothei stous Aggelous-phulakes tes Photias): <<Parte ton (apisto) kai surete ton biaia mekhri te mese tes Phlegomenes Photias.
Epeita rixte pano sto kephali tou apo to marturio tou zematistou nerou.>>
(Tha eipothei s' auton os epiplexe ): <<Geusou! Esu eisai (opos iskhuristekes sten egkosmia zoe) o timemenos, o eugenes (anamesa ston lao sou)!
Auto einai (to marturio), gia to opoio amphibalate (o, apistoi, sten egkosmia zoe).>>
Pragmati, oi enaretoi (pou phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou) tha briskontai se asphales meros (ton Paradeiso),
se kepous kai peges.
Tha phoroun imatia apo lepto kai pakhu metaxi, kathismenoi o enas apenanti apo ton allon (se uperupsomena stolismena krebatia, kai kaneis de tha dosei ten plate tou ston allon).
Etsi kai (opos tous kharisame auta), tha tous pantrepsoume me omorphes gunaikes me megala omorpha matia.
Tha kaloun (tous uperetes tous) ekei (ston Paradeiso) gia kathe eidous phrouto (pou epithumoun), kai tha einai asphaleis (apo kathe kako kai apo to na diakoptetai aute e eudaimonia).
De tha geutoun ton thanato ekei (ston Paradeiso), para mono ton proto thanato (sten egkosmia zoe), kai tha tous prostateusei (o Allakh) apo to marturio tes Phlegomenes Photias,
os khare apo ton Kurio sou. Pragmati, aute einai e megale epitukhia!
Pragmati, dieukoluname (kai steilame) auto (to Kor'an) ste glossa sou (o, Prophete), isos (oi apistoi) na laboun nouthesia.
Perimene loipon (o, Prophete, te nike enantion tous). Pragmati, kai autoi perimenoun (na se nikesoun, alla tha doun sto telos poios tha nikesei ton allon).

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou den sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
(Aute einai) e apokalupse tou Bibliou apo ton Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-Khakeim (Pansopho).
Pragmati, uparkhoun stous ouranous kai ste ge, Semadia gia tous pistous (pou sullogizontai ta Semadia tou Allakh).

Kai ste demiourgia sas (se stadia, apo ekkriseis ton duo phulon mekhri pou na ginete anthropoi) kai (ste demiourgia) oson skorpizontai (ste ge) apo kinoumena plasmata, uparkhoun Semadia gi' ekeinous pou ekhoun bathia piste (oti o Allakh einai o Demiourgos ton panton).

Kai ste diadokhe tes nukhtas kai tes emeras, kai se o,ti stelnei o Allakh apo ton ourano apo parokhe (brokhe), -me ten opoia anazoogonei te ge meta to thanato tes-, kai stis allages ton kateuthunseon ton anemon, uparkhoun Semadia gia tous anthropous pou katanooun (kai sullogizontai).

Auta einai ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) tou Allakh pou apaggelloume se sena (o, Prophete) me ten aletheia. Se poia alla logia meta apo ta Logia tou Allakh kai ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Tou, tha pistepsoun;
Alimono se kathe amartolo pseute,

pou akouei ta Edaphia tou Allakh na apaggellontai s' auton, kai epeita epimenei (sten apistia tou) me alazoneia, san na men ta akouse. Anaggeile, loipon, (o, Prophete) s' auton ten eidese gia ena epoduno marturio (pou ton perimenei).
Otan mathei kapoia apo ta Edaphia Mas, ta pairnei gia khleuasmo. Gia tetoious (anthropous) tha uparxei ena tapeinotiko marturio (sten Kolase).

Mprosta tous tha einai e Kolase (pou tha tous perimenei ten Emera tes Kriseos). De tha tous ophelesoun se tipote osa kerdisan (apo ploute), oute osous peran os kedemones ektos apo ton Allakh. Tha ekhoun ena tromero marturio.
Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia kathodegese, kai oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste sta Edaphia tou Kuriou tous, tha ekhoun ena epoduno kai tromero marturio.
Einai o Allakh pou upetaxe gia sas te thalassa, gia na pleoun s' aute ta ploia me ten entole Tou, kai gia na anazetesete (agatha) apo te gennaiodoria Tou, kai isos na eiste eugnomones.

Kai upetaxe gia sas osa briskontai stous ouranous (apo elio, pheggari kai asteria klp.) kai osa briskontai ste ge (apo potamia, dentra kai bouna klp.)* oles autes (oi Khares) einai ap' Auton. Pragmati, uparkhoun s' auto Semadia gi' autous pou sullogizontai.

Pes (o, Prophete) s' autous pou pisteuoun (kai tous blaptoun oi apistoi), na sugkhoresoun ekeinous (tous apistous) pou de phobountai tis emeres tou Allakh (del. ten timoria ap' Auton), gia na timoresei (o Allakh) ekeinous (tous apistous ten Emera tes Kriseos) gia o,ti diepraxan.
Opoios kanei enaretes praxeis, tha einai pros to ophelos tou, kai opoios diaprattei to kako, tha einai eis baros tou. Epeita pros ton Kurio sas tha epistrepsete.

Pragmati, dosame sta paidia tou Israel to Biblio (ten Tora tou Mouse kai to In-tzel tou Iesou), ten katanoese (tou Bibliou kai ton kanonon tou) kai (steilame s' autous) pollous Prophetes. Tous pareikhame kala agatha kai tous eunoesame pano apo olous tous anthropous (tes epokhes tous).

Tous dosame sapheis apodeixeis tes threskeias (kai tou erkhomou tou Mokhammant), alla de diaphonesan metaxu tous (skhetika me ton erkhomo tou) para mono apo adikia (kai phthono) metaxu tous, aphou tous erthe e gnose, (oti o Prophetes staltheke anamesa stous Arabes kai okhi stous idious). Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Mokhammant) tha krinei metaxu tous ten Emera tes Anastases se o,ti diaphonesan metaxu tous.

Epeita se odegesame (o, Mokhammant) se enan dromo tes threskeias (pou ton diataxame kai stous proegoumenous Prophetes). Etsi, akolouthese ton kai men akoloutheis tis epithumies ekeinon pou de gnorizoun.

Oi opoioi (autoi pou de gnorizoun) de tha mporesoun na se prostateusoun se tipote enantia sten timoria tou Allakh (an tha akoloutheseis tis epithumies tous). Pragmati, oi adikoi einai oi uposteriktes o enas tou allou (enantia stous pistous), eno o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes ton eusebon (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou terontas tis entoles Tou).
Auto (to Kor'an) einai mia xekathare apodeixe gia tous anthropous (gia na doun ten aletheia), kai mia kathodegese kai ena eleos, gia tous anthropous pou pisteuoun me bebaioteta.

E nomizoun ekeinoi pou diaprattoun kakes praxeis oti tha tous kanoume isous m' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, kata te zoe tous (sten egkosmia zoe) kai meta ton thanato tous (ste Mellousa Zoe); Poso athlio einai auto pou krinoun!
O Allakh demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge me ten aletheia, kai gia na labei e kathe psukhe (eite antamoibe, eite timoria) gia osa ekane, kai de tha adikethoun!

Eides (o, Prophete) auton pou pere ten epithumia tou os theo tou (kai etsi akolouthei opoia threskeia thelei base tes epithumias tou, khoris na akolouthesei ten kathodegese tou Allakh kai tis apodeixeis pou tis esteile), kai o Allakh ton ekane na parastratesei en gnose Tou (epeide xerei ede oti autos to axizei kai oti de tha pistepsei akoma kai an dei kathe apodeixe), sphragise ten akoe kai ten kardia tou, kai ebale pano sten orase tou ena kalumma; Poios loipon mporei na ton kathodegesei aphou ton ekane o Allakh na parastratesei; De tha labete loipon mia nouthesia;

Lene (oi apistoi): <<Den uparkhei (alle zoe) para mono e egkosmia zoe mas: pethainoume kai zoume (e mia genia meta apo ten alle), kai tipota de mas kanei na pethanoume ektos apo to perasma tou khronou.>> Den ekhoun gnose (kai apodeixe) gi' auto (pou lene oti de tha uparkhei anastase). Pragmati, autoi mono kanoun eikasies.
Otan tous apaggellontai ta saphe Edaphia Mas, den ekhoun kanena epikheirema para to na poun: <<Pherte piso tous progonous mas, an eiste eilikrineis (oti tha uparkhei anastase).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<O Allakh einai Autos pou sas dinei zoe, epeita aphairei te zoe sas, kai epeita tha sas sugkentrosei kata ten Emera tes Anastases, gia ten opoia den uparkhei kamia amphibolia, alla oi perissoteroi anthropoi de gnorizoun.>>
Ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges. Ten Emera pou tha erthei e Ora, tote oi anthropoi tes planes tha einai se apolute apotukhia.

Tha deis (o, Prophete, ekeine ten Emera) kathe ethnos gonatismeno (perimenontas ti tha ginei s' auto). Kathe ethnos tha klethei pros to biblio (ton praxeon) tou, (kai tha eipothei): <<Semera tha labete (eite antamoibe, eite timoria) gia o,ti kanate.
Auto einai to biblio Mas (sto opoio kategrapsan oi Aggeloi-grapheis tis praxeis sas), to opoio leei se sas ten aletheia. Pragmati, Emeis katagrapsame ola osa kanate.>>
Oso gi' autous pou pistepsan kai ekanan enaretes praxeis, o Kurios tous tha tous eisagei sto eleos Tou. Pragmati, aute einai e xekathare epitukhia.
Alla oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Den apaggellontan ta Edaphia Mou se sas, alla eseis deixate alazoneia kai esastan kakoi anthropoi;

Kai opote eipotheke (se sas): <<Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine kai den uparkhei amphibolia gia ten Ora>>, eipate: <<Den xeroume ti einai e Ora. Den nomizoume (gia ton erkhomo tes) oti einai kati allo para mono mia eikasia, kai den eimaste sigouroi (oti tha ginei).>>.>>
Tha tous phanerothoun oi kakes sunepeies oson diepraxan, kai tha tous perikuklosei auto (to marturio) pou sunethizan na khleuazoun.

Tha eipothei: <<Semera tha sas aphesoume (ste Photia) opos eseis adiaphorousate gia te sunantese autes tes Emeras (tou apologismou) sas. E katoikia sas tha einai e Photia, kai de tha ekhete uposteriktes.

Auto (to marturio einai) epeide perate ta Edaphia tou Allakh os koroidia kai sas exapatese e egkosmia zoe (me tis apolauseis tes).>> Semera de tha bgoun ap' aute (ten Kolase), oute tha tous epitrapei na epistrepsoun sten egkosmia zoe gia na anazetesoun ten eukharistese tou Allakh meso metameleias kai upakoes!
Olos o epainos anekei ston Allakh, ton Kurio ton ouranon, ton Kurio tes ges kai ton Kurio olon ton kosmon.
S' Auton anekei ole e Doxa kai e Megaleioteta stous ouranous kai te ge. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kh, M [Kha-Meim, duo xekhorista arabika grammata pou de sunthetoun kamia lexe, alla ekhoun semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tous. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio].
Aute einai e apokalupse tou Bibliou apo ton Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-Khakeim (Pansopho).

Pragmati, de demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te ge kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous para mono me ten aletheia kai gia enan kathorismeno khrono. Omos autoi pou arnethekan ten piste apomakrunontai, adiaphorontas gi' auto gia to opoio eikhan proeidopoiethei.

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Blepete autous (tous pseutikous theous) pou tous epikaleiste (kai tous latreuete) ektos apo ton Allakh; Deixte mou, ti ekhoun demiourgesei ste ge, e an ekhoun ena meridio ste demiourgia ton ouranon! Pherte mou ena biblio pou na apokaluphtheke prin ap' auto, e kapoia gnose pou emeine apo prin (apo kapoion Prophete, e opoia na uposterizei tous iskhurismous sas), an eiste pragmati eilikrineis!>>

Poios einai pio parastratemenos ap' auton pou epikaleitai ektos apo ton Allakh ekeinous (tous pseutikous theous) pou de tha antapokrithoun s' auton mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases! Kai autoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) de gnorizoun kan tis epikleseis tous (epeide oute akoun, oute katanooun)!
(Ten Emera tes Kriseos) otan tha sugkentrothoun oi anthropoi, (oi pseutikoi theoi) tha einai ekhthroi s' autous (pou tous epikalestekan), kai tha aparnethoun te latreia tous.
Otan apaggellontai s' autous (tous apistous) ta Edaphia Mas xekathara, autoi pou arnethekan ten piste lene gia ten aletheia (to Kor'an) otan tous erthe: <<Aute einai xekathare mageia!>>

E lene: <<(O Mokhammant) to ekhei epinoesei (to Kor'an kai iskhurizetai oti einai apo ton Allakh)>>! Pes: <<An to eikha epinoesei, de tha mporousate na me prostatepsete se tipota apo ton Allakh. Autos gnorizei kalutera auto pou lete pseudos gi' auto (to Kor'an). Eparkei o Allakh os Marturas anamesa se mena kai se sas. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Den eimai o protos Aggeliaphoros (gia na sas phanei periergo to kalesma mou pros esas), oute xero ti tha sumbei se mena e se sas (sto mellon sten egkosmia zoe). Den akoloutho para mono o,ti mou apokaluptetai, kai den eimai para enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me xekatharo tropo.>>

Pes (o, Prophete): <<Peite mou, an (iskhuei auto pou sas plerophoresa, oti) auto to (Kor'an) einai apo ton Allakh, alla eseis to arnethekate, parolo pou enas marturas apo ta paidia tou Israel (o rabinos Ampnt Allakh mpin Sallam) edose marturia gi' auto (gia tis perigraphes mou sten Tora) kai etsi autos pistepse (sto Islam), alla eseis deixate alazoneia, (tote de tha eiste adikoi kai paraplanemenoi); Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei tous adikous anthropous.>>

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste eipan s' autous pou pistepsan: <<An aute (e threskeia -to Islam-) etan kale, tote de tha espeudan prin apo mas (oi adunamoi kai oi phtokhoi) sto na pistepsoun s' aute.>> Tora aphou den kathodegethekan meso autou (tou Kor'an), tha poun: <<Auto einai palies pseutikes istories (pou epinoesan oi arkhaioi).>>

Prin ap' auto (to Kor'an), staltheke to Biblio tou Mouse (e Tora) os odegos kai eleos. Auto to Biblio (to Kor'an) epibebaionei (ta proegoumena Theia Biblia), to opoio staltheke sten arabike glossa, prokeimenou na proeidopoiesei ekeinous pou adikoun kai na dosei kharmosuna nea s' ekeinous pou prattoun to kalo.

Pragmati, oso gi' autous pou lene: <<O Kurios mas einai o Allakh>>, epeita menoun statheroi (sten piste kai stis kales praxeis), de tha uparkhei phobos gi' autous (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ten Emera tes Kriseos), oute tha lupethoun (gia otidepote paramelesan apo tis egkosmies apolauseis).
Ekeinoi tha einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou, opou tha meinoun ekei gia panta, os antamoibe gia o,ti ekanan.

Pragmati, diataxame ton anthropo na pheretai kallista stous goneis tou. E metera tou ton koubalouse (ste metra tes) me duskhereies, kai ton gennese me duskhereies. E diarkeia tes egkumosunes kai tou apogalaktismou tou einai trianta menes. Otan phtasei sten elikia tes plerous dunames kai phtasei ta saranta ete, leei: <<Kurie mou! Enepneuse me na eimai eugnomon gia ten Eunoia Sou, pou ten enapotheses se mena kai stous goneis mou, kai na pratto kales praxeis pou tis dekhesai, kai kane tous apogonous mou kalous anthropous. Ekho straphei pros Esena me metameleia, kai eimai enas apo tous Mousoulmanous (upotagmenous ste Boulese Sou).>>

Ekeinoi einai autoi apo tous opoious tha dekhthoume tis kales praxeis pou eprattan kai tha sugkhoresoume tis kakes praxeis tous. Tha einai anamesa stous katoikous tou Paradeisou. Mia alethine uposkhese pou tous dotheke.

Oso gi' ekeinon pou eipe stous goneis tou: <<Ouphph (kako) gia sas! Mou uposkheste oti tha anastetho (gia apologismo), parolo pou ekhoun perasei polles genies prin apo mena (kai kaneis den anastetheke);>> Oi goneis tou epikalestekan ton Allakh gia boetheia (na kathodegesei ton uio tous, kai epeita eipan):<<Alimono sou (tha katastrapheis an de tha pistepseis)! Pistepse! Pragmati, e uposkhese tou Allakh einai alethine.>> Alla autos eipe: <<Auto den einai para muthoi ton arkhaion.>>

Tetoioi (apistoi kai anupakouoi pros tous goneis tous) einai autoi gia tous opoious o Logos (Mou me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana, oti tha gemiso ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun) egine anapopheuktos (del. e timoria egine anapopheukte), opos egine kai gia ta (apista) ethne apo ta Tzinn kai tous anthropous pou perasan prin ap' autous. Pragmati, etan khamenoi.

Gia kathemia omada (piston kai apiston) tha uparkhoun epipeda sumphona me o,ti ekanan [anionta epipeda ston Paradeiso gia tous pistous, kai kationta epipeda sten Kolase gia tous apistous], gia na dosei (o Allakh) pleros s' autous (eite antamoibe, eite timoria) gia tis praxeis tous, kai de tha adikethoun.

Ten Emera pou oi apistoi tha ektethoun ste Photia, (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Exantlesate to meridio sas apo ta kala agatha sten egkosmia zoe kai ta apolausate. Semera tha labete to tapeinotiko marturio gia o,ti alazoneia deixate ste ge adika, kai gia osa parakousate (apo tis entoles tou Allakh).

Anaphere (o, Mokhammant), (ton Prophete Khount) ton adelpho tes phules 'Ant, otan proeidopoiese ton lao tou stous Al-Akhkaph (tous pselous ammolophous opou etan ta spitia tous) - kai pragmati, erthan proeidopoietes prin kai meta ap' auton - (legontas): <<Me latreuete kanenan para mono ton Allakh. Pragmati, phobamai gia sas apo to marturio mias megales Emeras.>>
Eipan (oi apistoi ston Khount): <<Erthes se mas gia na mas apomakruneis apo tous theous mas; Phere mas loipon aute (ten timoria) pou mas apeileis, an eisai apo tous eilikrineis.>>
Eipe (o Khount): <<Te gnose (gia to pote tha erthei e timoria) ten katekhei mono o Allakh. Mono metaphero se sas auto (to Menuma) me to opoio staltheka, alla blepo oti eiste anthropoi me agnoia.>>

Otan ten eidan (ten timoria) san pukna sunnepha pou erkhontai pros tis koilades tous, eipan: <<Auta einai sunnepha pou tha mas pheroun brokhe.>> (O Khount eipe): <<Okhi, alla auto einai pou zetesate anupomona (os proklese) - einai enas anemos ston opoio uparkhei mia odunere timoria.
(O opoios anemos) tha katastrepsei ta panta me ten entole tou Kuriou tou.>> Etsi, epeita den emeine tipota orato ektos apo tis katoikies tous. Etsi timoroume tous kakous anthropous.

Pragmati, tous eikhame dosei tetoia duname pou de sas ekhoume dosei (o, phule Kourais), kai tous eikhame dosei akoe, orase kai kardies (alla ta khresimopoiesan sten anupakoe pros ton Allakh), etsi, oute e akoe tous, oute e orase tous, oute oi kardies tous den tous prostatepsan se tipote (apo ten timoria), epeide arnethekan (me alazoneia) ta Semadia tou Allakh. Etsi, tous perikuklose aute (e timoria) pou sunethizan na te khleuazoun.

Pragmati, ekhoume katastrepsei ekeines tis (apistes) komopoleis guro sas (o, Makkanoi), kai tous eikhame dosei diaphora Semadia, isos kai na epestrephan (apo ten apistia tous, kai na stephontan me metameleia kai upakoe pros ton Allakh).

Giati den tous uposterixan ekeinoi (oi pseutikoi theoi) pou tous peran os theous ektos apo ton Allakh (kai tous latrepsan) os meso eggutetas pros ton Allakh (iskhurizomenoi oti einai oi mesolabetes tous enopion tou Allakh); Okhi (den tous uposterixan), alla tous egkateleipsan! Auto (pou iskhuristekan) etan to psema tous kai o,ti epinoesan apo psemata.

(Anaphere, o, Prophete) otan kaname na erthei se sena mia omada apo ta Tzinn gia na akousei to Kor'an. Otan erthan gia na to akousoun, eipan: <<Akouste me prosokhe!>> Kai otan teleiose, epestrepsan ston lao tous gia na tous proeidopoiesoun (gia ten timoria tou Allakh).

Eipan (ta Tzinn): <<O, lae mas! Pragmati, akousame ena Biblio (to Kor'an) pou staltheke meta apo ton Mouse, to opoio epibebaionei o,ti staltheke prin ap' auto (apo Theia Biblia, ten Tora kai to In-tzel), kai kathodegei sten aletheia kai ston isio dromo.

O, lae mas! Antapokritheite (me upakoe) s' auton (ton Prophete) pou (sas) kalei pros ton Allakh, kai pistepste s' auton, oste (o Allakh) na sugkhoresei gia sas tis amarties sas kai na sas sosei apo ena epoduno marturio.

Alla opoios de tha antapokrithei (me upakoe) s' auton (ton Prophete) pou (sas) kalei pros ton Allakh, de tha mporesei na xephugei (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) ste ge, oute tha ekhei kanenan uposterikte enopion Tou. Ekeinoi briskontai se xekathare plane.>>

De blepoun (oi apistoi) oti o Allakh pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge, kai den etan duskolo gia Auton na tous demiourgesei (para to megalo megethos tous, kai kamia kopose den Ton aggixe ap' auto), einai Ikanos na dosei zoe stous nekrous; Bebaios, einai gia ta panta, Ikanos.

Ten Emera pou autoi pou arnethekan ten piste tha ektethoun ste Photia, (tha erotethoun): <<Den einai auto (to marturio) aletheia, (e einai psema opos iskhuristekate prin);>> Tha poun: <<Okhi (den einai psema), alla (orkizomaste) ma ton Kurio mas (oti einai e aletheia)!>> Tha pei: <<Geuteite loipon to marturio gia o,ti arnethekate apo ten piste.>>

Na eisai, loipon, upomonetikos (o, Mokhammant, gia to kako kai te diapseuse pou lambaneis apo ton lao sou), opos etan oi Aggeliaphoroi tes iskhures bouleses kai upomones (o Noe, o Abraam, o Mouses, o Iesous kai esu, o, Mokhammant), kai me biasteis na zeteseis ten timoria gi' autous. Ten Emera pou tha doun auto (to marturio) pou tous ekhoume uposkhethei, tha aisthanontai san na men eikhan meinei (sten egkosmia zoe) para mono gia mia ora mias meras. (O, anthropoi! Auto to Kor'an) einai eparkes Menuma (gia na sotheite). Tha katastraphoun kapoioi alloi ektos apo tous anupakouous;
Osoi arnountai ten piste kai apotrepoun (tous anthropous) apo to dromo tou Allakh, (o Allakh) tha katastesei tis praxeis tous mataies.

Oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun, prattoun enaretes praxeis kai pisteuoun se o,ti staltheke ston Mokhammant, -to opoio einai e aletheia apo ton Kurio tous-, (o Allakh) tha sugkhoresei tis amarties tous kai tha beltiosei ten katastase tous.

Auto epeide autoi pou arnethekan ten piste akolouthoun ten plane, eno autoi pou pisteuoun akolouthoun ten aletheia apo ton Kurio tous. Etsi parousiazei o Allakh gia tous anthropous tis paromoioseis (kai tis sugkriseis) tous.

(O, pistoi) otan sunantate tous apistous (polemistes ste makhe), khtupeste tous laimous (tous), ospou otan tous apodunamosete kai tous upotaxete, deste tote tous aikhmalotous (gia na me sas skotosoun kai na me drapeteusoun). Epeita, (mporeite na tous apeleutherosete) eite os khare (khoris lutra), eite me lutra. (Sunekhiste na tous polemate kai na tous aikhmalotizete) mekhri na teleiosei o polemos. Aute einai (e entole tou Allakh), kai an o Allakh ethele, tha mporouse na tous upoballei se timoria (kai de tha khreiazotan na tous polemesete), alla (sas dietaxe na agonisteite enantion tous) gia na dokimasei kapoious apo sas meso ton allon. Osoi agonizontai (-e skotonontai-) ston dromo tou Allakh, (o Allakh) de tha aphesei tis praxeis tous na khathoun.
Tha tous kathodegesei kai tha beltiosei ten katastase tous,
kai tha tous eisagei ston Paradeiso, tou opoiou tis perigraphes tis ekane (o Allakh) gnostes s' autous (sten egkosmia zoe).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! An uposterixete te threskeia (kai ton Aggeliaphoro) tou Allakh, (o Allakh) tha sas uposterixei kai tha statheropoiesei (kai tha dunamosei) ta podia sas (kata te makhe).
Oso gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste, as einai e katastrophe kai e atimose s' autous, kai (o Allakh) tha katastesei tis praxeis tous mataies.
Auto epeide apekhthanontai auto pou esteile o Allakh, etsi tha katastesei (o Allakh) tis praxeis tous mataies.

Den taxidepsan (oi apistoi) ste ge gia na doun pos etan to telos ekeinon (ton apiston) pou etan prin ap' autous; O Allakh tous katestrepse, kai gia tous apistous (se kathe topo kai epokhe) tha uparkhoun paromoies (timories).
Auto epeide o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes ekeinon pou pisteuoun, eno gia tous apistous den uparkhei kanenas uposteriktes!

Pragmati, o Allakh tha eisagei, autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, se kepous, kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste, apolambanoun (sten egkosmia zoe akolouthontas tous pothous tous) kai trone opos trone ta booeide, alla (ste Mellousa Zoe) e Photia tha einai e katoikia tous.
Poses (apistes) komopoleis tis katastrepsame, -oi opoies etan pio dunates apo ten komopole sou (o, Prophete) pou se edioxe-, kai den eikhan kanenan uposterikte!
Einai autoi pou ekhoun xekathares apodeixeis apo ton Kurio tous, isoi m' ekeinous ton opoion oi kakes praxeis oraiopoiethekan sta matia tous, kai oi opoioi akolouthoun tis epithumies tous;

E perigraphe tou Paradeisou pou ekhei uposkhethei stous enaretous (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou terontas tis entoles Tou), einai oti: ekhei potamia apo nero pou den allazei (e osme e e geuse tou logo tes parodou tou khronou), potamia apo gala pou den allazei e geuse tou (epeide de bgainei apo armegma kanenos zoou), potamia apo krasi pou einai nostimo gia osous to pinoun kai potamia apo agno meli apallagmeno apo kathe akatharsia. Tha ekhoun ekei kathe eidous karpon kai sugkhorese apo ton Kurio tous. (Tha einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou) isoi m' ekeinous pou tha meinoun ste Photia gia panta, kai tha tous dothei na pioun zematisto nero pou tha skhizei ta entera tous;

Metaxu auton (ton upokriton) uparkhoun ekeinoi pou se akoun (o, Prophete, alla me adiaphoria), ospou otan pheugoun apo te sugkentrose sou, lene s' autous (tous suntrophous sou) stous opoious dotheke e gnose: <<Ti eipe molis;>> Ekeinoi einai autoi pou o Allakh sphragise tis kardies tous, kai oi opoioi akolouthoun tis epithumies tous.
Oso gi' autous pou akolouthoun ten kathodegese, (o Allakh) tous auxanei sten kathodegese, kai tous kathodegei pros to na phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou (me to na teroun tis entoles Tou).

Perimenoun (oi apistoi) loipon kati allo para na tous erthei e Ora xaphnika; Pragmati, erthan ede (kapoia apo) ta Semadia tes. Pos loipon tha laboun nouthesia (kai tha straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh) otan tha tous erthei (e Ora); [Aphou tote e metameleia de tha ophelesei kanenan]!

Mathe, loipon, (o, Prophete) oti den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh, kai zeta sugkhorese gia tis amarties sou, kai gia (tis amarties) ton piston, andron kai gunaikon. Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei tis kineseis sas (kata ten emera) kai ton topo anapauses kai egkatastases sas (kata te nukhta), [del. oles tis katastaseis sas].

Ekeinoi pou pisteuoun lene: <<Makari na stalei ena Kephalaio (pou na mas epitrepei na antimetopizoume tous diogmous ton apiston kai na agonizomaste enantion tous)! Alla otan tha stalei ena Kephalaio me xekathares oristikes semasies kai anapheretai s' auto e makhe, tha deis (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou ekhoun stis kardies tous ten arrostia (tes upokrisias kai tes amphibolias) na se koitazoun san kapoion pou lipothumese apo to phobo tou apo to thanato. Alimono s' autous!

(Tha etan kalutera gi' autous to) na upakousoun kai na poun kala logia. Otan diatazetai e entole (kai tous epitrepetai na antimetopizoun tous diogmous ton apiston kai na agonizontai enantion tous), an tha einai eilikrineis sten piste tous pros ton Allakh (kai tha teloun ten entole Tou), tha einai kalutera gi' autous!

Ti allo tha kanate, an tha apomakrunosastan (apo to Kor'an kai tis entoles tou), para na skorpizate to kako ste ge (me apistia kai amarties) kai na apokoptate tous suggenikous sas desmous (opos kanate prin kata ten epokhe tes agnoias -tes pro-Islamikes epokhes-)!

Tetoioi (pou skorpizoun to kako ste ge) einai autoi pou tous katarasteke o Allakh, kai etsi tous ekane kophous (apo to na akoun ten aletheia) kai tuphlose ten orase tous (apo to na blepoun ten aletheia).
De sullogizontai to Kor'an e uparkhoun kleidaries stis kardies tous;

Oso gi' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou epestrepsan sten apistia aphou tous eikhe ginei saphes e kathodegese, o Satanas oraiopoiese sta matia tous ten apistia, kai (o Allakh) tous edose anabole gia ten timoria (oste na auxethoun sten upokrisia kai sten apistia kai na tous pherei stadiaka sten timoria apo ekei pou den ten perimenoun).

Auto epeide (autoi oi upokrites) eipan (krupha) s' autous (tous eidololatres) pou apekhthanontai auto pou esteile o Allakh (ston Mokhammant): <<Tha sas upakousoume se ena meros tou thematos (enantion tou Mokhammant kai tha apotharrunoume tous pistous apo to na polemesoun enantion sas).>> Alla o Allakh gnorizei ta mustika tous.
Pos tha einai autoi, otan oi Aggeloi tha tous aphairesoun tis psukhes khtupontas ta prosopa tous kai tis plates tous;
Auto epeide akolouthesan o,ti prokalese ten orge tou Allakh kai apekhthanontan (o,ti tha tous ekane) na laboun ten eukharistese Tou, etsi, katestese tis (kales) praxeis tous mataies.
Nomizoun autoi pou ekhoun stis kardies tous ten arrostia (tes upokrisias) oti o Allakh de tha apokalupsei ten kakia tous (pros tous pistous, kai de tha ten emphanisei meso dokimasion);

An thelame (o, Prophete), tha sou tous deikhname (tous upokrites), oste na tous anagnoriseis apo ta semadia tous. Kai tha tous anagnoriseis apo ton tropo pou miloun. Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei oles tis praxeis sas.

Pragmati, tha sas dokimasoume gia na xeroume (auto pou ede xeroume, del. na emphanistei se sas) autous pou agonizontai apo sas (ston dromo Mas) kai autous pou einai upomonetikoi (ste makhe), kai na emphanisoume tis katastaseis kai ta mustika sas (gia na emphanistoun autoi pou arnountai na agonistoun ston dromo tou Allakh, kai autoi pou den einai upomonetikoi ste makhe).

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnountai ten piste, apotrepoun tous anthropous apo ton dromo tou Allakh kai antitithentai ston Aggeliaphoro aphou tous ekhei ginei saphes e kathodegese, de tha blapsoun ton Allakh se tipote kai (o Allakh) tha katastesei tis praxeis tous mataies.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Upakouste ton Allakh kai upakouste ton Aggeliaphoro kai men kanete tis praxeis sas na ginoun mataies (me ten anupakoe).
Pragmati, autoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai empodisan tous anthropous apo ton dromo tou Allakh, kai epeita pethanan os apistoi, o Allakh de tha tous sugkhoresei pote!

Men eiste adunamoi (kai me phobaste na polemesete tous ekhthrous sas) kai men tous kaleite pros sumphiliose (prin autoi na sas kalesoun pros sumphiliose), eno pragmati eiste oi anoteroi (me ten uposterixe tou Allakh kai tha eiste sto telos oi niketes) kai o Allakh einai mazi sas (me ten uposterixe Tou). Kai den tha meiosei (o Allakh) tipote apo ten antamoibe ton praxeon sas.

Pragmati, e egkosmia zoe einai mono paikhnidi kai diaskedase. Alla an pisteuete kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), tha sas dosei tis antamoibes sas. Kai de zetaei apo sas (olo) ton plouto sas, (alla sas kalei na dosete ena mikro poso sten eleemosune kai sto dromo Tou).
An to zetouse (olo ton plouto sas) apo sas epimona kai sas exouthenone, tha tsigkouneuosastan kai (auto) tha apokalupte te dusareskeia sas (pros to na xodeuete sto dromo Tou).

Na, eseis kaleiste na xodepsete (ena mikro poso apo ton plouto sas) ston dromo tou Allakh, kai omos kapoioi apo sas tsigkouneuontai. Alla opoios tsigkouneuetai, tha einai mono eis baros tou. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), eno eseis (o, anthropoi) eiste oi phtokhoi. Ean tha apomakruntheite (apo ten piste), (o Allakh) tha sas antikatastesei me allous anthropous, kai de tha einai san esas, (alla tha einai upakouoi).>>
Pragmati, kriname gia sena (o, Prophete) mia xekathare nike (enantion ton apiston ekhthron sou),
gia na sugkhoresei o Allakh gia sena tis proegoumenes kai tis mellontikes amarties sou, na oloklerosei ten eunoia Tou se sena, na se kathodegesei ston isio dromo,
kai na se uposterixei o Allakh me mia dunate uposterixe (pou kaneis den mporei na ten apotrepsei).

Einai Autos pou esteile ten eremia stis kardies ton piston, gia na megalosei e piste tous perissotero mazi me ten uparkhousa piste tous. Ston Allakh Anekoun ta strateumata ton ouranon kai tes ges. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

(Kai kriname gia sena mia xekathare nike), gia na eisagei (o Allakh) tous pistous kai tis pistes se kepous, kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta, kai na sugkhoresei gi' autous tis amarties tous. Pragmati, auto einai, enopion tou Allakh, mia megale epitukhia.

Kai gia na timoresei (o Allakh) tous upokrites, andres kai gunaikes, kai tous eidololatres, andres kai gunaikes, pou ekhoun kakes eikasies gia ton Allakh (oti de tha uposterixei te threskeia Tou). Tha tous perikuklosei e katastrophe kai e timoria. E Orge tou Allakh einai pano tous kai (o Allakh) tous katarasteke kai ekhei etoimase gi' autous ten Kolase. Ti athlios proorismos einai autos!
Ston Allakh anekoun ta strateumata ton ouranon kai tes ges. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
Pragmati, se steilame (o, Prophete) os martura, phorea kharmosunon eideseon kai proeidopoiete,
gia na pistepsete ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, na ton uposterixete (ton Aggeliaphoro) kai na ton sebeste, kai gia na Ton doxazete (ton Allakh) proi kai bradu.

Pragmati, autoi pou sou dinoun (o, Prophete) orko aphosioses [sten periokhe Al-Khountaimpegia, oti tha se uposterixoun kai oti de tha phugoun kata te makhe enantion ton apiston tes Makkas pou kratesan os aikhmaloto ton 'Outhman -ton aggeliaphoro pou esteiles pros autous-], ontos (meso autou tou orkou) dinoun orko aphosioses kai pros ton Allakh. To Kheri tou Allakh einai pano apo ta kheria tous.
