Opoios omos athetesei ton orko tou, tha einai mono eis baros tou, alla opoios ekplerosei te desmeuse tou pros ton Allakh, (o Allakh) tha tou dosei megale antamoibe.

Ekeinoi oi bedouinoi pou emeinan piso (kai den pegan mazi sou, o, Prophete, pros te Makka gia proskunema, gia na me se uposterixoun enantion ton apiston ste Makka) tha sou poun: <<Mas apaskholesan o ploutos kai oi oikogeneies mas, gi' auto zeta sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) gia mas.>> Lene me te glossa tous auto pou den uparkhei sten kardia tous (oti theloun na straphoun me metameleia pros ton Allakh). Pes: <<Poios mporei na empodisei apo ton Allakh otidepote gia sas, an thelei na sas blapsei e an thelei na sas ophelesei;>> Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou nomizete, o, upokrites, oti o Allakh de gnorizei ten upokrisia sas), alla pragmati, o Allakh einai gia o,ti kanete, Pantognostes.

Okhi (den iskhuei e dikaiologia sas), alla pragmati, nomizate oti de tha epestrephan o Aggeliaphoros kai oi pistoi pote stis oikogeneies tous (kai oti oi apistoi ste Makka tha tous katestrephan), kai (o Satanas) oraiopoiese auto stis kardies sas, kai eikhate kakes eikasies (oti o Allakh de tha uposterize ton Aggeliaphoro Tou), kai esastan katastramenoi anthropoi (pou den esastan katalleloi gia tipota kalo).
Oso gia opoion den pisteuei ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, pragmati, ekhoume proetoimasei gia tous apistous mia phlegomene Photia.

Ston Allakh anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges. Sugkhorei opoion thelei (me te gennaiodoria Tou) kai timorei opoion thelei (me te dikaiosune Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Ekeinoi oi (proanapheromenoi) bedouinoi pou emeinan piso, tha poun otan tha prokhorate pros (te makhe tes Khaimper kai gia) na parete ta laphura: <<Apheste mas na sas akolouthesoume (gia te makhe kai ta laphura).>> Theloun (m' auto) na allaxoun ta Logia tou Allakh (oti ta laphura tes Khaimper tha ta paroun mono ekeinoi pou edosan orko aphosioses sten Al-Khountaimpegia). Pes: <<De tha mas akolouthesete. Etsi eipe o Allakh prin (na epistrepsoume ste Mantina).>> Tha poun: <<De (mas empodizete apo to na erthoume mazi sas epeide einai e entole tou Allakh), alla apo phthono (oste na me paroume laphura).>> Okhi (den iskhuei auto), alla den katalabainoun para mono ligo.

Pes (o, Prophete) stous (proanapheromenous) Bedouinous pou emeinan piso: <<Tha kletheite se makhe enantion anthropon megales dunames, tha tous polemesete e tha upotakhthoun. Tote, an upakousete, o Allakh tha sas dosei mia kale antamoibe, alla an apomakruntheite opos apomakrunthekate prin, tha sas timoresei me mia odunere timoria.

Den uparkhei kati to mempto ston tuphlo, oute ston kouto, oute ston arrosto (an de bgainei gia te makhe). Opoios upakouei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, tha ton eisagei se kepous kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Opoios omos apomakrunthei, tha ton timoresei me ena odunero marturio.

Pragmati, o Allakh enapothese ten euarestese Tou stous pistous otan sou edosan (o, Prophete) orko aphosioses kato apo to dentro (sten Al-Khountaimpegia). Gnorize ti uperkhe stis kardies tous, kai etsi, esteile ten eremia s' autous. Kai tha tous antameipsei me mia epikeimene nike (pou tha ginei ste makhe tes Khaimper),
kai me aphthona laphura pou tha ta paroun. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Azeiz (Aniketos, Pantodunamos) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

O Allakh sas uposkhetheke aphthona laphura pou tha ta parete, kai epespeuse gia sas aute (te nike kai ta laphura ste makhe tes Khaimper), kai empodise ta kheria ton anthropon (ton Ebraion tes Mantinas) apo sas (apo to na blapsoun ta paidia kai ta spitia sas aphou phugate apo te Mantina pros te Makka gia proskunema), oste na einai ena semadi gia tous pistous (gia ten uposterixe tou Allakh) kai gia na sas kathodegesei ston isio dromo.

Kai (sas uposkhetai kai) alle (nike se alles poleis), gia ten opoia den eikhate te duname na ten petukhete, alla o Allakh ten periballei me te Duname kai te Gnose Tou (gnorizontas ede oti tha ten petukhete). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta, Ikanos.
An oi apistoi (tes Makkas) sas polemousan (sten Al-Khountaimpegia), pragmati tha gurizan ten plate tous (gia phuge), epeita de tha ebriskan kanenan prostate, oute kanenan uposterikte.
Autos einai o epanalambanomenos kanonas tou Allakh pou perase prin (sta proegoumena ethne). De tha breis (o, Prophete) ston epanalambanomeno kanona tou Allakh kamia allage!

Einai Autos pou empodise ta kheria tous apo esas (otan erthe mia omada apiston na epitethoun se sas) konta ste Makka kai (empodise) ta kheria sas ap' autous meta pou sas ekane na tous nikesete (kai na tous piasete aikhmalotous kai epeita tous apeleutherosate). Pragmati, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

Ekeinoi (oi apistoi apo te Makka) einai autoi pou arnethekan ten piste, sas empodisan apo to Iero Tzami kai empodisan ta zoa thusias apo to na phtasoun ston topo thusias tous. An den uperkhan (anamesa tous ste Makka, adunamoi) pistoi, antres kai gunaikes, pou (ekrupsan ten piste tous, tous opoious) den tous xerate kai tha mporousate na tous plettate -phernontas etsi logo auton enokhes en agnoia sas-, (tha sas eikhame dosei ten adeia na mpeite ste Makka os niketes). (Alla dinoume anabole sten timoria ton apiston) gia na eisagei o Allakh sto eleos Tou opoious thelei (opos tous adunamous pistous ste Makka, kai ekeinous tous apistous pou tha eiselthoun sto Islam prin mpeite ste Makka). An eikhan diakhoristei (oi adunamoi pistoi apo tous apistous), tha eikhame timoresei (meso esas) autous pou arnethekan ten piste me mia odunere timoria.

Otan autoi pou arnethekan ten piste ebalan stis kardies tous uperopsia- ten uperopsia tes epokhes tes agnoias (tes pro-islamikes epokhes)- (kai etsi kata te sunapse tes sumphonias anakokhes me ton Prophete, arnethekan na tou epitrepsoun na mpei ste Makka gia proskunema ekeine te khronia -alla tha mporouse ten epomene-, kai arnethekan na graphtei to Onoma tou Allakh os <<Ar-Rakhman>>, kai arnethekan na graphtei to onoma tou Prophete os <<o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh>>), tote o Allakh esteile ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai stous pistous eremia kai galene ap' Auton, kai tous ekane na parameinoun ston Logo tes eusebeias (oti: den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon o Allakh), giati (oi pistoi) etan autoi pou axizan auto (ton Logo, kai okhi oi apistoi) kai etan oi anthropoi autou (tou Logou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Pantognostes.

Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei deixei sto oneiro tou Aggeliaphorou Tou ten aletheia: oti pragmati tha mpeite sto Iero Tzami asphaleis (apo ton ekhthro sas), me to thelema tou Allakh, kai tha ekhete xurisei ta kephalia sas e tha ekhete kopsei ta mallia sas (meta to proskunema ekei), khoris kanena phobo. (O Allakh) exere auto pou den xerate (oti anamesa stous apistous ste Makka uperkhan adunamoi pistoi pou ekruban ten piste tous kai oti to ophelos sas etan to na ginei e sumphonia anakokhes). Etsi, tha sas parakhoresei prin ap' auto (del. prin mpeite ste Makka), mia epikeimene nike (pou tha ginei ste makhe tes Khaimper).
Einai Autos pou esteile ton Aggeliaphoro Tou me ten kathodegese kai te threskeia tes aletheias, gia na ten kanei na epikratesei pano apo oles tis alles threskeies, kai eparkei o Allakh os Marturas.

O Mokhammant einai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh. Kai autoi pou einai mazi tou einai dunatoi enantia stous (polemistes) apistous, kai einai eleemones metaxu tous. Tous blepeis na upoklinontai kai na pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos sten proseukhe), anazetontas khare apo ton Allakh kai ten euarestese Tou. To semadi tous einai sta prosopa tous logo tes Sitzount stases, kai aute einai e perigraphe tous sten Tora. Oso gia ten perigraphe tous sto In-tzel, einai san ena phuto pou ebgale ta kladia tou, ta opoia to endunamosan, kai etsi (to phuto) megalose kai statheke kala ston kormo tou, kai etsi arese stous kalliergetes (gia ten omorphia tou). (O Allakh ekane ton Prophete kai tous suntrophous tou m' aute ten perigraphe) gia na enokhlei m' autous, ekeinous tous apistous. O Allakh ekhei uposkhethei s' autous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, mia sugkhorese kai mia spoudaia antamoibe.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men epispeudete sto na apophasisete kati (ste threskeia e stis makhes sas) prin krithei apo ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai 'Aleim (Pantognostes).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men upsonete tis phones sas pano apo te phone tou Prophete, oute na tou milate me upsele phone opos milate dunata o enas ston allon (oute na ton kaleite me to onoma tou <<o, Mokhammant>>, opos kalei o enas sas ton allon, alla apokaleste ton <<o, Aggeliaphore tou Allakh>>), oste na me ginoun oi kales praxeis sas mataies, khoris na to katalabete.

Pragmati, autoi pou khamelonoun tis phones tous kata ten parousia tou Aggeliaphorou tou Allakh, einai ekeinoi ton opoion tis kardies ekhei dokimasei o Allakh kai tis ekhei epilexei gia ten eusebeia (gia na phulassontai apo ten timoria Tou, terontas tis entoles Tou). Gi' autous uparkhei sugkhorese kai mia megale antamoibe.
Pragmati, autoi (oi bedouinoi) pou se kaloun (me to onoma sou me upsele phone) apo ten piso pleura ton domation sou (opou zoun oi suzugoi sou), oi perissoteroi ex auton den katanooun.
An perimenan mekhri na bgeis gi' autous, tha etan kalutera gi' autous. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Ean enas amartolos (pseutes) erthei se sas me mia eidese (skhetika me kapoious anthropous), epibebaiotheite an einai soste, oste na me blapsete kapoious anthropous apo agnoia, kai etsi, na metaniosete gi' auto pou kanate.

Na xerete oti o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh einai anamesa sas (gi' auto timeste ton, upakouste ton kai men peite psemata enopion tou, giati tha mathei ten aletheia me ten apokalupse). An egkrinei polla ap' auta pou proteinete, pragmati tha upopherete (epeide mporei na epilexete apo agnoia auto pou tha sas blapsei). Alla o Allakh sas ekane na agapesete ten piste kai ten ekane eukhariste stis kardies sas, kai ekane misete gia sas: ten apistia, ten parekklise apo ten upakoe (pros Auton) kai ten anupakoe (pros Auton). Tetoioi einai oi ortha kathodegoumenoi.
Aute einai mia khare kai mia eunoia apo ton Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

An duo omades piston makhontai, sumphilioste tous, alla an mia ap' autes epitethei adika enantion tes alles (kai arnethei te sumphiliose), polemeste auten pou epitithetai, mekhri na epistrepsei sten entole tou Allakh* epeita, an epistrepsei, sumphilioste tous me to dikaio. Kai na eiste dikaioi, pragmati, o Allakh agapa tous dikaious.
Pragmati, oi pistoi einai adelphia. Etsi, sumphilioste tous adelphous sas metaxu tous, kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), isos kai na eleetheite.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! As me khleuazoun kapoioi kapoious allous, isos (oi teleutaioi) na einai kaluteroi ap' ekeinous (tous protous), oute kapoies gunaikes (na khleuazoun) alles gunaikes, isos (oi teleutaies) na einai kaluteres ap' ekeines (tis protes), oute na milaei o enas piso apo ten plate tou allou me kati kako e gia kapoio elattoma tou, oute na apokaleite o enas ton allon me prosbletika pseudonuma. To kheirotero pseudonumo (kai kharakterismos) einai to <<anupakouos>> (pou to axizei autos pou kanei ta proanapheromena) aphou ekhei ginei pistos! Opoios (de stamataei kai) de strephetai me metameleia pros ton Allakh, tetoioi einai oi adikoi.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Apophugete ten polle kakhupopsia (pou de basizetai se apodeixe)* pragmati, kapoies kakhupopsies einai amarties. Men kataskopeuete, oute na kakologeite o enas ton allon kata ten apousia tou. Tha arese se kapoion apo sas na phaei te sarka tou nekrou aderphou tou; Tha to misousate (kai etsi tha prepei na miseite to na kakologeite o enas ton allon kata ten apousia tou). Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Taouamp (Autos pou sugkhorei kai apodekhetai te metameleia) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, anthropoi! Pragmati, sas ekhoume plasei apo ena arseniko kai ena theluko, kai sas kaname se laous kai phules gia na gnoristeite metaxu sas (kai okhi na kataphronei o enas ton allon). Pragmati, o pio timemenos anamesa sas, enopion tou Allakh, einai o pio eusebes (pou phulassetai perissotero apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khampeir (Autos pou gnorizei pleros ta panta).

Oi bedouinoi (apo te phule Mpani Asant) eipan: <<Pistepsame.>> Pes (o, Prophete): <<Den pistepsate (akome), alla peite: <<Upotakhthekame (ste Boulese tou Allakh kai giname Mousoulmanoi)>>, giati e piste (kai e gnose ton kanonon tes, kai to alethino noema tes) den ekhei mpei akome stis kardies sas. Alla an upakoute ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, (o Allakh) de tha meiosei tipota apo ten antamoibe ton praxeon sas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>

Pragmati, oi pistoi einai ekeinoi pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, kai epeita den ekhoun amphibolies (sten piste tous), kai agonizontai me ton plouto kai ton eauto tous ston dromo tou Allakh. Ekeinoi einai oi eilikrineis (sten piste tous).
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Enemeronete ton Allakh gia ten piste sas, eno o Allakh gnorizei ola osa uparkhoun stous ouranous kai ola osa uparkhoun ste ge; Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Pantognostes.>>

To anapheroun os khare se sena (o, Prophete) oti aspastekan to Islam. Pes: <<Me mou to anapherete os khare se mena oti aspastekate to Islam. Okhi (den einai khare se mena), alla pragmati o Allakh einai Autos pou ekane khare se sas, oti sas kathodegese sten piste, an eiste pragmati eilikrineis.>>
Pragmati, o Allakh gnorizei ola ta aorata ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.

K [Kaph, ena arabiko gramma pou den apotelei edo mia lexe, alla ekhei semasia, kathos den uparkhei tipota sto Kor'an pou den ekhei semasia. Mono o Allakh gnorizei te semasia tou. Mporei na einai mia endeixe oti to Kor'an apoteleitai apo arabika grammata ta opoia xeroun kai miloun oi Arabes, kai etsi o Allakh tous prokalese kai prokalei opoiondepote allon pou amphiballei gia to Kor'an, na parousiasei opoiodepote paromoio biblio]. (Orkizomai) ma to endoxo Kor'an! (Oti sou steilame, o, Mokhammant, to Kor'an gia na proeidopoieseis tous anthropous gia ten anastase kai ton apologismo).

Okhi (de se diapseudoun, o, Mokhammant, epeide den xeroun ten eilikrineia sou), alla (epeide) tous phaneke periergo oti tous erthe enas proeidopoietes apo anamesa tous (kai okhi apo tous Aggelous), etsi, lene oi apistoi: <<Auto einai kati periergo!
Einai dunaton oti otan tha pethanoume kai tha ginoume skone, (tha anastethoume); Aute e epistrophe (ste zoe), apokleietai na ginei!

Pragmati, gnorizoume ti meionei e ge ap' autous (apo ta somata tous meta to thanato), kai ekhoume ena Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud) pou diaterei (ola auta, kai einai diateremeno apo opoiadepote allage e alloiose).

Okhi (den einai mono oti tous phaneke periergo oti tous erthe enas proeidopoietes apo anamesa tous), alla diepseusan ten aletheia (to Kor'an) otan tous erthe, kai etsi, briskontai se katastase sugkhuses (legontas gia ton Prophete mia phora oti einai magos kai ten alle oti einai poietes klp.).
Den koitazoun pros ton ourano pano tous, pos ton khtisame kai ton stolisame (me asteria), kai oti den ekhei rogmes;
Kai (de blepoun) te ge, pos ten aplosame (gia na mporoun na egkatastathoun), topothetesame s' aute stathera bouna kai kaname na phutrosoun s' auten kathe loges oraia phuta;
(Ta kaname auta) os Semadi meso tou opoiou na mporei na dei (te Duname tou Allakh) kai na labei nouthesia kai upenthumise, o kathe doulos pou strephetai me metameleia pros ton Allakh.
Kai steilame apo ton ourano eulogemeno nero, kai kaname m' auto na phutrosoun kepoi, sitera gia sugkomide,
kai pseles khourmadies me puknous karpous (o enas pano ston allo),
os agatha gia tous doulous Mas* kai m' auto (to nero) anazoogonoume mia nekre ge. Etsi tha einai e anastase.
Prin ap' autous (tous apistous ste Makka pou se diapseudoun, o, Prophete), diepseuse o laos tou Noe, oi anthropoi tou Pegadiou (Askhamp Ar-Rass), e phule Thamount,
e phule 'Ant, o Pharao, ta adelphia (del. o laos) tou Lot,

oi katoikoi tes komopoles ton strimmenon dentron (konta ste Madiam), kai o laos tou Toumpa', oloi autoi (oi proanapheromenoi) diepseusan tous Aggeliaphorous (tous), etsi egine anapopheukte e timoria gia ten opoia tous proeidopoiesame.

Mepos etan duskolo gia Mas e prote demiourgia (otan tous demiourgesame apo ten anuparxia, kai etsi na men mporoume na tous anastesoume apo tous taphous tous); Okhi (den ekhoun amphibolia oti Emeis emastan pou tous demiourgesame ten prote phora), alla briskontai se amphibolia kai sugkhuse gia ten kainouria demiourgia (meta to thanato)!
Pragmati, demiourgesame ton anthropo kai gnorizoume ti psithurizei o idios ston eauto tou, kai Eimaste pio konta s' auton apo te sphagitida phleba tou,

kai oi duo (Aggeloi-grapheis) lambanoun tis praxeis tou kai tis katagraphoun os epikheirema enantion tou), oi opoioi kathontai kai parakolouthoun sunekhos, o enas sta dexia (pou katagraphei tis kales praxeis) kai o allos sta aristera (pou katagraphei tis kakes praxeis).
Den propherei (o anthropos) kamia lexe, para na uparkhei enas (Aggelos) parateretes s' auton, pou einai paron (gia na ten katagrapsei).

E epithanatia katastase erthe (me tis duskolies tes ston anthropo kai ton kurieuei) me ten aletheia (kai tipote den mporei na ten apotrepsei). Auto einai pou prospathouses (o, anthrope) na apophugeis.
Kai (O Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga, ten Emera tes Kriseos), aute einai e Emera opou tha pragmatopoiethei e timoria gia ten opoia labane (oi anthropoi) proeidopoiese.
Kathe psukhe tha erthei me enan (Aggelo) odego, kai enan (Aggelo) martura (pou tha marturesei gia tis praxeis tes).

(Tha eipothei ston apisto): <<Pragmati, esoun se aprosexia gi' aute (ten Emera). Tora tha aphairesoume to peplo (tes aprosexias) sou (me ten timoria kai tis kakoukhies pou tha deis), etsi, e orase sou Semera tha einai dunate (kai tha deis auta gia ta opoia esoun aprosektos).>>
O (Aggelos-grapheas) suntrophos tou (pou tha marturesei gia tis praxeis tou) tha pei: <<Edo einai o,ti ekho (grammeno apo tis praxeis tou).>>
(O Allakh tha pei stous duo Aggelous pou ton epheran): <<Rixte sten Kolase kathe peismatare apisto.

O opoios empodise to kalo (kai parakratese ta dikaiomata ton allon, pou ta epebale o Allakh ston plouto tou), kai etan parabates, kai ampheballe (gia o,ti uposkhetheke o Allakh, kai gia o,ti proeidopoiese).
O opoios latreue enan allo (legomeno) theo mazi me ton Allakh. Etsi, rixte auton sto austero marturio.>>

O (diabolos) suntrophos tou tha pei: <<Kurie mas! Den emoun ego pou (ton paraplanesa kai) ton ekana parabate (sten apistia kai stis amarties), alla o idios etan se megale plane (makria apo ten aletheia).>>
O Allakh tha pei: <<Men diaphoneite metaxu sas enopion Mou, giati pragmati, sas eikha ede steilei ten proeidopoiese (sten egkosmia zoe meso ton Aggeliaphoron Mou).
Den allazei o Logos Mou (me ton opoio proeidopoiesa ton Satana, oti tha gemiso ten Kolase m' auton kai osous tha ton akolouthesoun), oute Eimai adikos pros tous doulous Mou.>>
Ten Emera pou tha poume sten Kolase: <<Gemises (me tous apistous);>> Tha pei (orgismene pros tous apistous kai zetontas na erthoun kai alloi): <<Uparkhoun kai alloi;>>

Kai o Paradeisos tha erthei konta pros tous eusebeis (pou phulakhthekan apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou), (se ena meros pou) den einai makria (ap' autous kai tha ton doun prin mpoun ekei).
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Auto einai gia to opoio labate uposkhese, to opoio tha einai gia kathenan pou strapheke me metameleia (pros ton Allakh) kai diaterese (tis entoles Tou).
O opoios phobotan ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) khoris na Ton eikhe dei (sten egkosmia zoe) kai erthe me aphosiomene kardia (pou strapheke me metameleia pros ton Allakh).
Mpeite s' auton (ton Paradeiso) me eirene kai asphaleia. Aute einai e Emera tes aionias zoes.>>
Tha ekhoun ekei o,ti epithumoun, kai Emeis ekhoume akoma perissotera.

Posa (apista) ethne prin ap' autous (tous apistous apo te Makka) ekhoume katastrepsei, ta opoia etan pio dunata ap' autous, kai etsi, periplanethekan kai ekhtisan ste ge (perissotero ap' autous). Uperkhe (gi' ekeina ta ethne) kapoia diaphuge (otan epese pano tous e timoria);
Pragmati, s' auto uparkhei mia nouthesia kai mia upenthumise gia opoion ekhei kardia (kai mualo) e akouei me prosokhe eno einai paron (del. den akouei me adiaphoria).
Pragmati, demiourgesame tous ouranous kai te ge, kai o,ti brisketai anamesa tous, se exi Emeres, kai kamia kopose de Mas aggixe.
Kane loipon upomone (o, Prophete) gia o,ti lene, kai doxaze ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton prin ten anatole (sten proseukhe Phatzr) kai prin apo te duse tou eliou (sten proseukhe 'Asr).
Kai doxaze Ton te nukhta (ste nukhterine proseukhe) kai meta tis proseukhes.
Akou (o, Prophete) ten Emera pou o kalon (o Aggelos Israphel) tha kalesei (phusontas to Keras -Salpigga-) apo ena kontino meros,
ten Emera pou tha akousoun ten krauge (tes Anastases) me ten aletheia. Aute einai e Emera tes Exodou (apo tous taphous).
Pragmati, Emeis eimaste pou dinoume zoe kai ten aphairoume, kai pros Emas tha einai o telikos proorismos.
Ten Emera pou e ge tha skhistei gi' autous kai tha bgoun (apo tous taphous tous) biastika. Aute e sugkentrose tous (apo tous taphous), tha einai kati polu eukolo gia Emas.
Emeis xeroume kalutera ti lene, kai de stalthekes (o, Prophete) gia na tous anagkaseis na pistepsoun. Dose loipon nouthesia kai upenthumise me to Kor'an se opoion phobatai ten proeidopoiese Mou.
(Orkizomai) ma autous (tous anemous) pou skorpizoun (te skone klp.)!
Kai (orkizomai) ma auta (ta sunnepha) pou koubaloun phortia nero!
Kai (orkizomai) ma auta (ta ploia) pou pleoun (ste thalassa) me eukolia!
Kai (orkizomai) ma autous (tous Aggelous) pou moirazoun (ta agatha, te brokhe kai tis khares klp.) sumphona me ten entole Mou.
Oti pragmati, auto pou sas uposkhetheka einai alethino,
kai oti o apologismos (kai e timoria kai e antamoibe) oposdepote tha ginei.
(Orkizomai) ma ton ourano me ten teleia demiourgia (kai ta monopatia)!

Oti pragmati, eseis (o, apistoi ste Makka) ekhete antikrouomena logia (skhetika me to Kor'an, kai etsi, mia phora lete oti einai mageia, alle oti einai poiese, kai alle oti einai thruloi ton arkhaion)!
Apomakrunetai ap' auto (to Kor'an), autos pou apomakruntheke (apo ten kathodegese kai ta Semadia Mas, kai diepseuse to Kor'an).
Kataramenoi na einai oi pseutes!
Oi opoioi einai autoi pou tous kurieuei e agnoia, (kai epimenoun sten plane), kai einai aprosektoi (gia ten aletheia).
Rotoun (koroideutika): <<Pote tha einai e Emera tou Apologismou;>>
Einai e Emera pou tha timorethoun sten Kolase.
(Tha eipothei): <<Geuteite ten timoria sas! Auto einai pou (os proklese) to zetesate anupomona.>>
Pragmati, oi eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh, terontas tis entoles Tou) tha briskontai se kepous kai peges (ston Paradeiso),
lambanontas o,ti tha tous parakhoresei o Kurios tous (apo antamoibe). Pragmati, prin ap' aute (ten antamoibe) eprattan kales praxeis (sten egkosmia zoe).
Kata te nukhta, koimontousan mono ligo (gia na telesoun te nukhterine proseukhe),
kai (sto teleutaio meros tes nukhtas) prin ten auge, zetousan sugkhorese,
kai sta ploute tous uperkhe meridio gi' auton pou zetaei (eleemosune) kai gia ton aporo.
Ste ge uparkhoun Semadia gi' autous pou pisteuoun me bebaioteta (oti o Allakh einai o Demiourgos ton panton).
Epises kai ston eauto sas (uparkhoun Semadia). Ma de blepete;
Kai ston ourano einai ta agatha sas [grammena] kai o,ti sas uposkhetheke (apo kalo e kako).
(Orkizomai) ma ton Kurio tou ouranou kai tes ges! Oti auto (pou sas uposkhetheka) einai alethino, opos (to gegonos) oti eseis milate.
Erthe se sena (o, Mokhammant) e istoria gia tous timemenous (Aggelous) episkeptes tou Abraam;
Otan pegan s' auton (ton Abraam, se anthropine morphe) kai eipan: <<Salam (Eirene)!>> Kai autos apantese: <<Salam! Eiste agnostoi anthropoi (pou de sas xeroume).>>
Meta pege ste gunaika tou kai ephere ena (pseto) megalo moskhari (nomizontas oti oi Aggeloi etan anthropoi).
Etsi, to ebale mprosta tous (alla autoi den ephagan), kai etsi eipe: <<De tha phate;>>
Tote eniose phobo ap' autous. Eipan: <<Me phobasai.>> Kai tou edosan kharmosuna nea gia ena agori (ton Isaak) pou tha ekhei polu gnose (ste threskeia).
E gunaika tou (e Sara otan akouse auta) erthe kai phonaxe (apo te khara tes), kai khtupese to prosopo tes (apo ten ekplexe) kai eipe: <<Eimai mia steira elikiomene gunaika!>>
Eipan: <<Etsi eipe o Kurios sou. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos), o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes).>>
Eipe: <<Poios einai loipon o skopos sas (gia ton opoio stalthekate), o, Apestalmenoi;>>
Eipan: <<Ekhoume stalei gia enan kako lao,
gia na steiloume s' autous petres apo pelo,
semademenes enopion tou Kuriou sou gia tous parabates.>>
Etsi, bgalame osous pistous etan mesa tes (komopoles),
alla de brekame mesa tes para mono ena spiti Mousoulmanon [to spiti tou Prophete Lot].
Kai aphesame mesa tes ena Semadi (tes timorias) gia osous phobountai ten odunere timoria (gia na men kanoun san ekeinous).
Kai ston Mouse (uparkhei ena Semadi gia osous phobountai ten odunere timoria), otan ton steilame ston Pharao me xekathares apodeixeis.
Alla ekeinos (o Pharao) apomakruntheke me tous uposteriktes tou kai eipe: <<(O Mouses) eite einai enas magos, eite einai enas trelos.>>
Etsi, arpaxame me ten timoria auton (ton Pharao) kai tous stratiotes tou, kai tous petaxame (kai tous pnixame) sto nero, eno etan axios katadikes.
Kai ste phule 'Ant (uparkhei ena Semadi gia osous phobountai ten odunere timoria), otan steilame s' autous enan (katastrophiko) agono anemo (pou den eikhe tipote kalo).
(O opoios anemos) den perase se kati khoris na to kanei san katestrammena ereipia.

Kai ste phule Thamount (uparkhei ena Semadi gia osous phobountai ten odunere timoria) otan eipotheke s' autous (aphou esphaxan ten kamela pou staltheke os Semadi): <<Apolauste (sta spitia sas gia treis meres) mekhri enan kathorismeno khrono (pou tha katastrapheite).>>
Kai parakousan me alazoneia ten entole tou Kuriou tous, kai etsi tous arpaxe e katastrophike timoria, eno koitousan.
Etsi, den mporesan na sekothoun (na xephugoun apo ten timoria), oute mporousan na uposterixoun ton eauto tous.
Kai (katastrepsame epises) ton lao tou Noe prin (ap' autous). Pragmati, etan anupakouoi anthropoi.
Khtisame tous ouranous me duname, kai pragmati, Emeis epekteinoume sunekhos ten aperantosune tous.
Kai te ge ten aplosame (kai ten proetoimasame gia na egkatastatheite). Poso exairetika ten aplosame (kai ten proetoimasame)!
Kai demiourgesame ta panta se zeugaria, isos na labete nouthesia.

(Pes, o, Prophete): <<Gi' auto, phugete (o, anthropoi) pros ton Allakh (pheugontas apo ten timoria Tou, pros to eleos kai ten antamoibe Tou, meso tes pistes kai tes upakoes). Pragmati, staltheka apo Auton pros esas, os enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia.
Kai me latreuete allo theo mazi me ton Allakh. Pragmati, staltheka pros esas apo Auton, os enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia.>>
Omoios, kanenas Aggeliaphoros den erthe s' autous (sta proegoumena apista ethne) pou etan prin ap' autous, khoris na poun: <<Autos eite einai enas magos, eite einai enas trelos!>>

Ton sunestesan auton (ton iskhurismo) o enas ston allo (del. sunestesan oi apistoi apo ta proegoumena ethne, stous apistous apo te phule Kourais na poun gia ton Prophete oti eite einai enas magos, eite einai enas trelos); Okhi (den to sunestesan), alla oi idioi (oi apistoi apo te Kourais) einai parabates.
Apomakrunsou loipon (o, Prophete) ap' autous (pou se diapseudoun), giati pragmati de tha kategoretheis (aphou metedoses to Menuma).
Kai dose nouthesia (kai upenthumise meso autou tou Kor'an), pragmati, e nouthesia (kai e upenthumise) ophelei tous pistous (kai ekeinous pou gnorizei o Allakh oti tha pistepsoun).
Den eplasa ta Tzinn kai tous anthropous, para mono gia na Me latreuoun.
Den anazeto ap' autous agatha (gia na ta parekhoun ston eauto tous e stous doulous Mou), oute anazeto na Mou parekhoun trophe (gia na ten parekhoun ston eauto tous e stous doulous Mou).
Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Ar-Razzak (Autos pou parekhei agatha stous doulous Tou), o Katokhos tes Dunames, kai o Al-Matein (Paniskhuros).

Pragmati, autoi pou adikoun (kai se diapseudoun, o, Mokhammant) tha ekhoun meridio timorias opos auto ton suntrophon tous (apo ta proegoumena apista ethne), opote as me Mou zetesoun na epispeuso ten timoria (prin ten kathorismene ora tes).
Alimono, loipon, s' autous pou arnethekan ten piste, apo ten timoria tes Emeras tous, gia ten opoia elaban proeidopoiese kai uposkhese.
(Orkizomai) ma to bouno!
Kai (orkizomai) ma to grammeno Biblio,
se aplomenes anoikhtes pergamenes!
Kai (orkizomai) ma ton Al-Mpait Al-Ma'mour (ton Oiko ston ourano, pou katoikeitai sunekheia apo proseukhetes, ston opoio mpainoun kathe mera ebdomenta khiliades Aggeloi)!
Kai (orkizomai) ma te stege pou einai upsomene psela (ton ourano)!
Kai (orkizomai) ma te phlegomene thalassa!
Oti e timoria tou Kuriou sou sigoura tha pesei (stous apistous),
kai tipote de tha ten apotrepsei.
Ten Emera pou o ouranos tha peristrephetai kai tha seistei polu,
kai ta bouna tha metakinethoun (apo tis theseis tous).
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun,
oi opoioi einai autoi pou diaskedazoun sten plane.
Ten Emera pou tha sprokhnontai biaia pros te Photia tes Kolases,
(kai tha eipothei s' autous): <<Aute einai e Photia pou diapseudate.
Einai auto (to marturio pou blepete) mageia e den to blepete;
Mpeite gia na kaeite mesa tes (Photias). Eite tha deixete upomone (sto marturio), eite okhi, einai to idio gia sas. Tha labete mono o,ti kanate.>>
Pragmati, oi enaretoi (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh terontas tis entoles Tou) tha einai se kepous kai eudaimonia,
apolambanontas o,ti tha tous dosei o Kurios tous, kai o Kurios tous tha tous prostatepsei apo to marturio tes Kolases.
(Tha eipothei s' autous): <<Phate kai pieite me anese gia o,ti kanate (apo enaretes praxeis).>>
Tha einai xaplomenoi se krebatia pou tha einai ola paratetagmena (kai kaneis de tha dosei ten plate tou ston allon), kai tha tous pantrepsoume me omorphes gunaikes me megala omorpha matia.

Oso gi' autous pou pisteuoun, ton opoion oi apogonoi, tous akolouthoun sten piste, tha kanoume tous apogonous tous na tous akolouthesoun (sten idia these ston Paradeiso, akome kai an oi praxeis, ton apogonon, den tous kanoun na phthasoun se tetoia these), kai khoris na meiosoume tipote apo ten antamoibe ton praxeon tous (ton progonon). Kathe anthropos einai desmios me o,ti ekane (kai kaneis de tha pherei ten amartia kapoiou allou).
Kai tha tous parekhoume phrouta kai kreas apo o,ti epithumoun.
Tha tous dothei mesa tou (Paradeisou) ena diskopotero (me agno krasi), pou de tha tous odegei, oute se mataia logia, oute se amarties, (se antithese me to krasi tes egkosmias zoes).
Tha peripherontai anamesa tous nearoi gia na tous uperetoun, oi opoioi tha moiazoun san na etan margaritaria prophulagmena (sta kokhulia tous).
Tha straphoun o enas ston allon rotontas (gia ten katastase tous otan etan sten egkosmia zoe).

Tha poun: <<Pragmati, prin ap' auto (sten egkosmia zoe) emastan anamesa stous anthropous mas, kai aisthanomastan phobo (gia ten timoria tou Allakh ste Mellousa Zoe, kai etsi apomakrunthekame apo tis amarties).
Etsi, o Allakh parakhorese se mas te khare Tou kai mas prostatepse apo to marturio tes Kolases.
Pragmati, (Ton latreuame kai) Ton epikaloumastan prin. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-Mparr (Agathoergos kai Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).>>
Dose loipon nouthesia kai upenthumise (o, Prophete). Pragmati, me te khare tou Kuriou sou (del. ten piste, te logike kai ten apostole sou os Prophete), den eisai oute mantes, oute trelos.
E lene (oi apistoi): <<(O Mokhammant) einai enas poietes, gia ton opoio perimenoume na tou erthei o thanatos e kapoio atukhema (kai etsi na xephortothoume to kalesma tou)>>;
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Perimenete loipon, pragmati, perimeno kai ego mazi sas (ten timoria pou tha pesei pano sas).>>
E tous diatazei to mualo tous (na poun) auto (oti eisai mantes kai trelos); E (to eipan epeide) oi idioi einai parabates;
E lene: <<(O Mokhammant) to ekhei epinoesei (to Kor'an)>>; Okhi (den to epinoese), alla autoi den pisteuoun.
As pheroun kapoia logia paromoia m' auto (to Kor'an), an einai eilikrineis!
E ekhoun demiourgethei khoris kanenan demiourgo, e oi idioi einai oi demiourgoi (pou demiourgesan ton eauto tous);
E demiourgesan tous ouranous kai te ge; Okhi (den tous demiourgesan), alla den ekhoun stathere piste.
E katekhoun tous thesaurophulakia tou Kuriou sou e ekhoun ton plere elegkho (ton panton);

E ekhoun mia skala (pros ton ourano) pano sten opoia kruphakoun (ten apokalupse, oti autoi oi idioi briskontai sten aletheia); Tote autos anamesa tous, pou kruphakouei, as pherei mia xekathare apodeixe.
E apodidete (pseudos) s' Auton oti ekhei kores (kai oti oi Aggeloi einai oi kores Tou, eno eseis oi idioi apekhthaneste na ekhete kores), kai epithumeite na ekhete agoria;
E tous zetas (o, Prophete) kapoia amoibe (gi' auto pou tous metadideis apo to Menuma tou Allakh), kai etsi einai epibarumenoi ap' auto pou zetas (kai gi' auto arnountai ten piste);
E katekhoun (te gnose gia) ta aorata (sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud), kai etsi graphoun (ap' auto ta epikheiremata tous);
E skhediazoun mia sunomosia (enantion sou, o, Prophete); Pragmati, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste tha einai autoi pou tha tous perikuklosei ena skhedio enantion tous.
E ekhoun allon enan theo (pou axizei na latreuetai) ektos apo ton Allakh; Doxa ston Allakh, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti etairous apodidoun pseudos s' Auton ste latreia.
An eblepan kommatia tou ouranou na pephtoun (s' autous os timoria), tha elegan: <<(Auta einai mono) sunnepha pou sussoreutekan to ena pano sto allo!>>
Aphese tous loipon (o, Prophete) mekhri na sunantesoun ten Emera tous, kata ten opoia tha katastraphoun.
Ten Emera kata ten opoia de tha tous prostatepsoun ta ponera skhedia tous se tipota, oute tha laboun kamia uposterixe.
Kai pragmati, gia tous adikous tha uparxei alle mia timoria prin ap' auto, alla oi perissoteroi ex auton de gnorizoun.

Kane, loipon, upomone (o, Prophete) upo to diatagma tou Kuriou sou (na metadideis to Menuma Tou, kai na deixeis upomone se o,ti antimetopizeis), pragmati eisai kato apo ta Matia Mas (kai ten Orase kai ten Uposterixe Mas). Doxaze, loipon, ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton, otan sekonesai [apo ton upno sou, -e apo mia sugkentrose, e otan sekonesai gia ten proseukhe].
Kai doxaze Ton kata te nukhta, kai otan ta asteria exaphanistoun (kata ten auge).
(Orkizomai) ma to asteri otan pephtei (-e exaphanizetai-)!
Oti o suntrophos sas (o Mokhammant), oute parastratese (apo ten aletheia kai ten kathodegese), oute einai paraplanemenos,
oute milaei apo dike tou epithumia.
Prokeitai mono gia apokalupse pou apokaluptetai (s' auton).
Tou didaxe (ston Mokhammant to Kor'an), autos (o Aggelos Tzimprel -Gabriel-) pou ekhei iskhure duname,
o opoios ekhei dunate kai omorphe emphanise, kai emphanisteke (ston Mokhammant, sten alethine tou morphe),
eno briskotan ston upselotero orizonta.
Epeita plesiase (o Gabriel) kai katebeke (pros ton Prophete),
kai etan se apostase duo toxon e akoma pio konta.
Kai apokalupse (o Allakh meso tou Gabriel) ston doulo Tou o,ti apokalupse.
De diepseuse e kardia (tou Mokhammant) auto pou eide [del. ton Gabriel phorontas kati pou emoiaze me roukha apo prasino metaxi, ekhontas exakosia phtera pou kaluptan ton orizonta].
Diaphoneite (o, apistoi) mazi tou gi' auta pou eide;
Pragmati, (o Mokhammant) ton eide (ton Gabriel sten alethine morphe tou) gia alle mia phora (sto nukhterino taxidi, Al-Isra' kai Al-Mi'ratz),
konta sto dentro Sintr (Tzitziphia) tou Upertatou Oriou (ston ebdomo ourano),
konta sto opoio brisketai o Paradeisos tes katoikias,
otan kalupse to dentro Sintr (Tzitziphia) auto pou to kalupse.
Den parekkline to blemma (tou Mokhammant apo ta Semadia pou eblepe), oute xeperase ta oria (-e den eipe kati pou den to eide-).

Pragmati, eide merika apo ta megalutera Semadia tou Kuriou tou. [Del. eide ton Gabriel sten alethine tou morphe phorontas kati pou emoiaze me roukha apo prasino metaxi, ekhontas exakosia phtera pou kalupsan ton orizonta].
Blepete (o, apistoi, ta eidola sas pou ta apodidete ston Allakh os etairous ste latreia), to Al-Lat, to Al-'Ouzza,
kai to Manat, to allo, to trito, (oti mporoun na sas ophelesoun, na sas blapsoun, e na sas apokalupsoun kamia apokalupse);
Einai dunaton oti epithumeite na apoktesete agoria, eno apodidete s' Auton oti ekhei kores (kai oti oi Aggeloi einai oi kores Tou, eno to miseite auto gia ton eauto sas);
Autos einai tote enas adikos diakhorismos!

Auta ta (eidola) den einai para mono kapoia onomata, pou ekhete epinoesei eseis kai oi progonoi sas, gia ta opoia o Allakh den ekhei steilei kamia apodeixe! Den akolouthoun (oi eidololatres) para mono eikasies kai o,ti epithumoun oi psukhes (tous). Pragmati, ekhei erthei s' autous e kathodegese apo ton Kurio tous (me ton Prophete Tou, alla den ten akolouthoun).
E tha ekhei o anthropos o,ti epithumei (to na diamesolabesoun ta eidola gia logariasmo tou enopion tou Allakh);
(Okhi, de tha ekhei o anthropos o,ti epithumei), pragmati, ston Allakh anekei e teleutaia (e Mellousa Zoe) kai e prote (e egkosmia zoe).

Posoi Aggeloi uparkhoun stous ouranous, ton opoion e diamesolabese de tha ophelesei se tipote, para mono aphou o Allakh epitrepsei se opoious thelei (na diamesolabesoun) kai (mono gia ton logariasmo auton pou o Allakh) dekhetai.
Pragmati, autoi pou den pisteuoun ste Mellousa Zoe, apokaloun tous Aggelous me gunaikeia onomata.
Den ekhoun kamia gnose gi' auto. Den akolouthoun para mono eikasies, alla oi eikasies den mporoun na antikathistoun ten aletheia se tipote.
Apomakrunsou loipon (o, Prophete) apo opoion apomakruntheke apo ten Upenthumise Mas (to Kor'an) kai den epithumei para mono ten egkosmia zoe.

Autes (oi eikasies tous) einai mono to orio tes gnose tous. Pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) gnorizei kalutera poios ekhei parastratesei apo to dromo Tou, kai gnorizei kalutera poios ekhei kathodegethei.

Ston Allakh anekei o,ti uparkhei stous ouranous kai o,ti uparkhei ste ge, kai etsi, tha timoresei ekeinous pou diepraxan tis kakes praxeis gia o,ti ekanan, kai tha antameipsei ekeinous pou eprattan tis kales praxeis, me ton Paradeiso.

Oso gi' autous pou apopheugoun tis megales amarties kai tis epaiskhuntes praxeis, ektos an pesoun se mikres amarties (pou sugkhorountai me tis praxeis latreias kai me ten apophuge ton megalon amartion), pragmati, o Kurios sou (o, Prophete) ekhei aperante sugkhorese. Autos gnorizei ta panta gia sas, otan sas demiourgese (del. ton Adam) apo te ge, kai otan esastan (akoma) embrua stis metres ton meteron sas. Gi' auto men epainesete ton eauto sas (perigraphontas ton eauto sas os eusebe). Autos gnorizei kalutera poios phulassetai apo ten timoria Tou (terontas tis entoles Tou).
Eides (o, Prophete) auton pou apomakruntheke (apo to Islam),

kai edose liga (khremata) kai epeita ekopse (auta pou etan na xanadosei); [Anaphertheke oti o Al-Oualeint mpin Al-Mougeira aphou aspasteke to Islam, eipe se enan apisto pou ton epeplexe: <<To ekana epeide phobamai ten timoria tou Allakh>>, alla o apistos tou eipe oti an tha epistrepsei sten eidololatria kai tou dosei kapoia khremata, tha koubalesei ten timoria ant' autou ste Mellousa Zoe -an tha uparkhei-! Etsi, o Al-Oualeint epestrepse sten eidololatria kai tou edose liga khremata, alla meta stamatese kai den tou xanaedose]!
Ekhei gnose tou aoratou (oti ekeinos o apistos, ontos tha koubalesei ten timoria ant' autou), kai etsi blepei (oti ekeinos o apistos tha ekplerosei ten uposkhese tou);
E mepos den plerophoretheke gi' auta pou etan (grammena) stis graphes tou Mouse (ten Tora),
kai (stis graphes) tou Abraam, o opoios (o Abraam) ekplerose (o,ti diatakhtheke apo ton Allakh);
Oti den uparkhei kamia (amartole) psukhe pou na epomistei ten amartia kapoias alles.
Kai oti o anthropos de tha ekhei para mono o,ti ekane (apo kales e kakes praxeis).
Kai oti oi praxeis tou tha phanoun,
kai epeita tha labei (o anthropos) pleros gi' autes (tis praxeis tou, eite antamoibe, eite timoria).
Kai oti pros ton Kurio sou (o, Prophete) tha einai o telikos proorismos.
Kai oti einai Autos pou kanei opoion thelei na gelaei, kai kanei opoion thelei na klaiei.
Kai oti einai Autos pou aphairei te zoe (opoiou thelei) kai dinei zoe (se opoion thelei).
Kai oti einai Autos pou demiourgese ta zeugaria, to arseniko kai to theluko,
apo stagones (ekkriseon ton duo phulon) otan bgainoun.
Kai oti enapokeitai s' Auton na epipherei te deutere demiourgia (kata ten anastase).
Kai oti einai Autos pou dinei (ston anthropo) o,ti (tou) eparkei kai ton kanei ikanopoiemeno (-e kharizei s' auton ploute pou ta apothekeuei-).
Kai oti einai Autos o Kurios tou Seiriou (tou asteriou pou latreuan kapoioi eidololatres Arabes).
Kai oti Autos katestrepse ten prote phule 'Ant (-e ten proegoumene phule 'Ant-, ton lao tou Prophete Khount),
kai (katestrepse) te phule Thamount (ton lao tou Prophete Salikh), kai den aphese kanenan,
kai (katestrepse) ton lao tou (Prophete) Noe prin (apo ten phule 'Ant kai te phule Thamount). Pragmati, (oi anthropoi tou Noe) etan pio adikoi kai pio parabates,
kai erixe sto edaphos tis anestrammenes komopoleis (ton Sodomon, tou laou tou Prophete Lot),
kai tis kalupse (o Allakh) me o,ti tis kalupse (apo petres).
Poies loipon khares tou Kuriou sou (se sena, o, anthrope) amphisbeteis;
Autos (o Mokhammant) einai enas proeidopoietes opos oi proegoumenoi proeidopoietes.
Pragmati, plesiazei e Emera pou plesiazei,
ten opoia den mporei kaneis ektos apo ton Allakh na ten apotrepsei (e na ten apokalupsei kai na xerei ten Ora tes).
Aporriptete auta ta Logia (to Kor'an) kai sas phainetai periergo (oti einai apo ton Allakh),
kai gelate (khleuazontas to Kor'an) kai den klaite (otan akoute tis nouthesies kai tis proeidopoieseis tou),
eno eiste adiaphoroi (paizontas kai tragoudontas);
Peste loipon se Sitzount stase (me to metopo sto edaphos) enopion tou Allakh kai latrepste (mono Auton).

E Ora ekhei plesiasei kai to pheggari ekhei khoristei sta duo. [Aphou oi apistoi ste Makka zetesan apo ton Prophete na kanei ena thauma pou tha to doun me ta matia tous, etsi khoristeke to pheggari sta duo, kai to eidan me ta matia tous].
Otan (oi apistoi) blepoun kapoio Semadi, apomakrunontai kai lene: <<Aute einai mia (dunate) mageia pou tha phugei!>>

Diepseusan (ten aletheia) kai akolouthesan tis epithumies tous. Kai pragmati, kathe zetema (eite kalo, eite kako) tha egkatastathei (ten Emera tes Kriseos, me tous anthropous tou, eite ston Paradeiso, eite sten Kolase).
Pragmati, tous erthan ede kapoies istories (ton proegoumenon apiston ethnon pou katastraphekan), oi opoies (istories) einai eparkeis gia na tous apotrepsoun (apo ten apistia kai ten adikia tous).
(Auto to Kor'an) einai mia teleia sophia, alla se ti mporoun na ophelesoun oi proeidopoieseis (enan lao pou epimenei sten apistia);
Apomakrunsou, loipon, (o, Prophete) ap' autous. Ten Emera pou o kalon (o Aggelos Israphel tha phusexei to Keras -Salpigga- kai) tha kalesei gia kati phrikto (del. gia ton Apologismo),
ta matia tous tha einai tapeinomena, kai oi idioi tha bgoun apo tous taphous san skorpismenes akrides,
speudontas kai koitazontas pros ton kalounta, kai tote oi apistoi tha poun: <<Aute einai mia duskole Emera!>>
O laos tou Noe diepseuse (ton Prophete tous) prin ap' autous (tous apistous tes Makkas). Diepseusan ton doulo Mas (ton Noe) kai eipan: <<Autos einai trelos>>, kai ton apeilesan kai ton ebrisan.
Etsi, (o Noe) epikalesteke ton Kurio tou: <<Den ekho duname apenanti tous, gi' auto uposterixe me!>>
Etsi, anoixame tis pules tou ouranou me polu nero pou khunetai,
kai kaname na anablusoun peges apo te ge. Etsi ta nera (tou ouranou kai tes ges) sunantethekan gia ena skopo pou oristeke.
Ton metapherame (ton Noe) se mia (Kiboto) pou ekhei sanides kai karphia,
e opoia pleei upo ta Matia Mas (ten Orase kai te prostasia Mas), os uposterixe gi' ekeinon (ton Noe) pou aporriphtheke (apo ton apisto lao tou).
Pragmati, ten ekhoume aphesei (ten timoria -e ten Kiboto-) os Semadi. Uparkhei kapoios pou tha te labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
Pos etan loipon e timoria Mou kai oi proeidopoieseis Mou;

Pragmati, dieukoluname to Kor'an (kai to exegesame leptomeros) gia (opoion thelei) na to labei upopse (kai na labei nouthesia kai upenthumise). Uparkhei kapoios loipon pou tha to labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
E phule 'Ant diepseuse (ton Prophete Khount). Pos etan loipon e timoria Mou kai oi proeidopoieseis Mou;

Emeis steilame s' autous enan biaio kruo anemo me dunato ekho, se mia dunate kake emera (gi' autous, logo tes timorias), kai sunekhise (gia epta diadokhikes nukhtes kai okhto diadokhikes emeres, kai den aphese kanenan ap' autous).
O opoios (anemos) arpaxe tous anthropous (apo tis theseis tous), san na etan kormoi khourmadion pou xerizothekan.
Pos etan loipon e timoria Mou kai oi proeidopoieseis Mou;

Pragmati, dieukoluname to Kor'an (kai to exegesame leptomeros) gia (opoion thelei) na to labei upopse (kai na labei nouthesia kai upenthumise). Uparkhei kapoios loipon pou tha to labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
E phule Thamount diepseuse tis proeidopoieseis.
Eipan: <<Tha akolouthesoume apo emas, mono enan anthropo (ton Salikh); (An tha to kanoume auto), tote, pragmati, tha eimaste se plane kai se talaiporia (kai paraphrosune)!

Pera apo olous emas, ekhei stalei e apokalupse apokleistika se auton; Okhi (den tou ekhei stalei e apokalupse), alla autos einai pseutes kai alazonas (pou epidiokei na ekhei uperephaneia enantion mas).>>
Pragmati, aurio tha mathoun poios einai o pseutes kai o alazonas (del. autoi oi idioi)!
Pragmati, tha steiloume ten Kamela os dokimasia gi' autous (kai os Semadi), gi' auto perimene (o, Salikh) to ti tha kanoun, kai kane upomone.
Kai pes tous oti to nero (tou pegadiou) tha moirastei metaxu tous (mia emera tha piei e Kamela, kai ten epomene tha pioun autoi). Se kathe mera, tha paei ekei mono autos pou einai e seira tou.
Alla kalesan ton suntropho tous (ton pio athlio anamesa tous), ki ekeinos pere (ena spathi kai epiase ten Kamela) kai te skotose.
(Etsi, epese pano tous e timoria). Pos etan loipon e timoria Mou kai oi proeidopoieseis Mou;
Emeis steilame s' autous mia mono krauge, kai etsi, eginan san ta spasmena dentra kai phuta pou ta mazeuei kapoios pou ekhei akhurona.

Pragmati, dieukoluname to Kor'an (kai to exegesame leptomeros) gia (opoion thelei) na to labei upopse (kai na labei nouthesia kai upenthumise). Uparkhei kapoios loipon pou tha to labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
O laos tou Lot diepseuse tis proeidopoieseis.
Emeis steilame s' autous mia kataigida me mikres petres, ektos apo ten oikogeneia tou Lot, ten opoia sosame prin ten auge,
os khare apo Emas. Etsi antameiboume autous pou deikhnoun eugnomosune.
Pragmati, (o Lot) tous eikhe proeidopoiesei gia ten timoria Mas, alla ampheballan gia tis proeidopoieseis (kai tis diepseudan).

Kai pragmati, zetesan ap' auton na tous paradosei tous (Aggelous) kalesmenous tou (gia na diapraxoun ten omophulophilia), etsi sphragisame ta matia tous, (kai eipame): <<Geuteite loipon ten timoria Mou kai tis proeidopoieseis Mou!>>
Pragmati, tous katelabe noris to proi ena monimo marturio (pou kaneis den mporei na to apotrepsei, kai sundeetai me to marturio tes Mellousas Zoes).
Geuteite, loipon, ten timoria Mou kai tis proeidopoieseis Mou!

Pragmati, dieukoluname to Kor'an (kai to exegesame leptomeros) gia (opoion thelei) na to labei upopse (kai na labei nouthesia kai upenthumise). Uparkhei kapoios, loipon, pou tha to labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
Pragmati, erthan ston lao tou Pharao oi proeidopoieseis.
(Alla) diepseusan ola ta Semadia Mas, kai etsi, tous timoresame me ten timoria tou Aniketou, tou Pantodunamou.
Einai oi apistoi sas (o, lae tes Makkas) kaluteroi ap' autous (ton proanapheromenon apiston ethnon pou ta katastrepsame), e ekhete stis Theies Graphes asulia (apo to marturio Mas);
E lene (oi apistoi ste Makka): <<Eimaste ena megalo enomeno plethos pou tha nikesei>>;
Pragmati, tha ettethei to plethos (tous) kai tha trapoun se phuge. [Kati pou egine ste makhe tou Mpantr].

Okhi (den iskhuei auto pou iskhurizontai oi apistoi oti de tha uparxei anastase), alla pragmati e Ora tha einai e kathorismene ora tous (gia ten anastase kai ten timoria), kai e Ora tha einai pio megale (pio katastrophike), kai pio pikre (kai pio duskole gi' autous apo o,ti epathan kata te Makhe tou Mpantr).
Pragmati, oi kakoi briskontai se plane kai talaiporia (kai paraphrosune)!
Ten Emera pou tha surthoun sta prosopa tous sto Pur (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Geuteite to marturio tes Sakar (tes Photias).>>
Pragmati, demiourgesame ta panta sumphona me to Theio Pepromeno (sumphona me te gnose kai te thelese Mas, kai sumphona me o,ti grapsame sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud -to Diateremeno Pinaka-).
E entole Mas (otan theloume kati), den einai para (na poume mono) mia lexe (del. <<Gennetheito>>, kai etsi ginetai) san en ripe ophthalmou.
Pragmati, (o, apistoi tes Makkas) ekhoume katastrepsei paromoious sas (sten apistia apo ta proegoumena ethne). Uparkhei kapoios pou tha to labei upopse (kai tha labei nouthesia);
Ola osa ekanan (oi apistoi apo ta proegoumena ethne) einai grammena sta biblia (ton praxeon tous),
kai ola, mikra e megala, einai grammena.
Pragmati, autoi pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) tha einai se kepous kai potamia (ston Paradeiso),
se uperokho topo (opou den uparkhoun mataia logia, oute amarties), konta se Auton pou katekhei ta panta kai einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
O Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas).
Ekhei didaxei (se sas, o, anthropoi) to Kor'an (me to eleos Tou).
Eplase ton anthropo,
ton didaxe pos na milesei (kai ten katanoese kai pos na diakhorizei to epitrepto apo to apagoreumeno).
O elios kai to pheggari trekhoun me teleio upologismo se akribeis poreies.

Ta asteria (-e ta anarrikhomena phuta-) kai ta dentra, pephtoun se Sitzount stase (enopion tou Allakh). [Del. oi skies ton dentron kai ton bounon klp. klinoun dexia kai aristera se Sitzount stase me kathe tapeinose].
Anupsose ton ourano (os stege pano apo te ge) kai dietaxe te dikaiosune (ste ge),
oste na men parabiazete ta oria tes dikaiosunes (kai tes zugises).
Zugiste me dikaiosune (otan poulate kati) kai me meionete tipota apo te zugise.
Te ge ten proetoimase gia (na egkatastathoun) ta demiourgemata (Tou).
Sten opoia (ge) uparkhoun phrouta, kai khourmadies pou ekhoun thekes (apo tis opoies proerkhontai oi khourmades).
kai (uparkhoun) sitera pou ekhoun phloio (pou einai os agatha gia sas kai gia ta booeide sas) kai (uparkhoun) aromatika phuta.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Demiourgese ton anthropo (ton Adam) apo xero pelo pou einai san ta keramika.
Kai demiourgese to Tzinn apo phloga photias.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Einai o Kurios ton duo anatolon (tou kheimona kai tou kalokairiou) kai o Kurios ton duo duseon (tou kheimona kai tou kalokairiou).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Eleutherose ta duo nera (eite tou potamou kai tes thalassas, eite ton duo potamon, eite ton duo thalasson), oste na sunantethoun.

Metaxu tous uparkhei ena phragma, oste na men parabiasei to ena to allo. [Kai etsi to nero tou potamou e tes thalassas, otan eiskhorei se mia alle thalassa, den allazei ten almurotata kai tis perigraphes autes sten opoia eiskhorei, alla apokta tis perigraphes tes].
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Ap' auta (ta nera) bgainoun ta margaritaria kai ta korallia [-e ta megala kai ta mikra margaritaria-].
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Se Auton anekoun ta ploia me ta upsomena pania ste thalassa san ta bouna.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oloi epano tes (ges) tha pethanoun,
kai tha parameinei mono to Prosopo tou Kuriou sou, o Opoios einai o Katokhos tes Doxas (kai tou Megaleiou), kai tes gennaiodorias.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;

Oloi osoi einai stous ouranous kai ste ge, zetoun apo Auton (o,ti ekhoun anagke). Kathe mera emphanizei ta themata (pou ekhei orisei gia tous doulous Tou, upsonontas kapoious, khamelonontas allous, sugkhorontas kapoious, timorontas allous, aphairontas tis kakoukhies apo kapoious kai apantontas stis epikleseis allon klp.).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Pragmati, (ten Emera tes Kriseos), tha sas pheroume, o, anthropoi kai Tzinn, gia apologismo (kai tha sas dosoume o,ti uposkhethekame apo antamoibe kai timoria)!
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;

O, Tzinn kai anthropoi! An mporeite na bgeite apo tis zones ton ouranon kai tes ges [sten egkosmia zoe gia na xephugete apo ton thanato, -e kata te Mellousa Zoe gia na xephugete apo ten timoria Mou kai apo o,ti orisa gia sas], tote kante to. Pragmati, den mporeite na bgeite, para mono me exousia kai duname (apo Emena, eno eseis den ekhete kamia duname), [-e oso kai an bgeite, de tha eiste para mono upo ten kuriarkhia Mou-]!
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Tha staloun enantion sas, akapnes phloges photias kai (liomenos) oreikhalkos (-e kapnos-), kai de tha mporeite na uperaspisteite ton eauto sas.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Otan o ouranos tha skhistei kai tha ginei kokkinos san to louloudi, kai san to lampero ladi,
-poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;-

ekeine ten Emera kanenas anthropos e Tzinn de tha erotethei gia tis amarties tou (gia na matheutoun ap' auton, alla tha erotethei os epiplexe kai timoria gi' auton, aphou o Allakh tis xerei ede kai oi Aggeloi tis ekhoun katagrapsei).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oi kakoi tha anagnorizontai apo ta semadia tous (ta maura prosopa kai ta mple matia tous), kai tha tous arpaxoun (oi Aggeloi) apo ta metopa kai ta podia tous (kai tha tous rixoun ste Photia).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
(Tha eipothei): <<Aute einai e Kolase pou diepseudan oi kakoi (sten egkosmia zoe).>>
Tha peripherontai anamesa s' aute (ten Kolase) kai sto zematisto nero (pou tha ekhei phtasei sten megiste thermokrasia, kai tha pioun ap' auto).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oso gia opoion phobatai na stathei (os kategoroumenos) enopion tou Kuriou tou (kai apopheugei tis amarties, kai kanei kales praxeis), tha uparkhoun duo kepoi (ston Paradeiso).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oi opoioi (duo kepoi) ekhoun (megala) kladia (me phrouta diaphoretikon khromaton).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Kai stous opoious (kepous) uparkhoun duo peges, pou trekhoun.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Kai stous opoious (kepous) uparkhoun duo eide apo kathe eidos phroutou.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
(Oi katoikoi) tha einai xaplomenoi se krebatia me esoterika kalummata apo pakhu metaxi, kai oi karpoi ton duo kepon tha briskontai khamela kai konta (stous katoikous).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;

Kai stous opoious (kepous) tha uparkhoun semnes gunaikes pou tha periorizoun to blemma tous (kai ten kardia tous, stous suzugous tous). Tis opoies (gunaikes) de tha tis ekhei aggixei prin ap' autous (tous suzugous tous), kanenas anthropos, kai kanena Tzinn.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oi opoies gunaikes tha einai san ta roumpinia kai ta korallia (sten omorphia).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Tha einai e antamoibe gia to kalo (kai tis kales praxeis) kati allo para mono to kalo (del. o Paradeisos);
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Kai ektos ap' autous (tous duo kepous), tha uparkhoun alloi duo kepoi (ston Paradeiso).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oi opoioi (kepoi) tha einai prasinoi skouroi (apo ta polla dentra pou potizontai sunekhos).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Mesa stous duo (kepous), tha uparkhoun duo peges pou anabluzoun.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Mesa stous duo (kepous), tha uparkhoun phrouta, khourmadies kai rodia.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Mesa stous duo (kepous), tha uparkhoun kales kai omorphes gunaikes.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Oi opoies tha einai omorphes gunaikes (me megala omorpha matia), pou tha menoun sta spitia (semnes periorizontas to blemma kai ten kardia tous, stous suzugous tous).
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Tis opoies (gunaikes) de tha tis ekhei aggixei prin ap' autous (tous suzugous tous), kanenas anthropos, kai kanena Tzinn.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
(Oi katoikoi) tha einai xaplomenoi se prasina maxilaria kai uperokha khalia.
Poia, loipon, apo tis khares tou Kuriou sas tha diapseusete;
Upsisto einai to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, o Opoios einai o Katokhos tes Doxas (kai tou Megaleiou) kai tes gennaiodorias.
Otan tha sumbei to Anapopheukto Gegonos (e Emera tes Anastases),
de tha uparxei kaneis pou na to diapseusei (kai tipota de tha mporei na to apotrepsei).
Tha khamelosei (tous apistous) kai tha upsosei (tous eusebeis).
Otan e ge tha seistei biaia,
kai ta bouna tha spasoun entelos,
kai tha ginoun skorpismene skone,
kai eseis oloi tha diakhoristeite se treis omades,
tote, oi anthropoi tes dexias (pou tha laboun to biblio ton praxeon tous me to dexi tous kheri), poso eulogemenoi tha einai oi anthropoi tes dexias!
Kai oi anthropoi tes aristeras (pou tha laboun to biblio ton praxeon tous me to aristero tous kheri), poso athlioi tha einai oi anthropoi tes aristeras!
Kai oi protoi (pou espeusan pros ten piste kai tis kales praxeis), tha einai oi protoi (sto na eiselthoun ston Paradeiso).
Ekeinoi einai autoi pou tha ekhoun kontine these,
(kai tha einai) stous Kepous tes Eudaimonias.

(Oi opoioi tha einai) polloi apo tous protous (del. oi Mousoulmanoi pou espeusan pros ten piste ston Mokhammant kai espeusan stis kales praxeis, kai oi proegoumenoi Prophetes kai oi suntrophoi tous pou espeusan pros ten piste s' autous).
kai ligoi apo tous teleutaious (del. apo tous Mousoulmanous ton metagenesteron genion).
(Oi opoioi tha einai) se krebatia uphasmena me khruso (kai polutimous lithous),
xaplomenoi pano tous, o enas apenanti apo ton allon (kai kaneis de tha dosei ten plate tou ston allon).
Tha peripherontai anamesa tous (uperetontas tous), epheboi me aionia neoteta (pou oute pethainoun, oute gernoun),
me poteria, kanates kai ena diskopotero apo krasi apo reousa pege,
-apo to opoio (krasi) de tha ekhoun oute ponokephalo, oute methe-,
kai me phrouta apo o,ti dialegoun,
kai me kreas poulerikon apo o,ti epithumoun.
Kai (tha uparkhoun os suzugoi) omorphes gunaikes me megala omorpha matia.
Oi opoies tha einai san ta margaritaria pou einai prophulagmena (sta kokhulia tous).
(Ola auta einai) mia antamoibe, gia o,ti ekanan (apo kales praxeis).
De tha akousoun mesa tou (Paradeisou), oute mataia logia, oute logia pou phernoun amartia (sukophantia klp).
(De tha akousoun) para mono kala kai agna logia (kai ton khairetismo metaxu tous, kai ton khairetismo ton Aggelon s' autous, pou tha einai: <<Salam! -eirene->>).
Oso gia tous anthropous tes dexias (pou tha laboun to biblio ton praxeon tous me to dexi tous kheri), poso eulogemenoi tha einai oi anthropoi tes dexias!
Tha einai anamesa se dentra Sintr (Tzitziphia) khoris agkathia,
kai (anamesa se) mpananies me karpous pou einai stoibagmenoi, o enas pano ston allon,
kai (anamesa se) ektetamene (monime) skia,
kai (dipla se) nero pou reei sunekhos,
kai (tha ekhoun) aphthona phrouta,
e parokhe ton opoion, de tha apokoptetai (logo epokhes), oute tha apotrepetai (logo times, oute tha uparkhei tipote na tous empodisei ap' auta opote ta theloun),
Kai (tha einai pano se) krebatia kai kalummata, upsomena psela (mazi me tis suzugous tous).

Pragmati, Emeis tis demiourgesame (tis gunaikes tou Paradeisou, -kai tha demiourgesoume tis pistes gunaikes pou tha mpoun mazi me tous pistous suzugous tous ston Paradeiso-) me mia xekhoriste demiourgia,
kai tis kaname parthenes (pou de tha tis ekhei aggixei kaneis prin),
oi opoies tha agapoun mono tous suzugous tous, kai tha einai oles ises elikias,
gia tous anthropous tes dexias (pou tha laboun to biblio ton praxeon tous me to dexi tous kheri),

oi opoioi tha einai polloi apo tous protous (del. oi Mousoulmanoi pou espeusan pros ten piste ston Mokhammant kai espeusan stis kales praxeis, kai oi proegoumenoi Prophetes kai oi suntrophoi tous pou espeusan pros ten piste s' autous),
kai polloi apo tous teleutaious (del. apo tous Mousoulmanous apo tis metagenesteres genies).
Oso gia tous anthropous tes aristeras, poso athlioi tha einai oi anthropoi tes aristeras!
Tha einai ste zeste tes Photias (pou tha tous kopsei ten anasa) kai (tha pioun) zematisto nero (kai tha rikhtei pano sta kephalia tous),
kai (tha einai) kato apo te skia enos maurou kapnou,
e opoia (skia) oute tha einai drosere, oute tha einai kale, (alla tha ekhei polu zeste kai askheme emphanise).
Pragmati, autoi (oi apistoi) prin ap' auto (to marturio), ezesan me apolause (sten egkosmia zoe kai den tous enoiazan para mono oi pothoi tous),
kai epemenan sto barutato amartema (ten apistia),
kai elegan: <<Einai dunaton oti otan tha pethanoume kai tha ginoume skone kai kokala, tha anastethoume;
E (tha anastethoun) oi propatores mas;>>
Pes (o, Prophete): <<Pragmati, kai oi protoi kai oi teleutaioi (del. oloi),
tha sugkentrothoun se mia prokathorismene Emera.>>
Epeita, pragmati eseis, o, parastratemenoi pou diapseudete (ten anastase),
tha trote apo ta dentra tou Zakoum (sten Kolase),
kai tha gemizete ap' auta (ta dentra) tis koilies sas,
kai meta ap' auto (pou tha phate), tha pieite apo to zematisto nero,
kai tha pieite san tis dipsasmenes kameles (pou logo arrostias, oso kai na pinoun, de sbenoun te dipsa tous)!
Aute tha einai e philoxenia tous ten Emera tou Apologismou!
Eimaste Emeis pou sas demiourgesame (apo ten anuparxia). De tha pistepsete loipon (sten anastase);
Blepete to sperma pou bgainei apo sas (kai egkathistatai stis metres);
Eiste eseis pou to demiourgeite e eimaste Emeis oi Demiourgoi;
Ekhoume orisei ton thanato anamesa sas (kai gia kathenan uparkhei mia kathorismene ora), kai den Eimaste anikanoi,

na allaxoume te demiourgia sas (ten Emera tes Anastases) kai na sas demiourgesoume m' aute (te morphe kai tis idiotetes) pou de gnorizete. [-E na sas antikatastesoume (meta ton thanato sas) m' allous san esas ste morphe, kai na sas demiourgesoume se opoies alles morphes (theloume), pou den tis gnorizete (del. aphou mporoume na demiourgesoume o,ti einai san esas, kai o,ti den einai, pos loipon de tha mporoume na sas anastesoume;)-]

Pragmati, gnorizete ten prote demiourgia (oti o Allakh sas demiourgese apo ten anuparxia, kai oti sas demiourgese stis metres ton meteron sas), de tha to labete loipon upopse (kai na mathete oti Autos einai Ikanos na sas anastesei);
Blepete autous (tous sporous) pou phuteuete;

Eiste eseis pou tous kanete na phutrosoun e eimaste Emeis pou tous kanoume na phutrosoun (aphou exaphanizontai oi sporoi kai ginontai prasina megala phuta); [Autos pou tous ekane na phutrosoun, einai Ikanos na sas anastesei].
An thelame, tha ta eikhame kanei (ta phuta) akhura (khoris na pairnete tous karpous tous), kai epeita tha paramenate se aporia (kai metanoia, gia o,ti egine gia ten kalliergeia sas),
(legontas): <<Pragmati, labame mia timoria (khanontas o,ti xodepsame sten kalliergeia).
Okhi (mono), alla eimaste steremenoi (apo tous karpous kai to kerdos pou epidiokame).>>
Blepete to nero pou pinete;
Eiste eseis pou to katebazete apo ta sunnepha, e eimaste Emeis pou to katebazoume;
An thelame, tha to eikhame kanei almuro. Tha deixete eugnomosune loipon;
Blepete te photia pou anabete;
Eiste eseis pou demiourgesate ta dentra apo ta opoia anabei, e eimaste Emeis oi Demiourgoi;
Emeis ten kaname (te photia) os mia upenthumise (gia ten Kolase), kai os kati ophelimo gia tous taxidiotes.
Doxase, loipon, to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, tou Al-'Adeim (Mega).
(Orkizomai) ma tis theseis ton asterion!
Kai pragmati, autos einai enas megalos orkos, an gnorizate.
Oti auto einai pragmati ena Eugenes Kor'an!
(To opoio einai) se ena diateremeno Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud).
Den to aggizoun para mono oi exagnismenoi (oi Aggeloi).
Apokaluphtheke apo ton Kurio ton kosmon.
Einai dunaton oti diapseudete auton ton Logo (to Kor'an),
kai anti na deixete eugnomosune (pros ton Allakh) gia ta agatha pou sas parekhei, diapseudete (to Kor'an);
Tha mporeite otan (e psukhe kapoiou pou pethainei) phtasei ston larugga,
-eno eiste tote (parontes kai) koitate,
kai eno Emeis eimaste (del. oi Aggeloi Mas einai) pio konta s' auton apo sas, alla eseis de blepete (tous Aggelous Mas)-,
kai tha mporeite epises an (eiste opos iskhurizeste oti) de tha (anastetheite, oute tha) apologetheite (gia tis praxeis sas),
na ten epistrepsete (ten psukhe tou xana sto soma tou), an eiste pragmati eilikrineis;
An autos (pou pethainei) einai ap' autous pou tha ekhoun kontine these (epeide speudoun pros tis kales praxeis),
tha uparkhei gi' auton anese (eleos kai khara), kai kala agatha kai enas Kepos Eudaimonias (ston Paradeiso).
Kai an (autos pou pethainei) einai apo tous anthropous tes dexias (pou tha laboun to biblio ton praxeon tous me to dexi tous kheri),
(tha eipothei s' auton): <<Eirene se sena, pou eisai enas apo tous anthropous tes dexias.>>
Alla an (autos pou pethainei) einai enas apo tous paraplanemenous pou diapseudoun (ten aletheia kai ten kathodegese),
tha ton kalosorisoun me zematisto nero (pou tha to piei),
kai tha eisakhthei sten Kolase gia na kaei mesa tes.
Pragmati, auto (pou anapherame se sena, o, Prophete) einai e apolute aletheia (pou den uparkhei kamia amphibolia gi' auten).
Etsi, doxase to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, tou Al-'Adeim (Mega).
O,ti brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge, doxazei ton Allakh. Pragmati, Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
Se Auton anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges. Dinei zoe (se opoious thelei), kai aphairei te zoe (apo opoious thelei), kai Autos einai gia ta panta, Ikanos.

Autos einai o Al-Aoual (o Protos pou panta uperkhe khoris arkhe, kai prin apo Auton den uperkhe tipota), o Al-Akhir (Autos pou tha paramenei khoris telos, aphou ta panta tha khathoun ten Emera tes Kriseos), o Ad-Dakhir (o Upsistos pou upotassei ta panta, kai tipota den einai pano apo Auton), o Al-Mpatein (Autos pou brisketai polu konta kai tipote den einai pio konta apo Auton) kai Autos einai gia ta panta, Pantognostes.

Einai Autos pou demiourgese tous ouranous kai te ge se exi Emeres, kai epeita upsotheke pano apo ton Throno (me tropo pou tairiazei ste Megaloprepeia Tou). Gnorizei o,ti mpainei ste ge kai o,ti bgainei ap' auten, kai o,ti katebainei apo ton ourano kai o,ti anebainei s' auton. Einai mazi sas (me te gnose Tou) opou ki an briskeste. Pragmati, o Allakh blepei ola osa kanete.
Se Auton anekei e kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes ges, kai ston Allakh tha epistrepsoun oles oi upotheseis.

Eisagei te nukhta sten emera, kai eisagei ten emera ste nukhta (del. auxanei kai meionei tis ores tous kata to kheimona kai to kalokairi). Pragmati, Autos einai o Pantognostes gia o,ti brisketai sta stethe (ton anthropon).

(O, anthropoi) pistepste ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai xodepste (gia khare tou Allakh) apo o,ti sas empisteuteke. Oso gia osous anamesa sas pisteuoun kai xodeuoun, tha ekhoun mia megale antamoibe.

Giati den pisteuete ston Allakh, -eno o Aggeliaphoros sas kalei (me xekathara epikheiremata kai apodeixeis) na pistepsete ston Kurio sas, kai eno (o Allakh) ekhei ede parei mia desmeuse apo sas (otan sas ebgale apo ten osphu tou Adam kai marturesate oti o Allakh einai o Kurios sas)- ean pote tha eiste pistoi;
Einai Autos pou stelnei xekathara Edaphia ston doulo Tou (ton Mokhammant) gia na sas bgalei apo ta skotadia sto phos. Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia sas Poluepieikes kai Polueusplakhnos.

Giati den xodeuete sto dromo tou Allakh, eno ston Allakh anekei e kleronomia ton ouranon kai tes ges; Osoi apo sas xodepsan kai polemesan prin apo ten kataktese (tes Mekkas) den einai isoi (me osous den to ekanan). Ekeinoi einai megaluteroi se bathmo, ap' autous pou xodepsan kai polemesan meta. Ostoso, o Allakh ekhei uposkhethei stis duo omades, ton Paradeiso. Pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete, ekhei aperioriste gnose.
Poios tha daneisei ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas gia khare tou Allakh), oste (o Allakh) na tou to pollaplasiasei (ten antamoibe tou), kai na ekhei mia gennaiodore antamoibe (ton Paradeiso);

Ten Emera pou tha deis tous pistous, andres kai gunaikes, me to phos tous na trekhei mprosta tous kai sta dexia tous, (tha eipothei s' autous): <<Kharmosuna nea gia sas Semera! Kepoi (ston Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinete mesa gia panta! Pragmati, aute einai e megale epitukhia!>>

Ekeine ten Emera oi upokrites, andres kai gunaikes, tha poun stous pistous: <<Perimenete mas, gia na ekhoume ligo apo to phos sas.>> Tha eipothei: <<Guriste piso kai anazeteste phos ekei (del. eite guriste piso opou esastan, e guriste piso sten egkosmia zoe -an mporeite- kai anazeteste phos meso tes pistes).>> Ste sunekheia, tha topothetethei anamesa tous enas toikhos, o opoios tha ekhei mia pule, sten esoterike pleura tes (pou tha einai pros tous pistous), tha uparkhei eleos, alla sten exoterike pleura tes (pou tha einai pros tous upokrites), tha uparkhei to marturio.

(Oi upokrites) tha tous phonaxoun (stous pistous): <<Den emastan mazi sas (sto Islam kai stis praxeis latreias);>> (Oi pistoi) tha poun: <<Nai, alla katastrepsate ton eauto sas (me ten upokrisia), perimenate (to kako na mas sumbei), amphibalate (ste threskeia) kai sas exapatesan oi (kakes) elpides (sas), ospou erthe to diatagma tou Allakh (gia to thanato sas). Kai sas exapatese autos (o diabolos) pou exapataei kai sas apomakrune apo ton dromo tou Allakh!

Semera, loipon, de tha ginoun dekta opoiadepote lutra apo sas e apo autous pou arnethekan ten piste. E katoikia sas tha einai e Photia, e opoia einai pio katallele gia sas, kai poso athlios einai autos o proorismos!>>

Den erthe e ora gia osous pisteuoun, na malakosoun oi kardies tous gia ten exumnese tou Allakh kai gia o,ti staltheke apo ten aletheia (to Kor'an kai tis nouthesies tou), oste na men ginoun san ekeinous stous opoious dotheke to Biblio prin (e Tora tou Mouse kai to In-tzel tou Iesou, alla apomakrunthekan ap' auta), kai perase polus kairos, kai etsi, oi kardies tous sklerunan; Kai pragmati, polloi ap' autous (stous opoious dotheke e Tora kai to In-tzel) einai anupakouoi.
Na xerete oti o Allakh anazoogonei te ge meta ton thanato tes, (kai etsi tha sas anastesei). Pragmati, ekhoume diasaphenisei gia sas ta Semadia, isos kai na sullogisteite.

Pragmati, autoi pou dinoun eleemosune, andres kai gunaikes, kai daneizoun ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas ston dromo Tou gia khare Tou), tha laboun pollaplasia antamoibe, kai tha ekhoun mia gennaiodore antamoibe.

Osoi pisteuoun ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou, ekeinoi einai pragmati oi alethina eusebeis pistoi (pou pistepsan apoluta tous Aggeliaphorous). Oso gia tous martures (pou skotothekan ston dromo tou Allakh), tha ekhoun apo ton Kurio tous ten antamoibe tous kai to phos tous. Oso gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseusan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, ekeinoi tha einai oi katoikoi tes Phlegomenes Photias.

Na xerete oti e egkosmia zoe den einai para paikhnidi, diaskedase, stolismos, kaukhema metaxu sas kai antagonismos se ploute kai paidia. Einai san te brokhe, tes opoias ta phuta (pou phutrosan ap' aute), aresan stous agrotes, meta xerainontai kai ta blepeis na kitrinizoun kai meta na ginontai akhura. Kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha uparxei ena austero marturio (gia tous apistous), kai e sugkhorese apo ton Allakh kai e euarestese Tou (gia tous pistous). Pragmati, e egkosmia zoe den einai para mono e eukharistese tes mataiodoxias.

Sunagonisteite o enas me ton allon gia te sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas, kai ton Paradeiso, to platos tou opoiou einai san to platos tou ouranou kai tes ges. (O Paradeisos) ekhei proetoimastei gi' autous pou pisteuoun ston Allakh kai stous Aggeliaphorous Tou. Aute einai e khare tou Allakh, ten opoia dinei se opoious thelei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales gennaiodorias.

Kamia sumphora den pephtei ste ge e se sas, para na einai grammene se ena Biblio (Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud) prin na tous demiourgesoume (tous anthropous, tous ouranous kai te ge). Pragmati, auto einai polu eukolo gia ton Allakh.
Gia na me stenakhorieste gia o,ti sas xephuge e diephuge (apo ten egkosmia zoe), oute na khaireste me alazoneia gia o,ti sas edose. Pragmati, o Allakh den agapa kanenan alazona pou kaukhietai.

(Oi opoioi alazones) einai autoi pou tsigkouneuontai (apo to na xodeuoun se o,ti tous dietaxe o Allakh) kai diatazoun tous anthropous na tsigkouneuontai. Opoios apomakrunetai (apo ten upakoe pros ton Allakh), pragmati, o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

Pragmati, steilame tous Aggeliaphorous Mas me tis xekathares apodeixeis, kai mazi tous steilame to Biblio kai te dikaiosune, oste oi anthropoi na prattoun me te dikaiosune. Kai katebasame (ste ge) to sidero, to opoio periekhei megale duname kai ophele gia tous anthropous. Gia na xerei o Allakh (-auto pou ede xerei- del. na emphanistei se sas) poios tha uposterixei Auton (del. te threskeia Tou) kai tous Aggeliaphorous Tou, khoris na Ton ekhei dei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).

Pragmati, steilame ton Noe kai ton Abraam, kai kaname apo tous apogonous tous na uparkhoun Prophetes, kai s' autous steilame ta Biblia (ten Tora ston Mouse, to Az-Zampour ston Dabid, to In-tzel ston Iesou kai to Kor'an ston Mokhammant). Omos, uparkhoun ap' autous (tous apogonous tous) ekeinoi pou kathodegountai, alla oi perissoteroi ap' autous einai anupakouoi.

Epeita, steilame sta bemata tous (tou Noe kai tou Abraam), tous Aggeliaphorous Mas, kai steilame meta, ton Iesou, ton uio tes Marias, kai tou dosame to In-tzel (to prototupo Euaggelio tou Iesou). Kai topothetesame stis kardies ekeinon pou ton akolouthesan (sten alethine threskeia), sumponia kai eleos. Kai (kapoioi ap' autous) epinoesan ton monakhismo (zontas se monasteria makria apo tous anthropous kai apekhontas apo ton gamo klp., diapheugontas apo tous diogmous ton basiliadon pou allaxan te threskeia tou Iesou), ton opoio (monakhismo) den ton diataxame s' autous (os tropo zoes kai latreias), alla (autoi ton epinoesan) gia na apoktesoun ten Euarestese tou Allakh (diaterontas ta authentika didagmata tou Iesou). Alla (autoi pou erthan meta ap' autous -ektos apo ligous-) den ton diateresan opos prepei (me to na diateresoun ta authentika didagmata, alla akolouthesan ta dogmata pou epinoesan oi basiliades ste threskeia tou Allakh). Etsi, dosame s' autous pou pistepsan anamesa tous ten antamoibe tous, alla polloi ap' autous einai anupakouoi.

O, eseis pou pistepsate (ston Mouse kai ston Iesou, kai epeita pistepsate ston Mokhammant), phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou) kai pistepste ston Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant), oste na sas dosei diplasio meridio apo to eleos Tou, na sas dosei ena phos me to opoio tha perpatesete (ston isio dromo), kai na sas sugkhoresei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

(Aute e proanapheromene antamoibe einai) oste na xeroun oi Anthropoi tou Bibliou (del. oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi pou den pistepsan ston Mokhammant) oti den katekhoun tipote apo te gennaiodoria tou Allakh, kai oti ole e gennaiodoria brisketai sto Kheri tou Allakh, ten opoia (gennaiodoria) te dinei se opoious thelei. Pragmati, o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales gennaiodorias.

(O, Mokhammant!) Pragmati, o Allakh akouse ta logia ekeines (tes Khaoulas, kores tou Tha'lampa), pou diaphonese suzetontas mazi sou, skhetika me to suzugo tes (ton Aous, gio tou As-Samit pou tes eipe: <<Eisai gia mena san ten plate tes meteras mou.>> Del. kathisto apagoreumeno gia mena na se plesiaso, alla khoris na se khoriso. Auto etan ena eidos diazugiou pou legotan "Ad-Dikhar" pou epikratouse prin to Islam. Etsi, oi gunaikes den etan oute pantremenes oute eleutheres gia na pantreutoun kapoion allo), kai apeuthunei to problema tes (proseukhomene) ston Allakh (gia na te boethesei na to epilusei). Kai o Allakh akouei te suzetese (kai ta epikheiremata kai ton duo) sas. Pragmati, o Allakh einai Samei' (Autos pou akouei ta panta) kai Mpaseir (Autos pou blepei ta Panta).

Ekeinoi anamesa sas pou kathistoun tis gunaikes tous apagoreumenes gi' autous me to "Ad-Dikhar" (legontas: <<Eisai gia mena san ten plate tes meteras mou.>>), - (as xeroun oti) autes (oi gunaikes tous) den einai oi meteres tous! Sten pragmatikoteta meteres tous den einai para mono ekeines pou tous gennesan. Kai pragmati, xestomizoun askhema kai apagoreumena logia kai ena psema. Kai pragmati, o Allakh einai 'Aphoou (Autos pou dinei aphese gia ta panta) kai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

Ekeinoi pou kathistoun tis gunaikes tous apagoreumenes gi' autous me to "Ad-Dikhar" (legontas: <<Eisai gia mena san ten plate tes meteras mou.>>), kai epeita thelesoun na anairesoun o,ti eipan (del. na plesiasoun xana tis gunaikes tous), tote (e exileose tous einai) e apeleutherose enos sklabou prin na aggixoun o enas ton allo. M' auto diatazeste. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Kai opoios den briskei (sklabo gia na ton apeleutherosei e khremata gia na apeleutherosei enan sklabo), tote prepei na nestepsei gia duo sunekhomenous menes prin na aggixoun o enas ton allo. Ki ekeinos pou den mporei (na nestepsei), tote as taIsei exenta endeeis. Auto gia na pistepsete ston Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou (telontas o,ti ekhei diataxei o Allakh kai akolouthontas te Sounna -paradose- tou Prophete, kai apopheugontas aute ten amartia). Auta einai ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, kai gia tous apistous (pou arnountai auta ta oria), tha uparxei ena epoduno marturio.

Pragmati, ekeinoi pou antitithentai ston Allakh (parabiazontas tis entoles Tou kai deikhnontas ekhthroteta s' Auton) kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, tha tapeinothoun opos tapeinothekan ekeinoi prin ap' autous (apo ta proegoumena ethne). Kai pragmati, steilame xekathara Edaphia (kai Semadia). Kai gia tous apistous tha uparxei ena exeutelistiko marturio.

Ten Emera pou o Allakh tha tous anastesei olous mazi kai tha tous enemerosei gia o,ti ekanan. O Allakh ta ekhei katagrapsei (sta biblia ton praxeon tous), eno autoi ta ekhoun xekhasei. Kai o Allakh einai Marturas gia ta panta (den uparkhei kati krupho ap' Auton).
