Den ekheis dei (o, Mokhammant) oti o Allakh gnorizei otidepote brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge; Den uparkhei kruphe idiotike sunomilia trion (atomon), ektos na einai Autos (o Allakh) o Tetartos tous (me te Gnose Tou), oute ton pente (atomon), ektos na einai Autos o Ektos tous, oute ligoteron e perissoteron (atomon), ektos na einai Autos mazi tous, opou ki an briskontai. Epeita, ten Emera tes Anastases tha tous enemerosei (o Allakh) gia o,ti ekanan (apo kales e kakes praxeis). Pragmati, o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Den ekheis dei (o, Prophete) ekeinous (tous Ebraious) stous opoious apagoreuteke e kruphe idiotike sunomilia (oi opoioi otan eblepan kapoion Mousoulmano arkhizan na sunomiloun krupha kleinontas to mati o enas ston allon, kati pou enokhlese tous Mousoulmanous kai aisthanthekan oti tous kakologousan, kai etsi paraponethekan ston Prophete, o opoios proeidopoiese tous Ebraious gi' auto), kai epeita epestrepsan (oi Ebraioi) s' ekeino pou tous eikhe apagoreutei; Kai sunomiloun krupha kai idiotika sten amartia, kai sten ekhthra kai ten anupakoe ston Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant). Kai otan erkhontai s' esena, se khairetoun me enan khairetismo me ton opoio o Allakh den se khaireta (del. elegan <<As-Samou 'Alaikom>> pou semainei <<o thanatos s' esena>> anti tou islamikou khairetismou <<As-Salamou 'Alaikom>> pou semainei <<eirene s' esena>>). Kai lene metaxu tous: <<Giati den mas timorei o Allakh gi' auto pou leme (an o Mokhammant einai aletheia Prophetes);>> Arkei gi' autous e Kolase, opou tha eisakhthoun gia na kaoun mesa tes. Kai pragmati, ti athlios proorismos einai autos!

O, eseis pou pisteuete! An sunomileite idiotika, me sunomileite idiotika sten amartia, kai sten ekhthra kai ten anupakoe ston Aggeliaphoro, kai na sunomileite idiotika (mono) sten upakoe pros ton Allakh kai sto na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (meso tes apophuges ton apagoreuseon Tou). Kai phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), ston Opoion tha sugkentrotheite (ten Emera tes Anastases).

Pragmati, e An-Natzoua (e kruphe sunomilia sten amartia kai ekhthroteta) proerkhetai mono apo ton Satana (pou psithurizei stous boethous tou), oste na prokalesei thlipse stous pistous. Ma auto den tha tous blapsei se tipote, para mono me ten Adeia tou Allakh. Kai ston Allakh as basizontai oi pistoi.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan eipothei s' esas na kanete khoro stis sugkentroseis opou katheste, (anoikhteite kai) kante khoro (oste na kathisoun kai alloi). O Allakh tha dieurunei (to Eleos Tou, ton Paradeiso kai otidepote allo kalo) gia sas. Kai otan eipothei s' esas <<Sekotheite>> (gia opoiodepote thema kalo gia sas), sekotheite. O Allakh tha exupsosei se bathmo amoibes kai euaresteses osous apo sas pisteuoun kai ekeinous stous opoious ekhei dothei gnose. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan (thelete na) sunomilesete idiotika me ton Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant, gia na ton sumbouleuteite gia kapoio thema), parousiaste mia eleemosune (stous phtokhous) prin apo ten idiaitere sunomilia (diabouleuse) sas. Auto tha einai kalutero kai pio agno gia sas (giati ekhei amoibe kai exagnizei tis kardies sas apo tis amarties). Ma an de breite (ta mesa gia ten eleemosune), tote st' aletheia o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Phobasthe (apo te phtokheia) na parousiasete mia eleemosune prin apo ten idiotike sunomilia (diabouleuse) sas (me ton Prophete); An omos den to kanete, kai o Allakh sas sugkhoresei (epeide sas epetrepse na men parousiasete eleemosune otan den breite ta mesa), tote (toulakhiston) teleite ten proseukhe kai doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai upakouste ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Den ekheis dei (o, Mokhammant) autous (tous upokrites) pou pairnoun os kedemones (kai philous) enan lao (tous Ebraious) pano ston opoio brisketai e Orge tou Allakh (metapherontas s' autous ta mustika ton piston); Autoi den einai oute apo sas (tous Mousoulmanous), oute ap' autous (tous Ebraious). Kai orkizontai pseudos (oti einai Mousoulmanoi kai oti pisteuoun s' esena os Prophete), eno gnorizoun (oti lene psemata).
O Allakh ekhei etoimasei gi' autous ena austero marturio. Pragmati, polu kako etan auto pou ekanan.
Ekanan tous (pseutikous) orkous tous propetasma (gia tis kakes tous praxeis). Etsi, empodisan (tous anthropous) apo to Dromo tou Allakh (to Islam): gi' auto tha laboun ena tapeinotiko marturio.
Oute o ploutos tous, oute ta paidia tous tha apotrepsoun tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh gi' autous. Ekeinoi tha einai oi katoikoi tou Puros, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta.

Ten Emera pou o Allakh tha tous anastesei olous mazi (gia apologismo)* kai tha orkistoun s' Auton (oti etan pistoi) opos orkizontai (tora) s' esas (o, Mousoulmanoi). Kai nomizoun oti stekontai se kati (upothetontas oti ta psemata tous tha ginoun pisteuta), alla st' aletheia, autoi einai oi pseutes!
O Satanas tous ekhei kurieusei. Etsi tous ekane na xekhasoun te mnemoneuse tou Allakh. Ekeinoi einai oi opadoi tou Satana, kai pragmati, oi opadoi tou Satana einai oi ettemenoi!
Autoi pou antitithentai ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) briskontai anamesa stous pio tapeinomenous (sten egkosmia kai ste Mellousa Zoe).
O Allakh egrapse (sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud): <<St' aletheia, tha nikeso Ego kai oi Aggeliaphoroi Mou.>> Pragmati, o Allakh einai Kaouei (Paniskhuros) kai 'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos).

Den tha breis (o, Mokhammant) kanenan lao pou pisteuei ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera, na agapa ekeinous pou antitithentai (kai deikhnoun ekhthroteta) ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, akoma ki an einai pateres tous, gioi tous, adelphoi tous e suggeneis tous. Gi' autous (tous pistous, o Allakh) ekhei grapsei (kai statheropoiesei) ten piste stis kardies tous, kai tous ekhei uposterixei me nike (pou proerkhetai) ap' Auton, kai (ste Mellousa Zoe) tha tous eisagei se kepous (ton Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. O Allakh einai eukharistemenos m' autous, kai ekeinoi einai eukharistemenoi ap' Auton (ap' ola auta pou tous dinei). Ekeinoi einai oi opadoi tou Allakh, kai pragmati, oi opadoi tou Allakh einai oi epitukhemenoi.
Otidepote brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge, doxazei ton Allakh. Kai Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos) kai o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Einai Autos pou edioxe ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste apo ton lao tou Bibliou (tous Ebraious tes phules ton Mpani An-Nanteir), apo ta spitia tous (ste Mantina) kata ten prote sugkentrose (opou ephugan pros ten palia Suria, kai auto epeide prodosan te sumphonia eirenes tous me ton Prophete, prospathontas na ton skotosoun kai kanontas summakhia me tous eidololatres enantion ton Mousoulmanon). Den nomizate (o, Mousoulmanoi) oti tha ebgainan (apo ta spitia tous logo tes dunames tous). Kai ekeinoi nomizan oti ta okhura tous tha tous prostateuan apo ton Allakh. Alla e Orge tou Allakh tous ephtase apo ekei pou den ten perimenan. Kai (o Allakh) erixe ton tromo stis kardies tous, kai etsi, autoi katestrepsan tis katoikies tous me ta dika tous kheria (epeide o Prophetes tous epetrepse na parei o kathenas tous o,ti mporei na koubalesei e kamela tou) kai ta kheria ton piston. Labete loipon mathema (kai proeidopoiese), o, eseis pou ekhete orase (gia na deite).
Kai an den egraphe (ekrine) o Allakh ten exoria gi' autous, tha tous timorouse sigoura s' auton ton kosmo* kai ste Mellousa Zoe tha ekhoun to marturio tou Puros.
Auto epeide antitakhthekan (me ekhthroteta) ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou. Kai opoios antitithetai ston Allakh, tote st' aletheia, o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria Tou.

Kamia khourmadia (tou ekhthrou) den ten kopsate (o, Mousoulmanoi), oute ten aphesate na steketai stis rizes tes, para mono me ten Adeia tou Allakh, (epeide oi Ebraioi erikhnan bele kai petres apo pano apo ta okhura tous, kai oi khourmadies tous boethousan s' auto), kai gia na tapeinosei (o Allakh) tous anupakouous.

Kai o,ti o Allakh parakhorese os laphura khoris makhe (Al-Phai') ston Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) ap' autous (tous Ebraious ton Mpani An-Nanteir pou aphesan ta pragmata tous, meta apo ten poliorkia tous apo tous Mousoulmanous) - auta den ta apoktesate kabalontas kanena alogo, oute kamia kamela (del. khoris makhe). Ma o Allakh dinei duname stous Aggeliaphorous Tou pano s' opoion thelei. Kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

Auta pou o Allakh parakhorese os laphura khoris makhe (Al-Phai') ston Aggeliaphoro Tou, apo tous laous ton komopoleon, auta proorizontai gia ton Allakh, ton Aggeliaphoro Tou (del. na xodeuontai pros to sumpheron ton Mousoulmanon), tous suggeneis (tou Aggeliaphorou, apo tous Mpani Khasim kai tous Mpani Al-Mouttalimp, stous opoious o Prophetes eikhe apagorepsei na dekhontai na paroun te Zaka), ta orphana, tous endeeis, kai ton odoiporo (ton xeno pou ta khremata tou ekhoun exantlethei), etsi oste na me ginoun (ta khremata mia) periousia pou tha kuklophorei (apokleistika) stous plousious anamesa sas (kai okhi stous phtokhous). Kai o,ti sas dinei o Aggeliaphoros (kai sas diatazei) na to labete (kai na to kanete)* kai o,ti sas apagoreuei, na to stamatesete. Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou). Pragmati, o Allakh einai Austeros sten timoria (Tou).

(Kai epises uparkhei ena meridio s' auta ta laphura) gia tous phtokhous metanastes (pou metanasteusan apo te Makka pros te Mantina), oi opoioi exoristekan apo ta spitia tous kai ten idioktesia tous (apo tous apistous tes Makkas), epidiokontas khare apo ton Allakh kai ten euarestese (Tou), kai uposterizontas ton Allakh (del. ten threskeia Tou) kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou. Autoi einai, pragmati, oi eilikrineis.

Kai autoi (oi Al-Ansar -oi Uposteriktes- oi katoikoi tes Mantinas) pou egkatastathekan ste Mantina kai eikhan dekhtei ten piste prin ap' autous (del. prin na metanasteusoun oi metanastes -Moukhatzerein- pros autous). Agapoun ekeinous pou metanasteuoun pros autous kai den ekhoun zelia sta stethe tous gia o,ti ekhei dothei s' autous (tous Moukhatzerein apo ta laphura ton Mpani An-Nanteir), kai bazoun se proteraioteta autous (tous Moukhatzerein) prin apo tous eautous tous, akoma ki an ekhoun anagke (kai phtokheia). Kai opoios sozetai apo te dikia tou aplestia, autoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

Kai autoi (apo tis epomenes genies) pou erthan meta ap' autous (tous Al-Ansar kai tous Al-Moukhatzerein, kai akolouthoun ta bemata tous mekhri ten Emera tes Kriseos), lene: <<Kurie mas! Sugkhorese mas kai ta adelphia mas pou proegethekan apo mas sten piste, kai me baleis stis kardies mas kanena misos enantia stous pistous. Kurie mas! Eisai pragmati Ra'ouph (Poluepieikes) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Ma den eides (o, Mokhammant) tous upokrites pou eipan st' adelphia tous pou arnethekan ten piste apo to lao tou Bibliou (del. tous Ebraious ton Mpani An-Nantir): <<Ean exoristeite (apo tous Mousoulmanous), (tote tha sas uposterixoume kai) tha phugoume mazi sas kai den tha upakousoume pote kanenan skhetika m' esas (pou tha mas pei na me sas uposterixoume kai na me phugoume mazi sas)* kai an sas polemesoun, tha sas uposterixoume.>> Ma o Allakh martura oti autoi einai pseutes (s' auta pou uposkhethekan).

Pragmati, an (oi Ebraioi ton mpani An-Nantir) exoristoun, den tha phugoun (oi upokrites) mazi tous (opos tous uposkhethekan)* kai an polemethoun, pote den tha tous uposterixoun. Akoma kai an tous uposterixoun, (oi upokrites) tha tous gurisoun ten plate (kai tha trapoun se phuge ettemenoi), kai epeita den tha boethethoun.

(O, Mousoulmanoi,) pragmati, eseis empneete megalutero phobo sta stethe tous (ton upokriton) ap' o,ti phobo ekhoun pros ton Allakh. Auto giati einai enas laos pou den katanoei (te Megaleioteta kai te Duname tou Allakh).

Den tha sas polemoun oute kan oloi mazi (enomenoi), ektos se okhuromenes komopoleis, e piso apo teikhe. E ekhthroteta anamesa tous einai megale. Tous nomizeis enomenous, alla (st' aletheia) oi kardies tous diapheroun metaxu tous. Auto giati einai enas laos pou den sullogizetai.

(Oi Ebraioi ton Mpani An-Nantir) moiazoun (se o,ti epathan apo ten timoria tou Allakh) m' ekeinous pou etan ligo prin ap' autous (del. tous apistous tes Makkas kai tous Ebraious ton Mpani Kainouka')* geutekan ta kaka apotelesmata tes apistias tous, kai (ste Mellousa zoe) tha ekhoun odunero marturio.

(To paradeigma ton upokriton pou deleasan tous Ebraious ton Mpani An-Nantir oste na polemesoun ton Prophete, kai tous uposkhethekan na tous uposterixoun, einai) san to paradeigma tou Satana, otan eipe ston anthropo (gia na ton deleasei): <<Arnesou ten piste.>> Ma otan (o anthropos) arnetheke ten piste, tote (o Satanas) eipe: <<Eimai athoos apo tis praxeis sou, st' aletheia, phobamai ton Allakh, ton Kurio olon ton kosmon (tes anthropotetas, ton tzinn kai olon oson uparkhoun)!
Kai etsi, to telos kai ton duo (tou Satana kai autou pou ton upakouse) einai oti tha brethoun sto Pur, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. Kai aute einai e poine ton adikon.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou). Kai as sullogistei kathe psukhe ti ekhei kanei (apo kales kai kakes praxeis) gia aurio (gia te Mellousa Zoe). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh. Pragmati, o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Kai men eiste san ekeinous pou xekhasan ton Allakh (kai den Ton upakousan), kai etsi, (o Allakh) tous ekane na xekhasoun ton eauto tous (kai na xekhasoun na kanoun enaretes praxeis pou tha tous sosoun ten Emera tes Anastases). Pragmati, ekeinoi einai oi anupakouoi.
Den einai isaxioi oi katoikoi tou Puros me tous katoikous tou Paradeisou. Pragmati, oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou einai oi kerdismenoi.

Pragmati, an eikhame steilei auto to Kor'an se ena bouno, tha to eblepes (to bouno para ole te duname tou) tapeinomeno kai ragismeno apo phobo pros ton Allakh. Tetoia paradeigmata dinoume stous anthropous, mepos kai na ta analogistoun.

Autos einai o Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Pantognostes ton aoraton kai ton oraton. Einai o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), o Ar-Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

Autos einai o Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos, o Al-Malek (Basileus ton olon), o Al-Kountous (o Ierotatos kai Upsistos), o As-Salam (Autos pou den ekhei kamia ateleia), o Al-Mou'men (Autos pou epibebaionei tous Prophetes Tou me thaumata kai semadia), o Al-Moukhaimen (o Parateretes pano sta demiourgemata Tou), o Al-'Azeiz (o Aniketos, o Pantodunamos), o Al-Tzampar (Autos pou upetaxe ola ta demiourgemata Tou pros Auton), o Al-Moutakampir (o Uperephanos gia te Megaloprepeia Tou). Doxa ston Allakh, einai polu Anoteros apo o,ti Tou apodidoun os etairous.

Autos einai o Allakh, o Al-Khalik (o Demiourgos), o Al-Mpari' (Autos pou ephere ta demiourgemata Tou sten uparxia apo ten anuparxia), o Al-Mousaoir (Autos pou edose morphe sta demiourgemata Tou). S' Auton anekoun ta Al-Asma' Al-Khousna (ta Omorphotera Onomata). Kai o,ti brisketai stous Ouranous kai ste ge Ton doxazoun. Kai Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (o Aniketos, o Pantodunamos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men pairnete tous ekhthrous Mou kai tous ekhthrous sas (apo tous polutheistes tes Makkas) os philous (opos ekane o Khatimp mpin Ampi Mpalta'a pou tous esteile ena gramma pou perieikhe kapoia nea ton Mousoulmanon, phoboumenos gia ten oikogeneia tou ste Makka). Tous deikhnete philia, eno autoi arnethekan ten Aletheia pou erthe se sas, kai ekdioxan ton Aggeliaphoro (Mokhammant) kai esas tous idious (apo ta spitia sas ste Makka), mono kai mono epeide pisteuete ston Allakh, ton Kurio sas;! An ekhete bgei gia na (metanasteusete apo te Makka pros te Mantina, kai na) polemesete sto Dromo Mou kai epidiokontas ten Euarestese Mou, (tote men tous pairnete os philous). Tous deikhnete philia krupha, eno Ego gnorizo osa sugkaluptete kai osa phaneronete! Kai opoios apo sas to prattei, tote pragmati ekhei parastratesei apo ton Isio Dromo.

An sas nikesoun, tha ginoun polu ekhthrikoi enantion sas, kai tha aplonoun ta kheria tous kai tis glosses tous s' esas me to kako (phono, aikhmalosia kai prosboles). Kai epithumoun na arnetheite ten piste.

Oute oi suggeneis sas, oute ta paidia sas, tha sas ophelesoun (ten Emera tes Anastases, gi' auto men pairnete tous apistous os philous gia na prostatepsete tous suggeneis sas ste Makka, opos ekane o Khatimp mpin Ampi Mpalta'a). Ten Emera tes Anastases (o Allakh) tha dikasei metaxu sas. Ki o Allakh blepei o,ti kanete.

Pragmati, uparkhei ena exairetiko paradeigma gia sas ston Impraem (Abraam) kai s' ekeinous pou etan mazi tou (tous pistous), otan eipan ston lao tous: <<St' aletheia, aparnoumaste esas kai o,ti latreuete ektos apo ton Allakh: aporriptoume esas (del. ten apistia sas), kai metaxu emon kai umon ekhei emphanistei ekhthra kai misos gia panta mekhri na pistepsete ston Allakh kai mono.>> -Ektos apo (auto to paradeigma) ta logia tou Impraem ston (apisto) patera tou: <<Pragmati, tha zeteso sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) gia sena, alla den mporo na apotrepso tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh gia esena.>> (kai auta ta logia ta eikhe pei o Impraem prin na epibebaiothei oti o pateras tou einai ekhthros tou Allakh, alla epeita ton aperripse). <<Kurie mas! S' Sena (kai mono) enapothetoume ten empistosune mas (gia oles tis upotheseis mas), kai (mono) s' Sena strephomaste me metameleia, kai (mono) s' Sena brisketai o telikos proorismos (mas, ten Emera tes Anastases).

Kurie mas! Me mas kaneis os dokimasia gia tous apistous (del. men tous kaneis na mas nikesoun kai etsi na poun <<An autoi briskontan ston isio dromo, den tha tous nikousame.>> kai etsi na auxethei e apistia tous), kai sugkhorese mas. Kurie mas! St' aletheia, Esu eisai o Al-'Azeiz (o Aniketos, o Pantodunamos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Pragmati, ekhete ena exairetiko paradeigma s' autous (gia na to akoloutheite, ston Imprakhem -Abraam- kai stous pistous pou etan mazi tou), -gia opoion epithumei to kalo apo ton Allakh kai ten Eskhate Emera. Alla opoios apomakrunthei (apo to na akolouthesei to paradeigma tou Imprakhem, pairnontas tous apistous os philous kai summakhous), tote st' aletheia, o Allakh einai o Al-Ganei (Plousios, Eleutheros apo kathe anagke), o Al-Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

Isos o Allakh na kanei philia metaxu esas kai ekeinon pou ekhete os ekhthrous ap' autous (del. na anoixei tis kardies tous sto Islam). Kai o Allakh einai Kanteir (Ikanos gia ta panta), kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Allakh den sas apagoreuei na sumperiphereste me kalosune kai dikaia s' ekeinous (tous apistous) pou den sas polemesan exaitias tes threskeias, oute sas ekdioxan apo ta spitia sas. St' aletheia, o Allakh agapa tous dikaious.

Sas apagoreuei omos o Allakh, autous pou sas polemesan exaitias tes threskeias, kai sas ekdioxan apo ta spitia sas, kai boethesan sten ekdioxe sas, na tous pairnete os philous kai summakhous. Kai opoioi tous pairnoun os philous kai summakhous, tote einai oi adikoi (kai oi anupakouoi pros ton Allakh).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan oi pistes gunaikes erkhontai s' esas os metanastes (apo te Makka pros te Mantina), na tis exetasete (kai na tis dokimasete gia na mathete an einai pragmati pistes)* o Allakh gnorizei kalutera gia ten piste tous. Epeita, an bebaiotheite oti einai pragmatika pistes, men tis steilete piso stous apistous (suzugous). Den einai nomimes (suzugoi) gi' ekeinous, oute ekeinoi einai nomimoi (suzugoi) gi' autes. Kai doste tous (del. stous apistous suzugous) o,ti edosan apo proikes. Kai den tha uparkhei kamia amartia s' esas an tis pantreuteite, me ten proupothese na tous dosete tis proikes tous. Kai men kratesete tis apistes gunaikes os suzugous, kai zeteste piso tis proikes pou tous eikhate dosei. Kai apheste ekeinous (tous apistous) na zetesoun piso o,ti eikhan dosei apo proikes. Aute einai e Krise tou Allakh, e opoia krinei metaxu sas (anaphorika m' auto to thema). Kai o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai an kapoies apo tis suzugous sas (apostatesan) kai sas aphesan kai pegan stous apistous (kai oi apistoi arnethekan na sas epistrepsoun tis proikes pou tous eikhate dosei), kai epeita nikesete (tous apistous se mia makhe)* tote doste (apo ta laphura) s' autous ton opoion oi gunaikes tous eikhan egkataleipsei, ena poso iso me tis proikes pou eikhan dosei. Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou), ston Opoion pisteuete.

O, Prophete! Otan oi pistes gunaikes erkhontai s' esena gia na sou uposkhethoun oti den tha apodidoun ston Allakh etairous ste latreia, oute tha kleboun, oute tha diaprattoun moikheia, oute tha skotosoun ta paidia tous (opos ekanan prin to Islam apo to phobo tes phtokheias klp.), oute tha apodidoun pseudos stous suzugous tous paidia pou den einai dika tous, kai oute tha se parakoun otidepote kalo (pou tous diatazeis), tote dexou ten uposkhese tous, kai zeta apo ton Allakh sugkhorese gi' autes. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O, eseis pou pisteuete, men pairnete os philous kai summakhous, enan lao pano ston opoio brisketai e Orge tou Allakh, oi opoioi ekhoun apelpistei apo (to na laboun otidepote kalo kata) te Mellousa Zoe, opos akribos oi thammenoi apistoi ekhoun apelpistei (apo to na laboun to Eleos tou Allakh, e na gurisoun piso sten egkosmia zoe oste na praxoun dikaia).
Otidepote brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge doxazei ton Allakh. Kai Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Giati lete auta pou den kanete; (opos to na men ekplerosei kapoios ten uposkhese tou e na nouthetesei tous allous gia mia kale praxe, eno o idios den ten kanei).
Einai polu miseto gia ton Allakh, na lete auta pou den kanete.

St' aletheia, o Allakh agapa ekeinous pou polemoun sto Dromo Tou se seira (parataxe) san na einai enas paratetagmenos toikhos (del. oi stratiotes einai o enas dipla ston allo, skhematizontas enan adiaspasto toikho).

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant), otan o Mouses eipe ston lao tou: <<O, lae mou! Giati me blaptete (me logia kai praxeis) eno gnorizete oti eimai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh gia sas;>> Etsi, otan apeklinan (apo ten Aletheia), o Allakh apekline tis kardies tous (apo to na dekhontai ten Kathodegese). Kai o Allakh den kathodegei ton anupakouo lao.

Kai (anaphere, o, Mokhammant), otan o Iesous, uios tes Marias, eipe: <<O, paidia tou Israel! Eimai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh gia sas, epibebaionontas ten Tora pou staltheke prin apo mena, kai (sas) anaggello ta eukharista nea (tes eleuses) enos Aggeliaphorou pou tha elthei meta apo mena, to onoma tou opoiou tha einai Akhmant [ena akoma onoma tou Prophete Mokhammant].>> Ma otan ekeinos (o Akhmant -Mokhammant-) elthe s' autous me xekathares apodeixeis, eipan: <<Aute einai xekathare mageia.>>
Kai poios einai pio adikos ap' auton pou mekhaneuetai pseude gia ton Allakh (apodidontas ston Allakh etairous ste latreia), eno kaleitai sto Islam; Kai o Allakh den kathodegei ton adiko lao.
Theloun na sbesoun to Phos tou Allakh (to Kor'an) me ta stomata tous (kai ta psemata tous). Ma o Allakh tha oloklerosei to Phos Tou (te threskeia Tou), akoma ki an oi apistoi to misoun.

Autos einai pou esteile ton Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) me ten kathodegese (to Kor'an) kai te threskeia tes Aletheias (to Islam) gia na ten exupsosei pano apo oles tis alles threskeies, akoma ki an oi eidololatres (to) misoun.
O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na sas odegeso se ena emporio pou tha sas sosei apo ena epipono marturio;

Na pisteuete ston Allakh kai ston Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) kai na agonizeste sto Dromo tou Allakh me ta ploute kai ton eauto sas: Auto einai kalutero gia sas (apo to emporio sten egkosmia zoe), an to gnorizate!

(An praxete etsi, tote o Allakh) tha sugkhoresei gia sas tis amarties sas, kai tha sas eisagei se kepous (Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, kai se kales katoikies stous kepous monimes diamones (Paradeiso). Pragmati, aute einai e spoudaia nike.

Epises kai alle (mia eunoia apo ton Allakh tha labete), ten opoia agapate -te nike apo ton Allakh (apenanti stous ekhthrous sas) kai mia epikeimene epanaktese (tes Makkas). Anaggeile loipon (o, Mokhammant) ta kala nea stous pistous (nike kai boetheia sten egkosmia zoe kai ste Mellousa Zoe ton Paradeiso).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Na eiste uposteriktes (ste threskeia) tou Allakh, opos eipe o Iesous, o uios tes Marias, stous mathetes tou: <<Poioi einai oi uposteriktes mou (ste threskeia) tou Allakh;>> Oi mathetes eipan: <<Emeis eimaste oi uposteriktes (ste threskeia) tou Allakh.>> Etsi, mia omada apo ta paidia tou Israel pistepse, eno mia alle omada arnetheke ten piste. Etsi, uposterixame autous pou pistepsan kata ton ekhthron tous, kai etsi eginan niketes (anoteroi).

Otidepote brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge doxazei ton Allakh, ton Al-Malek (ton Basilea ton panton), ton Al-Kountous (ton Ierotato, ton Anotero apo otidepote den Tou tairiazei), ton Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamo, Aniketo), ton Al-Khakeim (Pansopho).

Autos einai pou esteile anamesa stous agrammatous (Arabes pou oute exeran graphe oute eikhan ena Biblio apo ton Allakh) enan Aggeliaphoro (ton Mokhammant) apo tous idious (kai gia olous tous anthropous). Tous apaggellei ta Edaphia Tou (to Kor'an), tous exagnizei (apo ten apistia), kai tous didaskei to Biblio (to Kora'n) kai te sophia (ten Sounna -paradose- tou Prophete Mokhammant). Kai st' aletheia, autoi prin (apo ten apostole tou) briskontan se xekathare plane*

Kai (epises gia na dosei ta parapano ophele kai se) allous ap' autous (tous Mousoulmanous, eite Arabes eite me), pou den tous prolaban (del. den ekhoun gennethei akome). Kai Autos (o Allakh) einai o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).
Aute (del. e apostole tou Mokhammant) einai e eunoia tou Allakh, ten opoia parakhorei s' opoion Autos thelei (apo tous doulous Tou). Kai o Allakh einai o Katokhos tes megales gennaiodorias.

To paradeigma auton pou phortothekan ten (upokhreose tes) Tora (del. na upakoun tis entoles tes), alla epeita den ten koubalesan (del. den epharmozan tous nomous tes), einai san ekeino enos gaidarou pou koubala biblia (kai den xerei ti periekhoun). Poso athlio einai to paradeigma tou laou pou diapseudei ta Edaphia tou Allakh. Kai o Allakh den kathodegei ton adiko lao.

Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, eseis oi Ebraioi! An iskhurizeste (pseudos) oti eiste oi agapetoi tou Allakh, apokleiontas tous allous anthropous, tote eukhetheite to thanato (oste na pate pio gregora ston Paradeiso), an eiste eilikrineis (ston iskhurismo sas).>>
Kai de tha ton eukhethoun (to thanato) pote (phoboumenoi ten timoria tou Allakh) exaitias auton (ton kakon praxeon) pou eikhan kanei ta kheria tous. Ki o Allakh gnorizei polu kala tous adikous.

Pes (tous): <<St' aletheia, o thanatos ap' ton opoio drapeteuete, tha sas sunantesei oposdepote (otan erthei e ora sas), kai epeita (ten Emera tes Kriseos) tha epistrepsete ston (Allakh, ton) Pantognoste ton aoraton kai ton oraton kai epeita tha sas enemerosei gia o,ti kanate (sten egkosmia zoe).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Otan ginetai e klese (Adan) gia ten proseukhe tes Paraskeues (Al-Tzoumou'a), speuste gia te mnemoneuse tou Allakh (del. gia na akousete to kerugma kai na telesete ten proseukhe). Kai apheste tis sunallages. Auto einai kalutero gia sas, an to gnorizete!

Ki otan teleiosei e proseukhe (tes Paraskeues), tote skorpisteite ste ge (opou thelete) kai epidioxte apo ten gennaiodoria tou Allakh (douleuontas klp.). Kai na mnemoneuete polu ton Allakh, isos kai na epitukhete.

Ki otan doun (kapoioi Mousoulmanoi) kapoia emporike sunallage e kapoia diaskedase pegainoun s' auta, kai se aphenoun (o, Mokhammant) na stekesai orthios (eno paradideis to kerugma tes Paraskeues). Pes: <<Auto pou ekhei o Allakh (apo amoibe gia sas) einai kalutero apo opoiadepote diaskedase kai apo opoiadepote emporike sunallage! Ki o Allakh einai o Kaluteros auton pou parekhoun mesa kai agatha bioporismou.

(O, Mokhammant) otan oi upokrites erkhontai s' esena, lene (mono me tis glosses tous): <<Marturoume oti pragmati eisai o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh.>> O Allakh gnorizei oti eisai (bebaia) o Aggeliaphoros Tou, kai o Allakh martura oti oi upokrites einai pseutes (pou lene me tis glosses tous auto pou den uparkhei stis kardies tous).

Ekanan tous orkous tous (oti einai pistoi, os) propetasma (gia ten upokrisia tous). Kai etsi empodisan (tous anthropous) apo to dromo tou Allakh (meso ton amphibolion pou egeiroun). St' aletheia, athlio einai auto pou ekanan.
Auto epeide pistepsan (mono me tis glosses tous) kai epeita apistesan (mesa tous)* epomenos sphragistekan oi kardies tous, ki etsi den katalabainoun (poio einai to ophelos tous).

Otan tous blepeis (o, theate), thaumazeis to soma tous (kai tis morphes tous)* kai otan miloun, akous ta logia tous (logo tes euglottias tous). Alla autoi einai san kommatia xulou sterigmena (se enan toikho, epeide de mporoun na stathoun mona tous, kai einai kouphia apo mesa, khoris zoe, gnose e piste). Nomizoun pos kathe krauge einai enantion tous (logo tes megales deilias tous). (O, Aggeliaphore) autoi einai oi ekhthroi, gi' auto prosexe tous. As tous katarastei o Allakh. Pos apomakrunontai (apo ten piste aphou tous erthan oi xekathares apodeixeis);

Ki otan eipothei s' autous: <<Elate (metaniomenoi), oste o Aggeliaphoros tou Allakh na zetesei sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) gia sas.>>, autoi strephoun ta kephalia tous, kai tous blepeis (o, Prophete) na apomakrunontai (apo sena) eno einai alazones.
Einai to idio gi' autous, eite zeteseis (o, Mokhammant) sugkhorese gi' autous, eite de zeteseis, o Allakh de tha tous sugkhoresei pote. Pragmati, o Allakh den kathodegei ton anupakouo lao.

Einai autoi (oi upokrites) pou lene (stous katoikous tes Mantinas, tous Al-Ansar): <<Men xodeuete gi' autous pou einai mazi me ton Aggeliaphoro tou Allakh (pou metanasteusan apo te Makka pros te Mantina), mekhri na khoristoun ap' auton.>> Kai ston Allakh anekoun ta thesaurophulakia ton ouranon kai tes ges, ma oi upokrites den to katalabainoun.

Lene (del. o 'Ampnt Allakh impn Saloul, o arkhegos ton upokriton tes Mantinas, eipe): <<An epistrepsoume ste Mantina (apo te makhe tes Mpani Al-Moustalik), tha dioxei o dunatoteros (del. o idios me ten omada tou) ton pio adunamo (ton Prophete Mokhammant me ten omada tou)!>> Ma ole e duname (kai e doxa) anekoun mono ston Allakh, ston Aggeliaphoro Tou kai stous pistous, alla oi upokrites den to gnorizoun.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Men sas apospoun ta ploute sas kai ta paidia sas apo te mnemoneuse tou Allakh (ten proseukhe kai tis praxeis latreias). Kai opoios to kanei, tote ekeinoi tha einai oi khamenoi.

Kai xodepste (se philanthropia) apo osa sas parekhoume, prin erthei o thanatos se kapoion apo sas kai meta pei: <<Kurie mou! Makari na mou doseis anabole gia ligo akome, oste na doso eleemosune kai na eimai metaxu ton enareton.>>
Alla o Allakh den dinei anabole se kamia psukhe otan phtasei e prokathorismene ora tes. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

Otidepote brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge doxazei ton Allakh. S' Auton anekei e kuriarkhia, kai s' Auton anekoun oloi oi epainoi (kai e doxa kai oi eukharisties), ki Autos einai gia ta panta Ikanos.
Autos einai pou sas eplase, kai apo sas uparkhoun apistoi kai apo sas uparkhoun pistoi. Ki o Allakh blepei osa kanete.

Eplase tous ouranous kai te ge me ten aletheia (kai okhi mataia), kai sas edose morphe, kai ekane te morphe sas teleia (anamesa sta alla plasmata). Kai s' Auton brisketai o telikos proorismos (ton plasmaton).
Gnorizei ti brisketai stous ouranous kai ste ge, kai gnorizei ti sugkaluptete kai ti phaneronete. Ki o Allakh einai Pantognostes gia o,ti brisketai sta stethe (ton anthropon).

Den sas ephtase (o, eidololatres) e eidese auton pou arnethekan ten piste apo prin (apo ta proegoumena ethne); Etsi, geutekan to kako apotelesma tes apistias tous (sten egkosmia zoe), kai tha ekhoun (kata te Mellousa Zoe) ena epoduno marturio.

Auto (epathan) epeide erkhontousan s' autous oi Aggeliaphoroi tous me xekathares apodeixeis, ma ekeinoi eipan (arnoumenoi): <<Anthropoi pou tha mas kathodegesoun;>> Etsi arnethekan ten piste, kai straphekan makria (apo ten aletheia). Ma o Allakh den khreiazetai (autous, oute ten piste tous, oute ten upakoe tous). Kai o Allakh einai Ganei (Eleutheros apo kathe anagke, Plousios) kai Khameint (Axios kathe epainou).

Ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste iskhuristekan (pseudos) oti den tha anastethoun (gia na logodotesoun). Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Okhi, den iskhuei auto pou eipate! Alla, ma ton Kurio mou, bebaia tha anastetheite, kai epeita tha enemerotheite gia o,ti kanate (sten egkosmia zoe)* kai auto einai eukolo gia ton Allakh.>>
Pistepste (loipon, o, eidololatres) ston Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou (ton Mokhammant) kai sto Phos (to Kor'an) pou steilame. Kai o Allakh gia o,ti kanete ekhei aperioriste gnose.

(Kai anaphere, o, Mokhammant, gia) ten Emera pou tha sas sugkentrosei olous, ten Emera tes Sugkentroses -aute tha einai e Emera tes At-Tagampoun (tes apoleias ton apiston kai tou kerdous ton piston). Kai opoios pisteuei ston Allakh kai kanei enaretes praxeis, (o Allakh) tha ton exileosei apo tis amarties tou, kai tha ton eisagei stous kepous (Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei gia panta. Pragmati, aute tha einai e megale nike.

Ma autoi pou arnethekan ten piste kai diepseusan ta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) Mas, ekeinoi einai oi katoikoi tou Puros, opou tha katoikesoun ekei gia panta. Kai pragmati, autos einai o kheiroteros proorismos.

Kamia sumphora de sumbainei (se kanenan), para mono me ten Adeia tou Allakh (del. to Theio Pepromeno), kai opoios pisteuei ston Allakh (kai sto Theio Pepromeno), (o Allakh) tha kathodegesei ten kardia tou (sto na dekhtei to Theio Pepromeno). Kai o Allakh einai gia ta panta Pantognostes.

Kai upakouste (o, anthropoi) ton Allakh, kai upakouste ton Aggeliaphoro* an omos strapheite makria (apo to na upakousete ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou), tote to kathekon tou Aggeliaphorou Mas einai mono na diabibasei (to Menuma) xekathara.
Allakh! Den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Kai ston Allakh as enapothetoun oi pistoi ten empistosune tous (gi' oles tis upotheseis tous).

O, eseis pou pisteuete! St' aletheia, anamesa stis suzugous sas kai ta paidia sas uparkhoun ekhthroi gia sas (pou mporei na sas apotrepsoun apo ten upakoe pros ton Allakh)* etsi, prosexte tous (kai men tous upakousete)! Ma an parablepete (ta lathe tous), den tous timoreite (gia auta), kai (ta) sugkhoreite (kaluptontas ta), tote pragmati, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
St' aletheia, o ploutos sas kai ta paidia sas einai mono mia dokimasia gia sas (pou mporei na sas kanei na aphesete ten upakoe pros ton Allakh). Kai o Allakh ekhei spoudaia amoibe (ton Paradeiso).

Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh oso mporeite (meso tes tereses ton entolon Tou)* kai na akoute (ton Prophete), na upakoute (tis entoles tou) kai na xodeuete (se eleemosune), auto einai kalutero gia sas. Ki opoios sozetai apo te dikia tou aplestia, autoi einai oi epitukhemenoi.

Ean daneisete ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas gia khare tou Allakh se kathe kalo dromo), (o Allakh) tha to pollaplasiasei gia sas (del. ten amoibe tou), kai tha sas sugkhoresei (gia tis amarties sas). Ki o Allakh einai Sakour (Eugnomon gi' autous pou xodeuoun gia khare Tou kai tous antameibei me ten kalutere amoibe), kai einai Khaleim (Makrothumos).
(O Allakh einai) o Pantognostes ton aoraton kai ton oraton, o Al-'Azeiz (Pantodunamos, Aniketos), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

O, Prophete! An (eseis oi pistoi apophasisete na) dosete diazugio stis gunaikes (sas), tote doste tous to diazugio te stigme pou mporoun na xekinesoun te dike tous 'EInta [del. ten orismene periodo anamones kata ten opoia e gunaika den mporei na pantreutei allon. Ksekinaei apo te stigme pou o suzugos anakoinonei to diazugio prophorika, me ten proupothese e suzugos na me brisketai se emmeno ruse te stigme tes anakoinoses kai na men ekhei o suzugos sexoualike epaphe mazi tes apo ten teleutaia emmeno ruse tes, oste na einai sigouroi an einai egkuos e okhi]. Kai na metrate me akribeia ten (periodo tes)'EInta (isos kata ten periodo aute o suzugos na thelesei na epistrepsei te suzugo tou ston eggamo bio). Kai na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria tou Allakh, ton Kurio sas (ektelontas tis entoles Tou). Men tis diokhnete apo ta spitia tous (kata ten 'EInta) (del. e suzugos ekhei to dikaioma diamones sto spiti tou suzugou tes, kai den mporei na te dioxei), oute oi idies na to egkataleipsoun (kata ten 'EInta), ektos an einai enokhes gia mia phanere aiskhre praxe (paranome sunousia). Auta einai ta oria (nomoi) pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, kai opoios parabei ta oria pou tethekan apo ton Allakh, tote pragmati ekhei adikesei ton eauto tou. Esu (pou pairneis diazugio apo te gunaika sou) de gnorizeis (ti mporei na sumbei), isos o Allakh kanei epeita apo auto (to diazugio) kati (pou den to perimeneis, opos e ananeomene epithumia gia te suzugo).

Kai otan (prokeitai suntoma na) sumplerothei o orismenos khronos tous, eite na tis kratesete (ston eggamo bio) me kalo tropo (kai na tous phereste kallista), eite na khorisete mazi tous me kalo tropo (dinontas tous ola ta dikaiomata tous). Kai parte os martures duo dikaious andres apo sas (Mousoulmanous). Kai martureste (o, martures) gia khare ton Allakh. M' auto (pou sas diatazei o Allakh) tha labei nouthesia opoios pisteuei ston Allakh kai sten Eskhate Emera. Kai opoios phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis Entoles Tou), (o Allakh) tha tou kanei diexodo (luse gia kathe duskolia).

Kai (o Allakh) tha paraskhei gi' auton (agatha) apo opou den to perimenei. Ki opoios basizetai ston Allakh, tote (o Allakh) einai Eparkes gi' auton. St' aletheia, o Allakh tha ektelesei ten entole Tou. Pragmati, o Allakh orise gia kathe pragma enan orismeno khrono.

Kai oso gia tis gunaikes sas sten emmenopause, gi' autes - an amphiballete - e 'EInta (periodos anamones) tous einai treis menes* (to idio) kai gi' autes pou den ekhoun akome emmeno ruse. Kai oso gi' autes pou einai egkues, e 'EInta (orismene periodos anamones) tous einai mekhri na gennesoun. Kai opoios phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis Entoles Tou), (o Allakh) tha tou dieukolunei oles tis upotheseis tou.

Aute einai e entole tou Allakh (skhetika me to diazugio kai ten 'EInta), ten opoia ekhei steilei s' esas* kai opoios phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis Entoles Tou), (o Allakh) tha ton exileosei apo tis amarties tou, kai tha megalosei ten amoibe tou.

Apheste tes (tis diazeugmenes gunaikes kata te diarkeia tes periodou anamones tous) na katoikesoun opou katoikeite, analoga me ta mesa sas. Kai men tis enokhleite gia na kanete te diamone tous aphorete (gia na phugoun). Ki an einai egkues, na xodepsete gi' autes mekhri na gennesoun. Kai an (aphou gennesan) thelazan ta paidia (tous apo) sas, doste tous antamoibe gi' auto, kai na sumbouleuteite o enas ton allon me kalosune. Ma an duskoleuteite (kai den sumphoneite) metaxu sas (epeide e metera arneitai na thelasei to moro gi' opoiodepote logo), tote as tou (to) thelasei kapoia alle gunaika.

As xodeuei o eukatastatos andras (gia te khorismene gunaika tou kai gia to paidi tou) sumphona me te dunatoteta tou. Oso gi' ekeinon me periorismenous porous, as xodeuei sumphona me o,ti tou ekhei dosei o Allakh. O Allakh den epibarunei kamia psukhe pera ap' auto pou tes ekhei dosei. O Allakh tha pherei meta apo te duskolia dieukolunse.

Kai poses komopoleis (plethusmoi) parakousan (alazonika) ten Entole tou Kuriou tous kai ton Aggeliaphoron Tou* kai etsi, tous pherame gia sklere logodotese (gia tis kakes tous praxeis), kai tous timoresame me tromero marturio.
Kai etsi geutekan ta kaka apotelesmata tes sumperiphoras (apistias) tous, kai to apotelesma tes sumperiphoras (apistias) tous etan e apoleia.

O Allakh ekhei proetoimasei gi' autous ena austero marturio. Phulakhtheite, loipon, apo ten timoria tou Allakh (terontas tis entoles Tou), o, eseis pou ekhete nou, kai ekhete pistepsei! Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei, steilei kato s' esas mia Upenthumise.

(Kai aute e Upenthumise einai) enas Aggeliaphoros (o Mokhammant), pou sas apaggellei ta Edaphia tou Allakh (to Kor'an), ta opoia diasaphenizoun (gia sas ten aletheia apo to pseudos), oste (o Allakh) na bgalei osous pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis apo to skotadi, sto phos. Kai opoios pisteuei ston Allakh kai kanei enaretes praxeis, (o Allakh) tha ton eisagei stous kepous (Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha katoikesoun ekei mesa gia panta. Pragmati, o Allakh ekhei khoregesei s' auton (ton pisto) mia exairetike gennaiodoria (ston Paradeiso).

O Allakh einai Autos pou eplase epta ouranous, kai omoios gia te ge (epta). E Entole Tou katebainei anamesa tous (tous ouranous kai te ge), gia na mathete oti o Allakh einai gia ta panta Ikanos, kai oti o Allakh periballei ta panta me te Gnose (Tou).

O, Prophete! Giati apagoreueis (ston eauto sou) auto pou o Allakh sou ekhei epitrepsei; Epizetontas ten euarestese ton suzugon sou. Kai o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).

O Allakh ekhei thespisei gia sas ten exileose gia tous (anekplerotous) orkous sas [del. na taIsei kaneis deka phtokhous, na tous dosei roukha e na apeleutherosei enan sklabo, an omos den ekhei te dunatoteta na kanei kati ap' auta, tote as nestepsei gia treis meres]. Kai o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes sas, kai Autos einai o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Khakeim (Pansophos).

Kai otan o Prophetes ekmustereuteke ena zetema se mia apo tis suzugous tou (te Khaphsa), kai ekeine to eipe (sten AIsa)* kai o Allakh to phanerose s' auton* (tote o Prophetes) eipe (ste Khaphsa) ena meros (apo ta logia pou aute eipe sten AIsa) kai apephuge (na tes pei) ena allo meros (apo eugeneia). Kai otan (o Prophetes) tes to eipe, ekeine (e Khaphsa) eipe: <<Poios sou to eipe auto;>> Ekeinos eipe: <<Mou to eipe o Al-'Aleim (Pantognostes), o Al-Khampeir (Autos pou ekhei aperioriste Gnose).>>

An eseis oi duo (suzugoi tou Prophete, e AIsa kai e Khaphsa), strapheite me metameleia ston Allakh (gi' auto pou kanate, auto tha einai kalutero gia sas), epeide oi kardies sas eklinan (pros kati pou den arese ston Prophete)* kai an sunergasteite enantion tou (Mokhammant), tote, st' aletheia o Allakh einai o Uposteriktes tou, kai epises o Tzimpreil (Gabriel) kai oi enaretoi pistoi* kai oi aggeloi meta ap' auto einai (epises) uposteriktes kai boethoi (tou Prophete).

Isos, an (o Prophetes) sas dosei (se oles) diazugio, o Kurios tou na tou dosei (anti gia sas) alles suzugous kaluteres ap' esas - upotagmenes (ston Allakh), pistes, eulabika upakoues (pros ton Allakh), pou strephontai me metameleia pros ton Allakh, latreis (pros ton Allakh) kai pou nesteuoun (gia khare tou Allakh), oi opoies eite tha ekhoun pantreutei proegoumenos, eite tha einai parthenes.

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Phulaxte ton eauto sas kai tis oikogeneies sas (meso tes upakoes pros ton Allakh) apo ena Pur, tou opoiou to kausimo einai anthropoi kai petres. Pano apo to opoio tha briskontai aggeloi austeroi kai iskhuroi (ton opoion e douleia einai na basanizoun tous katoikous tou Puros), oi opoioi (aggeloi) de deikhnoun pote anupakoe pros ton Allakh se o,ti tous diatazei, kai kanoun o,ti diatazontai.

(Tha eipothei stous apistous ste Mellousa Zoe, otan eisagontai sto Pur:) <<O, eseis pou arnethekate ten piste! Me dikaiologeiste auten ten Emera! St' aletheia, tha labete mono (ten antistoikhe timoria gia) o,ti kanate.>>

O, eseis pou pisteuete! Strapheite me metameleia pros ton Allakh, me mia eilikrine metameleia! Isos o Kurios sas sas exileosei apo tis amarties sas, kai sas eisagei se kepous (Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Ten Emera pou o Allakh de tha tapeinosei ton Prophete kai osous pisteuan mazi tou (alla tha tous timesei). To phos tous tha proporeuetai mprosta tous kai sta dexia tous, eno tha lene: <<Kurie mas! Kane to phos mas na parameinei anammeno gia mas (kai men to sbeseis mekhri na perasoume ten As-Sirat -te gephura pano apo to Pur- kai na eiselthoume ston Paradeiso. Kai men mas kaneis san tous upokrites pou to phos tous ekhei sbesei pano sten As-Sirat) kai sugkhorese mas. St' aletheia, eisai gia ta panta Ikanos.>>

O, Prophete! Agonisou enantia stous apistous kai tous upokrites, kai na eisai austeros apenanti tous. Kai (ste Mellousa Zoe) e katoikia tous tha einai e Kolase, kai kheiristos einai, pragmati, autos o proorismos.

O Allakh ekhei probalei ena paradeigma gi' ekeinous pou arnethekan ten piste (oti e suggenike skhese me tous Prophetes den ophelei kanenan pou diaprattei to kako): te suzugo tou Noe kai te suzugo tou Lot. Briskontan kato apo te phrontida ton duo enareton doulon Mas, ma kai oi duo (gunaikes) tous prodosan (ste threskeia, aporriptontas ten piste). Ma, autoi (o Noe kai o Lot) den tis prostatepsan se tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh. Kai eipotheke (s' autes): <<Eisakhtheite sto Pur mazi m' ekeinous pou eisagontai!>>

Kai o Allakh ekhei probalei ena paradeigma gi' ekeinous pou pisteuoun (oti e suggenike skhese me tous apistous den tha tous blapsei se tipote): te suzugo tou Pharao, otan eipe: <<Kurie mou! Khtise gia mena ena spiti ston Paradeiso, kai sose me apo to Pharao kai ta erga tou, kai sose me apo ton adiko lao.>>

Kai (epises proballei os kalo paradeigma gia tous Mousoulmanous) te Maria (te metera tou Iesou), ten kore tou 'Imran, e opoia phulaxe ten agnoteta tes. Ki etsi, diataxame ton aggelo Mas (ton Gabriel) na emphusesei se mia skhisme sto enduma tes (kai etsi sunelabe ton Iesou), kai ekeine pistepse sta logia tou Kuriou tes, kai sta Biblia Tou, kai etan apo tous eulabika upakouous.
Upsistos einai Autos sto Kheri tou Opoiou brisketai e Kuriarkhia* kai einai gia ta panta Ikanos.

O Opoios demiourgese to thanato kai te zoe gia na sas dokimasei, poios einai o kaluteros anamesa sas stis praxeis. Ki Autos einai o Al-'Azeiz (o Pantodunamos, o Aniketos), o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta).

O Opoios demiourgese epta ouranous se stromata, ton enan pano ston allon* de tha deis ste demiourgia tou Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) kamia ateleia (e dusanalogia). Epeita strepse to blemma sou gia alle mia phora: <<Mepos blepeis kamia skhisme;>>
Epeita strepse xana to blemma sou duo phores (te mia meta apo ten alle): e orase sou tha epistrepsei s' esena, tapeinomene (anikane na brei kamia ateleia) kai exantlemene.

Kai pragmati, ekhoume stolisei ton kontinotero ourano me lampteres (asteria), kai tous kaname (tous lampteres puraktomenous meteorites) gia lithobolismo ton daimonon (oste na tous empodizoun apo to na kruphakoun), kai gi' autous ekhoume proetoimasei to marturio tou phlogerou Puros.
Kai gi' autous pou arnethekan ten piste ston Kurio tous, uparkhei to marturio tes Kolaseos, kai athlios, pragmati, einai autos o proorismos.
Otan tha rikhnontai ekei mesa (sten Kolase), tha akoun ap' auten ena tromero dunato ekho eispnoes, eno brazei (mainetai).

Par' oligo (e Photia) na skhistei apo ten orge (tes gia tous apistous). Kathe phora pou mia omada rikhnetai mesa tes, oi phulakes tes tous rotoun: <<Den elthe s' esas kanenas proeidopoietes (gia na sas proeidopoiesei gi' auten ten timoria);>>

Eipan: <<Malista, pragmati elthe s' emas enas proeidopoietes, ma (ton) diapseusame kai eipame: <<O Allakh den esteile (kato ste ge) tipota (kamia apokalupse)* st' aletheia, briskeste (o, Aggeliaphoroi) se megale plane (del. diepseudan olous tous Aggeliaphorous).>>.>>
Kai eipan: <<An akougame e antilambanomastan (auta pou mas eipe o Aggeliaphoros), de tha emastan anamesa stous katoikous tou phlogerou Puros.>>
Etsi, omologesan ten amartia tous. As apomakrunthoun, loipon, oi katoikoi tou phlogerou Puros (apo te sugkhorese tou Allakh).

St' aletheia, autoi pou phobountai aorata ton Kurio tous (khoris na Ton ekhoun dei, kai otan einai monoi tous kai den tous blepoun oi alloi anthropoi, den diaprattoun amarties phoboumenoi ton Allakh), tha laboun sugkhorese (apo ton Allakh) kai mia megale amoibe (ton Paradeiso).
Eite kratate ta logia sas mustika, eite ta phaneronete, st' aletheia, Autos einai o Pantognostes oson uparkhoun sta stethe (ton anthropon).
Ma einai dunaton na me gnorizei (tis upotheseis ton plasmaton) Autos pou (ta) eplase; Ki Autos einai o Al-Lateiph (o Eugenes pros tous doulous Tou), o Al-Khampeir (ekhei aperioriste gnose).

Autos einai pou ekane te Ge upotagmene (stromene) gia sas (gia na perpatate eukola, na zeite s' auten kai na ten kalliergeite ktl.)* etsi, perpateste sta monopatia (tis periokhes) tes kai phate apo ta agatha Tou, kai s' Auton tha einai e Anastase (sas apo tous taphous sas).

Ma aisthaneste asphaleis (o, apistoi tes Makkas) oti Autos pou brisketai pano apo ton ourano, de tha kanei te Ge na sas katapiei (opos katapie prin ton Karoun kai ta ploute tou), kai etsi aute tha seistei (aphou etan stathere gia sas);

E aisthaneste asphaleis oti Autos pou brisketai pano apo ton ourano de tha steilei pano sas mia kataigida me mikres petres (opos esteile ston lao tou Lot); Tote tha xerete pos einai e proeidopoiese Mou (kai to apotelesma tes).
Kai pragmati ekeinoi prin ap' autous diepseusan (ten proeidopoiese Mou), kai epeita pos etan (tromere) e arnese (timoria) Mou!

Ma de blepoun apo pano tous ta poulia pou anoigoun ta phtera tous kai meta ta mazeuoun; Kaneis den ta krata (psela apo to na pesoun ste ge) para o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas). St' aletheia Autos einai pou blepei ta panta.

Poios einai autos, pou mporei na einai stratos (uposteriktes kai prostates) gia sas, pou tha sas uposterixei (opos iskhurizeste) ektos apo ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona) (an thelei o Allakh na sas timoresei); St' aletheia, oi apistoi de briskontai para se plane.

E poios einai autos pou mporei na parekhei s' esas (ta pros to zen), an Autos kratesei (empodizontas) ten parokhe Tou; Ki omos, epimenoun (oi apistoi) sto peisma kai ten alazoneia, kai sten apokhe (apo ten aletheia).
Einai autos pou perpata me to prosopo tou strammeno pros ta kato (kai khoris na blepei pou paei), pio ortha kathodegemenos, e ekeinos pou perpata orthios eutheia ston isio dromo;
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Einai Autos pou sas eplase (apo ten anuparxia) kai sas edose akoe, orase kai kardies. Ligo omos (o, apistoi) (Ton) eukharisteite (gia tis khares Tou pou sas edose).
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Autos einai pou (sas eplase kai) sas skorpise ste Ge, kai s' Auton tha sugkentrotheite (ste Mellousa Zoe).>>
Kai lene (oi apistoi): <<Pote (tha ulopoiethei) aute e uposkhese (gia ten Emera tes Anastases), an eiste (o, Mousoulmanoi) eilikrineis;>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<St' aletheia e gnose (gia ten akribe stigme) brisketai mono me ton Allakh, ego omos eimai mono enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoio me sapheneia.>>

Ma otan (oi apistoi) ten eidan (ten timoria apo ton Allakh kata ten Emera tes Kriseos) na plesiazei, tote skoteiniasan (apo lupe kai thlipse) ta prosopa ekeinon pou arnethekan ten piste. Kai eipotheke (s' autous): <<Aute einai (e ekplerose tes uposkheses) pou zetousate (otan prokalousate tous prophetes sas, legontas: <<As doume ten timoria sas, an eiste eilikrineis.>>)!>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous apistous): <<Peite mou, an o Allakh aphairese te zoe mou kai ekeinon pou briskontai mazi mou (opos elpizete) e an mas eleese (parateinontas te zoe mas) - tote poios mporei na sosei tous apistous apo epoduno marturio;>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous apistous): <<Autos einai o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas), s' Auton pisteuoume kai s' Auton basizomaste (gia oles tis upotheseis mas). Kai tha mathete (otan tha deite ten timoria apo ton Allakh) poios einai autos pou brisketai se phanere plane.>>

Pes (o, Mokhammant stous apistous): <<Peite mou an (olo) to nero sas empaine bathia (ste ge kai den mporousate na to phtasate), poios tote tha sas ephodiaze me trekhoumeno nero (phanero sta matia sas);>>
N (ena Arabiko gramma kai propheretai Noun). Ma ten pena kai auta pou graphoun!
Den eisai (o, Mokhammant), me te khare (Menuma) tou Kuriou sou, paraphron (opos iskhuristekan oi apistoi).
Kai st' aletheia, gia sena (o, Mokhammant) tha uparkhei mia adiakope amoibe.
Kai st' aletheia, eisai (o, Mokhammant) spoudaiou ethikou kharaktera.
Kai tha deis, kai tha doun.
Poios ap' esas einai o paraphron!
Pragmati, o Kurios sou xerei kalutera poios ekhei parastratethei apo to Dromo Tou. Kai xerei kalutera tous ortha kathodegemenous.
Etsi, (o, Mokhammant), men upakouseis autous pou diapseudoun (to Menuma sou).
Epithumoun na eisai pio malakos mazi tous (egkrinontas kapoia ap' auta pou kanoun ste threskeia tous): kai etsi na einai kai autoi malakoi mazi sou.
Kai men upakous (o, Mokhammant) kathe anthropo pou orkizetai polu kai einai potapos (kai pseutes).
Pou kakologei tous anthropous piso apo ten plate tous, kai sunekheia metadidei koutsompolia (kapoion anthropon s' allous epidiokontas na khalasei te skhese tous).
Pou empodizei kathe kalo, kai einai parabates kai amartolos.
Kai einai anethikos (kai skleros sten apistia tou), kai iskhurizetai oti einai apo enan lao (tous Korais) parolo pou den einai ap' autous.
Epeide ekhei plouto kai paidia (arnetheke ten piste alazonika).
Otan ta Edaphia Mas (tou Kor'an) apaggellontai s' auton, leei (diapseudontas ta): <<Thruloi ton arkhaion!>>

Tha ton semadepsoume ste mute. [Kati pou egine argotera, otan kopeke e mute tou me spathi ten emera tou Mpantr], [ta parapano edaphia anapherontai ston Al-Oualeint mpin Al-Mougeira, o opoios etan polu skleros ekhthros tou Prophete].

St' aletheia, tous ekhoume dokimasei (tous polutheistes tes Makkas), opos dokimasame tous anthropous tou kepou, otan orkistekan na mazepsoun tous karpous tou (kepou) to proi, (gia na men phaei kanenas phtokhos apo tous karpous, eno o pateras tous prin pethanei, eikhe orisei ena meros apo tous karpous gia tous phtokhous).
Khoris na kanoun kamia exairese (sto meridio ton phtokhon pou orise o pateras tous, kai khoris na poun: <<in saa' Allakh (An to thelei o Allakh)>>).
Tote elthe pano tou (ston kepo), pur apo ton Kurio sou, (te nukhta kai ton ekapse), eno koimontousan.
Etsi, (o kepos) egine to proi (kamenos kai) mauros san te skoteine nukhta.
Epeita to proi phonaxan o enas ton allo.
(Legontas): <<Pegainete stis kalliergeies sas oso einai akoma proi, an epimenete na kopsete (tous karpous).>>
Etsi, anakhoresan gregora, suzetontas psithurista:
<<Na men aphesete kanenan endee na mpei semera mesa (ston kepo) oso eiste mesa.>>
Kai etsi, pegan to proi gia ton (kako) skopo (apophasismenoi na apotrepsoun tous phtokhous apo to na paroun karpous) nomizontas mesa tous oti ekhoun te duname (na to kanoun).
Ma, otan ton eidan (ton kepo), eipan: <<St' aletheia, khathekame (kai erthame s' allon kepo, okhi to diko mas).>>
(Epeita, aphou bebaiothekan oti einai o kepos tous, eipan:) <<(Den einai allos kepos) alla pragmati, emeis eimaste steremenoi (apo tous karpous tou logo tes kakes mas protheses)!>>

(Tote) o pio dikaios anamesa tous eipe: <<Ma den sas eipa: <<Na doxazete (ton Allakh kai na strapheite me metameleia pros Auton gia ten adike prothese sas, kai na Ton eukharisteite gia osa sas edose);>>
Eipan (metaniomenoi): <<Doxa ston Kurio mas! St' aletheia, emastan adikoi.>>
Epeita straphekan allelokategorontas o enas ton allon.
Eipan: <<Alimono mas: St' aletheia, emastan parabates (pou empodizame tous phtokhous kai parakousame ton Allakh).
Elpizoume o Kurios mas na mas ton antikatastesei m' enan (allon kepo) kalutero ap' auton. St' aletheia, ston Kurio mas strephomaste zetontas (to kalo, kai te sugkhorese Tou).
Tetoia einai e timoria (s' auten te zoe gi' opoion parakouei ton Allakh), ma, pragmati e timoria tes Mellousas Zoes einai megalutere (kai pio tromaktike), an to gnorizan!
St' aletheia, gi' autous pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis entoles Tou) uparkhoun oi kepoi tes eudaimonias (o Paradeisos) me ton Kurio tous.

(Ma einai dunaton oti) tha kaname tous Mousoulmanous (pou upotassontai me upakoe ston Allakh) isaxious (sten amoibe pou tha laboun), me tous egklematies (del. tous apistous, opos iskhurizeste, o, eidololatres tes Makkas);
Ti sumbainei me sas; Pos krinete (tetoia adike krise, exisonontas ton enareto me ton anupakouo);
E mepos ekhete ena (ouranio) biblio apo to opoio mathainete (auta pou lete, oti o eusebes einai isaxios me ton asebe);
Sto opoio (biblio) ekhete ola osa epilegete (kai epithumeite);
E mepos ekhete orkous (uposkheseis) apo Mas, pou phtanoun mekhri ten Emera tes Anastases, oti tha sumbei gia sas o,ti apophasisete;
(O, Prophete) rotese tous (eidololatres, pou iskhuristekan oti tha einai isaxioi sten amoibe me tous Mousoulmanous ten Emera tes Kriseos), poios ap' autous tha stathei egguetes gi' auto!
E mepos ekhoun <<etairous>> (pseutikous theous, pou tha stathoun egguetes gi' auto); Tote as pheroun tous <<etairous>> tous, an einai eilikrineis!

(Thumetheite) ten Emera (tes Anastases) pou (o Allakh) tha apokalupsei ten Kneme (Tou) (me ten Opoia den uparkhei kati paromoio) kai tha klethoun na pesoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomenoi), ma (oi upokrites, kai osoi telousan tis proseukhes tous kata ten egkosmia zoe gia epideixe kai pheme) de tha mporesoun (epeide e plate tous tha ginei eniaia kai alugiste).

Ta matia tous tha einai khamelomena, kai tha tous kalupsei e tapeinose* allote kalountan (sten egkosmia zoe) na pesoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomenoi), eno etan ugieis (kai geroi, ma den to ekanan).
Gi' auto (o, Mokhammant) aphese Me m' opoion diapseusei auto ton logo (to Kor'an) (del. aphese ton kai to thema tou, gia Mena). Tha tous pheroume stadiaka pros ten timoria apo kei opou den gnorizoun.
Kai tha tous parakhoreso khrono (zoes, gia na auxesoun tis amarties tous kai epeita tha tous arpaxo me austere timoria). St' aletheia, to Skhedio Mou einai iskhuro.
E mepos (o, Mokhammant) tous zetas kamia (egkosmia) amoibe (epeide tous metadideis to Menuma tou Allakh), kai gi' auto einai uperphortomenoi me khreos (kai gi' auto arnountai ten aletheia);

E mepos katekhoun (te gnose gia) ta aorata (to Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud pou periekhei ta aorata), kai etsi graphoun (ap' auto ta epikheiremata tous enantion sou, oti einai kaluteroi enopion tou Allakh apo tous eusebeis);

Etsi, perimene upomonetika ten apophase tou Kuriou sou (oti tous edose perissotero khrono zoes, anaballontas gia ligo te nike sou), kai men eisai san ton anthropo tou megalou psariou (ton Iona, pou etan apogoeteumenos kai thumomenos apo ton lao tou epeide den dekhteke to Menuma tou, kai etsi ephuge me ploio apo ten pole tou khoris ten adeia tou Allakh, kai etsi, ton katapie ena megalo psari) - otan phonaxe (epikalontas Mas apo ten koilia tou psariou) kai eno briskotan se megale thlipse.

An den tou eikhe phtasei e Eunoia apo ton Kurio tou, tha petagotan (apo to stomakhi tou megalou psariou) ste gumne ge os kategoroumenos (gia to oti ephuge khoris ten adeia tou Allakh, alla o Allakh dekhteke te metameleia tou kai ekane to psari na ton petaxei ste ge khoris na einai kategoroumenos, kai tou pareikhe mesa gia ten anarrose tou).
Etsi o Kurios tou ton epelexe (se upsele these, epistrephontas tou ten apostole tou) kai ton ekane anamesa stous enaretous.

Kai st' aletheia, ekeinoi pou arnethekan ten piste paraligo na se kanoun na glistreseis me ta matia tous (apo to misos kai te zelia) otan akoun ten Upenthumise (to Kor'an), kai lene: <<St' aletheia, autos (o Mokhammant) einai paraphron.>>
Kai den einai, para mono mia Upenthumise gi' olo ton kosmo.
To Anapopheukto (del. e Emera tes Anastases).
Poio einai to Anapopheukto;
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) poio einai to anapopheukto (kai poso megaleiodes einai);
Oi Thamount (o laos tou Prophete Salikh) kai oi 'Ant (o laos tou Prophete Khount) diepseusan ten Al-Kari'a (ten Emera tes Kriseos pou tha khtupesei tis kardies me te phrike tes).
Oso gia tous Thamount, exolothreutekan apo ten tromere krauge (pou xeperase kathe orio se entase)!
Kai oso gia tous 'Ant, exolothreutekan apo enan kruo, agrio anemo!
Ton opoio (o Allakh) epeballe s' autous gia epta diadokhikes nukhtes kai okhto diadokhikes meres, kai etsi tha eblepes (an esoun ekei) ton lao nekro, san na etan kouphioi kormoi khourmadion!
Blepeis na ekhei meinei kamia psukhe ap' autous (khoris na exolothreuthei);
Ki o Pharao, ki autoi pou proegountan autou, ki oi anestrammenes komopoleis (tou laou tou Prophete Lot) dieprattan aiskhres amarties.
Parakousan ton Aggeliaphoro tou Kuriou tous, ki etsi Ekeinos tous arpaxe dunata me mia sklere timoria.
Pragmati, otan to nero sekotheke pano apo ola (o Kataklusmos tou Noe), Emeis metapherame esas (del. tous pistous progonous sas) sten pleoumene (Kiboto tou Noe).
Oste na ten kanoume (ten kiboto tou Noe) mia nouthesia (kai upenthumise) gia sas, kai na te diateresoun ekeina ta autia pou mporoun na diateresoun o,ti akoun (gia tis epomenes genies).
Ki otan (o Aggelos Israphel) tha phusexei to Keras (Salpigga) ena phusema (to proto phusema, pou anakoinonei ten katastrophe tou kosmou).
Ki e Ge kai ta bouna tha aphairethoun apo ta mere tous kai tha sunthliphthoun me ena mono khtupema.
Tote, ekeine ten Emera tha ginei to (Megalo) Anapopheukto Gegonos.
Ki o ouranos tha skhistei, kai ekeine ten Emera (o ouranos) tha einai exasthenemenos.
Ki oi aggeloi tha briskontai stis pleures tou (ouranou), kai ekeine ten Emera, tha koubalesoun to Throno tou Kuriou sou apo pano tous, okhto (aggeloi).
Ekeine ten Emera tha parousiasteite (o, anthropoi, enopion tou Kuriou sas, gia apologismo). De tha apokruphtei kanena mustiko sas.
Epeita, oso gi' auton pou tha tou dothei to biblio (ton katagraphon ton praxeon) tou sto dexi tou kheri, tha pei (eutukhismenos): <<Oriste! Diabaste to biblio mou!
St' aletheia, pisteua (sten egkosmia zoe) oti tha sunanteso ton apologismo mou (ten Emera tes Kriseos kai oti tha labo ten amoibe mou).>>
Etsi, autos tha brethei se mia eukhariste zoe.
S' enan upselo Paradeiso.
Tou opoiou (Paradeisou) oi karpoi tha briskontai khamela kai konta (eukola na tous phtasei).
Phate kai pieite me anese, gi' o,ti kanate (apo kales praxeis) tis proegoumenes meres (sten egkosmia zoe)!
Ma oso gi' auton pou tha tou dothei to biblio (ton katagraphon ton praxeon) tou sto aristero tou kheri, tha pei (metaniomenos): <<Makari na me mou eikhe dothei to biblio mou!
Oute na mathaina pote pos einai o apologismos mou.
Makari (o thanatos mou kata ten egkosmia zoe) na etan to telos mou (kai na men anastainomoun apo to thanato mou pote).
Den me ophelese o ploutos mou (oute me prostatepse se tipote apo ten timoria tou Allakh).
Me egkateleipse (e exousia mou kai) to epikheirema mou (pou tha mporousa na po gia na uperaspisto ton eauto mou)!>>
(Tha eipothei stous aggelous - phulakes tes photias:) <<Parte ton kai alusodeste ton (me ta kheria tou sto laimo)*
Epeita, petaxte ton sto Pur gia na kaei mesa tou.
Epeita, alusodeste ton (oloklero) me mia alusida, to mekos tes opoias einai ebdomenta pekheis!>>
St' aletheia, den pisteue ston Allakh, ton Mega.
Oute proetrepe sto taisma tou endee (del. oute autos taize tous phtokhous, oute proetrepe tous allous na to kanoun).
Etsi, Semera den tha ekhei edo kanenan philo (gia na ton prostatepsei apo ten timoria).
Oute kamia trophe, ektos apo to puon (apo tis pleges tou dermatos ton katoikon tou Puros)*
To opoio den tha to trone para mono oi amartoloi (pou epimenoun sten apistia tous).
Orkizomai se o,ti blepete!
Kai (orkizomai) se o,ti den blepete (apo ta aorata)!
Oti auto (to Kor'an) einai o logos enos entimou Aggeliaphorou (del. to akoute apo enan entimo Aggeliaphoro, ton Mokhammant).
Kai den einai logos enos poiete: liga einai auta pou pisteuete!
Oute einai logos enos mante: liga einai auta pou thumaste (del. thumetheite te diaphora metaxu tou logou enos mante kai tou Prophete)!
Einai pragmati, e apokalupse apo ton Kurio ton kosmon (anthropoteta, tzinn kai ola osa uparkhoun).
Ki an autos (o Mokhammant) eikhe apodosei pseudos, akome kai kapoia logia s' Emas (ton Allakh),
Tha ton arpazame (gia ekdikese) me duname,
Ki epeita tha apokoptame ten arteria tes kardias (aorte) tou (prokalontas ameso thanato),
Kai kaneis apo sas de tha empodisei (ten timoria Mas) s' auton.
Kai st' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) einai mia Upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh, ektelontas tis entoles Tou).
Kai st' aletheia, gnorizoume oti uparkhoun anamesa sas ekeinoi pou diapseudoun (to Kor'an).
Kai pragmati aute (e diapseuse gia to Kor'an) tha einai mia thlipse stous apistous (ten Emera tes Kriseos).
Kai st' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) einai e bebaie aletheia (gia ten opoia den uparkhei amphibolia).
Etsi, doxase to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, tou Al-'Adeim (Mega).
Kapoios (apistos) epikalesteke (ton Allakh) gia to marturio (na epelthei s' auton kai ston lao tou, os proklese ston Mokhammant), (ena marturio) pou sigoura eperkhetai.
(Eperkhetai) stous apistous, to opoio kaneis den mporei na empodisei.
Apo ton Allakh, ton Kurio ton Dromon tes Anodou (stous ouranous).
Oi aggeloi kai o Gabriel anebainoun pros Auton mia Emera (tes Kriseos), tes opoias e diarkeia einai penenta khiliades khronia.

Etsi, na eisai upomonetikos (o, Mokhammant, me tous khleuasmous tous kai te biasune tous gia ten Timoria), me mia omorphe upomone (del. khoris apogoeteuse, e na apeuthuneis ta parapona sou s' allon ektos tou Allakh).
St' aletheia, to blepoun (to marturio), makrino (nomizoun oti de tha ginei).
Ma Emeis to blepoume konta (oposdepote tha ginei).
Ten Emera pou o ouranos tha einai san bromiko ladi pou brazei.
Kai ta bouna tha einai san phouskomeno malli.
Kai kanenas philos de tha rotesei kapoion philo (gia ten katastase tou, epeide tha einai apaskholemenos me te dike tou upothese).

Tous blepoun (del. o kathenas blepei tous suggeneis kai ta paidia tou, alla de tha tous milesei apo ton tromo pou epikratei, kai kaneis de tha mporesei na ophelesei kanenan). O amartolos tha epithumouse na lutrosei ton eauto tou apo to marturio ekeines tes emeras dinontas ta paidia tou,
Kai te gunaika tou, kai ton adelpho tou,
Kai to soi tou, pou tou prosepheran kataphugio,
Kai olous osous briskontai ste Ge, mepos etsi na sothei.
Okhi (den einai opos epithumeis, o, apiste)! St' aletheia, aute (e Kolase) puraktonetai,
Pou aphairei biaia to derma tou kephaliou, kai ta akra tou somatos (tha ta kapsei oloklerotika)!
Kalei opoion strapheke makria kai apomakruntheke (apo ten piste).
Kai mazeue (plouto) kai (ton) apothekeue (khoris na xodeuei ap' auton se eleemosune gia khare tou Allakh).
Pragmati, o anthropos plasteke polu anupomonos (anesukhos kai philarguros)*
Otan to kako (astheneia e phtokheia) ton aggizei, ginetai anupomonos (kai dusarestemenos)*
Kai otan to kalo ton aggizei, ginetai philarguros.
Ektos ap' ekeinous pou proseukhontai.
Ekeinous pou teroun panta ten proseukhe tous (me to sosto tropo kai stis kathorismenes ores).
Kai keinous pou ston plouto tous uparkhei ena orismeno upokhreotiko meridio (e Zaka -etesia upokhreotike eleemosune- gia tous phtokhous).
Gia ton epaite pou zeta, kai gia ton steremeno (ton phtokho pou ntrepetai na zetesei).
Kai keinous pou pisteuoun sten Emera tes Kriseos.
Kai keinous pou phobountai to marturio apo ton Kurio tous (kai einai prosekhtikoi apenanti s' auto).
St' aletheia, to marturio apo ton Kurio tous einai tetoio pou kaneis den mporei na aisthanetai asphales ap' auto.
Kai keinous pou phulassoun ta gennetika organa tous (apo paranomes sexoualikes praxeis)*
Ektos apo tis suzugous tous e ekeines pou katekhoun ta dexia kheria tous (del. sklabes) -opote de tha kategorethoun.
Ma opoios epidiokei pera ap' auto, tote ekeinoi einai oi parabates.
Kai keinous pou teroun ta katapisteumata kai tis sumphonies tous.
Kai keinous pou menoun statheroi stis marturies tous (khoris na pseudontai, na apokruptoun e na diastreblonoun gegonota).
Kai keinous pou teroun ten proseukhe tous (me to sosto tropo kai stis kathorismenes ores).
Tetoioi tha katoikoun se kepous (Paradeiso), timemenoi.

Ti sumbainei, loipon me tous apistous pou speudoun pros esena (o, Mokhammant); (Oi opoioi kathontai me tous laimous tous strammenous pros esena gia na s' akousoun, okhi gia na ophelethoun, alla gia na se diapseusoun kai na se khleuasoun)!
(Kathismenoi) se omades apo ta dexia kai t' aristera (sou, o, Mokhammant).
Elpizei o kathenas tous na mpei ston Paradeiso tes Makariotetas;

Okhi! St' aletheia, tous ekhoume plasei ap' auto pou gnorizoun (del. ena asemanto ugro, epomenos, einai adunamoi pou den mporoun oute na ophelesoun oute na blapsoun tous eautous tous, opote pos mporoun na einai alazonikoi kai apistoi;)
Etsi, orkizomai ston Kurio olon ton Anatolon kai ton Duseon (tou eliou, tes selenes kai olon ton allon planeton), oti, bebaia, eimaste Ikanoi.
(Eimaste Ikanoi) na tous antikatastesoume m' allous kaluterous ap' autous* kai kaneis den mporei na Mas xephugei (otan apophasisoume kati).
Kai etsi astous na buthizontai sten plane tous kai na paizoun (sten egkosmia zoe), mekhri na sunantesoun ten Emera, ten opoia tous eikhan uposkhethei.

Ten Emera pou tha bgoun apo tous taphous tous biastika, san na espeudan sunagonizomenoi pros ena eidolo (opos ekanan sten egkosmia zoe, pou opote orizotan ena neo eidolo, espeudan gia na einai oi protoi pou na to latreuoun).
Me ta matia tous khamelomena, kai kalummenoi me ten tapeinose! Aute einai e Emera pou tous eikhan uposkhethei!
St' aletheia, steilame ton Noe ston lao tou (legontas): <<Proeidopoiese ton lao sou, prin na phtasei s' autous ena epoduno marturio.>>
Eipe (o Noe): <<O, lae mou! St' aletheia eimai gia sas enas proeidopoietes pou proeidopoiei me sapheneia,
Oti na latreuete ton Allakh, na phulakhtheite apo ten timoria Tou (ektelontas tis entoles Tou), kai na me upakoute.

(Kai tote o Allakh) tha sas sugkhoresei tis amarties sas kai tha sas dosei anabole (gia to thanato sas) mekhri enan orismeno khrono. Pragmati, otan elthei o orismenos khronos (del. o thanatos) apo ton Allakh, de tha anablethei, an mono to gnorizate (tha speudate pros ten piste kai ten upakoe).>>
Eipe (o Noe): <<O, Kurie mou! St' aletheia, ekho kalesei ton lao mou nukhta kai mera,
Ma to kalesma mou den tous auxese tipota, para te phuge (tous apo ten aletheia).

Kai st' aletheia kathe phora pou tous kalousa, gia na tous sugkhoreseis, ebazan ta dakhtula tous st' autia tous, kaluptontan me ta endumata tous kai epemenan (sten arnese tous), kai sumperipherontan polu alazonika.
Epeita, tous kalesa phanera.
Epeita, tous kalesa (merikes phores) anoikhta (megalophona) kai (alles phores) mustika (idiaiteros) me khamele phone.
Eipa (s' autous): <<Zeteste sugkhorese apo ton Kurio sas, st' aletheia, Autos sugkhorei ta panta*
(Kai an Tou zetesete sugkhorese, tote) tha sas steilei aphthone brokhe (opote khreiasteite kai den tha uposteite xerasia),
Kai tha auxesei ton plouto kai ta paidia sas, kai tha kanei gia sas kepous, kai tha kanei gia sas potamia.>>
Ti sumbainei me sas; Pos de phobaste to Megaleio tou Allakh (kai te Duname Tou);!

Eno sas eplase se (diaphoretika) stadia (se Noutpha -anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon-, se 'Alaka -kremamenos thrombos aimatos-, se Mountga -ena kommati sarkas, pou phainetai masemene- se kokkala, ki epeita se sarka).
Den blepete pos eplase o Allakh ephta (panomoiotupous) ouranous, ton ena pano ston allo;
Ki ekane mesa tous to pheggari os ena phos, ki ekane ton elio os enan lamptera (pege photos kai thermotetas);
Ki o Allakh sas xephutrose (eplase) apo te Ge san to phuto.
Epeita tha sas epistrepsei s' aute (te Ge), kai tha sas kanei na bgeite (pali, kata ten Emera tes Anastases) mia anapopheukte exodo.
Ki o Allakh ekhei aplosei te Ge gia sas (san ena stromeno khali, kai os mia eureia ektase gia na egkatastatheite).
Gia na periplanieste ekei, se plateis dromous.

O Noe eipe: <<Kurie mou! St' aletheia (oi anupakouoi apo ton lao mou) me parakousan, ki (oi adunamoi ex' auton) akolouthesan autous (tous epikephaleis tes planes), stous opoious o ploutos kai ta paidia tous den auxesan tipote, para mono apoleia.
Kai (oi epikephaleis tes planes) ekhoun mekhaneuthei (enantion ton adunamon) mia iskhure mekhanorraphia (upokinontas tous enantion tou Noe).

Kai (tous) eipan: <<Na men egkataleipsete tous theous sas: na men egkataleipsete oute ton Ouant, oute ton Soua', oute ton Giagouth, oute ton Gia'ouk, oute ton Nasr (Auta etan onomata eidolon pou latreuan anti tou Allakh, ta opoia proerkhontan apo onomata eusebon anthropon, tous opoious otan pethanan, oi laoi tous tous ekanan eikones kai agalmata, oste na tous entharrunoun pros ten upakoe ston Allakh. Me to perasma ton khronon, oi anthropoi arkhisan na latreuoun auta ta agalmata kai tis eikones).>>
Kai pragmati ekhoun paraplanesei pollous. (O, Allakh:) Men auxeseis tous adikous, para mono sten plane.>>
Logo ton amartion tous pnigekan, kai eisakhthekan sto Pur. Kai den brekan uposteriktes (pou na tous boethesoun) anti tou Allakh.
Kai o Noe eipe: <<Kurie mou! Men apheseis ste Ge kanenan apisto zontano na kuklophorei!
Pragmati, an tous apheseis, tha paraplanesoun tous doulous Sou (tous pistous), kai den tha gennesoun kanenan, para mono kakopoious apistous.
Kurie mou! Sugkhorese emena, kai tous goneis mou, ki opoion mpainei sto spiti mou os pistos, ki olous tous pistous kai tis pistes. Kai men auxeseis tous adikous, para mono sten katastrophe.>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Mou ekhei apokaluphthei oti mia omada tzinn akousan (to Kor'an). Kai eipan: <<St' aletheia, akousame ena thaumasio Kor'an!
Kathodegei sten Aletheia, kai ekhoume pistepsei s' auto, kai de tha apodidoume ston Kurio mas (ton Allakh), kanenan (etairo ste latreia).
Kai -upsisto einai to Megaleio tou Kuriou mas -den ekhei kamia suzugo oute apektese enan gio.
Kai oti o anoetos anamesa mas (del. o Satanas) xestomize enantion tou Allakh kati pou etan terastio pseudos (oti o Allakh ekhei suzugo kai uio).
Kai st' aletheia, nomizame oti oi anthropoi kai ta tzinn de tha xestomizan psema enantion tou Allakh.

Kai st' aletheia, uperkhan andres apo tous anthropous pou (otan taxideuan kai pernousan te nukhta se mia skoteine koilada) katephugan se merika arsenika apo ta tzinn (legontas: <<anazetoume kataphugio ston kurio autes tes koiladas, apo ton lao tou.>>), ma auta tous auxesan se phobo (ap' auta, kai se amartia aphou anazetoun kataphugio sta tzinn anti tou Allakh).
Kai nomizan (oi apistoi apo tous anthropous) auto pou ki eseis nomizate (o, tzinn), oti o Allakh de tha anastesei kanenan (e den tha steilei kanenan Aggeliaphoro).
Kai epizetousame na phtasoume ston ourano* ma ton brekame gemato me pollous austerous phrourous kai meteorites.

Kai st' aletheia, kathomastan (prin ten apostole tou Mokhammant) se semeia ekei (ston ourano), gia na kruphakousoume (tous aggelous kai na metapheroume osa akousame se manteis). Ma opoiosdepote (prospathesei na) kruphakousei tora, tha brei enan meteorite na ton akolouthei (gia na ton kapsei).

Kai de gnorizoume an (m' aute ten entone phulaxe) proorizetai to kako gi' osous briskontai ste Ge (kai oti megale timoria tha pesei pano tous), e an o Kurios tous epithumei gi' autous to kalo (kai tha steilei enan Aggeliaphoro me Theia apokalupse);
Uparkhoun anamesa mas kapoioi pou einai enaretoi, kai kapoioi pou den einai* emastan se diaphoretikes aireseis (kai threskeutikes doxasies).
Kai pisteuoume oti den mporoume na xephugoume apo ton Allakh ste Ge (an thelei na mas timoresei), oute mporoume na xephugoume ap' Auton me opoiondepote tropo phuges (oute ste Ge oute ston ourano).

Kai pragmati, otan akousame ten Kathodegese (to Kor'an), pistepsame s' auto, kai opoios pisteuei ston Kurio tou, den tha prepei na phobethei oute gia meiose sten amoibe, oute gia adikia (auxese stis amarties tou).

Kai apo mas kapoioi einai Mousoulmanoi (upotagmenoi ste boulese tou Allakh), kai kapoioi einai adikoi (parekklinoun apo ton Isio Dromo). Kai opoios ginei Mousoulmanos (upotassetai ste boulese tou Allakh), tetoioi einai osoi epizetesan ton Isio Dromo.
Ki oso gia tous adikous, tha ginoun kausoxula gia ten Kolase.>>

Kai an (oi apistoi apo tous anthropous kai ta tzinn) eikhan akolouthesei to (sosto) dromo (to Islam), Emeis sigoura tha tous parakhorousame nero (brokhe) se aphthonia (del. polu plouto kai polla agatha).

Oste na tous dokimasoume m' auta (ta agatha, an tha ginoun eugnomones ston Allakh gia o,ti tous parekhei). Kai opoios strephetai makria apo ten Upenthumise tou Kuriou tou (del. to Kor'an), Autos tha ton eisagei se ena sklero marturio (sten Kolase).

Ta Tzamia einai gia ton Allakh (kai mono): etsi, na men epikaleiste (mesa tes) kanenan mazi me ton Allakh (opos ekanan oi Ebraioi kai oi Khristianoi pou epikalountai ton Iesou, ten Maria kai tous agious klp. mesa sta temene kai tis ekklesies tous).

Otan o doulos tou Allakh (o Mokhammant) sekotheke gia na Ton epikalestei (na latrepsei ton Allakh kai na apaggeilei to Kor'an), kontepsan (ta tzinn apo to megalo plethous tous) na mazeutoun s' auton se puknes omades, e mia pano apo ten alle (oste na akousoun ten apaggelia tou Prophete).
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<St' aletheia, epikaloumai (mono) ton Kurio mou (ton Allakh), kai den apodido s' Auton kanenan etairo ste latreia.>>
Pes: <<Den einai ste duname mou oute na empodiso kapoio kako na sas sumbei (an to orise o Allakh gia sas), oute na sas phero kapoio ophelos (an den to orise o Allakh gia sas).>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Kaneis den mporei na me prostatepsei ap' ten timoria tou Allakh (an Ton parakouga), oute mporo na bro kataphugio, para mono s' Auton.

(Auto pou mporo na kano gia sas den einai) para mono na sas metaphero o,ti lambano apo ton Allakh kai ta menumata Tou.>> Kai opoios parakousei ton Allakh kai ton Aggeliaphoro Tou, gi' auton proorizetai to Pur tes Kolaseos, opou tha katoikesei ekei mesa gia panta.

(Oi apistoi epimenoun sten apistia tous) mekhri pou, otan doun auto pou tous eikhan uposkhethei, tha mathoun poioi einai oi pio adunamoi oson aphora tous uposteriktes (oi apistoi pou den tha ekhoun kanenan uposterikte e oi pistoi, Uposteriktes ton opoion einai o Allakh), kai poioi einai ligoteroi se arithmo (boethon kai stratioton)!
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Den gnorizo an (e timoria) pou sas eikhan uposkhethei brisketai konta e an o Kurios mou tha ten orisei sto makrino mellon.
(Autos einai) o Pantognostes ton aoraton, kai den apokaluptei se kanenan ta aorata Tou.

Ektos se opoion epelexe (o Allakh) os Aggeliaphoro (ton enemeronei o Allakh gia osa thelei apo ta aorata), kai epeita tou stelnei phulakes (aggelous) apo mprosta tou kai apo piso tou (gia na prostateuoun to Menuma tou Allakh kai ta aorata apo to na ta kruphakousoun ta tzinn kai na ta psithurisoun stous mantes).

Oste na xerei (o Aggeliaphoros otan blepei tous phulakes aggelous) oti st' aletheia (oi aggeliaphoroi prin ap' auton) metedidan ta Menumata tou Kuriou tous (me aletheia kai eilikrineia kai oti o Allakh tous prostateue). Kai (o Allakh) periballei (me te Gnose Tou) o,ti katekhoun (eite phanero eite krupho), kai (o Allakh) katametrese (gnorizei) ola ta pragmata me tous akribeis arithmous tous (tipote den einai krupho ap' Auton).
O, esu (Prophete), o tuligmenos me ta imatia sou!
Na sekonesai (gia proseukhe, ole) te nukhta, ektos apo ligo.
Te mise (nukhta, an thes) e ligo ligotero ap' auto (oste na einai to ena trito tes nukhtas).
