E ligo perissotero ap' aute (te mise, an thes, oste na einai ta duo trita tes nukhtas). Kai na apaggelleis to Kor'an (phonakhta) m' enan kalo kai saphe tropo.
St' aletheia, tha steiloume kato s' esena (o, Mokhammant) ena baru Logo (to Kor'an pou periekhei entoles kai apagoreuseis).
St' aletheia, e proseukhe kata tis ores tes nukhtas ekhei ten pio iskhure epirroe sten kardia, kai einai e pio katallele gia ten apaggelia (tou Kor'an, me ton pio saphe kai katanoeto tropo).

St' aletheia, uparkhei gia sena, ten emera, paratetamene apaskholese (me te metadose tou Menumatos tou Allakh kai me tis idiotikes upotheseis tes zoes sou, gi' auto telese te nukhterine proseukhe aphosionontas ten kardia sou pros ton Allakh).
Kai na mnemoneueis to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, kai na aphosionesai ste latreia sou pros Auton me plere aphosiose.
(Autos einai) o Kurios tes anatoles kai tes duses* den uparkhei allos theos pou axizei na latreuetai para monon Autos. Etsi na pairneis mono Auton os Diakheiriste olon ton upotheseon sou.
Kai na eisai upomonetikos (o, Mokhammant) me o,ti lene (oi apistoi), kai na apomakrunesai ap' autous me kalo tropo (khoris na tous ekdiketheis).

Kai aphese Me m' autous pou diapseudoun (ta Edaphia Mou), pou apolambanoun tis apolauseis (tes egkosmias zoes). Kai dos' tous anabole (sten timoria) gia ligo (kairo, mekhri na erthei e orismene ora tes timorias tous).
St' aletheia, ekhoume (sten Eskhate Emera) baria desma (gia na tous alusodesoume), ki ena mainomeno Pur.
Kai mia trophe pou pnigei, ki ena epoduno marturio.
Ten Emera pou e ge kai ta bouna tha seiontai biaia, kai ta bouna tha ginoun enas soros ammou skorpismenos.
St' aletheia, steilame s' esas (o, anthropoi) enan Aggeliaphoro (ton Mokhammant) pou tha einai marturas s' esas, opos steilame enan Aggeliaphoro (ton Mouse) ston Pharao.
Ma o Pharao parakouse ton Aggeliaphoro (ton Mouse)* etsi ton arpaxame me mia austere timoria.
Pos, loipon, an arneiste ten piste tha phulakhtheite apo ten timoria mias Emeras (tes Anastases), pou tha kanei ta paidia gerasmena (apo ta tromaktika pragmata pou tha doun ekeine ten Emera),
Opou o ouranos tha skhistei. Bebaia, e Uposkhese Tou oposdepote tha ekplerothei.

St' aletheia aute (ola ta proanapherthenta apo o,ti periekhei e Emera tes Anastases) einai mia nouthesia: kai opoios thelei (na te labei upopse), as akolouthesei enan dromo (upakoes kai eusebeias) pros ton Kurio tou!

Pragmati, o Kurios sou gnorizei oti proseukhesai gia ligo ligotero apo ta duo trita tes nukhtas, allote te mise nukhta, kai allote to ena trito tes nukhtas, ki epises mia omada ap' autous pou briskontai mazi sou (tous opadous sou). Ki o Allakh orizei te nukhta kai ten emera. Gnorizei oti de tha mporousate na proseukhetheite oloklere te nukhta, gi' auto sas anakouphizei, kai etsi, apaggeilte auto pou mporeite apo to Kor'an (kata te nukhterine proseukhe). Gnorizei oti tha uparkhoun merikoi apo sas pou einai astheneis, alloi pou taxideuoun ste ge epidiokontas ta agatha tou Allakh, ki alloi pou polemoun sto Dromo tou Allakh. Etsi, apaggeilte auto pou mporeite apo to Kor'an (kata tis proseukhes sas), kai teleste tis proseukhes kai doste te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune) kai na daneisete ston Allakh ena kalo daneio (xodeuontas apo ta khremata sas gia khare tou Allakh se kathe kalo dromo). Ki o,ti kalo kanete (kata ten egkosmia zoe sas, gia na sas ophelesei kata te Mellousa zoe sas), sigoura tha to breite me ton Allakh, kalutero kai megalutero, os amoibe. Kai anazeteste sugkhorese ap' ton Allakh. St' aletheia, o Allakh einai Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta) kai Rakheim (Polueusplakhnos).
O, esu (Prophete), o skepasmenos me ta imatia sou!
Seko kai proeidopoiese (tous anthropous gia ten timoria apo ton Allakh)!
Kai doxase ton Kurio sou (ton Allakh)!
Kai exagnise ta endumata sou!
Kai apomakrunsou apo ta eidola (kai ten eidololatria) (opos ede kaneis)!
Kai men theoreis tis polles praxeis upakoes sou pros ton Allakh, os khare s' Auton.
Kai na eisai upomonetikos (se o,ti antimetopizeis apo duskolies) gia khare tou Kuriou sou!
Kai otan (o aggelos Israphel) phusexei to Keras (Salpigga) (to deutero phusema).
Pragmati, ekeine e Emera tha einai mia polu duskole Emera -
Pou gia tous apistous den tha einai katholou eukole.
Aphese Me, loipon, (o, Prophete) m' opoion demiourgesa monakho (ste metra tes meteras tou, khoris na ekhei oute plouto oute paidia) (Anapheretai ston Al-Oualint, uio tou Al-Mougeira Al-Makhzoumi).
Ki epeita, tou khoregesa aphthona ploute.
Kai paidia pou ton suntropheuoun.
Kai tou dieukoluna (ta mesa bioporismou) me kathe eukolia.
Ki epeita, (meta ap' ola auta kai par' olo pou arnetheke ten piste) epophthalmiouse me aplestia na tou edina perissotera*
Okhi! St' aletheia, etan peismatares enantia sta Edaphia (kai ta semadia) Mas.
Tha ton exanagkaso na antimetopisei ena sklero marturio (khoris anapause)!
St' aletheia, skephteke kai skhediase (sunomotika) (pos tha dusphemouse ton Prophete kai to Kor'an).
Kai kataramenos na 'nai: gia to pos skhediase!
Kai pali kataramenos na 'nai: gia to pos skhediase!
Epeita skephteke xana (s' auta pou tha pei gia na dusphemesei ton Prophete kai to Kor'an)*
Epeita sunophruotheke kai to prosopo tou skoteiniase (otan den breke tipota na pei gia na dusphemesei ton Prophete kai to Kor'an).
Epeita gurise ten plate tou (sten aletheia) alazonika.
Kai eipe: <<Auto den einai para mono mageia, pou metadotheke apo palia*
Auto (to Kor'an) den einai para anthropinos logos (kai okhi Theikos)!>>
Tha ton eisago ste Sakar (mia apo tis onomasies tes Kolaseos) gia na kaei mesa.
Kai den xereis (o, Mokhammant) poso (tromere) einai e Sakar!
Den aphenei tipote (oute te sarka oute ta osta khoris na ta kapsei), oute aphenei (tous apistous)!
Kaigontas ta dermata (ton apiston, stous opoious tha ananeonei o Allakh sunekheia ta dermata, te sarka kai ta osta tous, gia na geuontai sunekheia to marturio)!
Pano tes briskontai deka ennea (iskhuroi aggeloi os phulakes kai phrouroi tes Kolaseos).

Kai den thesame kanenan, para aggelous os phulakes tou Puros. Ki den orisame ton arithmo tous (os dekaennia), para mono gia na einai os dokimasia gia tous apistous (pou enas ap' autous eipe: <<Den mporoun kathe deka apo sas na nikesoun enan ap' autous;>>), kai oste autoi pou elaban to Biblio (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi pou elaban ten authentike Tora kai to authentiko In-tzeil) na sigoureutoun [oti to Kor'an einai e aletheia, kathos sumphonei me ta authentika Biblia pou eikhan, anaphorika me ton arithmo dekaennia], kai oste na auxethoun oi pistoi sten piste (kathos to Kor'an einai e aletheia), kai gia na men amphisbetoun autoi pou elaban to Biblio (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi), oute oi pistoi, kai gia na poun ekeinoi pou stis kardies tous brisketai mia astheneia (tes upokrisias) kai oi apistoi: <<Ti ethele o Allakh na pei m' auten ten parabole (auton ton arithmo);>> Etsi o Allakh odegei opoion thelei sto na parastratesei kai kathodegei opoion thelei. Kai kaneis de gnorizei tis straties tou Kuriou sou, para mono Autos. Kai aute (e Kolase) den einai, para mia (proeidopoietike) upenthumise gia ten anthropoteta.
Okhi (den mporoun oi apistoi na nikesoun tous aggelous opos iskhuristekan)! Kai (orkizomai) ma to pheggari!
Kai (orkizomai) ma te nukhta kathos upokhorei!
Kai (Orkizomai) ma ten auge kathos pheggei!
Oti aute (e Kolase) einai ena apo ta megala (Semadia).
Mia proeidopoiese gia ten anthropoteta,
Se opoion apo sas epithumei na prokhoresei (meso tes pistes kai ton kalon praxeon), e na meinei piso (meso tes apistias kai ton amartion).
Kathe psukhe (pou ekhei diapraxei amarties) tha einai omeros (sten Kolase) gi' o,ti diepraxe,
Ektos apo autous sta Dexia (del. tous eusebeis pou lambanoun ta Biblia ton katagraphon ton praxeon tous sto dexi tous kheri) (den tha einai omeroi),
(Alla tha einai) se kepous (Paradeiso), kai tha rotoun o enas ton allon,
Skhetika me tous egklematies (apistous), (kai tha tous lene):
<<Ti sas eisegage ste Sakar (Kolase);>>
Ekeinoi tha poun: <<Den emastan apo tous proseukhetes,
Oute taIzame tous endeeis,
Kai milousame sten plane mazi m' ekeinous pou milousane s' aute,
Kai diapseudame ten Emera tes Kriseos,
Mekhri pou erthe se mas to bebaio (o thanatos).>>
Ki etsi, den tha tous ophelesei kamia mesolabese apo mesolabetes.
Ti sumbainei m' autous (tous apistous), pos apomakrunontai apo te nouthetese (to Kor'an);
(Apomakrunontai) san na etan (tromagmena), agria gaidouria.
Pou trekhoun na xephugoun apo ena liontari.

St' aletheia, o kathenas ap' autous thelei (apo peisma kai alazoneia) na tou dothoun anoikhtes graphes (apo ton Allakh, pou na ton diatazoun na akolouthesei ton Mokhammant, eno tous staltheke ede to Kor'an. Kai o Allakh epilegei tous Aggeliaphorous Tou, stous opoious stelnei ta Biblia Tou).
Okhi (den einai opos iskhuristekan)! Alla (e aletheia einai oti) den phobountai te Mellousa Zoe (oute pisteuoun s' aute).
Okhi (to Kor'an den einai mageia opos iskhuristekan)! St' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) einai mia Upenthumise (kai Nouthesia),
Ki opoios thelei, tote as nouthetethei me auto (diabazontas to)!

Kai den tha nouthetethoun, ektos an thelei o Allakh* Autos einai pou Tou armozei na phulassontai oloi oi douloi Tou apo ten timoria Tou (upakouontas tis entoles Tou), ki Autos einai o Armodios na sugkhorei (tis amarties ton doulon Tou).
(Orkizomai) ma ten Emera tes Anastases!

Kai (orkizomai) ma ten auto-kategoroumene psukhe (tou pistou, pou ton kategorei an paramelesei kapoies kales praxeis e otan diaprattei amartia)! (Oti oi anthropoi tha anastethoun gia na logodotesoun).
Nomizei o (apistos) anthropos oti Emeis de tha sullexoume (xanademiourgesoume) ta osta tou (ten Emera tes Anastases);
Okhi (den einai opos nomizei o apistos), alla bebaia eimaste Ikanoi na epanaskhematisoume teleia ta akrodakhtula tou (opos etan prin, me te morphe tous kai ta daktulika apotupomata tous).
Alla! O anthropos (arneitai ten Anastase kai ten Apologia, epomenos) thelei na sunekhisei na diaprattei amarties (gia ten upoloipe zoe tou).
Rota (diapseudontas): <<Pote tha einai aute e Emera tes Anastases;>>
Ma otan e orase tha einai amekhane, phobismene kai kataplekte (apo osa tromaktika pragmata tha blepei kata ten Emera tes Anastases).
Kai (otan) to pheggari suskotistei.
Kai (otan) o elios kai to pheggari mazeutoun.
Ekeinen ten Emera o anthropos tha pei: <<Pou einai e apodrase (apo auto to marturio);>>
Okhi! Den uparkhei apodrase oute kataphugio!
Ston Kurio sou, ekeinen ten Emera, tha brisketai o telikos periorismos.

Ekeine ten Emera o anthropos tha enemerothei gia o,ti ekane kata te diarkeia tes zoes tou (apo kales kai kakes praxeis), kai gia o,ti ekane apo praxeis pou emeinan meta apo to thanato tou (del. tis praxeis tou pou oi anthropoi akolouthesan os protupo meta apo to thanato tou, eite etan kales eite kakes).
Kai omos! O anthropos tha ginei marturas enantion tou eautou tou (kathos ta mere tou somatos tou, kheria, podia, matia, autia klp. tha marturesoun tis praxeis tou).
Akome ki an thesei tis dikaiologies tou (gia na kalupsei tis kakes praxeis tou, den tha ton ophelesoun).
(O, Mokhammant) men kounas te glossa sou (epanalambanontas ta logia tou Kor'an, ten ora pou lambaneis ten Apokalupse apo ton Gabriel) biazomenos na to apomnemoneuseis (phoboumenos men to xekhaseis).
Einai dike Mas armodioteta na to sullexoume (sto stethos sou) kai na statheropoiesoume ten apaggelia tou (ste glossa sou).
Ki otan to apaggellei o aggelos Mas (o Gabriel, s' esena), tote akoloutha ten apaggelia tou (kai epeita na to apaggelleis opos to akouses).
Epeita einai dike Mas armodioteta na to kanoume saphes (s' esena, del. na katanoeseis tis ermeneies kai tis entoles tou).
Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizeste o, apistoi, oti de tha anastetheite)! Alla agapate ten egkosmia zoe (kai tis apolauseis tes).
Kai parameleite te Mellousa Zoe (kai ten eudaimonia tes).
Kapoia prosopa ekeine ten Emera (tes Anastases) tha einai lampera kai photeina.
Atenizontas ton Kurio tous.
Eno kapoia alla prosopa ekeine ten Emera tha einai sunophruomena kai skoteiniasmena,
Pisteuontas (kai anamenontas) oti kapoia sumphora kai timoria prokeitai na pesei pano tous.

Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizetai o apistos oti den tha anastethei)! Otan (e psukhe) phtasei stis kleides (del. sto laimo kata ten exodo tes apo to soma, otan autos tha brisketai sto kheilos tou thanatou).
Kai tha eipothei (apo tous paristamenous): <<Poios mporei na tou kanei xorki (oste na ton therapeusei kai na ton sosei apo to thanato);>>
Kai autos (o etoimothanatos) tha sigoureutei oti ephtase (e ora) tou apokhorismou (tou thanatou) (aphou blepei tous aggelous pou erthan gia na sunodeusoun ten psukhe tou)*
Kai tha tulikhthei to ena podi me to allo.
Tote, e poreia ekeine ten Emera, tha einai pros ton Kurio sou (ton Allakh)!
Oute (autos o apistos) pisteue (sto Kor'an kai sto Menuma tou Aggeliaphorou), oute proseukhotan!
Ma, (antithetos), diepseude (to Kor'an kai to Menuma tou Aggeliaphorou) kai apomakrunotan!
Epeita pege sten oikogeneia tou perpatontas me eparse (thaumazontas ton eauto tou)!
Alimono s' esena (o, apiste)! Kai (pali) alimono s' esena!
Pali, alimono s' esena (o, apiste)! Kai (pali), alimono s' esena!
Nomizei o anthropos oti tha paramelethei (khoris na labei diatages kai apagoreuseis, kai oute tha timorethei e tha antameiphthei gia o,ti ekane);
Den etan mia Noutpha (anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phulon), apo sperma pou khunetai (stis metres);
Epeita egine 'Alaka (kremamenos thrombos aimatos)* epeita (o Allakh) (ton) eplase kai epeita (ton) diamorphose.
Kai ekane ap' auton ta duo phula, arseniko kai theluko.
Den einai loipon Autos (o Allakh, pou kanei ola auta) Ikanos na dosei zoe stous nekrous; (Bebaia! Einai gia ta panta Ikanos).
Den ekhei perasei mia (megale) khronike periodos prin ten uparxe tou anthropou (prin na phusekhtei mesa tou e psukhe), kata ten opoia den etan tipote pou na mporei na anapherthei;

St' aletheia, plasame ton anthropo apo anamemeigmene Noutpha (stagones anamemeigmenon ekkriseon ton duo phulon, mesa ste metra), gia na ton dokimasoume (me tis diatages kai tis apagoreuseis pou tou thesame): etsi, ton kaname ikano na akouei (ta Edaphia Mas) kai na blepei (ta semadia kai tis apodeixeis Mas).

St' aletheia, tou deixame (me sapheneia meso ton Aggeliaphoron Mas) to dromo (tes kathodegeses), kai etsi eite tha einai (pistos kai) eugnomon (an dialexei to dromo tes kathodegeses), eite (apistos kai) agnomon (an dialexei to dromo tes planes).

St' aletheia, ekhoume etoimasei gia tous apistous siderenies alusides (pou tha tous sernoun apo ta podia ste photia), desma me ta opoia tha dethoun ta kheria tous sto laimo tous ki ena phlegomeno Pur.
St' aletheia, oi enaretoi pistoi tha pioun apo ena diskopotero (me krasi), anamemeigmeno me Kaphour (del. nero apo mia pege me glukia osme ston Paradeiso).
Mia pege apo ten opoia tha pinoun oi douloi tou Allakh, kanontas te na anabluzei se aphthonia (opou kai na briskontai).
Autoi (einai ekeinoi pou) ekpleronoun ta tamata (tous gia kales praxeis), kai phobountai mia Emera, tes opoias to kako tha skorpistei eureos.
Kai dinoun phageto, para (ten anagke kai) ten agape tous gi' auto, ston endee, ston orphano kai ston aikhmaloto.
(Legontas mesa tous): <<Sas trephoume mono gia te Khare tou Allakh. Den theloume apo sas oute amoibe, oute eukharisties.
St' aletheia, phobomaste apo ton Kurio mas mia Emera, kata ten opoia ta prosopa tha skoteiniasoun kai tha sunophruothoun.>>
Etsi, o Allakh tous esose apo to kako ekeines tes Emeras, kai tous edose lamproteta kai omorphia (sta prosopa tous) kai eukharistese (stis kardies tous).
Kai tous antameipse gia o,ti upemeinan karterika (stis praxeis latreias kata ten egkosmia zoe), me ton Paradeiso (gia na apolausoun mesa tou) kai me metaxi (gia na to phoroun).
Ksaplomenoi ekei, pano sta stolismena krebatia (me ta omorphotera kalummata), khoris na blepoun oute elio (pou na tous enokhlei me te zeste tou), oute (na niothoun) to uperboliko kruo.
Kai tha tous plesiazoun apo pano tous ta kladia ton dentron tou (Paradeisou), kai oi karpoi ton dentron tha kremontai khamela (oste na tous phtanoun) me kathe eukolia.
Kai tha peripherontai (oi uperetes) anamesa tous me diskous apo arguro (me phageto) kai poteria apo guali (kathara san to krustallo),

Guali pou einai phtiagmeno apo arguro (kai tha ekhei te leukoteta tou argurou kai te diaphaneia kai ten katharoteta tou gualiou), (Oi uperetes) kathorizoun ten posoteta (tou potou sta poteria) akribos (sten posoteta pou epithumoun oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou).
Kai tha tous dothei na pioun apo ena diskopotero (me krasi), anamemeigmeno me piperoriza,
Mia pege ekei, pou onomazetai Salsampil (del. gargaro nero).
Kai tha peripherontai anamesa tous (tous uperetoun) epheboi me aionia neoteta. An tous deis tha tous peraseis gia skorpismena (photismena) margaritaria.
Ki otan koitaxeis ekei (ston Paradeiso), tha deis mia eudaimonia (pou den mporei kaneis na phantastei) kai ena terastio basileio.
Tha phoroun prasina imatia apo lepto kai pakhu metaxi. Kai tha einai stolismenoi me brakhiolia apo arguro, ki o Kurios tous tha tous parekhei ena agno poto.
(Kai tha eipothei s' autous): <<St' aletheia, aute einai mia amoibe gia sas (gia o,ti kanate sten egkosmia zoe) kai ta kala erga sas eginan apodekta.>>
St' aletheia, Emeis eimaste pou steilame to Kor'an s' esena (o, Mokhammant) stadiaka.
Etsi na upomeneis karterika (o, Mokhammant) ten Entole tou Kuriou sou, kai na men upakous oute kanenan amartolo, oute kanenan apisto ap' autous.
Kai na mnemoneueis to Onoma tou Kuriou sou (polu) kathe proi kai apogeuma (prospherontas tis proseukhes Phatzr, Doukhr kai 'Asr).

Kai kata te nukhta na peseis se Sigkount stase pros Auton (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, telontas tis proseukhes Magrimp kai 'Isa'), kai na Ton doxazeis gia megale diarkeia te nukhta (kata ten proseukhe Takhatzount).
Pragmati, autoi (oi apistoi) agapoun ten (suntome) egkosmia zoe, kai aphenoun piso tous mia baria (duskole) Emera (ten Emera tes Anastases).

Eimaste Emeis pou tous demiourgesame, kai dunamosame ta somata tous. Ki otan thelesoume, mporoume na tous (katastrepsoume kai na tous) antikatastesoume pleros m' allous san autous (alla upakouous kai upotagmenous ste Thelese tou Allakh).
St' aletheia, auto (to Kephalaio tou Kor'an) einai mia nouthesia kai upenthumise, ki etsi opoios thelei, as parei enan dromo (tes pistes kai tes eusebeias) pros ton Kurio tou.
Kai den mporeite na thelete (na parete to dromo tes kathodegeses) ektos an o Allakh thelei (auto apo sas). St' aletheia o Allakh einai 'Aleim (Pantognostes) kai Khakeim (Pansophos).
Eisagei sto Eleos Tou opoion thelei (o Allakh), kai oso gia tous adikous, ekhei etoimasei gi' autous ena epoduno marturio.
(Orkizomai) ma tous stalmenous (anemous, e aggelous) pou stelnontai diadokhika!
Kai ma tous dunatous anemous pou phusoun biaia!
Kai ma autous (tous anemous) pou skorpizoun (ta sunnepha kai te brokhe)!
Kai ma auta (ta Edaphia tou Kor'an) pou diakhorizoun (ten aletheia apo ten plane).
Kai ma autous (tous aggelous) pou phernoun (apo ton Allakh) tis apokalupseis (stous Aggeliaphorous tou Allakh),

(Tis opoies apokalupseis, tis stelnei o Allakh) oste na men ekhoun (oi anthropoi) kamia dikaiologia (apenanti ston Allakh oti den exeran gia te threskeia Tou), e oste na einai proeidopoiese (gi' osous den pisteuoun ston Allakh).
Oti auto pou sas uposkhethekan sigoura tha pragmatopoiethei.
Etsi, otan ta astra sbesoun.
Ki otan o ouranos skhistei.
Ki otan ta bouna ekragoun (kai skorpistoun stous anemous).
Ki otan oi Aggeliaphoroi sugkentrothoun ten prokathorismene ora (gia na krinei o Allakh metaxu ton Aggeliaphoron kai ton laon tous).
Gia poia Emera peran anabole (oi Aggeliaphoroi oste na krinei o Allakh metaxu ton Aggeliaphoron kai ton laon tous);
Gia ten Emera tes Kriseos!
Kai pos na xereis (o, Mokhammant) ti einai (kai pos tha einai) e Emera tes Kriseos; (ekphrase pou deikhnei poso semantike einai).
Alimono, ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Ma den katastrepsame (ekeinous pou diepseudan tous Aggeliaphorous apo) ta prota ethne (opos ton lao tou Noe, tou 'Ant kai tou Thamount);
Epeita tha kanoume tis metepeita genies (opos tous apistous tes Makkas) na tous akolouthesoun (sten katastrophe, gia to oti diepseudan ton Prophete).
Etsi kanoume stous egklematies (polutheistes, apistous, amartolous).
Alimono, ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Ma den sas plasame (o! apistoi) apo asemanto nero (sperma);
Epeita to kaname na topothetethei se enan asphale topo (te metra),
Gia mia orismene periodo (tes kuophorias).
Kai prosdiorisame (te demiourgia, te morphe kai te zoe tou), kai Emeis eimaste oi Ikanoteroi (sta panta).
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (te Duname Mas)!
Ma den kaname te Ge dokheio (topo) upodokhes,
gia tous zontanous (sta spitia tous), kai gia tous nekrous (stous taphous tous);
Ma den ekhoume topothetesei s' aute (te Ge), stathera kai psela bouna, kai sas dosame na pieite gluko nero;
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ola auta ta agatha kai tis eunoies)!
(Tha eipothei stous apistous): <<Anakhoreste pros ekeino (to Pur tes Kolaseos) pou diapseudate (sten egkosmia zoe)!
Anakhoreste pros mia skia (tou kapnou tou Puros tes Kolaseos pou anebainei kai diakhorizetai) se treis kladous (kapnou),
(E skia autou tou kapnou) oute skiazei, oute prostateuei apo ten agria phloga tou Puros.>>
St' aletheia, aute (e Kolase) peta spithes (terasties) san ta kastra,

(To khroma ton opoion einai) san maures kameles pou to khroma tous teinei pros to kitrino! [Auto deikhnei oti e photia, oi phloges tes kai oi spithes tes einai polu skoteines kai oti e photia exairetika kaute].
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Aute ten Emera den tha miloun (oi apistoi),
Kai oute tha tous epitrapei na dikaiologethoun.
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Aute tha einai e Emera tes Kriseos! Sugkentrosame esas kai ta prota ethne mazi!
An loipon, ekhete kanena skhedio (gia na apophugete ten timoria), tote khresimopoieste to enantion Mou (an aletheia mporeite)!
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Pragmati, oi eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh ektelontas tis Entoles Tou) tha briskontai anamesa se skies (dentron) kai peges (nerou).
Kai tha ekhoun phrouta, ap' auta pou epithumoun.
(Kai tha eipothei s' autous): <<Phate kai pieite me anese gia o,ti kanate (apo enaretes praxeis kata ten egkosmia zoe).>>
St' aletheia, etsi (me tetoia gennaiodore amoibe) antameiboume tous enaretous.
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
(O, apistoi!) Phate kai apolauste gia ligo (sten egkosmia zoe). St' aletheia eiste egklematies (amartoloi kai apistoi).
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Ki otan eipothei s' autous: <<Upoklitheite (gia proseukhe)!>> Den upoklinontai (antithetos, epimenoun sten alazoneia kai to peisma tous).
Alimono ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ta Edaphia Mas)!
Etsi, (an den pisteuoun s' auto to Kor'an,) se poia alla logia (biblio) meta ap' auto (to Kor'an) tha pistepsoun;
Gia poio pragma rotoun (oi apistoi, o enas ton allon);
Gia te Megale Eidese (del. to Kor'an pou anapherei ten eidese tes Anastases, ten opoia diapseudoun oi apistoi).
Gia ten opoia, autoi (oi apistoi) diapheroun (sto ti na poun skhetika me to Kor'an, an einai mageia, poiese, manteia e muthoi ton arkhaion)!
Okhi (den einai opos nomizoun oi apistoi)! St' aletheia tha mathoun (to apotelesma tes diapseuses tous).
Kai pali okhi! St' aletheia tha mathoun (kai tha epibebaiothoun otan doun to marturio).
Ma den kaname te Ge etoime (san ena krebati) gia na ten katoikesete;
Kai (den kaname) ta bouna passalous (oste na statheropoiesoun te Ge kai na men tremei kato apo ta podia sas -apo te takhuteta tes kineses tes-);
Kai (den) sas demiourgesame se zeugaria (arsenika kai theluka);
Kai (den) kaname ton upno sas gia xekourase;
Kai (den) kaname te nukhta ena skepasma (pou sas kaluptei me to skotadi tes opos kaluptei ena phorema to soma);
Kai (den) kaname ten emera (ena meso) gia na apoktesate ta mesa bioporismou;
Kai (den) khtisame pano sas epta gerous (ouranous);
Kai (den) kaname (ton elio) puraktomeno lamptera (pege photos kai thermotetas);
Kai (den) steilame apo ta sunnepha (pou einai etoima na brexoun) aphthono nero;
Gia na kanoume m' auto na bgei (apo te ge) sitari kai phuta,
Kai kepous pou ekhoun diakladomena phuta (del. antherous kepous).
Pragmati, e Emera tes Kriseos einai prokathorismene!
E Emera kata ten opoia tha phusekhtei to Keras kai tha erthete espeusmena kata plethe (omades, kathe prophetes me ton lao tou),
Kai o ouranos tha anoixei kai tha ginei me polles portes (gia na kateboun oi aggeloi),
Kai ta bouna tha metakinethoun (tha anatinakhtoun) kai tha ginoun (san) ophthalmapate.
St' Aletheia, e Kolase paramoneuei (gia tous apistous),
Gia tous parabates tha einai (e Kolase) o proorismos,
Sten opoia (Kolase) tha meinoun gia epokhes (te mia meta apo ten alle, gia panta),
Ekei den tha geutoun tipota drosero (pou na anakouphisei te zeste tou Puros), oute poto (gia na sbesei te dipsa tous),
Para mono kauto nero kai puon (pou bgainei apo to derma ton katoikon tou Puros).
Mia (dikaie) timoria antistoikhe (me o,ti ekanan apo apistia kai amarties).
(Epeide) den phobontousan (kata ten egkosmia zoe) to na logodotesoun (kata ten Mellousa Zoe, oute pisteuan oti tha anastethoun).
Kai diepseudan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, me kathe dunato tropo.
Kai Emeis ekhoume katagrapsei (sto biblio katagraphes ton praxeon tous) ta panta (pou eikhan kanei).
Geuteite, loipon (ta apotelesmata ton kakon sas praxeon)! S' esas den tha auxesoume tipota allo, para ten timoria.
St' aletheia, tha uparxei gia tous eusebeis (pou phulassontai apo ten timoria tou Allakh meso tes upakoes ton entolon Tou) mia epitukhia (kai ena megalo kerdos, o Paradeisos):

Kepoi kai ampelones (del. karpous). [oi ampelones anapherontai edo logo tes timemenes theses tous metaxu ton phrouton kai logo tes aphthones posotetas pou paragoun os endeixe gia ten aphthonia pou tha ekhoun],
Kai (suzugoi) me orima stethe kai sunomelikes,
Kai gemato diskopotero me thaumasio krasi (pou den methaei).
Den tha akousoun ekei oute mataia logia, oute psemata,
(Ola auta einai) mia amoibe apo ton Kurio sou, os mia eparkes kai aphthone khoregese,

(Apo) ton Kurio ton ouranon kai tes Ges kai o,ti uparkhei anamesa tous, ton Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemona). Ston Opoion den mporoun (ta plasmata Tou) na Tou apeuthunoun kanena logo (ektos ap' auton pou tou epitrepei o Allakh).

Ten emera pou o Ar-Roukh (o aggelos Gabriel) kai oi aggeloi tha stekontai se seira, kanenas den tha milesei (gia na mesolabesei gia kapoion allon), ektos ap' ekeinon pou o Ar-Rakhman (Panteleemonas) tha tou to epitrepsei, kai tha pei aletheies (kai dikaia logia).
Ekeine einai e Bebaie Emera (pou oposdepote tha erthei). Etsi, opoios thelei as parei ena monopati pros ton Kurio tou (meso ton kalon praxeon).

St' aletheia, sas proeidopoiesame gia mia epikeimene timoria, ten Emera pou o anthropos tha dei (to apotelesma gia) o,ti ekane, kai tha pei o apistos: <<Makari na 'mouna skone (kai na men eikha anastethei gia na men sunanteso auto to marturio)!>>
(Orkizomai) ma ekeinous (tous aggelous) pou arpazoun me duname kai bia (tis psukhes ton apiston kata te stigme tou thanatou)!
Kai ma ekeinous (tous aggelous) pou malaka bgazoun (tis psukhes ton enareton piston te stigme tou thanatou)!
Kai ma ekeinous (tous aggelous) pou kolumpoun (katebainontas apo tous aitheres pros te Ge, kai anebainontas apo te Ge pros tous aitheres),
Kai ma ekeinous (tous aggelous) pou speudoun (gia na ektelesoun tis Entoles tou Allakh),
Kai ma ekeinous (tous aggelous) pou dieuthetoun tis Entoles (tou Allakh skhetika me tis upotheseis tou kosmou)!
(Oti, tha anastetheite oloi sas kai tha apologetheite) ten Emera pou e Ge tha seietai (meta apo to proto phusema tou Keratos, to phusema tou thanatou, kata to opoio oloi tha pethanoun),
Kai tha to akolouthesei to deutero phusema (kata to opoio oloi tha anastethoun),
Ekeine ten Emera tha tremoun oi kardies (ton apiston apo paniko),
Me tapeinomena, khamelomena ta matia tous.
Lene (oi apistoi kata ten egkosmia zoe diapseudontas ten anastase): <<Ma einai dunaton oti tha epanelthoume xana sten protere mas katastase pano ste Ge (del. zontanoi);
Akoma ki aphou ekhoume ginei (meta apo to thanato mas) aposuntethemena osta;>>
Lene: <<(An aletheia tha epistrepsoume xana ste zoe, tote) aute (e epistrophe) tha etan mia khamene (katastrophike) epistrophe (aphou tote de tha mporesoume na apophugoume ten timoria)!>>
St' aletheia, tha einai mia monakha krauge (to deutero phusema tou Keratos),
Kai tote - na toi - briskontai (zontanoi xana) pano ste Ge (aphou etan sta splakhna tes),
Den sou erthe (o, Mokhammant) e istoria tou Mouse;
Otan tou phonaxe o Kurios tou sten Iere Koilada tes Toua:
<<(O, Mouse) pegaine ston Pharao, giati st' aletheia parabiase ta oria (diaprattontas adikia, amarties kai apistia).>>
Kai pes tou: <<Mepos tha etheles na exagnisteis (apo tis amarties, kai na pistepseis ston Pantodunamo Allakh);
Kai na se odegeso ston Kurio sou (pou se demiourgese), ki etsi, na (Ton) phobasai (prattontas o,ti Ton eukharistei kai apopheugontas o,ti apagorepse);>>
Kai tou edeixe to megalutero Semadi (to thauma tes rabdou tou Mouse).
Ma ekeinos (o Pharao) to diepseuse kai parakouse.
Meta strapheke makria epidiokontas na antitakhthei (ston Mouse).
Epeita sugkentrose (ton lao tou) kai phonaxe dunata:
<<Ego eimai o kurios sas, o upsistos.>>
Kai etsi o Allakh ton arpaxe me ten timoria (pou tha einai sto Pur) kata ten Eskhate Emera, epises kai sten egkosmia zoe (meso tou pnigmou tou sto nero).
St' aletheia, s' auto uparkhei mathema (paradeigma, nouthesia kai proeidopoiese) gia opoion phobatai (ton Allakh).
(O, apistoi pou diapseudete ten Anastase), e demiourgia sas (meta apo to thanato) einai pio megale e (e demiourgia) tou ouranou pou (o Allakh) ton ektise (apo pano sas khoris kolones);
Ton upsose (ton ourano) kai ton isiose (me taxe kai teleioteta, khoris skhismes e rogmes),

Skepase te nukhta tou (ouranou) me skotadi (kanontas olo to sumpan na buthizetai se skotadi) kai edeixe ten emera tou (meso tou photos tou eliou). [Mas edeixe to phos tes emera meso tes atmosphairas pou emphanizei tis aktines tou eliou, oi opoies einai aorates mekhri na phtasoun sten atmosphaira, kai gi' auto exo apo ten atmosphaira, o elios phainetai os enas skoteinos mple diskos].
Meta ap' auta estrose te Ge (kai ten etoimase).
Ebgale apo mesa tes (Ges) to nero tes kai ta boskotopia tes.
Kai ta bouna ta ekhei stereosei gera (ste Ge os passalous gia na ten statheropoiesoun).
(Ola auta ta ekane o Allakh) os ephodia gia sas kai ta kopadia sas.
Meta, otan tha 'rthei e Megale Sumphora (del. to deutero phusema, kai e Emera tes Anastases),
Ten Emera pou o anthropos tha thumethei ola osa ekane (apo kales kai kakes praxeis kata ten egkosmia zoe),
Kai to Pur tes Kolaseos tha phanei me sapheneia se opoion blepei,
Ma, oso gia opoion parabiase ta oria (sten apistia, ten adikia kai tis amarties),
Kai protimouse ten egkosmia zoe (akolouthontas tous pothous tou kai adiaphorontas gia te Mellousa Zoe),
Tote to Pur tes Kolaseos tha einai e katoikia (tou).
Ma, oso gia opoion phobotan to na stathei (os kategoroumenos) enopion tou Kuriou tou kai (gi' auto) apetrepse ten psukhe tou apo tous pothous (tou),
Tote o Paradeisos tha einai e katoikia (tou).
(O, Mokhammant) se rotoun (oi apistoi) gia ten Ora (tes Eskhates Emeras, khleuazontas): <<Pote tha erthei;>>
Gia ten opoia den ekheis gnose, gia na peis pote einai aute.
(Mono) ston Kurio sou anekei e gnose tes.
St' aletheia, esu eisai mono enas proeidopoietes gia opoion ten phobatai.
Ten Emera pou tha te doun (ten Ora tes Anastases), tha einai (gi' autous) san na men eikhan meinei (sten egkosmia zoe) para mono ena apogeuma e ena proi.
Sunophruotheke (o Mokhammant) kai apomakruntheke,

Otan o tuphlos (o 'Ampnt Allakh impn Oumm Maktoum) erthe s' auton (zetontas sumboule, eno o Prophetes etan polu apaskholemenos ekeine te stigme kalontas tous egetes ton Kourais kai elpizontas na dekhtoun to Islam).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Mokhammant), isos na exagnistei (me tis sumboules sou)!
E na labei nouthesia kai na ton ophelesei e nouthesia!
Oso gi' ekeinon (del. tous egetes ton Kourais) pou adiaphorei (na labei kathodegese),
S' auton edoses prosokhe (akougontas ton);
(Parolo pou) den tha ekheis euthune an den exagnistei (aphou eisai mono enas Aggeliaphoros pou metapherei to Menuma tou Allakh, eno e kathodegese ton anthropon anekei mono ston Allakh)!
Oso gi' ekeinon pou erthe s' esena speudontas (me alethino zelo),
Eno phobatai (ton Kurio tou, ton Allakh),
Ton parameleis kai strepheis ten prosokhe sou s' allon;
Okhi (o, Prophete tou Allakh)! St' aletheia aute (e Soura - Kephalaio) einai mia nouthesia (gia sena kai gi' opoion thelei na nouthetethei),
Kai opoios thelei, as to mnemoneuei (del. to Onoma tou Allakh).
(Aute e Soura - Kephalaio - epises kai olo to Kor'an) brisketai mesa se timemenes Graphes,
Upsistes kai agnes (pera apo kathe alloiose kai diastreblose),
Sta kheria grapheon (aggelon),
Eugenon kai upakouon.
Kataramenos na einai o (apistos) anthropos! Poso athlia einai e apistia tou (ston Allakh)!
(Ma den eide) apo ti ton demiourgese (o Allakh);

Apo mia Noutpha (stagones apo anamemeigmenes ekkriseis ton duo phullon) ton demiourgese kai ton orise (se stadia: apo te stagona spermatos se 'Alaka, epeita se Mountga, epeita se kokala, epeita entuse ta kokala me sarka, epeita ton skhematise kai tou emphusese to pneuma),
Ustera, tou dieukolune to dromo (te diexodo apo te metra tes meteras tou),
Ustera tou aphairese te zoe kai ton ekane na mpei ston tapho tou.
Ustera, otan tha thelesei (o Allakh) tha ton anastesei!
Okhi! Den ekane (o apistos) o,ti ton dietaxe (o Allakh, to na pisteuei s' Auton kai na Ton upakouei akolouthontas te threskeia Tou)!
As koitaxei loipon o anthropos ten trophe tou (mepos kai sullogistei pos te demiourgese o Allakh):
Emeis khusame (pano ste Ge) aphthono nero,
Epeita skhisame te Ge (me ta phuta pou bgainoun ap' aute),
Kai kaname na phutrosoun s' aute sitera,
Ampelones kai alphalpha (khorta gia ta zoa),
Elies kai phoinikes,
Antherous kepous me pukna dentra,
Phrouta kai khortaria,
(Gia na einai) ephodio gia sas kai ta kopadia sas.
Alla otan tha erthei e ekkophantike krauge (to deutero phusema tou Keratos, to phusema tes Anastases),
Ten emera pou o anthropos tha xephugei apo ton adelpho tou,
Te metera kai ton patera tou,
Te gunaika kai ta paidia tou,
O kathenas tous, ekeine ten Emera, tha ekhei themata pou tou arkoun (kai tha ton kanoun na adiaphorei gia tous allous).
Merika prosopa, ekeine ten Emera, tha einai lampera,
Gelasta kai kharoumena gia tis kales eideseis (ton Paradeiso),
Kai merika (alla) prosopa, ekeine ten Emera, tha einai kalummena me skone,
(Kai) tha ta kaluptei to skotos kai e tapeinose (del. skoteiniasmena).
Ekeinoi einai oi apistoi, oi kakopoioi.
Otan o elios tulikhtei kai petakhtei kai to phos tou sbestei,
Kai otan ta asteria pesoun diaskorpismena kai to phos tous sbestei,
Kai otan ta bouna metakinethoun kai ekragoun,
Kai otan oi egkues kameles (pou einai etoimes na gennesoun) paramelethoun (del. ola ta pragmata megales axias kai ta ploute tha paramelethoun, opos einai oi egkues kameles gia tous Arabes),
Kai otan ta agria theria mazeutoun,
Kai otan oi thalasses ginoun phlogero pur,
Kai otan oi psukhes enothoun se omades (oi pistoi mazi kai oi apistoi mazi).
Kai otan to theluko (moro) pou thaphteke zontano (opos ekanan oi eidololatres Arabes prin to Islam kai alloi laoi), rotethei:
Gia poia amartia dolophonetheke; (e erotese edo einai os kategoria kai epiplexe gi' auton pou ten ethapse),
Kai otan oi graphes (ton katagegrammenon kalon kai kakon praxeon kathe atomou) anoikhtoun,
Kai otan o ouranos aphairethei apo te these tou (kai diplothei),
Kai otan to Pur tes Kolaseos anazopurothei (gia tous katoikous tou),
Kai otan o Paradeisos plesiasei (tous katoikous tou),
Tote, e kathe psukhe tha mathei ti ekhei pherei (gi' ekeine ten Emera apo kales kai kakes praxeis).
(Orkizomai) ma ta asteria pou apotrabiountai (del. exaphanizontai ten emera kai emphanizontai te nukhta)!
Pou trekhoun (stis poreies tous) kai (epeita) krubontai stous asterismous tous (opos krubontai ta elaphakia sto kataphugio tous),
Kai ma te nukhta otan plesiazei me to skotadi tes kai epeita apokhorei!
Kai ma ten auge otan lampei!
Oti st' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) einai o Logos enos eugenestatou Aggeliaphorou (tou Gabriel, pou metapherei ton Logo tou Allakh ston Prophete Mokhammant),
Pou katekhei megale duname, kai katekhei upsele these enopion tou Kuriou tou Thronou,
Kai ton upakoun (oi aggeloi), kai epises einai axiopistos (sten metaphora tes apokalupses apo ton Allakh ston Prophete Mokhammant),
Kai oti o suntrophos sas (o Mokhammant, pou ton xerete) den einai trelos.
Kai, pragmati, (o Mokhammant) ton eide (ton Gabriel) ston katharo orizonta.
Kai st' aletheia, (o Mokhammant) den einai pheidolos me ta aorata (ten apokalupse tou Allakh, pou sas te metadidei oloklere khoris kan na sas zetaei amoibe gi' auto).
Kai st' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) den einai o logos enos kataramenou Satana (pou ekdiokhtheke apo to eleos tou Allakh).
Pou pate, loipon, (anti gi' auto to Kor'an, pou periekhei gia sas kathodegese kai eleos);
St' aletheia, auto (to Kor'an) den einai para mia Upenthumise (kai nouthesia) gi' olous tous kosmous,
Gi' osous apo sas epithumoun na kathodegethoun ston isio dromo.
Kai den mporeite na to thelesete (ten kathodegese), para mono an to thelei o Allakh, o Kurios ton Kosmon.
Otan o ouranos skhistei,
Kai otan ta asteria pesoun, diaskorpismena,
Kai otan oi thalasses ekragoun,
Kai otan oi taphoi anapodogurisoun (gia na anastethoun oi nekroi),

Tote, kathe psukhe tha mathei ti ekhei kanei (apo kales e kakes praxeis kata te diarkeia tes zoes tes), kai ti ekane na meinei (meta to thanato tes os kleronomia apo kales e kakes praxeis, ta apotelesmata ton opoion sunekhisoun na opheloun e na blaptoun tous allous anthropous, p.kh. gnose, eleemosune e kapoia anethike kainotomia).
O, anthrope! Ti se apoplanese kai se ekane na tolmeseis na parakouseis ton Gennaiodoro Kurio sou;
Pou se demiourgese, epeita se diamorphose teleia, kai se orthose me armonikes analogies,
Se opoia morphe (Autos) ethele, se demiourgese (del. se anthropine morphe e se morphe zoou),
Okhi (den eiste, o, apistoi, sten alethine threskeia opos iskhurizeste latreuontas allous ektos tou Allakh)! Alla, diapseudete ten Emera tou Apologismou,
Kai pragmati, uparkhoun pano sas (aggeloi) parateretes,
Eugeneis grapheis (pou katagraphoun tis kales kai tis kakes praxeis sas),
Pou gnorizoun (pleros) o,ti kanete.
St' aletheia, oi eusebeis tha einai se eudaimonia (Paradeiso),
Kai oi kakopoioi tha einai sto Pur tes Kolaseos,
Opou tha eiselthoun gia na kaoun mesa tes ten Emera tou Apologismou,
Kai ap' auto (to Pur) den prokeitai na apousiasoun (oute tha bgoun exo, oute tha pethanoun).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Mokhammant) poso megaleiodes einai e Emera tou Apologismou;
Kai pali, pos na xereis poso megaleiodes einai e Emera tou Apologismou;
E Emera pou kamia psukhe den tha mporesei na ophelesei se tipote mia alle e na apotrepsei kamia timoria ap' auten. Kai e apophase, ekeine ten Emera tha anekei (apokleistika) ston Allakh.
Alimono stous apateones (poletes pou dinoun ligotera se metro kai baros),
Autoi pou otan agorazoun me metro e baros apo tous allous anthropous, theloun to sosto akribes poso,
Alla otan autoi (poloun kai) metroun e zugizoun s' allous, tote tous dinoun ligotera ap' auto pou dikaiountai.
Den nomizoun autoi oti tha anastethoun;
Se mia Megale Emera!
Ten Emera pou oi anthropoi tha stekontai orthioi apenanti ston Kurio ton Kosmon (kai tha tous dikazei).
Okhi (den einai opos iskhurizontai oi apistoi oti den tha uparkhei anastase kai apologismos)! Pragmati, to biblio (ton katagegrammenon praxeon) ton apiston tha einai ste Sitzin (aionia phulake).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) ti einai e Sitzin;
(Pragmati, to biblio ton katagegrammenon praxeon ton apiston einai) ena biblio grammeno xekathara (tipote den tha prostethei s' auto, oute tha aphairethei ap' auto).
Alimono, ekeine ten Emera se osous diapseudoun (ten Emera tes Anastases)!
Ekeinous pou diepseudoun ten Emera tou Apologismou.
Kai st' aletheia kaneis den ten diapseudei (ten Emera tou Apologismou) para kathe parabates amartolos,
Otan ta edaphia Mas (tou Kor'an) apaggellontai s' auton, leei (diapseudontas ta): <<Thruloi ton arkhaion!>>

Okhi (den einai opos iskhuristekan ekeinoi pou diapseudoun ta Edaphia Mas)! St' aletheia skepase tis kardies tous (apo to na pistepsoun sto Kor'an), auto pou ekanan (apo amarties kai aiskhres praxeis).
Okhi! St' aletheia, ekeine ten Emera tha apokleistoun apo to na doun ton Kurio tous.
Epeita, tha eiselthoun sto Pur tes Kolaseos gia na kaoun ekei mesa,
Epeita, tha tous eipothei: <<Auto einai pou diapseudate.>>
Okhi! St' aletheia, to biblio (ton katagegrammenon praxeon) ton eusebon tha einai sten 'Illigun (upsela stromata tou Paradeisou).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) ti einai e 'Illigioun;
(Pragmati, to biblio ton katagegrammenon praxeon ton eusebon einai) ena biblio grammeno xekathara (tipote den tha prostethei s' auto, oute tha aphairethei ap' auto).
To blepoun ekeinoi pou einai konta (ston Allakh, del oi aggeloi).
St' aletheia, oi eusebeis tha einai se eudaimonia (Paradeiso),
(Plagiasmenoi) pano sta krebatia (pou einai stolismena me ta omorphotera kalummata) koitazontas (o,ti ekhei etoimastei gi' autous),
(Otan tous koitas) tha deis sta prosopa tous te lampse tes eudaimonias.
Tha tous dinetai na pioun (katharo) sphragismeno krasi,

Sto telos tou (krasiou) tha einai e murodia tou moskhou, kai gi' oles autes (tis eunoies) as sunagonizontai oi agonistes (oi anthropoi kata ten egkosmia zoe stis kales praxeis kai sten upakoe pros ton Allakh),
Anakatemeno me nero apo te Tasnim,
E opoia (Tasnim) einai, mia pege apo ten opoia pinoun osoi einai konta (ston Allakh).
St' aletheia, (kata ten egkosmia zoe) autoi pou dieprattan egklemata (del. oi apistoi) gelousan m' autous pou pisteuan,
Kai, opote pernousan (oi apistoi) dipla tous (stous pistous), ekleinan to mati o enas ston allon (koroideuontas)*
Kai otan epestrephan stous dikous tous, sunekhisan na asteIzontai (me tous dikous tous, khleuazontas tous pistous)*
Kai otan tous eblepan, elegan: <<St' aletheia, autoi einai pragmati parastratemenoi!>>
Ma ekeinoi (oi apistoi, oi amartoloi) den stalthekan os epiteretes pano tous (stous pistous).
Alla semera (ten Emera tes Kriseos) oi pistoi tha geloun me tous apistous,
(Plagiasmenoi) pano sta krebatia (pou einai stolismena me ta omorphotera kalummata) koitazontas (o,ti ekhei etoimastei gi' autous),
Elaban oi apistoi ten timoria tous gia o,ti ekanan;
Otan o ouranos skhistei.
Kai upakousei ston Kurio tou opos prepei na to kanei (na Ton upakousei).
Kai otan e Ge epektathei (kai isopedothei),
Kai apobalei o,ti uparkhei mesa tes (tous nekrous) kai adeiasei.
Kai upakousei ston Kurio tes opos prepei na to kanei (na Ton upakousei).

O, anthrope! St' aletheia esu douleueis me mokhtho (kanontas kales kai kakes praxeis) kai epistrepheis pros ton Kurio sou (m' auta pou ekanes) kai tha Ton sunanteseis (gia na labeis ten amoibe sou pou proerkhetai apo ten Eleemosune tou Allakh, e na labeis ten timoria sou pou proerkhetai apo te Dikaiosune tou Allakh).
Oso gi' ekeinon pou tha labei to biblio (tes katagraphes ton praxeon) tou sto dexi tou kheri,
Autos tha logodotesei me eukolia,
Kai tha epistrepsei sten oikogeneia tou (ston Paradeiso) eukharistemenos.
Oso de gi' ekeinon pou tha labei to biblio (tes katagraphes ton praxeon) tou piso apo ten plate tou,
Autos tha phonaxei gia ten katastrophe (legontas: <<O, alimono mou! O, katastrophe mou!>>),
Kai tha eisakhthei sto phlogero Pur gia na kaei mesa.
St' aletheia, etan anamesa sten oikogeneia tou (kata ten egkosmia zoe), eukharistemenos (me ten apistia tou, kai de skephtotan gia tis sunepeies ton kakon praxeon tou),
Nomize oti pote de tha epistrepsei (ston Kurio tou gia na logodotesei).
Okhi (den einai opos nomize oti den tha anastethei)! Pragmati, o Kurios tou panta ton blepei (kai tha ton timoresei gia tis kakes praxeis tou).
(Orkizomai) ma to souroupo!
Kai (orkizomai) ma te nukhta kai o,ti tuligei sto skotadi tes (ta onta pou etan skorpismena kata ten emera, ma otan erkhetai e nukhta kathe ena pegainei ste stege tou)!
Kai (orkizomai) ma to pheggari otan gemizei (kai ginetai panselenos):
Oti tha perasete apo diadokhikes phaseis (e mia meta apo ten alle, sten egkosmia zoe kai ste meta thanaton zoe).
Ti sumbainei, loipon, m' autous, kai den pisteuoun;
Kai otan tous apaggelletai to Kor'an den pephtoun se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomenoi);
Alla antitheta, autoi pou aperripsan ten piste, diapseudoun (ten Aletheia)!
Kai o Allakh gnorizei kala o,ti kruboun (sta stethe tous).
Anaggeile tous, loipon, ena epoduno marturio (pou tous perimenei),
Ektos ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai prattoun enaretes praxeis: autoi tha laboun adialeipte amoibe.
(Orkizomai) ma ton ourano pou periekhei tous asterismous!
Kai ma ten Uposkhemene Emera (tes Anastases)!
Kai ma ton martura kai auton gia ton opoion tha einai e marturia!
Kataramenoi na einai oi anthropoi tou khantakiou (pou to ephtiaxan),
(Pou anapsan) dunate photia, pou taIzetai me kausima,
Kai kathisan dipla tes (photias),
Parakolouthontas auta pou ekanan stous pistous.
Kai den eikhan enantion tous kati, para mono oti pisteuan ston Allakh, ton Al-'Azeiz (ton Aniketo, ton Pantodunamo), ton Al-Khameint (Axio kathe epainou),
Auton ston Opoion anekei e Kuriarkhia ton ouranon kai tes Ges. Kai (st' aletheia) o Allakh einai Marturas ton panton.

St' aletheia, ekeinoi pou ebazan se dokimasia tous pistous kai tis pistes (basanizontas tous, oste na tous apomakrunoun apo te threskeia tou Allakh) kai epeita den straphekan me metameleia pros ton Allakh, tha laboun to marturio tes Kolases, kai tha laboun to marturio tes kauses tes Photias.

Pragmati, autoi pou pistepsan kai ekanan kales praxeis, tha ekhoun kepous (Paradeiso) kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia. Aute einai e megale epitukhia (kai to megalo kerdos).
St' aletheia (o, Mokhammant), e timoria tou Kuriou sou (gia tous ekhthrous Tou) einai austere.
Autos einai pou arkhizei (te demiourgia) kai ten epanalambanei.
Kai Autos einai o Al-Gaphour (Autos pou sugkhorei ta panta), o Al-Ouantount (Autos pou ekhei megale agape kai storge gia tous enaretous doulous Tou),
O Kurios tou Thronou, o Al-Matzeint (Endoxos).
Autos pou kanei o,ti thelei (kai den uparkhei tipote pou mporei na empodisei te thelese Tou).
Den erthe (o, Mokhammant) s' esena e istoria ton stratioton,
Tou Pharao kai ton Thamount (kai ti timoria elaban);
Ma oi apistoi (anti na laboun mathema apo o,ti sunebe stous apistous apo ta proegoumena ethne), exakolouthoun na diapseudoun (to Theio Menuma),
Kai o Allakh tous perikleiei (me te Gnose kai te Duname Tou, kai tipote apo tis praxeis tous den einai krupho ap' Auton).
Okhi (den einai to Kor'an mageia kai poiese opos iskhurizeste, o, eidololatres tes Makkas)! Alla, pragmati einai ena doxasmeno Kor'an,
(To opoio einai) diateremeno sto Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud (kai prophulagmeno apo ten alloiose, te diastreblose, te meiose e ten prostheke).
Ma ton ourano kai to At-Tarik (to asteri pou emphanizetai te nukhta e pou prokalei ekho opos otan kapoios khtupa ten porta)!
Kai pos na xereis poso megaleiodes einai to At-Tarik;
Einai to diaperastiko asteri. [Bl. opos o Asteras Netronion].
Oti den uparkhei psukhe pou na men ekhei pano tes (enan aggelo) paraterete (pou katagraphei tis kales kai tis kakes praxeis tes).
As dei loipon o anthropos (pou diapseudei ten Anastase) apo ti demiourgetheke!
Demiourgetheke apo nero (sperma) pou speudei (pros te metra).
Pou ekphuetai apo te spondulike stele kai ta pleura.
St' aletheia, (o Allakh) einai Ikanos na ton gurisei piso (ste zoe),
Ten Emera pou tha exetastoun (kai tha apokaluphthoun) ola ta mustika ton kardion.
Tote, (o anthropos) den tha ekhei oute duname, oute uposterikte (pou na ton prostatepsei apo ten timoria Tou Allakh).
(Orkizomai) ma ton ourano pou einai apo tis idiotetes tou na epistrephei piso (brokhes, aktines, thermoteta, ekhetika kumata klp.)!
Kai ma te Ge pou einai apo tis idiotetes tes na ekhei rogmes!
Oti auto (to Kor'an) einai enas Logos pou diakhorizei (ten aletheia apo to pseudos),
Kai den einai kati phaidro.
St' aletheia, autoi skhediazoun sunomotika ena skhedio (enantion sou, o, Mokhammant),
Alla ki Ego skhediazo to skhedio (Mou, pou tha deixei ten aletheia kai tha katastrepsei ten plane kai to pseudos).
Gi' auto, dose anabole stous apistous, mia mikre anabole (del. me biasteis na pesei e timoria pano tous amesa).
Doxaze to Onoma tou Kuriou sou, tou Upsistou,
Autou pou demiourgese (ta panta) se teleia morphe,

Autou pou orise (ta panta) kai epeita kathodegese (kathe demiourgema gia to ti tou tairiazei, kathodegese ton anthropo oste na xekhorizei ton kalo apo ton kako dromo, kathodegese ta zoa sta boskotopia ktl.),
Autou pou ekane na bgoun oi (prasinoi) boskotopoi,
Kai epeita to ekane na einai xero skouro akhuro.
(O, Prophete) tha sou didaxoume na apaggelleis (to Kor'an) kai tipote den tha xekhaseis.
Ektos o,ti thelei o Allakh (gia kapoia sophia). St' aletheia Autos gnorizei ta phanera kai osa einai krupha.
Kai tha se dieukolunoume pros ton eukolo dromo (ton kalon praxeon).

Gi' auto, nouthetese (o, Mokhammant tous anthropous), an e nouthesia tha einai ophelime (del. gi' auton pou thelei kai men kourazeis ton eauto sou m' auton pou e nouthesia den ton auxanei para mono se alazoneia kai apistia)!
Tha nouthetethei autos pou phobatai (ton Allakh).
Kai tha ten apophugei (ten nouthesia sou) o athlios,
Autos pou tha eisakhthei gia na kaei ste Megalutere Photia,
Epeita oute tha pethanei ekei (gia na anapauthei) oute tha zesei.
St' aletheia, tha epitukhei opoios exagnizetai (apopheugontas ten apistia kai tis amarties).
Kai mnemoneuei to Onoma tou Kuriou tou kai proseukhetai.
St' aletheia, protimate (o, anthropoi) ten egkosmia zoe,
Eno e Mellousa Zoe einai kalutere kai diarkei perissotero.
St' aletheia, autes (oi proeidopoieseis) einai (grammenes epises) stis protes graphes,
Stis graphes tou Impraem (Abraam) kai tou Mouse.
Sou erthe (o, Mokhammant) e eidese tes Al-Gasigia (del. tes Emeras tes Anastases, pou periballei tous anthropous me ta tromera tes gegonota);
Kapoia prosopa, ekeine ten Emera, tha einai tapeinomena.
Douleuontas (sklera) exantlemena (apo te douleia).
Kathos kaigontai se mia puraktomene Photia,
Tha tous dothei na pioun apo mia pege pou brazei dunata.
De tha ekhoun trophe para apo Ntarei' (agkathoto pikro phuto, me askheme murodia kai emphanise),
Pou oute trephei, oute ikanopoiei ten peina.
Alla prosopa ekeine ten Emera tha einai kharoumena (me ten eudaimonia pou elaban),
Gia tis prospatheies tous (gia tis kales praxeis pou ekanan sten egkosmia zoe) tha einai ikanopoiemena (ste Mellousa Zoe, me ten amoibe pou elaban),
S' enan upselo Paradeiso.
Opou den tha akoun Lagouo (kaka, mataia, blabera logia).
Mesa tou uparkhei mia trekhoumene pege (del. peges pou tis kanoun oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou na trekhoun opou theloun).
Kai uperupsomena krebatia.
Kai poteria topothetemena (kai proetoimasmena gi' opoion thelei),
Kai maxilaria taktopoiemena se seires (e mia dipla apo ten alle).
Kai polutele khalia stromena pantou.
Ma den koitoun (sullogizontai, oi apistoi) tis kameles* pos demiourgethekan;
Kai ton ourano* pos anupsotheke;
Kai ta bouna* pos anegerthekan (kai phtiakhtekan stathera);
Kai te Ge* pos aplotheke (oste na einai katoikesime);
Upenthumise tous, loipon (o, Mokhammant), st' aletheia esu eisai mono gia na tous upenthumizeis,
Kai den sou ekhei anatethei na tous anagkaseis.
Ma oso gi' ekeinon pou apomakruntheke kai arnetheke ten piste,
O Allakh tha ton timoresei me to megisto marturio.
St' aletheia, s' Emas tha einai e epistrophe tous.
Epeita, s' Emas enapokeitai na tous pheroume gia logodotese.
(Orkizomai) ma ten auge!
Kai ma tis deka nukhtes (tis protes deka nukhtes tou seleniakou mena De El-Khitza)!
Kai ma to As-Saph' (zugo) kai to Al-Ouatr (mono)!
Kai ma te nukhta otan perna!
Einai oi parapano orkoi eparkeis gi' auton pou ekhei mualo (etsi oste na peistei);
Den eides (o, Mokhammant) ti ekane o Kurios sou stous 'Ant (ton lao tou Prophete Khount, kai pos tous katestrepse);
(Oi opoioi etan apo te Phule) Iram pou etan polu pseloi kai me terastia duname,
San ten opoia (phule kai anthropous) de demiourgetheke pote tipote ste ge!
(Epises, den eides ti ekane o Kurios sou) kai stous Thamount (ton lao tou Prophete Salikh) pou ekoban kai eskaban tis petres (ton bounon) sten koilada (gia na phtiaxoun katoikies mesa sta bouna)!
(Epises, den eides ti ekane o Kurios sou) kai ston Pharao, auton pou eikhe tous passalous (pano stous opoious basanize tous anthropous);
Ekeinoi (del. 'Ant, Thamount kai Pharao) pou turannousan stis khores (tous),
Kai auxesan mesa tous (stis khores) to kako,
Kai etsi, o Kurios sou erixe pano tous polu austero kai epoduno marturio.
Pragmati, o Kurios sou parakolouthei (tis praxeis olon ton anthropon, kai antameibei ton pistous kai timorei tous apistous kai tous amartolous).
Oso gia ton anthropo, otan o Kurios tou ton dokimazei, dinontas tou time kai khares, tote autos leei: <<O Kurios mou me timese.>>
Otan omos ton dokimazei, steneuontas ta bioporistika mesa tou, tote o anthropos leei: <<O Kurios mou me tapeinose.>>
Okhi (den einai opos phantazeste oti oi eunoies einai endeixe eukharisteses tou Allakh s' esas, kai to antistrepho)! Alla eseis den timate to orphano (dinontas tou apo o,ti sas parekhei o Allakh),
Kai oute entharrunete o enas ton allo sto na taIzete ton phtokho,

Kai katabrokhthizete ten kleronomia me megale aplestia (adiaphorontas an einai nomimo e okhi, del. pairnontas to meridio sas kai to meridio ton allon, opos ton gunaikon, ton adunamon kai ton paidion, sterontas tous to dikaioma tous sten kleronomia).
Kai agapate ta ploute me uperbolike agape.
Okhi! Otan e Ge (seistei dunata kai) isopedothei pleros (me o,ti ekhei pano tes apo bouna kai ktiria klp.)
Kai o Kurios sou erthei (gia na krinei metaxu ton demiourgematon), kai oi aggeloi kata taxeis, seira - seira,
Kai ekeine ten Emera, e Kolase metapherthei konta (parousiastei), tote ekeine ten Emera o anthropos tha thumethei (o,ti ekane kata ten egkosmia zoe), alla pos tha ton ophelesei e thumese;
Tha pei: <<Oime! Makari na eikha kanei (kales praxeis kata ten egkosmia zoe) gia te zoe mou (ste Mellousa Zoe)!>>
Ekeine ten Emera de tha uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na timoresei, opos tha timoresei (o Allakh) (toso austera).
Oute tha uparkhei kaneis pou mporei na alusodesei (toso dunata) opos Autos alusodenei (del. oi aggeloi tha alusodesoun tous apistous polu dunata).
(Stous dikaious tha eipothei:) <<O, ephesukhasmene psukhe,
Epestrepse ston Kurio sou ikanopoiemene kai labe ten euarestese (tou Allakh),
Kai mpes anamesa stous (enaretous) doulous Mou,
Kai mpes ston Paradeiso Mou.>>
(Orkizomai) ma auten ten pole (Makka)!
Opou esu (o, Mokhammant) diameneis.
Kai ma ton patera (ton Adam) kai o,ti apektese (apo apogonous)!
Oti, st' aletheia demiourgesame ton anthropo se mokhtho (del. tha antimetopisei duskolies sten egkosmia zoe, apo douleies kai dokimasies ktl.).
Nomizei (o anthropos) pos (an diaprattei amarties) kaneis den mporei na ton upernikesei (kai na ton timoresei gia autes);
Leei (kaukhomenos): <<Spatalesa aphthona ploute.>>
Nomizei pos kaneis den ton eide;
Ma den tou dosame duo matia,
Kai mia glossa kai duo kheile;
Kai den tou deixame tous duo (phanerous) dromous (tou kalou kai tou kakou, oste na dialexei se poion dromo tha paei);
Omos autos den xeperase to empodio (pou ton diakhorizei apo ton Paradeiso).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) ti einai auto to empodio (pou prepei na to xeperasei gia na eiselthei ston Paradeiso);
Einai e apeleutherose enos sklabou,
E to taIsma, se mera megales peinas,
Enos orphanou (kai eidika autou) pou einai suggenes,
E enos phtokhou pou brisketai se megale anagke,
Epeita egine (autos pou kanei ta parapano) enas ap' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai sustenoun o enas ston allo na einai upomonetikoi, kai sustenoun o enas ston allon na deikhnoun eleos kai sumponoia.
Autoi einai oi anthropoi pou tha briskontai sta dexia (del. einai oi katoikoi tou Paradeisou),
Eno ekeinoi pou arnethekan ta Edaphia (kai ta Semadia) Mas, einai oi anthropoi pou tha briskontai sta aristera (del. einai oi katoikoi tes Kolaseos).
Pou tha kleistoun ste Photia.
(Orkizomai) ma ton elio kai te lamproteta tou!
Kai ma to pheggari kathos akolouthei auton (ton elio)!
Kai ma ten emera kathos emphanizei te lamproteta tou (eliou)!
Kai ma te nukhta otan ton kaluptei (ton elio, skepazontas me to skotadi tes ena meros tes Ges apo tis aktines tou eliou)!
Kai ma ton ourano kai Auton pou ton oikodomese!
Kai ma te Ge kai Auton pou ten estrose!
Kai ma ten psukhe (del. ton anthropo) kai Auton pou ten eplase kai ten teleiopoiese se analogies!
Kai enepneuse s' auten ti einai asebeia gi' auten, kai ti einai eusebeia gi' auten (oste na xekhorizei ton kako dromo apo ton kalo dromo).
Oti pragmati, petukhemenos einai autos pou ten exagnizei (ten psukhe tou, meso tou kalou),
Kai apotukhemenos einai autos pou ten khamelonei (ten psukhe tou) krubontas ten (anamesa stis amarties).
Oi Thamount diepseusan (ton Prophete tous, ton Salikh) meso tes parabiases ton orion tous (kai tes adikias, parakoes kai alazoneias tous),

Otan o pio athlios ap' autous espeuse (gia na skotosei ten kamela, pou o Allakh ten ekane os thauma gi' autous, aphou zetesan apo ton Prophete Salikh apodeixe oti einai Prophetes. Etsi, o Allakh orise gia ten kamela mia mera na piei, eno ekeinoi okhi, kai ten alle mera na pioun eno ekeine okhi, kai gi' auto ethelan na te skotosoun).
Ma o Apestalmenos tou Allakh (o Salikh) tous eipe: <<(Prosexte, men skotosete) ten kamela tou Allakh, kai (oute na ten apotrepsete apo) to meridio tes sto nero (ten emera tes).>>
Alla autoi ton diepseusan kai te skotosan. Etsi, exaitias tes amartias tous, o Kurios tous orgisteke mazi tous kai ephere ten katastrophe pano s' olous tous.
Kai den phobatai (o Allakh) te sunepeia autou pou ekane (del. den mporoun na blapsoun ton Allakh se tipote).
(Orkizomai) ma te nukhta kathos kaluptei (me to skotadi tes, ena meros tes Ges)!
Kai ma ten emera kathos emphanizetai (me to phos tes)!
Kai ma Ekeinon pou demiourgese to arseniko kai to theluko!
Oti pragmati, oi praxeis sas diapheroun (kapoioi apo sas prattoun kales praxeis gia na laboun ten amoibe tou Allakh, eno alloi diaprattoun to kako, pou einai enas logos gia na eiselthoun ste Photia).
Ma, oson aphora auton pou dinei (apo ton plouto tou se philanthropia) kai phulassetai apo ten timoria tou Allakh (ektelontas tis Entoles Tou),
Kai pisteuei sten Al-Khousna (oti o Allakh tha ton apozemiosei gia o,ti xodepse se philanthropia, kai oti tha ton antameipsei gia ta kala erga tou),
Tha tou dieukolunoume na phtasei sto eukolo monopati (tou kalou).
Alla, oson aphora ekeinon pou einai philarguros kai adiaphorei gia ten antamoibe tou Allakh,
Kai diepseude ten Al-Khousna (oti o Allakh tha ton apozemiosei gia o,ti xodepse se philanthropia, kai oti tha ton antameipsei gia ta kala erga tou),
Tha tou dieukolunoume na phtasei sto duskolo monopati (tou kakou kai kathe duskolias, kai etsi na pesei pano tou e timoria tou Allakh).
Kai den tha ton ophelesoun ta ploute tou otan tha pesei (sten Kolase).
St' aletheia, Emeis eimaste pou kathodegoume.
Kai s' Emas anekoun e teleutaia (del. e Mellousa Zoe) kai e prote (del. e egkosmia zoe).
Gi' auto sas proeidopoiesa gia mia puraktomene Photia,
Sten opoia den tha pesei gia na kaei, para mono o pio athlios,
Pou diepseuse (ton Prophete Mokhammant) kai apomakruntheke (apo ten piste).
Kai tha ten apophugei (te Photia) o pio eusebes (pou phulassetai polu apo ten timoria tou Allakh, ektelontas tis entoles Tou),
Pou dinei apo ta ploute tou (stous phtokhous) gia na exagnisei ton eauto tou (kai ta ploute tou),
Kai (auta pou xodeuei se eleemosune) den (einai epeide) opheilei se kanenan kamia khare pou tha prepei na ten antapodosei,
Alla (ta dinei) anazetontas ten euarestese tou Kuriou tou, tou Upsistou.
Kai pragmati tha eukharistethei (me o,ti tha tou dosei o Allakh apo antamoibe).
(Orkizomai) ma to Ant-Ntoukha (ten arkhe tes emeras e ole ten emera)!
Kai ma te nukhta otan skoteiniazei!

Oti, pragmati, o Kurios sou oute se egkateleipse (o, Mokhammant) oute se misei (opos iskhuristekan oi apistoi tes Makkas legontas: <<O, Mokhammant o Kurios sou se egkateleipse.>>, otan o aggelos Gabriel den tou erthe me apokalupse gia kapoies meres).
Kai pragmati, e Mellousa Zoe tha einai kalutere gia sena apo ten egkosmia zoe.
Kai o Kurios sou tha sou dosei (me aphthonia, kata te Mellousa zoe) kai tha eukharistetheis.
Ma den se eide (o Allakh) orphano (o, Mokhammant) kai sou edose kataphugio (kai phrontida);
Kai den se eide periplanomeno (del. den exeres ti einai to Kor'an oute ti einai e piste) kai se kathodegese (kai sou didaxe);
Kai den se eide phtokho kai se ekane ikanopoiemeno me o,ti sou parekhei (kai ikanopoiemeno me ton eauto sou);
Gi' auto, loipon, ton orphano men ton katapiezeis (oute na ton metakheirizesai me kako tropo),
Kai ton epaite men ton apotheis (alla phrontise ten anagke tou, kai dose tou phageto),
Kai gia tis Khares (del. ten Apostole kai tis alles Khares) tou Kuriou sou (pou sou edose) mila.
Ma den sou anoixame (o Mokhammant) to stethos (gia ten kathodegese, ten piste kai te sophia);
Kai den sou aphairesame to phortio sou,
Pou baraine ten plate sou;
Kai den anupsosame to onoma sou (to opoio anapheretai se kathe Adan -kalesma gia ten proseukhe-);
Pragmati, mazi me kathe duskolia erkhetai anakouphise (gi' auto men apheneis te blabe pou lambaneis apo tous apistous na se stamatesei apo to kalesma pros ton Allakh kai te threskeia Tou).
Pragmati, mazi me kathe duskolia erkhetai anakouphise.
Kai otan loipon teleioseis (apo tis kathemerines askholies sou), aphosiosou ste latreia (pros ton Allakh) sthenara,
Kai ston Kurio sou apeuthune oles tis protheseis kai tis elpides sou!
(Orkizomai) ma to suko kai ten elia [anapheretai ston topo opou xekinese e apostole tou Iesou],
Kai ma to Oros tes Sinein [pou ekhei polla dentra, kai anapheretai ston topo opou milese o Allakh ston Mouse],
Kai ma auten ten asphale Pole (te Makka opou xekinese e apostole tou Mokhammant)!
Oti pragmati, demiourgesame ton anthropo sten kalutere morphe (orthio, isio kai isorropemeno ste morphe kai ste phuse tou).
Epeita, ton balame sto katotero ton katoteron (del. sto katotero bathos tes Kolases, an den upakouei ton Allakh).
Ektos ap' ekeinous pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis. Autoi tha ekhoun ateleiote kai adiakope amoibe (ton Paradeiso).
Ti loipon, se kanei (o, apiste) na diapseuseis ten Emera tes Kriseos (aphou eides apo ta Semadia tou Allakh pou deikhnoun te Duname Tou se olo to sumpan);
Ma den einai o Allakh o Dikaioteros (kai o Sophoteros) ton kriton (orizontas ten Emera tes Kriseos gia na antameipsei tous kalous kai na timoresei tous kakous); (Bebaios, Einai).
Apaggelne sto Onoma tou Kuriou sou, pou demiourgese.
Demiourgese ton anthropo apo 'Alak (kremameno thrombo aimatos).
Apaggelne kai o Kurios sou einai o Al-Akram (o pio Gennaiodoros).
Autos pou didaxe (sta plasmata Tou) ten pena (te khrese tes).
Didaxe ton anthropo (ena meros apo) o,ti den gnorize (o anthropos).
Okhi! St' aletheia, o anthropos parabiazei (ta oria se kakes praxeis),
Epeide blepei ton eauto tou autarke (me o,ti ekhei apo ploute).
St' aletheia, ston Kurio sou tha einai e epistrophe (olon ton anthropon).
Eides (o, Mokhammant) ekeinon (ton Ampou Tzakhl) pou apotrepei,
Ton doulo (Mas, ton Mokhammant) apo to na proseukhetai (sten Ka'mpa);
Blepeis (o, Mokhammant) an (o doulos Mas, del. o idios o Mokhammant) etan sten kathodegese,
Kai an diatazei ten eusebeia; [Del. pos thelei o Ampou Tzakhl na apotrepei ton Mokhammant apo ten proseukhe aphou o Mokhammant brisketai sten kathodegese kai diatazei ten eusebeia;]
Blepeis (o, Mokhammant) an (o adikos o Ampou Tzakhl) diepseuse (to Kor'an) kai apomakruntheke (apo te piste);
Ma den xerei (autos o adikos), oti o Allakh blepei (o,ti kanei);
Okhi! An den papsei, tha ton arpaxoume kai tha ton suroume apo to metopo,
To opoio metopo einai pseutes kai amartolo!
As phonaxei tous uposteriktes tou (apo to lao tou, opos sou eipe, o, Mokhammant: <<Ekho tous perissoterous uposteriktes ste phule.>>).
Emeis, omos, tha phonaxoume tous aggelous phulakes tes Kolases (gia na ton suroun ste Photia, kata te Mellousa zoe).
Okhi! Men ton upakous (se tipote), alla pese se Sitzount stase (me to metopo kai tis palames sto edaphos, proseukhomenos) kai plesiase (ton Kurio sou meso ton kalon praxeon).

Pragmati, Emeis to katebasame (to Kor'an apo to Al-Laoukh Al-Makhphoud -ton Diateremeno Pinaka- kai to steilame ston proto ourano, kai ste sunekheia apokaluphthekan ta prota Edaphia ston Prophete) kata te Nukhta tou Al-Kantr (-tou Diatagmatos-, kata ton mena tou Ramantan).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) poso megaleiodes einai e Nukhta tou Al-Kantr;
E Nukhta tou Al-Kantr einai kalutere apo khilious menes (del. e latreia pros ton Allakh ekeine te nukhta einai kalutere apo khilious menes latreias pros Auton, delade 83 khronia kai 4 menes).
Oi aggeloi kai to Ar-Roukh (del. o Gabriel) katebainoun auten te nukhta me ten adeia tou Kuriou tous me ola ta diatagmata (gia oles tis upotheseis autes tes khronias).
Kai ekhei eirene (oloklere auten ten nukhta) mekhri ten enarxe tes auges.

Ekeinoi pou apistesan apo to lao tou Bibliou (pou bgekan apo ten orthe piste pros ton Allakh meso ton kainotomion tous) kathos kai oi polutheistes, pote de tha stamatousan (ten apistia tous), mekhri na tous erkhotan e saphes apodeixe.
(Aute e saphes apodeixe einai) enas Apestalmenos apo ton Allakh pou apaggellei agnotates graphes (to Kor'an),
Pou mesa tous uparkhoun ortha grapta (dikaioi nomoi kai entoles kai alethines eideseis).

Kai st' aletheia, ekeinoi stous opoious dotheke to Biblio (Ebraioi kai Khristianoi, pou perimenan oloi ton erkhomo enos Prophete) den diepheran metaxu tous (skhetika m' auton) para mono aphou tous erthe e saphes apodeixe (del. o Prophetes Mokhammant pou pleroi tis perigraphes pou anapherontai stis Graphes tous, kai etsi diaphonesan metaxu tous, kai kapoioi ap' autous pistepsan s' auton eno alloi ton arnethekan).

Kai pragmati, den diatakhthekan, para na latreuoun (mono) ton Allakh, kai na einai aphosiomenoi pros Auton ste threskeia kai na einai Khounapha' (na apekhoun apo ola ta mataia dogmata kai na klinoun mono pros to Islam), kai na teloun tis proseukhes kai na dinoun te Zaka (etesia upokhreotike eleemosune): kai aute einai e orthe threskeia.

St' aletheia, osoi apo to lao tou Bibliou (Khristianous kai Ebraious) arnethekan ten piste (ston Prophete Mokhammant) kathos kai oi polutheistes, tha briskontai (kata te Mellousa Zoe) sto Pur tes Kolaseos, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta. Autoi einai oi kheiroteroi ton plasmaton.
Pragmati, autoi pou pisteuoun kai kanoun enaretes praxeis, einai oi kaluteroi ton plasmaton.

E amoibe tous tha einai apo ton Kurio tous, oi kepoi monimes diamones (Paradeiso), kato apo tous opoious (del. kato apo ta palatia kai ta dentra tous) reoun potamia, opou tha meinoun ekei mesa gia panta. O Allakh tha einai Eukharistemenos ap' autous, ki autoi tha einai eukharistemenoi ap' Auton. Aute (e amoibe) tha einai gia opoion phobatai ton Kurio tou (apekhontas apo tis apagoreuseis Tou).
Otan e Ge seistei apo ton (dunato) seismo tes,
Kai otan e Ge apobalei ta bare tes (tous nekrous),
Kai o anthropos (tromagmenos kai ekplektos) tha pei <<Ti sumbainei m' aute;>>
Ekeine ten Emera (e Ge) tha pei tis istories tes (ti kalo kai ti kako egine pano tes),
Epeide o Kurios sou tha ten empneusei (kai tha ten diataxei na pei).

Ekeine ten emera oi anthropoi tha prokhoresoun khorismenoi (se omades, apo ton topo tes Krises pros ton teliko proorismo tous), gia na tous deixoun tis praxeis tous (del. ten amoibe e ten timoria tous).
Opoios kanei kalo (kata ten egkosmia zoe, esto kai) iso me to baros enos atomou (moriou), tha to dei (del. ten amoibe tou kata te Mellousa Zoe),
Kai opoios kanei kako (kata ten egkosmia zoe, esto kai) iso me to baros enos atomou (moriou) tha to dei (del. ten timoria tou kata te Mellousa Zoe).
(Orkizomai) ma auta (ta aloga) pou trekhoun dunata (sto dromo tou Allakh) mekhri pou akougetai e anasa tous (apo to dunato treximo tous)!
Kai ma auta (ta aloga) pou (apo tis oples tous otan khtupoun tis petres) bgazoun spithes (exaitias tes entases tou treximatos tous)!
Kai ma auta (ta aloga) pou epitithentai (stous ekhthrous) to proi!
Kai sekonoun apo to treximo tous skone,
Kai mpekan m' autous (tous ippotes tous) ste mese tou plethous (tou ekhthrou).
Oti pragmati, o anthropos einai agnomon pros ton Kurio tou.
Kai o idios einai marturas s' auto (sten akharistia tou pros ton Kurio tou).
Kai st' aletheia, diakatekhetai apo uperbolike agape gia ta ploute.
Ma den xerei (o anthropos ti ton perimenei) otan bgoun kai skorpistoun osoi briskontai stous taphous (kata ten anastase),
Kai phanerothoun auta pou briskontai mesa sta stethe (ton anthropon);
St' aletheia, o Kurios tous, ekeine ten Emera, gnorizei pleros gi' autous (oles tis praxeis kai tis upotheseis tous).
E Al-Kari'a (del. e Emera tes Kriseos pou ktupa tis kardies ton anthropon me ta tromaktika gegonota pou tha ginoun ekeine ten Emera).
Ti einai loipon e Al-Kari'a;
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) poso megaleiodes einai e Al-Kari'a;
Einai e Emera kata ten opoia oi anthropoi tha einai san tis skorpismenes nukhtopetaloudes,
Kai ta bouna tha einai san phouskomeno malli.
Oso gi' auton tou opoiou e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai baria,
Tha ekhei mia eukhariste zoe (ston Paradeiso).
Ma oso gi' auton tou opoiou e zugaria (ton kalon praxeon) tha einai elaphria,
Tha ekhei os katoikia tou ten Al-Khaouigia (abusso, del. to Pur).
Kai pos na xereis (o, Prophete) ti einai (e Al-Khaouigia);
Einai mia puraktomene Photia.
Sas apaskholei o pothos gia ten auxese (tou ploutou, ton paidion, tes exousias ktl. apo te latreia tou Allakh),
Mekhri pou tha episkephteite tous taphous (del. tha pethanete).
Okhi! St' aletheia tha mathete (otan pethanete to apotelesma tou na eiste apaskholemenoi me alla ektos apo ten latreia tou Allakh).
Kai pali okhi! St' aletheia tha mathete!
Okhi! An gnorizate me sigoure gnose (oti o Allakh tha sas anastesei ten Emera tes Kriseos, den tha sas apaskholouse tipote apo te latreia tou Allakh)!
St' aletheia, tha deite to Pur tes Kolaseos.
Epeita, tha to deite me bebaioteta (khoris kamia amphibolia),
Kai epeita, ekeine ten Emera tha rotetheite gia tis apolauseis (stis opoies epididosastan kata ten egkosmia zoe).
(Orkizomai) ma to Al-'Asr (to Khrono)!
Oti o anthropos brisketai se apoleia,
Ektos ap' ekeinous pou pisteuoun, kanoun enaretes praxeis, sunistoun o enas ston allo ten aletheia (ten alethine piste kai to na prattoun kales praxeis) kai sunistoun o enas ston allo ten upomone.
Alimono ston sukophante pou kakologei tous allous piso apo ten plate tous.
O opoios mazeue ploute kai ta metrouse xana kai xana.
Nomizontas oti ta ploute tou tha ton kanoun na zesei aionia.
Okhi! Pragmati, tha rikhtei sten Al-Khoutama (Spastera, te Photia pou spaei o,ti rikhtei mesa tes).
Kai pos na xereis poso megaleiodes einai e Al-Khoutama (Spasteras);
(Einai) e Photia tou Allakh pou einai (aionia) phountomene.
Pou dieisduei (mesa sta somata kai phtanei) eos tis kardies.
Einai kleidomene perikleiontas tous (apistous) mesa tes.
Me makries mpares (oste na men mporesoun na bgoun ap' aute).

Den eides (o Mokhammant) ti ekane o Kurios sou m' ekeinous pou kateikhan ton elephanta; [anapheretai sto strato tou Amprakha Al-'Asram, pou prospathese na katastrepsei ten Ka'mpa me enan terastio elephanta].
Den odegese (o Allakh) to skhedio tous se apotukhia;
Kai esteile katapano tous smene apo poulia,
Khtupontas tous me petres apo psemeno pelo;
Kai etsi, tous ekane (o Allakh) san phagomeno sano (pou to ephagan ta zoa kai epeita to aphodeusan).

Thaumaste te sunetheia ton Kourais (kai tis khares tou Allakh s' autous, tous prostateuse apo ton strato me ton elephanta, statheropoiese ta sumpheronta tous parolo pou zoun se agone eremo, meso tou na taxideuoun me asphaleia gia na pheroun oti khreiazontai).
E sunetheia tous to na taxideuoun (ta emporika karabania) to kheimona (pros ten Uemene) kai to kalokairi (pros ten palia Suria).
As latreuoun loipon ton Kurio autou tou Oikou (ste Makka),
Auton pou tous taize (sozontas tous) apo ten peina kai tous ekane na aisthanontai asphaleis apo to phobo.
Eides (o, Prophete) ekeinon pou diapseudei (ten anastase, ton apologismo kai) ten antapodose;
Einai autos pou diokhnei ton orphano (apo ta dikaiomata tou) me sklerada,
Kai den protrepei sto taisma tou endee (del. oute autos taIzei tous phtokhous, oute protrepei tous allous na to kanoun).
Alimono s' ekeinous (tous upokrites) pou proseukhontai,
Oi opoioi ameloun tis proseukhes tous (kai tis kathusteroun apo tis ores tous apo adiaphoria kai ameleia, kai den tis teloun me ton sosto tropo).
Oi opoioi kanoun (kales praxeis mono kai mono gia) epideixe,

Kai arnountai na daneisoun osa ophelema pragmata ekhoun (stous anthropous akoma kai an einai mikra pragmata), [opos otan o geitonas zetesei na daneistei kati mikro apo ta oikiaka skeue, arnountai na tou to dosoun].
St' aletheia, Emeis sou dosame (o, Mokhammant) to Al-Kaouthar (ena potami ston Paradeiso).
Gi' auto telese, loipon, ten proseukhe pros ton Kurio sou (me eilikrineia kai aphosiose pros Auton kai mono) kai prosphere thusia (gia tous phtokhous, gia Khare tou Allakh kai mono).

Pragmati, ekeinos pou se misei einai o apokommenos (apo ten euemeria kai apo kathe kalo s' auton ton kosmo kai ste Mellousa Zoe), [anapheretai se enan andra pou milese gia ton Prophete khleuazontas oti o Prophetes einai akleros apo gious, kai to onoma tou den tha sunekhistei meta apo to thanato tou, alla o Allakh tou apantese oti autos einai o apokommenos kai okhi o Prophetes]!
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<O, apistoi!
Ego den latreuo auta pou eseis latreuete,
Oute eseis latreuete Auton pou ego latreuo.
Kai oute ego tha latreuo auta pou eseis latreuete,
Kai oute eseis tha latreuete Auton pou ego latreuo.
Eseis ekhete te threskeia sas kai ego ekho te threskeia mou.>>
Otan erthei e Nike apo ton Allakh kai e kataktese (tes Makkas),
Kai blepeis tous anthropous na eiserkhontai ste threskeia tou Allakh se plethe,
Tote doxase ton Kurio sou eugnomonontas Ton, kai zeta te sugkhorese Tou. St' aletheia, einai Ekeinos pou panta apodekhetai te metameleia kai sugkhorei.

As khasoun ta kheria tou Ampou Lakhamp (del. as khasei kai as talaiporethei o idios), kai pragmati o idios ekhase kai talaiporetheke! [o opoios etan o theios tou Prophete kai enas apo tous ekhthrous tou].
Den ton prostatepsan (apo ten timoria tou Allakh) ta ploute tou, oute o,ti apektese (apo paidia).
Tha eisakhthei ste Photia pou ekhei (agries) phloges gia na kaei mesa tes,
Epises kai e gunaika tou, aute pou koubalaei kausoxula (del. ta agkathia pou koubalouse gia na ta balei sto dromo tou Prophete oste na ton blapsei),
Tha ekhei guro apo to laimo tes ena skhoini apo Masant (polu skleres plegmenes ines, me to opoio tha upsothei sten Kolase kai epeita tha rikhtei kato).
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Autos einai o Allakh, o Akhant (Enas, Monadikos kai Adiairetos).
O Allakh, o As-Samant (o Autarkes, pou den ekhei anagke tipote apo ta plasmata Tou, alla auta ekhoun anagke ap' Auton, kai Autos oute troei, oute pinei, oute pethainei).
De gennese, oute gennetheke.
Kai kanenas den einai isos e sugkrisimos m' Auton.>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Anazeto kataphugio ston Kurio tes Kharauges,
Apo to kako (pou proerkhetai) apo ta demiourgemata pou eplase,
Kai to kako tes nukhtas me to bathu skotadi tes otan diakheetai (kai kaluptei ta panta),
Kai to kako ekeinon (ton magisson) pou phusoun stous kompous,
Kai to kako tou zelophthonou otan matiazei.>>
Pes (o, Mokhammant): <<Anazeto kataphugio ston Kurio ton anthropon,
Ton Basilia ton anthropon,
To Theo ton anthropon,
Apo to kako tou upoulou psithuriste (tou diabolou, pou psithurizei to kako stis kardies ton anthropon), pou aposuretai (apo ton psithuro tou, molis kapoios mnemoneusei ton Allakh),
Pou psithurizei (to kako) sta stethe (kai stis kardies) ton anthropon,
Kai apo (to kako pou proerkhetai apo) ta tzinn kai tous anthropous.
